Having reached this conclusion, Lin Yu decided to go see for himself.
With the pistol on him, he wasn't afraid of Bao Liu going berserk and attacking him.
Lin Yu left the storage room and headed toward the opposite side of the first floor.
Soon...
At the restroom entrance, Lin Yu saw Yao Zhengye's corpse lying in a pool of blood and Bao Liu panting heavily beside it.
Bao Liu's hands were covered in blood - he hadn't even used any Werewolf weapons!
Their fight had been bare-handed!
In the end, Bao Liu had beaten Yao Zhengye to death with his fists!
Noticing Lin Yu approaching from a distance, Bao Liu straightened up while catching his breath.
"Well, if it isn't the honorable Game Master... I wasn't expecting company!"
Lin Yu smiled as he spoke.
"Haha, you players never fail to surprise me... I truly didn't expect the first death to come so quickly!"
Bao Liu chuckled at this: "Heh... any first blood rewards or something?"
"Not officially, but since you asked, here's some free information - behind you in the restroom, there's a 'Werewolf weapon container' under the sink. Hope you find it useful."
Lin Yu said with a smile.
Bao Liu narrowed his eyes: "Oh? I thought you didn't know our 'faction identities'?"
"I don't know for certain, but I can make educated guesses," Lin Yu replied cheerfully. "Attacking so quickly... and judging by how you initiated against Yao Zhengye, you must belong to a faction that requires 'killing' - in your view, you'd have to do it eventually anyway, right?"
Bao Liu nodded meaningfully.
He turned and entered the restroom, indeed finding a hidden Werewolf container beneath the sink.
Without bothering to hide from Lin Yu, Bao Liu opened it and pulled out a hammer.
"Bit underwhelming, but... better than nothing."
Bao Liu weighed the hammer in his hand as he commented.
Gripping the hammer, he turned to Lin Yu with renewed ferocity in his expression.
"Say, Game Master, don't I still have one 'question' left unused?"
As Bao Liu spoke, Lin Yu nodded calmly.
"Of course, would you like to ask now?"
"Alright... my question is - where is the nearest other player?"
Bao Liu's face twisted into an excited, bloodthirsty grin.
Lin Yu glanced at the map and answered casually.
"At this exact moment... the 'Veterinarian' is on the spiral staircase between the first and second floors in the castle's central area."
"But she's moving too."
As Lin Yu spoke, Bao Liu's eyes narrowed with murderous intent.
"Veterinarian, huh? Got it..."
He licked his lips and strode purposefully toward the central staircase.
Lin Yu could roughly guess Bao Liu's strategy as the Ruffian - his approach was brutally simple.
Before the bodies of those he killed were discovered...
Kill as many as possible!
Whether they were teammates didn't matter...
What mattered was killing!
Eliminate everyone else, and the game is won!
"Excellent, Bao Liu, I'm starting to like you..."
Lin Yu murmured as he watched Bao Liu's retreating figure.
Without question...
Bao Liu's mindset and actions were exactly what Lin Yu wanted to see right now.
That's precisely why Lin Yu had approached Bao Liu after seeing him kill Yao Zhengye, even helpfully pointing out where to find "weapons."
Once someone starts killing, it becomes easier to keep killing.
He looked at the map again...
Bao Liu's name rapidly closed in on Xia Yue.
And then...
In the next instant, Bao Liu's name abruptly vanished.
Lin Yu was stunned for a moment before...
He simply shrugged.
"Well, that works too!"
Lin Yu headed toward the staircase.
Soon enough, he found Bao Liu's corpse - a gruesome wound on his neck gushed blood, with two additional slash marks on his arm.
His eyes were wide open, as if he couldn't rest in peace.
Nearby, Xia Yue, who should have left already, had actually turned back from the second floor and returned.
Seeing Lin Yu, she relaxed slightly.
"Oh, it's you, Game Master..."
In Xia Yue's hand was a dagger - identical to the one she'd carried before.
This coincidence made Lin Yu sigh inwardly once more...
Fate truly worked in mysterious ways.
"Hello, do you have any questions you'd like to ask?"
Lin Yu smiled as he addressed Xia Yue.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
After some thought, Xia Yue blinked and asked:
"Game Master, may I ask - which players are still alive currently?"
"Besides you, there's the 'Lone Wolf', 'Soldier', 'Teacher', 'Otaku'..."
Lin Yu recited while checking the map, but suddenly paused mid-sentence.
"Oh wait, the 'Teacher' just died."
On the map, among the overlapping names of Xu Xiumei and Yu Longguo, Xu Xiumei's name had disappeared.
Honestly, seeing Xu Xiumei and Yu Longguo's names overlapping again had given Lin Yu quite a scare.
Fortunately, due to Lin Yu's earlier "announcement" and the fact that Xu Xiumei no longer had a pistol...
This time, the two...
Didn't get another chance to talk.
Now the only remaining Werewolves were Xia Yue and Yu Longguo.
It was astonishing... in just one short hour since the game began, so many had already died!
Last time, no one died throughout the entire day.
However...
This was good. It meant this game was nearing its conclusion.
Lin Yu turned to Xia Yue with a smile.
"Well then... Miss Veterinarian, I've answered your question."
"I'll be going now to check other areas. Good luck."

chapters.title: Chapter 26: The Troublesome Veterinarian! Lin Yu's Counter-Checkmate!
chapters.content:
After parting ways with Xia Yue, Lin Yu's next target was naturally Yu Longguo!
Even though he now possessed a pistol, Lin Yu still wasn't particularly eager to face Yu Longguo, the 'Soldier'...
But some meetings were unavoidable.
After all, that single bullet in the chamber was most likely meant for him!
With only Yu Longguo and Xia Yue remaining as 'Werewolves', Lin Yu's plan was to wait for them to eliminate each other before executing the survivor with his pistol.
Lin Yu arrived on the third floor.
After killing Xu Xiumei, Yu Longguo hadn't moved from his location.
Thus Lin Yu easily found Yu Longguo in the third-floor study.
The soldier was casually lifting Xu Xiumei's corpse, attempting to stash it atop a bookshelf.
Lin Yu approached the study door and politely knocked to announce his presence."Knock knock. Greetings, 'Soldier'."
Yu Longguo immediately turned around in alarm, relaxing when he saw it was Lin Yu.
"It's you, Game Master. What brings you here?"
Lin Yu smiled at Yu Longguo.
"Just came to check on your progress... Do you have any questions for me now that you've succeeded?"
Yu Longguo seemed surprised by Lin Yu's proactive approach.
"Hmm, didn't expect the Game Master to be so helpful," Yu Longguo muttered while stroking his chin. "As for questions..."
Just as Yu Longguo was pondering...
Rapid footsteps suddenly approached from behind Lin Yu.
"Huff—"
"'Soldier', don't be so quick to ask him anything!"
Xia Yue's voice abruptly rang out from behind Lin Yu.
Both Yu Longguo and Lin Yu turned to see the panting 'Veterinarian'.
In her hand, she openly carried a bloodstained dagger.
Yu Longguo frowned at Xia Yue. "You're that... Veterinarian. What do you want?"
Ignoring his question, Xia Yue looked at the half-concealed corpse on the bookshelf. "So you did kill the 'Teacher'. Don't bother explaining or attacking me yet—listen first!"
"I killed the 'Ruffian', and the 'Ruffian' had just killed the 'Thief' on the first floor—I found the body."
"That means currently, only you, me, the 'Otaku'... and this 'Game Master' remain alive," Xia Yue stated calmly.
Yu Longguo instantly grasped the crucial implication in her words.
"Are you suggesting the 'Game Master' is actually a player, and the 'Lone Wolf' doesn't exist?"
He looked at Xia Yue with undisguised wariness—clearly more suspicious of her than Lin Yu at this moment.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Lin Yu also regarded Xia Yue with interest.
"Accusing the Game Master? This batch of newcomers is truly fascinating!"
Xia Yue coldly addressed Lin Yu: "Stop acting... You're clearly the 'Lone Wolf'. This game probably never had a 'Game Master' to begin with!"
As she spoke, Lin Yu crossed his arms with amusement.
"And how did you reach this conclusion?"
"Because the killing pace is unnaturally fast... rendering all those supposedly 'complicated' rules from the letter meaningless!"
"Team divisions, voting meetings... even the tasks have become pointless—everyone will be dead within a day at this rate."
"This feels extremely 'abnormal'... And the root cause is the 'hints' provided by this so-called Game Master. His prompts have turned this into a simple closed-space killing game."
"In other words, if we removed the 'hints' from this Game Master... wouldn't we be playing the game as intended?"
"Another point—since entering this 'game', the setup actively avoids acknowledging it's a 'game'. Even the rules were delivered via letter."
"Yet this guy barges in boldly proclaiming himself 'Game Master'. Isn't that suspicious?"
As Xia Yue laid out her reasoning, Yu Longguo nodded slightly.
"Logical, but... not entirely convincing."
"These points alone shouldn't make you so certain."
Xia Yue smiled at his response. "Good, 'Soldier'—you're sharp. These weren't my definitive proofs."
"As the 'Veterinarian', my ability is conversing with animals," Xia Yue pointed at crows outside the window. "After growing suspicious, I spoke briefly with these crows... I asked two questions."
"First, whether they'd seen an eighth person in this manor besides our six and the 'Game Master'... Answer: no."
"Second, I inquired about the 'Game Master's' actions after game start—he immediately went to a storage room on the first floor and opened a supply crate."
"If he's truly the administrator... why would he need to open supply crates?"
Yu Longguo nodded thoughtfully.
"This does cast reasonable doubt on you, 'Game Master'... Though I'm curious how you knew so much about us."
His gaze at Lin Yu now held open suspicion.
"He might not necessarily be the 'Lone Wolf'. Knowing our personal details could be his profession ability," Xia Yue raised a finger. "Or... perhaps he isn't a new player and has special methods."
Yu Longguo narrowed his eyes.
"So your suggestion is—"
"Let's team up to challenge the 'Game Master'. After all, his goal seems to be having us all dead by day one."
Xia Yue grinned as she made her proposal.
"What brilliant deduction, Xia Yue. You've exceeded my expectations."
Lin Yu regarded the 'Veterinarian' with newfound respect.
To deduce he was the 'seventh player' from such limited information was impressive.
Though not entirely accurate... her reasoning was remarkably sharp.
Recalling the previous round, she'd even maintained a completely believable fake ability!
Last time, Lin Yu never guessed her true power was 'animal communication'.
Her early death then was simply due to terrible acting and challenging the wrong person.
Or perhaps the real reason—she'd been unlucky enough to be paired with him.
"Xia Yue, I underestimated you."
The praised Xia Yue flashed her sweet, innocent smile again. "Thank you, Game Master... But honestly, I just really want to survive."
Lin Yu chuckled.
"Is that so? Then you haven't gone far enough."
"Because while your deduction was brilliant... this game's foundation is ultimately violence."
With that, Lin Yu raised his hand.
"Bang!"
A gunshot echoed as Yu Longguo collapsed behind him in shock.
Then Lin Yu aimed the pistol at Xia Yue.
"Checkmate."

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Werewolves Eliminated, Game Over!
chapters.content:
After killing Yu Longguo, Lin Yu felt a wave of relief wash over him.
The most troublesome 'Soldier'... had finally been dealt with.
And so easily at that!
But Lin Yu didn't let his guard down completely.
Because Xia Yue was also a problematic opponent.
Lin Yu didn't underestimate Xia Yue just because he had killed her before.
After all, last time he had been killed by Yu Longguo - this time the man hadn't even died by his hand.
Facing Xia Yue now without the terrain advantage and her natural underestimation of him...
Killing this seemingly fragile girl wouldn't be easy either.
Especially since she was holding a knife.While Lin Yu's gun had no bullets left.
Still...
Lin Yu kept his gun trained on Xia Yue.
Just as 'Teacher' Xu Xiumei had said in the previous round - the muzzle of a gun could make people calm down.
Xia Yue, who had been about to charge at him with her knife, had already frozen when she saw Yu Longguo fall dead after the gunshot.
Now with Lin Yu's gun pointed at her, she didn't dare move at all.
But...
Lin Yu didn't fire.
Though Lin Yu knew perfectly well it was because he had no bullets left.
Xia Yue didn't know that.
As time stretched on under the pressure of impending "death", Xia Yue finally broke the silence.
"Why did you shoot the 'Soldier' first when I was the one who made the deductions and judgments?"
Xia Yue asked.
Lin Yu answered naturally: "Oh, that... Because I thought he might have been convinced by you."
"His 'Soldier' profession and real-life experience meant... if there was even a 'possibility' he might turn hostile against me, killing him would take absolute priority over dealing with you."
"Even if I knew you were 100% hostile, I'd still kill him first."
Lin Yu said calmly.
"So I was being looked down upon," Xia Yue frowned. "And that's an indirect admission... You're really not the 'Game Master'."
"I'm really not the 'Game Master'."
Lin Yu nodded in acknowledgement.
"Tch, to think I fell for it," Xia Yue sighed. "But why haven't you killed me yet?"
She narrowed her eyes. "Could it be... that gun only has one bullet?"
Hearing this, Lin Yu smiled.
She'd finally...
Steered the conversation here.
He was pleased.
While Xia Yue had never doubted the gun only having one bullet before, since Lin Yu hadn't actively 'deceived' her into reaching that conclusion through his 'Fraudster' abilities, it remained just her mistaken assumption - not something he could use to activate his class ability and make a second bullet appear.
"It's only natural a revolver has limited bullets," Lin Yu said with a laugh. "Want to bet... whether my gun has any bullets left?"
Xia Yue stared at Lin Yu, tightening her grip on the dagger.
"Honestly, you not shooting makes me suspect... you really might only have one bullet."
"There's absolutely no reason for you to keep me alive this long..."
"That clean headshot on Yu Longguo proved your marksmanship doesn't require careful aiming."
"Even if out of 'curiosity' about how I saw through your act, I've already explained everything..."
As she spoke, Xia Yue took a step forward.
"So... I think your gun only has one bullet."
Lin Yu watched Xia Yue approach, his smile confident and composed.
"Brilliant deduction as always... Xia Yue, you continue to surprise me!"
This seemingly delicate, fragile girl was truly the smartest player in this game!
But... what a shame.
Keeping his gun trained on her, Lin Yu said coolly: "Unfortunately, your deduction is only half right."
"This gun doesn't have many bullets, but... it's not one, it's two."
"I was just debating whether to use this last bullet on you or the 'Otaku'!"
Lin Yu's voice turned icy.
He didn't need to kill his fellow human faction member 'Otaku' to win.
But Xia Yue naturally couldn't realize this.
In her mind... Lin Yu going through all this trouble to make them kill each other meant the victory condition must be eliminating all other players.
This also aligned with her perception that Lin Yu had more "advantages" than any other participant.
The strong always had harder victory conditions, didn't they?
Yet even hearing this, Xia Yue took another step forward.
She met Lin Yu's gaze.
"I don't believe you - that pistol must be some sort of 'item'... Such items either come fully loaded or with just one bullet..."
"Two bullets is just too suspicious!"
Xia Yue declared.
But...
The young man's eyes held only mocking composure, as if already looking at a corpse.
And about him hung an eerie, chilling aura.
At this point, whether he had bullets or not...
She could only bet on none!
Xia Yue raised her dagger!The source of thɪs content is N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
"Bang!"
The next instant, gunfire erupted, the revolver's muzzle blooming with firework-like flames.
Time seemed to slow for Xia Yue - she saw the metal bullet emerge from the flames, racing toward her.
"So there was a second one after all..."
Was her final thought.
Then...
The bullet tore diagonally through her upper abdomen, massive blood loss robbing her of consciousness within seconds.
She collapsed heavily, dagger clattering aside.
Lin Yu approached, lowering his gun to look down at Xia Yue's glazed eyes, sighing.
"Despite saying you didn't believe... you actually believed in that second bullet quite a lot."
"But I can't blame you."
"My acting was just... too perfect."
Lin Yu holstered the pistol, marveling at himself.
Every word, every expression down to the moment he pulled the trigger had been delivered in perfect "performance mode."
Anyone watching would have believed he fired with absolute lethal intent, not as a bluff.
So...
The moment Xia Yue voiced her suspicion about "bullet count"...
Her fate had been sealed.
Seconds later, Xia Yue on the ground stopped breathing entirely.
'Veterinarian' deceased.
This marked the second time Lin Yu had personally killed Xia Yue.
But this time...
[Werewolf faction completely eliminated!]
[Game "Who Is the Outsider" - concluded!]
Lin Yu gently closed his eyes.
Then he was swallowed by endless [void].

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Settlement Complete! Return to Reality! Lin Yu's Plans!
chapters.content:
In a pitch-black space, lines of bloody text appeared before Lin Yu once again.
[Congratulations on winning the "Who Is the Outsider" game!]
[Calculating your rewards for this game session!]
[You have received the basic reward: 7 days of survival time.]
[Based on your performance this game, you've earned the "Master of Control" evaluation and received an additional reward.]
[Additional reward: You may select one "non-exclusive item" from this game as your reward!]
As Lin Yu was receiving his settlement, a pained cry suddenly came from beside him.
"Damn it—why only 7 days?"
Lin Yu turned toward the source of the noise.
This [Settlement Space] resembled the pre-game space but with slight differences.The main difference was...
Besides himself, Chen Zhuo was also present.
After his outburst, Chen Zhuo looked at Lin Yu with teary eyes.
"Game Master bro, you promised seven years..."
Seeing Chen Zhuo's pitiful state, Lin Yu shrugged. "Well, that was just a white lie to keep you from losing hope."
"Seven days is barely enough to watch one more episode," Chen Zhuo wailed. "Can't you... extend it a bit?"
"Sorry, Chen Zhuo," Lin Yu said helplessly. "Even though I'm the 'Game Master,' I'm just a player with special privileges. I don't have that level of authority."
"Rather than a god, think of me as a god's 'spokesperson'—otherwise I wouldn't be here in the settlement space with you."
Chen Zhuo looked dumbfounded. "Ah... Game Master, then... do you get more time than me?"
"Yes! I receive double your amount!"
Lin Yu declared confidently.
This was precisely why he had partially confessed to Chen Zhuo earlier.
Seeing that Chen Zhuo still believed him to be the "Game Master," Lin Yu had wondered...
Would his [Fraudster] ability work even in the game's settlement space?
After all, it was a Unique Class!
Unfortunately...
Although Chen Zhuo seemed to believe him and the [Fraudster] ability appeared effective...
The [Manifestation] didn't succeed.
Lin Yu vaguely understood: Chen Zhuo's [belief] alone was far from enough to make "receiving double survival time" [manifest].
"This is tougher than expected."
Lin Yu mused to himself.
But having confirmed his [Fraudster] ability still worked, Lin Yu grew more motivated.
"Of course, besides 'survival time'... I can also obtain ten 'non-exclusive' items from each game!"
"Ten?!"
Chen Zhuo exclaimed in shock.
"Right. Actually, if you perform exceptionally well and earn a 'special evaluation,' you can get item rewards too," Lin Yu patted Chen Zhuo's shoulder. "Not bad, huh?"
Chen Zhuo said in amazement, "I see..."
He naturally [believed] Lin Yu's words.
Lin Yu sensed Chen Zhuo's [belief], but unfortunately, it still didn't [manifest].
The degree of [belief] still wasn't enough... though this time, Lin Yu could tell it was very close.
After some thought, Lin Yu looked at the easily fooled Chen Zhuo and spoke again.
"Just kidding earlier—it's actually only six, not ten."
With anyone else, Lin Yu wouldn't dare change his story so casually, as it would raise suspicion.
But Chen Zhuo...
The chubby boy bought it again!
"Damn, that's still awesome, Game Master bro! You're really something!"
Yet...
Still no [Manifestation]!
But Lin Yu could feel they were almost there.
So he decided to keep messing with Chen Zhuo.
This time, however, he avoided mentioning specific numbers.
"Actually, it's not unconditional. As the Game Master, I just get to double any rewards I earn!"
"So I merely doubled the 'additional reward' from this game!"
As Lin Yu spoke, Chen Zhuo had an epiphany.
"I see... being a Game Master is really amazing!"
"But I think you were chosen because you're strong too... you handled this game really well!"
Chen Zhuo gave Lin Yu a thumbs-up.
Then he realized something was off.
"Wait... according to you, bro, all surviving players should be in this [Settlement Space], right?"
"Why don't I see anyone else?"
Lin Yu spread his hands. "Oh, they're all dead—because I added special rules that made them turn on each other. The last two killed each other simultaneously, so the game ended quickly with only one survivor."
"What?!"
Chen Zhuo looked stunned, then asked, "Even the Lone Wolf died?!"
Hearing this, Lin Yu paused, realizing Chen Zhuo still believed in the Lone Wolf's existence.
Lin Yu nodded solemnly.
"Right. The Lone Wolf was killed by the Veterinarian—one slash to the throat."
Chen Zhuo was horrified.
"Damn, I never thought the Veterinarian—a woman wearing glasses and looking all gentle—could be so ruthless!"
Lin Yu froze.
Xia Yue didn't wear glasses?
Then he understood.
"You're mistaken—that was the Teacher."
"Oh," Chen Zhuo scratched his head, then sighed. "Sorry... I'm just shocked by how brutal this game is."
"Yeah, it's brutal."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Lin Yu said softly.
Chen Zhuo's survival was mostly luck—aside from himself, the chubby boy was the only human role left, dutifully completing tasks until the end.
But luck was part of strength too.
"Good luck going forward—cherish this second chance at life."
"Only seven days though, bro..."
Chen Zhuo said mournfully.
Before he could finish, the [Settlement] concluded.
Lin Yu blinked and found himself lying at the center of a stage.
He checked his phone—it was just past midnight.
Almost overlapping with the 00:01 on his screen were the floating bloody words in the upper right of his vision.
[Time until next game starts at latest: 06 days 23 hours 59 minutes]
Lin Yu exhaled.
"Though the 'time' was wrong, it's true..."
This Death Game really had another round.
Compared to Chen Zhuo, Lin Yu didn't think seven days was short.
But...
"It's still urgent."
He got up, touching his chest where the "gunshot wound" no longer existed.
It all felt like a dream.
Yet proof it wasn't a dream existed beyond the bloody countdown...
There was also the storage space within his soul, now holding the [Guaranteed-Hit Revolver] and [One-Statement Lie Detector].
And—
His still-functional [Fraudster] ability.
With these as his foundation...
"It's time to figure out who that 'psycho' who killed me really is."
Sure, the other guy had a gun—but now so did he!
As Lin Yu muttered to himself, he took a step forward.
Then he suddenly felt something odd in his right pants pocket.
Like someone had slipped a card inside.
He reached in and pulled out a pure black card.
In its center were two lines of small silver printed text.
"Welcome 'back,' dear senior."
Seeing these words, Lin Yu's hair stood on end.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Return to Reality! Investigation and Appointment!
chapters.content:
Without a doubt, this card was left by that mysterious "junior girl."
And this card was "printed."
In reality, only a few minutes had passed since his "death."
In other words...
That junior who killed him had already predicted he would "revive."
She knew about the existence of the "Death Game" and was certain he would return from it alive.
Thinking back carefully, she casually pulled out a pistol in a country with such good public security just to shoot an ordinary college student like him, and said some strange things...
It was indeed rather "abnormal."
It wasn't surprising that it was connected to something equally "beyond reason" like the "Death Game."
But then...His original profession and item "advantages" wouldn't be so significant anymore.
After all, the other party at least knew these things existed.
It was even highly possible...
That person had personally participated in the "Death Game" too.
Lin Yu took a deep breath and calmed down again.
"It seems I have no choice but to 'accept the invitation.'"
The second line of text on this card...
Was a "time" and "address."
"Friday 20:00, No. 940 Changming Street, Shangnan District, Jiangcheng"
This was undoubtedly an "invitation" left by his murderer.
As for what would happen after accepting this invitation...
Lin Yu still didn't know.
But other than "accepting the invitation," he seemed to have no other choice.
After all...
Although she was his murderer, she was also the only "connection" Lin Yu currently knew in reality that was related to this game.
However.
Today was Wednesday, and it had just passed "midnight" Wednesday.
In other words, there were still nearly three full days until the "time" on the card!
This time was enough for Lin Yu to do many things.
But the most important thing now was...
"Time to go back to sleep."
Lin Yu walked off the stage, went backstage to change out of his costume, put on his plain black hoodie and sweatpants, shouldered his backpack containing the script, and left the drama club.
There would be rehearsals tomorrow, and the performance was in the evening, so of course he needed proper rest tonight.
Even after experiencing something absurd like the "Death Game," Lin Yu didn't intend to let it disrupt tomorrow's "performance" schedule.
One very important reason he came back alive was to continue "performing"...
If he didn't perform well or live properly because of something like this...
Wouldn't that be putting the cart before the horse?
After locking the drama club's main door, Lin Yu took out his keys and unlocked his bicycle parked outside.
Lin Yu's bicycle was also very plain—an ordinary black mountain bike.
He pushed the bike to the south gate of Jiangcheng Media University, where the security guard smiled and nodded at him, unlocking the small side gate.
"Xiao Lin, practicing alone so late again!"
Lin Yu smiled: "Yeah, uncle, you should rest early too... Oh, by the way, did you see a girl dressed like a Japanese middle school student with two braids?"
He asked tentatively, and after getting a confused head shake from the guard, Lin Yu smiled and nodded slightly again.
"Just asking randomly, thanks uncle."
Lin Yu pushed his bike through the small gate and left the Jiangcheng Media campus.
He rode through Jiangcheng at night.
After two intersections, Lin Yu arrived home—he was a local of Jiangcheng, and since his home wasn't far from the media university, he didn't bother living in the dorms.
Gently pushing open the door, the simple old-style two-bedroom apartment was quite cramped, with the entire place visible from the doorway.
Though old and small, the apartment was warmly decorated with potted plants everywhere, and there was a fish tank on the small coffee table in the living room.
On the flower-patterned tablecloth-covered dining table were two plates of leftovers covered with mesh nets, with the rice cooker still on keep-warm mode.
The photo hanging on the wall was taken just last year—it was shot next to the stone engraved with the university's name at Jiangcheng Media University's entrance, featuring a round-faced young woman who bore 70-80% resemblance to Lin Yu making an exuberant "V" sign with one hand while her other arm wrapped around a shy, restrained-looking Lin Yu standing stiffly with his head slightly lowered.
Lin Yu carefully took off his shoes, unplugged the rice cooker, then carried his slippers back to his bedroom.
After that, he placed his backpack and clothes on the desk nearby and wearily collapsed onto the bed.
"Phew..."
Lying in bed, Lin Yu fell asleep within seconds.
He slept dreamlessly through the night, and at exactly 7 AM the next morning, Lin Yu opened his eyes.
After washing up and leaving his room, he came to the dining table.
Last night's leftovers had now become a new plate of fried rice with leftovers.
Beside the fried rice was a sticky note.
"You skipped dinner again last night—I'll deal with you when you get back tonight!"
The note also had a simple angry face doodled on it.
Lin Yu picked up the note, folded it gently, and tossed it into the wastebasket under the table.
Though he had little appetite, he could feel the intensity behind that doodle, so he obediently sat down and finished the fried rice made with stir-fried green beans with pork and shredded potatoes.
After that, Lin Yu rode his bike back to school.
Though a sophomore, Lin Yu happened to have no classes today.
Coming to school early, he naturally headed straight to the drama club.
And when Lin Yu arrived at the drama club's activity center, an expected person was already standing on the theater stage.
A petite girl in a white T-shirt and baseball cap was holding a script with one hand while resting the other on her hip, pacing back and forth across the stage with a black pen clenched between her teeth.
Hearing Lin Yu's footsteps, the petite girl didn't look up as she spoke in a light tone.
"Oh, my dear 'star performer,' you're early again today... Since the others aren't here yet, find somewhere to run your lines yourself."
This girl who looked no taller than 1.5 meters was named Shen Bingmiao, a third-year student and Lin Yu's senior.
She was also the drama club's president, playwright, and director.
Seeing Shen Bingmiao, Lin Yu thought for a moment before speaking.
"President, I need to ask you for a favor."
Hearing this, Shen Bingmiao looked up with a strange expression.
She flicked her cap's brim and said: "Now this is odd—you actually asking me for help... What is it, my dear 'ace'?"The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"I need to find someone—she might be a freshman junior."
Lin Yu chose his words carefully.
Shen Bingmiao raised an eyebrow: "Shouldn't you post that on the confession wall?"
"No, first I need results quickly, and second, I suspect she might not even be from our school," Lin Yu said calmly. "So this isn't something just anyone can handle."
Hearing this, Shen Bingmiao laughed.
"I get what you mean—quite the troublesome request! But I'll help you, since you're my 'ace'!"
Shen Bingmiao spat out the pen she was biting, threw her script to the ground, and hopped down from the stage in two steps.
"Let's go!"
She patted Lin Yu's arm cheerfully.
"Now? What about their rehearsal?"
"They've rehearsed plenty—one last time won't make a difference... To me, the lead actor's condition matters most!"
"So, let's solve your problem first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 30: A Successful Performance! Lin Yu's Solo Investigation!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu had his reasons for approaching Shen Bingmiao.
This senior who was one year above him was the most "famous" figure at Jiangcheng Media University.
And her fame had little to do with her identity as "Drama Club President."
Shen Bingmiao became famous because during her freshman year, she hacked into the school's academic system to send push notifications to every student's app, promoting the drama club's new play.
This earned her disciplinary action from the university.
Though Shen Bingmiao loved theater and scriptwriting and attended a media university, her major was actually "Digital Media Arts."
She had also independently participated in Jiangcheng's university programming competition, thoroughly defeating the computer science teams from neighboring Jiangcheng Polytechnic and Jiangcheng University.
So when Lin Yu sought Shen Bingmiao's help...
He naturally hoped she could directly access the academic records of all Jiangcheng Media University freshmen.
In the backstage lounge of the activity center, Lin Yu watched as Shen Bingmiao opened her laptop, clicked a few times, and pulled up several windows..."Here, all the freshman academic records."
"Thanks, President."
Lin Yu filtered for "female" students and began rapidly scrolling through.
Jiangcheng Media University had enrolled over 3,000 freshmen this year, with slightly more girls—nearly 2,000.
Lin Yu had sharp recognition skills, scanning four profiles per page at a glance...
The girl who killed him wasn't there.
Of course, it helped that his junior was strikingly beautiful in a distinctive way.
Those bright, sharp eyes—Lin Yu would never forget them.
In less than half an hour, Lin Yu reached the end.
"Not here."
He sighed regretfully.
Seeing Lin Yu's disappointed expression, Shen Bingmiao grew even more curious.
"You don't seem to be looking for a crush..."
"Let's just say I'm looking for my attacker."
Lin Yu shook his head.
"Could it be a boy? You only checked girls," Shen Bingmiao analyzed. "Maybe it's a 'crossdressing expert'!"
"No, that body type and facial structure were definitely female," Lin Yu stated firmly. "And if a boy looked like that... he'd probably be famous campus-wide by now."
Jiangcheng Media University's acting program was renowned, so the school wasn't lacking in beautiful girls or handsome boys. Even if last night's "junior" was stunning, she might still be unknown.
But if it had been a boy that beautiful...
Lin Yu would have recognized him immediately last night!
Shen Bingmiao clicked her tongue. "Alright, want me to help you... investigate through other means?"
"If you mistook her for a student, she must look college-aged. Jiangcheng doesn't have that many universities..."
She sounded eager, but Lin Yu hesitated before declining.
"Forget it, President."
If Shen Bingmiao dug deeper, Lin Yu worried she might get into trouble.
He still didn't understand the motives of that mysterious girl who killed him—or whether she was prone to killing indiscriminately...
But she was undoubtedly dangerous, capable of pulling out a pistol at any moment and likely a participant in the "Death Game."
As a Death Game participant himself, Lin Yu knew well...
This game had taught him to cherish life—his own life!
But toward others' lives...
Lin Yu couldn't deny his attitude had become more dismissive!
Because he'd genuinely killed someone in the Death Game.
Like how man-eating beasts can't be kept, the same logic applies to killers...
They begin considering "killing" as a potential "solution"—something ordinary people would never seriously contemplate.
"Don't worry, President... it's just a small matter."
"It won't affect my stage performance!"
Lin Yu declared confidently.
Seeing his assurance, Shen Bingmiao could only nod.
"Fine, I believe you... after all, you're our drama club's 『Ace』!"
True to Lin Yu's promise...
During subsequent rehearsals, he seemed to have completely forgotten his worries, maintaining perfect form.
Even Shen Bingmiao had to admit...
Lin Yu's performance today was truly flawless.
"He's in great form..."
"No, it's beyond just 'good form'—it's like he leveled up overnight!"
"Almost as if someone held a gun to his head last night, forcing him to practice acting all night!"
Shen Bingmiao muttered.
Little did she know...
This joking remark held a grain of truth!
Last night, Lin Yu had indeed performed his most successful improv act with a gun pointed at his head!
Playing the 『Detective』, the 『Player』, and... a 『God』!
Lin Yu could feel it himself...
After experiencing last night's Death Game, his acting had undergone a "sublimation"!
"Is this what teachers mean by life experience improving acting...?"
That evening, after the final curtain call...
Hearing the thunderous applause, seeing students who'd only come for "credits" or as reluctant plus-ones now completely immersed in his performance, Lin Yu felt deeply moved.
His acting had always been good, but today's emotional impact was unprecedented!
"A blessing in disguise?"
Lin Yu chuckled at the thought.
Still... improved acting was always good news!
"President, I'm heading out now!"
Seeing the darkened sky outside, Lin Yu changed out of his costume backstage and bid farewell to Shen Bingmiao.
"『Ace』, we still have the thank-you session and fan interaction!"Googlᴇ search No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Shen Bingmiao reminded him.
Lin Yu grinned: "Just say I have a 'stomachache'—the lead actor performed through illness but can't meet the audience afterward... I'm sure everyone will understand, right?"
With that, Lin Yu walked straight out of the drama club.
"Hey! Get back here!"
Shen Bingmiao stomped her foot in frustration, powerless to stop him.
Watching Lin Yu's retreating figure, she sighed.
"Fine, we'll do as he says..."
"Hope his 'fans' won't be too upset."
...
After leaving the drama club, Lin Yu hopped on his bicycle and hurried off campus.
His current destination...
Was naturally the address on that card—"940 Changming Street, Shangnan District, Jiangcheng"!
Though the timing wasn't right...
Lin Yu still wanted to scout the location in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: The Abandoned Restaurant
chapters.content:
"I won't be home for dinner tonight. The club is having a gathering."
After finishing the text message, he hit send.
Lin Yu turned off his phone screen and stopped his bicycle at the intersection.
He had arrived at Changming Street.
Located in the old district of Jiangcheng, Changming Street had no skyscrapers—only low-rise buildings and even some self-built houses.
Small shops lined both sides of the road—convenience stores, auto repair shops, breakfast stalls—all exuding a shabby atmosphere.
Lin Yu walked along Changming Street, counting the blue nameplates nailed above each doorway.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"937, 938, 939..."
He stopped.
Number 940 had arrived.This place was larger than the others, yet more desolate.
Because it was an abandoned two-story restaurant.
The sign reading "Jiangcheng Family" was tattered, and the door lock was rusted over.
After some thought, Lin Yu approached a side window—the glass was broken, covered only by a layer of paper.
He tore through the paper covering and opened the window.
The windows in these old buildings weren't high, so Lin Yu easily climbed inside.
But what he saw inside surprised him.
"Something's not right..."
Though dilapidated and worn, all the tables and chairs were neatly arranged, and the floor was spotless.
As if someone had just cleaned it.
This was completely different from the aged, abandoned exterior.
Lin Yu immediately became alert.
He gripped the lie detector and pistol in his hands.
As for why he took out the lie detector too... well, having it ready couldn't hurt.
Nervously, Lin Yu scanned the restaurant, even hiding behind a pillar.
And just then...
"Tap, tap, tap..."
Footsteps echoed through the empty space.
Lin Yu cautiously peeked out, following the sound.
He saw a figure descending the stairs between the first and second floors.
It was a tall, portly middle-aged man wearing an elegant navy blue double-breasted suit and polished leather shoes.
Moreover... he was adorned with glittering gold accessories—a gold watch, gold rings, a gold necklace.
The man was practically dripping with jewels.
He descended the stairs and looked in Lin Yu's direction.
"I see you there, kid—no use hiding!"
"The 'gathering' isn't until the night after tomorrow... you're a bit early!"
The middle-aged man's voice boomed with confidence.
Lin Yu still didn't dare come out.
Though this man seemed nothing like the "junior girl" from before, Lin Yu wasn't about to take chances.
Hiding behind the pillar, he called out:
"What gathering? I don't know anything about that!"
The middle-aged man burst into laughter.
"Oh, first time? By my count, it's about time for this batch of newcomers to find the 'forum'..."
As the man spoke, Lin Yu grew even more confused.
"I don't understand what you're saying. I just happened to pass by."
Hearing this, the man smiled wider.
"Kid, setting aside how you're sneaking around 'scouting the place' just like most first-timers I've seen..."
"As a 'veteran,' let me remind you—we players who've survived the Death Game can't mention those two words to ordinary people, not even hints. The moment the thought crosses your mind, the words get 'stuck' in your throat."
"The fact that I can talk about it so freely proves you're definitely a 'player.'"
Despite the gold-covered man's words, Lin Yu remained behind the pillar.
He didn't think the man was lying...
But precisely because they were both players, Lin Yu grew even warier.
"Aren't players supposed to be adversaries... Why aren't you more cautious around me?"
Lin Yu muttered quietly.
The middle-aged man chuckled: "Kid, seems your first round was PvP."
"Players rarely oppose each other in real life. We've all cheated death once—why fight to the death outside the game too?"
"As the saying goes, harmony brings wealth!"
The man's deep, enthusiastic voice sounded particularly convincing.
Lin Yu believed most of it, but still didn't fully trust him.
He raised the lie detector.
"Then swear you won't hurt me."
The man looked surprised.
"Huh? Swear... alright then!"
He raised his right fist: "I bear you no malice and have no intention of harming you."
Hearing this, Lin Yu released the lie detector's button.
"Beep—"
The green light turned on.
Lin Yu finally relaxed slightly—though not completely.
There was still the possibility this man was "using truth to deceive."
But Lin Yu considered that "extremely unlikely" scenario practically negligible.
He stepped out from behind the pillar.
The middle-aged man raised an eyebrow.
"Well, aren't you a sharp-looking rookie... and you found the forum, solved the puzzle to locate the gathering spot, even knew to scout ahead in just one day. The younger generation sure is impressive."
Seeing the man still seemed friendly, Lin Yu decided to be more open: "I genuinely know nothing about any gathering or puzzle."
He spoke earnestly. The man paused, then asked:
"Then how did you find this place?"
"Someone gave me a card with this address."
Lin Yu took the business card from his pocket.
Hearing this, the man quickly descended the stairs.
Lin Yu watched him warily, but the man made no threatening moves—he just took the card and examined it closely.
After a moment, he returned it to Lin Yu, muttering: "How strange. Why would someone just give a newcomer the 'gathering' address?"
"Maybe some 'organization' wants to recruit you... but this is a weird way to do it."
As the man muttered, Lin Yu frowned.
"So what exactly is this 'gathering' about?"
At this question, the man fell silent for a moment.
"Alright, 'rookie'... though I don't know your background, since you lack even this basic knowledge, I'll explain."
"After all, you could find all this on the 'forum' anyway."
"Consider this me doing you a favor!"
Lin Yu felt somewhat exasperated.
"You're making it sound so worthless—do you really think I'll owe you for this?"
"Haha, sincerity is my ultimate weapon!"
The man laughed, then turned serious: "First, let me ask you this, rookie... what do you think is the standard for measuring a Death Game 'player's' strength?"

chapters.title: Chapter 32: The Forum and Big Sister
chapters.content:
"Strength standards?"
As a "newbie player" who had only experienced one game session, Lin Yu was naturally confused.
But he tentatively made a guess based on his limited experience.
"Uh... profession strength?"
"That's part of it... but for most people, profession strength is only a small factor—after all, a profession's effectiveness varies depending on the scenario."
The middle-aged man wagged his finger.
Lin Yu thought for a moment before making another guess.
"Is it perhaps 'number of completed game scenarios'?"
Lin Yu carefully speculated.
"That's not wrong, but... it's not a 'hard requirement'. Many who've gone through seven or eight scenarios might still lose to an exceptionally strong newbie who's only done two."The middle-aged man stroked his chin, the diamond-encrusted gold watch on his wrist glinting dazzlingly.
"For newcomers like you, there's really only one measurement that matters—item quantity."
The man looked directly at Lin Yu.
"That 'gun' in your hand must be an item... getting such a powerful reward in your first scenario is quite lucky—though I suspect your abilities are equally impressive."
Lin Yu nodded slightly without denying it.
He was beginning to understand.
"So these 'items' can be traded between players?"
"Is this gathering a place for such exchanges?"
The middle-aged man paused, then burst into laughter.
"Newbie, you're sharp—figured it out immediately!"
"Correct... this is Jiangcheng's largest and most reliable 'offline gathering spot', where all local Death Game players trade exchangeable items."
Lin Yu pondered this before asking: "Is the currency... real money?"
"That's flexible... some use real money, especially those who excel in the Death Game but struggle in real life... naturally they'd want to improve their circumstances."
"But more often, people prefer trading with 'forum points'!"
Lin Yu frowned at this.
"Forum points? So that forum... it's not just a discussion site for strategies?"
The middle-aged man chuckled.
"You really are clueless... here, add my WeChat and I'll send you the forum."
He pulled out an outdated senior-friendly smartphone from his pocket—a budget model from Huawei.
Opening WeChat, Lin Yu scanned his QR code.
The man's WeChat name was "Harmony Brings Wealth", with a profile picture of a golden toad statue—bearing uncanny resemblance to himself.
"Alright kid, I've sent the installer. Enter my WeChat ID as referrer when you register. Study the forum yourself later!"
"The gathering's day after tomorrow—don't linger here too long. Being seen with me might cause trouble."
Lin Yu looked surprised.
"Brother Harmony Brings Wealth... do you have many enemies?"
The man laughed.
"Complete a few more scenarios and you'll have enemies too... what, didn't make any rivals in your newbie scenario?"
"Even brothers turn on each other at gambling tables—when lives are at stake, grudges form easily."
Lin Yu nodded silently.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFirenᴇt
He mentally recalled the faces of Yu Longguo, Yao Zhengye, Bao Liu, Xu Xiumei... and Xia Yue.
Undoubtedly, any survivor would likely hold an undying grudge against him.
Especially those two—Yu Longguo and Xia Yue...
Just thinking about them gave him a headache.
Deciding to probe further, Lin Yu asked:
"Brother Harmony, those who die in the game... can't possibly come back, right?"
"Of course, the Death Game is the final chance... so cherish it—I believe in 'fate'. Our meeting today is no coincidence."
The man patted Lin Yu's shoulder.
"Hope to see you at this gathering and next week's too!"
"I hope so too!"
With that, Lin Yu bid farewell and left.
At the intersection, he mounted his bicycle and hurried home.
Night had fallen deeply, enveloping everything in silence.
But upon opening his door, a shadowy figure suddenly lunged at him from the darkness.
"What the—?"
Was it that mysterious junior girl?
No—wrong height. An accomplice perhaps?!
Or one of the middle-aged man's enemies?
Maybe just another player!
Startled, Lin Yu instantly summoned his pistol, pressing it against the attacker's abdomen!
Then a familiar shampoo scent reached his nose.
Followed by excruciating ear pain.
"OW—that hurts!"
Lin Yu yelped in pain.
"SMACK!"
The girl twisting his ear turned on the lights, her expression thunderous.
"Little Yu, how impressive... coming home past eleven two nights straight!"
The round-faced girl wore loose homewear, her short hair framing an angry scowl.
Lin Yu raised his hands in surrender: "Sis, have mercy! Yesterday was rehearsal, today was dinner..."
This was Lin Zhao—Lin Yu's only weakness, his elder sister.
Though only five years older, she'd essentially raised him after their parents disappeared during their childhood.
From working student jobs to eventually dropping out to open a shop supporting Lin Yu's education, she'd been more mother than sister.
While Lin Yu cared little for others, his sister was the exception.
"Bullshit! I ran into your club president today—she said there was no dinner," Lin Zhao's voice rose sharply, "Since when did you start lying?"
She snatched the revolver from Lin Yu's hand.
"And waving a gun around—planning to shoot me?!"
"Club prop! Brought it home to practice handling," Lin Yu said carefully, "You scared me jumping out like that—just wanted some courage."
Lin Zhao sighed.
"Fine... then where were you really?"
Facing his sister, Lin Yu hesitated.
He hated lying to her, but as the middle-aged man said...
The Death Game was impossible to explain.
As if some unseen force gagged him.
Finally, Lin Yu forced a smile.
"The role I'm playing barely survives... got too immersed. Went biking by the river to clear my head..."
"Didn't want you worrying, so I lied."

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Forum Guide!
chapters.content:
After experiencing the "Death Game," Lin Yu realized his acting skills had undergone an almost "qualitative transformation" improvement.
It wasn't just about today's stage performance...
He was becoming increasingly adept at applying his "acting skills" to daily life.
No, rather than calling it an "improvement," it would be more accurate to say...
The "Death Game" had reminded him—reminded Lin Yu that in reality, he could also use his "acting skills" to do these things.
Like telling a white lie to his sister.
Faced with Lin Yu's sincere words, Lin Zhao naturally didn't harbor the slightest suspicion.
Her initial anger had all turned into concern.
"Then you should go rest, Xiao Yu..."
"Don't take acting too seriously... If it's too much, we can take a break. Sister has her own shop now and can support you!"In the past, as a "method actor," Lin Yu would fully immerse himself in his roles when performing, often experiencing difficulty "snapping out of character." Lin Zhao had witnessed that state before.
Especially after seeing a few short videos online and hearing news like "renowned actor commits suicide due to inability to break from role," Lin Zhao had become deeply afraid of such situations.
Lin Yu was Lin Zhao's only family in the world, and wasn't Lin Zhao the same for Lin Yu?
Looking at his sister Lin Zhao's concerned eyes, Lin Yu returned to his room.
As he felt relieved inside, he also couldn't help but feel somewhat guilty.
"People really are hypocritical... Or perhaps those who can enter the 'Death Game' are all first-class 'egoists.'"
Lin Yu muttered self-deprecatingly.
In the "Death Game," he had deceived others, set up schemes that led to the deaths of five living people, and even personally killed two—yet he only felt somewhat affected.
But lying to a loved one he cared about and seeing their cautious expression...
Lin Yu felt genuinely unsettled.
However, Lin Yu wasn't sentimental enough to wallow in self-blame over it.
He wasn't the type to overthink things.
"Ultimately, it's all because of this strange 'Death Game'... and that person who killed me."
"Tomorrow's gathering—I must catch her... and also see if I can really use that gathering to improve my life."
Lin Yu secretly made up his mind.
With this thought in mind...
He didn't hesitate, locking his room door and opening the installation package sent by "Harmony Brings Wealth."
After clicking install, soon...
A brand-new app icon appeared on his desktop—completely pitch black.
Its name was equally plain, just two characters: "Forum."
"It's really called 'Forum,'" Lin Yu couldn't help but mutter. "I thought it was some kind of codename."
Complaints aside, Lin Yu had to admit the app's name and icon did seem mysterious and high-end.
He tapped the icon, revealing an extremely minimalist interface—pure black, with only an input box in the center offering no prompts.
If not for the blinking white cursor indicating he needed to input something, Lin Yu would have thought his screen had malfunctioned.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Opening the input box made the keyboard appear.
Though no text told Lin Yu what to input, he recalled "Harmony Brings Wealth's" words—"enter WeChat ID for invitation."
He input the older man's WeChat ID.
Sure enough...
The input box flickered twice, then changed to display two characters:
"Welcome."
Then, a new input box appeared—this time with a prompt.
"Enter your 'nickname' and 'account.'"
Lin Yu thought for a moment, deciding against using his WeChat ID as his "account" like "Harmony Brings Wealth" had.
Instead, he entered: "Stanislavski1938."
This was the English spelling of his favorite playwright and drama theorist's name, with 1938 being the year this master of theater passed away.
Next, Lin Yu hesitated slightly over his nickname.
In the end, he input two characters:
"Director."
He had initially considered "Actor," but felt that might reveal too much about himself.
Though rationally speaking, it was nearly impossible for anyone to identify him based solely on these two words...
But adding an extra layer of obfuscation gave Lin Yu peace of mind—why not do it?
After completing this, the input box flickered again.
Soon, new text appeared:
"Welcome to the 'Forum'!"
The words faded, replaced by an extremely simple forum interface.
The forum had only four main sections: "Announcements," "Discussions," "Guides," and "Bounties."
Lin Yu checked the "Announcements" section first, which resembled ordinary forums filled with posts about muting users for specific durations.
Most threads were meaningless, with only a few about "permanently restricting XX organization members from accessing the forum" piquing Lin Yu's interest.
"Seems the group running this 'Forum' isn't completely neutral!"
Lin Yu muttered.
He also mentally noted the names of the banned organizations.
Pinned at the top were three: "Psychological Society," "Free Alliance," and "Marauders"...
The "Marauders" clearly seemed shady, but the other two made it hard for Lin Yu to discern the forum's stance.
Moreover, the pinned announcement listed only three rules: "No personal attacks, no spreading rumors, no irrelevant information."
It didn't even explain why members of those three organizations were banned.
"Could it be because of large-scale flame wars?"
Lin Yu couldn't tell.
But this wasn't important...
Lin Yu continued browsing the forum.
In the "Discussions" section, many threads were being bumped, though their titles left Lin Yu somewhat confused:
"Rational Discussion: Can completing two profession quests match the strength of exclusive items?"
"Is the 'Ruffian' rule-based profession the most useless in pure 'survival' scenarios?"
"Experts, I really want to know how long the 'Referee's' abilities last in reality?"
"Looking to trade powerful offensive items—DM me!"
"Between 'General' and 'Grandmaster,' who's stronger in a duel?"
"Haicheng, female, newbie, seeking guidance! Can verify via video!"
These posts gave Lin Yu a vague impression of other players' profiles, but he couldn't fully grasp them.
"Better check the 'Guides' section first!"
Lin Yu muttered, opening the next section.
And upon entering the "Guides" section...
Lin Yu was shocked.
"Holy shit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Types of Games and Classes!
chapters.content:
As soon as Lin Yu clicked open the "Guide Section," his eyes were immediately drawn to a pinned red post at the top.
"Essential Guide for Newbies!"
Lin Yu swiftly clicked on it with a decisive "tap"!
After reading through this post...
Lin Yu couldn't help but admire how truly essential it was for newcomers!
Clear and well-organized, it answered nearly all his questions!
Rather... it covered every possible question any new player might have.
The post consisted of three parts—about the 『Death Game』, about the 『forum』 itself, and advice on how to interact with other 『Players』.
The first part was about the 『Death Game』.
The author of this guide mentioned that most of this section consisted of players' speculations.Theories about the origins of the 『Death Game』 varied widely—some factions even formed based on differing interpretations of this very question.
The currently dominant theory was that it was a game created by 『Gods』 to give them a second 『chance』.
All participating players were people who had died once.
And each time a dungeon was cleared...
They would earn seven more days of life.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
Seven days later, as the next dungeon approached, bloody text would appear with new "hints," telling players how to enter the next game dungeon.
Players could use special 『Party Items』 to join another player's game, thereby avoiding their original dungeon.
Within dungeons, players had the chance to obtain 『Items』.
Just as Uncle "Harmony Brings Wealth" had said, the number of 『Items』 was an important measure of a new player's strength in the early stages.
The author also mentioned that after players moved past the newbie phase, they would face a trial called 『Promotion』. Players who passed it would experience a world of difference in strength compared to others!
However, the author seemed to avoid elaborating on how exactly 『Promotion』 worked, likely to avoid misleading newcomers.
But no matter how strong a player became, they could never escape the weekly "dungeon."
Although there were some 『Special Items』 that allowed players to enter additional dungeons, completing these extra dungeons wouldn't reset the seven-day countdown.
Reading this, Lin Yu couldn't help but feel a little disheartened.
Though he had expected as much...
Knowing that "this would happen every week without fail" still gave Lin Yu a headache.
"Is this really a 'fresh start'?"
"Having to worry about this 『Death Game』 every week would take up so much energy!"
Lin Yu even felt like complaining to the gods who wrote the 『bloody text』 about false advertising!
However...
Lin Yu eventually calmed himself down.
Not only because this life was essentially "free" anyway, but also because looking at this forum gave him a sense of "at least I'm not alone in this."
Perhaps that was the purpose of the forum—knowing that so many others in the world were also suffering like this made Lin Yu feel slightly better.
Next, the guide delved into some practical information about the Death Game.
For example, the types of 『Classes』 and 『Dungeons』.
Every player would awaken to a 『Class』, their greatest reliance for survival in the Death Game.
And 『Classes』 were categorized.
The simplest and most straightforward were the 『Enhancement Types』, which greatly boosted a specific ability.
Then there were 『Information Types』 and 『Rule Types』, related to the game itself. The former could obtain key information within the game, while the latter could slightly alter the game's rules.
There were also 『Skill Types』, which granted specific abilities.
Beyond these, there were 『Special Types』 that were difficult to classify.
Classes only came in two varieties—『Common Classes』 and 『Unique Classes』.
The distinction was simple: Common Classes could be duplicated, while Unique Classes almost never were.
However, it wasn't true that 『Unique Classes』 were necessarily stronger than Common Classes. Based on general information...
The abilities of 『Unique Classes』 were often just more complex and unique! Their holders were also extremely rare!
Most 『Unique Classes』 could be classified as 『Special Types』.
Reading this, Lin Yu understood.
"In my very first game, I encountered every type of class!"
The 『Soldier』 and 『Otaku』 were 『Enhancement Types』!
The 『Teacher』 was an 『Information Type』!
The 『Ruffian』 was the most typical 『Rule Type』!
The 『Thief』 and 『Veterinarian』 were 『Skill Types』!
As for his own 『Fraudster』...
Not only was it a 『Special Type』, but it was also an extremely rare 『Unique Class』!
Because the first game had exposed him to such a complete range of classes, Lin Yu couldn't help but feel a little lucky.
Combining his class abilities with this guide...
With this "information," carrying out 『Fraud』 would be much easier!
"I should look for more guide posts and memorize the abilities of other classes!"
Lin Yu thought silently.
He felt immense gratitude toward the creator of this forum.
With proper application...
In future dungeons, he could practically assume any 『Class』 he wanted!
No longer would he have to rack his brains like when he first fabricated the 『Detective』—he could just use existing ones!
In fact... Lin Yu felt that from now on, he might have no choice but to use existing ones.
After all, most players had probably visited the forum too.
If you claimed a 『Class』—as long as it wasn't a 『Unique Class』—everyone would know exactly what your abilities were.
However, Lin Yu wasn't in a hurry to look up summaries of other class abilities just yet.
He continued reading this "Essential for Newbies" guide.
Because next...
The guide introduced several types of game dungeons!
Just like the classification of classes, these were player-made categories, not "official" designations from the game itself.
Based on the clearance conditions and main challenges of various dungeons...
Game dungeons were primarily divided into the following types.
『Competition』, 『Survival』, 『Puzzle』, and 『Slaughter』!
『Competition』 was self-explanatory—dungeons focused on player-versus-player conflict, where the clearance condition usually involved defeating an opposing player faction or eliminating everyone else.
『Survival』 dungeons mostly required players to endure and stay alive for a set duration... These dungeons either had extreme environments or an overwhelmingly powerful, terrifying presence that followed predictable patterns.
『Puzzle』 types had clearance conditions that required solving specific riddles. These sounded the simplest but often had "instant-death mechanics," making their actual fatality rates just as high.
As for 『Slaughter』... it was the simplest and most brutal—these dungeons also had monsters, but they could actually be defeated!

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Ways to Make Money!
chapters.content:
"So that's how it works."
After reading this "Beginner's Guide," Lin Yu felt he had gained a much clearer understanding of the Death Game!
Due to his Fraudster profession, every bit of knowledge Lin Yu acquired about the game translated into genuine strength.
"What a shame I don't know how Promotion works yet—otherwise I might be able to impersonate even more powerful experts!"
Lin Yu sighed inwardly.
After finishing the beginner's guide, he downloaded several other strategy articles and studied them carefully.
Soon, Lin Yu grasped many aspects of the Death Game beyond just gameplay.
For example...
The upcoming "gathering"!
Just as Uncle Harmony Brings Wealth had mentioned, gatherings were inseparable from this forum.You could earn "forum points" through trading.
These "forum points" served as hard currency because they could initially be used to post "bounties" on the forum—whether hiring someone to carry you through dungeons or purchasing information, everything could be paid with points!
The forum itself even offered a service to exchange points for RMB at a rate of 1 point to 100 RMB!
However, players couldn't acquire points by "topping up with RMB."
Aside from obtaining points from others, the only ways to get points from the forum officially were by publishing "valuable" posts or completing "missions" issued by the forum!
The bounty board contained many such missions and targets posted by forum administrators.
Lin Yu felt these matters were still too distant for him and didn't delve deeper.
His main focus remained on the gathering itself!
Different cities had different gathering locations.
These gatherings weren't organized by the forum officially—most were hosted by local organizations within cities. After receiving official forum certification, they could be published and promoted through the forum.
Of course, there were also unofficial small-scale gatherings not recognized by the forum...
But whether these were safe or worth attending depended entirely on players' own judgment.
While those who committed murder or robbery through such means would supposedly be blacklisted by the forum and possibly hunted by an organization called "Administrators"...
For victims who'd already lost their lives, posthumous punishment held little meaning!
Fortunately, the address Lin Yu had received was indeed a certified "official gathering point" in their Jiang City.
The listed information matched perfectly.
It even included details about the gathering's organizer—someone called "Tycoon."
Lin Yu had a strong hunch this "Tycoon" was the same uncle whose WeChat ID was "Harmony Brings Wealth."
"Gotta admit, that name suits his 'vibe' perfectly..."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Lin Yu muttered to himself.
After finishing all these guides...
Lin Yu fell into a deep sleep.
The next morning, Lin Yu woke up refreshed.
Although he had two general education classes today, Lin Yu—who'd never been interested in "College Student Entrepreneurship Guidance"—took the whole day off to stay home studying more guides.
After careful consideration, an idea took shape in Lin Yu's mind.
A plan to make money at this gathering and compensate his sister Lin Zhao!
"Since this game already exists and my life can't return to its previous peace..."
"Then I might as well use it to earn some money and improve our living conditions!"
Lin Yu exhaled firmly, his expression resolute.
The simplest way to "make money" was selling items at the gathering!
After all...
When entering Death Game dungeons, you couldn't bring anything from reality—not even an entire armory!
Experiments had shown that besides the clothes on your back, almost nothing could be taken in.
Hair clips were about the limit...
Food, water, stationery, lighters—nothing in your pockets could be brought inside.
Even clothing had restrictions—wearing bulletproof vests or obviously functional gear might get you stripped naked upon entry!
Thus, items held tremendous value in this game.
Imagine being in a survival-type dungeon where "finding food" was the main challenge...
If Lin Yu had stockpiled bread and water from the beginner dungeon beforehand, wouldn't that drastically reduce the difficulty for him?!
Not to mention various weapon-type items that could significantly boost combat effectiveness.
Even though there were many Enhancement-type professions, most were like the Otaku's minor boosts.
Professions like Soldier that dramatically improved "frontline combat power" were highly sought after by all major organizations!
For other profession holders wanting to increase "combat capability," items remained the best option.
Lin Yu knew this firsthand.
His Guaranteed-Hit Revolver gave him immense confidence.
Without it, he wouldn't have dared investigate that address alone yesterday!
"So even a decent-quality item like a sharp firewood chopper could easily sell for over a hundred points..."
Over a hundred points...
That translated to tens of thousands in real cash!
With luck meeting players urgently needing weapons, you might even fetch hundreds of thousands!
Thinking this, Lin Yu couldn't help feeling regret.
That first dungeon had contained so many exquisite werewolf weapons...
What a shame he'd brought out so few!
Lin Yu wasn't foolish enough to consider selling his most reliable trump card—the Guaranteed-Hit Revolver.
Though based on auction records mentioned in forum posts, this item might be worth over a million!
But Lin Yu had no intention of selling it.
Making money was important... but not at the cost of his life.
As for the Lie Detector...
Not only would this item likely not fetch a high price, more importantly...
It synergized perfectly with Lin Yu's Fraudster abilities.
When driven to desperation by that madman Yu Longguo in the beginner dungeon, being able to reverse fate through deception and achieve Rewind partly relied on this miraculous lie detector helping him turn his least believable statement into an unquestioned "truth" through technique!
Even if it became obsolete later, Lin Yu wouldn't simply sell off this "meritorious servant"!
With these two items off the selling block...
Lin Yu still refused to abandon this money-making opportunity at the gathering!
He'd already conceived a brilliant plan!

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Finding Chen Zhuo
chapters.content:
"Alright, shopping complete!"
Lin Yu stepped out of Jiangcheng's small commodities street, carrying a heavy backpack with a look of bountiful joy on his face.
This was the first step of his plan completed.
Next...
Time for step two!
Lin Yu took out his phone and found Drama Club President Shen Bingmiao's QQ account.
"President, can you do me a favor?"
Shen Bingmiao quickly replied with a "?".
Her QQ nickname was "Nine Waters".
[Nine Waters: Skipping club activities but still trying to order me around?][Nine Waters: Your sister said you went to a club gathering last night - using us as your alibi, huh?]
[Nine Waters: Went to see a girlfriend instead? Speak!]
[Nine Waters: Wow Lin Yu, you've really made it big - privately meeting fans to date now?]
[Nine Waters: The drama club isn't your springboard for hookups!]
Shen Bingmiao's messages bombarded in rapid succession, interspersed with aggressive panda head memes.
Lin Yu ignored Shen Bingmiao's hysterical messages and memes, continuing to type his request.
[Two Trees: Help me look someone up.]
[Two Trees: Chen Zhuo, male, high school student, probably from Jiangcheng based on accent. Likes anime, standard otaku.]
[Two Trees: Can you doxx him for me?]
After Lin Yu finished typing, Shen Bingmiao's message bombardment stopped.
Soon, Shen Bingmiao directly called him via voice chat.
"This high schooler pissed you off?"
Shen Bingmiao got straight to the point.
"Yeah, he screwed me over in a game then doxxed me - I want to retaliate. But my skills aren't good enough, only found out his real name is Chen Zhuo."
Through the screen, Lin Yu's lies flowed more smoothly.
"Got it, I hate people who screw up games then doxx others... I'll teach him a lesson for you!"
Shen Bingmiao hung up.
Lin Yu waited a few minutes with his backpack still on, soon receiving a message from Shen Bingmiao containing a file package.
Opening it revealed Chen Zhuo's complete personal information - from ID number to home address to all his social media accounts.
This guy's QQ nickname was "Loving Ai Haibara is the Best"... Seeing this, Lin Yu felt he didn't even need to check the photo to confirm it was him.
[Nine Waters: This the right Chen Zhuo?]
[Two Trees: Yes, thanks.]
[Nine Waters: How you gonna deal with him? Need me to hack his accounts?]
[Two Trees: No need, since he's local to Jiangcheng, I'll confront him in person.]
After replying to the president, Lin Yu exhaled.
Chen Zhuo was indeed from Jiangcheng - he'd suspected from the accent earlier.
And though Chen Zhuo had been wearing an anime girl T-shirt, his sweatpants looked suspiciously like Jiangcheng High School's uniform pants.
While these were common nationwide, there were always regional differences.
Recalling it now, Lin Yu felt those pants were unmistakably Jiangcheng High's!
"If he's local, that simplifies things."
Even if Chen Zhuo weren't local, it wouldn't have affected Lin Yu's plans much...
At worst they'd communicate online.
But being able to meet Chen Zhuo in person would be ideal!
"Jiangcheng No. 6 High... didn't expect this chubby kid to have decent grades."
Looking at Chen Zhuo's school, Lin Yu muttered.
This high school was considered first-tier in Jiangcheng - not the absolute best, but with solid university admission rates.
Every few years they'd produce students admitted to the nation's two top universities.
In lucky years, even two per graduating class!
Lin Yu shouldered his backpack and rode his bicycle straight to Jiangcheng No. 6 High.
The school wasn't close to Lin Yu's home, but he was starting from the central small commodities street.
From there, nowhere in Jiangcheng was too far.
After about twenty minutes of cycling, Lin Yu arrived at the school gates.
Parking his bike in the designated area, Lin Yu approached the guard booth with a smile.
"Hello sir, I'm a Jiangcheng Media University student. My cousin in Class 5 Grade 2 forgot his exercise books at home and is afraid of getting checked. I'm here to deliver them."
As he spoke, Lin Yu pulled out his student ID from his backpack.
The security guard glanced at Lin Yu's ID and face.
His sunny, open college student appearance naturally aroused no suspicion.
Plus, it was Friday afternoon in broad daylight - the guard was feeling lazy.
"Go on then! No need to sign in!"
The guard used the remote to open a small gap in the gate.
He waved dismissively, signaling Lin Yu to hurry inside.
Lin Yu smiled, nodded, and slipped through.
"Thanks sir!"
Lin Yu then jogged across the playground toward the teaching building.
It was class time, so besides a few PE classes, the playground was empty.
After circling the teaching building twice, Lin Yu quickly discerned the classroom arrangement pattern.
"Grades 1-2 on first floor, Grades 3-4 on second... third floor must be... got it, Class 5 Grade 2!"
Lin Yu easily found the classroom.
But peering through the window, he was stunned.
The classroom was completely empty!
"Huh?"
Lin Yu quickly pushed open the door and walked to the teacher's desk.
There he saw the schedule showing the current period's activity - PE.
Lin Yu sighed in frustration.
"Of course they're those PE classes on the field!"The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
He could've saved himself the trip.
Lin Yu reluctantly retraced his steps back to the playground to search for Chen Zhuo.
After failing to spot him, Lin Yu pragmatically approached two approachable-looking students.
"Excuse me, classmates, where is Class 5 Grade 2 having PE?"
The two high school girls wore loose blue-white uniforms, with neat thick bangs and plain black-framed glasses.
Being stopped by this "poster boy" of the drama club made their hearts race.
"We're from Class 5 Grade 2," the taller girl on the right said softly. "Can we help you?"
"You're from that class? Perfect!" Lin Yu smiled. "I'm Chen Zhuo's brother, here to bring him something!"
At this, the girls blinked.
"Chen Zhuo's brother?"
Their faces showed clear skepticism.
Seeing their expressions, Lin Yu smiled wryly again.
"Alright, cousin then."

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Fraud in Reality! Fake Items Become Real!
chapters.content:
Under the guidance of the two girls, Lin Yu quickly found Chen Zhuo's location.
"He was just taken to the first-floor restroom by some boys from our class!"
Returning from the playground to the main teaching building, Lin Yu hadn't even reached the boys' restroom when he heard loud commotion coming from inside.
"You think you're hot shit now?"
"Asked you to buy a drink, why so difficult?"
"Don't know what you're acting all high and mighty about!"
Peeking inside, Lin Yu saw Chen Zhuo cornered in the restroom by four boys.
Chen Zhuo crouched on the floor, silently covering his head as the boys kicked and punched him, throwing water-soaked toilet paper at his head. He looked utterly miserable.
"School bullying," Lin Yu muttered, feeling a surge of anger.
He'd always despised this kind of behavior where the strong preyed on the weak."Hey, stop that!" Lin Yu entered the restroom, and the four boys immediately turned around.
Seeing Lin Yu appeared older than high school age, they quickly scattered, putting on fake smiles.
"Teacher, we were just playing around!"
Lin Yu glared coldly at them, adopting a stern tone. "Which class are you from?"
The four tall boys wearing expensive sneakers exchanged uneasy glances before bolting out the door.
Lin Yu didn't stop them, letting them escape. After all, he was here under false pretenses.
Then he turned to Chen Zhuo, who looked up at him, blinking away water droplets from his face.
"Game Master, how did you find me here?"
Lin Yu shrugged. "I'm the Game Master, of course I have my ways."
Chen Zhuo patted his soiled clothes as he stood up, looking somewhat awkward.
Seeing his wretched state, Lin Yu sighed. "Why not fight back?"
"Even if you used to take it... after participating in the Death Game, we've all 'died once' already. Why not be braver?"
Chen Zhuo looked embarrassed. "Fighting back is useless. I really can't take on four of them... Game Master, you're handsome and probably get good grades. You wouldn't understand."
"This kind of thing... resisting doesn't help." Chen Zhuo spread his hands helplessly. "It's already second year of high school. Just endure a bit longer."
"If I'd gotten the Soldier ability, I'd definitely fight back... but unfortunately, my profession is just Otaku."
"Though having a profession is better than nothing. My recovery speed after beatings has improved!" Chen Zhuo optimistically pointed to his reddened bruises that were visibly fading.
Lin Yu pondered Chen Zhuo's words before speaking. "The Death Game gives you more than just professions—there are items too."
"What if you had powerful items that could give you overwhelming strength?"
Chen Zhuo blinked, then his gaze hardened. "If I had items like that, no way I'd let people bully me!"
Lin Yu nodded approvingly. "Good... then wait a moment."
Turning to his backpack, Lin Yu pulled out a telescopic baton and a delicate glass bottle containing light blue liquid.
"These are the Baton item and Agility Potion item."
"The former is self-explanatory—just a baton that can be stored in your item space, no different from regular ones."
"As for this Agility Potion... after drinking, it greatly enhances your reflexes and movement speed for one hour."
Lin Yu pressed both items into Chen Zhuo's hands. Chen Zhuo looked stunned.
"Huh? Game Master, what's this for?"
Lin Yu patted Chen Zhuo's shoulder. "A gift from me as Game Master. See if you can use them—there should be descriptions popping up."Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirenᴇt
As Lin Yu spoke naturally, he felt something—
Belief power was emerging from Chen Zhuo.
Then, Lin Yu's earlier words became reality once more!
This was Lin Yu's first time activating his Fraudster ability in the real world.
Chen Zhuo looked amazed as the baton and potion disappeared into his palms.
"It's real... Game Master, thank you for your generosity!"
Lin Yu nodded slightly and pointed outside. "Go on, Chen Zhuo... now that you have power, do what you want to do."
Chen Zhuo nodded solemnly, summoning the baton and potion again.
He unscrewed the potion and drank it all. "Blueberry flavor? Tastes pretty good!"
Tossing the bottle aside, he suddenly felt surging energy throughout his body.
Seeing Lin Yu's expectant gaze, Chen Zhuo grew even more determined!
Gripping the baton, he charged out of the restroom with a roar. "Hey, you guys!"
Lin Yu remained in the restroom, elegantly washing his hands while listening contentedly to the chaotic sounds of fighting and shouting outside.
Of course, both the baton and "potion" were fakes—the former bought from a discount store, the latter homemade with food coloring and flavoring.
