This was exactly why Lin Yu had sought out Chen Zhuo—to test whether deceiving someone could activate his Fraudster ability to turn fake items into "real" ones.
After all, if he tried this at a gathering, experienced players might spot his counterfeit goods immediately!
But with a newbie like Chen Zhuo, it was different.
Now the experiment proved... it worked perfectly!
And coincidentally helped Chen Zhuo deal with his bullies too.
Lin Yu was extremely satisfied.
A few minutes later, Lin Yu exited the restroom to find Chen Zhuo leaning against the wall, panting heavily.
The four tall bullies lay on the ground in pain, looking at Chen Zhuo in disbelief—the usually clumsy chubby kid had just dodged and struck with impossible speed, beating them mercilessly.
Now holding the baton, Chen Zhuo looked down at them coldly.
"Used to let you off easy, but today was the last straw... from now on, you'd better stay out of my way!"
With that, Chen Zhuo quickly approached Lin Yu, his expression sincere again.
"Thank you... Game Master bro, that felt amazing just now!"
"But giving me potions and items like that... won't it violate rules?"
Lin Yu waved dismissively. "Not at all. Those were my personal items. Giving them to you is normal player behavior, unrelated to being Game Master."
Opening his backpack, Lin Yu revealed more batons and bottles inside.
"I've got plenty more little items like these!"

chapters.title: Chapter 38: The Gathering Begins! Hot Commodities!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu bid farewell to Chen Zhuo, who had now fully regained his confidence. After experiencing the "brink of death" and the bizarre Death Game, Chen Zhuo had already undergone a transformation. However, his "habitual mindset" had still prevented him from fighting back.
With Lin Yu giving him that little push—even though the potion had been used up and even though those school bullies might not accept defeat—Chen Zhuo would likely never be bullied again. Lin Yu felt quite satisfied with this outcome.
"Although the initial goal was to complete the 『Deception』, looking at the results... it turned out to be a good deed!"
Of course, compared to Chen Zhuo, Lin Yu himself had gained even more! The telescopic baton and potions in his backpack had, thanks to Chen Zhuo's belief, transformed into genuine 『game items』! Lin Yu even felt somewhat fortunate that he had arrived at just the right moment, stumbling upon Chen Zhuo being bullied. Otherwise, Chen Zhuo might not have so easily believed this 『Deception』 of his.
After all, if Lin Yu had no reason to give Chen Zhuo game items out of the blue, it would have been far too suspicious! Even if Chen Zhuo might not have outright disbelieved him, harboring doubts would have significantly weakened the 『belief』, and the 『manifestation』 effect might have been poor. In such a case, it might not have been possible to turn all the items real!
Because Lin Yu could sense... Chen Zhuo's 『belief』 was already stretched thin just converting all the items in the backpack into real ones.
"It seems this 'gathering' is a must-attend. Besides Chen Zhuo... I'll need to find other gullible players to exploit their trust in the future!" Lin Yu muttered to himself.Thɪs
......
Soon, Friday night arrived. The player gathering in "Jiangcheng" was about to begin!
Following the hints from the "guide," Lin Yu put on a face mask, a baseball cap, and sunglasses, parked his bicycle far from the abandoned restaurant, and walked the rest of the way to the gathering location.Many players in the "Death Game" had already had their psyches twisted by the successive games. For them, robbery and murder were commonplace tactics.
In recent years, with the rise of the 『forum』 and 『Order』—two just and righteous organizations—they had jointly established some customary 『Player Rules』 and created the "Administrators" organization to punish those who violated them.
The content of the 『Rules』 was straightforward—for example, prohibiting players from using their abilities to commit crimes in reality or from killing each other outside the game.
The emergence of the Rules and the Administrators had significantly improved the atmosphere among "players," with malicious incidents greatly reduced.
But one could never be too cautious!
A reduction in malicious incidents didn’t mean they had been completely eradicated.
While 『forum』 and 『Order』 were widely recognized as powerful, and the "Administrators"—their subordinate organization—was composed of high-level experts from both groups... they still weren’t strong enough.
At the very least, they hadn’t reached the point where no one dared to break the rules!
Thus... most guides still recommended concealing one's identity when attending offline "gatherings."
In fact... unless you were powerful enough to be confident, it was best to keep your identity as a player hidden in most situations.
And once you began acting as a "player," you had to take every precaution to avoid exposure.
Lin Yu took this advice seriously, so before attending the gathering, he naturally disguised himself thoroughly and planned his route carefully.
He left home a little after six... but by the time he arrived at the abandoned restaurant he had visited a few days earlier, it was already around eight in the evening.
Lin Yu noticed many people dressed similarly to him, moving furtively around the area.
People with faces concealed by scarves, masks, or even full head coverings were silently making their way toward the restaurant.
Lin Yu understood immediately.
These were definitely all "players"!
Blending into the crowd, he walked silently until everyone naturally formed a line at the entrance.
At the door stood two tall, burly men wearing ski masks and tank tops, holding scanning devices to "check in" attendees.
The scan was, of course, for the backend QR code of the "forum" app.
Since no one was making noise, the process was highly efficient.
The line, which had seemed quite long, moved quickly, and soon it was Lin Yu's turn!
Mimicking those before him, he pulled up his personal QR code from the "forum" app's backend.
Then...
"Beep—"
The machine, which resembled a supermarket payment scanner, emitted a sound indicating "approved."
A label printed out from the top of the machine.
"Nickname: Director"
This was Lin Yu's forum ID.
The burly masked man at the door tore off the label and stuck it on Lin Yu's chest.
"No fighting inside. Set up your own stall at any table. Don’t lose the label, or you’ll be kicked out."
The man, who looked like a bandit, seemed to sense that Lin Yu was a first-timer and gave him a quick reminder.
Lin Yu nodded, then entered with his backpack.
The abandoned restaurant, which had been clean but desolate a few days ago, was now bustling with activity.
Clearly, most people here were seasoned players. Many had already set up their stalls on tables, laying out the items they wanted to sell and waiting for potential buyers.
A few players who were primarily there to "buy" were wandering around the scattered stalls, some already haggling over items they fancied.
"Boss, how much for this toolbox?"
"Fixed price, 15 points!"
"Damn, that’s daylight robbery... I’m a student, can you go lower?"
"Hah, even if you were livestock, no! That trick won’t work on me!"
Hearing these down-to-earth exchanges, Lin Yu couldn’t help but chuckle and shake his head.
Though he had been a little nervous at first...
Once inside, Lin Yu realized—
This so-called "gathering" wasn’t all that different from the small merchandise street he had visited earlier in the day!
After all... it was just people selling things.
With this realization, Lin Yu relaxed considerably and found an empty table.
He began laying out his telescopic batons and potions one by one.
Then, mimicking the other stall owners, he sat leisurely behind the table, waiting for "customers" to approach.
But...
Lin Yu had barely settled in, about to kill time on his phone, when—
He heard an eager voice asking:
"Bro, how much for these batons?"
"If I buy them all, can you give me a discount?"
Lin Yu looked up and saw a masked young man with burning enthusiasm in his eyes.
"10 points each... cash preferred, I’ll give a discount for that."
"Damn, 10 points? I’ll take everything here!"
The masked young man’s eyes practically glowed.
But before he could pull out his phone to pay, another voice urgently cut in:
"Don’t sell to him, bro! I’ll pay 13 points each! Cash, no discount needed!"
Almost immediately, a man wearing a mask and a fisherman’s hat rushed over!

chapters.title: Chapter 39: The Tycoon Appears! A Fair Price!
chapters.content:
The masked fisherman-hatted man's loud voice quickly drew everyone's attention.
"Someone's selling weapon-type items over there!"
"Looks like telescopic batons..."
"Only 10 points each?! And cash payment accepted?!"
"Holy shit! What kind of philanthropist is this?!"
Instantly, players who had been browsing other stalls rushed over.
The other stall owners who lost customers didn't show any displeasure toward Lin Yu.
Because they all quickly packed up their stalls and ran toward Lin Yu's direction too!
Weapon items priced at just over ten points - you'd regret missing this opportunity!
Within moments, over a dozen people crowded around Lin Yu's stall."Hey kid, I'll give you 15 points, cash payment!"
"17 points from me!"
"I'll also pay 17 per baton... I want them all!"
"Who doesn't want them all? Damn it!"
Lin Yu looked at the players' burning gazes and realized he'd underestimated the allure of 'weapons'.
And these were just ordinary telescopic batons, not even proper blades!
The exchange rate was 1 credit point to 100 RMB!
In other words, 10 points equaled 1000 RMB!
The batons Lin Yu bought from the shopping street weren't top quality, originally priced at 229 RMB each.Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
He bought fifteen at once, haggled the price down to 120 each, spending only 1800 RMB total!
Of course, this 1800 RMB was nearly all of Lin Yu's savings at the time.
Lin Zhao hated seeing Lin Yu overworked with rehearsals and studies, refusing to let him take part-time jobs; Lin Yu also hated burdening Lin Zhao, unwilling to ask for more allowance.
Considering the low purchase price, Lin Yu had already set the selling price as high as he dared knowing how scarce 'weapon' items were!
But he never expected...
"Nearly ten times the price, and it's still considered too low?!"
"This is just an ordinary telescopic baton..."
But upon reflection, it made sense.
After all, having a baton in the Death Game might save your life at critical moments!
These people who experienced the Death Game...
None would think spending a few thousand for life insurance wasn't worth it!
Soon, someone exclaimed in surprise.
"Hey wait... he's selling potions too!"
"Let me see—'Agility Potion', holy shit! These effects are insane!"
"Didn't expect you'd have such good stuff, boss!"
[Agility Potion: After consumption, increases player's reaction speed and mobility by 200% for one hour.]
Because the previous 'Fraud' effect on Chen Zhuo worked, all these 'fake' items had now become 'real'!
So when players picked them up, the game's official blood-text descriptions naturally appeared.
Their eyes shone as they looked at Lin Yu.
"Boss, how much for these potions?"
Having learned from the baton pricing, Lin Yu—who originally planned to sell the potions at 3 points (300 RMB) each—hesitated.
He rubbed his chin and tentatively said: "These are also... 10 points?"
Indeed, the 10-point price didn't deter them but made them even more excited.
"I'll take all of these too!"
"Fuck, stop hogging everything, selfish much?"
"Boss, I'll pay 15 points per potion!"
As the commotion grew louder, they almost started fighting at Lin Yu's stall.
Then crisp clinking sounds came from upstairs.
"Clink! Clink!"
Lin Yu looked up to see the well-dressed Harmony Brings Wealth man from before descending the stairs, still wearing his elegant suit.
The sounds came from him tapping two gold ingots together.
He said loudly: "Quite lively here! Seems someone brought good stuff!"
The previously heated arguments instantly quieted as everyone turned to look at him.
"Tycoon!"
"It's Tycoon!"
"You're here, Brother Tycoon."
Several familiar faces in the crowd greeted him respectfully.
Watching this, Lin Yu understood.
Indeed, the Harmony Brings Wealth man he met yesterday was the 'Tycoon' mentioned on the forum!
And he seemed quite prestigious among these players.
After reading the forum guide's advice to "avoid revealing your identity," Lin Yu had regretted exchanging contacts with this man yesterday.
Though he'd been cautious, using a burner account... it still increased his exposure risk.
But seeing how respected the man was, Lin Yu felt slightly relieved.
Though...
This "relief" didn't completely eliminate his wariness.
The man addressed as 'Tycoon' approached Lin Yu's table.
"So these are the treasures causing such a stir?"
"Just ordinary batons... Hmm? These potions are interesting!"
"But hardly worth such frenzy!"
Tycoon then looked at the crowd.
The fisherman-hatted man smiled and explained: "Tycoon, the items are ordinary, but... he's selling them way below market price! And in such quantity!"
"Oh?"
Tycoon turned to Lin Yu, pretending not to recognize him: "What're your prices for these?"
"My initial pricing was 10 points each, with discounts for bulk or cash purchases."
Lin Yu answered truthfully.
Tycoon shook his head, fiddling with his phone: "That's too low... How'd you acquire so many items at once? Not easy."
"Seeing they're identical, probably from one dungeon—did your group collect them together? Or do you represent an organization?"
As Lin Yu prepared to respond,
Tycoon suddenly pointed at his phone screen.
Understanding, Lin Yu discreetly checked his phone underneath the table.
"Newbie, however you got so many items, you'd better claim you're backed by an 'organization'!"
Lin Yu's heart skipped a beat. He looked up gratefully at Tycoon and nodded slightly.
"I do represent an organization, though I can't disclose its name... Our leader urgently needs funds, so we're selling accumulated items... Hence my preference for cash payments."
Lin Yu said calmly.
Tycoon pretended to ponder, then said:
"In that case, why not sell everything to me?"
"I'll buy at 25 points per baton, 20 per potion—slightly below market price, but I'll pay entirely in cash. Fair deal."
He then addressed the crowd:
"After midnight tonight, I'll list these on the forum's marketplace at the same price—no markup. First come first served, one item per account."
Hearing this, the players voiced no objections.
"If you say so..."
"Alright, we'll do as you suggest!"
Tycoon turned back to Lin Yu: "How's this arrangement?"
"If your organization has items to sell in Jiangcheng, consider working with me—Tycoon—in the future. Deal?"
Lin Yu had no reason to refuse.
"Agreed, Tycoon—we'll do as you suggest!"

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Raking in Cash! The Mysterious Organization Appears!
chapters.content:
With Tycoon's help, Lin Yu had originally planned to set up a stall and sell items slowly throughout the night, but now everything was sold out in one go.
Of course, even without Tycoon's intervention, given how hot the sales were earlier... Lin Yu would have sold out quickly anyway.
But Lin Yu knew this was Tycoon helping him out!
After all, as an unknown newcomer suddenly offering a bunch of low-priced items, he could easily attract unwanted attention!
By selling everything to Tycoon in one go...
Lin Yu had effectively minimized the attention on himself.
Moreover, Tycoon's immediate payment also saved Lin Yu a lot of trouble.
15 telescopic batons and 20 potions totaled 775 forum points!
True to his word, Tycoon completed the entire transaction in RMB!
For this purpose, Tycoon even specially invited Lin Yu to the second floor.The restaurant's second floor had been remodeled by Tycoon into a luxurious office!
"We meet again, kid."
Tycoon smiled as he looked at Lin Yu.
"So you did recognize me."
As the saying goes, you don't hit a smiling face—even though Lin Yu remained wary of Tycoon, he still responded politely.
Tycoon waved his hand.
"Didn't recognize you at first, but kid, you're too green... These telescopic batons start at 30 points in Jiangcheng! You brought out over ten and priced them at 10 points each!"
"Then I remembered your reckless approach yesterday, felt like the same person... Got closer and hey, the build matched too!"
"Sent a message and confirmed it was you."
As Tycoon spoke, Lin Yu smiled: "No choice, even after reading the forum guides, there's still much I don't understand."
"True enough, you're a genuine rookie who just cleared your first round," Tycoon sighed. "But damn kid, you got over ten batons and twenty potions from one round, plus you had a pistol yesterday... What, was your first round some bonus stage?"
"Just got lucky."
Lin Yu answered vaguely.
Seeing this, Tycoon burst out laughing: "Look how scared you are... Relax, if you've read the forum you should know—I, 'Tycoon,' can organize and oversee Jiangcheng's offline gatherings because my reputation is solid!"
"Even if my reputation wasn't solid... I wouldn't care about your small potatoes!"
With that, Tycoon picked up his phone.
"Transfer received: 70,000 yuan!"
Lin Yu's phone announced the notification.
He froze.
"70,000 yuan, just like that?!"
Tycoon waved his hand again and pulled out a paper bag.
"Here's another 7,500 in new bills—take it. Saw your shoes and clothes yesterday, standard stuff. Young guy like you, first time making this much money?"
"Having some fresh bills to count at home feels nice."
Tycoon said with a smile.
Lin Yu took the heavy paper bag and quietly stored it in his backpack.
"Thanks... You're pretty observant."Thɪs updatᴇd by ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Lin Yu felt somewhat helpless.
Holding this thick stack of new bills did feel more satisfying than the digital transfer.
"I'll head out then... Really appreciate your help."
After thanking and bidding farewell, Lin Yu turned and left the second floor.
This "Tycoon" uncle was being unusually kind to him.
If they weren't in Jiangcheng but a southwestern city, if the man didn't seem so straight, if there wasn't that golden wedding ring on his right ring finger... Lin Yu might have suspected the man was attracted to his handsome looks.
But precisely because he couldn't figure out the reason, Lin Yu grew more puzzled.
"Why exactly is this happening?"
After Lin Yu left...
Tycoon also stood up and walked to the window, quietly watching as Lin Yu exited the gathering's restaurant without looking back.
From a door inside the office emerged a tall, burly man with dark skin.
"Boss, why are you so invested in this kid?"
"Sure, it's rare for a newcomer to have so many items at once, but not enough for you to pay this much attention, right?"
Tycoon shook his head.
"I can sense it—this kid has an aura, one very similar to mine!"
"His future is limitless, a rough gem worth my investment!"
Tycoon declared firmly, but the dark-skinned man wasn't convinced.
"Cut the crap boss... Since when were you good at judging people? What's the real reason?"
Tycoon sighed helplessly.
"Fine. When this kid came yesterday, he showed me a business card with our address... I recognized it as the handiwork of the 'Psychological Society'—he's someone chosen by the 'Psychological Society'! And likely at the highest selection level!"
"The 'Psychological Society'?!"
The dark-skinned man gasped, his expression turning grave: "Doesn't that mean... as long as this kid doesn't die young, he'll at least reach 'Third Tier'?"
Tycoon nodded slowly.
"Exactly. And his 'profession' probably isn't weak either!"
"No matter how lucky you are, you can't possibly get that many common items from just one beginner's round!"
......
The departed Lin Yu knew nothing of Tycoon's evaluation.
Since things ended early, it wasn't too late now.
Currently, Lin Yu was brimming with excitement from his earnings.
"Should I buy something for my sister on the way back?"
After all, many malls in Jiangcheng were still open at this hour.
But besides excitement...
Lin Yu was also curious.
What exactly did that "junior girl" who killed him and left the business card want?
Was it just to guide him to the gathering and quickly integrate into Jiangcheng's local player circle?
Before leaving, he had circled the restaurant inside and out again—even with everyone masked, Lin Yu didn't spot anyone resembling his murderer.
Neither the build nor the aura matched.
Just as Lin Yu was deep in thought...
Laughter sounded behind him.
"Hehehe... Not bad, Lin Yu. As expected of someone we chose."
"Not only did you clear your first round smoothly—you even made such a splash at your first auction!"
"Your potential truly is immeasurable."
Lin Yu turned to see a figure clad entirely in black, face completely covered, emerging from a nearby alley.
The person's voice was hoarse, as if deliberately speaking in a lowered tone.
"Who are you?!"
Lin Yu demanded coldly.
Hearing the question, the figure chuckled raspily.
"Heh, who I am isn't important..."
"But I can tell you that I'm from the same organization as the pretty girl who sent you into the Death Game and left you that business card."
"We're both members of the 'Psychological Society'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 41: The Battle Begins, 'Soldier' Lin Yu!
chapters.content:
'Psychological Society'?
Hearing this name, Lin Yu immediately understood.
Wasn't this the organization that was banned from "accessing the forum" that he saw yesterday?
Definitely not a good group!
Lin Yu quietly slipped his hand into his coat, concealing the revolver.
The [Guaranteed-Hit Revolver] still only had one bullet after returning to reality - though the bullet count refreshed daily, unlike in dungeons where the entire game only provided one.
Lin Yu didn't rashly fire or even reveal the pistol.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Though this guaranteed-hit bullet was powerful...
The other party had already introduced himself as belonging to an organization.
And one specifically called out by the [Forum]!This meant the 'Psychological Society' was likely not only shady but also highly notorious, probably large and influential.
At the very least...
Besides this unidentified man in black, their organization included that gun-wielding madman who had shot him before.
So Lin Yu decided to negotiate first.
"Who exactly are you people? Why did you try to kill me before?" Lin Yu asked coldly.
The man in black chuckled: "Kill? No no... Our goal wasn't your death, but to make you join the Death Game!"
"According to our organization's 'assessment,' you showed great potential - as expected, you were selected and even cleared the game successfully!"
"Our organization seeks promising individuals... those capable of extraordinary achievements in this game who haven't yet joined. We can't allow such talents to be wasted."
Hearing the man's excited words, Lin Yu became even more convinced these people were insane.
"What a bunch of psychos... No wonder the forum banned you."
The man in black scoffed at Lin Yu's remark.
"The forum? Just mediocre people huddling together for warmth!"
"Anyway... We're short on time. To avoid interference from those mediocrities, I should complete my mission."
He looked directly at Lin Yu: "So, esteemed Mr. Lin Yu, what class have you awakened?"
Lin Yu narrowed his eyes: "Why should I tell you?"
Not only had he awakened the unique class [Fraudster] which couldn't be revealed to anyone...
Even if he had awakened another class, he wouldn't tell this man or the 'Psychological Society.'
"Because this is part of further 'assessment.' You'd better cooperate... Otherwise..."
The man drew a dagger from his waist.
"I'll have to extract the information forcefully."
Seeing the glinting blade, Lin Yu immediately sensed danger again.
What happened when Death Game players were killed again in reality?
The answer... was permanent death.
Lin Yu almost instantly wanted to fire.
But he suppressed the impulse.
This man in black was his only current lead... he couldn't die.
Moreover, while the dagger was threatening, it was likely more for intimidation.
So Lin Yu responded coldly:
"Oh? Then I'd love to see you try!"
Putting away his pistol, Lin Yu bent down and picked up half a brick from the ground - in these old neighborhood streets, many broken bricks lay loose and easily lifted.
The man in black seemed surprised by Lin Yu's confidence.
"You don't seem afraid of direct combat? Bricks versus daggers aren't favorable odds. Plus, you don't know my class, do you?"
"Your class doesn't matter, because I've awakened as [Soldier], the best class for combat," Lin Yu declared.
He had made his choice.
Facing this mysterious man, Lin Yu decided to impersonate a [Soldier]!
Yu Longguo's insane combat prowess had left a deep impression.
Moreover, after reviewing common class abilities yesterday, Lin Yu knew [Soldier] was among the best for one-on-one fights, granting comprehensive physical enhancements!
The man in black froze momentarily before shaking his head: "Impossible. Your real-life background has nothing to do with [Soldier]. We investigated you - you're a college student..."
Lin Yu smiled.
"Seems you never attended college. Don't you know we have military training?"
Without hesitation, he weighed the brick in his hand and raised it level before him.
"Watch closely, idiot... Even with your dagger, you're no match for the enhancements [Soldier] gives me!"
The man's expression changed slightly.
Lin Yu raised the brick high overhead and, with full force, smashed it toward his own other arm.
During the brick's descent—
Lin Yu felt his words become reality!
In that instant, the man believed Lin Yu was a soldier!
After all, who would deliberately break their own arm before a fight unless absolutely confident?
This was precisely Lin Yu's plan.
He'd raised the brick dramatically to give the man time to think and believe.
As for his decisiveness? Pure acting.
And he gambled right.
With the man's belief...
Lin Yu truly became a [Soldier]!
His physical abilities multiplied instantly - strength flooded his body, movements turning light and agile.
"Crack!"
The brick struck Lin Yu's forearm, causing slight pain.
But enhanced skin, muscles and bones improved his durability - the impact only stung briefly without real harm!
The brick itself shattered against his arm.
Lin Yu stared down the man in black.
"Now you know my class."
"Since you admitted being from the same organization as my killer... It's only fair I take revenge, right?"
Lin Yu clenched his fist.
"Name your class, or I'll have to extract it forcefully!"
The man in black laughed at Lin Yu's imposing demeanor.
"Fine, I'll tell you. Though you're a [Soldier], the organization sent me because my class handles such situations."
"Oh?" Lin Yu squinted.
The man put away his dagger and produced two black spheres from his clothes.
"Surprised? While not unique, my class is rare and powerful!"
"My class is [Ninja] - farewell, Lin Yu!"
He smashed the spheres on the ground, producing billowing smoke.
"Cough! Cough!"
The acrid, slightly spicy smoke made Lin Yu's eyes water and nose burn.
Waving away the smoke, Lin Yu found the street empty again.
Under the vast night sky, Lin Yu sighed.
"[Ninja]? If classes relate to real-life 'experience,' how does someone awaken that?"
That guy didn't even look Japanese!
Too much Naruto gaming, perhaps?

chapters.title: Chapter 42: The Eccentric Thief and Lin Yu's Superior Skills
chapters.content:
Although the black-clad figure had escaped, Lin Yu didn't feel particularly frustrated.
After all, no matter how enhanced a 'Soldier's' physical abilities were, they still couldn't withstand bullets—he had already confirmed this with Yu Longguo.
And within the 'Psychological Society' organization, there was undoubtedly someone armed with firearms.
While Lin Yu harbored deep resentment toward these people who had dragged him into this Death Game under absurd pretenses after killing him, he hadn't let hatred cloud his judgment.
Revenge was something that needed careful planning.
"Tonight wasn't a complete waste though—at least I learned my killer belongs to the 'Psychological Society' and their general motives," Lin Yu muttered to himself.
Just as Lin Yu was deep in thought...
"Ouch!"
A petite girl bumped into Lin Yu.
The girl wore her hair in a short single ponytail barely longer than a tuft, with a perfectly round head shape.Despite it being midnight, she wore sunglasses and a mask, dressed in a black windbreaker with a hiking backpack—looking every bit like a Player.
Before Lin Yu could determine if this was an attack, the girl rubbed her head and angrily spoke first.
"Damn your ancestors! Are you blind? How could you just bump into people!"
The girl, who only reached Lin Yu's chest, looked up angrily.
Her accent and attitude clearly marked her as a local of Jiangcheng.
Seeing this tiny but fierce creature, Lin Yu took a step back, ready to apologize.
But then he reconsidered—something wasn't right here.
"Hey! Watch your mouth! I was standing still—you're the one who bumped into me!"
"You're the one not watching where you're going! How dare you turn this around on me?"
The short girl paused, then puffed her cheeks: "Well... well you shouldn't be standing in the middle of the road at night anyway! With all this smoke around, I couldn't see!"
Her tone had weakened considerably but she remained defiant.
Seeming to realize she was in the wrong, she waved her hand dismissively.
"Alright alright fine—my bad, sorry!"
With that hurried apology, the girl pushed past Lin Yu and continued walking.
Shaking his head, Lin Yu turned and followed the same direction.
After just a few steps, the petite girl whirled around, pointing angrily at Lin Yu.
"Why are you following me? I already apologized!"
Lin Yu raised his hands: "I'm not following you—I'm going this way too!"
"Yeah right... wearing a mask at night—you're a Player too, aren't you? Who knows if you're planning to rob me!"
She pulled out a box cutter from her pocket, extending the blade with a threatening flick.
"Stay back! Keep your distance! I'm not someone to mess with! My Class is super strong—I'm a 'Soldier'!"
The girl declared fiercely.
Lin Yu looked at the tiny box cutter matching its owner's stature and sighed.
His 'Soldier' deception was still in effect.
While a dagger might pose some threat, this box cutter...
Probably couldn't even break his skin.
And this girl was definitely no Soldier.
But with her jumpy personality, he didn't want further complications.
"Fine, fine, I'll keep my distance—you go first!"
Lin Yu remained in place, raising his hands in surrender.
The girl glanced back, snorted, then quickened her pace.
Her speed gradually increased until she was practically jogging.
Seeing her figure grow distant, Lin Yu resumed walking.
"Why do so many Death Game Players seem mentally unstable..."
He muttered, reaching the street corner.
As Lin Yu prepared to unlock his bicycle to head home...
He froze—his properly locked bicycle parked by the roadside was gone!
Checking his pocket, the keys were missing too.
Rushing forward, he saw a shared bike parked where his bicycle had been.
A sticky note on the shared bike bore messy yet delicate handwriting:
"Just kidding—I'm not a 'Soldier', I'm a 'Thief', hehe!"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
A doodled tongue-sticking-out face completed the note.
Lin Yu immediately recalled the girl who had bumped into him—this was undoubtedly her handiwork!
He immediately sprinted down the street, but found no trace of the girl anywhere.
Lin Yu exhaled sharply.
"I've really been looked down upon!"
That girl's acting had been impeccable—he hadn't detected any performance!
Here he was, a top-performing theater student and the Death Game's designated 'Fraudster', out-acted by some petty thief...
The world truly overflowed with talent!
Standing still, Lin Yu began laughing coldly.
"Very well..."
First a 'Ninja', now a 'Thief'... tonight seemed destined for encounters with vermin!
"Better hope I don't catch you in the Game, you sewer rats."
Lin Yu ground his teeth.
If he encountered Psychological Society members in the Game, he'd kill them given the chance.
As for that bicycle-stealing 'Thief'...
He'd at least give her a thorough beating and make her return his bike!
Thinking this, Lin Yu exhaled slowly.
Though to her credit, the thief had left him a shared bike.
Peeling off the note covering the QR code...
His phone immediately displayed a notification:
"This vehicle is temporarily out of service due to damage!"
Inspection revealed the shared bike's chain had been removed.
The night breeze flipped the sticky note, revealing additional text:
"With your IQ, you should probably give up on bicycles altogether."
Lin Yu took three deep breaths upon reading this.
For a moment, his hatred for that thieving girl surpassed even his resentment toward the 'Psychological Society' member who had killed him—that 'mysterious junior'.
Taking another deep breath, Lin Yu muttered:
"You'd better hope I never catch you..."
Otherwise, he'd personally hang that girl up and whip her with a bicycle chain until her skin split!
"Forget it, I should head home before my sister worries."
With this thought, Lin Yu walked forward...
But just one block away, he found his bicycle perfectly parked by the roadside.
Even his keys sat on the seat alongside another sticky note.
"Just messing with you—here's your bike back."
Another doodled tongue face concluded the note.
Lin Yu didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
"What kind of... mental disorder does that Thief have?"
Why return the bike?
Crouching to unlock it, he noticed something amiss.
"This isn't my lock?!"
Lin Yu stared blankly at the unfamiliar lock.
Another sticky note on the lock bore just two characters this time:
"Teehee!"
Lin Yu was utterly speechless.
"'Teehee' my ass."
With a powerful punch fueled by his 'Soldier'-enhanced fivefold strength, the lock shattered with a loud BANG.
Shaking his slightly reddened hand, Lin Yu tossed the broken lock into a nearby trash bin.
"Good thing I'm always one step ahead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 43: A New Game, Deadly Quiz!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu rode his bicycle back home.
Just like yesterday, Lin Zhao was waiting behind the door - except this time she was sitting on the sofa with the lights on.
Seeing Lin Yu push the door open, Lin Zhao immediately sprang up from the sofa, rolled up her sleeves and marched toward him with undisguised anger on her face.
"Lin Yu, today is already—"
Before Lin Zhao could explode, Lin Yu quickly opened his backpack and pulled out two stacks of RMB.
"Official business, sis! I went to make money!"
As he spoke, Lin Yu stuffed the two thousand yuan into Lin Zhao's arms.
The pink banknotes instantly wiped the anger from Lin Zhao's face.
She instinctively rubbed the bills between her fingers to verify their authenticity before speaking in a still somewhat reproachful tone.
"Why didn't you tell me earlier... Besides, didn't I tell you not to take part-time jobs?""That's exactly why I kept it from you - because I knew you wouldn't allow it," Lin Yu waved his hand. "Don't worry, it's not tiring work. Just quick money earned over a few nights."
Lin Zhao suddenly looked suspicious: "Quick money at night... Lin Yu, you didn't become some kind of male host, did you? I'm telling you, you better keep yourself clean!"
Lin Yu found this both funny and irritating.
"What kind of idea is that, sis! Why would I do that kind of work!"
As for the origin of this money, Lin Yu had already prepared an explanation.
"An upperclassman at my school is making short videos, and I made two guest appearances. This is my appearance fee!"
As Lin Yu spoke, Lin Zhao indeed believed him.
After all, in Lin Zhao's eyes, Lin Yu was practically a future big star and award-winning actor.
Getting paid a few thousand for a few days' appearance in short videos was perfectly reasonable!
"If there are such good opportunities, you should tell me. I would definitely agree, it's not like I'm completely unreasonable."
Lin Zhao even got somewhat excited: "Hey, what's your upperclassman's account name? I want to see what you filmed."
Lin Yu waved his hand: "Ah, they're still building their follower base, so all the videos are being saved up before release. I'll definitely tell you when they're posted!"
"I'm pretty tired after filming all night, I'm going to bed now!"
With that, Lin Yu quickly escaped to his room.
Closing the door behind him, Lin Yu let out a sigh.
"Whew..."
He had finally managed to fool Lin Zhao.
Lin Yu was already considering whether he should actually film some short videos.
Not only to have something to show his sister in a few days...
But also to avoid having to make up new excuses every time he earned money at gatherings.
"But these are all small matters... The most urgent thing is ensuring my survival in the Death Game."
Thinking this, Lin Yu opened the forum again and began browsing strategy guides.
Because of the unique characteristics of his Fraudster class, Lin Yu decided to memorize all currently known classes and their abilities!
For other players, memorizing other classes' abilities wasn't completely useless, but nobody would deliberately go through such trouble.
After all, in non-Competition dungeons, everyone would introduce their own abilities.
But for Lin Yu, the most useful application of his Fraudster class right now was pretending to be other classes.
Depending on each dungeon's characteristics, he could choose the most suitable class to impersonate.
Of course, besides this.
Lin Yu was also studying regular dungeon strategies!
...
Soon, four days passed in the blink of an eye.
Lin Yu spent the entire weekend holed up in his room studying various game strategies under the pretense of "reading scripts."
Even during school days, he spent all his free time outside of classes and rehearsals frantically studying strategies.
This greatly enriched his theoretical knowledge about the Death Game.
Even on his way to and from school, Lin Yu would recall the Death Game classes like memorizing vocabulary while riding his bike.
"Feels almost like going back to the days before college entrance exams."
Lin Yu couldn't help but sigh.
And just past noon on Tuesday, the bloody text before his eyes underwent some changes.
'Less than 24 hours remain until the latest possible start time for the next game!'
'Before midnight tonight, find a "body of water" deeper than 50cm and completely submerge yourself in it to wait for game entry.'
Looking at the bloody text, Lin Yu understood.
This was the entry method for the next game!
From browsing the forum these past few days, Lin Yu had learned that...
Weekly entries into the Death Game didn't happen instantly.
Instead, you had to follow some bloody text instructions to enter, and these methods usually resembled certain 'ways to die.'
Today's method was probably imitating "drowning"!
"Lucky it's not too demanding, otherwise it would be more troublesome."
Lin Yu muttered to himself.
If you failed to enter the dungeon as instructed by midnight...
You wouldn't be erased or anything, but would be forcibly entered into the dungeon.
However, in such cases, you'd usually face extremely harsh penalties in the dungeon!
Some people even died immediately upon entry... practically no different from the "death penalty."
As a newcomer who just passed his first dungeon, Lin Yu didn't want to challenge higher difficulties in his second dungeon!
So Lin Yu had already prepared his "body of water" - fortunately, he had one right at home!
Although their apartment was old and small, the bathroom was relatively spacious.
On a whim some time ago, Lin Zhao had bought a huge wooden bathtub, planning to enjoy hot baths.
But later she found it wasted too much water - especially since heating that much water consumed a lot of gas.
So the bathtub had only been used a few times before being left on the balcony.
Today, taking advantage of Lin Zhao not being home, Lin Yu returned early from school and dragged the tub to the bathroom to clean it.
Then, Lin Yu quietly waited until Lin Zhao returned home in the evening.
"You're back early today... You took out the bathtub?"
"Yeah, I thought I'd take a hot bath after studying tonight."
Lin Zhao wasn't surprised by this.
After dinner, Lin Yu returned to his room to review a few more strategy guides and reinforce his memorization of classes.
Then, around midnight when Lin Zhao was already asleep in her room.
Lin Yu tiptoed to the bathroom and locked the door behind him.
"People on the forum generally agree that the 'entry methods' are mostly related to the game content."
"Since my dungeon this time is likely related to 'water,' I should try to roleplay as either a 'fisherman' or 'sailor.'"
Thinking this, wearing flip-flops and tropical-style shorts and shirt, Lin Yu took a deep breath and submerged himself in the tub.
Holding his breath, within minutes...
As Lin Yu felt his consciousness fading, bloody text appeared before his eyes.
[Entering game—]Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
[Ga%me... na*me: Isl...and sur&...]
In his dazed state, the bloody text seemed to squirm momentarily.
But soon, the text became orderly again.
[Game Name: Deadly Quiz]
[Clear Condition: Solve the necessary puzzles.]
[Number of players in this game: 5.]

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Entering the Dungeon! Reencounter with the Bike Thief! Lin Yu's Fury!
chapters.content:
"Cough—ptui!"
Lin Yu sat up from the water, coughing out the liquid in his mouth.
His clothes and hair were completely soaked, and the air was thick with moisture.
He immediately wiped the water from his bangs and surveyed his surroundings.
It was an empty room about the size of a classroom, with pure white walls and ceiling emitting a soft glow.
Square openings existed at the very top and bottom of the walls—the upper ones slowly pouring water while the lower ones drained it.
The drainage speed clearly outpaced the inflow, causing the water level to rapidly decrease—where it had reached chest height when he first sat up, it now only came up to his abdomen.
The room contained nothing else besides these features.
Lin Yu looked around and saw the other four players as the game notification had mentioned.
"Cough...""Ptui!"
They too were just emerging from the water, sputtering out mouthfuls of the liquid.
Lin Yu examined them as usual.
There was a tanned, burly middle-aged man wearing a blue shirt and trousers, with a white hard hat on his head.
Not far from him stood two young people supporting each other—a guy in a gray hoodie and jeans, and a girl in pink athletic wear.
They looked like ordinary college students.
Lin Yu raised an eyebrow curiously.
"These two seem to know each other and are overly familiar."
Most likely a couple... at the very least in some ambiguous relationship.
He'd seen mentions of "team formations" on the forum before.
Certain special items could temporarily allow two or more people to participate in the same dungeon together.
He just hadn't expected to encounter a pair in his second dungeon.
Then Lin Yu's gaze fell upon the last player.
He froze momentarily.
The final participant was a rather young girl.
She stood barely taller than his dear club president Shen Bingmiao.
Dressed in a black windbreaker and cargo pants with a short ponytail, her head appeared perfectly round—topped with a pair of circular black sunglasses.
Lin Yu found her outfit vaguely familiar but couldn't place it immediately.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
That was until the girl turned her head toward him—even through the sunglasses, Lin Yu was certain their eyes had met!
And in that instant of eye contact, her unmasked lower face showed slight surprise as her lips parted slightly.
This reaction confirmed it for Lin Yu...
This was the bastard who'd stolen his bicycle!
Lin Yu felt anger surge through him, yet he also laughed in grim satisfaction.
"Instant karma comes quickly! Never thought I'd actually meet you in the game!"
Lin Yu immediately stood up and began wading through the water toward the girl.
"Just wait till I break both your legs!"
Seeing Lin Yu's expression, the girl panicked instantly.
"Hey hey... don't come any closer!"
She scrambled to her feet and started backing away.
"From the hints, this dungeon is probably cooperative and puzzle-based! There's no need for violence between us!"
Lin Yu's smile turned icier. "I know, but having broken legs shouldn't affect puzzle-solving, right?"
The girl hastily pulled out a utility knife, her face pale.
"Then stay back... you can't be sure you'd win if we fought!"
"Trying to pretend you're a 'Soldier' again? Don't think I don't know you're a 'Thief'!" Lin Yu sneered.
"I wouldn't dare! Even if I were a 'Soldier' it wouldn't matter... you're one too," the girl whined pitifully, "But don't think being a 'Soldier' makes you invincible—this knife is really sharp!"
Lin Yu responded with a cold laugh before pulling out his [Guaranteed-Hit Revolver] from his coat.
"Oh really? Is your knife as good as this?"
The appearance of the pistol shattered the girl's last shred of resistance.
She plopped down into the water with a splash, her face the picture of misery.
"Big bro, I was wrong, it was just a joke—I returned your bike in the end anyway... and that lock didn't even slow you down! I saw from a distance how you smashed it open in two hits!"
Seeing her surrender so quickly, Lin Yu felt somewhat helpless.
Just like the previous 'Ninja'... it seemed the 'Soldier' class carried considerable intimidation among common classes.
Combined with this pistol, his setup probably made him formidable among regular players.
Indeed, the other three players watching this exchange regarded Lin Yu—a 'Soldier' with a pistol—with newfound respect.
Finally, observing the kneeling girl and armed Lin Yu, the hard hat-wearing man spoke up nervously.
"Ahem, young man, I gather you have some real-life grievance with this girl... she played a prank by locking your bicycle, right?"
"In my opinion, while the girl is indeed mischievous, it's not worth risking danger in the Death Game over this... especially since this appears to be a cooperative scenario. No need to jeopardize yourself out of anger, don't you think?"
Lin Yu had mostly cooled down after her dramatic kneel.
But he kept the gun out—he needed to confirm one thing.
"But why target me with your prank out of nowhere—were you sent by some organization to test me?"
The girl raised her hands above her head, shaking them frantically.
"I swear on my life, absolutely not!"
"Then why? Spit it out!" Lin Yu demanded sternly.
The 'Thief' girl looked utterly miserable. "I... I was at the market that day selling items!"
"I worked hard last dungeon to obtain two 'Speed Talismans', hoping to sell them at good prices... but when I got there, some players told me my prices were too high because someone had just sold over a dozen bottles of 'Agility Potion' with better effects..."
"After confirming it was true, I only managed to sell one talisman all night even after lowering prices... I got frustrated and asked about your general description."
"Then by chance I actually saw you on the street... you were confronting a ninja at the time... it seemed like perfect timing, so in a fit of pettiness, I decided to mess with you a little!"
Hearing this, Lin Yu found himself torn between anger and amusement.
"Fine... such childish behavior!"
He waved dismissively.
Now that he knew she wasn't sent by some organization to probe him, Lin Yu's last concern vanished.
His anger had completely dissipated too.
Picking fights with someone this immature simply wasn't worth his time!

chapters.title: Chapter 45: The Quiz Begins, The Eerie Crow-Man!
chapters.content:
"Alright, now that the misunderstanding has been temporarily cleared up, let's briefly introduce ourselves... After all, this is a cooperative puzzle-solving game, so it's necessary for us to get to know each other."
After Lin Yu put down his pistol, the atmosphere instantly relaxed.
The middle-aged man wearing a white hard hat quickly stepped in to mediate again.
In puzzle-oriented games like this, the situation usually isn't too urgent, often providing ample time for players to communicate and understand each other.
He took the lead in setting an example.
"You can call me 'Iron Uncle', that's also my forum ID... My profession is 『Craftsman』, and I've cleared ten dungeons so far."
Hearing Iron Uncle's introduction, Lin Yu understood.
Eight dungeons meant he had been participating in the 『Death Game』 for two months already...
This placed him beyond the beginner range, making him a relatively "veteran" player!
After all, the forum had only been established two years ago!The oldest known batch of players... had only joined the game two and a half years prior.
Since the Death Game becomes progressively more difficult, players surviving over six months are extremely rare.
For Iron Uncle to survive two months and ten dungeons was already quite impressive.
And his profession was 『Craftsman』...
This was also a relatively common and versatile profession, belonging to the 『Enhancement Types』.
Lin Yu remembered the abilities of 『Craftsman』: increasing proficiency with various "tools" and enhancing understanding of mechanical structures.
This was an extremely versatile profession, since most craftsmen could fully utilize their professional advantages simply by obtaining tools like "wrenches" or "screwdrivers" through purchase or collection.
Moreover, regardless of the dungeon type, most game dungeons would contain mechanisms of some sort...
Having a 『Craftsman』 around could save a lot of trouble.
After Iron Uncle finished speaking, the young couple-like pair spoke up.
"My forum ID is 'April', profession is 『Doctor』, and I've cleared six dungeons."
The girl introduced herself, then nudged the young man beside her.
The young man quickly spoke up.
"My forum ID is 'Number Eight', profession is 『Student』, and I've also cleared six dungeons."
The two introduced themselves one after another.
Lin Yu nodded slightly.
The 『Doctor』's ability was simple yet powerful - the unconditional ability to perform one "treatment" per day without requiring any tools or medicine. A typical 『Skill Type』 profession.
As for 『Student』, it belonged to the 『Rule Types』 - when encountering non-player characters that could be negotiated with in a game dungeon, students would get one opportunity to "greatly increase success rate".
The self-introductions of "April" and "Number Eight" made Iron Uncle realize something.
"You two seem to be together, did you enter as a team?"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
The two nodded, and 『Doctor』 April didn't avoid the question, nodding as she said: "Yes, we used Party Items."
Iron Uncle sighed with emotion: "Out of five people, two pairs actually know each other..."
Then he looked at Lin Yu and the young girl.
"Though we already know you two are 『Soldier』 and 『Thief』... but please introduce yourselves properly."
The young girl nodded and began her introduction.
"Hello everyone, my forum ID is 'Unforgotten', and I've been through three dungeon games."
Lin Yu felt somewhat helpless.
Truth be told, in what appeared to be a puzzle-oriented game like this, Lin Yu really didn't want his 『Soldier』 identity.
He would have preferred an 『Information Type』 profession - like Teacher or Reporter.
But since there was someone here who knew him...
So Lin Yu had no choice but to admit it.
"That's right, my profession is 『Soldier』, you can call me 'Nine Waters'... I just cleared my first dungeon."
Lin Yu said calmly.
The young girl's eyes widened: "What? You just cleared your first dungeon?!"
Lin Yu looked at her and nodded.
"Yeah, is that strange?"
The others also looked incredulous.
Iron Uncle adjusted his hard hat and asked: "Brother Nine Waters, how did you know about the forum after just your first dungeon?"
"And from what you said, you even attended your city's offline gathering?"
Beginner dungeons wouldn't encounter veterans, only other beginners!
So most "newbie" players would only learn about the forum and items from older players in their second dungeon.
Lin Yu smiled modestly.
"I just got lucky."
Everyone looked at Lin Yu with surprise, clearly curious.
The college boy named Number Eight showed a relieved expression.
"Whew, having a newbie means... this dungeon probably won't be too difficult!"
He said optimistically and thankfully.
After the self-introduction session ended, the water in the room finally finished draining.
When all the water had been drained...
Everyone heard a faint "click" sound coming from the walls.
Lin Yu and the others followed the sound and saw that four doors had appeared on the walls.
The four doors were different colors: red, yellow, blue, and green.
Among them, the green door slowly opened, and a "person" walked out.
But Lin Yu and the others were certain that it wasn't human.
A "humanoid creature" wearing a "crow head" mask and covered in a black feathered cloak walked out.
"Caw caw— Hello there, 'players'!"
The crow-head's throat produced a hoarse voice, like dozens of voices overlapping.
Lin Yu and the others watched it solemnly.
The blood-lettered prompt before entering had shown the dungeon name and clearance conditions.
The dungeon name was "Deadly Quiz", and the clearance condition was "solve the necessary puzzles"...
In other words, this crow-man before them was likely the quizmaster.
Sure enough, after a few seconds, the crow spoke again.
"Caw caw, I will be serving as the 'examiner' for this game... I will give you questions and hints!"
"Caw, there are three 'rooms' in this game."
"Caw caw, I've set three questions in each room—two reward/punishment questions, and one 'decision question'."
"Caw caw, caw, answering reward/punishment questions correctly brings rewards, while wrong answers bring punishment. As for 'decision questions', you can only proceed to the next room by answering correctly—answer all 'decision questions' correctly to clear the dungeon."
"Caw, those are all the rules for this 'Deadly Quiz' game..."
As the crow spoke, it flapped its wings.
And in that instant, the water flow from the upper water outlet holes suddenly increased.
"Boom—"
Water gushed out, falling on everyone again, making them cry out.
"Damn it!"
The crow-man's voice sounded again.
"Everyone, please listen to the first question— At the current water inflow and drainage speeds, how long will it take for the water to completely fill this room?"

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Rising Water Levels! Unforgotten's Solution! Lin Yu's Doubts!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu was momentarily stunned when he heard Crow-Man's question.
This was a classic "pool filling" problem that mathematically belonged to elementary school level content.
As expected, Number Eight - the one with the 'Student' profession - wiped water from his face and spoke up.
"A pool filling problem? That's easy! We just need to set time as variable X!" he said somewhat urgently.
Lin Yu shook his head.
No, the difficulty of this problem didn't lie in the mathematical aspect.
Before he could speak, his girlfriend beside him - the 'Doctor' whose ID was "April" - sighed helplessly: "But do you know this room's volume, the water inflow rate, and drainage speed?"
Number Eight froze momentarily: "Ah, right... Examiner, what are those values? You can give hints, right? These should fall under hint parameters!" He looked at Crow-Man anxiously.
Crow-Man was also soaked, his feathers and mask dripping wet. He looked at Number Eight and said: "Caw caw, that's not within 'hint' parameters."
Iron Uncle shook his head at Number Eight. "What you're asking about is precisely this problem's difficulty - why would elementary-level math appear in the Death Game... This is testing our estimation skills."As he spoke, Iron Uncle had already moved to the room's edge, wading through water to walk its perimeter.
Number Eight and April looked puzzled: "What's this uncle suddenly doing?"
Before Lin Yu could explain, the young female Thief named "Unforgotten" spoke: "I think he's using 'step measurements' to calculate the room's length and width... This uncle wears a hard hat and has the 'Craftsman' profession, so he should be skilled at this."
As Unforgotten spoke, Lin Yu nodded slightly.
While the uncle measured the room, Lin Yu wasn't idle either - he approached Crow-Man.
"May I ask whether the final answer needs minute or second precision - this should be within hint parameters, right?" Lin Yu asked with a smile.
Crow-Man glanced at Lin Yu, shook off some water, and replied:
"Caw caw, let me think... alright, your answer's margin of error should be within five minutes."
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief at this.
A five-minute margin!
This meant the estimation didn't need extreme precision.
Soon, Iron Uncle completed his circuit and returned.
"By my estimate, this room is about 9 meters long and 6 meters wide... As for ceiling height..." He reached toward the ceiling: "Judging from this, about 3 meters."
Number Eight immediately blurted out: "Then I know! This classroom's 'volume' should be about 162 cubic meters!" He continued eagerly: "Now we just need the drainage and inflow speeds to calculate!"
As Number Eight spoke, Iron Uncle and April nodded, seemingly considering how to measure the water flow rates.
"If each outlet's speed is consistent, we could catch all water from one outlet in a container, then calculate each outlet's flow rate based on filling time, and with ten outlets total..." April proposed first.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
But Unforgotten interrupted: "No need for such trouble. Although five-minute error is allowed, the more estimates we make, the greater final error accumulates..."
She looked at Iron Uncle: "Uncle, just one question - are you sure the room height is 3 meters? Within 10cm error?"
Iron Uncle nodded confidently: "Though height is harder to measure, based on my experience, the proportion suggests three meters! After so many construction years, my eyes are rulers!"
Unforgotten pulled out her utility knife.
"This standard utility knife is 15cm long," she said, placing it vertically against the wall with the tip touching water and blade snug in the corner. "We just need to time how long until water submerges it completely... then multiply by 20 for total estimated time."
She began counting: "1, 2, 3..."
Iron Uncle immediately understood.
"Transforming the problem into water rise speed is brilliant... I have this 'pocket watch' item I obtained - let's use it for precise timing!"
He joined by the wall, taking out a pocket watch to time properly.
April and Number Eight also grasped Unforgotten's method, showing admiration.
"So that's how... this way we can estimate fairly accurately," April murmured. "I overlooked this approach."
Number Eight pouted: "Thought it was a math problem, turns out it's a brain teaser letting this 'Thief' show off."
April jabbed his waist disapprovingly: "Watch your words! Stop saving face with thoughtless comments!" Her tone carried displeasure.
Chastised, Number Eight awkwardly rubbed his nose and squatted down.
"Eye-level observation might be more accurate. I'll help watch when the water passes the mark."
Observing the group timing the water rise, Lin Yu instead felt something was off.
As "Iron Uncle" initially said, simple elementary math wouldn't appear in the Death Game.
At first they thought the difficulty was "estimating all parameters."
But after Unforgotten simplified everything to just "water level" plus Crow-Man's allowed "five-minute" margin...
This problem seemed too easy!
But what if viewed differently?
Like Number Eight said, if this wasn't logic/math but a "brain teaser"?
Brain teasers' hallmark is their "traps."
Moreover, Crow-Man clearly wasn't some mechanical NPC reciting rules - it possessed high intelligence and independent will.
It could "judge" which questions to answer between his and Number Eight's.
Yet...
Crow-Man's earlier reply made Lin Yu sense something odd in its tone.
"Let me think", "then", "alright" - three uncertain, imprecise phrases in one "hint" answer about "answer rules."
Crow-Man didn't seem to care about the "error margin," just casually saying five minutes!
In fact, Crow-Man not stating the "margin" initially already struck Lin Yu as strange.
With these thoughts, Lin Yu approached Crow-Man again.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: An Unexpected Answer! Unforgotten's Doubts!
chapters.content:
Looking at the drenched Crow-Man before him, Lin Yu spoke again.
"Examiner, I'd like to ask... after you pose a question, can we ask you any questions in return?"
For some reason, the Crow-Man seemed pleased by Lin Yu's question, flapping its wings twice.
"Caw caw, of course! This is how I give 'hints'—if you ask the right questions, I'll provide corresponding 'hints'!"
"Just as I thought!"
Lin Yu understood immediately.
This question further confirmed his suspicion—the Crow-Man's "answers" were absolutely not meaningless!
When previously asked about margin of error, the Crow-Man's "casual" attitude had led Lin Yu to form a hypothesis.
The hypothesis being...
The final answer wasn't a "specific" time at all, making the margin of error truly unimportant!But to confirm this theory, Lin Yu needed to keep questioning.
Meanwhile, the group in the corner noticed Lin Yu's actions.
Iron Uncle looked at Lin Yu while holding the stopwatch.
"Nine Waters, what are you doing?"
The somewhat enthusiastic veteran asked again.
"Just verifying some theories. Uncle, you all keep working... we might still need your calculated results later."
Lin Yu waved them off as he spoke.
Number Eight glanced at Lin Yu, opening his mouth as if to say something.
But remembering Lin Yu's powerful 'Soldier' profession and the revolver he'd initially pulled out, Number Eight ultimately refrained from criticizing Lin Yu's actions.
Lin Yu turned back to the Crow-Man.
"Then I have three questions... First, Examiner, are the four doors in this room related to the 'decision problem' from the first room?"
The Crow-Man turned its head sideways, fixing Lin Yu with one eye as if carefully examining him.
After a while, it turned back and said, "Caw caw, yes. The final decision problem... requires choosing one door from all in the room, behind which lies the exit to the next room."
As the Crow-Man spoke, Lin Yu narrowed his eyes.
"Then, Mr. Examiner, what lies behind the wrong doors?"
The Crow-Man chuckled darkly: "Caw caw, endless void of course. Falling means death... caw caw, but isn't it too early to ask about the 'decision problem'? You haven't even answered the first question yet!"
"But are these truly unrelated to the first question?" Lin Yu said, looking down at the drainage hole beneath him. "Mr. Examiner, you seem quite skilled at misleading people by 'telling half-truths.'"
At this, Lin Yu grinned widely.
"For my third question, you may choose any of the following to answer."
"When you refer to 'this room,' do you mean this enclosed space with four walls, ceiling and floor, or the entire 'first room' of this game?"
"Do these drainage holes lead to the same void space as the 'wrong' doors?"
"Does the 'void space' you mentioned count as part of the 'first room's' scope?"
Lin Yu fired off questions rapidly.
The Crow-Man chuckled low.
"Caw caw... impressive, player—I can answer all those questions."
"Caw caw, the answer is the same—yes, just as you've guessed."
As the Crow-Man spoke, Lin Yu looked toward the four people huddled in the corner.
"Hey, you can stop fiddling with your utility knives and water levels now... the answer is obvious."
He shouted, and the four looked at him confused.
The loud rushing water made it hard to hear clearly.
While they'd noticed Lin Yu asking the "crow" questions, they hadn't caught the specifics.
Just then, the four finished their timing measurements. Iron Uncle stopped the stopwatch and led them over.
"Nine Waters, we've got our results—the water rises about 15cm in 2 minutes 40 seconds, meaning roughly 53 minutes 20 seconds total... we could round to 55 minutes."
Despite Lin Yu's strange remarks earlier, Iron Uncle calmly presented their group's unified conclusion after measurements and calculations.
Lin Yu shook his head, rejecting Iron Uncle again.
"No, Iron Uncle. This question isn't about calculation—it's a 'word trap'!"
Lin Yu then explained his entire reasoning process, questions and all, to Iron Uncle and the other three.
Hearing this, Number Eight looked astonished.
"What? It's really like that?! Then we almost got tricked into dying!"
He spoke with utter disbelief.
Nearby, April helplessly reminded her boyfriend again: "Hey, this is just a 'reward-punishment question'—getting it wrong won't kill you directly! There'd just be some 'punishment'!"
As April spoke, Number Eight chuckled foolishly.
"Ohhh, is that so!"
His eyes shone with pure stupidity.
However, both April and Number Eight seemed convinced by Lin Yu's explanation.
Iron Uncle also nodded slightly after hearing Lin Yu's analysis, somewhat convinced.
"Put that way, your theory does make much more sense..."
"And with the Crow-Man's responses as evidence, it's almost certain that..."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Lin Yu nodded, continuing Iron Uncle's thought: "Exactly! The answer is that no matter how long it takes, 'this room' can never be filled with water!"
Lin Yu declared confidently.
After all, the scope of "this room" actually included the "endless void" mentioned by the Crow-Man—not just this 162 square meter house!
Hearing Lin Yu's words...
Though three of them appeared convinced, only "Unforgotten" looked at Lin Yu suspiciously.
"Really? Nine Waters... you're not tricking us, are you?"
Lin Yu sighed at the thieving girl who kept doubting him inexplicably.
"Why would I trick you? This is a cooperative game!"
Unforgotten shook her head.
"I don't know, but what if... just what if, you're completely deranged and petty, holding a grudge against me, wanting to torture me by giving the wrong answer on purpose?"
Hearing this, Lin Yu nearly laughed in frustration.
"You've got quite the imagination—if I wanted to torture you, would I go through such pointless trouble?"
Lin Yu pulled out his revolver, pointing it at Unforgotten's knee.
"Wouldn't shooting your leg twice work better than any 'punishment'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Reward? Punishment? The Second Question!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu's attitude immediately changed after drawing his pistol. The young girl adjusted her sunglasses and gave an awkward smile.
"Aiya, Brother Nine Waters, I was just casually questioning... It was mostly meant as a joke."
"Actually, I basically believe your answer. It's just that after all that wasted effort earlier, I couldn't help feeling a bit unwilling!" Unforgotten said while making a "please continue" gesture.
"Let's go with your answer."
Lin Yu put away the pistol and looked at Crow-Man.
"Good, then... our answer is 'No matter how long, this room will never be completely filled with water.'"
He spoke calmly as Crow-Man turned to the other four.
"Do you all agree with this answer?"
The other four nodded in unison.
"Agreed!""Agree!"
Their voices overlapped, with Unforgotten - who had just been "questioning" - sounding the most firm.
Hearing this, Crow-Man flapped its wings.
"Caw caw—Correct answer! Congratulations on your reward! I will eliminate one incorrect door option!"
As Crow-Man spoke, it turned around and touched the green door it had emerged from with its wing—and the door disappeared!
Then Crow-Man turned back.
"Caw caw, now for the second reward—"
It waved its wings, and then...
A new black square suddenly appeared in the center of the ceiling!
The square split open in the middle as two black trapdoors appeared and swung open, then...
An even larger torrent of water gushed out from the trapdoors.
For a moment, all five players froze.
They had naturally assumed that after the first question ended, the water outlets would stop again and the accumulated water would drain from the room.
But not only had the original water flow not stopped, now there was an additional outlet from the ceiling—with a flow rate nearly equal to the other ten outlets combined!
The water level began rising noticeably faster!
From this perspective, their earlier estimate of "about 55 minutes" for the room to fill wasn't entirely meaningless.
Because now... they could easily calculate that with the room filling much faster, their survival time was likely less than half an hour!
Considering they'd already wasted nearly five minutes answering the question.
Now they had less than fifteen minutes left.
Soon, the water in the room reached past their waists.
"What kind of reward is this?! This is punishment!" Iron Uncle couldn't help shouting angrily.
Crow-Man laughed.
"Caw, this is indeed punishment... Although you answered the first question correctly, so I gave you a reward—but you took too long answering, so I'm also giving punishment—with this restriction, you should answer faster next time!"
As Crow-Man laughed, Iron Uncle's expression darkened further.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Number Eight also looked displeased.
"How can you do this?! You never said we'd be timed!"
He looked at the group and whispered: "Should I use my ability to make it shut off the water outlets... At least get it to close that huge one on the ceiling!"
Hearing this, Iron Uncle and April both seemed tempted.
Lin Yu frowned, about to speak up against it.
But Unforgotten beat him to it.
"Unnecessary. I don't think we should use your ability here—this is only the first room."
"At least wait until we're truly stumped by the second or third question in this room before using your ability to buy us time."
Unforgotten said playfully, then added: "Aiya, I assume everyone here can swim?"
Number Eight and April both shook their heads.
"We took swimming together in college," April said.
Iron Uncle also laughed: "I can swim too, been fond of it since my youth."
Lin Yu nodded.
He could swim too—though not exceptionally well, floating in still water wasn't difficult.
Unforgotten's words essentially reflected his own thoughts.
This young girl had convinced the others for him, making Lin Yu view this 'Thief' in a slightly better light.
"Alright, let's not waste any more time," Lin Yu looked at Crow-Man. "Since you dislike wasted time too... then present your second question."
Hearing Lin Yu's request, Crow-Man spread its feathers and floated on the water's surface.
"Caw caw, then here comes the second 'reward-punishment question'..."
"With the increased water flow, you already know time is limited—so hypothetically, I'm assigning your group of five three tasks."
"These three tasks are 'crack the safe combination,' 'find the padlock key,' and 'turn the switch to close the black trapdoor.'"
As Crow-Man spoke, a projection of a safe appeared on the wall nearby.
Seeing Iron Uncle and Number Eight's eager expressions, Crow-Man cawed twice.
"Caw caw, interruption—these are just hypothetical tasks, you don't actually need to do them, so the trapdoor can't really be closed."
This dashed Number Eight and Iron Uncle's unrealistic hopes.
"Assume cracking the safe combination takes 10 minutes, finding the padlock key takes 12 minutes, and turning the switch to close the black trapdoor takes 15 minutes."
"Cracking the safe requires one person."
"Finding the key requires three people."
"Turning the switch requires two people."
"So—can you ensure no one drowns before the trapdoor is closed?"
Number Eight instinctively responded:
"Another elementary math problem?!"
This was even more classic than the pool-draining problem—a time allocation question!
Like brushing teeth while boiling water to "save time"... a problem type engraved in every elementary math student's DNA.
But...
This time, no one treated it as just a simple math problem.
After their earlier lesson!
Even Number Eight, who had spoken without thinking, quickly realized and looked at Lin Yu.
"Nine Waters, is this question also fundamentally a 'word trap' question?"
Lin Yu shook his head.
"I'm not sure yet, but based on the last question, that possibility seems high."
Unforgotten nodded and said:
"But... we can't assume it definitely is a 'word trap' question either—after all, this game might intentionally do the opposite!"
"Using our expectations to make us think it's another word trap—when actually it's just a normal math problem this time. That possibility exists too."

chapters.title: Chapter 49: The Trap of the Second Question! A Dilemma!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu basically agreed with Unforgotten's reasoning.
Although the Crow-Man had indeed played word games and set a "trap" in the first question.
However.
This couldn't be used as proof that this question must contain wordplay.
In a sense, this was also a form of "fraudulent behavior."
So after putting himself in the other's shoes, Lin Yu the 'Fraudster' easily reached a conclusion...
If it were him, Lin Yu would definitely mix truth with falsehood too.
After brief consideration, Lin Yu picked up where Unforgotten left off.
"Then let's temporarily treat this 'problem' as a regular elementary school math question."
"If we discover the possibility of 'wordplay traps' while solving it... we can consider that aspect then."Lin Yu said quietly.
Since Lin Yu had almost single-handedly solved the first question earlier.
Despite being the "newest" member in terms of experience, he had become the group's backbone.
Naturally, the other four players had no objections to Lin Yu's current suggestion.
Number Eight quickly began calculating.
"There are five of us, but these 'tasks' require a total of six people!"
Number Eight looked at the "Crow-Man," as if realizing something.
"Examiner, must we strictly adhere to this number? Could we possibly do it with one more or less person, even if it affects completion time?"
Number Eight asked.
The Crow-Man shook its head: "Caw caw, each task must be completed with exactly the required number!"
After hearing this, Number Eight scratched his head sheepishly.
"So that's how it is. I thought the 'trap' might be hidden here!"
Then he began mental calculations.
"If we strictly treat this as a math problem..."
"With this calculation method, the fastest would take 25 minutes," Unforgotten said beside them. "One person cracks the code, three search for keys, one stands by—then the code-cracker immediately joins the standby person to turn the switch."
"25 minutes," Iron Uncle pondered. "At that time, it seems quite likely someone among us would die."
After all, in the most optimistic scenario, this room would be completely flooded in about 15 minutes.
Even considering breath-holding duration, someone would undoubtedly drown.
April also frowned: "So the answer... inevitably involves someone dying?"Follow current novels on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"No, that's the conclusion from treating it purely as a 'math problem,'" Unforgotten shook her head. "We haven't considered the possibility of 'wordplay traps' yet—did you notice the Crow-Man's exact wording: 'Can you guarantee no one will drown before the hatch closes?'"
"He didn't specify that we must complete all three tasks."
"In other words, if we prioritize completing the most time-consuming task of closing the switch, then after 15 minutes—the hatch would close, stopping the water flow."
"Considering breath-holding time in that scenario, we might not lose anyone."
As Unforgotten spoke, Iron Uncle and Number Eight were convinced.
"That makes sense, this seems to be the 'wordplay trap'!"
Only April remained frowning.
"I feel something's off... but I can't pinpoint it."
Lin Yu also felt something was wrong.
The water level had now risen to his chest, and the shorter Unforgotten had to tread water to speak.
April wasn't tall either, so she stood on tiptoe in the water.
Number Eight grew anxious: "Right or wrong, at least Unforgotten's analysis sounds reasonable..."
"Let's just answer based on this—after all, answering too slowly also incurs 'penalties'!"
Number Eight's words swayed April too.
But just as April was about to endorse Unforgotten's analysis.
Lin Yu spoke up.
"No—what Unforgotten deduced is actually the biggest 'trap'!"
Even though Lin Yu had suggested temporarily ignoring "wordplay traps," everyone still couldn't truly disregard that possibility.
It's hard to overcome preconceived notions in one's subconscious.
Having experienced deception in the first round, Lin Yu knew well that successful fraud often exploits people's "subconscious" assumptions.
"So this question's 'trap' isn't in the wording... but on the wall."
Lin Yu looked at the safe projection on the wall.
It was an old-fashioned safe projection with a combination dial lock.
"Whether it's 25 minutes or 15 minutes, the timing is too 'ambiguous'—both scenarios could either result in deaths or not... so the answer can't be such an uncertain timeframe."
"And I'm curious—why must you present these as 'hypothetical' tasks rather than having us actually perform them?"
The Crow-Man shrugged: "After all, this game is called 'Deadly Quiz'!"
Lin Yu shook his head.
"No, there's more to it."
"That safe on the wall is probably the 'illustration' for the first task," Lin Yu looked at the Crow-Man. "Then where are the 'illustrations' for the next two tasks..."
Hearing Lin Yu's question, the Crow-Man floating on the water burst into laughter, slapping the water surface with its wings.
"Caw caw, you've found the key point again!"
The Crow-Man waved, and projections illustrating the other two "tasks" appeared sequentially.
First was a narrow hole too small for a hand to reach into, containing a metal key.
This was likely the illustration for the second "find the key" task.
Next, an old-fashioned rotary switch projection appeared on the wall—wrapped with fist-thick chains—ending in a massive padlock.
This illustrated the third "turn the switch" task.
The padlock's design perfectly matched the metal key.
Seeing these three illustrations, the remaining four players realized something.
Lin Yu looked at the Crow-Man and said quietly: "Let me confirm this—Examiner, these three tasks must be completed sequentially, correct?"
The Crow-Man laughed: "Caw caw, yes—the safe contains a magnet and thin wire, the key unlocks the switch's padlock, you're too clever!"
Lin Yu exhaled.
"So the actual time needed to close the overhead hatch is 10 plus 12 plus 15, a full 37 minutes—at that point, forget about possible deaths, none of us might survive."
"Therefore, my answer is... we cannot guarantee no one will die."
The Crow-Man looked at the other four players.
Before it could ask, the remaining four hurriedly spoke up.
"We all agree with Lin Yu's answer!"
The water level had risen further, now forcing even the three taller men to stand on tiptoe.
The Crow-Man then announced the answer.
"Caw caw, congratulations... you've correctly answered the second 'reward-punishment question'!"
"Your reward is—in the next room's 'dilemma question,' after your first answer, I'll open the door you didn't choose in this room and give you one chance to change your selection!"

chapters.title: Chapter 50: The Monty Hall Problem! Saving Unforgotten!
chapters.content:
After Crow-Man finished speaking, Lin Yu showed a slight reaction.
This "hint" combined with the room's layout and the information he obtained from the first question...
All these immediately made Lin Yu think of a classic "probability theory problem".
Just as expected.
Crow-Man spoke again.
"Caw caw, congratulations on reaching the first room's 'decision' problem."
