His voice suddenly rose an octave, the trailing tremble carrying a low roar, flames seeming to ignite in his eyes: "This is an insult to me, to all my past efforts honing acting skills—I demand you apologize immediately!"Follow current novels on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
After speaking, Lin Yu immediately reined in his emotions, expression returning to normal.
"At least act angry to this degree, Your Deity Majesty."
Lin Yu waved his hand.
"Fine, since you can't stop spouting nonsense, let's change the request... Can you dispel the surrounding mist and let me choose which path to take?"
After Lin Yu's rapid-fire speech, the opposite "Lin Yu" gently applauded.
"I'm genuinely starting to admire you now, Lin Yu."
As he spoke, the surrounding gray mist gradually thinned and dispersed.
Then, a space even vaster than the second room appeared, comparable to a large central square.
The towering dome reached a hundred meters high, surrounded by gray cliff-like walls.
Looking back, Lin Yu realized the spiral staircase behind him was merely decorative—though tall, it fell far short of the dome's height.
After the mist cleared, hidden deep in the mist to Lin Yu's right was a genuine long staircase.
An imposing, lengthy and broad stairway led to a giant gate near the dome, previously also concealed by mist.
The gate was similarly gray, though lighter in shade, as if carved from two massive square boulders.
Lin Yu exhaled.
"As expected..."
Each room's choice followed the same pattern—the real answer was never the surface "options."
"I choose this path," Lin Yu pointed at the staircase. "This is selectable, right?"
"Of course."
The opposite "Lin Yu" replied, then transformed into gray mist and vanished into the air.
In its place echoed a dull "boom" throughout the space.
"Rumble—"
The massive stones ground against the floor with heavy sounds.
The gray giant gate's two stone doors opened slightly, revealing a narrow gap emitting soft light.
Looking at the long staircase and opening stone gate, Lin Yu sighed.
"The first two rooms had crows carrying me. Now I have to climb stairs myself."
He jogged up helplessly.
Fortunately, the 『Soldier』's physical enhancements remained, so Lin Yu soon reached the staircase's base.
The gentle slope allowed Lin Yu to quickly ascend to the top—right before the giant gate.
"Whew, still somewhat tiring."
Lin Yu mused, wishing he could switch to 『Otaku』 mode now.
But he wasn't that greedy.
After brief rest, Lin Yu stepped through the gate's narrow gap.
Though just a "slit" relative to the massive gate, it was wide enough for three people to walk through hand in hand.
Exiting the gate, Lin Yu found himself in an even more expansive space.
This room resembled an observation deck—gray floor beneath, surrounded by circular walls of "transparent crystal" material, forming panoramic glass-like curves.
Looking around, the platform seemed suspended high in the sky, surrounded by rolling clouds where enormous creatures faintly swam.
Turning back after a few steps, Lin Yu saw a hundred-meter-tall gray Crow-Man stone statue.
The "stone gate" he'd exited was the base of the staff in its right hand.
"So the final room is a 'rooftop terrace'..."
Lin Yu muttered.
Before him, gray mist coalesced, reforming into the gray Crow-Man's image.
It looked at Lin Yu and spoke:
"Congratulations, Lin Yu."
"Welcome to the final room of the 'Inverted Tower'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Reward Stage - The Origin of the Fraudster Class!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu carefully examined the gray Crow-Man before him. Compared to the clearly "worn" crow mask and feathered costume from earlier, this Crow-Man now resembled a true crow transformed into human form. Moreover, it wore a crisp and elegant gray suit - though the gray was slightly darker than its feather color.
If the previous one was just an avatar...
This should be its true form.
Or at least a high-level avatar.
After all, this Crow-Man's coloration matched the hundred-meter-tall colossal statue perfectly.
Lin Yu's gaze returned to the Crow-Man before him. "This place is called the 'Inverted Tower'... correct?"
The Crow-Man nodded. "Indeed, this is the 'Inverted Tower'... though since this is only your second dungeon, you probably don't understand what that name represents yet."
As it spoke, Lin Yu nodded. "Then I'll make sure to inquire about what this place represents after I get out."
"Since this is the final room... state your question!"
A smile appeared on the Crow-Man's face - or rather, on the face of the God of Change. "Actually, reaching this final room should be considered a 'reward stage'.""After all, for those capable of deciphering my layered puzzles to reach here, further 'tests' and 'obstacles' would be meaningless."
"Therefore, these three questions... while answering 'correctly' is still better than answering 'wrongly', the moment you're asked, you've already gained something."
"The only difference lies in how much you gain." The Crow-Man said with polite laughter.
Lin Yu looked at the Crow-Man and nodded: "Really? I don't believe you!"
The Crow-Man sighed helplessly. "You... while caution is good, you're really being excessively suspicious!"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
"Never mind, you'll understand when you hear the question..." Clearing its throat, the Crow-Man continued:
"Then... Lin Yu, listen to the first question."
"Why is your class in the Death Game 『Fraudster』 rather than 『Actor』?"
After hearing this first question, Lin Yu looked at the Crow-Man in astonishment. This guy actually wasn't lying - the moment he heard this "question," Lin Yu had indeed gained something.
Because this was precisely the question that had been puzzling him. While browsing the forum, Lin Yu had seen information about the 『Actor』 class from guides. Though rare, it did exist.
The 『Actor』 class ability was 『Rule-based』, granting an advantageous "identity" for each game session. This "identity" wasn't a class - for example, if Lin Yu's class were truly 『Actor』, in the first dungeon he might have obtained an identity like "human explorer," giving him an extra letter compared to others.
In dungeons with many NPCs, 『Actor』 would be quite a powerful class. Yet Lin Yu hadn't awakened this class, but rather the unique class 『Fraudster』.
Though he agreed with the saying that "the essence of performance is deception," just because of that... he shouldn't have awakened as "Fraudster."
Lin Yu had never found any leads about this - until now. As this question resurfaced, he felt he'd grasped a clue. Just as this Crow-Man incarnation of the "God of Change" had said, posing this question itself was a reward. For a deity to ask this was itself a hint.
Lin Yu exhaled. He recalled the moment he entered this game - being shot by that mysterious girl from the 『Psychological Society』 whose identity remained unknown. In his dying moments, those lightly spoken words now echoed again, deafeningly loud:
"May you be seen by the gods." These words weren't her mad ravings after all, but a prophecy now coming true!
He also remembered the moment his 『Rewind』 succeeded in the first dungeon, hearing that admiring voice: "Truly... magnificent!" That voice hadn't come from anywhere in the world, as if directly resonating within his soul.
And just now, this God of Change had given another hint - within the lies and deceptions he'd woven hid a clue: "Manipulating time is the exclusive privilege of gods."
Indeed, after increasingly utilizing the 『Fraudster』 abilities, Lin Yu had grown to understand more about the "belief" required for 『Manifestation』. Thinking back now, that 『Rewind』 had truly been incredible - relying merely on six people's "belief," even deceiving himself... was that really enough to reverse time?
As all these details accumulated, every piece seemed to connect together faintly. Including this current dungeon. Though only his second... Lin Yu remained quite certain that a "god" personally appearing was an extremely rare occurrence regardless.
Lin Yu looked at the gray crow before him and spoke: "I'm not entirely confident about the answer to this question."
"But I think... it should relate to my 'potential' and the 'gods'."
"The condition for entering the 'Death Game' after death, according to the bloody text, should require 'intense longing for life'."
"As for 'class'... most believe it's closely connected to one's real-life experiences." Here Lin Yu paused slightly.
"But that's just the surface level... the deeper reason, I think connects to why this game exists."
"This 『Death Game』 was indeed created by gods."
"And some people in reality seem able to discern who has 'potential' in this game," Lin Yu sighed here, "to be honest, I was forcibly sent in by them."
He recalled that ninja from the 『Psychological Society』 organization who came to test him. That person had enthusiastically invited him to join the 『Psychological Society』, while initially expressing skepticism about him awakening the 『Soldier』 class. Yet that very attitude made Lin Yu realize something:
"So in this game, while most people awaken classes related to their experiences, and most classes initially have no inherent superiority..."
"But... those with exceptionally high potential might attract divine attention and awaken 'unique classes'."
"Therefore, from the very beginning, my starting point differed from other players," Lin Yu exhaled, looking at the "God of Change," "this 『Fraudster』 unique class... was probably given to me by you or other gods, right?"
Lin Yu stated calmly.
The "God of Change" laughed. "Basically correct, though with several key omissions and the final conclusion wrong... but I can give you 85 points!"

chapters.title: Chapter 64: “Unforgotten’s” True Purpose and Identity!
chapters.content:
“Is the conclusion wrong, and are there key omissions?”
Hearing the God of Change give his own evaluation of “85 points,” Lin Yu wasn’t particularly happy but instead slightly furrowed his brows.
In other words…
This ‘Fraudster’ profession wasn’t the result of divine intervention?
And what exactly was omitted?
Lin Yu grew curious.
“What did I miss? And what is the real answer?”
Lin Yu looked toward the gray Crow-Man.
The latter smiled and shook his head.
“That is something you will have to explore on your own in the future…”“Don’t be too greedy, Lin Yu. Being able to understand the roles of ‘Potential’ and ‘Gods’ in this game by the second dungeon already puts you far ahead of the others.”
“If this continues, they’ll have something to complain about.”
The Crow-Man said this and, before Lin Yu could continue questioning, changed the subject.
“All right, Lin Yu—you answered the first ‘reward-punishment question’ correctly, so naturally, there will be a reward.”
“Now, you can ask me about one ‘hidden secret of someone.’ It can be any secret of anyone.”
Hearing this reward, Lin Yu couldn’t help but scoff.
“So you were watching my entire first dungeon, huh…”
This was exactly the lie he had told when playing the ‘Detective’ class in his first dungeon.
The real ‘Detective’ ability wasn’t actually this.
Lin Yu muttered to himself and then looked at the Crow-Man.
“Can I choose you?”
“Sorry, I’m not ‘someone.’ I am a god.”
The God of Change refused Lin Yu.
Lin Yu wasn’t surprised by this answer: “Fine, then let me think…”
If it were the old Lin Yu, this question wouldn’t be easy to answer.
After all, his social circle was simple, and he had little curiosity to pry into his friends or classmates’ secrets.
But now, Lin Yu really had two people whose secrets he wanted to investigate.
One was the recently encountered “Unforgotten.”
The other…
Naturally, was the “junior girl” who killed Lin Yu, the mysterious “murderer.”
Lin Yu knew that the latter likely came from the Psychological Society and had killed him after noticing his “Potential.”
However, Lin Yu knew very little about her information or what kind of person she really was.
As for “Unforgotten”…
Lin Yu had spent an entire dungeon with her and had begun to grasp some of the quirky, nervous traits of this mischievous girl.
Her profession was ‘Thief,’ probably stemming from her prank-loving personality and “kleptomania.”ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Her true identity was likely a wealthy heiress from Jiangcheng—her windbreaker and sneakers were all expensive brand-name goods, and the black windbreaker was even made of cut-resistant fabric.
She was probably still in high school, with decent grades, and likely maintained a well-behaved image in front of her parents—when Unforgotten held a utility knife, she instinctively gripped it like a pen, and the calluses on her fingers had not faded.
With this information, even without asking Shen Bingmiao, Lin Yu felt he could find some clues about Unforgotten’s identity after leaving.
However…
Lin Yu still leaned toward using this question on “Unforgotten.”
Because even though the real identity of that “junior girl” was unknown, at least Lin Yu basically understood the organization she belonged to as a “player” and her purpose for killing him.
She looked strong and wasn’t in a hurry for revenge.
But…
What purpose did “Unforgotten” have for approaching him, and which organization did she belong to? Lin Yu was completely in the dark.
That’s right, although he had finally used the ‘Lie Detector,’ Lin Yu still did not believe the words “Unforgotten” said.
This ‘Thief’ was just as skilled at deceiving with the truth.
Her number of cleared dungeons might be correct, but she definitely wasn’t approaching him without purpose or just for fun.
From the very beginning, when Lin Yu saw the note left on the bicycle and shared bike stolen by “Unforgotten,” he clearly realized one thing…
This was an “evaluation.”
Although “Unforgotten” really loved pranks, everything she did to him…
That strong sense of “evaluation” meant to test his reactions was overwhelming!
Especially since this girl left almost immediately after the ‘Ninja.’
As a veteran player, how could she not recognize the ‘Ninja’s’ smoke bomb?
So, even if Lin Yu wasn’t sure whether this was a “test” and “evaluation,” or if someone was secretly watching him…
Out of caution, he acted irritable, quick-tempered, and completely fooled at that time.
And later, Lin Yu also solidified his persona by demonstrating the abilities of a ‘Soldier.’
And it proved…
Lin Yu’s guess was correct.
After meeting “Unforgotten” in this dungeon, she indeed already knew about his ‘Soldier’ profession beforehand.
This meant… she had definitely been secretly observing him!
Therefore, Lin Yu could never believe it was a coincidence that she appeared in this dungeon!
The forum mentioned many kinds of items that allowed people to “team up” in the same dungeon.
So an item that allowed someone to “join a specific player’s dungeon” wasn’t impossible.
Even though “Unforgotten” mentioned “Heavenly Artisan” briefly at the end, Lin Yu still believed…
“Unforgotten’s” target was definitely himself.
The reason was simple: just from the accent, “Heavenly Artisan” was from the northwest region.
“Unforgotten” probably just took his things casually.
In fact, because of “Unforgotten’s” intentional or unintentional misdirection, Lin Yu was even more certain she likely came for him.
So, Lin Yu further displayed his “persona” to “Unforgotten” in this dungeon.
From the previously “irritable” persona, he extended traits of being “good at puzzles, vengeful, and extremely arrogant.”
But no matter how much he disguised and concealed himself, once he realized that besides the Psychological Society, there might be other organizations targeting him, Lin Yu’s anxiety only deepened.
After all, what “Unforgotten” said about not coming from the Psychological Society was verified truth by the lie detector.
After careful consideration, Lin Yu decided to ask about “Unforgotten.”
He couldn’t keep up this “enemy-hidden, I-know” act forever.
So, Lin Yu looked at the gray Crow-Man and said,
“I want to ask about the secret of the player in this game whose profession is ‘Thief’… what exactly is her purpose for approaching me?”
The God of Change laughed.
“I guessed there was about an eighty percent chance you’d ask about her… But that one is really interesting; before leaving, she even tried to steal something from me.”
“I’ll tell you—she is a member of the ‘Free Alliance.’ She used an item to join this dungeon to evaluate whether you are suitable to join the ‘Free Alliance’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 65: The Final Deception!
chapters.content:
"Free Alliance?"
Hearing Crow-Man's words, Lin Yu froze momentarily before recalling.
This was another one of the three organizations banned from the forum, alongside the Psychological Society.
Lin Yu couldn't help but laugh wryly.
"Well, seems like I've only cleared one dungeon and already caught the attention of two troublesome organizations!"
He genuinely marveled at this.
Was his "potential" really that impressive?
To think two organizations would want to recruit him!
Wait—considering that Heavenly Artisan had also extended an invitation earlier...
"So all three organizations on the forum's blacklist have invited me, huh?"Lin Yu sighed.
Things were getting increasingly complicated.
As a newcomer who'd only cleared two dungeons, he barely understood the faction dynamics among Death Game players, yet three notoriously "non-virtuous" organizations had already set their sights on him.
This definitely wasn't good news.
"After getting out, I'll need to disguise myself properly and gather more intel," he thought.
"I should also investigate what this 'Promotion' business is about soon."
Turning back to the gray Crow-Man, Lin Yu asked,
"Alright, shouldn't we move to the next question?"
Crow-Man nodded with a smile.
"Indeed. Now for the second question..."
"Among all the information I've told you in this room, exactly one statement is false. Which one is it?"
Lin Yu narrowed his eyes.
This second question was rather interesting.
Unlike the first one which had immediately triggered revelations, this required careful analysis.
If taken as premise, any false statement among Crow-Man's words—about itself, about "deities," about the Death Game—could lead to vastly different conclusions.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
But as for this question...
Lin Yu exhaled.
"Guess I'll have to rely on intuition—I'll say it's when you gave me 85 points."
Crow-Man squinted.
"Oh? Your reasoning?"
"My reasoning is that I think my answer was perfect," Lin Yu said calmly.
"You definitely wanted to give me 100 points internally... at least 98!"
Crow-Man blinked, then burst into laughter.
"Hahahaha! Wrong answer..."
"But your response amuses me, so I'll still grant you a reward—you may ask me one question during any game session. For any puzzle I know the answer to, I shall provide a clear and truthful response."
"—This privilege isn't limited to the current game!"
With that, Crow-Man raised its right hand and snapped its slender fingers.
*Snap!*
A sharp pain erupted on Lin Yu's right wrist as a simple gray crow design appeared, as if etched into his skin.
"When you have a question, simply press your left index finger here and ask," Crow-Man explained.
Lin Yu rubbed the mark gingerly.
"Alright, now I'm starting to believe this is really a 'reward stage'..."
He then looked up.
"So, is it time for the final 'decision question'?"
Crow-Man nodded.
"Indeed... though this time, it's not about choosing an exit method, but selecting your equipment reward."
It spread both hands, where gray mist coalesced into two capsules—one red, one blue.
"In my open palms lie two items that will greatly benefit you."
"Choosing either left or right will grant you one reward and let you leave this dungeon."
"Now make your choice... which hand will you pick?"
"Point to it and tell me!" Crow-Man whispered.
Lin Yu stared at the red and blue pills, momentarily stunned.
"You deities watch The Matrix too?"
"I dabble in human entertainment," Crow-Man inclined its head slightly.
"Indeed, it's precisely humanity's boundless creativity that makes this game increasingly rich and fascinating."
"So the items are capsules," Lin Yu stroked his chin.
"Given you've seen The Matrix, from an auspicious perspective, red seems the obvious choice..."
"Blue feels like it might trap me forever in the Death Game."
Crow-Man chuckled.
"No such implication—neither capsule affects your ability to leave this dungeon."
Lin Yu also laughed.
"Right, because neither choice lets me leave... you bastard deity! Calling this a reward stage while hiding your biggest trick in the final room's 'last question'? Those two pleasant earlier questions were just to lower my guard!"
His laughter sharpened into a piercing gaze.
"You even stopped saying 'caw'—afraid I'd realize your single falsehood was actually hidden in the third question?"
"No wonder the second question felt impossible—every word you said seemed fake... though credit where due, you kept your promise of only one lie."
"'Choosing either left or right will grant you one reward'—this entire statement needs to be taken inversely, doesn't it?"
Lin Yu's eyes locked onto Crow-Man's outstretched hands.
"Choosing either hand means receiving no items and being unable to leave, correct?"
The gray Crow-Man gave a low chuckle.
"Heh... so what's your choice?"
"Using the same trick four times makes it pretty obvious," Lin Yu sighed.
"You even emphasized pointing instead of saying 'left' or 'right'..."
He suddenly pointed upwards.
High above in the vaulted sky, the towering Crow-Man statue leaned on a cane with one hand while the other...
lay completely flat and open.
"I choose the statue's open hand."
Lin Yu raised both arms overhead and declared calmly.
Crow-Man's laughter boomed like thunder.
"Even at the end, I couldn't deceive you... no wonder you obtained the 'Fraudster' profession!"
The giant Crow-Man "statue" bent down, placing its enormous left palm before Lin Yu.
Upon it rested two massive "items"—a row of gleaming white teeth and a crimson tongue.
The gray Crow-Man behind him dissolved into smoke as the statue spoke again.
"Lin Yu, congratulations on solving the final 'decision question.' Here are your rewards—choose one."
"One is named [Teeth of Prophecy]!"
"The other is named [Tongue of Deceit]!"
"After making your choice, I shall send you forth from this dungeon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Two Rewards: Teeth of Prophecy and Tongue of Deceit
chapters.content:
Lin Yu looked at the two items in the crow-man statue's hands and took a step forward.
"Can I check their effects?"
As Lin Yu spoke, the crow statue opened its mouth again, its voice deep, solemn, and resonant.
"Of course."
With the deity's permission, Lin Yu took another step forward, approaching the enormous hand.
Both items were roughly the same size as Lin Yu. He reached out and touched them.
The [Teeth of Prophecy] felt slightly hard and cold to the touch, while the [Tongue of Deceit] was warm and soft.
They resembled real teeth and a tongue, yet Lin Yu couldn't shake the feeling that they truly represented "truth and lies."
Like other items, these two displayed their descriptions upon being touched.
[Teeth of Prophecy: When activated, your next statement of "established fact" will be unquestionably believed. Can be used once per game. Disappears after three uses.][Tongue of Deceit: When activated, your next "potentially achievable" lie will inevitably come true. Can be used once per game. Disappears after three uses.]
Lin Yu froze momentarily as he read the descriptions.
These were practically tailor-made for a [Fraudster] like him!
The [Tongue of Deceit] was self-explanatory—it allowed him to bypass the usual conditions required for a [Fraudster] to make lies come true, forcibly realizing one false statement!
Best of all, it didn't even require a "target to deceive"!
At first glance, the [Teeth of Prophecy] seemed less impressive than the [Tongue of Deceit]. After all, "truths" were already "true," so the chance of disbelief was minimal.
But Lin Yu had learned during this game just how effective using "truth" to deceive could be.
Moreover, one "unquestionably believed truth," if wielded skillfully, could serve as the foundation for countless lies.
Faced with these two items, Lin Yu felt torn.
"What should I do? I want both..." he muttered.
Then, he looked up at the gray crow-man and suddenly realized something.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Hey, if I take one of these, can I test it out?"
The gray crow-man statue looked down at Lin Yu, narrowing its eyes as if understanding his intentions.
"You want both, don't you?"
"If you choose the [Teeth of Prophecy], I'll let you test it once... but not if you choose the [Tongue of Deceit]."
Lin Yu grinned at the statue.
"No problem, the [Teeth of Prophecy] will do. If you'd given me the [Tongue of Deceit], taking both would've been too easy."
His calm declaration only piqued the crow-man's curiosity further.
"Very well, let's see what you'll do!"
"The [Teeth of Prophecy]'s effect will work on me too," the gray crow-man murmured, lightly waving its hand.
The row of chilling teeth shrank to normal size and flew into Lin Yu's mouth.
He felt a brief coolness against his teeth before everything returned to normal.
Simultaneously, an instinctive understanding surfaced in his mind—just like when he'd first acquired his profession.
"Just think [Teeth of Prophecy] and wish to activate it, and the next statement will take effect..."
Lin Yu looked up at the crow-man statue, bared his now razor-sharp white teeth, and uttered his prepared "truth":
"Whenever I receive item rewards in any instance, I always obtain double the rewards—this is an ability granted to me as the [Game Master]."
Words passed through teeth, emerging as prophecy!
This was an "established fact"—Lin Yu had indeed received "double" rewards every time he'd earned them in past instances!
But it was also a deception... Lin Yu omitted that he'd only experienced one instance so far, and the double rewards came from deceiving Chen Zhuo.
This was the art of "deceiving with truth"—enhanced by the [Teeth of Prophecy]'s "unquestionable belief" effect.
Lin Yu felt a torrent of "belief" surge toward him.
The power of a deity completely solidified his "double rewards" claim as absolute truth!
The [Tongue of Deceit] on the massive hand also shrank and merged with Lin Yu's own tongue.
He flicked his tongue, producing a crisp sound.
Just like with the [Teeth of Prophecy], Lin Yu felt no discomfort.
He had acquired the [Tongue of Deceit].
The gray crow-man seemed dazed for a moment before exclaiming in admiration:
"So that was your plan all along... Even if I'd let you test the [Tongue of Deceit], you'd have chosen the [Teeth of Prophecy]!"
"Of course, the difference is significant," Lin Yu replied with a smile.
His successful deception didn't just earn him the [Tongue of Deceit].
Lin Yu had said "any instance"!
While he didn't know the upper limits of the [Tongue of Deceit]'s "potentially achievable" scope, guaranteeing double rewards in all future [Death Games] likely exceeded its capacity.
But a deity's "belief" was powerful enough to make Lin Yu's audacious lie come true.
Though the [Teeth of Prophecy] might not normally work on a deity, Lin Yu had deliberately piqued the crow-man's curiosity, prompting the God of Change to declare that "the [Teeth of Prophecy] will affect me."
Of course, Lin Yu was still gambling—after all, the crow-man might have witnessed his entire previous game.
This was both a test and a wager: could the [Teeth of Prophecy] override established facts?
The answer was yes—with the right phrasing, even deities could overlook reality.
The crow-man sighed.
"Daring to exploit a deity like this... you're the first."
"I'm starting to wonder why the [Death Game] chose you—you don't seem particularly afraid of death."
Lin Yu shook his head. "On the contrary... I'm terrified of death. That's exactly why I couldn't pass up this high-reward, rare opportunity to 'exploit a deity.'"
"Besides, you won't kill me, right?"
The crow-man snorted. "Don't be so sure."
The statue suddenly raised its hand and swung at Lin Yu!
Whoosh—
The mountain-sized palm generated chaotic winds as it descended.
Lin Yu calmly watched the approaching hand.
"Until next time, revered God of Change."
He didn't flinch or even blink.
Just before impact...
Everything went black.
[Congratulations on clearing the game "Deadly Quiz"!]
[Calculating your rewards...]
[Base reward: 7 days of survival time.]
[Additional rewards obtained this game:]
[Item·Teeth of Prophecy - Bound.]
[Item·Tongue of Deceit - Bound.]
Lin Yu exhaled.
"Told you he wouldn't kill me."
But he'd worry about "deities" later—he had more pressing matters now.
Looking around the [Settlement Space], he wasn't surprised to see [Heavenly Artisan], [Unforgotten], and [April].

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Returning to Reality, Promotion Trial!
chapters.content:
Although the trio had left the "instance" earlier than Lin Yu, just as he predicted, the exit time from the [instance] wouldn't affect the [Settlement Space]. They still entered the [Settlement Space] simultaneously with him - after all, the remaining three also seemed to have just regained their senses.
"Heavenly Artisan" looked around blankly, noticed someone was missing, saw the bloodstains on "April," and gazed at her with interest. "Heh, didn't expect this. After playing nice the whole game, someone actually died at the end... and it's 'lovers turning against each other.'"
"April" coldly stared at "Heavenly Artisan": "None of your damn business."
Having heard of "Heavenly Artisan's" reputation earlier, "April" had been somewhat afraid of this member of the [Marauders]. But after killing "Number Eight," April's personality seemed to have undergone some changes.
"Heavenly Artisan," choked by "April's" retort, helplessly raised his hands. "Alright, alright... my bad. This probably isn't a pleasant memory."Follow current novels on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Lin Yu then looked at "Unforgotten." Having confirmed this person was from the [Free Alliance], Lin Yu naturally needed to reinforce his persona more. "Tch, what a shame I couldn't leave you completely in that instance this time." Lin Yu put on an expression of dissatisfaction and indignation as he looked at "Unforgotten."
"Unforgotten" smiled: "Oh? Didn't you have fun? The [Death Game] is just a 'game'... enjoying it is what matters most, isn't it?"
Lin Yu shook his head: "I can't enjoy that kind of game. I just think the further away I stay from lunatics like you... the better." He said with a headache.
"Unforgotten" burst out laughing. "What a pity, you've already caught my attention - I said I'd pester you even more intensely."
Lin Yu coldly threatened: "Next time we meet, I might just kill you.""Then I'll be... eagerly waiting!" "Unforgotten" laughed heartily.
Then...
The settlement time ended.
Lin Yu returned to reality once more - opening his eyes, he woke up in that enormous wooden bathtub. "Splash!" Lin Yu stood up from the still-warm water in the tub, droplets rolling off his clean skin.
Through the conversation in the Settlement Space, Lin Yu roughly understood one thing. "Unforgotten's" evaluation of him was likely "qualified." Even though he'd acted "vengeful, impulsive, and scheming," even showing obvious "hostility" toward "Unforgotten"... the other party still seemed to consider him "qualified."
The reason was probably the abilities he'd displayed in the previous instance. "So the [Free Alliance] probably selects members based solely on 'potential,' not caring much about relationships between members or their personalities." "This suggests either the organization is as loose as its name implies..." "Or its administrators are confident in resolving conflicts between members." Lin Yu thought to himself.
Anyway, this [Free Alliance] was truly as bad as the [Psychological Society], having good reason to be banned from the forum. But Lin Yu felt the [Free Alliance] was slightly better for now. At least "Unforgotten" hadn't actually harmed him - whereas that mysterious junior girl from the [Psychological Society] had genuinely shot him dead.
Thinking of this, Lin Yu rubbed his chin. The reactions of other players in this game also revealed something. "The 'forum' really does seem like a trustworthy organization..." After all, even "Heavenly Artisan" and "Unforgotten," who weren't allowed on the "forum," had initially fabricated forum IDs. And when "April" and "Number Eight" heard "Heavenly Artisan's" forum-banned name, they immediately became wary and guarded against him. Even "Heavenly Artisan" himself didn't dispute anything.
This indicated that the [forum] should be a highly credible and authoritative organization among most players. Previously, the reliable information Lin Yu saw about the [forum] and [Order] organizations came from posts on the "forum." How could information from the same source be credible? Only after seeing the reactions of several "veteran players" did Lin Yu finally lower his guard slightly toward the "forum."
Similarly, the [Tycoon], verified by the "forum," might also be relatively trustworthy. "Maybe I can try subtly probing him for information about that mysterious woman from the Psychological Society..." "And the [Free Alliance's] 'Unforgotten'..." Pondering this, Lin Yu decided to find another opportunity to contact the [Tycoon].
Of course, he'd temporarily stop selling fake items this week. Lin Yu now had a more reliable money-making method than "selling fake items" - the "bounty" posts on the forum! Since the [forum] organization was trustworthy, those they put bounties on were likely people who deserved to die. So why not kill some deserving targets within his ability and earn some extra cash?
"I'll carefully ask that Tycoon about the 'bounty' thing later!" "Might as well ask about [Promotion] while I'm at it." Although Lin Yu had decided to temporarily stop selling fake items, to the Tycoon, just based on that last deal, he was somewhat of a "big client" now. Moreover, with the permanent "double rewards" buff, even if he never sold fakes again, he could always sell genuine items! So the Tycoon probably wouldn't mind answering a few questions.
With this in mind, Lin Yu took off his wet clothes, dried himself with a towel, and changed into prepared clean clothes. He decided to message the Tycoon right now to contact him. Lin Yu picked up his phone from the bathroom counter and turned on the screen. The time was just five minutes past midnight - same as last time, he'd woken up around one minute past midnight. Drying himself had taken about four minutes.
But at this moment, Lin Yu suddenly realized the blood text before his eyes seemed different from before. [Time until next game latest start: 06 days 23 hours 54 minutes] [Note: In the next game instance, you will receive an additional [Promotion Trial] task.]
Lin Yu was dumbfounded. "[Promotion Trial]... huh?" He'd just been wondering whether to ask the Tycoon about [Promotion] while inquiring about other matters. Now it seemed... he'd have to prioritize investigating [Promotion]. If he couldn't get satisfactory answers from the Tycoon... Lin Yu was even prepared to use that precious "question opportunity" given by the "God of Change"!

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Evaluation and Inquiry
chapters.content:
"Self-identified as 'Nine Waters', occupation is 『Soldier』, impulsive and vengeful personality but meticulous in thinking. Shows unique insights in puzzle-solving and setting traps using 'game rules'. Estimated potential at A+ to S- level."
"During actual gameplay, he didn't uncover my identity or purpose, but noticed my earlier surveillance and caused me some trouble in the dungeon."
"My recommendation: If he passes 『Promotion』, he might be worth recruiting into our organization."
In a standalone villa on Jiangcheng's outskirts.
A swimsuit-clad girl wrapped in a towel sat by the poolside, holding a tablet.
Beside her lay a soaked windbreaker and sweatpants.
After saving the file on her tablet, she dragged it into an 11-person group chat to upload.
Soon, the quiet group chat came alive with responses.

【Undertaker-Xiao Yun: Vengeful personality? Probably won't join the 『Psychological Society』 then, since they're the ones who killed her】【AAA Construction Lao Wu: But we should prevent 『Order』 from poaching him, especially since he's a 『Soldier』】
【Chef God: An S- 『Soldier』? No wonder the Psychological Society sent that guy to Jiangcheng!】
【Magician: Seriously? Even I'm only rated A!】

【AAA Construction Lao Wu: Honestly, should we make an exception and invite him first? With that potential, he'll definitely pass 『Promotion』】

【Magician: I agree with Chef God [flower]】
【Prisoner: Chef God makes sense. We can observe him more during this time】
【Undertaker-Xiao Yun: One thing bothers me - why call himself 'Nine Waters'? Rumors say that guy's also from Jiangcheng, possibly Jiangcheng's 'Game Master'!】
【Magician: Probably coincidence [sweat]】
【Chef God: If not, we're in big trouble!】
【Braised Carp King: Regardless, we should make more contact to confirm. Ideally determine his Promotion timeline and ensure he doesn't join 『Order』】
Seeing the message from "Braised Carp King" (whose avatar was a Charmander), the girl picked up her tablet again.
【Master Thief Anian: Then pay up! The kid's dangerous enough already, now possibly connected to the 'Game Master'? No extra pay, no deal!】
【Braised Carp King: Deal. Before next dungeon, I'll mail you the 'Exquisite Gloves'.】
Reading this, the girl's lips curled into a smile as she turned off her tablet.
"Nice, scoring 'Exquisite Gloves'... Carp's really going all out..."
"But the kid's worth it... Hope he passes 『Promotion』 smoothly."
......
"So the 『forum』 is deliberately hiding information about 『Promotion』."
Lin Yu put down his phone.
After browsing forum posts, he confirmed one thing...
While the forum had countless posts and guides, mentions of 『Promotion』 were extremely rare.
Even when mentioned, discussions were superficial at best.
Instead, many bounty requests contained posts like "Starting 'Trial' next dungeon, need help surviving safely."
This only deepened Lin Yu's confusion about what "Trial" actually was.
Realizing further searching wouldn't yield answers, Lin Yu opened his contacts.
After some thought, he messaged "Harmony Brings Wealth".
"Available?"
Within seconds came the reply:
"Oh, the 'newbie' who sold all those items!"
"Congrats on clearing your second dungeon... Got more items to sell?"Follow current novels on
Lin Yu smiled at the enthusiastic response.
A true businessman, always eager for customers.
"Sorry, nothing to sell this time."
"But I have some questions."
Lin Yu sent the message.
The reply came quickly:
"Ask away."
"If it's sensitive, come to the 'restaurant'."
"Just be discreet when coming."
Lin Yu considered this.
"I'll head over soon."
Currently, Harmony Brings Wealth was the most trustworthy 'Player' he'd met.
Though late at night, most Players had just returned from dungeons and wouldn't be moving around.
Perfect timing for Lin Yu.
Soon changed and masked, Lin Yu left home.
This time, he didn't take his bicycle but rented a shared bike instead.
The ride was less smooth than his own bike, taking longer to reach familiar Changming Street.
After returning the bike, Lin Yu approached the "abandoned restaurant".
As he prepared to find entry, a second-floor window suddenly opened.
"Kid, up here."
A bright blue-suited man lowered a retractable metal ladder.
Lin Yu blinked at the ladder before climbing up and hopping through the window.
Once inside, the man closed the window while Lin Yu removed his mask.
He found himself back in the luxurious office.
Harmony Brings Wealth took some loose tea leaves from a cabinet and gestured "please sit".
"Take a seat! What's so urgent you came running right after a dungeon?"
"Trouble in the dungeon?"
Seeing his composed host, Lin Yu sat on the sofa, sipped tea, and exhaled deeply.
"Big trouble!"
Adopting a troubled expression, Lin Yu continued:
"Do you know about the 『Marauders』 and 『Free Alliance』? Those banned groups from the forum notice?"
"I encountered them last dungeon. They seem dangerous... and I offended one. Am I in trouble?"

chapters.title: Chapter 69: The Truth About Promotion!
chapters.content:
Harmony Brings Wealth's expression turned serious upon hearing the two organization names from Lin Yu's mouth.
"The Marauders and the Free Alliance? Explain in detail, what exactly happened!"
Lin Yu nodded.
"My last dungeon was of the Puzzle type, so the competition wasn't too intense."
"After entering the dungeon, we exchanged identities and introduced ourselves. Two players seemed somewhat odd to me, but I didn't pay special attention at the time."
"It wasn't until near the end, due to the 'puzzle' factor, that they revealed their true identities."
"One was 'Heavenly Artisan' from the Marauders!"
Harmony Brings Wealth looked enlightened. "Ah, that super rookie who just joined the Marauders. He's got some real skills... You can find him on the bounty board if you check the forum."
He continued calmly, "Was he targeting you? If I remember correctly, he's from the northwest region, so no need to worry too much!"
Lin Yu shook his head. "Not exactly... On the contrary, he was relatively friendly toward me.""It was the other one from the Free Alliance who seemed hostile toward me."
Harmony Brings Wealth's expression turned serious again.
"The Free Alliance? It's quite rare for you to encounter them!"
"To be honest, when it comes to the Free Alliance... there's a high probability they're imposters!"
Lin Yu shook his head again.
"That shouldn't be the case, because she didn't claim to be from the Free Alliance herself—I confirmed it through my own means..."
"But why do you say they're probably imposters?"
Harmony Brings Wealth waved his hand. "First describe her characteristics!"
"A girl, not too tall, wearing sunglasses and a windbreaker. Her profession seems to be Thief, with a rather unpleasant personality, and her accent sounded like a local from Jiangcheng..."
After Lin Yu finished, Harmony Brings Wealth had a realization.
"You encountered 'Master Thief Anian'."
Hearing this name, Lin Yu also had an epiphany.
"Anian... Unforgotten... So that's what her ID meant."
He thought to himself while maintaining a confused expression.
"Is she very famous?"
"Extremely famous. Before being purged from the Free Alliance forum, her ID 'Anian' was quite notorious... Basically, anyone who participated in a dungeon with her would lose one or two items to her—and those items wouldn't return even after leaving the dungeon!"
Hearing this, Lin Yu was shocked.
"Her 'skill' can permanently steal items?"
Normally, items stolen by a Thief's skill in a dungeon would automatically return to their original owners after the dungeon ended.
If used in reality, the items would return at the start of the next dungeon.
While non-"item" objects could be stolen permanently, a Thief's ability wasn't supposed to work permanently on "items"!
Previously in the dungeon, Unforgotten... or rather "Anian" had shown him the items she stole from Heavenly Artisan. Lin Yu had thought she just wanted to play with them or see their effects.
He never imagined she actually had the ability to permanently steal others' items!
Harmony Brings Wealth said gravely, "Her profession is indeed Thief, but she probably achieved this through some special item..."
"The forum's evaluation of her was: 'There are many thieves, but only one Master Thief'!"
After hearing this, Lin Yu appeared even more worried.
"That impressive? So if she and her organization are targeting me, am I doomed?"
Harmony Brings Wealth shook his head.
"Don't worry too much. Although the 'Master Thief' has a nasty personality... so far, she rarely actively kills anyone!"
"She prefers teasing people and playing pranks. While being targeted by her might bring trouble, it usually doesn't pose a life-threatening danger."
After a pause, he added,
"As for the Free Alliance, you have even less to worry about!"
"Although this organization is 'notorious,' it has very few members... Currently, only nine confirmed members exist!"
Lin Yu was stunned.
"So few? How many members do normal organizations usually have?"
Seeing Lin Yu's confusion, Harmony Brings Wealth patiently explained,
"The largest is the major organization Order, with probably over five hundred to nearly a thousand members! Almost every sizable city has more than ten Order members!"
"Next are several nationally known organizations, each with a few hundred members—larger ones with four to five hundred, smaller ones one to two hundred... The Marauders, Psychological Society, Player Mutual Aid Association, Night Watchmen, etc., are all about this size."
"Regionally famous organizations are generally small to medium-sized. For example, my Jiang'an Hall in Jiangcheng has about a hundred members."
"Finally, there are various small organizations... but they need at least twenty to thirty members to be widely recognized as an organization by players."
"The Free Alliance is the only exception!"
After hearing this, Lin Yu thought for a moment before asking,
"Then why is the Free Alliance an exception?"
"Because their admission standard requires successful Promotion," Harmony Brings Wealth said calmly. "Although there are only nine members now, each one is a very famous 'powerhouse'... just like 'Master Thief Anian'!"
Hearing this, Lin Yu felt secretly pleased.
The topic had finally reached Promotion—he had been wondering how to naturally steer the conversation there.
Now that Harmony Brings Wealth brought it up himself, it was perfect for Lin Yu.
So Lin Yu put on a slightly confused expression and asked,
"Promotion? Didn't you say before that the standard for measuring strength is the number of dungeons cleared?"
"Many forum posts mention Promotion... What exactly is it?"
Harmony Brings Wealth looked at Lin Yu, picked up his tea, and took a slow sip.
"Correct, the number of 'dungeons cleared' is an important standard for judging a player's strength... but that's only relative to players of the 'same tier'."
"Having experienced two dungeons and obtained so many 'items,' you must have noticed... when receiving item rewards, the Settlement Space will notify you that you've received 'non-exclusive item' rewards, right?"
"Promotion means that before a dungeon begins, you'll receive a prompt to activate the 'Promotion Trial.' During that dungeon... you'll get some additional mission requirements beyond the normal clearance conditions."
"These extra missions are optional... but whether you complete them or not, the dungeon's difficulty will increase significantly for you. Even compared to other players in the same dungeon, yours will be exceptionally harder!"
"However, if you survive this dungeon and complete those additional missions... then congratulations, you've achieved Promotion, transforming from an ordinary player into a 'First-Tier' player!"
"The difference comes from the rewards—you'll receive an 'exclusive item' that essentially unlocks a second 'professional ability' for your class!"Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"Moreover, this new exclusive item often synergizes well with your original class ability, creating an effect greater than the sum of its parts!"
"Therefore, there exists a qualitative gap between players who have achieved Promotion and those who haven't!"

chapters.title: Chapter 70: The Tycoon's Invitation!
chapters.content:
"Qualitative change..."
Lin Yu heard the tycoon's words, and a subtle movement flickered across his expression.
In the last dungeon, neither "A Nian" nor "Heavenly Artisan" really used their class abilities.
Not to mention the abilities after 'Promotion,' even the original abilities of the 'Thief' and 'Craftsman' classes were barely used.The source of this content ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
But just based on the tycoon's statement, Lin Yu could still imagine that players who had completed 'Promotion' indeed held a significant advantage over ordinary players.
Seeing Lin Yu's thoughtful look, the tycoon laughed.
"Alright, no need to get too ambitious. After all, the day you get to 'Promotion' is still a long way off!"
Hearing this, Lin Yu was somewhat surprised.
A long way off?
He was clearly going to face his 'Promotion' next week!However, Lin Yu's face remained calm and composed.
"Is that so? Then how much longer roughly?"
The tycoon chuckled at Lin Yu's words.
"Usually, players encounter their first 'Promotion' dungeon at the ninth or tenth dungeon... it depends on their performance in the previous dungeons!"
"When the Death Game thinks you're ready, it will open the 'Promotion' dungeon for you."
"Those with higher potential get it at the ninth; those a bit lacking get it at the tenth."
"Of course, a small number with decent potential and early signs get the 'Promotion' hint at the eighth dungeon."
"And a very few geniuses start their 'Promotion' as early as the seventh dungeon!"
The tycoon looked at Lin Yu and said, "Honestly, I don't think you'll have to wait until the ninth or tenth dungeon!"
"But even if you are a prodigy who gets the 'Promotion' qualification at the seventh dungeon... that's still a month away, no rush."
Lin Yu smiled and nodded, saying, "That makes sense."
Yet deep down, he felt utterly shocked.
He wasn't just not waiting until the ninth or tenth...
According to the tycoon's tone, starting 'Promotion' at the seventh dungeon was already extremely rare...
He was on his third!
Lin Yu immediately made up his mind to keep this matter completely hidden!
He was just a newcomer already being targeted by three troubling organizations. If he exposed any special traits, he would never find peace again!
Some people naturally loved being in the spotlight and thrived even in danger.
But Lin Yu was not one of them.
Except when performing, enjoying the attention of the masses, his daily life was very low-key.
Moreover, these Death Game players and organizations were crazier than one another, and Lin Yu did not want to draw too much attention from them.
So, Lin Yu lightly cleared his throat.
"Alright, it seems there's no need to worry too much about this for now... but I'm curious, you just said the 'Promotion' task is optional—so what happens if you don't do it?"
"Oh, nothing will happen," the tycoon took a sip of tea and smacked his lips lightly, "It just means you'll face it again after ten more dungeons... So, many people don't complete their first 'Promotion,' and even those who do it the second time are in the minority!"
"Of course, even if you don't do the 'Promotion' task, the task itself will make your dungeon harder... surviving that itself counts as strength."
At this, the tycoon laughed.
"This is also why there is rarely information or guides about 'Promotion' on the forum; it's a tacit understanding among the organizations."
Lin Yu also lifted his teacup and took a sip.
"What do you mean by that?"
The tycoon laughed again.
"You've been on the forum, so you should know, although the Death Game has a wide variety of 'classes,' excluding those extremely special 'Unique Classes'... currently, the known classes don't exceed a hundred!"
"And among them, some classes that aren't unique are still quite rare... excluding those, the common classes are actually just over fifty!"
Lin Yu nodded slightly.
During the past week, he had almost memorized over fifty common classes and more than twenty less common ones.
He knew the tycoon's words better than most new players.
And the tycoon's words also gave Lin Yu a faint realization.
"So... could it be that the 'Promotion' tasks of the same class are very similar?"
Lin Yu said, and the tycoon smiled.
"Yes, although the 'Promotion' tasks adjust slightly according to the next dungeon, the tasks for the same class are basically similar—therefore, many organizations have rich experience on how to 'survive the Promotion dungeon' and 'complete the Promotion task.'"
"Thus, players with average talent who want to survive the 'Promotion' dungeon have the best chance by joining an organization," the tycoon said calmly, "After joining, you can get experience on how to survive, and even enjoy the service of experienced veterans 'helping with the Promotion dungeon' at quite a favorable price. Some large organizations, like 'Order,' even offer this as a free benefit—you only need to pay the cost price for 'Party Items!'"
"And players with higher talent and ambitions who want to complete the 'Promotion' task earlier and more safely can also gain a lot of useful experience—although once the 'Promotion' task is in a party, it cannot be completed and you can't rely on the organization inside the dungeon for help, but outside the dungeon, the experience and guidance are invaluable!"
"Moreover, after each class completes 'Promotion,' it will split into two different branches... choosing a branch is also valuable information for players seeking further advancement."
The tycoon stopped, and Lin Yu understood.
"I see, thank you!"
Lin Yu said, also understanding the tycoon's intention.
Since last time, Lin Yu had sensed that this uncle...
Seemed to want to recruit and win him over.
And through these inquiries, besides getting a lot of information about the Death Game and the player situation, he also confirmed one thing.
This "tycoon" was definitely well-informed and experienced.
He even knew about the 'Psychological Society' organization.
So...
Had he recognized that business card?
Recalling the tycoon's subtle expression at that time... Although this experienced uncle was a good actor, any trace of "acting" could not escape Lin Yu's eyes.
He definitely recognized the origin of that business card.
Therefore, he knew from the start that Lin Yu was being targeted by the 'Psychological Society'!
Moreover, judging by the uncle's knowledge of the 'Psychological Society,' he likely knew that the Society targets newcomers because they have very high "potential"!
But since the "tycoon's" goodwill was genuine, Lin Yu didn't expose anything.
Still, he was somewhat curious about the tycoon's real intention.
Just now...
During this self-introduction, the tycoon mentioned the organization he founded, 'Jiang'an Hall,' making Lin Yu completely clear.
This uncle definitely wanted him to join his organization.
Sure enough, the tycoon cleared his throat and spoke.
"Ahem, brother, to be honest, I won't be polite. I'll be straightforward with you!"
"I want you to join our 'Jiang'an Hall!'"

chapters.title: Chapter 71: The Tycoon's Strength!
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the Tycoon's invitation, Lin Yu was already mentally prepared, but he still showed a shocked expression on his face.
Or rather, he had planned exactly this "shocked" expression.
And he had prepared it quite carefully—not an ordinary "shock," but a mix of "30% doubt, 30% flattered, and 40% disbelief."
Anyone who saw Lin Yu's expression at this moment would naturally assume that he was feeling exactly that.
The Tycoon was no exception.
He looked at Lin Yu’s expression with some pride.
“No need to answer me right away; you can take some time to think about it!”
“Although our Jiang’an Hall is just a local organization, here in Jiangcheng… I still have the confidence to say we’re one of the top few!”
“Besides, you’ve probably seen some things about me on the forum… I’m the one who can organize the Jiangcheng Gathering recognized by the forum, so naturally, I have some real strength—our Jiang’an Hall is also one of the cooperative organizations of the Order.”
“In other words, within Jiangcheng’s territory, our Jiang’an Hall can represent the Order to some extent!”The Tycoon said proudly.
Seeing the Tycoon’s smug expression, Lin Yu added a little “admiration” and “reverence” to his shocked look.
“That impressive? From what I’ve read on the forum, the Order is the strongest organization! Those three groups removed from the forum? Anyone who sees the Order avoids them!”
As Lin Yu spoke, the Tycoon nodded calmly.
“That’s right. So outside the game, as long as you’re within Jiangcheng’s territory, whether it’s the Marauders, the Free Alliance… even including the Psychological Society, if they want to mess with you, I can protect you!”
“Of course, the premise is that you join our Jiang’an Hall!”
The Tycoon said earnestly.
Lin Yu looked at the Tycoon’s expression and deepened the "doubt" on his face once more.
“But based on what you said, wouldn’t it be better for me to join the Order directly?”
As he spoke, the Tycoon laughed.
“Do you think the Order takes in people without any threshold? Although the organization has many members, recruitment is very strict… they not only assess your strength but also your character! Once you join, there are many rules!”
“If you compare the Death Game players’ circle to a martial arts world, the Order is currently the leading righteous sect.”
The Tycoon spoke while gesturing with his hand.
Although Lin Yu didn’t know what he was gesturing at, he still nodded.
“I get it, the people inside are not only strong but also righteous, right?”
Lin Yu said, and the Tycoon showed a “worthy pupil” expression.
“Exactly. Relatively speaking, our Jiang’an Hall also has rules, but basically, it’s just ‘no killing people casually in real life’ and ‘don’t betray the organization’—those basics!”
The Tycoon said, looking at Lin Yu.
“Also, if a promising young talent like you joins now, the benefits are many!”
This middle-aged man winked and smiled.
“Like the Promotion strategies? But I can’t use those right now.”
Lin Yu said casually.
That was a lie—Lin Yu knew he probably wouldn’t be able to use them later either.
The Tycoon had just said…
The various organizations’ “experience guides” were all summarized from quests of the “same profession.”
But…
Lin Yu knew he had the Unique Class, the Fraudster!
“Unique Class”—where could he find any reference for that?
Moreover, he was especially special—the third dungeon had already unlocked the Promotion Trial, and from the Tycoon’s tone…
It was probably something no one had heard of.
Therefore, these “Promotion” strategies were basically useless to Lin Yu.
The Tycoon laughed after hearing Lin Yu’s words.
“That’s why I said, no rush to decide… wait until after a few more dungeons and see!”
“Then you’ll know how good it is to have an organization!”
The Tycoon said this.
Lin Yu nodded and interrupted him.
“Thank you for your kindness, Tycoon. I’ll think it over!”
The Tycoon was a man of standards; hearing Lin Yu’s words, he also knew the other was somewhat uninterested.
“I was a bit abrupt. It seems you hold yourself in high regard and want to join a major organization,” the Tycoon sighed, “But local organizations like ours have their own advantages, and actually, I’m not weak either—have you ever looked at the ‘Bounty’ section on the forum?”
The Tycoon asked.
Lin Yu nodded. “Although I was tempted by the money from bounties, I never really understood what Promotion was, nor did I know how strong other players were, so I didn’t look to avoid making myself greedy.”
He paused. “Now that I know, I’m even less interested… after all, you said the gap between players without Promotion and those who have it is qualitative.”
Lin Yu was telling the truth.
He wanted to make money but wasn’t that desperate.
He could take some risks, but not too big.
The Tycoon smiled.
“Still, take a look. The forum section’s name really should be changed… It says ‘Bounty,’ but now it also has a ‘Ranking’ function!”
“At first, some enthusiasts compiled a list of the ‘total credit points’ carried by the supernaturals under bounty, then someone joked, why doesn’t the forum create a feature to evaluate high-level players’ strength!”
“Turns out, the forum actually made it! They created a top hundred leaderboard!”
“At first, there was a lot of controversy about how the ranking was determined, but this feature has been out for over half a year, and after various events… people have mostly accepted it!”
“At least the ranking error should be within three to five spots!”
“Of course—those on the list who have forum accounts can choose to remain anonymous.”
As the Tycoon spoke, Lin Yu finally understood.
“Sounds like you’re on that list.”
The Tycoon laughed.
“Take a look!”
Lin Yu took out his phone and opened the forum.
He then opened the “Bounty” section, where he really found a pinned post titled “Player Ranking (Real-Time Update).”
The poster was the forum’s official account.
After clicking it, names and their organizations appeared on the black forum background.
First place, General, organization Order!
Second place, Diviner, organization Marauders!
Third place, Grandmaster, organization Order!
Fourth place, anonymous player.
…
Lin Yu scrolled down a bit but did not find the Tycoon in the top ten.
He scrolled down vigorously, the page scrolling rapidly.
The Tycoon, glancing at the screen, saw the text rolling and quickly spoke up.
“Hey hey hey, you passed it! You passed it!”
Lin Yu heard the Tycoon and scrolled back up a bit.
He quickly found the Tycoon.
Twenty-seventh place, Tycoon, organization Jiang’an Hall!
Lin Yu was slightly shocked.
“Whoa, among all the players, you’re ranked twenty-seventh?”
Hearing Lin Yu’s words, the Tycoon humbly waved his hand.
“That’s nationwide players… foreign servers don’t participate in the forum rankings yet!”

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Unboxing!
chapters.content:
Although Tycoon maintained a humble demeanor, Lin Yu could sense his underlying pride. Being ranked 27th on the forum's national leaderboard was clearly a source of immense pride for this middle-aged man. After revealing this information...
Lin Yu became even more certain. Tycoon valued him more than he had imagined. It couldn't just be because of those items he sold last time...
Considering the enthusiastic attitude of the Free Alliance toward him, Lin Yu could easily guess. Apparently, being killed by someone from the Psychological Society and entering the Death Game while leaving a business card served as a reliable "certification"!
This realization made Lin Yu even more composed. His careful "performance" toward Tycoon from the beginning was precisely to gather more information - and to fully understand Tycoon's cards and attitude.
Sure enough, while Lin Yu remained silent, Tycoon couldn't help but speak again: "So, what do you think after seeing this ranking?"
"I do. It makes me want to join Order even more," Lin Yu replied with perfect sincerity.
In the rankings, Order had two members in the top three, four in the top twenty... eight in the top fifty! Out of the hundred names on the leaderboard, Order alone accounted for fifteen!
The Order organization could truly be called dominant in the field. "With Order being so powerful, even if they have more rules, it wouldn't be unbearable," Lin Yu added.
Tycoon was momentarily stunned by Lin Yu's words, then burst into laughter. "Hahahaha—that's indeed an impeccable way of thinking!"
"But I'll say it again—don't rush. Large organizations have their drawbacks too... Order may appear strong, but as the 'leader of the righteous path,' they bear heavy responsibilities... Otherwise, they wouldn't be cooperating with our Jiang'an Hall!""Moreover, while we at Jiang'an Hall might not match Order in terms of assistance with Promotion... we do offer excellent benefits." Tycoon tapped the table meaningfully.
"For instance, items at the Jiangcheng Gathering and from our Jiang'an Hall can be purchased at 40-10% discounts... Plus, we provide one free Party Item every month."
"And, brother, you seem to be a university student, right? We can provide internship certification. After graduation, you could even work at my company! I'll handle your social insurance and housing fund—a no-strings-attached base salary over 10,000—weekends off, but you wouldn't even need to actually come to work!"
Lin Yu was momentarily stunned. Among all the offers, the internship certification and social benefits genuinely tempted him. This was perhaps the most attractive proposition for Lin Yu.
He couldn't imagine how sunny and cheerful Lin Zhao would become if he secured a stable job in Jiangcheng after graduation—with weekends off, full benefits, and a base salary exceeding 10,000...
Although Lin Zhao supported his "actor dreams" in both words and actions, Lin Yu knew deep down that his elder sister still hoped he'd find stable employment. And Tycoon's offer wouldn't even interfere with his acting aspirations.
"Might I ask which company you own, brother?" Lin Yu inquired cautiously.
"Qingsheng Group—Jiangcheng's own listed catering conglomerate," Tycoon smiled, extending his hand toward Lin Yu. "My father holds some shares, and my elder brother holds an important position there."
Lin Yu took a deep breath. Qingsheng! Their milk products and fast food were childhood staples for every Jiangcheng resident! He could already picture Lin Zhao boasting to every elderly neighbor in their community if he got a job at Qingsheng.
However, Lin Yu quickly regained his composure. Looking at Tycoon's hand adorned with rings and bracelets, he felt some realization. No wonder this guy had paid so readily last time—he was a rich second-generation! With his slightly older age and flashy style, Lin Yu had initially thought him a nouveau riche, but it turned out he was just a tasteless old playboy!
As these thoughts flashed through his mind, Lin Yu swallowed hard and shook Tycoon's hand. "I'll need to think about it some more!" he responded again.
Though it was still a "need to think," Tycoon could hear the change in Lin Yu's tone and smiled. "Good, I'll await your reply!"
Lin Yu stood up and left the restaurant. Once outside, his expression quickly returned to calm. "Organizations..."
Although Tycoon's offer was tempting, Lin Yu had only been playing along with his emotions. He wouldn't join Jiang'an Hall just for money. Of course, this didn't mean Tycoon's assumptions about him were correct either.
Lin Yu had no real intention of joining Order either. To be precise, Lin Yu didn't plan to join any organization at all. The existence of his Fraudster class had already prepared him mentally—he could never have true "companions"!
The Death Game players formed "circles," or as Tycoon put it, something like a "jianghu" (martial world). This was terrible news for Lin Yu. His class destined that the more others knew about him, the worse it would be for him. Therefore, Lin Yu could never truly join any organization.
"Unless one day I gain some means to freely change identities without anyone knowing, working with these organizations will remain the limit of my involvement!" With this thought, Lin Yu took out his phone and opened a chat window.
[Double Wood: President, are you awake?]
The reply came almost instantly.
[Nine Waters: ?]
[Nine Waters: No money, loved before, can't add performances]
Looking at Shen Bingmiao's messages, Lin Yu felt somewhat helpless.
[Double Wood: No, I need your help again. Someone else needs checking]
[Nine Waters: Ohhh, you scared me! Sending "are you awake" late at night]
[Nine Waters: I thought you were confessing or borrowing money or asking for extra performances!]
[Nine Waters: Just doxxing huh... Who screwed you over in the game this time?]
Lin Yu couldn't help but chuckle at Shen Bingmiao's messages. The senior was as lively as ever! He edited his message and sent it.
[Double Wood: Neither. This time it's a public figure]
[Double Wood: A relative of a Qingsheng Group executive or shareholder, male around late 30s. I have his WeChat]
[Nine Waters: Are you crazy? Doxxing rich people is dangerous! They can track you down!]
[Nine Waters: And this is a listed company's family... What are you planning? Considering marrying into wealth already? But don't pick an old man!]
[Nine Waters: Wait, don't tell me that's your type?]
Lin Yu sighed. Senior Shen Bingmiao was great in every way, except sometimes too eccentric!
[Double Wood: No, I just want to know if he's reliable—no need for private details, just check if he has any scandals or criminal records, okay?]
[Double Wood: Preferably a simple "growth trajectory"—where he studied, previous jobs, etc.]The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
With this information, Lin Yu could sketch out some deeper traits of Tycoon by writing a "character profile"—applying acting techniques to real life. Though after meeting Tycoon, he already seemed fairly trustworthy, and even if Lin Yu didn't join Jiang'an Hall, friendly relations might be possible.
Still, Lin Yu preferred caution.
[Nine Waters: Easy enough, but... feels like you're writing this guy's "profile"?]
Lin Yu had to admire his senior's sharpness again—but he was prepared.
[Double Wood: Not a "profile"—just experimenting with scriptwriting recently, using him as inspiration]
Then an idea struck him.
[Double Wood: By the way, while you're at it... do you know any Jiangcheng tycoons with daughters around 16-17? Probably only children, likely high-achievers]
[Double Wood: If convenient, could you check for matches?]
Shen Bingmiao immediately replied with a shocked panda meme.
[Nine Waters: What are you planning now?]
[Nine Waters: To prove you're not after uncles, so switching to sugar mommas instead?!]
[Nine Waters: Specifically requesting 16-17... Lin Yu, you're too disgusting]
[Nine Waters: No wonder you ignore all your school fans—they've expired?!]
[Nine Waters: If you ever get famous and get exposed for underage scandals, don't say you're from Jiangcheng Media Drama Club—I can't take that shame!]
Lin Yu grew even more exasperated.
[Double Wood: You've misunderstood, President. There's a reason—let me explain]
Shen Bingmiao sent a listening panda meme.
[Nine Waters: You'd better explain clearly, or I'll have to purge you from the club]
[Double Wood: It's a long story, so I'll keep it short...]
Lin Yu considered, deciding to omit the Death Game parts and mix truth with lies.
[Double Wood: Last week at an "offline gathering," I met a girl who seemed wealthy but might have kleptomania...]
[Nine Waters: She stole your underwear? Probably a Jiangda High student, your fan, obsessed with your looks!]
[Double Wood: ...No, she stole my bike key and rode off with it]
[Nine Waters: Huh?]
[Double Wood: Right. When I caught up at the next intersection, she'd already locked it back properly—hence my kleptomania theory!]
[Nine Waters: 6]
[Nine Waters: That's so absurd it might actually be true]
[Nine Waters: I'll help investigate, see what turns up!]
Reading Shen Bingmiao's messages, Lin Yu relaxed. With the president's help, finding information about "A Nian" wouldn't be completely impossible!

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Investigation Results
chapters.content:
After entrusting Shen Bingmiao with the investigation, Lin Yu rode the shared bike back home again.
Since he had informed "Lin Zhao" before going out this time, saying he was going to discuss "filming" matters, Lin Zhao didn't wait up for him at home and had gone to bed early.
Returning to the silent house, Lin Yu lay on his bed, continuing to ponder the events of the day.
"Hah..."
In the darkness, Lin Yu stretched his hand toward the ceiling, spreading his ten fingers.
After this dungeon and his conversation with the Tycoon, Lin Yu became even more certain...
That "peaceful life" had truly left him far behind.
Even his current life might be more thrilling than that of ordinary Death Game players.
After all, normal players in the early stages only needed to worry about weekly dungeons at most.
But after just two dungeons, he was already facing the Promotion challenge for his third...Moreover, various organizations had their eyes on him.
Even a deity had personally appeared in the last dungeon.
Lin Yu felt increasingly troubled by this.
"They say I have 'potential,' but what the hell is this so-called 'potential' anyway?"
Everyone treated him like some rare treasure—evaluating, inviting, testing, and trying to recruit him.
But Lin Yu believed he had "clear self-awareness."
He was just a college student who loved acting.
Neither a "genius" nor a "madman."
Although he had genuinely survived two dungeons, only Lin Yu himself knew how perilously close to failure he had been each time.
"Originally, I thought someone like me wouldn't survive past the first chapter in those 'infinite flow web novels'..."
Lin Yu sighed.
All he could do now was take things one step at a time.
"Let's just treat the rest of my life as a 'stage' and perform to my heart's content."
"After all, my Class requires me to perform anyway."
As Lin Yu muttered to himself, his phone vibrated slightly by his pillow.
"Buzz—"
Opening his phone, he found two files sent by Shen Bingmiao.
One was titled "He Jucai."
Opening it revealed a headshot of the Tycoon at the top.
Lin Yu skimmed through it—Shen Bingmiao was indeed highly efficient at digging up information on semi-public figures like this.
The Tycoon's life trajectory unfolded clearly on the screen—graduated from a private elite high school, paid his way into Jiangcheng University's international joint college.
During college, he apparently had some disagreement with his family, started his own business, and ended up losing everything.
That abandoned restaurant seemed to be something the ambitious Tycoon had acquired during that period, intending to turn it around—but the results were what Lin Yu had already seen.
"Still keeping that office shows he's nostalgic and probably values relationships."
Lin Yu mentally commented.
Even the reason for his business failure was being too sentimental, getting dragged down by incompetent school friends.
Though "dragged down" might not be accurate—the Tycoon probably wasn't cut out for business either.
Since the other party was assessing him, Lin Yu felt he should return the courtesy by evaluating the Tycoon and others more thoroughly.
Perhaps in future dealings with the Tycoon, he should take a more "emotional approach."
Overall, the Tycoon's life trajectory was pretty much what Lin Yu had expected.
"Someone slightly trustworthy, and more sentimental than I imagined."
"Thinking about it, the name 'Jiang'an Hall'... sounds like something out of a gangster comic."
Lin Yu closed the Tycoon's profile.
Then, he opened the second file.
This one was titled...
"Li Nian."
Just seeing the filename, Lin Yu already had an idea.
And sure enough, upon opening it...Googlᴇ search ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
A familiar face greeted him.
A youthful high school girl, radiating innocence and liveliness, with a cute bob cut and straight bangs, shallow dimples visible at the corners of her smiling mouth.
The kind of girl who ranked above average academically, got along with everyone, and served as many boys' first crush.
However, looking at those lively, nocturnal-animal-like eyes, Lin Yu clicked his tongue softly.
"Little brat's acting skills aren't bad—I almost didn't recognize her from this photo's vibe."
This girl was none other than the renowned Thief A'Nian from the Death Game!
Lin Yu continued reading her profile.
"Currently a second-year student at Jiangcheng Shengle Private High School."
Next, he saw Li Nian's family background.
Both parents were university professors—the kind whose names frequently appeared in textbooks.
Her father also served as an R&D consultant for an international corporation.
Financially, Li Nian's family wasn't as wealthy as the Tycoon's.
But still comfortably "well-off."
At least this confirmed that Li Nian's "thieving" and Thief class were likely genuine quirks.
Lin Yu rubbed his chin, feeling this little Thief's character was becoming more defined.
In that case, her troublemaking in the Death Game, including joining the unconventional Free Alliance...
Was it because her real life was too oppressive?
Based on Lin Yu's observation, families with "professor" parents—top-tier intellectuals—tended to be either extremely open or extremely restrictive...
Li Nian was probably the latter.
"Maybe this can be exploited too."
Lin Yu mentally noted his analysis and evaluation of Li Nian.
Next time he encountered this girl, he'd try to "verify" it somehow.
Ideally by intimidating her.
After this thought, Lin Yu set his phone aside.
Of course, these were matters for later.
Right now, the most pressing concern was the Promotion!
And...
Tomorrow's 8 AM class.
Thinking of tomorrow's schedule made Lin Yu's molars ache.
"Hard to say which is more troublesome—early classes or the Death Game..."
With this lament, he closed his eyes and drifted into sleep.
......
Meanwhile, elsewhere underground in Jiangcheng.
A petite girl in white pajamas sat hugging her knees on a black ergonomic chair.
The spacious room was heavily air-conditioned.
The water-cooled PC hummed loudly, while LED lights and over a dozen monitors cast cold illumination, giving the space a sharp, futuristic feel.
Pale blue and green lights reflected off the girl's face, outlining her predominantly cute features.
Multiple windows opened and arranged themselves—some containing messages, others code, and some even images and videos.
Her eyeballs moved at speeds far exceeding human physiological limits, scanning the rapidly scrolling information as she bit her thumb.
"Good... all organizations and individuals survived this week safely."
"No new movements from the Psychological Society, and 'Robin' has left Jiangcheng."
"The Night Watchmen remain unchanged too."
"Unfortunately, last week the General failed to capture the Diviner, and now he's completely vanished again this week..."
"Seems the 'Rankings' don't need updating."
The girl lightly tapped her keyboard, closing dozens of windows.
Finally, only one chat window remained on the central screen.
Her gaze settled on this window, no longer darting about rapidly.
"But my dear Ace... I never expected you'd become the biggest 'variable' recently."

chapters.title: Chapter 74: New Dungeon! The Cafeteria Freezer!
chapters.content:
In the following days, although Lin Yu had obtained some "information," he didn't rashly take any new actions.
Before completing the Promotion trial, Lin Yu wouldn't actively involve himself with those organization-related matters.
After all, schoolwork kept him quite busy.
Two courses had midterm assignments due, one of which was a "group project."
The performance class professor suddenly assigned them to study Shakespearean plays, claiming it was related to the final exam—this would require considerable effort from Lin Yu too.
After repeatedly asking Shen Bingmiao for investigations recently, the club president naturally began making demands of Lin Yu—the club promotional video recording that Lin Yu had always refused now became something he had to agree to.
"Welcome all juniors to join the 'Jiangcheng University Drama Club.' I'm Lin Yu, waiting for you in the drama club!"
Amidst these real-life obligations, time passed quickly...
Seven days flashed by in an instant.
Tuesday arrived again.Right after noon at twelve o'clock, the notification popped up as usual.
『Less than 24 hours remain before the latest possible start time for the next game!』
『Before midnight tonight, place yourself in a sub-zero temperature environment to await game entry.』
Reading this prompt, Lin Yu stroked his chin.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Sub-zero?"
This condition would be hard to fulfill. Lin Yu's first thought was to clean out his home refrigerator and climb inside.
But...
Previously locking himself in the bathroom was one thing.
The apartment Lin Yu currently lived in was small, with a tiny kitchen, so the refrigerator stood in the dining area!
If he messed with the fridge in the middle of the night, Lin Zhao would definitely drag him out and give him an earful.
So Lin Yu pondered.
