Seeming to realize Lin Yu didn't want to reveal his "god's mark" in front of Furbollo, he spoke vaguely.
"And that thing on you can ensure you find it."
"However... I don't know how you'll destroy it after finding it! But I believe you can figure it out—with both of your intellect, you'll definitely find a way!"
Vale Valetti said honestly.
"Are you kidding me?" Furbollo couldn't help but curse. "I don't know what riddles you're exchanging with May or why you're so sure he can find some soul..."
"But we don't know how to destroy souls either!"
Vale Valetti explained: "In the dream, its soul has physical form... and it can only take the shape of 'frightening monster forms'—specifically, the fears of those souls in the dream, like giant snow monsters seven or eight meters tall!"
"You make it sound easy," Furbollo said irritably. "That's not something we can handle either!"
"You're not just two people—there should be nine of you remaining!"
"In the dream, if you two gather them, you can definitely figure out a solution!"
Vale Valetti urged anxiously.
Lin Yu, who had been silently pondering how to kill the snow monster, suddenly spoke up: "You mean all remaining survivors will enter the same dream together!"
"Exactly. The monster will want to gather you all to eliminate you at once... after all, it doesn't need many more souls now!"
Before Furbollo could respond, a loud noise erupted from below.
"Voom—!"
Vale Valetti looked at a spherical machine activating below and paled, shouting urgently.
"No... the device has started!"
"Remember, you must 'eliminate all fear from your hearts.' No matter how terrifying the apparitions, if fear takes hold, it's over!"
As he finished speaking, the spherical device below emitted a blinding light.
Furbollo collapsed to the ground with a thud.
But...
Vale Valetti stared in shock at Lin Yu.
Lin Yu stood calmly, unaffected.
"You... how can you resist the Dream Manufacturing Device?!"
"Because this is essentially a 'rule'—when this device activates, everyone must enter the dream it creates."
"And I happen to have the ability to interfere with rules—fortunately, the one who granted me that ability hasn't disappeared yet."
Lin Yu said gratefully.
He was truly thankful he'd studied the 'Rule Type' class advancement guide thoroughly.
In the game, various "non-player-activated item effects" and "specific monster/NPC abilities" could also be considered types of 'rules.'
They could be nullified by 'Ruffian' or modified by 'Official.'
Otherwise, in simpler 'Survival' or 'Slaughter' type dungeons, these 'Rule Type' classes would be pathetically weak!
Lin Yu had just used his 'Official' ability to modify the Dream Manufacturing Device's activation range, excluding himself.
Of course, Lin Yu was even more grateful he'd prepared a backup—having two Rule Type classes ready.
Because...
His 'Ruffian' ability had already disappeared!
Vale Valetti's shock turned to despair: "But if you don't enter the dream, your companions will all die!"
"This monster called 'Chate' will truly come to life!"
He collapsed to his knees weakly, looking at Lin Yu.
Lin Yu shook his head and spoke coldly: "I have absolute reasons not to appear in that dream—in fact, I absolutely cannot be with them in the same space!"
Otherwise, all of Lin Yu's contradictory lies would be exposed!
"As for those people's lives... sorry, Researcher Vale Valetti, they're not my companions. Their deaths mean nothing to me."
"As for the monster... all I care about is the 'truth.'"
"Killing it offers me no benefit!"
Lin Yu said indifferently.
From the beginning, his step-by-step unraveling of mysteries was solely to complete his Promotion mission.
And the second requirement only demanded he find the 'Fraudster' and uncover the 'deception.'
At no point did Lin Yu need to "expose" or "destroy" this 'deception.'
He did sympathize with the deceased, but...
Not enough to risk himself for it.
Hearing this, Vale Valetti was stunned for a long moment.
Finally, he gritted his teeth and said: "Fine, fine... in that case, let's make a deal!"
"I've noticed you've given everyone different 'identities' and don't want them knowing your true self—after all, you're favored by the God of Change, so your motives are clear."
"I can interfere with their communication in the dream, ensuring your lies won't be exposed!"
"Though I retain self-awareness, I'm also part of this 'monster'... Earlier, I could enter your dream to give hints. I can enter this dream too!"
Vale Valetti said.
Lin Yu looked at him, intrigued.
"That's tempting."
Indeed, even if he didn't appear in the dream, those people gathering still posed some risk of exposing his lies.
"But... not enough!"
"I can also give you my 'notebook'—it has indestructible properties," Vale Valetti added. "This is all I can offer!"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
Hearing this, Lin Yu exhaled.
"Then... deal."

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Lin Yu's Plan
chapters.content:
Lin Yu agreed to Vale Valetti's request, not because he was genuinely tempted by the promised "notebook" as a reward.
In truth, he had only been testing the waters with his earlier question.
Since he could get extra rewards for free... why not take them?
From the very beginning, Lin Yu had never truly intended to leave this monster alone.
Admittedly, Lin Yu didn't care about the lives of other players in this game, but...
He understood clearly that if he wanted to survive, it would be best to work with Vale Valetti to eliminate this monster!
After all, this was only the "fifth day."
Although Lin Yu could temporarily avoid the Dream Manufacturing Device's forced sleep using his Official abilities...
The difference between the Official and Ruffian abilities lay in the time limit for rule modifications.
Depending on the extent of the rule changes, the Official's abilities would last anywhere from one to three hours.After three hours, when the Dream Manufacturing Device reactivated, he would still fall unconscious!
Moreover, Lin Yu wasn't confident he could stay completely alert for 48 hours straight in this freezing weather.
So...
If he wanted to survive and complete his Promotion mission, this monster absolutely could not be allowed to awaken!
"I'll help you kill it... Though it's not technically alive yet, so 'destroy' might be more accurate," Lin Yu said seriously, looking at Vale Valetti.
Vale Valetti frowned in confusion. "But how? You haven't even entered the dream!"
"Simple—destroy it physically," Lin Yu said quietly. "Besides, even if we destroy the 'consciousness' formed by those souls, the Fear Oil itself will remain. Sooner or later, more souls will be devoured by it."
Vale Valetti shook his head. "Impossible. I've already told you... and you've seen for yourself. The Fear Oil has spread throughout the entire underground research base. Its scale is enormous—far beyond what one or two people can physically destroy!"
"Even if the 'Company' intervened, they probably couldn't do it."
Lin Yu shook his head. "No, it's possible... Though the amount of Fear Oil is vast, it's still technically a 'fuel,' isn't it?"
As soon as Lin Yu said this, Vale Valetti froze for a moment before realizing what Lin Yu intended.
"You... you're insane!"
"Even if it were possible, doing this would destroy the entire Extreme Winter Mountain!"
"The whole mountain would collapse... and it might even trigger an avalanche!" Vale Valetti shouted.
Lin Yu spread his hands. "So what? You said it yourself—if this thing awakens, the danger would be unimaginable. Researcher Vale Valetti, at this point, you should abandon conventional thinking... After all, there are only nine living people left in this mountain!"
Vale Valetti's resolve wavered slightly. "But... your companions would die... and you might too..."
Lin Yu stepped forward, staring at the soul bound by the Fear Oil—the remnants of a dead man's consciousness—and spoke sharply.
"You tried to stop it before, but you failed... I don't know what you did back then, but I think I can guess why you failed."
"Mercy and weakness... Researcher, you really are different from most people in the 'Truth Corporation,' just as my companion Furbollo said. You're kind," Lin Yu said coldly. "But that kindness also gives you a 'flaw'... You're too soft."
"Faced with a monster that has already killed hundreds and could grow even more terrifying, you still think you can destroy it without any sacrifices?"
"In this situation, soft-hearted kindness is no different from evil!"
"Or perhaps... you're not just weak."
"Are you simply unwilling to let go of this lingering consciousness that coexists with it?"
Lin Yu stared intently at Vale Valetti, his tone almost accusatory.
"Which is it—weakness or cowardice, Vale Valetti?"
Vale Valetti was left speechless.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
He clenched his fists and said, "...I'm not!"
Finally, after an intense internal struggle, Vale Valetti relented. "Fine... But even if Fear Oil is flammable... you've already realized something from the torch made of it, haven't you?"
"Though it burns efficiently, its properties are unusually stable—it won't burn too quickly."
"Now that this monster has gained self-awareness, it could isolate itself to survive... It might even use the snowstorm outside to extinguish the flames."
Once again, Vale Valetti tried to dissuade Lin Yu.
This time, however, his argument wasn't that Lin Yu shouldn't do it—but that his plan wouldn't work.
In other words, if Lin Yu found a viable "solution"... Vale Valetti would agree.
Hearing this, Lin Yu relaxed slightly.
Not just because Vale Valetti had finally accepted his plan.
But also because...
From Vale Valetti's reaction just now, Lin Yu could finally confirm that this NPC was trustworthy.
He truly was an outlier in the "Truth Corporation"—a good man who genuinely wanted to prevent the monster's birth.
Yes...
Until this moment, Lin Yu had still been testing Vale Valetti.
It couldn't be helped—his first two dungeons had been full of traps.
Lin Yu had no choice but to be suspicious of everything.
As for how to ignite the entire sea of Fear Oil without allowing the monster to save itself...
Lin Yu already had an idea.
"So, Vale Valetti... are you afraid of death?"
He looked at the curly-haired young man before him.
The young man froze for a moment before smiling bitterly. "Actually... I was terrified. But that was back then."
"Now that I'm already 'dead,' I don't feel the desperate need to cling to this remnant of consciousness, like you suggested earlier."
"To be honest, I don't feel any attachment to this state—if anything, I'd prefer to be freed from it sooner."
Vale Valetti spoke earnestly.
"That makes things easier, Researcher," Lin Yu grinned. "As long as you're willing to cooperate, the next steps will be much smoother."
"Anyway, since you said Fear Oil is too stable and burns too slowly..."
"Then all we have to do is make it unstable, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Confirmation and Preparations
chapters.content:
On the underground platform, Vale Valetti looked puzzled after hearing Lin Yu's explanation.
"How could this be? The nature of Fear Oil is quite stable, and it's very difficult to transform it into an unstable state."
As Vale Valetti spoke, Lin Yu shook his head.
"I have a solution for that. Right now, I need to confirm two crucial points with you..."
"First, the Fear Oil that transformed into this guy lying on the ground existed in reality, not in some dream scenario I wasn't aware of, correct?" Lin Yu asked cautiously.
Vale Valetti nodded: "Correct. Fear Oil itself can simulate various things in reality... That's precisely why the company values it so highly."
"In other words, this monster can actually create fear in reality too?"
"Yes," Vale Valetti nodded. "Though normally, it's more 'convenient' to manufacture fear within dreams, since dreams... don't need to follow the physical laws of reality."
"Not only does this produce more intense fear, but it also consumes far less resources - whereas transforming real physical Fear Oil in reality is much more laborious!"
Lin Yu looked at Vale Valetti and gave a slight nod."I understand. Now for the second important question... Researcher, since you can currently be considered part of that monster, to what extent can you influence its judgment? And how much can you affect its actions?"
Lin Yu asked seriously.
Though he didn't understand why Vale Valetti's soul hadn't been devoured or assimilated, maintaining independent consciousness...
This guy, while preserving his "self," must still be able to significantly influence the Fear Oil.
Vale Valetti looked at Lin Yu in surprise.
"How did you know? I hadn't had the chance to tell you this yet."
"I never suffered any attacks from this monster in the dreams - that must have been your doing... And the 'past scenes' you showed me were essentially using the same methods this monster employs to 'manufacture fear,' weren't they?"
Lin Yu continued while taking out the map: "Not only that, these 'strongholds' were probably created to lure people to Extreme Winter Mountain and make them feel safe enough to sleep..."
"But the fact they're arranged to spell 'cheat' on the map must be because you secretly influenced the details, right?"
"Leaving clues, yet doing so in such an awkward and obscure way, combined with your behavior in the 'dreams' I mentioned... I suspect you can influence some of the monster's operations, but not too much."
"Also, your promise just now - you could even guarantee that people in the dream wouldn't be able to speak to each other."
As Lin Yu spoke, Vale Valetti sighed and nodded: "I wasn't wrong about you. You truly are capable of ending all this."
"My interference with its cognition and behavior is limited to simple obfuscation."
"To put it visually, it's like these 'strongholds' - I made slight coordinate adjustments to their originally random placements, eventually forming them into meaningful connectable patterns."
"In the dreams, I've constantly been interfering, trying to make it ignore your presence as much as possible."
Vale Valetti then looked at Lin Yu: "So, what do you need me to do?"
Lin Yu replied: "Simple. In about... forty hours, I need you to make it notice my existence, notice that I'm unaffected by the 'Dream Manufacturing Device,' notice that you harbor hopes I can end it."
Vale Valetti froze: "Are you sure?"
"Of course," Lin Yu nodded firmly. "And when the time comes, I'll need your help with one more thing... though you'll understand what that is when the time comes."
Vale Valetti hesitated slightly at Lin Yu's words.
But ultimately, he nodded.
"Alright, I believe you."
"Though... why forty hours?"
Lin Yu didn't answer the question.
"Since we're on the subject, can you keep these guys trapped in dreams without waking up?"
He pointed at Furbollo lying on the ground, referring to the other players.
Vale Valetti didn't press further, simply nodding in agreement to Lin Yu's new request.
Lin Yu exhaled and slowly sat down on the ground.
"Next... I just need to make sure I don't fall asleep."
"Or at least, don't let me encounter them in dreams."
Closing his eyes lightly, Lin Yu began to rest.
"I've done all I can. Now it's just... doing my best and leaving the rest to fate."
Soon, Lin Yu felt drowsiness washing over him.
It seemed Vale Valetti had chosen the latter option.
When he opened his eyes again, Lin Yu felt much more refreshed.
Furbollo was still snoring on the ground, with Vale Valetti standing nearby.
"As an imprisoned soul, you no longer feel fatigue, do you?"
"Indeed not," Vale Valetti responded.
Glancing at the Black Oil below, he said quietly: "To be honest, your companions actually caused it some trouble..."
"But correspondingly, three of them died."
Lin Yu checked - the lost abilities were 『Otaku』, 『Enforcer』 and 『Thief』.
"No big deal," Lin Yu shook his head.
As long as the 『Soldier』 and 『Doctor』 abilities remained, that would suffice...
Right now, he just needed survival capabilities.
Then Lin Yu looked at Vale Valetti: "The 'Dream Manufacturing Device' still has no effect on me. Among the three who died, none had abilities that would affect my immunity to it."
As Lin Yu spoke, Vale Valetti nodded.
"I can somewhat guess the first step of your plan, but what comes after... I still can't see through it."
Vale Valetti's body emitted waves of "belief."
Lin Yu's earlier words had 『materialized』 - using 『Official』 to obtain rule exemptions that should have been invalid, they became effective again.
"Thank goodness this NPC is smart enough..."
Probably Vale Valetti, who had been observing everything, had guessed that Lin Yu could gain special abilities by claiming different false identities.
But he didn't understand the underlying mechanism.
So all Lin Yu needed was to make vague statements, and someone as sharp as Vale Valetti would naturally comprehend and "believe" his words.
Having resolved the "Dream Manufacturing Device" issue once more, Lin Yu waved his hand.
"Alright, Vale Valetti..."
"Let's begin. Let this monster witness my existence."
As Lin Yu finished speaking...
Vale Valetti suddenly sensed it -
The aura emanating from the youth before him had abruptly undergone some fundamental transformation!

chapters.title: Chapter 103: The Silent Deception
chapters.content:
Inside the underground base, Vale Valetti began influencing the monster's judgment through their intricate connection, just as agreed.
"As you wish... the plan begins now."
With these words, Vale Valetti's figure dissolved into black oil once more, seeping through the platform's cracks and merging with the dark ocean below.
The moment Vale Valetti disappeared, the entire black oil sea began stirring. The previously calm surface started undulating violently—
As if...
It had begun boiling!
Lin Yu stood quietly on the platform, observing everything.
He felt invisible eyes scrutinizing him from all directions, as if the entire Extreme Winter Mountain was gazing back at this tiny human within its depths.
This sensation was enough to make anyone's blood run cold.
Lin Yu was no exception—he felt creeping dread rising from the depths of his heart.Though not quite "fear" yet, it was far from pleasant.
"Tch, losing the Corporate Drone ability is genuinely regrettable."
"But... it's not a major problem."
Lin Yu climbed onto the platform's railing as he spoke.
The cavern ceiling housed numerous metal "maintenance passages."
With powerful legs, Lin Yu leaped onto the nearest metal walkway.
Grabbing the edge, he effortlessly flipped himself up.
Now standing even higher, Lin Yu declared loudly:
"Come on, monster... come on, Chate!"
His resolute gaze fixed downward, directly confronting the amorphous entity's scrutiny.
The monster seemed to sense Lin Yu's challenge and transformed again.
The black oil churned violently below, truly boiling now!
Soon...
It morphed and condensed, forming one terrifying apparition after another on its surface—
Ferocious snow monsters, grotesque zombies, pale spectral ghosts...
Yet Lin Yu simply watched these horrifyingly realistic manifestations with cold detachment, showing not a trace of fear.
"These don't scare me..."
Knowing they were illusions, no monster could frighten Lin Yu at this point.
Having aspired to be a great actor since childhood, Lin Yu had consumed countless horror films and thrillers.
Simple visual shocks could never instill fear in him.
As expected, realizing Lin Yu remained unfazed, the terrifying images quickly dissipated.
Just as Vale Valetti had said—just as Lin Yu had predicted—
"This monster can only kill in reality by exploiting 'fear'!"
Without fear, these manifestations couldn't harm him.
"Most people probably wouldn't realize this..." Lin Yu murmured.
After all, this monster's "nature" resembled the Fraudster's!
One required "belief," the other "fear"—that was the only difference.
From his elevated position, Lin Yu looked down contemptuously:
"Pathetic tricks like these won't work on me."
"Save your cheap theatrics!"
"If this is all you've got... today will be your end!"
His taunts made the monster increasingly agitated.
So close to attaining true life, yet...
Its consciousness now mimicked living beings perfectly.
Thus, it had developed primitive "emotions"—
And emotions led to poor judgment.
"Come, come, come—show me what you're really made of!"
Lin Yu's intense stare remained locked on the seething oil below.
Soon...
All the black oil coalesced into a new form—
A towering humanoid figure several stories tall, dripping with viscous black oil.
It roared at Lin Yu menacingly.
Suddenly, overwhelming terror flooded Lin Yu's heart.
All his earlier arrogance vanished, replaced by primal dread.
Painful childhood memories surfaced—
That collapsing mine shaft, the flammable gas-filled environment, the oil pipeline explosion caused by rusted screws...
His oil-drenched father growling "Run!"
Then...
Young Lin Yu reaching the shaft's exit, only to watch his father engulfed by flames...
This was his deepest fear—that monstrous oil-soaked figure disappearing into inferno...
"Run..." the monster snarled.
"Ah Hu... run!"
Yet just as the increasingly realistic (and distorted) giant form solidified—
Lin Yu's fear abruptly vanished.
He exhaled,
"Oh right, my name isn't Ah Hu... and my father wasn't a miner."
His tone was eerily calm, as if reminding himself.
This wasn't the Corporate Drone's ability—that was long gone.
Lin Yu had snapped out of it.
Everything until now had been Lin Yu's grand deception—
An actor's masterpiece so convincing it fooled even himself.
Why forty hours?
To fully immerse in his fabricated role.
For forty hours, Lin Yu had lived as "Ah Hu"—
A young man whose miner father died in a shaft accident he'd witnessed.
Chate could partially read human fears.
This was precisely what Lin Yu exploited.
Surveying the fully-formed oil monster, smelling faint gas in the air, watching the boiling black sea below—
Lin Yu smiled.
"My 'fear' plus your 'belief'... double confirmation creates near-perfect replication!"
He called down to the oil:
"Vale Valetti, this is what I needed you to do—understand now?"
"Make it maintain this form!"
Producing the Black Oil Torch—
"Whoosh!"
Pale flames ignited.
"Now, Vale Valetti—my friend, let it burn as you desired!"
Lin Yu hurled the torch at the colossal monster.
From within the oil-covered giant, a human hand emerged—
Catching the torch.
"Thank you... friend!"
Vale Valetti's voice echoed underground as he dragged the flame into the monster's core.
"Hiss—"
Pale fire erupted from within, igniting the oil-saturated entity, spreading rapidly until—
"BOOM!"
A massive explosion rocked Extreme Winter Mountain's foundations!

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Clearing the Dungeon! Bountiful Settlement Rewards!
chapters.content:
"Finally, it's over. Truly worthy of being someone recognized by the God of Change."
Gazing at the Fear Oil burning fiercely across the ruins, Vale Valetti felt genuine relief.
The entire "monster" had been set aflame, having transformed into a highly flammable creature that caused the entire cave to overheat the moment it ignited, making the fire unstoppable.
All the Fear Oil was burning - Vale Valetti included.
Finally...
The Fear Oil erupted in a violent explosion that collapsed the entire Extreme Winter Mountain.
Most of the Fear Oil had been consumed by flames, with the remaining portions insufficient to reform the "monster."
Most importantly, the entire base and all equipment had been destroyed in the explosion, eliminating the Fear Oil's means of "self-replication."
The remaining remnants would eventually disappear completely.
Now, even Vale Valetti's own soul was being gradually consumed by the pale flames.By using the "Ancient Notes" left by his mentor to preserve his independent consciousness and soul integrity, Vale hadn't mindlessly become part of the monster's collective consciousness, thus largely retaining his ability to perceive.
Now, feeling the flames scorching his soul...
"Still quite painful..."
Vale Valetti sighed.
But at least it was over.
Since joining "Truth Corporation," this could be considered a rare good outcome.
Though perhaps it wasn't exactly good either.
Having his research stolen, being ordered by superiors to ignore the dangers of immature technology, getting "exiled" to field operations...
And finally meeting his end in this frozen wasteland, perishing together with a nameless monster.
Vale Valetti smiled self-deprecatingly.
"My teacher was right - I'm truly a hopeless fool."
"Even that god-favored individual could see my weakness and cowardice."
"But... I was quite brave just now, wasn't I?"
Sitting amidst the snowstorm, Vale Valetti pondered and asked himself aloud.
But no one answered him - the world around was now completely pale.
"Just as well. Though I don't know what methods they used, escaping was the right choice."
Besides, he no longer needed anyone's approval.
The person he'd been moments ago was undoubtedly brave and cool.
......
[Congratulations on clearing the game "Frostpeak Mountains"!]
[Calculating your rewards for this game session!]
[You have received the basic reward: 7 days of Survival Time.]
Opening his eyes to the familiar [Settlement Space], Lin Yu exhaled in relief.
"I actually survived!"
As an excellent actor, Lin Yu could fully immerse himself in a "role" in about ten hours.
So why stay for forty...?
Partly because more time meant more safety.
But mainly because Lin Yu had calculated that forty hours would be just about when they'd exit the dungeon.
As researcher "Vale Valetti" had said,
Surviving the monster's physical destruction was nearly impossible.
So Lin Yu had timed it perfectly -
Ensuring he'd leave the dungeon right as the true explosion occurred!
And now...
He'd succeeded!
In the [Settlement Space], besides Lin Yu, five other figures had survived.
The dream world must have been truly perilous - three more had died in that final stretch.
Everyone stood frozen in shock, not speaking to each other.
Even the usually optimistic Furbollo sat there covered in dust.
But this was exactly what Lin Yu wanted to see.
He turned his attention to the game's settlement - with his performance, he was certain to receive extra rewards.
[Based on your performance, you have earned the evaluation "Master of Control," granting one additional reward.]
[Additional Reward: Randomly obtain one "non-exclusive item."]
[Based on your performance, you have earned the evaluation "Threading the Needle," granting one additional reward.]
[Additional Reward: Randomly obtain one "non-exclusive item."]
[For completing an NPC's hidden task and achieving hidden clearance conditions, you receive one additional reward.]
[Additional Reward: Obtain one NPC "item reward."]
Seeing three extra rewards pop up, Lin Yu was pleasantly surprised.
"Ha, not bad at all!"
He'd gotten [Master of Control] in his first dungeon too - this time Lin Yu had again become the player who absolutely dominated the situation.
As for [Threading the Needle]... Furbollo had mentioned it, so getting it made sense.
But the third one genuinely surprised him.
"Though guides mentioned hidden tasks that grant extra rewards, I never expected this was one!"
This was truly an unexpected windfall.
Helping Vale Valetti had clearly been the right choice.
"Virtue has its rewards!"
Lin Yu mused.
Especially for him...
All these rewards could be doubled again!
After deceiving the "God of Change" last time, even though the deity had seen through his lies...
Perhaps to encourage such behavior, Lin Yu's "privilege" of double rewards had been retained!
And this "doubling" mechanism... Naturally worked better with larger bases!
This single dungeon would net him three extra rewards!
No wonder he felt so satisfied.
"I wonder what items I'll get!"
Thinking this, Lin Yu began claiming his rewards!Thɪs novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
[Congratulations! You have obtained the non-exclusive item reward: Fear Torch.]
Seeing the first reward, Lin Yu recognized an old friend.
The Black Oil Torch that had accompanied him throughout the dungeon had now returned to his inventory under its [True Name].
"Excellent!"
Lin Yu said happily.
This item provided constant warmth and illumination - extremely handy tools.
Also good for starting fires.
Its metal construction and moderate length made it effective for hitting people at range too.
It perfectly compensated for Lin Yu's lack of melee combat options and sustained damage capabilities.
After all, the [Guaranteed-Hit Revolver] only had one bullet.
Next, Lin Yu examined the second item reward.
[Congratulations! You have obtained the non-exclusive item reward: Chate's Supplies.]
Lin Yu saw it was a small wooden box containing a packet of biscuits and a bottle of water.
But surprisingly...
This wasn't a consumable item.
[Chate's Supplies: Generates biscuits and water meeting an adult's minimum daily requirements. Requires "Fear" as material.]

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Choosing Class Items, Activating the Tongue of Deceit!
chapters.content:
After receiving the two items from [Master of Control], Lin Yu next obtained the rewards for [Threading the Needle].
[Congratulations! You have obtained a non-exclusive item reward: Fear Lens]
[Fear Lens: When used, allows you to see the deepest fear in a person's heart. Can be used once per scenario/return.]
[Congratulations! You have obtained a non-exclusive item reward: Active Map]
[Active Map: Generates a 500-meter radius terrain map centered on your current location upon use. Cooldown: 72 hours.]
Looking at these two items, Lin Yu was quite satisfied.
"Both are excellent items!"
These items would be very useful to him.
And next...
The rewards for completing the [Hidden Mission] also arrived.[Congratulations! You have obtained an NPC item reward: Ancient Notebook]
[Ancient Notebook: An indestructible notebook where recorded information remains permanently. It seems to have other undiscovered uses...]
[Congratulations! You have obtained an NPC item reward: Truth Corporation B3 Access Card]
[Truth Corporation B3 Access Card: In certain scenarios, this card grants you the identity and privileges of a B3-level researcher at Truth Corporation.]
Lin Yu skimmed through these two rewards.
They didn't seem entirely useless.
The former appeared to have untapped potential, while the latter would likely be valuable in specific scenarios.
After all, Furbollo had mentioned that "Truth" Corporation was quite famous, appearing in many scenarios.
After reviewing all the rewards
The settlement process concluded.
Lin Yu felt darkness engulf his vision once more.
However, this time, he didn't wake up back in reality.
Instead, he found himself in a new space.
Unlike the previous void, this white, boundless space resembled an endless room.
Blood-red text appeared before him:
[Promotion Trial 1: During this game, tell each participating player a different lie that absolutely contradicts the others, then use the [Fraudster] class ability to make them "come true." Ensure none are exposed or discovered until the game ends.]
[Evaluating... Task completed.]
[Promotion Trial 2: Find the hidden [Fraudster] in this game and expose their deception.]
[Evaluating... Task completed.]
[Congratulations! You have completed this [Promotion Trial].]
Lin Yu exhaled and nodded slightly.
"I did complete it after all."
Earlier in the [Settlement Space], when the blood text delayed mentioning the [Promotion Trial], he had felt somewhat uncertain.
Unexpectedly, the [Promotion Trial] settlement had its own dedicated space.
The blood text continued:
[Having completed one [Promotion Trial], you are now officially a [First-Tier] player.]
[Detected class: [Fraudster]. Please choose your [First-Tier] class item.]
Lin Yu's expression shifted slightly at this prompt.
He had to make a choice?
Two faint white lights flashed before him, revealing two floating items.
On the left was a pitch-black, squirming mask.
[Class Item: False Face: Can freely alter your facial features and adjust your physique within certain limits. Duration: 1 hour. Cooldown: 1 hour.]
On the right was an unstable mass of black, gelatinous substance.
[Class Item: Counterfeit: Can perfectly replicate the appearance of any item you've seen. Duration: 1 hour. Cooldown: 24 hours.]
Looking at these two [Class Items], Lin Yu instantly understood why [First-Tier] players held absolute advantages over those who hadn't completed the trial.
The benefits of these tailor-made [items] were...
Truly terrifying!
Whether [False Face] or [Counterfeit], combined with the [Fraudster]'s existing abilities, they could make Lin Yu several times more powerful!
Not only did they ensure a solid foundation, but they also raised the ceiling infinitely!
While he didn't know what other classes' exclusive items might be...
Lin Yu guessed they wouldn't be weak either.
Precisely because both items were so enticing, he found himself in a dilemma.
"How should I choose between these [First-Tier] class items?" Lin Yu muttered.
The utility of [False Face] was obvious. Based on his experience in this scenario—unless everyone started together and had to stick as a group—it would allow Lin Yu to create multiple fake identities and cycle through several [classes]!
[Counterfeit] was equally powerful—just copy any useful item and use it!
Faced with this choice, Lin Yu hesitated.
Neither was inferior to [Teeth of Prophecy] or [Tongue of Deceit], and neither had usage limits.
"I really don't want to give up either..."
But Lin Yu also knew life sometimes demanded sacrifices... or did it?
He decided to take both.
Staring at the blood text and the two items, Lin Yu exhaled and made his decision.
"Alright, this still counts as a form of 'sacrifice.'"
What he chose to "sacrifice" was...
One use of [Tongue of Deceit].
"To this day, I still possess the [Game Master] ability from my first game, and it remains active here, allowing me to obtain both class items!"
As this "lie" left his lips, Lin Yu felt a sharp pain in his tongue.
"Is this plausible enough to directly 'come true'?" he wondered nervously.
This was his first time using [Tongue of Deceit], and he wasn't sure about the "upper limit" of what it could achieve.
He was certain statements like "I'll never participate in the [Death Game] again" or "I am a god" wouldn't work.
But whether this claim about obtaining both [Class Items] would succeed remained uncertain!
If it failed, Lin Yu would have to painfully choose between [False Face] and [Counterfeit].
However...
Fortunately, that didn't happen.
A surge of "belief" manifested out of nowhere, and his near-fantastical words [came true].
The glow around [False Face] and [Counterfeit] faded as they entered Lin Yu's item storage!
[Congratulations! You have obtained the class item: False Face!]
[Congratulations! You have obtained the class item: Counterfeit!]
Lin Yu let out a long breath.
"Good. This use of [Tongue of Deceit] wasn't wasted!"

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Return to Reality! A Crazy Plan!
chapters.content:
After obtaining two untradeable, permanently bound [Class Items]...
The [Promotion Trial] settlement was complete!
Lin Yu opened his eyes, feeling his limbs frozen numb with piercing cold, his entire body trembling uncontrollably.
He pushed open the freezer door with force, stumbling out unsteadily.
Lin Yu reached the table and used his shaking hands to cancel the scheduled text message.
"Phew... finally, [Promoted]!"
Now back in reality, the joy and relief of completing the [Promotion Trial] and becoming a true [First-Tier] player finally washed over Lin Yu.
He'd even obtained two [Class Items]!
"Now I at least have some ability to protect myself," Lin Yu mused inwardly.
He sat in the cafeteria for quite some time until his body gradually warmed up.After carefully restoring everything to its original state, Lin Yu left the cafeteria directly.
The joy and relief only lasted briefly before settling back into calm.
Though now a [First-Tier] player with six additional items obtained at once, and despite having only experienced three dungeons, by all appearances Lin Yu could be considered a fairly capable "veteran player."
Yet Lin Yu understood clearly that he still only qualified as having "self-preservation capability."
Both the [Tycoon]'s vague implications and the post-[Promotion Trial] settlement text indicated one thing...
Current Lin Yu was a [First-Tier] player.
Where there's [First-Tier], there's Second-Tier, Third-Tier...
And even more powerful individuals beyond.
Compared to those established major organizations and ranked experts, Lin Yu still didn't measure up.
And unfortunately...
The very forces Lin Yu sought strength to defend against were two exceptionally powerful organizations.
[Free Alliance], [Psychological Society]...
That dangerous girl who killed him was definitely no ordinary member of the [Psychological Society].
Lin Yu had sharp judgment - while her initial acting wasn't masterful, that apex predator-like dangerous aura when her true nature emerged...
Even now, the memory made his heart race.
To make her his "revenge target," Lin Yu needed to grow stronger!
Moreover, the pressure wasn't just from the reality side.
Within the [Death Game] dungeon worlds, the [God of Change], [Truth Corporation]...
Though Lin Yu had gotten through the [Frostpeak Mountains] dungeon relatively unscathed,
Over half the participants had died there!
The [Death Game]... was simply that cruel!
"I must continue growing stronger..."
"Though with [False Face] and [Counterfeit], I can attempt some more aggressive 'experiments.'"
Lin Yu arrived at the school's perimeter wall.
With a running start, he easily vaulted over it.
But instead of heading home, Lin Yu moved in the opposite direction.
After all, he'd already told his sister he wouldn't be returning tonight.
He had no intention of wasting this rare "free" evening.
Under cover of darkness, Lin Yu retrieved the pitch-black [False Face] from his item space and placed it over his face.
With each step, his physique and appearance transformed in this unmonitored blind spot.
His originally tall frame became somewhat gaunt, his skin darkening several shades.
That handsome, clear-featured face turned ordinary - sparse eyebrows, narrow upturned eyes giving off a somewhat shifty vibe.
Lin Yu then removed his thick outer clothing, stuffing it into his bag, leaving only thin black undershirt and pants.
He soon arrived at the [Tycoon]'s restaurant.
Lin Yu gently knocked on the door.
"Who's there at this hour?"
The [Tycoon]'s sleepy voice sounded as a second-floor window opened.
Spotting the unfamiliar dark, thin figure below, his confusion grew.
"Who are you?" he asked warily, right hand already moving behind his back in clear preparation for defense.
Lin Yu, prepared, smiled with hands clasped.
"Apologies, [Tycoon]... You may call me [Old Yao], as you can see, a fellow player."
"Having just completed my seventh dungeon and about to enter [Promotion Trial]... I wish to join your [Jiang'an Hall]!"
Lin Yu said with an ingratiating grin.
Simultaneously, he marveled inwardly at how effective [False Face] was!
Even his vocal tone and range had changed significantly.
Though speech habits and accent weren't assisted... mimicking accents happened to be Lin Yu's specialty!
Hearing Lin Yu's purpose, the Tycoon remained guarded.
"Old Yao, is it?"
"Wanting to join our [Jiang'an Hall] is good - being able to attempt [Promotion] by your eighth dungeon marks you as talent... but we don't accept just anyone, understand!"
"If genuinely interested, we'll administer an evaluation!"
Lin Yu quickly adopted an excited expression, nodding vigorously below.Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"Of course, boss! I completely understand! Test away!"
"I believe both my character and capabilities will earn your approval," Lin Yu said earnestly.
The Tycoon nodded.
"Good, then return for now... Come back Thursday at 8pm when I'll arrange evaluation tasks!"
As he spoke, Lin Yu nodded repeatedly.
"No problem, boss! I'll definitely complete them!"
With that, Lin Yu gave an exaggerated salute before turning to leave.
After departing, Lin Yu exhaled deeply.
He truly had no intention of joining the Tycoon's [Jiang'an Hall] - or any "organization."
After all, the [Fraudster] class couldn't afford letting others know too much about them.
Lin Yu also detested that constrained feeling organizations brought.
But that was Lin Yu's thinking before obtaining [False Face].
Now, with the mask, his perspective had shifted.
He'd found a method to avoid both constraints and exposure:
Joining organizations under false identities.
And Lin Yu's "aggressive" and "crazy" plan wasn't limited to just joining Jiang'an Hall as "Old Yao."
After leaving the Tycoon's restaurant, Lin Yu rushed straight to Jiangcheng's night market.
Purchasing several outfits to stuff in his bag, he then hailed a cab.
"Driver, to the intersection of Yong'an Road and Park Road in southern Jiangcheng suburbs,"
Lin Yu said quietly.
He'd never been to southern Jiangcheng before.
This address...
Was near the residential location of "Master Thief" Li Nian from the materials Shen Bingmiao had provided last time.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: The Standards for Joining the Free Alliance
chapters.content:
Inside the villa, Li Nian sat in the second-floor study, playing with two newly acquired props.
Torn cling wrap lay on the floor—this was her "method" of entering the game.
Wrapping her head in cling wrap until suffocation.
The cling wrap remained scattered on the floor.
Li Nian wasn't afraid of being discovered, since tonight the enormous villa only housed the live-in housekeeper and herself.
"Tonight's dungeon was quite dangerous... but also quite boring."
"In the end, no one discovered my scheme—ah, truly talented individuals are rare indeed."
"The Psychological Society has been quiet this week too."
After growing tired of playing with the props, Li Nian stored away the two items she'd obtained and leaned back idly.
"If only something interesting would happen!"Just as Li Nian sighed this thought, she suddenly heard faint noises from downstairs.
"Click—"
Li Nian immediately perked up.
She recognized that sound all too well.
It was the careful sliding open of the patio door connecting the yard to the living room.
Since joining the Death Game, Li Nian had frequently sneaked out of her home late at night.
Most people might not notice such sounds, but Li Nian knew them intimately.
Moreover, while that door normally remained unlocked, scaling her family's walls without triggering the alarms required considerable skill.
More importantly, knowing his daughter often went out at night, her father had kept a Rottweiler in the yard to prevent Li Nian from feeling afraid.
Yet the dog hadn't barked at all!
"Finally someone tracked down my home address," Li Nian excitedly rubbed her hands together, pulling out her utility knife from her pocket before putting on sunglasses, "I wonder what caliber of opponent has come."
She silently approached the study window, soundlessly standing on tiptoe on the windowsill before flipping directly out the open window.
Li Nian landed lightly on the outdoor AC unit below the window, surveying the moonlit courtyard.
The yard stood empty—the imposing Rottweiler had vanished from its kennel.
Sliding slowly down the drainpipe, Li Nian confirmed the patio door had indeed been opened.
The evening breeze fluttered the sheer curtains as she cautiously peered inside.
A slender figure dressed in white sat on the living room sofa.
The typically ferocious Rottweiler now lay obediently on the floor, enjoying the figure's petting.
A stranger.
Though she couldn't see the face clearly, Li Nian knew she'd never met this person before.
Someone from Order? Or Jiangcheng's Game Master?
No, judging by the clothing style resembling a lab coat... possibly the Psychological Society!
As Li Nian pondered...
The figure in the living room suddenly spoke.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"Miss 'A Nian', please come out."
The voice sounded gentle and warm.
After brief consideration and sensing no hostility, Li Nian emerged from the yard gripping her utility knife.
Then she clearly saw the figure in the living room.
A delicate-looking woman wearing a lab coat, appearing no older than twenty.
Noticing Li Nian's approach,
She stood up, smiling at the younger girl.
"Hello, 'A Nian'. I didn't expect you to be so young."
Li Nian stared at her, arms crossed.
"So? Breaking into someone's home in the middle of the night... just who are you?"
"And what exactly do you plan to do?"
The woman maintained her gentle smile: "Right, I should introduce myself... you may call me 'Zhu Ming'. My profession is—"
"A veterinarian, correct?" Li Nian rudely interrupted.
"You're quite perceptive. Yes, I'm a veterinarian," unfazed by the interruption, the woman continued warmly, even complimenting Li Nian, "I knew I came to the right place!"
As she spoke, Li Nian narrowed her eyes.
"So what?"
"To be direct, I wish to join the Free Alliance."
The woman calling herself Zhu Ming said softly.
Hearing this intention, Li Nian blinked in surprise.
"Oh? You want to join the Free Alliance?"
"Yes, I want to join the Free Alliance."
Facing Li Nian's questioning, "Zhu Ming" nodded firmly.
"Why?"
Li Nian's attitude shifted slightly as she curiously examined the woman.
"Because I need an organization's protection... my next dungeon will be my seventh, when I'll undergo the Promotion Trial," the woman named Zhu Ming explained, "Moreover, I've recently offended certain organizations."
"Reaching Promotion by your seventh dungeon... if you're not lying, your potential qualifies."
"These organizations you offended... let me guess, the Marauders or Psychological Society?"
Li Nian said with growing interest.
"You're indeed clever," the delicate woman whispered, "That's precisely why I sought out the Free Alliance."
"How amusing. If you seek protection... why not join Order instead?"
Li Nian took a step forward.
Almost instantly, her figure seemed to flicker as she appeared before the woman.
The cold utility knife blade pressed precisely against the carotid artery.
"We Free Alliance members aren't exactly benevolent folk either."
Yet faced with this sudden mortal threat, the woman showed no fear.
"Because I dislike Order... I've researched all organizations and determined one thing—only the Free Alliance suits my temperament."
Her voice remained calm as she pinched Li Nian's blade between fingers, moving it from her neck.
"Besides, managing to offend both the Marauders and Psychological Society... do I look like someone who accomplished that through excessive righteousness?"
Her quiet question met Li Nian's scrutinizing gaze.
After a long moment, Li Nian burst out laughing.
"Ahaha, what an interesting character!"
"However... as you know, our Free Alliance has extremely strict admission standards—that's why we remain the smallest organization!"
"You may admire us, but... how can you be certain you meet the requirements?"
Facing Li Nian's teasing question, "Zhu Ming" smiled brilliantly back at her.
"I believe that by appearing in your living room and declaring my wish to join... I've already passed the preliminary evaluation."
"Wouldn't you agree, Miss 'A Nian'?"
Hearing Zhu Ming's answer, A Nian shrugged helplessly.
"Well, though this question has no standard answer..."
"You've passed, Zhu Ming."
"I'll inform the others about this!"

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Lin Yu’s Plan and the Fanatical Detective
chapters.content:
After leaving Li Nian’s villa and walking quite a distance, Lin Yu finally reverted from the frail "Zhu Ming" back to his normal appearance.
Just as he had anticipated, judging by the consistent style of the Free Alliance and Li Nian’s attitude…
If someone could find a member of this organization in reality and express a desire to join,
then the Free Alliance would not refuse!
However, there would still be an assessment.
Lin Yu did not yet know what the assessment entailed.
All he had was a note with Li Nian’s contact information—originally, Li Nian wanted to add him on a messaging app.
But Lin Yu declined, claiming he did not have a phone.
The reason was reasonable.
“I’m currently being watched by the Psychological Society. If I carry a phone and get caught, I’m afraid some of my personal information will be exposed.”So Li Nian wrote down her phone number on a slip of paper and handed it to Lin Yu.
“Call me when you get home, or add me… in any case, just let me be able to contact you.”
Therefore…
After leaving Li Nian’s house, Lin Yu began to formulate his next plan.
His current plan was to join as many known organizations as possible.
Including the Free Alliance, the Marauders, and the Psychological Society!
The existence of the False Face class item gave Lin Yu the possibility of maintaining multiple false identities in reality.
However, from what he could see now…
“Besides the False Face, I’ll need several phones and secure phone numbers.”
“Also… it would be best to register multiple forum accounts.”
The former was somewhat troublesome, as anonymous phone cards were no longer easy to obtain, but there were ways.
After all, money could move mountains.
The latter, however, was very troublesome.
According to posts on the forum…
The operators behind the forum seemed to have some incredibly magical method to ensure that each person could only have one account.
Moreover, once someone joined an organization that had been purged, the forum operators would also ensure they could never access the forum again.
No one knew exactly how this “forum” organization accomplished this, but so far…
No one had ever doubted it.
Lin Yu still remembered the highly uniform evaluations.
“If it weren’t for the fact that all the veteran players knew this was established by ‘players,’ I’d even suspect this was the official Death Game forum!”
“I seriously suspect a god manages this forum!”
Therefore, Lin Yu did not hold much hope of obtaining multiple forum accounts.
However…
Lin Yu was not entirely without ideas.
“The first step with the Free Alliance is done. I’ll have to wait until tomorrow night to see what arrangements the Tycoon at Jiang’an Hall has…”
“The next organization to try is the Marauders.”
Lin Yu had already chosen his target in his mind.
And to join the Marauders… the joining criteria were even public.
Although Marauder members could not access the forum, forum members all knew the simplest joining condition of this organization.
That was…
To kill a player in reality.
Then, find a Marauder member and have them recommend you for joining.
This was why the Marauders’ organization name alone sent chills down people's spines.
In reality, players did not have mortal grudges against each other!
Those who could actually kill other players in reality were likely ruthless villains motivated solely by profit!
This condition was indeed not difficult for Lin Yu, who was First-Tier.
And the fact that other players dreaded being hunted by the Order could be mitigated by Lin Yu fabricating false identities.
In theory, the Marauders were even the organization most suited to Lin Yu.
But…
Lin Yu did not want to join the Marauders in such a simple way.
He had a nearly crazy plan in his mind—Lin Yu often came up with such wild plans.
“If the Jiang’an Hall mission isn’t too difficult, maybe…”
“I can take a trip to Henan Province.”
Lin Yu murmured.
…
Henan Province, Zheng City.
A young man who looked like an ethnic minority or a mixed-race person was crouched in the corner of an internet cafe in front of a computer, wearing a baseball cap low over his head.
He was holding a bowl of sauerkraut beef noodles with two sausages and had a large bottle of nutritional drink beside him, focusing intently on the screen.
The yawning internet cafe manager walked over and asked, “Old Fu, pulling an all-nighter again today? Got big work?”
The young man called “Old Fu” was actually named Fu Luo. He shook his head when he heard the manager’s voice.
Fu Luo took a pack of Yunyan cigarettes from his pocket, opened it, and took out a mint-flavored cigarette candy which he put in his mouth.
“No big work, just investigating someone.”
At this moment, seven or eight open webpage windows were on the computer screen.
The manager was curious: “Investigating someone? An affair or a deadbeat?”
He knew that Fu Luo was a famous private detective in Henan Province.
Although the extremely low criminal rate in China meant most private detectives only caught affairs or deadbeats…
there was no doubt Fu Luo was the top in this barren industry.
He still maintained a 100% case-solving rate.
And these cases, for the Chinese people who loved gossip and excitement, were precious topics for after-meal conversations.
Therefore, the manager naturally liked chatting and asking Fu Luo questions.
But Fu Luo’s answer disappointed him once again.
“Sorry, I’m just looking for someone… someone I met in the game.”
Fu Luo said, and the manager’s interest instantly waned.
“Ah, I see… then I’m off to sleep.”Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
“Get your own water from the fridge, and call me if anything happens.”
The manager said as he walked toward the bar.
Fu Luo nodded coldly, then returned his gaze to the screen.
On the screen were graduation photos of nearly three recent graduating classes from all high schools in Jiangcheng, along with the compiled admission lists.
Fu Luo had already filtered out all students admitted to medical universities or medical programs in comprehensive universities and found their corresponding classes…
But unfortunately,
None matched.
“Damn it, May, you really lied to me!”
“I trusted you so much… but you’re not a medical student at all!”
Fu Luo, also known as Furbollo, painfully scratched his head.
“Damn it, damn it—I just wanted to find a reliable and smart teammate, is that so hard?”
“The one with the forum ID ‘May’… judging by the posting records, their profession is actually ‘Assassin.’”
“And they’re even a member of the Order. That’s ridiculous.”
After complaining for a bit, Fu Luo’s expression hardened.
“No, I’m going to find out your true identity today!”
He took off the baseball cap from his head and replaced it with a straw hat.
“May, I really want to see what your real identity is all about!”

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Crossing the Line and Warning
chapters.content:
After putting on the straw hat, Fu Luo's work efficiency increased several times over. He tirelessly gathered information, recalled Lin Yu's characteristics, and conducted exhaustive searches. Starting with Jiangcheng's recent three graduating classes from key high schools and elite programs—focusing on top scorers first—since Lin Yu appeared intelligent and his speech and demeanor suggested he wasn't from a rural school. Simultaneously, he investigated posts from high school confession pages three years prior, like "looking for someone" notices. Though he'd mostly only seen half of Lin Yu's face behind a mask, Fu Luo distinctly remembered one thing—that guy was handsome.
This needle-in-a-haystack approach had always been most effective. To Fu Luo, a detective's most vital assets were "knowledge reserves" and... "patience!" Real life wasn't a mystery novel with convoluted cases and flawless logic—genuine "puzzles" were exceedingly rare. For most cases, patience was key to uncovering the truth. Fu Luo loved puzzles and "investigation." Moreover... sometimes puzzles emerged during the "investigation" process. Like now.
"Jiangcheng Experimental High School, graduation photo from two years ago... one person was erased from this Class 7 photo. Their honor roll announcement was also photoshopped to remove someone." Fu Luo noticed details most would overlook. "Hah... is someone trying to hide a high schooler's past?" He felt he'd grasped something crucial. Though the erased person might not be the "May" he sought... with a "wiped" individual right before him, Fu Luo couldn't resist investigating. His detective intuition also whispered that this hidden person might be intricately linked to "May"—perhaps even the same person!
Fu Luo noted the class and searched online for more information. Soon, he found the homeroom teacher's number. After considering calling—then abandoning the idea given the late hour—he instead checked the class roster on the education website. As expected... the count matched the photos: sixty-four people. Meaning... one was still missing. Then Fu Luo spotted something: a "Model Student" commendation notice listing a Class 7 student with an unfamiliar name.
"Lin... Lin what? Why's this character so blurry?" The announcement was a low-resolution photo of a bulletin board—only the surname "Lin" was legible, the second character an indecipherable blob. Fortunately, the site had an attachment. As Fu Luo went to download it—
Suddenly, the internet café's computer fans whirred violently. "Vrrr—" The dim café, nearly empty save for a few night owls, had most machines dormant. Yet in an instant, every computer booted up, screens glowing crimson. Fu Luo's own display turned solid red.
Cries erupted throughout the café:
"Hey, why's my screen red?!"
"Red screens now? What the hell?!"
"Manager—!"The complaints abruptly silenced. Fu Luo bolted up, pulling a magnifying glass from his coat. "Ghosts must be messing with me—I took the bait!" That commendation notice wasn't carelessly overlooked... it was left as bait! Just who was this "May"? A seemingly ordinary student, yet digging deeper revealed layered traps!
"Could they be a Player?" He climbed onto a table, surveying the café now bathed in eerie red light. The gamers and staff had all collapsed, fast asleep. On the blood-red screens, cursors blinked before displaying identical text:
"Player 『Furbollo』, you've crossed the line!"
From the start, Fu Luo suspected another "Player" of the 『Death Game』 was behind this. Now his forum ID appeared—confirmation. Realizing another Player orchestrated this, Fu Luo paled as a terrifying possibility struck him. "Are you... the 『Hacker』?!" he whispered tremulously at the screen. He knew they could hear.
Indeed, new text materialized:
"Correct."
Followed by a simple, old-school emoticon:
":)"
Fu Luo didn't find it cute—his legs turned to jelly. "I-I didn't know he was yours! I just met him in-game and got curious—no ill intent! You know me, I'm just overly curious... I'm not even in any faction!" His rapid-fire plea carried a sob. Never since discovering his adoption papers in his parents' drawer had Fu Luo hated his curiosity more!
As he spoke, the red screens suddenly went dark. The unnatural silence lifted—all computers powered down normally, noise resuming.
"Damn it, manager! Fix this! My rig froze!"
"Coming!"
Amid the restored commotion, Fu Luo slumped into his chair, clutching his chest. "Did I... pass?" He stared at the blank desktop, back drenched in cold sweat. But as he reached for the candy cigarettes in his pocket to calm his nerves—they were gone.
Beside him, a petite hooded girl popped one into her mouth before tossing the pack onto the table. Grinning at his stunned expression, she said:
"No, you didn't pass, 『Furbollo』."
"First—stop investigating. Second... I'll be watching your performance in an 'upcoming matter.' Perform poorly, and you'll be 'expelled'... and you know I don't mean from the forum."
Without waiting for a response, she stepped forward—melding into the computer screen. Fu Luo sat frozen, his heart utterly dead.
"F***ing hell, what was that?!"
A hand shot from the screen.
*Slap!*
A crisp strike landed on his cheek.
"No swearing!" scolded the voice from the monitor.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Jiang'an Hall's Test
chapters.content:
The next night.
After catching up on sleep at home during the day and making some preparations, Lin Yu returned to Tycoon's abandoned restaurant.
Lin Yu's "disguise" had now reached a higher level.
He had purchased several new phones, bought some anonymous prepaid SIM cards, and acquired several virtual numbers.
After registering new social media accounts with these numbers...
Lin Yu made an attempt...
For some reason, while under the effects of [False Face], he could even register new forum accounts!
This discovery surprised Lin Yu.
"Could it be that the forum's verification system uses facial recognition through the camera?"
Though he didn't understand the mechanism, since it worked...Lin Yu considered it a good thing.
Armed with brand new social media accounts and forum IDs, Lin Yu arrived at the abandoned restaurant again.
This time, however, before he could go upstairs, someone called out to him.
"Hey!"
Lin Yu turned to see a classic silver minivan parked by the roadside - the kind famously produced by a domestic automaker.
This vehicle seemed rather unbefitting of Tycoon's status - whether as the second son of Qingsheng Group or as the leader of [Jiang'an Hall].
Yet there was no mistake - Tycoon's solemn face appeared behind the rolled-down rear window.
"Old Yao, right? You're punctual!"
Lin Yu put on an obsequious smile as he addressed Tycoon.
"Damn, boss! You came in person today!"
"What's the test mission? Though I've only cleared seven instances, I've got some skills!"
"Just tell me what to do - I'll go through fire and water without hesitation!"
Lin Yu thumped his chest confidently, then added:
"And boss, don't judge me by my [Thief] class - I've actually turned over a new leaf. It's just that [Death Game]'s evaluation criteria might be... a bit problematic."
Lin Yu perfectly played the role of an unreliable person trying too hard to appear reliable.
Tycoon scrutinized Lin Yu carefully, stroking his chin.
"Relax, Old Yao. As the saying goes, if you suspect someone, don't employ them; if you employ them, don't suspect them. Since you sought out our [Jiang'an Hall], it shows your trust in us..."
"And naturally, I trust you too!"
Tycoon declared solemnly, making Lin Yu appear even more moved.
"Great! Let's start the test - I guarantee I'll complete the mission!"
Tycoon cleared his throat: "Well, the test is really just a formality."
He then produced three silk pouches.
"Now, you'll open these three pouches from left to right in order, and follow the instructions inside."
"You might need to pay some... not-too-exorbitant costs..."
"But don't worry, it definitely won't exceed what you can handle!"
"After completion, return with whatever you obtain, and the mission will be considered accomplished!"
Tycoon explained seriously.
Lin Yu nodded and accepted the pouches.
"I guarantee mission completion!"
He then opened the first pouch.
"Go to 115 Jiuhuai Street, East Bridge District, Jiangcheng. Find the person wearing black uniform there. After finding them, open the second pouch."
Reading the contents, Lin Yu nodded slightly.
"Seems I need to make contact first?"
Without hesitation, he hailed a taxi to the address on the note.
The location wasn't far from Tycoon's restaurant - the taxi ride took only about 20 minutes.
Lin Yu paid the driver in cash, pocketing the change as he stepped out.
Seeing the bright signage beneath the number 115, Lin Yu couldn't help but comment:
"Why is this a McDonald's?"
As for the person in black uniform...
Looking inside, Lin Yu noticed the counter staff all wore black uniforms.
Could Tycoon's organization members be McDonald's employees?
Maintaining his guard, Lin Yu pushed the door open and entered, then opened the second pouch.
"Approach the black-uniformed personnel. After they initiate conversation, read the words on the back of this note."
Holding the note carefully, Lin Yu approached the cashier.
"Need to exchange passphrases too..."
Lin Yu muttered as the cashier greeted him first.
"Hello, may I take your order?"
The cashier smiled.
Lin Yu flipped the note and read aloud:
"'Hello, I'd like a Big Mac meal, upgrade the Coke to large no ice, to go'... Huh?"
Finishing the words, Lin Yu looked puzzled.
What kind of secret code was this?
The cashier maintained his smile: "Will that be all?"
Lin Yu opened the third pouch: "Make payment. Return with 'acquisition'."
Reading this, Lin Yu fell silent.
What exactly was going on here?
Still, he paid for the meal in cash.
In the end...
Lin Yu received a paper bag containing a Big Mac, fries, and a large Coke.
Was the challenge that Tycoon's people would ambush him on the return trip?
Lin Yu grew suspicious, but ultimately...
Nothing happened.
The taxi returned him uneventfully to the domestic-brand minivan, paper bag in hand and confusion on his face.
"What the hell?"
Lin Yu handed the bag to Tycoon, who - despite his seven-figure net worth and polished businessman demeanor - eagerly took out the burger and took a big bite.
"Delicious! I've been craving this for so long!"
Tycoon declared with satisfaction.
He then tore open a ketchup packet, squeezing half directly into his mouth before smearing the rest on his burger.
Between bites of burger, fries, and gulps of Coke, his mouth stuffed full, Tycoon gave Lin Yu an approving look.
"You've done well, Old Yao - you passed!"
"Welcome to [Jiang'an Hall]!"
Lin Yu looked dumbfounded: "That's it?"
Tycoon seemed surprised: "What else? Did you think it'd be more complicated? We're not like [Order] with their grand responsibilities, nor those sneaky groups like [Psychological Society] or [Free Alliance]!"
"Sure we have rules, but we can always kick you out if you break them later."Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Speaking between bites, Tycoon pulled out his phone.
"Come on, brother, scan this QR code - I'll add you to our [Jiang'an Hall] group."
Lin Yu nodded, taking out his new phone from his pocket and unlocking it.
Tycoon's sharp eyes noticed the phone's newness: "Hey, newest FruitPhone model? Where'd you get it?"
Lin Yu paused, then replied: "Boss, with that tone I thought you were about to advertise one of those phone recycling apps!"
Tycoon laughed heartily: "True enough! Now scan this."
Just as Lin Yu was about to open WeChat to scan, Tycoon interrupted.
"Wait, Old Yao, not that app."
"It's the 'forum' app."

chapters.title: Chapter 111: The First Organization to Join, Lin Yu's Considerations!
chapters.content:
In the taxi, Lin Yu fiddled with his newly purchased phone, eyeing the somewhat tacky descending tiger logo of the newly installed 'Jiang'an Hall' app, and sighed.
"Such a gangster aesthetic."
Beyond criticizing Tycoon's personal taste, Lin Yu was mostly reflecting.
Mainstream organizations were indeed easier to infiltrate.
According to Tycoon himself, as a senior partner of both 'Order' and 'forum', he had a specialized app personally developed by 'forum' for him.
The security was far better than regular chat apps!
No wonder Tycoon had been so casual about his "assessment" - with 'forum' and 'Order' backing him, whether someone was a troublemaker or had ulterior motives could be screened simply by checking if they could properly use the forum app.
The forum was like a vast net connecting all players.
And those excluded from this net... would undoubtedly find their actions severely hindered.
From this perspective, what seemed like mild punishments like account suspensions by these organizations were actually among the harshest penalties possible.Only now did Lin Yu belatedly realize two things.
First, the fact that he could use [False Face] and a new phone to deceive the forum and successfully register an account under 'Old Yao' was an enormous advantage granted by [False Face].
Judging by Tycoon's reaction, seeing him scan the code to join had completely put the man at ease.
Clearly, even someone like Tycoon - leader of a mid-sized organization, local power in Jiangcheng, ranked 27th among all players - never suspected anyone could "trick" the forum.
Including how everyone kept volunteering their forum IDs in consecutive instances, Lin Yu could confirm...
Ordinary players, or rather the vast majority, held near-absolute trust in the forum's reliability.
Second... Tycoon giving him his WeChat contact during their first meeting was genuinely unusual.
Even for 'Old Yao' joining the "organization", Tycoon used the specialized app to communicate.
Combined with the forum's ubiquity, Lin Yu suddenly realized...
Tycoon's attitude toward "Lin Yu" was absolutely not how he treated ordinary newcomers.
Considering everything that had happened between 'Free Alliance', 'Psychological Society' and himself, Lin Yu could roughly piece together the sequence:
"Probably some organization - the 'Psychological Society' - has some method to evaluate a person's 'potential', assessing how much talent someone has."
"Once they identify an exceptionally promising newcomer... these maniacs will stop at nothing to drag that person into the game - even sending someone to kill them."
"And I was likely judged by the 'Psychological Society' as having high potential... no, considering most experts undergo Promotion around their seventh instance while I achieved 『Promotion』 in just three, I must have exceptionally high potential for some reason."
"Moreover, the 'Psychological Society's' actions or these evaluation results aren't completely secret - after observing their assessments, the 'Free Alliance' chose to dispatch 'A Nian' (Li Nian) in Jiangcheng to contact me for concrete evaluation."
"And Tycoon probably recognized my potential through the business card I gave him or similar means."
Lin Yu exhaled.
He had mostly sorted out the situation.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
So ultimately, everything came back to...
The 'Psychological Society' and that mysterious girl who first killed him.
Moreover, whether it was the 'Free Alliance' or 'Jiang'an Hall', their motives were actually quite clear.
Only the 'Psychological Society'...
Lin Yu couldn't fathom.
This organization killed promising newcomers - who would ever want to join the group of their own murderer?
It might not be permanent death... but being dragged into this godforsaken game would piss anyone off!
Plus bringing in people with high potential was just manufacturing enemies for themselves!
And they even left business cards pointing toward 'Jiang'an Hall'...
The more Lin Yu learned about player groups, the more he felt...
This organization reeked of something sinister!
There was good reason they got booted from the forum along with the 'Marauders'.
"Regardless, I need to accelerate my progress..."
Lin Yu never hesitated to assume the worst about unknown enemies.
Who knew if those 'Psychological Society' people had some dark arts to refine high-potential players into pills for power boosts!
"I must grow stronger quickly."
Fortunately...
As a 『Fraudster』, his path to power was much more unorthodox than others'.
Opening the 'Jiang'an Hall' app, the interface resembled a messaging group chat, just with the same minimalist design as the forum app.
Everyone used their forum IDs when posting.
[Tycoon: Welcome our new member 『Old Yao』! Old Yao is a 『Thief』 about to undergo Promotion next instance, everyone show him some courtesy!]
[Battle Wolf: 『Thief』? Not bad! You should exchange notes with 『Phantom Hand』! @Phantom Hand]
[Phantom Hand: Haha, welcome newcomer. I'm also a 『Thief』.]
[Phantom Hand: There's a file with my 『Promotion』 insights, check it out!]
The group had 83 members.
As Tycoon mentioned earlier, 『Jiang'an Hall』 was a nearly hundred-strong organization.
After briefly posting "Hello everyone, please guide me. I'll go study Phantom Hand's insights now," Lin Yu resumed lurking.
No one paid much attention, casually chatting - surprisingly about topics barely related to 『Death Game』, mostly current social trends.
Like elections in neighboring countries, fluctuating liquor stock indices, recently deceased celebrities...
Apparently even 『Death Game』 group chats were mostly for idle chatter.
But Lin Yu found this reassuring - it showed 『Jiang'an Hall』 was indeed a relatively relaxed and harmonious organization.
He opened the group files, searching for the real "treasures".
The various "guides" only available to organization members.
Some related to Promotion, others more detailed than the forum's class guides, item explanations, and instance introductions.
There were also evaluations of other organizations.
Naturally, the first file Lin Yu opened...
Was the 『Thief Promotion Guide』 mentioned by the user called 『Phantom Hand』.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: New Memorization, New Mission
chapters.content:
The guide written by Phantom Hand was extremely detailed, spanning thousands of words, but Lin Yu finished reading it quickly.
He didn't actually need to complete the promotion as a Thief - he just needed to understand what a Thief's promotion generally looked like so he could fabricate a convincing story without revealing flaws.
Just as Lin Yu had guessed, the Thief's promotion mission involved stealing.
Moreover, unlike the Fraudster's Unique Class which had two promotion paths, the Thief only had one.
Typically, it required stealing a specific valuable "item" from a dungeon!
Phantom Hand had passed his Promotion Trial on the second attempt. His first trial had opened the ninth dungeon - a museum scenario where the objective was to steal any exhibit valued over 50 million and keep it until the dungeon ended without being retrieved.
It sounded simple enough, but after witnessing a security-uniformed monster punch a Soldier player to death, Phantom Hand abandoned most of his plans.
After scouting the museum, he discovered exhibits worth over 50 million were inherently dangerous - either a pharaoh's cursed sarcophagus or a vampire's mask that would summon something terrible when taken. So he decided to postpone and focus on clearing the dungeon normally.
His second Promotion Trial came ten dungeons later.
By then, Phantom Hand had grown more experienced. Fortunately, this dungeon wasn't a dangerous Puzzle type like the museum, but a Survival scenario - enduring seven days on a drifting abandoned ship while stealing a mermaid's pearl.After some effort befriending the ship's mermaids and ghost NPCs to gain their trust, Phantom Hand secretly stole the [Mermaid Pearl] and kept it until the dungeon ended.
With Phantom Hand's two experiences as reference, Lin Yu considered he could fabricate a plausible Thief promotion story now.
Of course, the most important part was...
The [Class Item] obtained after reaching First-Tier as a Thief.
According to Phantom Hand's guide, Thieves could choose between two [Class Items]: [Wonder Pouch] or [Swift Blade].
The [Wonder Pouch] granted additional skill uses - increasing the once-per-24-hours limit to three times.
The [Swift Blade] was more straightforward - allowing Thieves to inflict sharp weapon damage when using their class ability.
With perfect timing, it could even deliver a lethal strike to vital points.
[Wonder Pouch] typically manifested as storage items like backpacks or waist pouches, while [Swift Blade] appeared as thin, lightweight blades.
Both had excellent attributes - the pouch's interior space exceeded its appearance, and the blade's sharpness surpassed ordinary weapons.
Reading this Thief guide made Lin Yu's neck feel chilly.
So Li Nian was quite dangerous too - that utility knife she carried was likely a [Swift Blade]!
Fortunately, Phantom Hand had also chosen [Swift Blade] and thoroughly complained about its limitations in the guide.
Despite seeming powerful, the blade required manual operation by the Thief!
Accuracy depended entirely on the Thief's skill, creating huge performance gaps!
Against other players, disabling an arm already counted as a critical hit most times.
Sensing Phantom Hand's frustration between the lines, Lin Yu sighed.
"This guy... as a Thief, having some offensive capability should be enough. It's not like he expects to fight like a Soldier!"
Lin Yu then closed the guide.
Since the group files had few access restrictions, he naturally browsed other class guides too.
Even with view history, he could justify it as cross-referencing knowledge.
Of course, Lin Yu primarily focused on each class's two [Class Items]!
[False Face] was already in use...
Next, he needed to figure out how to utilize [Counterfeit] effectively.
[Counterfeit] could mimic any item's appearance but not functionality, requiring coordination with the Fraudster's abilities.
Combined with its long cooldown...
Lin Yu concluded mimicking Class Items would be more worthwhile than ordinary objects!
Then...
Just like memorizing class abilities before, Lin Yu committed to memory over ten Promotion Trial guides and subsequent item choices from Jiang'an Hall's internal files.
For example:
The Soldier's [Field Rations] and [Military Rank].
The Teacher's [Pointer] and [Chalk].
The Otaku's [Figure] and [Tissue].
The Craftsman's [Tools] and [Blueprints].
...
Lin Yu observed that all Common Classes only required completing one task for their Promotion Trial.
Their two Class Items also followed two directions:
One significantly enhanced existing class abilities...
The other compensated for the class's inherent weaknesses.
This provided Lin Yu more strategic options.
"For the next dungeon, it's better to disguise as a class that's already completed Promotion for greater advantage."
"Moreover, in reality... I can also operate as someone who's completed Promotion."
Lin Yu muttered to himself before closing Jiang'an Hall's app.
Of course, he had more important matters next.
Lin Yu pulled out a brand new phone from his pocket - a compact mid-range domestic model this time.
He dialed a memorized number and put it on speaker.
"Beep—"
The call connected after just one ring.
"Hello?"
After the cheerful female voice answered, Lin Yu remained silent.
Just as he expected, the "clever" person on the other end could follow his thoughts without verbal cues.
"Ahahaha, is this Zhu Ming?"
"I understand - I'll text you the details later."nᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Free Alliance's Entry Test, Journey to Henan Province
chapters.content:
Compared to Jiang'an Hall, Lin Yu could foresee that the Free Alliance's assessment would undoubtedly be much more stringent. Not only because the Free Alliance didn't have the same resources as the forum to fall back on, but also... This organization might be the most unique among all player groups.
Tycoon had previously mentioned that the Free Alliance had very few members—currently only nine confirmed individuals. Moreover, the organization was quite loose, seemingly without many rules—it even included members who appeared to be sworn enemies. This was completely different from more formal and conventional organizations like Jiang'an Hall.
After joining Jiang'an Hall, the pinned document in their app outlined some basic rules: members couldn't attack each other, had to assist one another in instances, and had to contribute at least once a month to the organization. In return, the benefits were substantial—free strategies, discounted items, and even the ability to request help from the organization's top players. These were standard rules most organizations followed.
Based on Lin Yu's observations and further verification through Jiang'an Hall's internal documents, he was certain of one thing: the Free Alliance had none of these rules. They seemed more like a gathering of exceptionally strong, highly talented, and eccentric individuals who came together for "fun."
Thus, the method of joining the Free Alliance... was practically a blank slate.
But now, looking at the text message on his phone, Lin Yu was getting a glimpse of the organization's truly insane side.
"Complete two out of three tasks to pass, huh?"
"First: Kill any player with a bounty exceeding 3,000 points on the forum or over 500,000 RMB on the Hunters' Association."
