"Second: Join the Order, the Marauders, or the Psychological Society, then publicly announce your withdrawal to join the Free Alliance."
"Third: Team up with at least two Free Alliance members in a game and earn their approval."The third task was manageable, but the other two were downright insane.
The first task's difficulty spoke for itself. A bounty over 3,000 points on the forum likely meant a player who had undergone Promotion. Such players were pillars of any organization—even in Jiang'an Hall, only about 40% of members had completed Promotion. Out of nearly a hundred members, fewer than forty had achieved it. Some veterans who had been in the Death Game for almost a year and attempted Promotion four or five times still fell short.
Though Lin Yu had completed his Promotion by his third instance, he knew full well... his case was exceptional! Players who had undergone Promotion were not to be trifled with.
The second task was equally insane. Just joining the Order, the Marauders, or the Psychological Society was difficult enough. Announcing your withdrawal afterward would mean making a powerful enemy for no reason! Though Lin Yu already had complicated ties with the latter two... he couldn't help but sigh.
"What a bunch of lunatics."
Was everyone in the Free Alliance wanted by these three organizations? Though he had only interacted with Li Nian... Lin Yu was starting to seriously suspect... the rest of the Free Alliance members were just as crazy!
"Looks like this test will take some time—best to finish it this week." Lin Yu pondered before turning off his phone. There was something more important to do now.
Heading to the bus station.
Lin Yu altered his appearance, though this time, he only made slight adjustments to his facial features rather than completely transforming into someone else. His build and posture remained largely unchanged, but these subtle tweaks made him look like a completely different person—more ordinary and slightly colder in demeanor.
After arranging excuses for both his school and his sister, Lin Yu arrived at the bus station. He didn't plan to buy a ticket directly. Both buses and trains required ID for purchase—something Lin Yu absolutely didn't want to leave traces of. So, before arriving at Jiangcheng's main bus station with his backpack, he naturally considered "unofficial" transportation methods.
He knew Jiangcheng's bus station all too well. After standing around for a bit with his backpack, a private driver approached him with a grin.
"Hey buddy, where to? I can leave right now!"
This was exactly what Lin Yu was waiting for. "Private ride, out of province. You up for it?"
The driver blinked. "Where to?"
"Zheng City, Henan Province. Drop me off at a bus station there."
The driver's eyes widened. He had expected a short trip to the airport or a nearby city, not a cross-province job. Tentatively, he quoted a price: "Zheng City's pretty far... how about 2,800?"
"Can you do 2,500?"
"Sure, sure!" The middle-aged driver nodded eagerly. "Leaving now?"
"Now. What kind of car do you have? Fast?"
The driver puffed out his chest proudly. "Don't worry, boss! Got a brand-new car last year, runs like a dream! Used to be a test driver for rally teams." He patted his chest. "I'll get you to Zheng City overnight—guaranteed in time for morning spicy soup!"
Lin Yu gave a slight nod. Jiangcheng's central location meant no city was too far, and with an experienced driver, the timing was feasible.
"Alright, let's go." He said decisively.
Though 2,500 wasn't a small sum, for Lin Yu... this was a necessary expense. Besides, this trip to Zheng City might just pay for itself. He never hesitated—this had always been his nature since childhood, acting with decisive swiftness.
However, hearing Lin Yu's agreement, the driver suddenly grew hesitant. "Uh, kid, mind if I call home first? This trip'll take a whole day round trip—don't want the wife and kids worrying!"ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Contacting the Detective
chapters.content:
At 5:30 in the morning, Henan Province Bus Station.
Lin Yu handed a stack of 25 cash bills to an unlicensed taxi driver with a pale complexion, speaking weakly.
"Count it. There's a bank nearby where you can verify it."
As Lin Yu spoke, the middle-aged unlicensed taxi driver nodded.
"Got it, brother!"
Without refusing, he cheerfully walked to the ATM and deposited all 25 red bills.
Naturally, there were no issues.
The driver, now assured of his payment, waved excitedly.
"Thanks, young man! Whatever brings you to Henan, I wish you all the best!"
He bid Lin Yu farewell with genuine sincerity before flooring the accelerator and speeding away.Lin Yu watched the taillights disappear, waving with mixed emotions.
He had initially thought the driver was exaggerating when he claimed to have been a test driver for rally racing teams—turns out that might have been an understatement.
The speed was truly impressive. Had the driver said he'd competed professionally, Lin Yu would have believed him.
Though the ride was rather bumpy.
The Nissan sedan had practically been smoking on the highway.
Lin Yu had hoped to catch some sleep during the ride but ended up being jostled awake every second.
He yawned.
"But this works out better—at least I'll have more time now."
With that thought, Lin Yu found a breakfast spot near the train station.
After polishing off an authentic bowl of spicy soup with fried dough twists, he wiped his mouth and wandered around the station area.
Just like Jiangcheng Bus Station, Zheng City Bus Station in Henan had no shortage of unlicensed taxi drivers.
However, these drivers had more local flair—their vehicles weren't limited to sedans.
Motorcycle taxis and three-wheeled rickshaws were equally common.
As Lin Yu strolled along the roadside after breakfast, an early-rising unlicensed driver approached.
"Where to, young man?"
This time, Lin Yu decided to leverage another characteristic of these drivers.
"I'm looking for someone. There's this famous private detective in Zheng City—exceptionally good at catching cheaters, and unusually handsome... Where can I find him?"
Switching to a Henan accent, Lin Yu asked warmly.
The question left several drivers scratching their heads.
"Detective?"
"Don't know 'im!"
Coupled with Lin Yu's local accent, which signaled he wasn't an out-of-towner, many drivers lost interest and walked away.
Undeterred, Lin Yu continued searching for clues about Furbollo.
Finding someone through such needle-in-a-haystack methods wasn't easy, but...
Just as Lin Yu expected, while Furbollo wasn't a celebrity, he wasn't entirely unknown either!
Soon, a helpful tattooed man carrying a leather bag stepped off a bus and overheard Lin Yu's conversation with the drivers.
"Hey there, local buddy. This 'detective' you're asking about—does he like wearing all sorts of fancy hats and look kinda foreign?"
Hearing this, Lin Yu turned around, his face lighting up.
"Yes! You know him?"
The man chuckled. "We've crossed paths. He's got skills—not just catching cheaters but also helping debt collectors track down deadbeats. And his rates are fair."
Lin Yu was surprised. "Were you his client? Hired him before?"
"Nah, I was the deadbeat he tracked down."
The tattooed man answered honestly.
Lin Yu was momentarily speechless.
The man laughed heartily. "But it's all good now. Later, he helped me find the mole in my company... I'm back on my feet now."
"So what do you need him for? You're too young to be married, and don't seem like someone chasing debts... Why look for him?"
Lin Yu hesitated briefly before putting on a sincere expression. "To be honest, I need his help finding someone."
"No money involved, but there's some history between us."
Hearing this, the man grew serious.
"In that case, he's your guy—though it's been two years since I last sought his help. No idea if he's still around."
"He doesn't have a fixed office, but try the old eastern district of Zheng City, especially near primary schools. Might find his flyers on telephone poles."
"Look for the ones that say nonsense like 'World's Greatest Detective'—that's him."
"Oh, and if his phone's not working, check cheap internet cafes or snack bars."
"He might be holed up in some corner."
With that, the tattooed man waved goodbye.
"That's about all I know... Take care, brother!"
Lin Yu nodded.
"Got it, brother. Thanks a bunch. See you around."
Following the man's directions, Lin Yu hailed a cab to Zheng City's eastern old district.
After getting off near Zhengcheng Third Primary School, he stepped onto the worn-out streets with their wobbly pavement tiles, scanning the walls and poles for old flyers.
Most advertised locksmiths, miracle cures, or fake certificates, with occasional religious pamphlets.
But nothing about private detectives.
Just as Lin Yu wondered if Furbollo had moved away, he spotted an A4 printout on a bus stop sign.
"Henan's Most Badass Detective! King of Zheng City! Puzzle-Solving Emperor! Your Trusted Choice!"
"Call 0371-XXXXX!"
The unhinged, pathologically arrogant tone made Lin Yu sigh.
After a moment's thought, he dialed the number using a secondhand phone he'd purchased.
The call connected instantly, but the voice on the other end took him aback.
"Hello! Yufu Supermarket!"
The booming voice unmistakably belonged to a middle-aged woman.
Lin Yu spoke uncertainly. "Uh, hello... I'm looking for a private detective..."
"Oh! Oh! You want Xiao Luo—is it urgent?"
The woman asked.
"Somewhat, yes. It's a big case."
Hearing this, the woman's tone warmed instantly.
"Big case?"
"Alright, hold on—I'll call you back."
A loud *click* followed as the call ended abruptly.
Ten confusing minutes passed before Lin Yu's phone rang again—the same woman calling back.
"Hello, young man! You're looking for Xiao Luo, right?"
"I'm handing you over to him now—Fu Luo, pick up the phone!"
A groggy voice mumbled in the background: "Wha... who calls this early?"
"A client!"
"Tell 'em to... OW!"
"A BIG client!"
"Big clients can also... OW!"
"Alright, Ma, I got it! I'll take the call!"

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Meeting the Detective! Lin Yu's Request!
chapters.content:
Zheng City, Speed Net Cafe.
Fu Luo sat in the waiting area wearing a ridiculous duck hat, studying the ordinary-looking young man before him who seemed vaguely familiar. Though the man's face was mostly hidden behind a mask, there was something recognizable about him. Upon closer inspection, he seemed to just have one of those common forgettable faces.
"So you're the client who came looking for me, correct?"
Lin Yu gave a slight nod.
"Indeed, esteemed Detective. I'd like to commission you to find someone."
"Finding people," Fu Luo mused, "my fees vary based on difficulty—I'll need to hear who you're looking for before quoting a price."
"A player of the Death Game."
Lin Yu stated calmly.
Hearing this, Fu Luo showed slight surprise.
"You're a player too?""Of course," Lin Yu sighed, voluntarily revealing his "identity." "Tell me, Furbollo, as someone who's survived a dungeon together, don't I qualify for some friends-and-family discount?"
As he spoke, Lin Yu subtly lowered his mask just enough. He had adjusted his facial features slightly so Fu Luo—Furbollo—wouldn't immediately recognize him as 'May.' But with this hint, Fu Luo quickly disregarded those minor alterations, matching this face to the one in his memory while unconsciously correcting his recollection. Exactly as Lin Yu intended.
"You're May?!"
Fu Luo exclaimed in astonished delight.
"Yes, we meet again, great Detective."
Lin Yu replied with a smile. He could feel himself accessing the Doctor's abilities again. All class skills remained functional in reality, though apparently "balanced"—their effects and cooldowns adjusted accordingly. The Doctor's abilities were among those weakened in reality, with skill cooldowns extended to three days.
Fu Luo looked Lin Yu up and down before speaking.
"Ah, you—why go through the trouble of meeting offline? You could've just contacted me through the forum!"
Lin Yu chuckled at Fu Luo's words. "I happened to be coming to Zheng City to find someone anyway. After arriving, I remembered you're local here too. Considering how... conspicuously you operate, I made some inquiries."
"Didn't expect to actually find you."New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Fu Luo nodded proudly. "Naturally—I've built quite the reputation in Zheng City..."
"Since it's you asking, and considering I owe you for getting through that last dungeon safely—not to mention that Threading the Needle achievement—I'll help you for free!"
Lin Yu shook his head. "You should still charge. The person I'm looking for is... more troublesome than you think."
"Heavenly Artisan of the Marauders."
Lin Yu said quietly. Fu Luo looked surprised.
"Heavenly Artisan?"
He blinked rapidly, searching his memory.
"Oh, right—that Craftsman who killed five people. First-Tier. Currently has an 8,000-point bounty from Order."
"One of the highest bounties on any First-Tier right now!"
Fu Luo sighed. "This guy... is genuinely dangerous."
Lin Yu met Fu Luo's gaze. "Exactly why I'm looking for him. So... you should definitely charge."
"Going after the bounty?"
Fu Luo asked perceptively.
"You could say that," Lin Yu considered before adding, "If you're willing to help directly, that'd be ideal—I can give you 10% of the points if we succeed."
He said seriously. The offer was quite reasonable—after all, Lin Yu had no intention of letting Fu Luo take point.
But Fu Luo hesitated.
"Well... you know I already have issues with the Psychological Society. If I cross the Marauders too..."
His voice trailed off uncertainly. Lin Yu smiled.
"Let me ask—without any malice—who poses a greater threat to you: me or the Marauders?"
Fu Luo didn't answer, seamlessly changing tack: "Crossing the Marauders would just be adding another debt—so I'm in!"
"But—I want 20%!"
He held up two fingers.
"Deal. Whatever I get, you get 20%."
Lin Yu agreed without hesitation.
"So, can you investigate Heavenly Artisan for me?"
Fu Luo nodded. "Of course."
"How quickly? Before the next dungeon starts?"
Lin Yu asked. Fu Luo grinned.
"Naturally. I work faster than you'd believe."
Pulling out his phone, Fu Luo tapped away. About five minutes later, he looked up. "Done! Let's go, May!"
"Where?"
Lin Yu stared blankly.
Fu Luo said matter-of-factly: "To find Heavenly Artisan, obviously. Weren't you going to take him down?"
Lin Yu looked even more confused. "You found him in five minutes?!"
Fu Luo smirked proudly. "Surprised? Your boy's just that good."
Seeing Fu Luo's expression, Lin Yu grew wary. "You're not actually with the Marauders, are you? Leading me into a trap?"
Fu Luo had been about to boast further, but noticing Lin Yu's guarded expression—remembering both the Doctor's tendencies from their last dungeon and certain past encounters—he coughed and explained properly.
"Ahem. Let's just say recent events have led me to investigate these guys myself."
"Anyone active in Henan with high bounties on the forum or Hunters' Association lists has caught my attention."
"Your Heavenly Artisan happened to be on my radar."
Lin Yu nodded slightly. "Running low on points yourself, investigating these things?"
At the casual question, Fu Luo seemed reluctant. He grimaced, rubbing one cheek as if recalling something unpleasant.
"Well... points are always useful!"
"Anyway let's move—Heavenly Artisan won't stay put forever!"
Lin Yu nodded. "Lead the way."
"Where exactly is he?"
Fu Luo checked his phone. "Guy used to be a low-level manager at a construction company. Quit after joining the Death Game."
"Right now he's holed up in Zheng City's most famous unfinished development zone southside—his company's failed project. That's where he spends most of his time."

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Heavenly Artisan's Past, Lin Yu's Plan
chapters.content:
Lin Yu wasn't sure why Fu Luo had agreed so readily to his plan of going after Heavenly Artisan.
Truth be told, this was quite a dangerous endeavor.
Based on Lin Yu's expectations of Fu Luo and his performance in the previous game instance, the guy seemed more like the cowardly type.
However, since he'd agreed, Lin Yu naturally wouldn't refuse.
After all...
What Lin Yu planned to do next desperately required a "companion."
On the way to the abandoned housing complex in the taxi, Lin Yu reviewed the information Fu Luo had compiled about Heavenly Artisan.
Heavenly Artisan's real name was Chen Zhitie, aged 35.
As Fu Luo had mentioned, he used to be a minor supervisor at a construction company, a top graduate from Henan University of Technology's civil engineering program.
Over two months ago, he officially joined the Death Game and completed his Promotion last month.On the very day Heavenly Artisan completed his Promotion instance, he returned to reality and killed three players in Zheng City, Henan Province.
After lying low for a week, right before entering the next instance... he went to neighboring Yang City and killed two more players.
Investigations showed the victims all had prior transactions or contact with him.
Later, after he announced joining the Marauders, Order and the game masters of both Henan cities issued warrants and launched hunts against him.
But so far, they'd achieved nothing.
Because Heavenly Artisan Chen Zhitie had no family or friends to speak of. After the incident, he immediately quit his job and vanished from Zheng City.
Some on the forum even speculated he might have fled to another province!
After all, while Order had many official personnel among its ranks, it wasn't actually the government!
No matter how powerful the organization was, it couldn't blockade transportation or investigate spending records.
For someone to hide from Order would be troublesome but not impossible.
Order wouldn't mobilize its entire force just for one Heavenly Artisan either.
Reading through the detailed dossier, Lin Yu grew curious.
"How did you pinpoint his location?"
Faced with Lin Yu's question, Fu Luo replied modestly in a low voice:
"Ah, he was pretty notorious a month ago. I happened to look into it while bored."
"Though Order and the forum didn't have the resources to dig deep... most information was already exposed, so I just asked my Order connections for what they knew."
"Cunning as he is, you know the saying—'Every contact leaves a trace'... he couldn't hide from me."
As Fu Luo spoke, Lin Yu nodded.
"I know—Edmond Locard, founder of modern forensics. That's the fundamental principle of forensic science, Locard's Exchange Principle."
"But," Lin Yu hesitated, "that only applies to crime scene investigation, right..."
Lin Yu eyed Fu Luo suspiciously.Google seaʀᴄh
Fu Luo grinned: "Right, so I went—to both murder scenes and his former workplace."
"While Order thinks Heavenly Artisan killed out of resentment over unfair deals... that's not actually the case."
"He killed five people just to cover up the two he really wanted dead—one was a supplier that worked with his construction company once, the other a construction worker."
"Coincidentally, both were Players too."
"Heavenly Artisan's quite calculating—he even deliberately interacted and traded with them at Zheng City's gathering in Henan."
Hearing this, Lin Yu was surprised.
"So his motive relates to real life?"
"Probably. When I kept investigating," Fu Luo stroked his chin, "I traced it to this abandoned complex we're heading to—Jiuxi Garden... a project his company, that supplier and construction team jointly worked on."
"I had a case back then and didn't follow up... this time returning, I looked into it yesterday out of boredom and made a discovery."
"Heavenly Artisan bought an apartment there himself."
Lin Yu suddenly had an epiphany.
"You said Heavenly Artisan has no family—what exactly did you mean?"
Fu Luo chuckled at Lin Yu's question.
"Sharp as ever, catching that immediately—his parents divorced when he was young, mother remarried, basically no contact for over a decade."
"His alcoholic father died early, leaving him with an old army comrade."
"That comrade died during his second year of high school—after that he apparently boarded at school."
"Remaining relatives... no contact either."
"Talented guy, got into a decent university, worked part-time through school—that's the gist."
Lin Yu exhaled softly.
"Now I fully understand his motive."
Perhaps barely qualifying as revenge... no, realistically speaking, less revenge than...
Venting rage.
For someone like Heavenly Artisan with no family, he could only rely on himself.
He yearned for a home of his own more than anyone.
That apartment likely embodied all his hopes and dreams.
His own company, a home he supervised, a place to call his own.
Without family, that apartment emotionally became his family.
And ultimately...
It became an abandoned ruin.
Meaning Heavenly Artisan's hope vanished.
While unclear what happened with the supplier and construction team—maybe related to the abandonment, maybe not...
Heavenly Artisan ultimately chose to kill them.
This was also why Fu Luo believed Heavenly Artisan would be there now.
"Chances are, Heavenly Artisan's living in that apartment he bought back then."
Fu Luo nodded at Lin Yu's words.
"Yes... high probability he's there."
"Probably alone too—but can you take him? He's a First-Tier Player who completed Promotion!"
"Even with your gun, anyone who killed five people won't be easy..."
Fu Luo looked at Lin Yu questioningly.
Lin Yu smiled.
"No problem, I'm First-Tier too—and a Doctor's combat ability at this tier isn't weak."
Fu Luo seemed surprised.
"You're First-Tier? And from your tone, you didn't choose [First Aid Kit] but went with [Syringe]?"
Lin Yu nodded.
"Right, I advanced down the 'Quack' path."
"But... for safety's sake, I need your help with something."
Fu Luo straightened up: "Name it."
"You mentioned Order connections earlier—when the fighting starts, call in reinforcements!"

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Quack and Pre-Battle Preparations
chapters.content:
After obtaining the [Class Item] and being promoted to [First-Tier], the name of one's profession doesn't change.
However, according to internal documents from [Jiang'an Hall], most [First-Tier] professions have different "nicknames" among players based on the functions of their Class Items.
For example, [Soldiers] with [Field Rations] are called "Special Forces," while those with [Military Rank] are called "Officers."
The same goes for [Doctors].
This profession offers two choices: [Medical Kit] and [Syringe].
The [Medical Kit] enhances healing abilities and effects, and can even be used on healthy players in advance—the "healing" effect remains on them, activating when injured or ill, functioning like a preventive measure.
[Doctors] who choose the [Medical Kit] are often called "Miracle Doctors."
The [Syringe], on the other hand, causes "medical accidents"—worsening injuries, poisoning, or illnesses of those already affected.
Thus, [Doctors] who choose the [Syringe] are referred to as "Quacks"!
However, after tricking Fu Luo into believing he was a [First-Tier] "Quack," Lin Yu realized his ability hadn't [Manifested].Because Fu Luo's belief alone wasn't enough to create something out of nothing!
But...
Lin Yu didn't need to create something out of nothing.
Once certain Fu Luo believed he was a "Quack," Lin Yu activated the [Counterfeit] ability!
A rust-stained syringe materialized in his hand.
Seeing this [Syringe], Fu Luo exclaimed,
"Is this your [Class Item]?"
"Of course!"
Lin Yu nodded slightly—and in the next instant...
He felt the hollow imitation [Syringe] in his hand transform into a genuine [Doctor]'s [Class Item]!
"As expected, the 'belief' required for a [Counterfeit] item to become a [Class Item] is minimal—just one person is enough!"
Lin Yu understood this perfectly.
If he had pulled out an ordinary syringe like when he deceived Chen Zhuo, the difference between a [Class Item] and a [non-exclusive item] would have been too stark, and Fu Luo's belief alone might not have sufficed for [Manifestation].
Moreover, veteran players can often distinguish between "real-world items" and "game items."
Fortunately, he now had [Counterfeit].
After this confirmation, Lin Yu was certain:
[Counterfeit] truly allowed him to disguise himself as other [First-Tier] professions!
The taxi slowly came to a stop, and Lin Yu and Fu Luo arrived at the unfinished residential complex called "Jiuxi Garden."
The half-built entrance gate, weathered by wind and sun, looked dilapidated, with garbage strewn everywhere.
Though it was broad daylight, the desolate and ruined scene sent an involuntary chill down one's spine.
Especially knowing a ruthless killer with at least five lives on his hands lived inside—Fu Luo even shrank his neck slightly.
"May, when are we calling for backup?"
He couldn't wait to summon [Order] right now.
But clearly, Lin Yu had no such intention.
"Wait a bit longer—at least until I start fighting him. Otherwise, we won't get the full bounty," Lin Yu said seriously.
The bounty points listed in the forum post were for solo kills or captures.
If it was just providing clues or assisting [Order] or the "Game Master," the reward would be discounted—only 20% to 70%.
"I'm already sharing part with you. If the forum and [Order] take another cut, I can't accept that."
Lin Yu shrugged.
"So, call for backup only after I start fighting."
"Even if I can't win, holding out until [Order] arrives shouldn't be impossible, right?"
"We're both [First-Tier], and my [Syringe] isn't exactly harmless!"
Hearing Lin Yu's insistence, Fu Luo could only nod.
"Alright, then I hope you can hold out!"
Despite his words, a faint trace of worry lingered between Fu Luo's brows.
Lin Yu looked at him and patted his shoulder. "Don't worry, no matter what happens to me, you'll be safe."
"After all, I won't make a [Detective] like you fight. Just wait downstairs when the time comes!"
Fu Luo looked at Lin Yu, touched.
"Bro, I can really just wait downstairs?"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"Of course!"
Lin Yu nodded earnestly.
As they spoke, the two reached the depths of the complex.
Following the address Fu Luo had uncovered, they soon found the building where Heavenly Artisan had bought his apartment.
From a distance, the building looked as desolate and ruined as the rest of the complex.
But both Lin Yu and Fu Luo were extremely sharp.
Without even checking the apartment number, they could tell someone was definitely living there!
As Fu Luo had mentioned earlier—the "Locard's Exchange Principle": a living person leaves traces no matter how careful they are.
The dried water stains on the ground, the noticeably cleaner stairwell entrance compared to other abandoned buildings...
And, among all the windows, the only one covered with newspaper—on the fifth floor, east unit.
Lin Yu patted Fu Luo's shoulder.
"Wait here. I'll go meet that guy."
"Remember, only call [Order] after you hear my 'gunshot'—if I don't fire, don't call for backup."
"Based on your estimate, how long would [Order] take to arrive? And how many people?"
Fu Luo thought for a moment. "Zheng City's 'Game Master' is a [Postman], so he could arrive in as little as fifteen minutes."
"As for the rest of [Order], they'd probably take half an hour at most."
"Considering Heavenly Artisan is quite high-profile, they might send three or four people, including the 'Game Master.'"
"But... once [Order] moves, if Heavenly Artisan calls for help, the [Marauders] might rush in too. If other organizations join the fray, it could turn into a massive brawl."
Lin Yu nodded.
He had expected this—[Marauders], as an organization capable of confronting [Order] head-on, wouldn't just stand by if one of their members was cornered.
If they lacked that much resolve, why would anyone risk being blacklisted by the forum and becoming public enemies to join [Marauders]?
Especially for someone as notorious and high-potential as Heavenly Artisan—[Marauders] would definitely put in some effort to protect him.
"Zheng City's Game Master, the [Marauders]..."
Lin Yu exhaled slowly.
The coming operation was dangerous.
And the danger didn't just come from "Heavenly Artisan"!
Lin Yu knew that after his [Promotion], he and Heavenly Artisan were on the same level.
But... the people Fu Luo mentioned were still far stronger than him.
They might not be as formidable as Tycoon, but his interactions with Tycoon had never involved seeing him fight, let alone fighting him.
At this thought, Lin Yu felt nervous—but also...
A faint excitement!
"What would it be like to see those top-tier players in action?"
"How intriguing!"
Muttering to himself, Lin Yu stepped into the darkness of the unfinished building.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Taking Action!
chapters.content:
Heavenly Artisan Chen Zhitie stood behind the living room door, a claw hammer resting on his knee.
This was currently his only weapon—and also his [Professional Tool].
However, although it was a [Professional Tool], this claw hammer wasn't particularly handy as a "weapon."
The two optional tools for the [Craftsman] profession were [Tools] and [Blueprints].
Choosing [Blueprints] would grant one blueprint at the start of each instance, allowing the crafting of a powerful [Temporary Item] using materials from that instance. Moreover, this item would persist until the next instance began, even after returning to the real world.
Thus, Craftsmen who chose [Blueprints] had highly variable performance, being particularly weak at the start of each instance before crafting their [Temporary Item].
Heavenly Artisan disliked this instability, so he chose [Tools] as his [Professional Tool] and advancement path.
[Blueprints] represented creation.
While [Tools] represented destruction.
The effect of [Professional Tool·Tools] was simple and brutal—it granted a tool that enhanced destructive power against inorganic objects, environments, and mechanical structures.Besides preferring this simple, reliable ability, Heavenly Artisan chose [Tools] for another reason—he already possessed a hammer as his "primary weapon."
[Non-Exclusive Item·Bone Crusher: Enhances destructive power against living beings, revealing their "weak points for striking." Hitting these weak points deals massive damage.]
With these two hammers combined, Heavenly Artisan's combat prowess was naturally formidable!
However, two instances ago, his most frequently used item, the [Bone Crusher]... was stolen.
After returning to reality, Heavenly Artisan realized his missing item and belatedly understood that in that game, he wasn't the only expert hiding their identity.
"Damn it, ran into that damn brat from the [Free Alliance]..."
There were many [Thieves], but only one [Master Thief].
Only the [Free Alliance]'s [A Nian] could steal someone's [Item] and still not return it after the instance ended!
Especially since the other party looked like some cheeky little girl—this further confirmed Heavenly Artisan's suspicions weren't wrong.
Although he'd asked the big shots within the [Marauders] to negotiate for him, dealing with the [Free Alliance] was troublesome—it wouldn't be resolved in just a week or two.
Even if he got it back...
The [Marauders] operated on quid pro quo.
He'd probably have to do quite a few favors for those big shots in return.
And as if encountering the Master Thief wasn't headache enough, who would've thought...
"Troubles never come singly."
Sitting in the dark living room, Heavenly Artisan stared at the slightly blurry "surveillance footage" on his phone, his expression grim.
He'd set up Bluetooth surveillance cameras at every entrance of Jiuxi Garden. Though the resolution wasn't great, they covered all major entry points.
Heavenly Artisan had noticed someone entering the complex early on.
And just from glancing at the footage, his instincts told him...
Those two were dangerous.
Especially when they headed straight for his building with clear purpose, Heavenly Artisan became certain...
They were definitely players coming for him!
Though there were only two, he didn't dare be careless or underestimate them.
After all, Heavenly Artisan knew he was famous.
In the [Death Game] player circles, a simple search would reveal his glorious exploits and approximate skill level.
Yet they still only sent two people...
What did that mean?
It meant they were confident—that even two people could take him down.
Especially when after reaching his building...
One even stayed downstairs, leaving only one to come up!
This made Heavenly Artisan even more wary—after losing the [Bone Crusher], he knew his combat power had significantly diminished.
So he chose to ambush them.
"Tap, tap, tap, tap..."
Faint footsteps echoed from the staircase, growing steadily closer as Heavenly Artisan listened intently.
Then, upon reaching this floor...
The footsteps suddenly vanished.
Had they stopped outside his door?
Did they realize he was hiding behind it?
His thoughts were chaotic, but a thrill of excitement coursed through him.
Adrenaline surged, quickening his heartbeat, while his palms grew slightly sweaty gripping the [Tool] hammer.
Though he knew his opponent might be formidable, Heavenly Artisan wasn't afraid.
After all...
How could someone who'd killed five players consecutively and escaped unscathed from [Order] be some nobody?
He had an 8,000-point bounty on his head!
Even without his best weapon, he didn't consider himself mediocre.
"If you want my bounty, let's see if you've got what it takes," he thought viciously.
The silence beyond the door had lasted too long, and Heavenly Artisan was nearly out of patience.
He pulled out a crimson potion from his pocket and drank it.
This potion, purchased at great cost from within the [Marauders], could triple his physical attributes for 15 minutes!Googlᴇ search ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Almost equivalent to gaining most of a [Soldier] profession!
This was Heavenly Artisan's life-saving trump card!
Though unsure of his opponent's strength, Heavenly Artisan never skimped on consumable items!
Life was precious—save where you can, spend where you must!
Just as he stood behind the door, hammers at the ready...
"Yo!"
A cheerful greeting came from behind him.
Heavenly Artisan whirled around to see a tall young man standing on his balcony, waving at him with an amused smile.
The voice sounded familiar.
The thought flashed through Heavenly Artisan's mind.
Backlit and wearing a mask, the man's features were unclear.
But his next words jogged Heavenly Artisan's memory.
"Long time no see, Heavenly Artisan of the [Marauders]... or should I say, 'Iron Uncle'!"
That confident, resonant voice made Heavenly Artisan's expression shift.
"You're... [Nine Waters]?! That [Soldier]!"
Damn it, it was the same soldier he'd encountered alongside [A Nian]!
If he recalled correctly, this kid wasn't just a [Soldier]—he also had a gun!
And his appearance here... could it be related to the [Free Alliance]?!
Thoughts raced through Heavenly Artisan's mind, but caution kept him rooted in place.
"What do you want?" he demanded coldly.
Lin Yu grinned. "What do I want? I'm here to—"
In the next instant, Heavenly Artisan saw Lin Yu suddenly close the distance.
And from his sleeve, Lin Yu drew a black rod!
"Claim your bounty!"
The black rod swung in a wide arc, heading straight for Heavenly Artisan's skull!

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Impromptu Performance
chapters.content:
Fu Luo stood downstairs, hearing faint “ping ping pang pang” sounds coming from above, gripping his phone with some hesitation.
Although Lin Yu had said not to call for backup unless gunshots were heard, wasn’t this a bit too intense?
Weren’t the two sides upstairs supposed to be a Craftsman and a Doctor? Why did the fierce clash of metal sound like a scene straight out of an old Hong Kong martial arts film?
Endless!
“Could it be that the shooting actually started earlier, but it was too noisy for me to hear?”
Fu Luo couldn’t help but suspect.
However...
Just as he was doubting, a loud bang came from upstairs, breaking Fu Luo’s train of thought.
“Bang!”
An overwhelming sound rang out, and Fu Luo’s expression turned grim.“They’re shooting!”
He quickly pulled out his phone and dialed the number he had saved long ago.
“Beep—beep—”
The call was answered after only two rings.
“Hello?”
Fu Luo spoke rapidly: “Brother Shan, Heavenly Artisan has been found at Jiuxi Garden Building 4. He’s fighting someone. Come quickly!”
After he finished, the voice on the other end immediately responded with seriousness.
“Okay, stay safe. We’re on our way.”
Then, the call was cut off.
Fu Luo exhaled.
What should he do next?
That gunshot just now sounded like a curtain falling, a final decisive blow, and there was no more movement upstairs.
Should he go up and check?
Or... should he hide farther away?
Fu Luo was torn.
He was somewhat worried about Lin Yu on one hand, but also afraid of dying on the other.
Before he could decide...
“Crack!”
The crisp sound rang out again, and then Fu Luo saw a window upstairs shatter. A sturdy figure fell down from the building!
The three-story height was neither high nor low, but an ordinary person jumping down would definitely suffer serious injuries!
“Bang!”
That figure landed on the ground but seemed unharmed, quickly getting up.
Fu Luo saw clearly that the person who fell was not May, who was on the same side...
But rather, Heavenly Artisan Chen Zhitie!
He scrambled up in an instant and saw Fu Luo standing below the community building, stunned and speechless.
“An ambush too?”
Heavenly Artisan cursed, the left side of his clothes soaked in blood, clearly looking battered and miserable.
He was holding a hammer, apparently seriously injured.
Yet he charged fiercely toward Fu Luo, terrifying this so-called Detective enough to panic.
“Heavenly Artisan? I... I’m not here to block you!”
Fu Luo hurriedly said, frantically pulling out a pair of brass knuckles from his pocket and slipping them onto his hands.
Though he barely managed a boxing stance, his loose posture and shrinking gaze revealed his amateur level.
Sure enough, as Heavenly Artisan rushed at him, Fu Luo was scared back step by step.
Then...The most update n0vels are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
“Boom!”
Pale flames erupted from the broken window just now, and a low roar echoed in the stairwell.
“Heavenly Artisan, you bastard, get back here!”
Fu Luo recognized the voice as May’s.
Hearing this, Heavenly Artisan’s expression drastically changed.
He punched Fu Luo in the face, and Fu Luo’s vision went black as he collapsed to the ground.
Before losing consciousness, Fu Luo vaguely saw Heavenly Artisan sprinting toward the southern exit of the community!
...
At the south side of Jiuxi Garden, Heavenly Artisan ran quickly and soon reached the community entrance.
He looked left and right for a moment, then soon saw a taxi approaching.
“Whoosh—”
The taxi skidded sharply, tires screeching and dragging a long gray-black mark on the ground, stopping steadily in front of Heavenly Artisan.
The window rolled down, revealing a mature woman in a tropical floral shirt, her hair tied back, smoking a thin ladies’ cigarette, sitting in the driver’s seat.
“Oh, Heavenly Artisan, you look pretty beaten up!”
“You’re actually asking for help yourself!”
Heavenly Artisan frowned darkly, opened the door, and slid into the back seat. “Cut the crap, Almond. The one targeting me is that damn Detective!”
“He called people from the Order! And the Zheng City Game Master!”
The woman called “Almond” chuckled lightly, skillfully shifting gears and flooring the accelerator as the taxi sped off.
“Stop flattering yourself. The Order and the Game Master only just started making moves. Our Zheng City chief has already led people to intercept them...”
“You must’ve been attacked by some wild bounty hunter from nowhere!”
Heavenly Artisan snorted coldly. “Not really. The guy who ambushed me is a Doctor... probably related to the Free Alliance.”
“He appeared in the same instance as the Master Thief and came knocking right when my gear was stolen...”
Almond was surprised upon hearing this. “You mean you suspect the Free Alliance did it on purpose?”
“Of course! What are the chances of this happening by accident?” Heavenly Artisan grit his teeth. “I’ll make them pay... and that Doctor kid who suddenly appeared!”
“He even dared to burn down my house!”
Heavenly Artisan gritted his teeth in hatred, holding his left shoulder where blood had stained his clothes, a long wound running through.
It looked like a gunshot wound.
But apparently, some method had partially healed it.
Almond glanced at Heavenly Artisan’s injured shoulder through the rearview mirror, then looked toward the roaring white flames in the distance—now the fire had fully spread, engulfing most of the building!
She exclaimed.
“A gun and arson? The profession is still Doctor... Whoever’s trying to kill you really is a master.”
Heavenly Artisan fell silent.
“A master, huh? Then sooner or later, I’ll kill him too!”
He said angrily.
Almond laughed. “Is that so? Then for such an interesting matter, you have to invite me along...”
“But you said your place is gone. Where do you plan to go?”
Heavenly Artisan was silent for a moment, then sighed. “Back to the organization’s base. I really have nowhere else to go.”
“I’ll lay low there first, wait for the chief to return, and see if there’s any useful news.”
He seemed calmer now.
“Although I suspected the Free Alliance just now, thinking it over, it probably isn’t them. They don’t have connections with that Detective and wouldn’t call the Order for help.”
Almond nodded. “Good. Want me to drive you there?”
“No need. That would cost too much,” Heavenly Artisan glanced sideways at the taxi meter flashing up front. “This taxi really isn’t cheap. Let me off up ahead.”
The car entered Zheng City’s old town district, blending perfectly with the atmosphere.
Almond smiled and stopped the car steadily after passing an intersection. “Alright, see you at the base—pay me when you get there.”
“You’re in such a hurry, only holding a hammer, didn’t even bring money.”
Since the Marauders couldn’t use the forum or forum points, all transactions were cash-based inside the group.
Heavenly Artisan got out without saying much, slamming the door heavily.
Almond pouted. “Still fiery as ever.”
Then the taxi sped away, disappearing again into Zheng City’s streets.
After seeing Almond off, Heavenly Artisan quickly walked into a nearby alley.
He took off his blood-stained clothes and pulled out a clean, youthful-looking hoodie and sweatpants from his bag to change into.
Then his facial features shifted, transforming into Lin Yu’s appearance.
“Phew—”
Lin Yu exhaled long and relaxed considerably.
“Not a bad impromptu performance. Looks like... I managed to bluff my way through smoothly.”
He packed away Heavenly Artisan’s clothes and phone, then took out his own phone and checked the time.
“Hm... still just in time to watch a fight between the Marauders and the Order.”

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Lin Yu's Scheme and Script, The Arrival of "Order"!
chapters.content:
The Heavenly Artisan from earlier was of course Lin Yu in disguise.
The real "Heavenly Artisan" Chen Zhitie had already been killed by Lin Yu.
This outcome was entirely within Lin Yu's expectations.
Lin Yu knew very well that this guy had suffered far worse from "A Nian's" sabotage than himself, likely having some crucial item stolen that significantly weakened his combat ability.
Therefore, Lin Yu had absolutely no doubt about his ability to defeat Heavenly Artisan.
What he was considering was how to utilize Heavenly Artisan to gain more "benefits."
The conditions for joining the "Marauders" were simple and brutal, yet not an easy task.
Even if he could fabricate a "false identity"... Lin Yu still felt the risk was too great.
So rather than starting from scratch to join and gradually gain the "Marauders" organization's trust...
Why not try substituting one thing for another?Although the risk of impersonation was significant, well...
According to Fu Luo's intelligence and Lin Yu's own investigation and observations, Heavenly Artisan was a very reclusive individual.
For such an isolated person, there weren't many who truly knew him.
The "Marauders" wasn't an organization like "Jiang'an Hall" with harmonious and deep cooperation.
While having some level of organization, it was understandable... gathering a bunch of players wanted by "Order," who would actively kill and rob in reality without survival pressure—what trust could there be among them?
Someone like Heavenly Artisan would have even less chance of having bosom friends or confidants within!
Moreover, Lin Yu had interacted with him throughout an entire dungeon and had a basic understanding of his temperament and habits.
Most importantly...
Lin Yu had complete confidence in his "acting skills" and this hastily crafted "script."
From his brief contact with "Almond" earlier, Lin Yu could confirm.
The other party hadn't noticed at all that he wasn't Heavenly Artisan!
"The 'Marauders' side is probably fine now. Next is to see if 'Order' can spot any flaws."
Lin Yu murmured as he quickly made his way back to the "crime scene," the Jiuxi Garden residential area.
Although Heavenly Artisan did have some skills, under Lin Yu's careful calculations, the actual time of death...
Was one minute after they met.
With premeditation against unpreparedness, Lin Yu didn't even need to use his pistol.
With the physical enhancement of the "Soldier" class, two strikes were enough to numb Heavenly Artisan's hands and make him drop his hammer.
But the truly fatal blow was the third attack!
Lin Yu anticipated Heavenly Artisan would mistake it for a short rod, deliberately letting him grab the [Fear Torch]...
Before twisting it open.
The scorching flames instantly burned Heavenly Artisan's hands and face.
Because Heavenly Artisan let go quickly enough, the burns were actually minor, but then...
Lin Yu activated the advanced ability of the "Doctor" class.
He used the [Syringe] item effect to instantly worsen Heavenly Artisan's burns.
Overwhelmed by excruciating pain, Heavenly Artisan was momentarily dazed, and his respiratory tract was affected by the burns, impairing his mobility.
And that moment...
Was enough for Lin Yu to kill Heavenly Artisan outright with the [Syringe] and [Fear Torch]!
As for why Fu Luo below continued to hear impacts for so long afterward...
That was intentional.
Lin Yu kept hammering and striking the surroundings, creating the illusion of intense combat, while also going through Heavenly Artisan's phone and using [False Face] to transform into Heavenly Artisan's appearance.
Through the phone, Lin Yu aimed to thoroughly understand Heavenly Artisan's "persona," and also...
To learn about the "Marauders" and prepare to send a distress signal.
After a quick scan of the phone, Lin Yu sent the distress signal, then piled up flammable materials in the room and recorded his own "roar," placing it at the stairwell entrance at maximum volume.
Next, he stripped Heavenly Artisan's clothes and collected the items he dropped.
After setting up the "audio" and igniting Heavenly Artisan's corpse with the [Fear Torch] on the flammable pile...
Lin Yu changed into Heavenly Artisan's clothes, shot himself in the shoulder...
And jumped from the third floor.
Using the "Doctor" ability to heal the gunshot wound and minor fall injuries, Lin Yu then began his performance.
The performance successfully fooled Fu Luo and the subsequently arriving "Marauders" member "Almond."
"Now my identity as 'Heavenly Artisan' is confirmed. I should be able to operate under this identity from now on!"
Thinking this, Lin Yu returned to Jiuxi Garden.
The fire caused by the [Fear Torch] had died out, leaving the entire building charred black, erasing all traces.
Lin Yu wandered downstairs and found Fu Luo still unconscious.
Lin Yu's punch earlier had been perfectly calculated—dazing without causing brain damage.
Lin Yu crouched down and shook Fu Luo.
"Hey, wake up!"
Fu Luo gradually came to under Lin Yu's shaking.
Looking up at Lin Yu's concerned face, Fu Luo apologized, "Sorry, May..."
Lin Yu quickly interjected, his expression a mix of concern and guilt, "No, it was my mistake. I underestimated him and let him escape. I couldn't catch up either!"
"And I almost got you killed!"
As Lin Yu spoke, Fu Luo rubbed his slightly aching head, "I almost died?"
Facing Fu Luo's question.
Lin Yu nodded sincerely, his expression full of remorse, "I noticed you had intracranial hematoma and severe concussion symptoms earlier. I was too busy chasing Heavenly Artisan, who was impossible to catch, and didn't notice at first."
"Luckily he ran too fast, hopping into a taxi and disappearing as soon as he left the compound. When I came back, I managed to give you emergency treatment in time."
"Any later, and it could have been dangerous!"
Lin Yu clenched his fists, eyes slightly red with emotion, "I'm sorry... Furbollo, I was too arrogant! This is all my fault!"
Fu Luo stared blankly at Lin Yu before hurriedly waving his hands.
"It's fine, buddy—you saved me in the end, didn't you?"
"And this is Heavenly Artisan's fault!"
Lin Yu shook his head, dejected, "But I let him get away. We gained nothing—you took that hit for nothing!"
Fu Luo looked at the still guilt-ridden Lin Yu and couldn't help but laugh.
"It's fine, not for nothing. At least I gained a trustworthy friend."
"Honestly, I thought you were the cold, ruthless type who only knows how to use and threaten others," Fu Luo said emotionally, "But your genuine concern just now confirmed for me... you're a good person, someone worth befriending and trusting!"
"Your earlier behavior was just a protective facade."
"This gain is far more valuable than a few thousand points in bounties."
Fu Luo patted Lin Yu's shoulder, "Besides, we might not have come away empty-handed—if 'Order' catches that guy, we might still get some 'information-providing' points."
Just as Fu Luo finished speaking, a robust voice sounded behind them.
"Indeed, we're already pursuing 'Heavenly Artisan.' Your information is extremely valuable!"
Turning around, they saw a tall man in police uniform approaching.
Lin Yu glanced at the police insignia on his shoulder and understood.
"Third-rank police superintendent, probably a veteran frontline officer who earned his rank purely through experience and capability."
Lin Yu subtly became more serious, his previously relaxed acting now flawless.
Fu Luo greeted the man warmly.
"Brother Shan, 'Order' must catch that bastard!"

"Oh, and... let me introduce you. This is my friend and temporary partner, May—his class is 'Doctor'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Zhu Ming and Old Yao, Li Nian and the Tycoon
chapters.content:
Jiangcheng, early morning.
Li Nian sat in the living room staring at her phone with furrowed brows.
"Huh? The Marauders actually took the initiative to come looking for me?"
"This Heavenly Artisan has more guts than I imagined... Is this for real?"
Although the Free Alliance was an organization banned from the forum, as the most renowned group among players, they naturally had their own information channels.
The moment Lin Yu and five other Marauders members arrived in Jiangcheng after an all-night journey, Li Nian had already received internal intelligence from the Free Alliance.
[Chef God: Anyway, I heard it's not entirely about you. The Marauders in Henan Province suffered major losses, apparently because Heavenly Artisan got targeted.]
[Chef God: And the guy who attacked Heavenly Artisan happens to be from Jiangcheng.]
[Master Thief Anian: Tch, what undeserved misfortune for me.]
[Magician: Regardless of reasons, please be careful—intel suggests besides Heavenly Artisan, there are two other First-Tiers: Red Fuji and Almond.][Magician: I've uploaded their profiles to the group.]
Li Nian opened the file Magician sent to her phone.
While reading, faint noises suddenly came from the courtyard.
"Hey—"
Looking up, she saw the familiar figure she'd met before, just as expected.
Hearing her dog didn't bark, Li Nian already guessed who the visitor was.
"Yo, Zhu Ming... right?"
She stood from the couch, crossing her arms.
"Though I said I was quite interested in you, my home isn't some public restroom—you can't just come and go as you please, can you?"
Veterinarian Zhu Ming—actually Lin Yu—revealed a gentle smile.
"Don't be angry, A Nian. I came for a reason."
"I got some news—a group of Marauders have infiltrated Jiangcheng and might target you."
"Free Alliance members are probably scattered far apart, so I wanted to ask... do you need help?"
Li Nian looked surprised.
"You know about this too? You're quite well-informed."
"But don't worry—with only three First-Tiers in their lineup, I can handle them easily."
Lin Yu raised an eyebrow.
"Oh, could it be..."
"Of course, I'm Second-Tier."
Li Nian answered bluntly, pride evident in her tone.
Lin Yu was inwardly astonished.
He'd truly underestimated this Master Thief all along!
"Then my concern was unnecessary," Lin Yu said, stroking his chin. "But Miss A Nian... since there are three First-Tiers this time, that means at least one must have a bounty over 3,000 points or 500,000 yuan, right?"
"How about treating this as my test? See if I can help resolve this matter?"
Li Nian arched an eyebrow: "You haven't been promoted yet... and you're saying you'll try to kill three First-Tiers to solve this?"
"Not through direct confrontation, of course," Lin Yu chuckled. "Anyway, if you trust me... do me a favor."
"What?"ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Li Nian looked at Lin Yu with interest.
"Lend me Heavenly Artisan's Bone Crusher."
Lin Yu said calmly.
Li Nian froze momentarily, then narrowed her eyes: "My, you know more about my feud with the Marauders than I imagined."
"I'm starting to suspect you might be a Marauder spy."
As she spoke, Lin Yu nodded.
"Indeed. So... willing to take a chance on trusting me?"
Her response was a black hammer tossed toward him.
Lin Yu caught it smoothly, then saw the item prompt appear:
[Bone Crusher: Enhances damage against living beings, revealing "weak points" on targets. Striking weak points deals massive damage.]
Lin Yu casually tucked it into his sleeve, then looked at Li Nian: "Thank you for your trust, Miss A Nian... Then, around 2 PM this afternoon, if you want to avoid trouble, make sure the Marauders can confirm your absence."
"Best if you can have tea with Jiangcheng's Marauders contacts or something."
Lin Yu said with a smile.
Li Nian blinked. Though unsure of his meaning, she eventually nodded slowly.
"Sounds like you're planning something absolutely spectacular that won't disappoint..."
"Though I'm not familiar with local Marauders, arranging a meeting shouldn't be hard."
"I'll await your good news."
As Li Nian spoke, Lin Yu bowed slightly with a radiant smile.
"I absolutely won't disappoint you."
Then he left with Heavenly Artisan's hammer.
After leaving, Lin Yu waited exactly one hour before entering a newly opened mall.
When he reemerged, he'd transformed from the gentle girl Veterinarian Zhu Ming into a thin, dark, furtive young man.
Lin Yu soon arrived at Jiang'an Hall's base—the Tycoon's abandoned restaurant.
Entering the abandoned restaurant, Lin Yu took out the phone belonging to his Old Yao identity, opened the app, and sent a message:
"Boss, I got important intel—the Free Alliance's Master Thief is negotiating with some out-of-town Marauders. Should we take advantage? @Tycoon"
Almost instantly, the quiet group chat exploded.
"Free Alliance and Marauders? What a explosive combo!"
"What are these two groups plotting?"
"Old Yao said negotiations... probably not collaborating for something bad?"
"Boss, what do you think?"
Messages flooded in, everyone shocked by Lin Yu's revelation.
Watching Jiang'an Hall's internal app reactions, Lin Yu wasn't surprised.
"Hmm... As expected, organizations like Jiang'an Hall aren't as well-informed as the Free Alliance."
"Top-tier organizations have their reasons for being top-tier..."
After several minutes of chaos, the Tycoon finally appeared.
He replied to Lin Yu:
[Tycoon: Come to my office if free. Tell me in person @Old Yao]
[Old Yao: Received.]
After replying, Lin Yu went straight upstairs and knocked on the Tycoon's door.
A surprised Tycoon opened the door, looking at Lin Yu: "So fast?"
Lin Yu scratched his head, a sly look flashing across his furtive face: "I've been waiting outside your office since morning. After accidentally hearing such big news, I feared someone might beat me to it."
"I'm eager to advance, Brother Tycoon!"
The Tycoon laughed: "I did hear about some Zheng City Marauders coming to Jiangcheng. The Order informed me last night... but I hadn't uncovered the reason yet."
"Never thought you'd already figured it out—they're after the Master Thief!"
"I overheard it at a breakfast stall this morning," Lin Yu reiterated. "And it's not just the Master Thief—they're also after killing someone: a Doctor, also First-Tier, from Jiangcheng, who made Zheng City's Marauders suffer major losses."
Lin Yu said solemnly.
The Tycoon looked even more astonished.
Then he gazed at Lin Yu and spoke thoughtfully: "You rushed to report this—do you have any ideas?"
Lin Yu nodded.
"Of course. I have a rough plan, but... it might require some support from you, Tycoon."

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Bonds of Trust
chapters.content:
As evening fell.
The river cutting through Jiangcheng flowed quietly as a small sightseeing cruise ship slowly docked at an abandoned pier.
Almond parked the rented business car on the riverside road, gazing at the distant cruise ship before turning to Heavenly Artisan in the passenger seat.
"Setting the negotiation with Master Thief on the water? You're truly a genius!"
Lin Yu, currently disguised as Heavenly Artisan in the passenger seat, nodded: "Naturally. I don't want Order interrupting our negotiations. And... choosing this relatively enclosed location will prevent that girl from pulling any escape tricks."
Red Fuji nodded in agreement: "Indeed, escaping is Master Thief's greatest specialty."
Almond pondered briefly: "Fair enough. But can we trust the cruise staff..."
"They're trustworthy, just ordinary people."
Lin Yu stated confidently.
Noticing Almond's lingering concern, he patted their shoulder: "Relax, Almond. Just wait ashore as our backup.""Don't worry, Red Fuji and I... can handle most situations ourselves."
Red Fuji nodded as well.
"When it comes to battles between Players, we Marauders fear no one!"
"Right guys?"
Inspired by Red Fuji's energy, the three other Marauders in the car all voiced their agreement.
"Exactly, nothing to worry about!"
"Even if Order shows up, we can still fight!"
Lin Yu was pleased with their morale.
"Good, excellent spirit!"
He then led Red Fuji and three other non-Promoted Marauders aboard the cruise ship.
Seeing the staff on deck, Lin Yu waved his hand.
"Set sail!"
The cruise ship slowly departed, soon reaching the river's center.
As a sightseeing vessel, the cabin was luxuriously appointed.
The Marauders settled comfortably on sofas, helping themselves to sodas from the fridge.
"Hey, there's even playing cards..."
"These river cruises really have gambling functions?"
"My first time seeing this..."
The three non-Promoted Marauders chattered excitedly.
As Red Fuji cracked open a beer, Lin Yu approached and patted his shoulder.
"Come, let's get some air on deck."
"Jiangcheng's nightscape is quite beautiful."
Red Fuji considered briefly before nodding: "Alright."
The two left the cabin.
Emerging onto the deck, Lin Yu pulled out a pack of Liqun cigarettes he'd found in Heavenly Artisan's pocket, lighting one and offering another to Red Fuji.
Red Fuji accepted, lighting up at his lips.
Leaning against the railing, they enjoyed the night breeze and river view.
"Jiangcheng's night scenery really is stunning."
"No wonder it's nationally renowned."
Red Fuji marveled.
The towering office buildings and trade centers along the riverbanks glittered with colorful lights, their reflections dancing on the shimmering water.
"Just the CBD... venture to the suburbs and it's nothing special."
Lin Yu remarked casually before asking: "Come to think of it, I've never asked - how did you join the Marauders?"
Red Fuji seemed taken aback: "Who in our organization asks that?"
"I joined for revenge," Lin Yu continued in Heavenly Artisan's gravelly voice, "My life savings were stolen by my most trusted colleague and partner, turned into that unfinished development zone."
"I couldn't accept it, so I decided to kill them - though I lacked the courage to kill ordinary people. Fortunately... some had already become Players!"
Lin Yu said calmly.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"So I killed them, not for their items... but because someone had to pay."
Red Fuji seemed moved. He took a deep drag, smoking it down to the filter before flicking the butt into the river.
"Brother Heavenly Artisan, why tell me this..."
"Now I'd feel bad not sharing, but my story's simple... Before my Promotion, fearing I might fail, I set up and killed two former teammates... only to get caught by Order."
Red Fuji smiled bitterly.
"Our members lack trust," Heavenly Artisan said quietly, "Even among ourselves, there's constant suspicion - truthfully, I dislike that."
"So through this mission, I want to find a few truly reliable comrades."
"Being attacked made me realize... no one goes far alone."
He spoke earnestly. After consideration, Red Fuji responded:
"Alright, Brother Heavenly Artisan, I'll trust you."
Then Red Fuji laughed.
"But don't think this means you can skimp on payment!"
Lin Yu laughed too.
"Haha, fair enough - but let me be even more honest."
Lin Yu produced the Bone Crusher from his coat.
Red Fuji's face showed shock as he leaned closer.
"That's... your hammer?"
"Didn't Master Thief steal it?"
Lin Yu smiled and nodded: "I took it back."
Just as Red Fuji started to react—
"CRACK!"
Lin Yu's full-powered swing smashed Red Fuji to the deck.
The downward Bone Crusher shattered the man's jaw, teeth and blood spraying as facial bones fractured.
Then—
Before the agonized Red Fuji could scream, Lin Yu struck again!
"CRACK!"
This time both hammers struck simultaneously at Red Fuji's temples!
[Item: Hammer] and [Bone Crusher] hit left and right.
The Bone Crusher even scored a critical hit!
Red Fuji's eyes bloodshot as he collapsed silently.
Bloody foam bubbled from his nose and mouth - no life remained.
Lin Yu shook out his wrists and exhaled.
"Whew—"
He pulled out Zhu Ming's phone from his pocket.
Opening the camera, he photographed Red Fuji's corpse, then uploaded it to the Hunters' Association app.
Like the forum, the Hunters' Association was less an organization and more a platform.
Open to all Players, it functioned solely for bounties.
No point system - only cash and gold transactions.
Similarly, its functions were robust, its developers mysterious.
Some claimed it was created by a former forum developer who left dissatisfied.
Others said it was the Psychological Society's work.
Regardless, it worked well.
As now - after uploading, Lin Yu found Red Fuji's bounty post.
The app quickly verified completion.
"Congratulations on completing Bounty C-1805, including D-0907 and D-2315. Total reward: 1,040,000 RMB."
"Please select payment method."

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Cry for Help and Scheme
chapters.content:
After killing Red Fuji, Lin Yu selected his reward method from the Hunters' Association and set up a timed message on his phone. After scheduling the message, he took a moment to breathe in the fresh air on the deck. He didn't usually smoke—the Liqun cigarette he'd taken from Heavenly Artisan had nearly choked him to death earlier.
After some time passed, Lin Yu smeared some of Red Fuji's blood on his face, stripped the corpse bare, collected the items that had dropped, then threw the body overboard.
"Plop!"
The splash echoed as Lin Yu transformed into Red Fuji's appearance and donned his clothes. Adjusting his emotions, he put on a panicked expression and rushed back into the cabin.
Inside, three Marauders members were playing cards. When the blood-covered "Red Fuji" burst through the door, they all jumped in shock.
"What happened, Brother Red?" the leader among them asked.
"We're under attack... Heavenly Artisan was injured and fell overboard!" Lin Yu gasped heavily.
The three were stunned. "Who attacked you?"
"It was a Thief," Lin Yu lowered his voice, panting. "He was too fast... I couldn't see clearly..."
"Could it be the Master Thief?!" one of the young men exclaimed in horror."Dammit, that bastard never came to negotiate!" another Marauder gritted his teeth.
The female Marauder remained composed. "No matter. From now on, we stick together and get this boat to shore. Whether it's the Master Thief or not, choosing to ambush means they lack confidence in facing us head-on..." Her calm words steadied the other two.
"But Heavenly Artisan is missing—how do we contact the crew?" Lin Yu asked, sweating profusely while feigning pain.
"We never asked for their contact info!"
The captain and crew numbered only two, both stationed on the sightseeing boat's top deck. This meant...
Sticking together wouldn't work—someone had to go upstairs.
The two male Marauders exchanged glances before making a decision. "Brother Red Fuji, you and 'Little Ice' stay here. We'll go inform the captain to dock! Even the Master Thief wouldn't dare kill in front of ordinary people!"
In reality, killing "Players" rarely drew official attention unless evidence was blatant. Some unseen force seemed to make normal people dismiss Player deaths as accidents—which was why Order existed to punish such killings. The law simply didn't care about Players' lives. After all, Players were already dead men walking. This was why Player battles always avoided civilians.
Hearing their plan, Lin Yu still hesitated.
One youth urged, "No time to hesitate, Brother Red... We'll all die if this continues! We can't stay trapped here—we need to regroup with Sister Almond!"
The other nodded. "Right! Little Ice is a Doctor—she can heal you. The two of us are an Enforcer and a Ruffian—we can defend ourselves together."
Reluctantly, Lin Yu agreed. "Fine, but hurry back!"
As they left, the woman nicknamed "Little Ice" approached to treat Lin Yu. "Brother Red, where are you hurt?" The blood covering him made it hard to identify wounds.
Just as she reached out to heal him...
Lin Yu produced a lightweight utility knife with a cute pink casing.
Little Ice stared at it, puzzled. "This is...?"
"A First-Tier [Class Item] from a Thief," Lin Yu said.
"Eh? Brother Red Fuji, aren't you a Musician?"
Then her phone buzzed.
"Vibrate—"
She checked it—a text from Heavenly Artisan. The message was simple:
"Beware! Red Fuji is the Master Thief in disguise!"
Her pupils contracted as she stared at Lin Yu, alarm bells ringing in her mind. "You—"
Lin Yu grinned. "Oops. Busted."
A lighthearted tone, then—
Swish!
Lin Yu marveled at the [Class Item·Swift Blade]-enhanced tool in his hand. Big faction members were convenient—they knew all about item effects without needing explanations, making deception effortless.
A crimson line bloomed across Little Ice's throat. Clutching her neck, she activated her Doctor abilities while gasping, "H-help... me..." She staggered toward the cabin door, but...
It was futile.
Lin Yu pursued with the utility knife.
Then—
"Schlick!"
This time, the blade entered her neck laterally, severing an artery. The first cut hadn't been fatal—just bait to draw out her healing. This was the killing blow.
Confirming her death, Lin Yu exited the cabin and hurried upstairs, encountering the two descending Marauders.
They blinked at him. "Brother Red Fuji? Why are you here?"Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Lin Yu feigned relief. "Little Ice got worried when you didn't return. She healed me and sent me to check on you. Any progress?"
"The captain agreed to dock," one said.
Just then, all three heard it—
"H-help... me..."
A faint, ghostly cry from the cabin's direction.
"Oh no—that's Little Ice!" The Ruffian paled and sprinted toward the sound.
"Damn it! How'd she get to the deck so fast?" Lin Yu said regretfully, following.
They arrived to find Little Ice in a pool of blood. The Ruffian's devastation matched Lin Yu's expectations—he'd noticed the man's fondness for her.
"N-no... no..."
Trembling, the Ruffian lifted her body and discovered the phone clutched in her hand.
Or more accurately...
The phone Lin Yu had planted there.
What mattered was the Ruffian seeing the message. His head snapped up to meet Lin Yu's smile—and the glinting utility knife in his hand.
The vanished "belief" returned!
And this time, as the Ruffian shouted—
"Look out—"
The Enforcer's throat was pierced from behind by Lin Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Negotiations with the Tycoon and Cleanup
chapters.content:
Sitting inside the cabin, Lin Yu gathered the corpses and took photos to upload to the Hunters' Association—this time using his Old Yao identity. The combined bounties of the remaining three Marauders members didn't even match Red Fuji's alone, but altogether it still amounted to around two hundred thousand.
Lin Yu sat in the cabin wearing Red Fuji's appearance, feeling somewhat surreal. "I've become a millionaire now..." He rubbed his chin and muttered. There was no denying that robbery and murder really brought fast money. Of course, these funds hadn't been transferred yet—they weren't safely in his pocket.
But after eliminating these people, Lin Yu hadn't just obtained the Hunters' Association bounties—he'd directly acquired five items. Two from Red Fuji and one each from the remaining three. After checking them, Lin Yu found nothing particularly useful for himself. He'd sell them later for additional income.
After waiting quietly in the cabin for an hour until False Face's cooldown ended, Lin Yu transformed back into Old Yao's appearance. He left the cabin and entered the wheelhouse, where the captain and first mate nodded in acknowledgment upon seeing him.
"Mission accomplished?"
"Naturally."
Lin Yu smiled as he spoke. These two were peripheral members of Jiang'an Hall, assigned to him by the Tycoon. Since the Tycoon didn't fully trust "Old Yao," he hadn't sent any core Jiang'an Hall members for this operation—after all, Lin Yu had told the Tycoon that all he needed was a boat to completely eliminate the Marauders. This naturally made the Tycoon suspicious.
Fortunately, Lin Yu didn't actually want the Tycoon to send powerful assistants either—that would have made executing his plans much more inconvenient.
"Shall we dock now?" asked the peripheral member steering the boat. Lin Yu shook his head.
"No need. Let me report to the boss first." With that, Lin Yu took out his phone and used an internal app to call the Tycoon."Hello? Old Yao, already finished?" came the Tycoon's lazy voice.
"Yeah, except for Heavenly Artisan escaping by jumping into the river... the rest are confirmed eliminated. Three corpses in the cabin, and the First-Tier Red Fuji fell into the water after death—if they dredge the river, they should find his body." Lin Yu deliberately adopted a somewhat frivolous, boastful tone to match Old Yao's character.
The Tycoon laughed. "You've really got some skills, kid—though I didn't ask beforehand, how exactly did you pull this off? You couldn't have done it alone, right?"
Lin Yu chuckled awkwardly. "I did get some help... given your information network, boss, you probably already know Heavenly Artisan suffered losses in Zheng City before chasing targets to our Jiangcheng."
The Tycoon nodded. "Right, I heard he was injured by some Doctor from Jiangcheng, which is why he gathered people here—negotiating with the Master Thief was just one aspect."ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"I happened to know that Doctor," Lin Yu said without blinking. "Along with a Veterinarian I recruited... the three of us boarded secretly after them and took them out one by one. They've already left after finishing the job."
The Tycoon sounded surprised. "You actually know someone stronger than Heavenly Artisan? What's that Doctor's background? Any chance of recruiting him to Jiang'an Hall? If you can bring him in, I'll give you top-tier point rewards!"
His tone grew enthusiastic—Jiang'an Hall's internal rules clearly stated that recruiting capable players with potential earned point rewards.
Lin Yu gave a bitter laugh. "Boss, I'd love to... but since he advanced tiers without joining any organization, he's got pretty high standards..."
"Apparently his goal is to join Order! Besides, I only teamed up with him once for a dungeon."
Hearing this, the Tycoon sounded disappointed. "Ah, forget it then—what about that Veterinarian you mentioned? Since you brought her up separately, she must be quite capable too?"
Lin Yu's tone adopted appropriate wariness for his character. "That one... I don't have confidence persuading her either. Honestly, she looks fragile but has a pretty sinister personality." He spoke seriously, then lowered his voice. "No proof, but I suspect... she might join the Free Alliance!"
"The Free Alliance?!" The Tycoon sounded startled, then cautiously advised, "Then keep your distance. Free Alliance members are crazier than even the Psychological Society!"
Lin Yu adopted a solemn expression. "Understood..." Then he smoothly shifted topics with obvious flattery. "But I'm not afraid—just a small organization with few members. In Jiangcheng territory, there's only the so-called Master Thief... how could they compare to our Jiang'an Hall?"
"Especially when our leader ranks twenty-seventh on the forum's top 100 list! With your protection, why wouldn't they fear me?"
Lin Yu's serious delivery actually made the Tycoon somewhat embarrassed. "You kid... well, you're not wrong! But still be careful of the Free Alliance. They might not appear on the rankings, but rumor says most of the top fifty anonymous users are theirs."
"There's even talk that three of the top ten anonymous spots belong to Free Alliance members!" the Tycoon added.
Lin Yu mentally noted this information. "The Free Alliance is that powerful? Though it makes sense—if a small organization is so famous, they must focus on elite members with exceptional skills!" he thought. "If I really join, I'll need to verify this thoroughly!"
Aloud, he said, "Boss, anyway, aside from Heavenly Artisan escaping, I confirmed the deaths of the other four who boarded—the Veterinarian took the Hunters' bounty for the First-Tier kill, left me the other three, and the Doctor kept all the items... that arrangement works, right?"
The Tycoon was magnanimous. "No problem, keep the small change. As someone called 'Tycoon,' I've got considerable assets—this amount means nothing. More importantly, you took out four intercity Marauders—this achievement will be credited to Jiang'an Hall... that benefit outweighs any monetary gain for me."
"After docking, go claim your Hunters' bounty without worry—I'll handle the cleanup."

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Further Negotiations
chapters.content:
With the Tycoon's approval, Lin Yu disappeared into the night before the members of Jiang'an Hall arrived after the boat docked.
It wasn't that he was in a hurry to claim the Hunters' Association bounty as the Tycoon had suggested.
For Lin Yu...
The cleanup work wasn't finished yet.
In the darkness, the False Face ability became ready again, and Lin Yu changed his appearance once more.
Dressed in a white lab coat with a shoulder bag, he approached a business sedan by the riverbank.
Tapping on the driver's window, he watched as it rolled down smoothly to reveal Almond's face.
The woman was clearly on high alert but pretended to be relaxed.
"What's up, little sister? Need a ride?" Almond asked casually with a toothpick between her teeth.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Lin Yu, now in the form of a delicate young girl, smiled."No, I don't need a ride... Sister Almond of the Marauders."
He cheerfully called out her name, and the moment her expression changed dramatically as she reached for a weapon inside her jacket—he struck first.
A pistol pressed against Almond's forehead—though it had no bullets, she obviously didn't know that.
She immediately raised her hands. "Whoa—calm down."
Lin Yu had used this trick too many times.
With cowards like Almond, whether the gun was loaded didn't matter.
She wouldn't dare take the risk.
"Let me introduce myself. I'm Zhu Ming, a veterinarian by profession... Not affiliated with any organization yet, but you could say I'm a reserve member of the Free Alliance now."
Almond looked confused but relieved at Lin Yu's words.
While ordinary people would avoid the Free Alliance...
If Marauders members had to choose—
"At least you're not from the Order. So... Zhu Ming, what do you want? Are you here representing the Master Thief?" Almond asked.
Lin Yu shook his head. "Miss A Nian does know about this, but it's not directly related... Mainly doing a friend a favor to earn some extra cash—and complete the Free Alliance's assessment."
"I regret to inform you that apart from that Craftsman uncle, all your teammates are dead... Though I can't guarantee that Craftsman is still alive. Hope he's a good swimmer."
As Lin Yu spoke, undisguised panic flashed across Almond's face.
"What? What do you mean?"
She understood—Lin Yu had killed all her companions and forced Heavenly Artisan to disappear.
But Almond didn't understand...
Why she was the only one left.
"I hate boring things," Lin Yu said with a gentle smile. "Negotiations are so dull. If you'd come planning to kill A Nian, I might have even helped you."
"Pity... Your leader was an idiot who could only think of 'safe' plans."
"That's why I'd never join your Marauders—frankly, you're no different from the Order to me."
Lin Yu rambled on in a mild tone that made his abnormality obvious to Almond.
Almond swallowed hard. "What exactly are you trying to say?"
"Nothing. What I want to say isn't important. What matters is... you want to live, right?"
Lin Yu looked at Almond and lowered the gun.
"Then—go back where you belong. Run back with your tail between your legs while I still find the idea amusing!"
"Or... try seeking 'revenge'."
Lin Yu stared eagerly at Almond, lightly licking his upper lip.
Almond didn't hesitate for a second. The moment Lin Yu fully put away the gun, she slammed the accelerator to the floor and frantically rolled up the window.
Soon, the business sedan disappeared down Riverside Avenue.
After watching the taillights vanish, Lin Yu slowly exhaled.
"Good. Just one last step now."
Using Zhu Ming's phone, he sent a message to A Nian, then changed into blood-stained clothes, threw the shoulder bag and phone into a flower bed, and dove into the river.
The river through Jiangcheng was wide with a steady current—anyone who could swim wouldn't drown here.
And Lin Yu happened to know a thing or two about swimming.
It was excellent cardio for maintaining physique and lung capacity—very helpful for becoming a competent actor.
After floating in the river awhile, he came ashore at a gently sloping bank he'd scouted earlier.
By now, False Face had changed again, this time into Heavenly Artisan's miserable appearance.
Slumping onto a riverside rock, he soon heard a plain Nissan sedan stop on the road above the bank.
Li Nian—who definitely didn't have a driver's license and whose family certainly didn't own a Nissan—stepped out of the driver's seat and walked down to the bank.
Seeing the dejected "Heavenly Artisan," she shoved her hands in her pockets and grinned.
"Hey, heard you came to Jiangcheng... to talk to me?"
