Sometimes it would suddenly clutch its wing in pain, as if having a cramp.
After each fall, it would be dizzy and bump into the hard transparent partition, wasting more time.
Of course, Li Hua himself was not idle during this process;
he also pulled out a deck of playing cards and some chips, presumably plotting and preparing something.
On the other side, Robin’s maneuvers also made Lin Yu sigh in admiration.
She kept sketching various geometric shapes, and then those shapes would jump out and stack on the table, blocking the goose’s path!
The wild giant goose in front of Robin kept ramming its head and biting at those geometric shapes, but its speed was barely faster than the snail’s.
Of course, although choosing the snail meant slow movement, it didn’t mean the other three were having an easy time.
Whether it was Phantom the ‘Magician’ or Fish and Mosin-Nagant,
They all seemed helpless against the snail slowly crawling toward them!
No matter the attack—whether Mosin-Nagant’s arrows, Fish’s flintlock gunshots,
Or Phantom’s flames released from his hat—
They were somewhat ineffective against the snail!
All attacks hitting the snail only caused it to retreat into its black shell, remaining completely unharmed!
Seeing this, Lin Yu both admired the diverse skills of these expert players.
At the same time, Lin Yu was very relieved...
Luckily, he had been clever enough to take a shortcut on this stage.
Otherwise, if he had to fight either the goose or the snail head-on, Lin Yu really wouldn’t be confident in directly taking down these two magical creatures.
Even if he barely managed to...
His disheveled appearance afterward might raise suspicions among others!
Of course, Lin Yu did not think this showed he was smarter than these veteran players.
Rather than saying Lin Yu was especially clever to see through the octopus Ka’s trap...
It was more that his experiences in the three dungeons so far had all come with NPC and “rule” traps and manipulations.
Especially the second dungeon involving the gods—that was the one with the most traps!Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
So, Lin Yu’s habitual way of thinking and problem-solving was different from most players.
Whenever any rules or instructions were placed before him, he would doubt them repeatedly.
Searching for textual traps and hints within.
And through the reactions of these veteran players, Lin Yu could even deduce one thing.
“It seems dungeons with traps deliberately hidden in the rules... really are a tiny minority.”

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Side Effects of Two Foods
chapters.content:
Although the remaining participants were momentarily in disarray, these "experts" would never truly be defeated by mere snails and geese.
Fish spat lightly after realizing gunfire had no effect on the snail.
"Tch... physical attacks don't work?"
"Highly toxic, huh—let's see how toxic you really are."
Saying this, Fish pulled out a gas mask from her bosom and fastened it over her head.
Then she produced a scroll from her clothing.
Fish tore the scroll, revealing a hexagram pattern before her as thick green smoke erupted forth.
The smoke surged toward the black snail, which retreated into its shell as before.
But this time, it was futile.
The green smoke seemed to lock onto the snail, directly penetrating its shell.The entire snail shell trembled violently, then...
Holes appeared one after another on the seemingly indestructible shell, emitting sizzling sounds and white smoke as if being corroded.
Soon.
The entire snail completely "disappeared"!
Meanwhile, Li Hua had completed his preparations.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
During intervals of spinning dice, Li Hua finally finished shuffling his deck of cards.
He then drew five cards from the deck and tossed them toward the goose's direction.
Li Hua threw down two chips marked not with numbers but with depictions of eyes.
"Placing bets, my friend!" he announced clearly as the chips landed on the table with crisp sounds.
"Show your cards!"
At his command, both his and the goose's five cards flipped open simultaneously!
Li Hua's hand wasn't strong—just a pair of nines with miscellaneous cards.
But the goose only had a single ace—even weaker!
As the ten cards were revealed, the bewildered wild giant goose let out a shriek, its eye sockets becoming empty, bloody holes.
Blinded, the goose naturally panicked, ceasing its charge and flapping wildly in place!
Seizing this moment, Li Hua drew the king of spades from his deck and flung it, piercing through the goose's left eye socket straight into its small avian brain.
The wild giant goose collapsed heavily onto the table.
Elsewhere, Robin had also eliminated her wild giant goose.
While Li Hua's method was bizarre enough, Robin's approach sent chills down Lin Yu's spine.
The woman bit her finger and used the blood to sketch a crude goose drawing on paper, then crumpled it.
And on the table...
The wild giant goose's body grotesquely twisted and contorted as if being crushed by immense forces from all directions!
Equally incomprehensible to Lin Yu was Phantom's method—the guy simply draped a red cloth over the advancing snail, blew on it...
And the snail vanished into thin air.
Among those present, only Mosin-Nagant's approach made complete sense to Lin Yu.
After repeatedly repelling the snail with arrows, he trapped it at the edge with a net before shattering its "indestructible" shell with some animal's fang dagger.
Regardless...
Watching all this, Lin Yu couldn't help but remark:
"Truly, when eight immortals cross the sea, each displays their divine powers."
These experts' methods had reached levels of weirdness beyond Lin Yu's comprehension.
After all creatures were slain,
Ka spoke up with a smile.
"What magnificent skills our guests have demonstrated!"
"Now then... please enjoy your delicacies."
As Ka spoke, the previously lowered transparent partitions slowly rose.
Then, delicious portions of goose liver and snail were served before each panting participant.
Like trophies of consolation and reward.
"For optimal dining experience, please finish your appetizers within fifteen minutes... Taking too long would be sacrilege against fine cuisine."
"Naturally, we'd have to sever a rope as punishment."
Ka warned meaningfully.
Fifteen minutes might sound ample, but in reality...
It wasn't much at all.
Those who chose snails had it slightly easier—after shelling and frying, the meat was only palm-sized.
The goose liver portion... was nearly half a head in size.
And from the clanking sound it made landing on plates, this thing was undoubtedly quite firm.
However, choosing snails had drawbacks too.
The snail flesh was black tinged with purple. Though Ka claimed its toxicity was reduced, the remaining poison was absolutely substantial.
Of course...
Whether goose liver or snail meat was worse didn't matter to Lin Yu.
Before him sat two plates.
"So the fun earlier comes with payback now!"
Lin Yu sighed.
Not having to fight those creatures was great, but eating this food wouldn't be easy either!
Especially with the fifteen-minute limit.
Plus maintaining Fluoxetine's persona...
Lin Yu quickly began cutting and eating the goose liver with knife and fork.
Admittedly...
The goose liver tasted excellent. Though slightly firmer than normal, beyond the crust's summer-popsicle hardness, the interior was just chewy like tough beef.
The rich aroma paired wonderfully with the sweet-sour blueberry sauce beneath, making it genuinely enjoyable.
The only problem was...
"Too filling. Too rich."
By halfway through, Lin Yu already felt dizzy.
Fortunately, Lin Yu was naturally a fast eater with good appetite—his family ran a restaurant after all...
And in his memory, he often ate double portions.
Thus, when two-thirds of the fifteen minutes had passed...
At the ten-minute mark, Lin Yu had elegantly finished his goose liver.
This speed made him the fastest among all goose liver choosers.
The remaining five minutes, Lin Yu used to recover while eating the snail.
During this breather, he observed the reactions of Li Hua, Radish and Robin who chose snails.
Uncle Radish looked unfazed, as if the weakened toxins didn't affect him.
Li Hua took some dissolving tablets, though his body trembled slightly before the medicine took effect.
As for Robin...
She now sat curled up hugging her knees, sweat rolling down her pale forehead.
"Is this severe toxicity pain-related?"
Watching the trio's reactions, Lin Yu gained some understanding.
The poison's effect seemed strongly pain-based!
However, Lin Yu refrained from jumping to conclusions.
He cautiously picked up the snail meat, stuffed it whole into his mouth and swallowed.
The initial savory flavor lasted but a moment before the anticipated intense pain arrived.
Only...
The pain's location surprised Lin Yu.
Rather than digestive system issues, the agony came from his extremities.
Lin Yu instantly understood why Robin looked so miserable.
The pain from fingers and toes—ten digits connecting to the heart—nearly made him scream.
"Fuck!"
"Isn't this pure torture?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Reward Stage, Side Dish and Main Course
chapters.content:
In daily life, Lin Yu actually didn't have particularly high tolerance for pain.
Getting scalded while cooking or bumping his shin against a table corner could make him gasp in pain or even shed tears.
As a child, what Lin Yu feared most was getting injections.
To avoid shots, he'd even pretend to be perfectly healthy while running a 39°C fever in front of his sister.
But that was only the "ordinary" Lin Yu—the Lin Yu in "performance mode" wouldn't flinch at physical pain.
Right now, experiencing sharp agony comparable to torture, Lin Yu's mind was screaming internally.
Yet...
The Lin Yu on the surface remained completely unfazed.
Because Fluoxetine would never be someone who'd show weakness to this level of pain.
Even if this pain made Li Hua pop pills like candy or left Robin trembling in agony...Lin Yu could still maintain his composure.
His obsession with "performance" surpassed almost everything else.
Feeling the bodily pain with crystal clarity, Lin Yu exhaled softly and spread his hands.
"My, what an interesting sensation," he maintained Fluoxetine's voice and lighthearted tone, "And this is the weakened version too... An ordinary person poisoned like this would probably die from sheer agony!"
Hearing this, Li Hua—who'd taken painkillers to barely stay composed—instantly understood...
The Lin Yu beside him hadn't found some method to reduce the pain, but had endured the full brunt of it without flinching.
"What a monster... Truly worthy of being the Psychological Society's S-Class!"
"A complete psychopath!"
Lin Yu chuckled at Li Hua's words: "Now now, Gambler... Isn't the old man over there the same?"
The addressed Radish coughed lightly.
"Ahem, I don't have that ability... This old man just has some immunity to toxins..."
He said amiably.Thɪs
As they spoke, fifteen minutes passed in a flash.
The others who'd chosen goose liver also finished their portions.
Ka observed the diners and spoke again.
"Dear guests, it seems you've all enjoyed the appetizer..."
"Now, please enjoy today's soup course."
"Misty Island Raspberry and Calm Sea Clam Chowder."
From the pool beneath it, Ka produced a soup pot and seven shallow bowls, serving the deep red soup before distributing them.
"Please enjoy."
Receiving the bowl, Lin Yu remained highly vigilant—as did the other players.
Since Ka hadn't specified a time limit this time...
Lin Yu first tentatively sipped a small amount.
Sweet and sour, with a hint of umami.
It was actually quite delicious.
Moreover, drinking it caused no physical discomfort.
Noticing Li Hua downing his entire bowl in one go, Lin Yu caught on.
The Gambler's ability had a 30-minute cooldown...
Meaning Li Hua likely used his power to confirm the soup's safety?
Realizing this possibility, Lin Yu also drank his soup without hesitation.
After finishing, Lin Yu suddenly noticed...
Both the limb pain and overwhelming stomach fullness had miraculously vanished.
"So... this is a reward stage?"
Lin Yu pondered.
Seeing Lin Yu and Li Hua's actions, the others followed suit.
Expressions of astonishment appeared on every face.
Everyone realized this soup course contained no "test"—it was pure reward.
Yet knowing this, no one let their guard down.
Any gamer knew such full-recovery "rewards" only appeared in two scenarios:
After defeating the final boss...
Or right before facing it!
Considering the upcoming banquet segments were "side dish" and "main course"...
They were likely about to encounter their toughest challenge yet!
Once everyone finished their soup, the octopus Ka spoke again.
"Honored guests, having enjoyed the raspberry clam chowder, we now proceed to the banquet's climax—"
"Next you'll taste my signature dishes and newest menu creations!"
"The side dish is named [The Frontier's Gift to Pioneers at World's End]!"
"The main course shall be... [A Victor's Blood Runs Ever Sweet]!"
With this, a lever rose from Ka's pool.
"Come—distinguished guests!"
"Both my 'side dish' and 'main course' require you to personally select ingredients... Let's begin with choosing your 'side dish' components!"
Pulling the lever, Ka triggered whirring pulley sounds overhead.
"CLANG—"
The table and all chairs began ascending, accelerating rapidly.
At first like an old factory freight elevator...
Then speeding up to high-rise office elevator velocity...
Until the intense weightlessness made Lin Yu mutter:
"This is practically a space elevator now?"
Howling winds rushed past as dark thunderclouds loomed overhead.
"WHOOSH—"
The dining setup soon plunged into the clouds, where damp mist reduced visibility and made breathing difficult.
Only then did the ascent gradually stop.
Within these cold, humid clouds, Lin Yu glimpsed faint "shadows"—
Unidentified creatures swimming through the clouds like fish.
Ka spun its spatula:
"Guests... players, you have three attempts to choose side dish ingredients."
"Select creatures from this 'sky sea' as your next 'meal'."
"Some are unsuitable as ingredients... others grant wondrous effects when consumed..."
"Choose carefully."
"However, as a hint—I'll provide a confirmed 'edible' list."
"Creatures on this list are absolutely 'safe' and 'harmless', though without special benefits."
"Anyway, ANYWAY!"
Ka's voice suddenly rose as its spatula struck the pot.
"CLANG—"
A new rope descended before each person.
"You must retrieve your side dish ingredients within thirty minutes!"
"Grab the rope—it will move according to your will, granting free aerial mobility."

chapters.title: Chapter 144: The Rope-Tying Method, Alone with Robin
chapters.content:
As the rope descended, Lin Yu saw a menu fly into his hand.
On it were crudely drawn cartoon sketches of four different creatures...
Looking at the drawings and descriptions on the menu, Lin Yu couldn't help but comment.
"This is insane... Is this how you introduce ingredients?"
All four creatures were drawn in an extremely cute style.
Their names sounded like characters from some children's cartoon.
As for the written descriptions, they read more like preschool textbooks.
"Hello everyone! I'm Cute Star! Though I look like a starfish, don't get me wrong—I'm much tastier and bigger! But catching me isn't easy—I'm quite the fast swimmer!"
"I'm Bubble Snail, who likes floating around leisurely in my bubble—with both my bubble and shell for protection, catching me won't be simple!"
"My name's Saucer Shrimp. Though I'm not fast and lack a hard shell, we always move in groups—one shrimp in trouble means a hundred come to help! To catch me, your net better be strong enough!""Hi, I'm Transparent Fish... You can't see me, you can't see me, you can't see me..."
Lin Yu frowned as he finished reading all the creature descriptions.
Was this supposed to evoke childhood nostalgia and sympathy to spare these creatures?
"Forget it, these are probably four easier targets to handle."
"The menu did point out what to watch for with each... One's fast, one has protection, one moves in groups... and one's hard to spot."
"Anyway... let's focus on these four first!"
Lin Yu folded the menu and put it away, then looked at the rope hanging before him.
Each person had one in front of them, seemingly identical to the ropes suspending their chairs.
Across the table, Fish had also finished reading the "menu's" ingredient descriptions, wearing an equally displeased and disgusted expression.
"What absolute nonsense."
Fish commented before grabbing the rope before her.
She stood from her chair, looped it around her left wrist and tied a sailor's knot, then...
Fish seemed to successfully connect with the rope, taking a step back...
"Whoosh—!"
Her figure vanished from the seat, disappearing into the endless dark clouds.
Watching Fish's actions, Li Hua and Phantom sighed simultaneously.
"As expected of a Marauder..."
"Beijing colleagues warned us—famous for having no brains."
These two Haicheng representatives—one orderly, one chaotic—simultaneously tied their ropes around their waists with tight knots.
Clearly, compared to Fish's wrist method, theirs offered better stability without restricting a hand.
However, Mosin-Nagant and Radish, being older, demonstrated more professional approaches.
Mosin-Nagant threaded the rope under his arms twice, weaving it through various points to create a harness that secured his body.The source of this content ɪs ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Old man Radish lifted his shirt to wrap the rope around his torso several times, tying it tight before pouring what looked like glue over it—soon the rope fused firmly with his skin.
The four departed one after another.
Soon only Robin and Lin Yu remained in the venue.
Lin Yu sat gripping the rope, turning to look at Robin.
Robin met his gaze.
An inexplicable sense of danger surfaced in Lin Yu's mind.
Looking at the Painter before him, he confirmed once more:
This girl was powerful, dangerous...
Absolutely on par with the Fluoxetine he was currently impersonating.
Moreover, she seemed genuinely interested in and knowledgeable about Fluoxetine.
Which was precisely why Lin Yu hadn't left yet.
Because after Ka finished speaking, he'd realized...
This segment might be one of his few chances to be alone with Robin within the dungeon.
Though he might be exposed...
No risk, no reward!
Lin Yu's initial goal was never flawless impersonation—he just wanted more information about Fluoxetine!
He wouldn't let caution make him miss this golden opportunity to gather intel about Fluoxetine and the Psychological Society.
Besides...
Lin Yu had full confidence in his acting skills.
Even alone with Robin who likely knew Fluoxetine well and was extremely perceptive.
A Painter's abilities made them even harder to deceive than a Detective among Information Types.
Her earlier use of "sketches" to create objects and shapes belonged to advanced Painter abilities.
The basic Painter ability was Information Type.
"Draw an item with over 70% similarity to learn its basic information. 24-hour cooldown."
This was widely considered the strongest intelligence-gathering profession... Hence even if rare, major organizations would hire at least one Painter.
Whenever rival organizations obtained powerful new items, they'd immediately send someone to secretly photograph it for their Painter to sketch.
Moreover, a Painter's ability wasn't limited to game items—they could analyze non-item objects too.
Thus if Robin had interacted enough with Fluoxetine, she likely knew most of his item usages.
Yet...
Lin Yu remained completely confident about not being exposed.
In fact, precisely because of Robin's Painter abilities, his confidence grew stronger!
Seeing "Fluoxetine" watching her with interest, Robin couldn't resist speaking first.
"About that Beretta earlier..."
"Where'd you get that prank prop?"
Lin Yu smiled.
Just as predicted—starting with the items.
Then... there were absolutely no issues.
Because Robin had already provided the answer herself.
"Scared you, didn't I?" Lin Yu produced the Counterfeit Beretta M9 again, twirling it, "Pity it didn't fully shock you."
"Someone as strong and promising as you shouldn't die so early in such an interesting dungeon... So I just wanted to scare you a bit."
"I couldn't bear to kill you!"
Lin Yu said with a radiant smile.
"But thanks... recognizing it as a fake means you remember my items perfectly."
"Of course, considering Gunflower is practically your signature move," Robin rubbed her temples, "How could I forget nearly dying to that..."
"So stop lying, bastard—if you really couldn't bear to kill me, you wouldn't have shot me last time."
"That was then, this is now," Lin Yu raised a finger, "I told you—this dungeon's fascinating! It's truly watched over by deities!"
His tone was pious and certain.
Robin studied Lin Yu, sighing after a long silence.
"Same as always, completely unchanged."
"So you deliberately adjusted your dungeon schedule, specifically choosing Tuesday to attend this banquet?"

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Genius Newcomer with Potential Assessment S+
chapters.content:
Regarding what Zhi Geng said...
Lin Yu had no idea what was going on!
How to enter the dungeon in advance in the 'Game of Death'? Lin Yu didn't know what to do.
Although he can judge based on Zhi Geng's words, "knowing the content of the dungeon in advance and choosing the time to enter the dungeon" should be feasible among high-end players.
Li Nian had also come to the same dungeon with him before.
but......
Lin Yu didn't know anything about how to operate it specifically.
He only knows that there are props that allow players to form teams, but what kind of props are used
to achieve this kind of locking a certain dungeon in advance and entering the same dungeon without the consent of others...
Lin Yu didn't know.
Therefore, if this question is answered normally, it is very likely that the secret will be revealed.
but......
Lin Yu was very lucky.
"It's not so much that I did it on purpose, but rather... it's fate."
"Destiny brought me here and gave me this game where I can face the gods."
Fortunately, the character of 'Fluoxetine' doesn't have to talk well.
really......
After Lin Yu spoke like this, Zhi Geng sighed silently.
Although helpless, there was no doubt.
"Alright alright."
She muttered quietly, then waved her hands as if resigned to her fate.
"It's really impossible to ask you something..."
"What exactly are you planning? I'd better investigate on my own."
Speaking of this, Zhi Geng was thoughtful.
"Although rationally I feel there is no connection, but I don't know why..."
Zhi Geng looked at Lin Yu, his eyes full of doubts.
"I always feel that your appearance here is related to your previous trip to Jiangcheng."
I heard the word "Jiangcheng" appearing in Zhigeng's words.
Lin Yu's heart almost skipped a beat.
He wanted to deduce more about fluoxetine through his words and reactions.
But I didn't expect...
The other party actually mentioned what Lin Yu wanted to know most.
No......
It's a bit arbitrary to say this now.
Although 'Fluoxetine' appeared in Jiangcheng, it did kill him.
But what Zhi Geng said was not necessarily the fact that fluoxetine killed him.
SO......
Lin Yu tilted his head calmly and spoke with interest.
"Oh, you are surprisingly sharp..."
"But do you really know what I did in Jiangcheng?"
Lin Yu said casually.
Zhi Geng sighed: "How much do you distrust my ability? Although others may not know it, I already figured out the situation almost clearly before I went to Jiangcheng."
"Of course, there's nothing wrong with you wanting to hide it..."
"After all, among so many potential players evaluated so far, he is the second guy with 'S+' potential - even most people in your organization only think he is A- or A."
Zhi Geng said, Lin Yu's heart beat wildly when he heard this.
The 'Psychological Association' has [tools] that can evaluate people's potential and never make mistakes.
Based on the evaluation of that [prop], the top management of the 'Psychological Society' will classify people's potential into seven levels from S to F.
The higher the level and the greater the potential, the further you can go in the 'Game of Death'.
Even not only players who have joined the game, but also players who have not yet become a death game, can also get their own rating.
The results of this evaluation are semi-public in most cases - the lunatics from the 'Psychological Society' will even take the initiative to send their recently evaluated player potential qualifications to other organizations.
And because of this behavior, Lin Yu knew their evaluation standards very well.
Those who get a B rating can almost all be 'upgraded' around the eighth dungeon, and nearly a quarter of those who get a B+ rating can succeed in one go.
Most of the experts who support the scene level of various organizations have received evaluations of B or above.
As for A...
Among the people I have come into contact with, 'tycoon' and 'A Nian' are at this level.
Even the other players at the dinner table are at this level.
Lin Yu couldn't help but guess after knowing the evaluation criteria of the 'Psychological Association'.
I may have been assigned to the evaluation standard of A for some unknown reason.
but......
Zhigeng's words made Lin Yu aware of a possibility.
"Am I S+?"
This possibility even made Lin Yu feel a little creepy.
He maintained his composure and spoke with a smile.
"This is really groundless conjecture, and I won't admit it."
"S+ or something...how could an evaluation of this level appear so easily?"
Zhi Geng sighed.
"It seems you still think I'm deceiving you."
"I have evidence...'Jiangcheng University of Communication', is this enough?"
"You act so casually, do you still want to hide it from me, a 'painter' who has already reached the 'third
level'?"
Zhi Geng's words were almost the final word.
Based on these words, Lin Yu completely confirmed...ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"It's really me."
With quite complicated emotions, Lin Yu looked at Zhi Geng.
"Correct answer - then, are you going to try to snatch him away?"
Lin Yu said with a smile.
"I don't have that plan, it's just...since it's S-class or S+, it always makes me suspicious."
"Has he been noticed by the gods... If so, who is the god who favors and watches him? Could it be the
'God of Joy'?"
Zhi Geng was thinking.
Lin Yu laughed.
"Well, I don't think so."
It turns out that it is inevitable for S-class to be targeted by gods.
Moreover, I know the answer to this more entangled question...
Lin Yu also knew it very well.
Although it has disappeared due to disguise, Lin Yu can still detect it as long as he concentrates a little.
The simple crow mark on his wrist.
"You seem to know something?"
Zhigeng looked at Lin Yu and said curiously.
"Of course - but I won't tell you."
Lin Yu said, grabbing the hanging rope with one hand.
"Since you are so good at investigating these, then continue to investigate on your own - dear third-
level painter!"
After saying that.
Lin Yu stood up from the chair and gently waved goodbye to Zhi Geng.
He just held the rope directly without any protection, without any entanglement or knotting, and disappeared into the dim and stacked clouds under Zhi Geng's surprised eyes.
Zhi Geng looked at all this and was stunned.
"It's crazy."
She muttered, then took out the sketch paper and drew a rather sturdy-looking, metallic hanging
basket.
I took out the hanging basket from the paper and put it on the table. I tied it with a rope several times and pulled it hard to test the load-bearing capacity. Then I got in.
Then she held a piece of rope hanging from the hanging basket above her head and began to move
extremely slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: The Perfect Solution
chapters.content:
After Lin Yu pulled himself away from the dining table using the rope, he immediately regretted his decision as the strong winds between the clouds battered against his body.
All for this Fluoxetine performance...
He'd definitely gone overboard this time!
Now gripping the rope for dear life without any "audience" to perform for, Lin Yu sobered up from his act slightly, feeling nothing but adrenaline coursing through his veins.
"Damn it, I could fall any second now!" Lin Yu thought nervously.
Visibility was extremely low in all directions, with the damp mist and rolling thunder only heightening his unease.
Some clouds clustered together like solid hills, while other areas condensed into thick water vapor. Certain ominous spots even swirled with dangerous vortices.
Further away, continuous flashes of lightning illuminated the distance.
But the terrifying environment and precarious feeling weren't Lin Yu's only concerns.
The real problem...
Were the "monsters" surrounding him.
Although Ka's ingredient list had described the four targets as "Cute Star", "Bubble Snail", "Saucer Shrimp" and "Transparent Fish" - all seemingly harmless creatures - the actual "organisms" Lin Yu encountered within the cloud layer were anything but cute.
A hideous, car-sized deep-sea anglerfish with a sickly green lantern darted past just dozens of meters away - moving at incredible speed because it was fleeing for its life.
Chasing it was a bus-sized squid.
Even further away, a dense swarm of crimson scallops was attacking a massive manta ray - within seconds, the ray (no smaller than the squid) had been reduced to bare bones.
This "aerial sea" was far more dangerous than imagined!
No wonder Ka's list only included four "safe" ingredients.
Most creatures here were violent and deadly.
At least the four listed creatures appeared non-aggressive.
"Better avoid these dangerous ones and search carefully..." Lin Yu thought, gripping the rope tightly as he moved cautiously through the cloud sea.
His free hand pulled out the [Guaranteed-Hit Revolver].
This marked the second time Lin Yu had lost faith in this weapon.
Most sea creatures here were so massive that he doubted a single bullet would do much.
The [BBE-300] obtained from Heavenly Artisan might actually deal effective damage.
But using a self-destructing robot mid-air seemed unwise - during testing, its wheeled form could move incredibly fast, even scaling vertical walls.
But it couldn't fly!
Here, it might function as a grenade - perhaps useful against exceptionally large monsters.
Still, none of these options felt reliable enough.
Lin Yu sighed.
"Besides, while killing one of the four listed creatures would suffice, would 'Fluoxetine' really settle for ordinary ingredients after seeing all these exotic creatures?"
Probably not!
Though even if he did, no one would question it...
After all, this segment's greatest advantage was that no one could witness his actual "hunting" performance.
The space here was vast, and everyone had instinctively chosen different directions.
Under normal circumstances, they shouldn't encounter each other.
Otherwise, his incompetent performance might be exposed immediately.
Wait a minute...
Lin Yu suddenly realized something.
An extremely risky solution had occurred to him!
One perfectly in character for 'Fluoxetine' that would not only help him clear this dungeon segment, but also benefit his real-world situation!
Without hesitation, Lin Yu placed the revolver between his teeth and retrieved a parchment map from his coat.
[Active Map: Generates a 500-meter radius terrain map centered on current location. 72-hour cooldown.]
Instead of activating it immediately, Lin Yu maneuvered the rope back to the dining table first.
After unfolding and activating the map, he wondered:Thɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
"No idea if this thing even works in 'sky' conditions."
But the emerging ink lines didn't disappoint!
The spreading stains on the aged yellow parchment resembled an ancient treasure map.
Dense cloud formations appeared, some marked with rain, others with lightning...
Corresponding to the clearly hazardous areas Lin Yu had observed earlier.
After excluding these danger zones and considering everyone's chosen directions...
Plus the thirty-minute time limit...
Each player's actual activity area wasn't very large.
"Time to find the safest easy target first."
Clutching the revolver in his teeth while examining the map, Lin Yu urged the rope past the dining table at maximum speed.
Soon he spotted his first "easy target".
Behind a distant raincloud, the middle-aged man with a short bow fired an arrow into the tail fin of a vicious-looking meter-long flying fish.
A sharp whistle summoned a diving osprey whose talons viciously gripped the unbalanced fish.
Though struggling, the fish's movements slowed considerably under the osprey's control.
This created the perfect opportunity for Mosin-Nagant.
"Whoosh!"
Another precise arrow pierced through both eyes of the fish, which instantly went limp.
Witnessing this impressive display, Lin Yu stored the map and applauded while holding his revolver.
"Magnificent... truly professional 'hunter' work!"
Mosin-Nagant turned in shock, immediately drawing his short bow with an arrow nocked and aimed at the armed Lin Yu.
"Fluoxetine, what are you doing?"
Lin Yu smiled at the drawn bow before casually raising his revolver.
"Robbery, of course!"
"Hand over your catch, or else... we'll have to settle this with a proper 'Wild West duel'!" Lin Yu declared loudly.
This was his "perfect solution".
While the [Guaranteed-Hit Revolver] might be useless against giant fish...
It could still kill people.
Rather than fighting monsters, why not just...
Rob the other players!

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Swearing to the Gods
chapters.content:
After Lin Yu finished his "robbery" declaration.
Mosin-Nagant spoke coldly: "Fluoxetine, do you think I fear you?"
"I've killed members of your Psychological Society before—even if you're S-Class, I might not lose to you."
As he spoke, he tightened his grip on the short bow in his hands.
Pointed at by the sharp arrowhead, Lin Yu shook his head with a calm expression.
Though he didn't know who would win if Mosin-Nagant and Fluoxetine truly fought...
This fake Fluoxetine certainly couldn't compare to the long-renowned 'Hunter' Mosin-Nagant.
However...
Lin Yu's most powerful weapon from the beginning was never his gun.
It was the reputation of 'Fluoxetine'—this woman's past was Lin Yu's strongest weapon now.Of course, perhaps Mosin-Nagant before him was stronger than Fluoxetine.
But—
Lin Yu looked at Mosin-Nagant and spoke with a smile.
"Then do you have the courage to gamble with me? For this fish... gamble on which of us will survive."
"Also, let me remind you—this banquet 'prohibits fighting'."
But Mosin-Nagant was definitely not as crazy as Fluoxetine.
He was a "bounty hunter," the famous bounty hunter of the Hunters' Association.
This meant he was someone who needed money or really liked money, likely a "profit-first" type.
Perhaps Mosin-Nagant would take risks and fight dangerous people to the death.
But the more someone was like this, the more they would put a price tag on all lives—even their own.
He wouldn't take life-or-death risks without sufficient profit.
That's why Lin Yu judged him as an "easy target."
"Though we're not at the dining table now... besides gambling on which of us wins, have you prepared like me to face 'punishment'?"
"And—this is a good opportunity to evaluate you too."
Lin Yu said with a smile.
Mosin-Nagant's expression changed slightly.
Finally, he said solemnly: "Can you lower your gun?"
Even though the other still held his bow, Lin Yu relaxed and holstered his weapon upon hearing this.
"So, what's your choice?"
Mosin-Nagant blew his whistle with displeasure.
"Whoosh—"
A raptor flapped its wings toward Lin Yu, then dropped the dead flying fish corpse to him.
Lin Yu caught the dead fish steadily with one hand and laughed.
"Good, good—seems your potential is slightly higher than I imagined."
"Mosin-Nagant, though the organization's rating was already high, it seems they underestimated you."
Mosin-Nagant looked displeased.
"I thought you'd mock me for backing down and being weak!"
"Impossible," Lin Yu waved his hand. "Did you think we only like mindless hardliners?"
"Well... there's still plenty of time. Surely catching another won't be hard for a professional 'Hunter' like you!"
Lin Yu waved goodbye to Mosin-Nagant.
"See you."
Without waiting for a response, Lin Yu tugged the rope and continued moving.
Dragging the flying fish back to the dining area, he looked toward "Ka" who was boredly browsing the menu at the pool's center and called out:
"Hey chef, I'm storing ingredients temporarily—no problem right?"
After Lin Yu spoke, Ka looked at him in surprise.
"Of course no problem."
Once Ka replied, Lin Yu casually tossed the flying fish before his seat.
Then, Lin Yu pulled the rope toward another direction.
With his earlier success, Lin Yu quickly targeted another "easy mark."
Not far out, he saw a dozen playing cards dancing in the air, slowly slicing a fathead fish to death.
However, though these were also playing card [items] in appearance,
The one controlling them wasn't Li Hua.
A man in a tailcoat and top hat extended his palm, recalling the metallic-glinting cards.
Then he removed his hat and reached in, pulling out the barely-alive fathead fish that had just been before him.
He casually stuffed it into a transparent bag on his back—already containing several fish.
This person was naturally the 'Magician' of the 'Free Alliance.'
Lin Yu looked at him and spoke cheerfully:
"Quite the haul, Phantom."
Lin Yu's voice caught Phantom's attention.Thɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
He looked up alertly, wearing a friendly smile.
"Oh, respected Lady Fluoxetine... may I ask why you seek me?"
Lin Yu didn't beat around the bush.
"Robbery. Give me half the fish you've caught now, or I'll kill you."
Lin Yu stated bluntly.
Phantom's expression changed slightly before he cautiously said:
"Um, Lady Fluoxetine—this banquet seems to prohibit fighting."
"Though we're not at the table now, who knows..."
Listening to Phantom's words, Lin Yu mused internally.
The Free Alliance members really thought quickly, using this to negotiate with him.
But...
Lin Yu intended to fully commit to Fluoxetine's persona.
"Then give me the fish, and we can avoid meaningless fighting."
He said very matter-of-factly.
"I only want half, not all."
Phantom smiled wryly: "Then why don't you catch some yourself?"
"That's boring," Lin Yu said naturally. "I ask again—why haven't you given them yet? Looking down on me?"
"Not at all," Phantom quickly said. "I just have concerns."
"Concerns about my methods or character?"
Lin Yu asked.
Phantom answered seriously: "Both."
Lin Yu burst out laughing.
"Hahaha... so you fear I'll take your things then still attack you!"
"Relax, I don't think you should die by my hand in this dungeon—talented players like you, I'd rather see live!"
"Anyway, if you're still uneasy, I can swear an oath."
"To reassure you—you can even decide who I swear to."
Lin Yu spoke in an utterly ordinary tone.
But combined with his words, the more normal his tone, the more it revealed an underlying madness.
However, hearing Lin Yu's words, Phantom actually considered it.
He spoke jokingly:
"Well, no need for oaths really..."
"But if you insist—swear to the 'gods' then."
Phantom said seemingly casually.
Hearing this, Lin Yu nodded.
"Alright."
He gently placed his right hand over his chest.
"I swear to the gods—in this dungeon, I will absolutely not harm you in any way."

chapters.title: Chapter 148: The Targets of Robbery and the Etiquette of Being Robbed
chapters.content:
After Lin Yu finished reciting his oath, Phantom opened his bag and took out three strangely shaped fish tied together with a rope. He then threw them accurately toward Lin Yu, who caught them effortlessly in his arms.
"Good."
With the fish secured, Lin Yu turned to leave. The most valuable gain from this exchange with Phantom wasn't the three fish... but rather the conversation during the oath-taking.
"Swear before the gods"—though Phantom's tone had been joking, his relieved and somewhat solemn expression after Lin Yu's genuine oath suggested this vow carried real weight. Considering this game truly had deities...
"Do the gods actually witness such oaths?" Lin Yu couldn't help wondering.
Regardless, this behavior fit Fluoxetine's established character. After all, Fluoxetine had mentioned gods when trying to kill him earlier, and Robin hadn't batted an eye when he emphasized divine matters during their conversation. Apparently, Fluoxetine was exactly the type who'd frequently spout such mystical nonsense.
"The Psychological Society might call itself an academic organization, but it could very well be some extreme religious cult..." Lin Yu mused.
Carrying the fish this time, he didn't return to the dining table. Phantom had thoughtfully tied them with rope, and more importantly—time was running out. Lin Yu had been mentally counting down the thirty minutes, and making another round trip now would likely cut it too close. His robbery mission remained incomplete.
After parting with Phantom, Lin Yu quickly located his final target—the unassuming old farmer Radish from the Player Mutual Aid Association. This choice had been predetermined through simple elimination.
Lin Yu's primary robbery objective was to gather as many usable ingredients as possible, ensuring he wouldn't be unlucky enough to end up with entirely unusable loot. Moreover... he'd begun suspecting that more ingredients might be better for this challenge, given the generous time limit and how side dishes and main courses had been introduced together. The side dish ingredients might represent the bare minimum requirement, but extra supplies certainly wouldn't hurt!Therefore, within the limited time, he needed to rob the easiest targets available. In Lin Yu's analysis, Fish from the Marauders topped the "do not rob" list. While perhaps not as unhinged as Fluoxetine, this girl had a notoriously explosive temper. Every time Lin Yu provoked conflict, she responded enthusiastically—unlike Mosin-Nagant who only brandished weapons to appear intimidating. Fish genuinely relished every fight.
Additionally, she possessed a Unique Class whose abilities Lin Yu still hadn't figured out. From what he could gather, her Freelancer class, like his own Fraudster, could somehow utilize other class abilities under certain conditions... which made interacting with her even less appealing.
The remaining two—Gambler Li Hua and Painter Robin—were also best left undisturbed in Lin Yu's opinion. Li Hua's probability-reading abilities would have recovered somewhat by now, making him difficult to fool. As for Robin... their earlier one-on-one conversation had already been extensive enough. Attempting to rob her might actually expose his deception.
Thus, Lin Yu's final robbery targets became Mosin-Nagant, Phantom, and Radish. With the help of his Active Map, locating Radish proved simple enough. Soon, Lin Yu spotted the elderly farmer's figure amidst the sea of clouds.
This unassuming old man truly excelled outside combat. His earlier calm handling of the snail's toxin had already demonstrated impressive survival skills. But when Lin Yu found him, he couldn't help but marvel.
"Now this is what you call a 'bumper harvest'..."
In the distance, Radish carried a bamboo basket with two open woven bags tied at his waist while swinging a massive fishing net to catch some kind of "transparent" fish in the air. His bags and basket overflowed with various bubble-blowing sea snails, flat disc-shaped prawns, and brightly colored starfish—all four ingredient types from the menu!
This aligned with Lin Yu's expectations—Radish's steady personality and apparent talent for "finding things" made him an ideal target precisely because he'd likely have all the safe, basic ingredients. But the old man's thoroughness still surprised Lin Yu—he'd collected everything!ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
For Lin Yu, this was perfect. Clearing his throat, he called out:
"Ahem—"
"Sorry about this, Elder Radish!"
"I'm here to rob you!"
Radish turned in alarm at the declaration. "Rob me?! You... you want to rob what?"
"These 'aquatic products,' of course." Lin Yu grinned.
Though initially flustered, Radish visibly calmed upon hearing this. He exhaled deeply. "Oh, is that all? You want what I've gathered? You should've said so—it's no big deal!"
Without hesitation, Radish immediately removed his woven bags and basket. "Take them, no problem at all!" Despite Lin Yu's robbery announcement, Radish now acted as if receiving an honored guest!
Witnessing such generosity, Lin Yu pressed his lips together. This was going even smoother than anticipated... The situation felt so congenial that even if he'd harbored ill intentions, he'd have struggled to follow through. Who'd have thought robbery could feel this... pleasant?
No wonder this famously weak fighter had survived so long—it wasn't just his organization's backing. Perhaps this very personality had allowed him to build the Player Mutual Aid Association into its current size.
"I don't need everything—just half will do." Lin Yu sighed, then addressed Radish sincerely with a touch of Fluoxetine's mannerisms: "Elder Radish, you truly are a remarkable individual."
Radish mixed all ingredient types into one woven bag and handed it over. "Haha, you flatter me," he chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Main Course and Banquet Game
chapters.content:
Although Fluoxetine might lack a conscience, Lin Yu wasn't Fluoxetine after all.
When Radish cheerfully handed him the woven bag, Lin Yu did feel slightly guilty.
Fortunately, Lin Yu didn't possess much conscience to begin with.
After some effort, he successfully overcame this minor moral dilemma.
He and Radish returned to the dining table one after another—slightly earlier than the final deadline, about five minutes ahead of schedule.
However, both had obtained ingredients that were "absolutely foolproof."
So there was no need to race against time.
They were also the first to return.
Sitting in their respective seats, Lin Yu piled all the looted ingredients together.
"These are what I found—anyway, see if any are usable," Lin Yu said as Ka inspected them."Oh, most are usable except this one," Ka picked out one of the three fish Phantom had provided, "This one is completely inedible."
"Its flesh is like wood."
Having said that, Ka casually tossed it aside.
Then he turned to Lin Yu.
"So...are you going to cook all these ingredients?"
"No, spare me. I only want to eat one of them," Lin Yu pointed at the fish Phantom had brought, "This one."
It wasn't too big and looked relatively appealing.
Ka nodded and gathered the remaining fish, shrimp, shellfish, and other seafood into the sink.
"Then I'll prepare a grilled fish fillet for you..."
"As for the remaining ingredients, I won't take them for free."
After speaking, Ka took out a stack of "yellow tickets" from his chef's hat.
The small tickets were barely larger than fingernails, neatly stacked like postage stamps.
"What's this?" Lin Yu instinctively asked.
"Flavor Papers...you can consider them blessings from my master."
"At any time, you can use them to request food from my master. The more papers you offer, the higher the quality of food you may receive—though what you get is random."
"Of course...you can also use them to participate in banquet games hosted by my master," Ka explained.
"Based on the value of ingredients you provided—I grant you 99 Flavor Papers!"
With that, Ka handed Lin Yu a thick stack of the papers.
Lin Yu exhaled deeply.
"As expected, gathering more ingredients was the right move."
Though he didn't yet know the full use of Flavor Papers...
These things were definitely valuable.
[Flavor Papers: Paper coupons issued by a deity presiding over banquets. Hold them in your palm while silently reciting "delicacy" or related words to receive random food. There's a small chance to obtain food with beneficial effects, but also a slight probability of receiving "extremely dangerous" food.]
After Lin Yu received the Flavor Papers, the other players gradually returned.
Mosin-Nagant carried two medium-sized fish along with some Saucer Shrimp.
Phantom's bag had returned to its pre-robbery state.
Li Hua steadily brought a bag of squirming starfish "Cute Stars" and some unidentified shellfish.
Robin caught a large number of Transparent Fish.
It seemed almost everyone had realized that gathering more ingredients might be a good choice.
Except for Fish, that is.
This guy carried only one prey—
A ferocious-looking giant shark.
Its size was roughly three times that of Fish.
"This thing looks exceptionally strong...by the way, we don't have to eat everything we caught this time, right?"
"And it is edible, yes?"
Fish, who seemed to have just gone through an intense battle, asked seriously.
"Of course it's edible, and any excess can be exchanged for Flavor Papers with me," Ka replied cheerfully.
The same process that happened with Lin Yu repeated for everyone.
After removing inedible "ingredients," each person selected what they would eat, with the remainder converted into Flavor Papers.
Lin Yu also secretly noted everyone's Flavor Paper counts:
Radish: 32
Li Hua: 25
Mosin-Nagant: 37
Robin: 39
Phantom: 30
Fish came second only to Lin Yu, with 81.
Excluding Fish and Lin Yu, no one else surpassed Robin's count.
Their amounts didn't even reach half of what the top two held.
Especially Li Hua, who had the least.
While Mosin-Nagant, Phantom, and Radish falling short of Robin could be attributed to Lin Yu's robbery—
Why was Li Hua, the Gambler, at the very bottom?
Not even breaking the 30 mark!
This made Lin Yu wonder:
"Is this 'Gambler' just terribly unlucky, or is he genuinely bad at search-and-collect missions involving animals?"
Lin Yu couldn't be sure.
Regardless, Ka served everyone their customized, completely different [Side Dishes].
Lin Yu received grilled fish fillet.
Before Li Hua was baked starfish.
Radish got a seafood medley.
Mosin-Nagant was served steamed butterflied shrimp.
Robin's dish was sliced raw fish salad.
Phantom had pan-fried fish belly.
Fish enjoyed shark fin soup.
Since everyone already knew about the [Main Course], though each side dish was delicious, no one was in the mood to savor them slowly.
Only after finishing did they belatedly realize...
"I feel unprecedentedly energetic—my mind is exceptionally clear," Radish remarked in surprise.
Hearing this, the others also noticed the effect.
Lin Yu too felt his mental state was excellent—like the peak freshness of early morning.
Ka smiled and explained,
"Naturally, everyone. Every seafood here has the effect of 'restoring energy and sharpening the mind'...though the intensity varies by species."
"Through my cooking, their effects are maximized."
Ka then raised a tentacle toward the sky.
"After all, for the upcoming [Main Course] segment, as head chef and banquet host...I expect everyone to be fully alert!"
With that, the tables and chairs trembled again, slowly rising upward!
This time, the ascent wasn't accelerated—just a steady, leisurely pace through the cloud sea teeming with countless marvelous and delicious creatures.
Finally...
They breached the cloud layer, and everything suddenly became clear and bright!
The thick clouds now seemed to form a floor beneath their feet, surrounded by pristine, boundless blue skies.
Even the howling winds had ceased.
Ka gave a slight bow.
"Honored guests, we shall now partake in the [Main Course]."
"However, to taste the [Main Course], you must first participate in and win a banquet game."
"The winner gets to enjoy tonight's main dish."
"As for the losers...the penalty is severing two ropes."

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Placing Bets
chapters.content:
With the wind gone and the tables no longer shaking, and the sea of clouds blocking their view of the ground below, the only reminder that they were still high in the air was the faint sensation of falling...
It almost felt like they were sitting at a normal dining table.
After all, this divine banquet seemed to have some sort of blessing that protected them from the high altitude's low temperatures and thin air.
But...
No one believed that anyone would survive if all the ropes snapped.
So when they heard the punishment of "two ropes breaking," everyone became extremely alert.
Especially when combined with Ka's earlier words, it wasn't hard for them to reach a conclusion...
The [Main Course] seemed to involve competition between players again.
After all, the dish was literally called [A Victor's Blood Runs Ever Sweet]!
Just like how the side dish was named [The Frontier's Gift to Pioneers at World's End]...And then they had to actually hunt and gather ingredients themselves.
These two cryptic "dish names" undoubtedly contained some kind of metaphor.
Thus, the looks they gave each other became scrutinizing and hostile once more.
Lin Yu also wore an amused expression as he scanned everyone's faces.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
However, he was secretly praying inside.
"Please don't let it be direct confrontation!"
First, he would definitely be exposed.
Second, judging from the attitude of those who had been robbed earlier, these people might even team up to target Fluoxetine first!
But fortunately...
That didn't end up happening.
Ka proceeded to announce the rules.
"Everyone, the banquet game to determine who gets to taste the [Main Course] is very simple... no need for any of you to lift a finger."
As soon as it finished speaking, a four-sided screen descended from above the table, suspended by ropes.
It resembled the screens used in 360-degree stadiums or performance stages, allowing people from all directions to see its contents.
On the screen was what appeared to be an arena-like fighting ring.
Solemn gray-white stone bricks formed neat rows, surrounded by dark red chains and iron pillars serving as railings.
Beyond the ring was another circle of high walls and spectator stands in the same gray-white tones.
Though currently, the stands were completely empty.
Surprisingly, it was Radish who quietly recognized the arena's origin.
"It's the 'Land of Certain Death.'"
Ka seemed equally surprised and burst into laughter.
"Correct! This is indeed the 'Land of Certain Death' belonging to the God of Fairness and Judgment. For this banquet's entertainment, my master specially borrowed it from the God of Judgment..."
As it spoke, a tall figure appeared on the screen, standing on the gray-white stone arena.
It was a massive snow-white werewolf.
With sharp interlocking fangs and claws, its muscular body was wrapped in black chains that extended all the way to the wall behind the arena.
"Grrrr..."
The werewolf's low growls emanated from the screen's speakers.
"White Wolf, White Drace, direct descendant of the Werewolf Three Ancestors' royal bloodline," Ka calmly introduced. "From 'Night Valley,' imprisoned in the 'Eternal Cage' for the sacrilegious crimes of kin-devouring and soul-stitching to obtain forbidden power."
It stood at one corner of the arena.
Then, a second figure appeared.
This one looked equally formidable—dark red skin with a metallic sheen, powerful muscles, standing half a head taller than the white wolf, with four arms and protruding fangs, resembling some kind of demonic fiend.
It too was bound by thick iron chains.
"Asura, Pitiān, from the 'Blood Kingdom.' The entire Asura race committed acts of sacrilege against the gods, hence their imprisonment in the 'Eternal Cage.'"
Ka introduced again.
Then...
A final figure materialized.
A tall, slender black shadow with elongated limbs stood there, its entire body pitch black except for the faint outlines of facial features.
Instead of chains, it wore a silver collar.
"This one... is an artificially created lifeform. Its creator called it a 'Shadow-Type Pseudohuman,' a forbidden alchemical creation. After escaping its creator's control, it was deemed too dangerous due to its lack of autonomous consciousness and imprisoned in the 'Eternal Cage.'"
After finishing the introductions, Ka paused.
"What you all need to do is simple..."
"These three will participate in a life-or-death match in the 'Land of Certain Death,' with the victor being freed from the 'Eternal Cage.'"
"You just need to choose who you think will win—"
"In other words, this is a 'betting game'!"
Ka then produced paper and pen from its body.
"Each contestant can only be chosen by up to three people—and the selection order will start with whoever obtained the fewest Flavor Papers in the previous round."
"Honored guest, please make your choice!"
Ka's free tentacles all pointed at Li Hua.
Li Hua studied the screen carefully.
Without a doubt, he activated his [Gambler] ability.
However, after looking at the screen's display, he frowned.
After a long deliberation, he finally spoke: "Then I choose... Pitiān."
"Very well—"
Ka quickly scribbled something down, and then...
After it finished writing, the crooked characters for "Pitiān" floated up from the paper and hovered in front of Li Hua.
"Next—"
Ka pointed at Phantom.
Phantom looked at Li Hua sincerely: "Bro, for the sake of our years-long friendship, can you give me a hint?"
"Did you use your [Gambler] ability just now? What's Pitiān's win probability?"
Hearing Phantom's question, the others also pricked up their ears.
After all, in this kind of "betting" game...
The [Gambler] ability was undoubtedly the most suitable!
Being able to see probabilities would greatly increase their chances of winning.
Li Hua looked at Phantom, adjusted his glasses, and smiled.
"Heh, I'm not telling you."
"What 'years-long friendship'? [Magician]... we haven't even known each other for a year, have we?"
Li Hua's current smile was the creepy kind that didn't reach his eyes.
Despite this treatment, Phantom remained warmly smiling.
"Come on, Brother Hua, no need to be so distant. Though it's only been over half a year, we've interacted plenty during these eight months and twenty-five days."
"Yeah, because I've been constantly hunting you down, you [Free Alliance] bastard," Li Hua interrupted with an icy smile. "Even if I don't tell you the exact probability, you could still pick the same as me."
"Want to test whether I'd deliberately choose the least likely option just to screw you over?"

chapters.title: Chapter 151: Delicacies Falling From the Sky
chapters.content:
After Li Hua's threat, Phantom indeed stopped further conversation.
He pondered for a moment before re-examining the three candidates on the screen.
Then, Phantom made his decision.
"I'll choose that werewolf... White Drace."
It was unclear whether he genuinely believed the werewolf had better odds or simply distrusted Li Hua too much.
After Phantom made his choice,
the inky characters of White Drace's name floated before him.
Next was Radish's turn.
Radish didn't hesitate much, directly selecting the same option as Li Hua.
"I'll also choose Pitian."Then came Mosin-Nagant.
He made the same choice as Radish.
With three people already having chosen Pitian, Ka issued a reminder:
"Pitian can no longer be selected from now on."
After Ka's announcement,
it was Robin's turn.
Robin thought briefly before speaking: "Um... I'll choose the 'Shadow-Type Pseudohuman'."
As she spoke, the four characters of Shadow-Type Pseudohuman floated before her.
Next was Fish.
After some consideration, Fish ultimately chose the same faction as Phantom.
"Then I'll pick the werewolf... well, his fur color reminds me of my schnauzer at home."
"What a random reason," Phantom couldn't help commenting.
"None of your business!" Fish retorted fiercely.
Finally, it was Lin Yu's turn.
Resting his chin on one hand, Lin Yu contemplated.
"Hmm..."
Judging purely by the three contestants, it was hard to determine who was stronger.
So he could only follow his intuition.
After some thought,
Lin Yu wondered if the reverse order of Flavor Paper quantities meant anything...
He felt like he was vaguely grasping something.
Perhaps teaming up with Fish and Phantom would be the best choice?
No...
That might not necessarily be true.
After deliberating, Lin Yu finally decided:
"I'll choose the 'Shadow-Type Pseudohuman'!"
At this moment, he could only gamble.
After all... losing would only mean severing two ropes.
With everyone's choices complete,
each person had the name of their supported contestant floating before them.
The octopus Ka put away his pen and paper, adopting a praying posture.
"Then..."
"The banquet game will begin shortly, please enjoy—"
"This game is also my master's favorite type."
As Ka finished speaking, the screen's imagery began changing.
On the arena, three simple iron tables materialized at the center.
Then railings descended from the sky, dividing the arena into three wedge-shaped sectors.
Each sector contained exactly one table.
A thunderous voice boomed from above:
"Blasphemers who have committed unforgivable sins, this is your chance!"
"Defeat your opponents... or return to the Eternal Cage!"
Though the three on the arena clearly weren't of the same species—possibly not even the same artistic style—
they all perfectly understood the words from above.
The previously despondent Pitian and White Drace both perked up, fiery determination blazing in their eyes.
Even the seemingly unintelligent Shadow-Type Pseudohuman slightly raised its head, as if gaining fighting spirit.
However...
At the dining table outside the screen, Li Hua frowned slightly.
"Why divide the arena with railings?"
Those barriers completely prevented communication between contestants.
But the next announcement resolved Li Hua's and the other players' confusion:
"The duel between you three is being watched by spectators."
"These spectators have placed bets on different individuals..."
"So during the competition, they may offer you 'assistance'—by providing [items]!"
As the voice spoke, Ka added:
"Hmm... you can deliver items to corresponding sectors by touching them to the floating names—any items will do."
"Simply make contact between the item and the name to transport it to the arena."
"Except for consumed items, all others will be returned after the duel concludes."
"They'll understand each item's usage upon receiving them."
"Of course, whether they can use them... is another matter."
"And—each person has at most three support opportunities!"
After Ka's explanation, Lin Yu nodded.
"So it's an item support battle after all..."
Hearing these rules, the other six players also showed thoughtful expressions.
Especially Li Hua.
"So that's why my abilities weren't restricted—relying solely on contestants' probability would be too uncertain," the Gambler muttered.
Everyone realized this wasn't purely a betting game relying on luck.
Perhaps the three "contestants" on the arena truly differed in strength.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
But...
The real competition lay in the supporters' "resources"!
Who could provide more items to support their contestant,
and what items to deploy at what timing—
these factors could determine the battle's outcome!
Aside from Lin Yu, every expert player present had cleared dozens of dungeons and belonged to major organizations.
Thus they possessed numerous usable items.
Each person already began planning which items to deploy.
"With railings separating them, maybe we should first provide ranged attack items... or perhaps the barriers will disappear when fighting starts?"
"Need to deploy our strongest items immediately..."
"Maybe recovery items first to ensure survival..."
Everyone's minds raced rapidly.
Even Mosin-Nagant and Fish had already taken out their weapons, seemingly preparing to toss them in once the match began!
Amid this atmosphere, Lin Yu suddenly felt something amiss.
While everyone pondered "strategies,"
a growing sense of wrongness troubled Lin Yu.
"No... something's wrong."
"Feels like we're overlooking something crucial!"
This competition definitely wasn't what everyone imagined.
Just then...
Ka spoke again:
"Alright, everyone—"
"The match over there has begun!"
Above the arena on screen appeared numerous dark, indistinct objects.
Then these objects began falling like dense raindrops into the three sectors,
continuously bombarding the three contestants and tables within each area.
*Plop plop plop!*
The three contestants all possessed considerable physical resilience—none were injured or knocked down—
but all became somewhat disheveled.
The falling objects inevitably left them somewhat dirty.
When Lin Yu saw what was falling,
he finally understood the source of his unease.
They had all completely misunderstood the competition format and "content of the duel."
"Holy crap, delicacies are falling from the sky..." Fish couldn't help exclaiming.
Descending from above were various meats, breads, skewers, vegetables, noodles...
All aromatic, delicious foods!
As Ka and what was likely the deity's voice from the screen announced together:
"Everyone, welcome to witness the duel—"
"The Gluttony Championship!"
"Rules are simple: the first contestant to finish all food in their sector wins!"

chapters.title: Chapter 152: The Situation Unravels, A Chance to Reinforce
chapters.content:
A huge pile of delicacies fell onto the ground, quickly stacking up like a small mountain.
Then...
The rain of delicacies stopped.
Within each person's area, countless amounts of food were distributed—much larger than the people standing on the field.
The three players who already understood the rules were stunned for just a moment before they began to eat furiously.
The white werewolf, White Drace, was the first to react. He shouted loudly and pounced onto the ground, then began shoving the meat into his mouth at lightning speed.
He didn’t even need to chew much;
he could swallow the meat directly.
“Glug!”
Next to White Drace, the nearest small food mountain quickly developed a gap and then collapsed.
But...Even though White was very fast, his speed was still slightly inferior to Pitian beside him!
This muscular Rakshasa demon with four arms grabbed food with all four hands, then regardless of what was in his hands, he squeezed and compressed it into a very compact little ball before popping it into his mouth like a pill. With a swallow, the food went straight into his stomach.
Radish felt quite pleased watching this.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
“He really can eat. He looks like the best eater here.”
Mosin-Nagant also nodded.
Following Li Hua’s lead was definitely the right call!
At this moment, the slowest one on the field was the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman.
This guy hadn’t even started eating yet.
It just raised its long arms and gathered the several small piles of food around it, stacking them again into an even bigger little mountain, completely without making any move to eat.
Lin Yu watched this with some concern.
This thing... could it be that it doesn’t have the ability to eat?
After all, it seemed to be an artificial lifeform.
However, he still kept his outward composure, pretending to be interested as he looked toward Robin.
“I say... why did you choose this guy?”
Lin Yu rested his chin on one hand and started a conversation with Robin.
Robin pursed her lips. “Didn’t you pick it too?”
“Yeah, so I want to hear your reason.”
Lin Yu smiled lightly.
Robin looked at Lin Yu suspiciously. “You didn’t just pick it because you saw me pick it, did you?”
“That’s hard to say.”
Lin Yu answered ambiguously.
Robin thought for a moment, then said, “Because although I’ve never seen a werewolf with such strong bloodline or a living Rakshasa before, I really have seen this ‘Shadow-Type Pseudohuman’...
“Not long after I joined this game, I encountered it in the ‘Wicked City’ dungeon.”
“Or one of its kind.”
“At that time, this thing had a scarier name... Soul-Devouring Horror Shadow.”
Robin paused, as if still haunted by the memory. “I don’t think anything can kill it, not even the Rakshasa or the white werewolf.”
She fiddled with the hem of her clothes.
It sounded like an extremely bad memory, a real psychological shadow.
Lin Yu understood immediately.
“I see... but it’s very strong in combat, how about eating?”
Hearing Lin Yu’s question, Robin sized up Pitian and White Drace’s eating speed.
“Hmm, if these two guys can only eat at this level...”
“They will lose.”
Robin’s tone was very certain.
This young girl was extremely powerful, but Lin Yu knew she was not a domineering type.
So when she spoke so decisively, she must have full confidence.
“So certain, why?”
Lin Yu asked, and Robin nodded.
“The reason is because I have seen its way of ‘attacking’ or rather ‘killing’...”
After Robin finished speaking...
Suddenly, that tall, slender black figure stopped moving the food piles.
Instead, the roughly shaped mouth on its head, as if just a slight indentation, suddenly cracked open.
Its head deformed weirdly, the mouth growing larger and stretching in an unnatural way...
Then, that funnel-shaped mouth flipped downward toward the piled food.
In the next instant, its mouth snapped shut quickly.
Everyone felt the screen flash, and it had already returned to its normal appearance.
The food on the ground had completely disappeared.
This once-called “Soul-Devouring Horror Shadow” Shadow-Type Pseudohuman...
Had eaten one-third of the food in its area with just one bite.
Although the other two also ate fast, and they stuffed a pile of delicacies while the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman was methodically piling food, they seemed to have eaten at least one-tenth of the total amount.
But the difference in progress and speed... was undeniably huge.
Not only that, seeing such a visually shocking scene, the players who voted for White Drace and Pitian also changed their expressions drastically.
Without a doubt, this one bite from the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman gave them a strong sense of crisis.
This round had divided players into three camps, and only one camp was destined to win.
When such a very “unbalanced” situation appeared, everyone would instinctively want to use the “rights” they held.
That meant each person’s “three” support opportunities.
Especially since the distribution of “support rights” outside the field was already unbalanced.
The group supporting Pitian had one more person than the other two groups.
They had Radish, Li Hua, and Mosin-Nagant—three people!
Each had three “support items” chances.
So, in other words...
Pitian’s supporters had three more support opportunities than the others.
Almost everyone had realized this from just now.
So at this moment, Li Hua spoke in a low voice.
“Mr. Radish, I think we can use one support chance first.”
“Do you have any [items] that could help the situation over there?”
Facing Li Hua’s question, Radish thought for a moment and showed a troubled expression.
“I do have something, but... I’m not sure how much it will help!”
If this were a direct battle, it would be easy to handle, but this was originally a “big eater competition.”
There was no direct confrontation between the players!
Octopus Ka took this opportunity to emphasize again.
“Friendly reminder, there is a barrier personally set by the God of Judgement between the railings... so it’s very difficult to cross the railings to attack.”
Octopus Ka said with a smile.
Li Hua looked at Radish and said, “It doesn’t matter, we have more support chances anyway;
we can afford trial and error!”
Mosin-Nagant also nodded: “Let’s give it a try!”
Old Radish was persuaded and took out a bottle of potion from his bosom.
“This... is a ‘Physical Enhancement Potion’!”
“It should boost his strength, speed, and constitution... Although I don’t have any potion to increase his appetite, if these stats improve, his appetite and eating speed should also increase, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Rather Than Improving Yourself, Slander Others
chapters.content:
With both teammates' approval, Radish used this [Support] opportunity.
He inserted the potion into the name "Vitian" floating before him.
The octopus Ka lazily announced:
"Consuming one [Support] opportunity!"
The potion then entered the arena, quickly landing before Vitian.
Vitian, who had been diligently eating, noticed the suddenly appearing potion and glanced over.
In that instant, Vitian immediately understood the potion's effects.
Combined with the rules explained earlier by the voice from above, Vitian quickly realized:
This was a support item sent by his "audience."
Vitian directly grabbed the potion and downed it in one gulp!Immediately, he felt his body brimming with strength!
"Roar!"
Vitian's already rough and bulky muscles swelled even larger.
With a mighty roar, he pounced on the food at twice his previous speed, devouring everything in sight.
Seeing Vitian's enhanced performance after receiving [Support], the werewolf White Drace supported by Phantom and Fish immediately fell to last place.
Fish grew visibly anxious.
"Tch... falling behind now, little wolf pup!"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"You're a werewolf yet you can't even out-eat others?"
Fish complained irritably, turning to Phantom.
"Hey, you bastard magician from the [Free Alliance], don't you have any useful support items?"
Phantom spread his hands.
"Unfortunately, you rude little girl from the [Marauders], I don't typically carry physique-enhancing potions."
Li Hua couldn't help a disdainful chuckle.
"He really wouldn't have such potions. Just drag him into melee combat... and he surrenders immediately."
Ignoring Li Hua's mockery, Phantom waved his hand and continued:
"However... I do have these."
He produced a box of digestive tablets.
Fish facepalmed in exasperation: "While not completely irrelevant, these are utterly useless here!"
"Why would you even carry these?! When would these ever be useful?!"
Phantom shrugged helplessly: "Not my choice - random reward from previous dungeons. As you said, completely useless, so I couldn't even sell them."
Fish spat in disgust.
"Useless trash!"
Then she suddenly slapped herself hard.
"I'm the useless one here! Can't even think of what [Support Item] to use now!"
Fish fumed angrily.
This startled Mosin-Nagant beside her.
Radish quickly intervened: "No need for that, calm down."
At that moment...
"Heh."
A cold laugh cut through the tense atmosphere.
Then came a crisp, icy female voice:
"I must say... if this is all you're capable of, I'll be rather disappointed."
Everyone turned toward Fluoxetine, who was resting her chin on her hands.
Meeting their gazes, Lin Yu maintained his calm pace as he continued:
"The [Support] opportunity was designed to be fair - because the near-perfect [Support Item] is already in each of our hands."
"Think carefully - what order did we use to select our contestants?"
As Lin Yu posed the question, everyone simultaneously looked down.
At the small yellow square papers - some in pockets, some clenched in hands, some on the table - that each possessed.
The "Flavor Papers" they'd received after the [Side Dishes] segment...
Li Hua sighed.
"I did consider these might be useful later."
"But... they're technically 'food.' If the random buff proves useless, it would waste time and potentially hinder their subsequent eating."
As Li Hua spoke, Robin nodded slightly.
"These might be useless for this segment."
These elite players weren't fools - they'd guessed these "Flavor Papers" might be important "chips" for later segments!
But... using food as [Support Items] in an eating contest? Absurd!
Hearing their reasoning, Lin Yu sighed internally.
Indeed, these veterans might excel at PVP and PVE...
But they rarely dealt with deities - at least, rarely outsmarted gods.
Thus, they'd all overlooked one thing.
Overlooked how Octopus Ka had deliberately left a loophole when explaining support rules.
So...
Lin Yu turned to [Robin].
"Lend me your Flavor Papers."
Robin blinked, then produced hers.
"How many do you need?"
"Twenty for now, thanks!"
Lin Yu smiled.
Accepting the papers, he held them aloft.
"Respected God of Revelry... grant me food that's substantial and calorie-dense."
After this solemn prayer, the papers vanished.
Disintegrating into sparkling lights that floated upward!
Moments later...
From the sky descended an enormous hunk of meat - a massive roasted animal leg, dripping with succulent juices.
The whole leg landed in Lin Yu's arms, nearly his own size, incredibly heavy.
[Roasted Cyclops Mountain Boar Hind Leg: Dense, flavorful roast providing SUPER·MASSIVE satiety! Sixty times the protein of beef!]
Holding the leg with one arm, Lin Yu raised a finger, his face breaking into a charming smile.
"Let me teach you an important life philosophy about competition and cooperation."
"Rather than improving yourself, slander others!"
Standing from his chair, he declared swiftly:
"I choose to [Support] Vitian!"
Seeing Octopus Ka raise no objections...
Lin Yu shoved the entire roasted leg into the floating name "Vitian" before Li Hua!
The gigantic leg disappeared entirely into the name.
Then...
"Thud!"
The roasted leg materialized in Vitian's arena!
Lin Yu collapsed back into his chair, laughing uproariously.
"Ahahaha—so it really works!"
He said, settling back comfortably.
"Everyone, lesson learned?"
Crossing his legs elegantly, Lin Yu concluded:
"This is the correct way to use [Support] opportunities!"

chapters.title: Chapter 154: An Unprecedented Collaboration
chapters.content:
From the moment "Ka the Octopus" explained the rules about [Support], Lin Yu had keenly noticed one thing...
There were once again "misleading" hidden aspects in the rules this guy had described.
Combined with [Flavor Papers], an item that clearly should serve some purpose in this segment, Lin Yu easily reached a conclusion.
From start to finish, Ka the Octopus never said you could only "support" your own contestant.
And the victory condition was to eat all the "food"—this "food" was never defined by the rules as necessarily being what fell from above.
Putting these together, the function of Flavor Papers became obvious.
Their purpose was to increase the "total food amount" that the other two contestants needed to eat.
Of course...
Lin Yu had briefly hesitated about whether to "reveal" this point immediately.
After all, if no one else realized it and wasted all their "support" opportunities, he might be able to pull off a decisive move.But that was "Lin Yu's" way of thinking.
Right now, he was 『Fluoxetine』.
Moreover, everyone present was an experienced player—Li Hua, Phantom, Mosin-Nagant, and Robin all seemed quite "clever."
While Fish and Radish had contrasting personalities—one aggressive and one honest—that didn't mean they were slow-witted.
Lin Yu wasn't arrogant enough to think that something he figured out instantly would remain beyond these people's comprehension.
It was just that his 『Fraudster』 profession made his perspective more attuned to spotting these "loopholes."
So Lin Yu chose an extremely 『Fluoxetine』 way to handle it.
He demonstrated and explained everything to everyone.
"Deciding how to allocate the [Flavor Papers] in your hands is what we 'spectators' should really be doing,"
Lin Yu said casually.
Hearing his words, everyone's expressions changed slightly.
This new "rule" interpretation introduced many variables to the situation.
Li Hua looked grave.
"So that's how it is..."
As Lin Yu expected, he had already sensed something was off.
With this pointer, everything clicked into place.
Meanwhile, Phantom glanced at Li Hua and suddenly realized something.
"Hey, 『Gambler』... I suggest our two groups temporarily set aside our differences and cooperate."
Li Hua was momentarily taken aback by the proposal but surprisingly didn't reject it.
"Worth considering."
Fish, however, voiced dissatisfaction: "Hah? Why should we team up with these guys after everything?"
"Because of the number of [Flavor Papers],"
Phantom said quietly.
