With this reminder, the remaining people also realized the situation.
Li Hua, Radish and Mosin-Nagant's group seemingly had three people, but their combined [Flavor Papers] only totaled 94.
Not even as many as Lin Yu alone.
Fish and Phantom together had 111.
But...
Lin Yu and Robin combined had 99 plus 39... totaling 138.
Even after Lin Yu spent 20 to exchange for food and threw it into Vitian's area, they still had 118 left—the most by far.
This meant that if everyone's [Flavor Papers] excluded exchange errors and operated under ideal conditions where each could exchange for corresponding food units...
Lin Yu and Robin currently held the most food.
Moreover, Lin Yu had just demonstrated he could use 20 Flavor Papers at once to deliver food.
This rendered the extra [Support] opportunities of Li Hua, Radish and Mosin-Nagant's trio rather useless.
Because [Flavor Papers] could be exchanged in unequal amounts for the same "portion" of food.
And most crucially...
Currently, the fastest eater among the three contestants was visibly the "Shadow-Type Pseudohuman"!
After finishing that one-third portion of food, it had merely rested briefly before starting to gather more.
"Truly worthy of you... Fluoxetine,"
Robin murmured beside him.
"But what if they really join forces?"
Lin Yu looked at Robin and grinned.
"What, you want to win? Even when teamed up with me!"
"Shouldn't you be protecting those upstanding guys over there that you're close with?"
Lin Yu asked playfully, pointing toward Li Hua and Radish.
"In a dungeon... survival comes first..."
Robin said, lowering her head.
"No wonder you so obediently gave me your [Flavor Papers]," Lin Yu leaned halfway across, using his foot to drag his chair closer. "Though I don't agree with your view—to me, there are more important things in games..."
Lin Yu looked at Robin, lowering his voice further.
"But your approach and mindset... I quite admire them."
"Those who struggle desperately to survive are most beloved by the gods."
"So... since you want to win this round with me, I'll make sure you do."
Lin Yu said.
This was his genuine thought—winning would be ideal.
And the real 『Fluoxetine』 would probably act this way too.
Though Lin Yu had only met that crazy, powerful, mysterious girl once, the longer he played this 『Fluoxetine』 role in the game...
Judging by others' reactions and his repeated recollection of her demeanor, actions and speech during their brief encounter...
Lin Yu felt his responses were exactly what 『Fluoxetine』 would do.
He had completely immersed himself in the 『Fluoxetine』 persona!
"Even if those two groups—all five of them—join forces."
Lin Yu gently reached out and pinched Robin's cheek.
"I'll still make you win."
"As long as you trust me completely!"
After Lin Yu finished speaking...
Robin's face briefly showed conflict before...
This ordinary-looking girl sighed and spoke.
"I never imagined I'd cooperate with you one day..."
Robin took Lin Yu's hand from her cheek, gently moving it aside as her gaze drifted away.
"Then I'll trust you this once."
Lin Yu burst out laughing.
"Relax—you'll absolutely win this round."
Then he whispered two sentences in her ear...
Before releasing her and returning his chair to its original position.
Robin handed all her Flavor Papers to Lin Yu, then took out her drawing board and began sketching!Thɪs

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Lin Yu's Backup Plan and Absolute Violence
chapters.content:
After Lin Yu and Robin finished discussing their strategy.
The remaining two groups had also basically reached a "cooperative agreement".
After all, if they didn't take action soon, the "Shadow-Type Pseudohuman" selected by Lin Yu and Robin would achieve final victory!
It was visibly about to complete its second mouthful - at this rate, it would only need one more feeding to succeed!
But...Follow current novᴇls on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Both Pitian and White Drace over there hadn't even finished half their portions!
Especially Pitian - although he had received [Support Items] from Radish and consumed potions that greatly enhanced his physique, significantly increasing his eating speed to far surpass the white werewolf...
Still...
Both contestants' progress remained roughly similar.
Because that enormous hind leg meat "Lin Yu" had thrown down was simply too difficult to eat.This food exchanged from [Flavor Papers] was clearly on a completely different level from all other items on the field.
Pitian could compress other foods, but faced with this hind leg meat, he was completely helpless!
Moreover, every bite required strenuous chewing, and he needed long breaks after swallowing each mouthful.
Clearly...
For Pitian, the satiety provided by this food was completely different from others!
After observing Pitian's reaction, Li Hua became even more convinced.
He immediately took action.
"I choose to exchange 12 [Flavor Papers]!"
Following Lin Yu's earlier example, Li Hua placed the [Flavor Papers] in his palm and devoutly prayed to the god presiding over "banquets, wine, and revelry".
The number 12 wasn't randomly chosen.
Their group had 94 [Flavor Papers] and 8 [Support] opportunities, so the optimal strategy was to distribute them evenly across each attempt.
Hearing Li Hua's "chosen number", Lin Yu couldn't help but admire.
"Instantly grasped the optimal strategy?"
"No wonder someone who could make a name in 『Order』 and become 'Hai City Game Master' is absolutely no ordinary expert."
The reason for "even distribution" was actually simple...
On one hand, [Flavor Papers] had a hidden property mentioned by Ka the Octopus - the more [Flavor Papers] used in a single exchange, the higher the probability of obtaining food with "positive buff effects".
In other words.
The ideal number for each [Flavor Papers] use should be the "minimum possible"!
The only way to satisfy this condition was even distribution!
This was also the only way Li Hua's group could leverage their numerical advantage in [Support] opportunities.
After Li Hua completed the "prayer" ritual for using [Flavor Papers], moments later...
Delicacies descended from above just like before.
What fell was an enormous pizza base.
About the size of two middle school desks combined - and with thick crust too!
The pizza was generously topped with cheese and ample meat chunks, looking like a typical party pizza - the kind that could feed a dozen people at once!
"Thud!"
Li Hua single-handedly lifted the massive pizza and without hesitation threw it toward Lin Yu's direction.
"I choose to use [Support] opportunity, supporting the 'Shadow-Type Pseudohuman'."
Li Hua declared loudly.
This 『Gambler』, despite his scholarly appearance wearing traditional Chinese attire and glasses, possessed considerable strength.
The large, thick pizza spun through the air like a thin Indian paratha.
Since Li Hua was seated adjacent to Lin Yu, it took barely a moment...
For the pizza to reach the space before Lin Yu's name.
Just as the pizza was about to enter the area marked "Shadow-Type Pseudohuman", in that split second...
"Bang!"
A gray, hard cube materialized on the table, blocking the pizza's trajectory.
And this was just the beginning!
More and more gray geometric shapes appeared, eventually stacking into a wall-like "defensive line" on the table.
These geometric shapes formed a barrier that instantly divided the table, much like the partitions that appeared during the [Appetizer] round.
However, it only separated Lin Yu, Robin from the others!
Li Hua reacted swiftly to catch the pizza again!
Clearly, his [Support] attempt had failed!
Not only that, had he been slightly slower, this food obtained from "12" [Flavor Papers] might have fallen into the endless void below, completely wasted!
Holding the pizza, a slightly shocked Li Hua immediately looked toward Robin's direction - though now separated by a thick barrier.
Behind the geometric defense line, Robin set down her brush, beads of sweat forming on her forehead.
This was what Lin Yu had instructed Robin to do earlier - Lin Yu's prepared "backup plan".
"Everyone, everyone - while the best way to use [Support] is through [Flavor Papers], I won't let you all have it so easily!"
Lin Yu said with a laugh.
"In fact, this is the real challenge of this round."
"Each person's name is in front of themselves... so protecting your own name from becoming others' delivery channel for [Items] is equally important."
After finishing with a light chuckle, Lin Yu added.
"Although the banquet prohibits direct attacks between us, that doesn't mean... our conflict is limited to just 'strategic' competition."
Sitting behind the "wall" constructed by Robin, he even looked somewhat gratefully at "Robin".
This was also why he ultimately chose "Robin".
Instead of "Phantom" or "Fish".
Another important reason was...
He and "Robin" were seated together.
Although Lin Yu hadn't fully understood the significance at the time, he vaguely sensed that "seating arrangements" might prove useful.
After Lin Yu finished speaking.
Looking at the sturdy gray geometric wall on the table, Fish burst into laughter.
"Ahahaha... truly worthy of 『Fluoxetine』, seeing is believing indeed!"
"And 『Night Watchmen』's 『Robin』... not very famous, but quite capable - to erect such a formidable wall in such short time."
"Among all the 『Painters』 I know, you're definitely among the strongest."
She exhaled, then turned to Li Hua, Radish and Mosin-Nagant.
"Though I don't particularly like you sanctimonious gentlemen types, this time... I'll let you bask in my glory!"
After speaking, Fish drew an antique flintlock pistol from her bosom and twirled it once.
"However, strategies and defenses... they're just side dishes."
"In the face of true violence - these mean nothing!"
With that, Fish pulled the trigger.
The wooden grain on the flintlock pistol emitted dazzling light as it unleashed an ear-splitting explosion.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Counterattack and Reversal
chapters.content:
The spark from the flintlock muzzle bloomed like a grand firework, its roar more terrifying than the thunder heard earlier from the clouds. The released bullet instantly struck the high wall constructed by "Robin," producing a massive explosion.
"Boom!"
Part of the geometric structure shattered instantly, the wall breached like an ancient fortress struck by a catapult. Old Man Radish jumped in fright.
"This... is this still a gun?"
Mosin-Nagant's expression also darkened slightly. Though currently in a temporary alliance with Fish, the relationship between the Hunters' Association's "top bounty hunter" and a Marauders executive was inherently more tense than that between Marauders and Order members.
After all, every Marauders executive carried an exorbitant bounty, while every bounty hunter possessed far more items than ordinary players. Meeting Fish in this dungeon, Mosin-Nagant had harbored some thoughts about observing her combat patterns up close.
If...
If he could discern some patterns or weaknesses, that enormous bounty might not be impossible to claim!
But after witnessing Fish's shot, most of Mosin-Nagant's calculations evaporated.
"What a formidable madwoman...""No wonder she's been operating so brazenly even in Beijing!"
Just this single shot—regardless of its limitations—left Mosin-Nagant unable to conceive how he might counter it.
Only Gambler Li Hua and Magician Phantom seemed unsurprised by this attack.
"That power... she directly used [Piercing Sacred Might]," Phantom remarked calmly. "This woman truly acts without considering consequences. Isn't she afraid the blast might accidentally hit someone behind and get flagged as 'mutual attack'?"
Li Hua adjusted his glasses. "The probability is low, but... I doubt she made this decision after careful deliberation."
Ka the Octopus cleared his throat to offer his opinion.
"Ahem, while I know you were aiming at the wall—if you use such weapons again, I'll have to penalize you by cutting one of your ropes!"
"Very dangerous."
Ka's meaning was clear.
"No penalty this time, but don't let it happen again."
Losing a rope was serious—especially since four or five participants would eventually lose two ropes. With Fish already down one rope, losing all four would mean immediate elimination.
Fish holstered her gun, showing no gratitude. She glared at Ka and retorted, "Damn octopus, is this how timid those who serve the gods are? Can't even use this?"
"What, doubting my accuracy? I wouldn't hit anyone!"
Fish declared with full confidence.
Ka ignored her rebuttal, sinking back into the pool silently. Fish didn't press further either, unwilling to escalate conflicts with the game host unnecessarily.
She simply stored away the flintlock and switched to another with a lighter wooden hue.
"Whatever, [Piercing Sacred Might] is valuable anyway..."
Then she pointed at the breach she'd created.
"Hey—everyone, I've opened a path for you."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
"This level of defense shouldn't be something that Painter over there can maintain casually."
"Even if they try to repair it, I'll blast it open again."
"Now it's your turn—Phantom, catch!"
Fish folded the [Flavor Papers] into a stack and tossed them toward Phantom.
The players all snapped to attention, focusing on the breach. Fish's shot had been precise and powerful—the opening perfectly exposed both Lin Yu and Robin's displayed names simultaneously.
As Fish predicted, creating so many geometric constructs had drained Robin considerably. She lacked the energy to seal the gap immediately.
Phantom began exchanging [Flavor Papers] for food, mimicking what Li Hua and Lin Yu had done earlier.
Meanwhile...
The [Flavor Papers] held by Li Hua, Radish, and Mosin-Nagant were all concentrated in Mosin-Nagant's possession.
Firstly, as a [Hunter], Mosin-Nagant possessed superior throwing accuracy and specialized in such techniques.
Secondly, those seated beside Fish had the optimal angle to attack the breach.
The first assault would naturally come from these two.
Mosin-Nagant and Phantom exchanged their papers for food—massive grilled meat and enormous meat buns descended from above!
Phantom caught the falling bun—several times larger than his head—and held it aloft. Then he removed his top hat and retrieved an item from within.
An oversized slingshot!
"Fantastic luck! The food actually turned out to be spherical!"
Phantom exclaimed, then...
He braced the slingshot against the table, adjusted the angle, and loaded the meat bun onto it. Though the slingshot was already oversized—half a person's height—it still seemed small compared to the bun!
Yet Phantom's hands seemed magical, somehow "shrinking" the originally larger bun to fit the slingshot.
Then he braced his feet against the table, leaned back, and drew the slingshot taut—
"Whoosh!"
The bun launched straight toward the words "Shadow-Type Pseudohuman" before Robin.
As he released it, Phantom announced:
"I choose to [Support] 'Shadow-Type Pseudohuman.'"
The massive bun merged into the name, soon appearing in the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's designated area on the screen!
Then...
Mosin-Nagant's voice followed.
"I also choose to [Support] 'Shadow-Type Pseudohuman'!"
After declaring this, he tossed the grilled meat high into the air while emitting a sharp whistle.
A black panther materialized midair, snatching the meat and charging at full speed toward the breach!
Within moments, the panther leaped past the broken wall, twisting to hurl the meat toward the name before Lin Yu.
Soon...
The "grilled meat" also appeared in Lin Yu's designated area!
With two additional [Flavor Papers] converted into food, the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's total food supply had increased by roughly 30%!
In other words... it now required one additional "feeding"!
But the situation still wasn't secure enough.
So Phantom and Mosin-Nagant struck again.
New food converted from [Flavor Papers] descended once more, and the duo repeated their methods, delivering two more portions into the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's area.
The situation...
Had completely reversed!

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Game Theory Lesson
chapters.content:
After six portions of food consecutively landed in the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's designated area, the total amount it had to consume became double that of other zones!
Though lacking the energy to create more obstacles to prevent food from entering its territory, Robin didn't simply wait for death either.
Seated behind her wall, Robin had received all the Flavor Papers from Lin Yu and began her own exchanges! With Lin Yu's support, she now held 60 Flavor Papers, which she exchanged in three batches for 3 food portions!
Then...
Robin delivered these three portions into Pitian and White Drace's designated areas respectively! Her chosen targets were strategic - precisely Phantom and Mosin-Nagant who were also on the offensive.
Their teammates attempted to intervene but reacted too late. After all, Robin's methods were utterly unpredictable! She drew a "blue hole" on the table, pushed the food through, then painted two "orange holes" in midair...
The food then flew in incomprehensible parabolic trajectories directly into the names. The speed surpassed even Phantom's slingshot attacks!
Yet despite this...
The Shadow-Type Pseudohuman still had the highest quantity of Flavor Paper-exchanged food on its field!
Both Pitian and White Drace's areas only contained food worth "40 sheets" of Flavor Papers, while the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's zone held nearly 90 sheets worth. Though originally the fastest, the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman now trailed behind in progress - though not by much.Mosin-Nagant and Phantom had exhausted their support opportunities, both wisely returning their remaining Flavor Papers to teammates. Phantom, having only one ally, simply tossed his share to Fish. Mosin-Nagant equally divided his between Gambler Li Hua and Radish.
The battlefield temporarily quieted, with no daring to make reckless moves.
After all, Pitian and White Drace's speeds had equalized again, though Pitian held a slight lead. Thus the opposing groups transitioned from collaborators back to competitors.
Li Hua and Radish collectively held "46 sheets" of Flavor Papers, while Fish retained "52 sheets". This six-sheet difference could potentially reverse Pitian's marginal lead in consumption speed.
Most crucially...
Though currently last, Lin Yu still possessed the most Flavor Papers - a staggering 58 sheets!
In other words...
The three contestants' progress in this Land of Certain Death eating competition inversely correlated with their supporters' Flavor Paper quantities. In a sense, this represented the most "balanced" scenario possible.
Especially among the leading groups - their three and two members sat intermingled. Preventing name-based Support while forbidden from direct attacks created near-impossible conditions for interference.
Thus none dared act rashly.
Yet it was Lin Yu who shattered the stillness.
The remnants of his "geometric wall" suddenly collapsed spectacularly. Emerging from the ruins, Lin Yu surveyed the tense, mutually suspicious circle with a sigh.
"What a tedious sight. Everyone's being far too cautious..."
Producing his Flavor Papers, he declared: "I didn't teach you how to use these just for mental arithmetic!"
Fish protested: "I wasn't calculating!"
Lin Yu smirked: "Not you, darling. I meant the others - especially those two from Haicheng, practically burning brain cells with calculations."
His gaze settled on Gambler Li Hua and Magician Phantom.
"The Gambler doesn't gamble, the Magician performs no magic - how disappointing."
"Then what would you have us do?" Li Hua asked quietly.
"Place an epic wager! Stage a spectacular show!"
Grinning, Lin Yu gathered all his Flavor Papers and raised them high.
Then—
He scattered them violently!
"Swish—!"
"I choose to exchange all 58 Flavor Papers for food—"
"Let's gamble on what delicacy appears!"
The pale yellow papers fluttered like butterflies across the ten-thousand-meter-high sky, transforming into glowing motes as they descended, carrying Lin Yu's audacious declaration upward.
Old Man Radish gasped: "This... this is too reckless!"
Everyone remembered the Flavor Paper rule - higher quantities increased chances of beneficial food effects!
Why would Fluoxetine exchange everything at once?!
This wasted a Support opportunity!
Mosin-Nagant and Fish looked equally perplexed. Only Phantom grasped it first: "This is... deterrence."
Li Hua stared intently at Lin Yu: "State your terms!"
A fist-sized cupcake descended from the sky into Lin Yu's grasp - surprisingly petite compared to previous offerings.
Seeing their comprehension, Lin Yu laughed uproariously.
"Pretend our group doesn't exist - just trip each other up."
"Whoever targets me gets this cupcake force-fed to their contestant."
Admittedly...
Food exchanged for nearly 60 Flavor Papers might possess beneficial effects.
But its actual appearance made everyone hesitant to call the bluff.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
What if it didn't?
Or if the benefits couldn't offset the food quantity?
Nearly 60 portions would devastate any team's current standing.
Exchanging 58 sheets without splitting them seemed to waste a Support chance, yet...
Reducing his own options actually amplified pressure on Li Hua and Phantom.
"A simple game theory lesson, my dear friends."
Lin Yu smiled, brandishing his cupcake, having grasped the most crucial truth in games—
The power to flip the table.
"Now, please perform and slaughter each other as I desire."
"Because beyond winning this round, I most want to see... your upper limits!"

chapters.title: Chapter 158: A Performance That Shocked Everyone
chapters.content:
After hearing Lin Yu's words, not just Phantom and Li Hua, but everyone else understood his intentions. Everyone's expressions turned grim.
"Psychological Society members really are complete lunatics!" Fish cursed out loud.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Even Robin, as Lin Yu's teammate, didn't look pleased. Because right now, while Lin Yu seemed to hold a "nuclear weapon" level of deterrence... this deterrence came at the cost of him completely abandoning any chance of "winning this round"!
After all, with the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman being the furthest behind, even if Li Hua and Phantom's groups used all their Flavor Papers... Pitian would ultimately have 40+52, equaling 92 Flavor Paper foods on his side! White Drace would end up with 40+46, totaling 86 Flavor Paper foods! Meanwhile, the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman currently had 49+48... making 97 Flavor Paper foods!
The Shadow-Type Pseudohuman would still be the slowest. Even though the numbers were close and it seemed to eat quickly... its eating method made victory impossible. While it could consume large amounts at once, its eating speed and intervals remained constant. When foods became larger portions, it couldn't reach optimal consumption rates, wasting "eating turns"—meaning at least one or two extra eating cycles.
In other words, Flavor Paper foods had the most delaying effect on the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman. After exchanging all his Flavor Papers at once, Lin Yu could only ensure someone would lose, not that he could win himself.
So... Lin Yu's current threat was somewhat like a barefoot man threatening those wearing shoes. Coming from anyone else, this threat might not have worked! Among the seven present, only Fluoxetine would possibly stir trouble in such a "cutting off your nose to spite your face" manner!
Even Fish from the Marauders... she might be radical, but she wasn't insane! There's a clear difference between mania and outright madness. So within seconds... everyone believed Lin Yu was dead serious.
Under Lin Yu's amused gaze, Fish was the first to move. "Damn it all, I'm done with this! Exchange 17 sheets for me!" She raised her Flavor Papers to exchange for food. As 17 sheets disappeared, a giant meatball descended from above.
Fish pulled out a baseball bat from her coat. "Phantom, cover me!" She swung the bat with full force, smashing the giant meatball like a baseball toward Li Hua's direction!Li Hua immediately pulled out his twenty-sided die, but was distracted by a sudden loud noise. "Bang! Thud!" Turning his head, he saw an elegant snow-white rabbit—usually dressed in a tailcoat and carrying a cane—leap from Phantom's hat.
The rabbit twirled its cane and spoke in perfect British accent: "Ladies and gentlemen—Welcome to The Greatest Magic Show!" Instantly, the rabbit teleported before the falling die and whisked it away with a red cloth. Then it patted its coat pocket and bowed slightly to Li Hua.
"Are you insane? Using your [Assistant] for this?!" Li Hua cursed, fishing his die from his pocket. During this distraction, the meatball landed in Pitian's area.
Radish scratched his head. "What now? I'm not good at this!" Mosin-Nagant spoke up: "No problem. Just throw the food up—I'll handle delivery!" He blew his whistle repeatedly.
Phantom's expression changed seeing hunting dogs and ospreys appear on the table. "Seriously? I called one, you call two?!" In response, both Radish and Li Hua shouted: "Exchange Flavor Papers!"
The five participants descended into complete chaos! Food rained down as everyone brought out their trump cards. Spectating Lin Yu was thoroughly entertained. "So this is how masters fight..."
Though he'd witnessed top-tier battles between Order and Marauders in Zheng City before, he'd been too far away to appreciate it fully. Moreover, that battle's level paled in comparison to this one!
However... with limited Flavor Papers and support uses remaining, the struggle didn't last long. Soon, everyone successfully delivered their items. With attacks on opponents forbidden... defense proved far harder than offense!
Soon, Pitian and White Drace's areas overflowed with food. Yet as predicted, they still outpaced the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman. The creature truly struggled with large foods—often managing only one portion at a time. While possessing some intelligence, it couldn't strategize food consumption, worsening its glacial pace.
Meanwhile, Pitian and White Drace ate at neck-and-neck speeds, making the eventual winner seemingly up to Lin Yu's deciding "vote." Their chances appeared equal. Of course, there remained a slim possibility... the cupcake contained some overpowered buff allowing the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman to stage a comeback.
But... the odds were minuscule. Yet at this critical juncture, everyone couldn't help glancing at Lin Yu, fearing that improbable scenario. Bathed in their gazes, Lin Yu—transitioning from spectator back to center stage—felt utterly delighted.
"The anticipation has peaked. Time for the climax..." Lin Yu smiled internally. "Oh? Everyone seems so interested in me... or rather, this 'cupcake.'" He lifted the cupcake, flicking it lightly with his finger.
Then he did the unthinkable—breaking off a piece and popping it into his mouth. "Mmm—delicious!" Under stunned stares, he proceeded to eat the entire cupcake, leaving no crumbs! Watching their dumbfounded expressions, Lin Yu licked frosting off his finger, grinning.
"The performance... was a great success!"

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Lin Yu's Perfect Plan
chapters.content:
As Lin Yu finished eating the entire cake, everyone was once again stunned by his madness. The first to speak up was his temporary teammate in this round—Robin.
"Fluoxetine, what exactly have you done?!"
"Without food exchanged from the [Flavor Papers], how are we supposed to win this round?!"
Though Robin's voice wasn't loud, for this somewhat socially withdrawn girl, it was already a hoarse shout. Lin Yu simply smiled without responding.
"It's simple..."
He pulled out a fresh stack of yellow papers from his hand—a thick bundle of over fifty sheets once again.
"I still have reserves."
At Lin Yu's words, the other players present were shocked.
"Why do you still have [Flavor Papers]?!" Li Hua couldn't help but ask.
"Because the [cupcake] just now didn't actually cost '59 sheets', of course," Lin Yu said, causing everyone present to tense up."You bastard actually lied!" Fish exclaimed indignantly.
"So what if I did? What can you do about it?" Lin Yu playfully stuck out his tongue at Fish.
Radish and Mosin-Nagant looked equally shocked. Only Phantom couldn't help but applaud lightly.
"What excellent misdirection... Honestly, Miss 'Fluoxetine', if you chose to become a magician, your achievements would be extraordinary."
"I completely failed to notice those earlier [Flavor Papers] were actually illusions!"
After Phantom finished speaking, Lin Yu smiled and said, "So I still have '58 sheets' of [Flavor Papers] in hand!"
"Everyone—my apologies, but checkmate."
After pausing briefly, Lin Yu continued, "Now—I'll exchange these [Flavor Papers] for two food items!"
As his words fell, the Flavor Papers in Lin Yu's hand dissolved into light particles again. Then...
Two food items descended from the sky, each exchanged from 29 [Flavor Papers]—one was a rice ball wrapped in seaweed, the other some kind of wrap. Both portions were as large as an adult man's head.
Lin Yu caught them and placed both items on the table. Li Hua spoke coldly: "Everyone, we haven't lost yet... The final offensive is just beginning."
All eyes were fixed intently on the two food items on the table, their attention completely captured. Then...
Lin Yu suddenly knocked on the table.
"Tap, tap!"
After two crisp sounds, Robin beside him froze momentarily.
"Now."
With Lin Yu's soft utterance, he suddenly reached toward Robin's side—not where the food was stacked. Then...
A notebook and a small box were thrown onto the table—the orange void drawn by Robin appeared again.
Moments later, before anyone could react...
The notebook and box, emerging from a blue void above the dining table, landed precisely on the names in front of Radish and Phantom!
"I choose to [support] Pitian and White Drace!" Lin Yu's amused voice rang out.
The notebook and black box disappeared!
Having seen this move once before, the remaining players should have been able to react. But...
Because everyone's attention had been captured by the food in front of Lin Yu, they were all half a beat too slow. By the time they realized what was happening, the items had already fallen into the names!
"Whoosh—!"
Above Pitian's area, the black box appeared and fell to the ground with a "thud." In White Drace's area, the notebook also dropped to the ground.
Everyone looked at Lin Yu in confusion. "What does this mean?"
Even Lin Yu's teammate Robin was puzzled. "So... what's actually going on?!"
From the beginning, Robin's mental state had been like a rollercoaster ride. When she saw Lin Yu exchange all the [Flavor Papers] for one food item, she already felt something was wrong. But at that time, Robin could still comfort herself:
"Maybe 'Fluoxetine' has her own plan... Perhaps one food item can still secure final victory."
Then when Lin Yu ate that [cupcake], Robin felt dizzy with shock!
"What is she doing?!"
"Trusting someone from the [Psychological Society]... I must be insane!"
"She's deliberately sabotaging me."Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
But when Lin Yu inexplicably produced a fresh stack of 58 [Flavor Papers]...
Robin's hope was rekindled again.
Lin Yu exchanged for two food items. Though 29 [Flavor Papers] per side might not seem entirely secure, as long as they were delivered, the chance of winning was definitely over seventy percent!
Just when Robin thought everything would proceed to the final "all-out offensive" phase as Li Hua had said...
Lin Yu suddenly knocked on the table—their prearranged signal. Part of what Lin Yu had whispered in her ear earlier:
"Later, first use your geometric shapes to block everyone's view... This can also prevent them from throwing items between our names."
"You can do that, right?"
"I can... Good—then let me ask, that 'Magic Brush Ma Liang' ability of yours that turns drawings into reality, are there any limitations? Can you draw objects with 100% accuracy? Can you control the timing of when they become real?"
"You really can? That's perfect—after the wall goes up, I'll need you to draw something for me with delayed activation."
After the wall was erected, they discussed specifics:
"Hmm—please draw it in this notebook!"
"Yes, copy exactly what's in this lens!"
"After it's drawn, when I tap the table twice, throw these two [items] onto Li Hua and Phantom's names—the notebook is for Phantom, the other item is for Li Hua. First demonstrate your most reliable throwing method, then I'll coordinate with you."
As the game progressed with Lin Yu's continuous maneuvers, Robin had almost forgotten these instructions! She even began to think the plan had changed.
So now, after the original plan was executed, Robin looked at Lin Yu and couldn't help asking: "Why use these two items instead of the food exchanged from the [Flavor Papers] in front of you?"
"Because it's not secure enough," Lin Yu shook his head. "Sending just 30 food items, while having a high chance of winning, might still result in failure."
"I promised you we'd win this round with 100% certainty!"
As Lin Yu finished speaking...
On White Drace's field, the fallen notebook opened. Then...
The "drawing" on it became reality—a silver-white cross emerged from it, appearing in White Drace's area!

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Perfect Item Synergy!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu had never intended to use the food from [Flavor Papers] to win this round.
Although the saying "Rather than improving yourself, it's better to undermine others" was indeed correct for this stage.
But from the very beginning when Lin Yu introduced the concept of [Flavor Papers], he had been carefully guiding these intelligent players toward drawing the exact conclusion he wanted them to reach.
Namely, that the optimal strategy for using [Support] opportunities in this round was to divide the [Flavor Papers] equally among all support opportunities.
This wasn't entirely deceptive - it was indeed a decent solution...
But it absolutely wasn't the optimal solution.
When the [items] in hand could produce greater effects, abandoning [Flavor Papers] was also a good choice.
To make these players overlook this point, Lin Yu continuously distracted their attention and thinking, guiding them to focus entirely on "offense and defense"!
The initial "wall-building" served two purposes: first, to block everyone's view so they couldn't see what he and Robin were actually doing and saying.
But more importantly, it made them subconsciously think about "how to breach the wall."Thus preventing them from considering other "solutions."
And one such solution superior to [Flavor Papers] was...
An item that could completely incapacitate a contestant or render them immobile for an extended period.
However, this was also difficult to achieve - after all, no player knew what weaknesses these three powerful "monster" contestants might have.
Using a single [item] to hard-control a monster was challenging to begin with.
Moreover, in this round, players couldn't directly manipulate items or know the monsters' weaknesses.
But coincidentally...
Lin Yu could see the monsters' weaknesses.
[Fear Lens: After using this item, you can see the image most feared in another's heart. Limited to one use per dungeon/return.]
And it was through this item that Lin Yu saw White Drace's deepest fear!
Silver crosses, powerful and terrifying demon hunters - during his childhood, the entire Drace family of werewolves had been slaughtered by that formidable demon hunter!
Gigantic silver crosses nailed his family members and elders to the ground, draining their blood and leaving them powerless!
Those massive silver crosses were like natural predators to werewolves.
So Lin Yu had Robin observe the image in the [Fear Lens] and paint this "cross" scene.
And to ensure the painting would effectively work.
Lin Yu even used the item [Ancient Notebook]!
[Ancient Notebook: An indestructible notebook where recorded information remains permanently preserved. Other undiscovered uses may exist...]
This guaranteed that even without Robin, the notebook's effects would absolutely take hold.
The [Ancient Notebook] and the 'Painter' were practically a match made in heaven.
The combination of these two [items] with Robin's 'Painter' abilities ultimately resulted in...
A silver cross standing tall in White Werewolf White Drace's area, radiating dazzling silver light.
The moment the silver cross appeared, White Drace immediately felt his entire body weaken.
Under that silver glow, White Drace trembled uncontrollably.
He turned his head and saw that nightmare image again.
Although it was from his earliest childhood, seeing it now once more...
Still nearly suffocated White Drace.
Why?
Why was this cross here?
Was that demon hunter watching too?
Was he among the audience?
These chaotic thoughts, combined with the weakness induced by the light, left White Drace collapsed atop the food pile, completely immobilized!
He wanted to roar loudly, to vent his fury - he knew he wasn't that weak little pup anymore.
But...
Ultimately, all his howls and rage were swallowed by overwhelming terror.
All the loud cries he wanted to make could only emerge as pitiful whimpers.
"Whimper... whimper..."
He lay limp on the ground, motionless.
And this scene, witnessed by all players...
Became absolute shock!
Robin looked at Lin Yu in disbelief.
"Fluoxetine... it actually worked?!"
"How did you know this would work? How did you get that image?"
Lin Yu smiled mysteriously: "That's... my secret!"
He said with a laugh.
As White Drace's supporters, Phantom and Fish looked extremely upset.
Especially Fish - she'd already lost one rope!
If she lost two more ropes after this round ended, she'd be in extreme danger.
"I've really lost to you, 'Fluoxetine'!"
Phantom also sighed.
"Looks like we're done for..."
It was clear White Drace wouldn't have the strength or mental capacity to act anytime soon... Even if he recovered later, catching up to the other two would be extremely difficult.
So Phantom spoke as if accepting fate:
"But I'm curious - even if White Drace is immobilized now... how will you defeat Pitian?"
"You couldn't possibly have items that coincidentally counter both characters, could you?"
As Phantom asked this, Li Hua, Radish and Mosin-Nagant all listened intently.
After all, this directly concerned them.
Lin Yu shook his head.
"I really don't have a way to counter that red muscle mountain... but..."
"Even without countering him, I have a [item] better than [Flavor Papers] to use!"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
As Lin Yu spoke...
The black box that had landed in Pitian's area suddenly began multiplying wildly!
Massive amounts of food came gushing out!
Compressed biscuits, mineral water - they sprayed out from the black box like a fountain.
Huge piles of food accumulated on the ground.
"Ta-da! The Delicacy Fountain!"
Lin Yu laughed loudly.
Mosin-Nagant and Radish's expressions changed dramatically.
Especially Elder Radish, who like Fish, looked too despairing to speak.
Li Hua, observing this hopeless scene, still managed to comment:
"You actually had... this kind of [item]..."
Lin Yu explained with a smile.
"I used it well - this [item] isn't just some box that spews food without reason."
This was the "truth."
[Chate's Supplies: Generates biscuits and water meeting an adult's minimum daily requirements, using "Fear" as fuel.]
And now...
White Drace's endless, overwhelming fear was vigorously powering [Chate's Supplies]!

chapters.title: Chapter 161: The Victor and the Loser
chapters.content:
As Lin Yu's two items began to take effect within the arena, it was clear that White Drace and Pitian had both lost any chance of winning this match.
In the end...
The Shadow-Type Pseudohuman devoured every last bit of food on the field.
Finally, the entire area within its domain was completely empty.
After the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman finished eating,
the voice in the sky sounded once again.
"The final victor has emerged—congratulations, you may leave this place!"
Then, black voids appeared beneath White Drace and Pitian's feet, and they fell into them.
Directly above the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's head, a gentle and bright white light appeared.
Bathed in this white light, it slowly ascended, flying towards the sky.Although it was impossible to tell if the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman had any emotions, at this moment the image on the screen looked as if it was flying towards freedom and happiness, inspiring awe.
As this scene unfolded...
Ka the Octopus also spoke.
"Alright, everyone—so the victors and losers at this dining table have now been decided!"
Just as Lin Yu promised, he led Robin to win this round!
"So, how about it? I told you... you'd win."
Lin Yu looked at Robin with a light smile.
Robin lowered her head, pursed her lips, and shook her head. "You owe me one..."
"However, you didn't tell me the whole plan."
The girl spoke with a hint of dissatisfaction.
"Ahahaha... no choice, because I was worried your acting skills were too bad to fool them."
Lin Yu rested his cheek on one hand and said.
As he expected, Robin's acting was indeed terrible—just as bad as everyone else Lin Yu had seen.
So keeping her in the dark to produce a “genuine reaction” could better confuse the others.
Before Robin could defend herself, Lin Yu looked toward Ka the Octopus.
"Alright, head chef—what about our main course?"
Ka the Octopus answered politely when asked:
"Please remain patient, two victors. Before I prepare the main course 'A Victor’s Blood Runs Ever Sweet' for you two honored guests... I must first complete the punishment for the remaining five guests."
"Everyone—banquet game, honor the bet and accept the consequences."
Ka the Octopus said with a smile, then pulled out a new button from the pool.
Then, he slammed it down heavily.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
*Boom!*
*Snap snap snap...*
The continuous sound of ropes breaking rang out. Everyone except Robin and Lin Yu had their chairs suddenly tilt!
The two broken ropes were those closest to the dining table in front—undoubtedly the worst breakage possible!
The five players punished by broken chair ropes swayed and nearly fell!
However, they were all prepared.
These top-tier players, famous in the Death Game player community, were not about to die so easily.
Phantom snapped his fingers, summoning his assistant rabbit, which hopped onto the chair back and grabbed Phantom’s collar with one hand.
Then, like a character from a comedic cartoon, its other hand pulled out an exaggeratedly large iron chain from its bosom.
The rabbit’s iron chain wrapped under Phantom’s ribs, binding him to the chair back and locking the chain's end.
"Heh heh—my favorite escape magic... but I guess you don’t want to escape now, do you?"
"Thank you, Teacher Ribbit, I definitely don’t want to."
Phantom, tied to the chair and swaying with it, replied politely.
On the other side, Mosin-Nagant had a similar plan to Phantom’s. The moment his chair lost balance, he sent his osprey flying underneath to prop it up.
Then, Mosin-Nagant took out two pieces of steel wire rope and fashioned a diagonal cable structure on the two remaining connected ropes, straightening the chair again.
Li Hua’s method was much simpler—he didn’t even use any items.
He directly braced both hands on the chair back, leapt upward, and sat on the highest tilted part of the chair.
Although it looked the most unstable, Li Hua sat quite steadily.
"Don’t you find it uncomfortable on your butt?"
Lin Yu asked curiously.
Li Hua pushed up his glasses. "Better than nothing."
The three players who had just lost two ropes were in a messy situation but still manageable.
Radish and Fish looked much more desperate.
With one rope already broken, both of their chairs were now hanging by only a single rope.
Old Radish made a quick decision, pulling out a seed and tossing it into the air.
The seed quickly sprouted and grew into a sturdy vine, forming a net-like trap around the chair, preventing Radish from falling.
Judging by the old farmer’s pained expression, this life-saving item must be extremely precious.
As for Fish...
She grabbed the single rope and pulled out three silver-white spherical robots, each about the size of an eyeball. Once released, the robots unfolded two transparent wings that vibrated rapidly, then flew beneath Fish’s feet.
The three robots supported the chair legs like fulcrums, helping Fish sit steadily again.
But no one knew how long these little robots could hold out.
Watching the five struggling players, Lin Yu rubbed his chin.
"Hmm... sure enough, these 'experts' have all sorts of survival tricks and strange functional items. Each one is hard to kill."
Luckily, for now, he didn’t have to deal with any of them.
Ka the Octopus smiled as he observed the players’ self-rescue attempts. "You guests truly each possess unique skills. I knew these 'punishments' wouldn’t faze you."
"But... be careful. If even one rope breaks, the situation becomes very bad—because then you have to worry about more than just the 'rope'."
"All ropes breaking means you are an unwelcome guest... so besides trying to stay 'up in the sky,' you need to think about..."
"How to prevent me from forcibly ejecting you."
Ka the Octopus added with a smile.
The five guests with broken ropes all looked grim.
Lin Yu understood immediately.
"As expected..."
He had already guessed that if all the ropes broke, besides falling, there would be other extremely unfavorable conditions.
Although he couldn’t imagine how to save himself in that case, Lin Yu trusted those “experts” would have some method.
After Ka the Octopus finished his “supplementary explanation,” he once again looked at Lin Yu and Robin.
"Thank you both for waiting. The ingredients for the main course have arrived. I will prepare them for you immediately!"
The white light from the screen shone into Ka the Octopus’s pool, and then...
The previous victor, one of the three contestants—the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman—fell from the white light, landing in front of Ka the Octopus.
The moment the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman appeared, before it could even move, Ka the Octopus tightly wrapped it with seven tentacles, pinning it to the iron plate in front of him.
Then, the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman struggled violently...
But in Ka the Octopus’s tentacles, it was like a child with a toy.
Its resistance had no effect whatsoever.
Humming a lively jazz tune, Ka the Octopus then pulled out a kitchen knife with his free tentacle.
*Scratch!*
The sharp kitchen knife plunged into the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman’s chest, causing it to tremble violently.
Then...
There was no more movement or life.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: The Main Course and Memories
chapters.content:
Amidst Ka the Octopus's cheerful humming, the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's pitch-black, rigid body gradually softened. It withdrew the sharp kitchen knife embedded in the creature's chest. At the tip of the knife was a perfectly round black sphere—though deep in color, its texture appeared somewhat translucent, resembling a type of black crystal. After being pierced by the knife, fine cracks radiated outward from the wound like frozen lightning.
"Quality stuff," Ka remarked appreciatively as it plucked the crystal sphere from the knife's tip. After examining it carefully, Ka tossed it into the sink. Then, it placed a frying pan on the stove, using two tentacles to hold the pan while another coiled around the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman and dragged it over. With ease, Ka lifted the creature, folded it in half, and began wringing its body like a wet towel. Thick, black liquid oozed from the chest wound, dripping steadily into the pan.
All the Players fell silent as they watched Ka's series of actions. "Truly a dungeon directly involving the gods..." Li Hua muttered under his breath.
After Ka's earlier threatening reminder, the six Players aside from Lin Yu had all harbored the same thought—if it truly came down to the ropes breaking, they'd do whatever it took to remain at the table. If this octopus became an obstacle... well, fighting it wasn't out of the question. Based on the appetizer round, Ka seemed only slightly stronger than them, with no clear upper limit visible. Perhaps... this octopus wasn't as formidable as it appeared?
But witnessing Ka instantly obliterate the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman gave these experts a more direct understanding of its capabilities. While the "Eating Contest" didn't directly showcase the three contestants' combat abilities, the Shadow-Type Pseudohuman's behavior during consumption allowed these veterans to deduce one thing: this thing was not to be trifled with. Seeing the creature in person made its terrifying aura even more palpable—especially for Robin, who had encountered such monsters in dungeons before. Yet it had been instantly annihilated the moment it appeared!
Even the typically most aggressive Fish found herself sobered by the display. "This thing doesn't seem like an NPC meant for frontal combat..." the seasoned Marauders member assessed quietly.
Everyone watched in silence as Ka discarded the wrung-out Shadow-Type Pseudohuman and began stirring the thick black liquid in the pan. As Ka cooked, an incredible aroma began to emerge from what looked like stale squid ink or freshly extracted crude oil—an unbelievably delicious fragrance that surpassed all expectations, especially in this banquet where they'd already tasted so many unimaginable delicacies. The scent alone was intoxicating, evoking memories of every delicious meal they'd ever eaten.
"So fragrant, and with such complex layers of aroma," Lin Yu praised sincerely. Among those present, he alone remained unaffected by Ka's earlier display—partly because he remained fully committed to his Fluoxetine persona, but mostly because he simply wasn't intimidated. He was too weak. Whether Ka's combat power was 50, 100, or over 10,000 made no difference to Lin Yu;
he stood no chance against any of them. Every creature at this table could put him in mortal danger. Even with everyone believing he was Fluoxetine... Lin Yu couldn't clearly determine what abilities the real Fluoxetine possessed, making it impossible to fabricate a convincing deception.
This detachment allowed Lin Yu to maintain his composure and continue his performance naturally. Ka seemed pleasantly surprised by Lin Yu's initiative to converse. "Oh... oh! Of course it's complex!" Ka exclaimed. "These creatures commonly called 'Soul-Devouring Horror Shadows' have unique physiology. The rare liquid in their bodies, similar to blood, contains concentrated life essence in every drop! Moreover, our host personally selected three contestants with abilities related to 'consumption' and 'devouring.' No matter who wins this eating contest, I can recreate all the delicious flavors from everything they've eaten! That's why this Main Course is my proudest masterpiece... Wait until it's fully cooked—just one bite will feel like tasting a dozen exquisite dishes simultaneously, with each mouthful offering a different experience! And the final bite... holds a special surprise!" Ka declared proudly.
Lin Yu clapped in amazement. "Wow, that's truly incredible... I can hardly wait!" Ka visibly preened at the genuine praise, its cooking motions speeding up slightly. The thick black liquid gradually solidified in the pan, taking on a gelatinous form while lightening in color. Finally... Ka divided the substance into two portions in the pan, turned off the heat, and retrieved a blowtorch from the sink. Blue flames erupted as it lightly torched the surfaces until they bubbled and changed color. With care, Ka plated two square portions of the black substance in porcelain dishes, drizzling them with bright red sauce."To our two guests..." Ka presented the dishes with spoons to Lin Yu and Robin. "The banquet's Main Course: 'A Victor's Blood Runs Ever Sweet.' Please enjoy!"
Gazing at the tantalizing dish before him, Lin Yu picked up his spoon and scooped up a portion without hesitation. Seeing this, Robin quickly followed suit. Moments later... both exclaimed in unison, "This is amazing..." A taste experience beyond human imagination—a near-divine explosion of flavor—filled their mouths. It was like consuming the freshest oysters, the most perfectly fatty roast pork, the crispest vegetables, the richest braised chicken... a dozen ultimate taste experiences manifesting simultaneously yet distinctly, transmitting "deliciousness" directly to their souls.
Spoonful after spoonful, Lin Yu and Robin quickly finished their portions. Lin Yu lifted his spoon with the final bite, remembering Ka's promised "surprise." "What could it be?" he wondered before eating it. Then—as in all great food-related stories—Lin Yu tasted something familiar from his past. A flavor encapsulating the word "happiness," from days long gone.
He found himself seated at a low wooden table, perched on a wobbly old plastic chair. The table was laden with steaming dishes—at its center, a grass carp topped with scallions sizzled as hot oil was poured over it. A young girl wearing an apron far too big for her stood proudly with the pot. "This three-pound fish cost less than ten yuan," she boasted with a grin, "and the vendor threw in half a bag of clams for free! Your sister's pretty amazing, huh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Dessert Course, Blank Canvas
chapters.content:
Lin Yu recalled exactly which moment from his memories this scene represented.
It wasn't any special occasion—just an ordinary day when he returned home from elementary school at age ten.
At that time, Lin Zhao hadn't dropped out of school yet and only occasionally took part-time jobs.
The siblings mainly relied on savings and welfare subsidies to get by.
Lin Yu had already set his heart on becoming an actor, though his understanding of "acting" remained superficial back then.
Life always has certain moments—utterly mundane yet etched into memory with startling clarity.
And when recalled, they always feel particularly...
Beautiful.
Like physical manifestations of "happiness."
Lin Yu picked up his chopsticks and placed a piece of fish in his mouth.The familiar taste he hadn't experienced in so long made him briefly dazed.
But he quickly regained his composure.
With just a slight shake of his head, his vision refocused on the dining table.
Ka the Octopus looked at Lin Yu in astonishment.
"Only three seconds... My, my guest, you truly aren't someone shackled by the past."
Lin Yu grinned unapologetically. "Yeah—that's right."
His gaze shifted to Robin beside him, who was already dripping tears like a leaky faucet.
No idea what memory that girl was seeing.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
About six or seven minutes later, Robin finally seemed to snap out of it.
Finding everyone at the table—including Ka—staring at her, she immediately grew flustered.
"Wh-what's wrong?"
Lin Yu observed her with interest.
"What did you see?"
Wiping her tear-streaked cheeks, Robin mumbled, "I saw my late grandmother... cooking my favorite eggplant with string beans."
Then hesitantly, she asked Lin Yu, "Was I out of it for long?"
"Six or seven minutes."
Ka nodded in agreement. "That recovery time is quite decent! It means you're an emotional person who isn't excessively clinging to the past."
Robin caught Ka's implication and turned to Lin Yu. "How long were you?"
Lin Yu shrugged. "Squid said three seconds."
This left Robin utterly baffled. "That fast?! How... how did you do that?!"
"Don't you feel any attachment to the past at all?"
Lin Yu looked at her sincerely.
"Of course not, because the person I saw... isn't dead."
"I could still eat that steamed fish anytime I want."
"So there's nothing to linger over."
Lin Zhao was still alive and kicking.
The reason he hadn't tasted her steamed fish in so long was simply because she'd been too busy running her shop alone.
And Lin Yu hated making his sister go through the trouble of preparing such labor-intensive dishes.
Hearing Lin Yu's blunt words, Robin's expression darkened.
She bit her lip hard before finally muttering after a long pause:
"You bastard... I'll kill you someday..."
Though killing each other had become routine among Death Game players,
Lin Yu could tell with absolute certainty...
This was an empty threat devoid of any real intent.
Not that it would matter even if she meant it.
In fact, Lin Yu would welcome her sincerity.
After all, Robin wanted to kill Fluoxetine...
What did that have to do with him?
Oh wait—it actually did!
He had a grudge against Fluoxetine.
If Robin actually succeeded, he'd probably laugh himself awake from dreams.
Not only would his vendetta be settled, but he'd also lose the looming threat of being hunted by an elite.
Though even if Fluoxetine died, the Psychological Society likely wouldn't stop harassing him.
At least they'd lose one elite and have to send someone else.
Lin Yu suspected that even an organization as powerful as the Psychological Society—capable of rivaling Order—couldn't possibly have many members on Fluoxetine's level.
So upon hearing Robin's offhanded threat,
Lin Yu responded with genuine enthusiasm:
"Oh, I look forward to it!"
Ka's voice then intervened:
"Now then, everyone... The 【Main Course】 segment has concluded."
"Next, please enjoy your 【Desserts】."
Ka chuckled.
"Since our guests have varied tastes, after observing everyone through most of this banquet, I've grasped your preferences and personalities."
"Thus, I'll prepare customized desserts for each of you... Each 【Dessert】 will also contain a special banquet card with unique functions hidden within."
"Find the card and finish your dessert completely... Otherwise, penalties may apply!"
"Which guest would like to go first?"
The table fell into silence.
Nobody dared or wanted to be the first guinea pig.
The later segments would undoubtedly increase in difficulty.
This round had already explicitly warned of "penalties"!
Who knew what tricks this 【Dessert】 segment might involve?
Though Ka mentioned...
Each person's dessert would differ, "tailor-made" for them.
Everyone still preferred going later.
Even with individualized desserts...
They could at least gauge the segment's nature by watching others first!
The potential advantages of being first paled against the risks of the unknown—
Especially for Li Hua's group of five.
With only one or two ropes left, their margin for error was nearly gone.
One misstep could spell absolute doom!
Caution was paramount.
As for Lin Yu and Robin who still had four ropes...
Lin Yu naturally wouldn't volunteer to test the waters.
Finally...
After several seconds of silence, Robin beside Lin Yu sighed and raised her hand.
"Um... I'll go first."
She said timidly.
Ka turned to her with delight.
"Wow—our esteemed lady volunteers to enjoy 【Dessert】 first?"
"Then I shall prepare something special for you..."
Ka retrieved an assortment of baking tools from the pool—
From molds to whisks, everything needed.
All eight tentacles worked busily as Ka enthusiastically began cooking.
Soon...
A plate bearing an exquisite, pure white dessert—likely some white chocolate creation—was presented to Robin.
Beside it sat three small bowls holding differently colored sauces.
Ka explained considerately:
"Your specially prepared dessert is called 【Blank Canvas】."
"I look forward to your 'masterpiece,' my dear Painter."

chapters.title: Chapter 164: The Most Dangerous Phase and Robin's Trial and Error
chapters.content:
Robin stared at the dessert called [Blank Canvas] before her, showing a slightly stunned expression.
"So that's how it is... But how should it be 'consumed' correctly?"
She murmured.
The other players noticed this scene and also showed puzzled expressions.
"What does this mean?"
Robin looked up at Ka the Octopus: "Can I ask others for help or discuss with them?"
"Of course you can!"
Ka the Octopus nodded.
"It's a banquet - having fun together is what matters most!"
The octopus said cheerfully.However, Robin couldn't share this cheerfulness.
She took a deep breath and addressed everyone: "Everyone... The information I currently have is... this dessert might be related to everyone's [Class]."
"Painters can obtain two [Class Items] at [First-Tier], namely [Paints] and [Pencil] - the former is called [Oil Painter], the latter called [Sketch Painter]."
"You should all know I chose [Pencil]."
Lin Yu nodded.
The function of [Paints] is allowing the [Painter] to make corresponding colors appear in reality by adding pigments to the canvas.
This is an excellent method for information transmission, and can also be used in direct combat to suddenly splatter paint on an opponent's face to block their vision.
The function of [Pencil] is allowing the [Painter] to materialize simple geometric shapes they draw and maintain them for one hour, with cooldown determined by the object's size.
Robin had been using this ability constantly - but clearly, this top-tier [Painter] had some method unknown to Lin Yu that made her [Pencil] ability seem to have no cooldown.
Hearing Robin's words, Fish couldn't help but ask:
"We all know this, [Night Watchmen] stuff. So what?"
Robin continued: "You know about [First-Tier] matters, but regarding the four advancement 'paths' after [Second-Tier]...[Blank Canvas] is one of them."
"And it's the path farthest from me - one I would never choose from the beginning."
As Robin spoke, Li Hua showed an understanding expression.
"Oh... So [Blank Canvas] is the [Second-Tier Item] [Painters] would choose after selecting [Paints], right?"
Li Hua said, and Robin confirmed again.
"Correct."
Everyone else also showed understanding.
"I see."
Clearly, Robin's explanation at least let them know what kind of [Dessert] they might be facing next.
Though the solution was still unknown, they now had a general direction.
After all, in this dungeon...
Everyone were players who had undergone their second [Promotion].
Except Lin Yu.
Although he also wore an expression of sudden realization, Lin Yu knew very well inside...
"This is troublesome."
No, rather than troublesome... it's more like completely screwed!
How would he know what the [Second-Tier Item] for [Assassin] was?
Lin Yu had only just learned from Robin's words that...[Second-Tier] advancement had four possible items to choose from!
As for which advancement path [Fluoxetine] himself had chosen, Lin Yu had no idea.
He didn't even have a clue which side this guy had chosen at [First-Tier].
So purely from an information standpoint, he might suffer a huge disadvantage in this [Dessert] phase.
Lin Yu had even prepared himself to 100% accept punishment!
Losing just this phase wouldn't be so bad, given the considerable advantage he'd accumulated earlier.
Ka the Octopus hadn't emphasized how many "ropes" the punishment would cut this round, likely just one.
But...
If he failed to recognize the dessert modeled after the [Item] and reacted suspiciously, his identity might be doubted.
All his efforts maintaining the [Fluoxetine] disguise would be wasted.
Lin Yu absolutely didn't want that to happen.
Moreover...
If Ka the Octopus really provided desserts related to [Assassin], that would be the better scenario.
Lin Yu still had confidence to maneuver and salvage the situation with his acting skills.
If the octopus provided everyone with desserts modeled after their own class's [Second-Tier Items], but gave him something related to [Fraudster] instead of [Assassin]...
That would be truly disastrous, leaving him no way to explain.
Although Ka the Octopus had shown no intention of exposing him, Lin Yu didn't dare be too confident...
Could this NPC backed by "gods" see through his true identity and class?
After all, that damned crow of the "God of Truth and Falsehood and Change" had completely seen through him.
Setting aside the [False Face] used before entering...
During the banquet, he'd also used two [Fraudster]-exclusive items: [Counterfeit] and [Teeth of Prophecy].
In contrast, he hadn't used any [Assassin] items at all.
So...
Lin Yu didn't dare be too optimistic that Ka the Octopus was completely fooled.
"This phase is the most dangerous one for me."
"Think of a way to bluff through..."
Lin Yu's mind raced, pondering completely different problems from everyone else.
While Lin Yu was thinking, Robin was also deep in thought facing the [Blank Canvas] dessert shaped like an item.
According to Ka the Octopus...
This phase's task included two requirements: "find the card" and "consume completely."
For the latter, Robin currently had no clues.
What about the former "find the card" then?
"Where could it be hidden?"
"[Blank Canvas] isn't small - is it hidden inside? Quite possible, since it's chocolate, and when it was being prepared earlier many ingredients were added in a dazzling way that made it hard to see clearly..."
Robin bit her finger in thought.
At this moment, [Magician] Phantom, who had remained silent, spoke up.
"Um... Miss Robin of the [Night Watchmen]."
"Perhaps you could try using your most fundamental [Painter] ability?"
"I mean - use that original class ability to draw the dessert before you!"
Phantom suggested, and Robin looked at him.
Seeing it was Phantom's suggestion, Robin felt somewhat doubtful.
Especially since the suggestion sounded rather nonsensical.
But unexpectedly...
Li Hua, who normally didn't get along with Phantom and likely had real grievances with him in reality, adjusted his glasses and supported Phantom.
"I also think it's worth trying."

chapters.title: Chapter 165: United Effort, Banquet Card
chapters.content:
As a member of Order and a Hai City Game Master, Li Hua, who operated under his real name as a "player," naturally had a much better credibility score than Phantom.
And when both of them proposed the same plan simultaneously, their trustworthiness naturally soared.
So, although Robin still couldn’t quite understand why the two wanted her to use the basic ability of the Painter class, she complied anyway.
After using the Painter’s ability to sketch the dessert in front of her, a line of text appeared on the paper.
[Name: Ka’s Handmade Dessert]
[Function: A delicious chocolate dessert paired with three-colored syrup. Eating it brings a pleasant mood and allows you to paint on top of it. The appearance references the career item called "Blank Canvas."]
[Additional Note: Redraw what you painted the first time you used your ability on it!]
Normally, when the Painter’s ability is activated, it reveals information about the [item] she painted.
However, this painting depicting the Blank Canvas had an extra "Additional Note."
Judging from the content...It was clearly a deliberate hint left by Ka the Octopus specifically for Robin.
Its purpose was to give Robin a clue about the next step to take after using her basic Painter ability.
Robin looked at Phantom in disbelief.
“How did you know?”
Phantom spread his hands: “I guessed.”
Such an honest answer surprised Robin.
“Guessed… you guessed?!”
Robin didn’t say more, but the look she gave Phantom and Li Hua was clearly filled with gloomy resentment.
Li Hua noticed this silent anger and hurriedly added:
“Cough, cough, sometimes you just have to trust your instincts!”
“And when I agreed with Phantom earlier, I also checked the probabilities... it’s very likely to succeed.”
Li Hua said seriously.
Robin’s expression immediately improved a lot.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
“So that’s how it is.”
Lin Yu, who had been quietly thinking about his own matters nearby, couldn’t help but smile seeing their interaction.
“So even the Order guys lie sometimes...”
Although Li Hua’s statement was likely a well-intentioned lie to calm Robin’s mood, a lie is still a lie.
Lin Yu was one hundred percent sure that Li Hua was faking it;
he definitely hadn’t used his ability to check the ‘probability.’
However...
Lin Yu agreed with Phantom’s plan.
This dessert phase was related to each person’s advancement item, in other words, their career.
Starting from the career’s ability... although there was definitely some gambling involved, it was somewhat relevant.
Besides, the result turned out well.
And precisely because Phantom guessed correctly, Robin didn’t dwell on it too much.
She looked back at the Blank Canvas.
Seeing Robin hesitate again, Fish couldn’t help but speak.
“Hey, little Painter, you haven’t forgotten what you painted the first time you got your ability, right?”
Robin shook her head.
“No, that painting... I probably will never forget it.”
Then Robin dipped her finger into the three-colored syrup, skillfully blending them in a certain proportion to form a somewhat grayish dark gold color.
She then used the mixed sauce to paint...
A pair of golden scissors.
“This was a tool I encountered in my first dungeon. Almost everyone who joined me in that dungeon died...”
Robin sighed, then pulled out a tissue from her pocket and wiped her finger clean.
“They all died under this pair of scissors.”
After finishing the painting...
The chocolate canvas with the golden scissors seemed to shed a thin film.
That film, stuck to the scissors, floated down and then shrank in the air, quickly turning into a hard-textured card that dropped onto the table with a clack.
Ka the Octopus, seeing this, spoke calmly.
“Oh, congratulations, guest, you have found the little card I hid!”
Saying this, Robin grabbed the card tightly and let out a long breath.
The card was now in her hands!
Next, she just needed to finish eating the chocolate and syrup to succeed!
Robin quickly broke the chocolate into small pieces and dipped them in syrup to eat.
Although the chocolate looked substantial, under the pressure of survival, Robin finished it quite fast.
To prevent “completely enjoying” from not counting, Robin took out a bottle of water and even rinsed the syrup containers clean to finish everything.
After finishing eating, Robin looked up, and Ka the Octopus spoke again.
“Dear guest, you have finished enjoying the [dessert]. How does it taste?”
“Pretty good, very sweet, and rich in chocolate flavor.”
Robin said cautiously.
Hearing the praise, Ka the Octopus happily took back the plate: “Thank you for your recognition!”
This sentence and action clearly showed one thing.
Robin had passed!
She sat in her chair and let out a long sigh.
“Phew... that’s great!”
Robin placed her hand on her chest.
Not only did Robin breathe a sigh of relief, but the others at the table were also happy for her success.
This meant that when it was their turn, they could refer to Robin’s “solution thought process.”
Moreover, it seemed this round was not too difficult!
After recovering, Robin thanked Li Hua and Phantom again: “Thank you both for your help... If it still needs my Painter ability when it’s someone else’s turn... I will still help!”
Although the Painter’s ability had a relatively long cooldown, as Lin Yu had observed before...
Robin seemed to have an ability to refresh or greatly reduce the cooldown of [items] and [skills]!
After Robin finished speaking, Li Hua said:
“We should be the ones thanking you since you were the first to step forward and try. That was already very difficult.”
Master Radish also laughed: “Yeah, when it’s my turn, I’ll rely on your help a lot!”
The others didn’t say much but also didn’t object.
Compared to previous rounds, the atmosphere at this table was relatively harmonious.
After all, by now, everyone seemed to realize that the tone of the dessert phase tended to encourage cooperation.
Taking turns meant the remaining people could help those undergoing the test.
However...
The cheerful atmosphere and optimistic guesses were soon cut short.
Ka the Octopus’s voice twisted the mood at the table again.
“Anyway, before taking the next guest’s order, let me introduce the function of the banquet card that just appeared.”
“The card just now was called [Scissors Card], and its function is...”
“To cut the two ropes on the chairs of any two people at the table!”

chapters.title: Chapter 166: The Second Dessert
chapters.content:
Ka the Octopus's words cut through the players' hopeful fantasy of enjoying a harmonious dessert round like a cruel blade.
Robin tentatively asked, "Um...do I have to use this card?"
"Of course," Ka the Octopus replied mercilessly, shattering her hopes. "If you don't use it by the time everyone finishes their desserts, the card will be 'randomly activated.'"
Ka the Octopus said this with a beaming smile. Robin's expression darkened upon hearing this.
Currently, besides her and Lin Yu, everyone else had at most two ropes remaining.
In other words...
This card would allow Robin to choose two people to immediately sever all their ropes.
And Robin didn't have the courage to choose herself either.
After all...
If she were left with only two ropes while someone else obtained a similar Scissors Card, it would undoubtedly...Mean she was handing her fate over to others.
So Robin clutched the card tightly, lost in thought.
She seemed to be psyching herself up.
Noticing Robin's state, Lin Yu immediately spoke up. "You don't have to use the card right away... The deadline is after the dessert round ends anyway. Let's see what cards others get before deciding."
"There might be more than just this type of card," Lin Yu added in a low voice.
Hearing this, Robin came to her senses. "That makes sense."
She then tightened her grip on the card and fell silent.
But Robin wasn't the only one feeling heavy-hearted.
Ka the Octopus's words had made everyone realize one thing...
This round definitely wasn't based on "cooperation."
The "cards" others obtained could very well become blades pointed at themselves.
Perhaps instead of helping others, interfering when they tried to pass the challenge was the right move!
Moreover...
Having already seen Robin complete this round once, getting a card early might be the best strategy!
Just as the players came to this realization...
Fish raised her hand.
"I'll go second," she declared without hesitation.
Despite having only one rope left - genuinely having just one chance remaining -
Fish still raised her hand.
"Calculating that the intelligence advantage of watching longer isn't worth the risk of waiting to obtain a card, huh?" Li Hua adjusted his glasses and commented. "Very much her style."
Fish ignored Li Hua's remark.
She simply looked straight at Ka the Octopus. "Hurry up and serve me dessert, chef."
As Fish spoke, Ka the Octopus studied her. "Oh, it seems our second guest has arrived... In that case, I'll prepare a dessert guaranteed to satisfy you!"
Then...
The octopus retrieved new ingredients and cookware from the pool, beginning to prepare the dish at dizzying speed.
The clanging sounds of cooking were so intense they sounded more like construction work than dessert preparation!
Soon...
A clock-shaped cake emerged from Ka the Octopus's hands.
He inserted a bell-shaped candy into the clock cake before sliding the dessert toward Fish.
Lin Yu also watched Fish closely.
He knew Fish also possessed a Unique Class.
And that class called "Freelancer" seemed capable of using abilities from other classes.
Lin Yu wanted to see what kind of dessert would be presented to her...
And what situation would unfold.
"Please enjoy your dessert. I've named it [Alarm Clock]."
Fish glared at the cake placed before her, her expression dark. "Tch..."
She clearly had no clue what to do.
Seeing this, Lin Yu spoke up: "Hey Fish, is this a Second-Tier item you didn't choose?"
Fish looked at Lin Yu in surprise. "Fluoxetine, are you trying to mess with me or help me?"
"Help you, of course," Lin Yu replied with a smile.
Others might only use Robin as reference, but for Lin Yu...
Someone else with a Unique Class like "Fish" held far more reference value.
In fact, if he could extract useful information...
It might even help in his next Promotion dungeon!
Sure enough, Fish pressed her lips together before finally responding to Lin Yu. "This isn't a Second-Tier item I didn't choose, but a First-Tier one."
Since no one knew what Promotion items for Unique Classes looked like, Fish's answer surprised everyone.
"This was your First-Tier item? Why are you First-Tier?" Lin Yu asked curiously.
"Who knows? Maybe it's random, maybe because I have a Unique Class," Fish shrugged. "But...why are you helping me?"
"Right now you have the most ropes left on the field, but you still wouldn't want others getting cards, would you?" Fish countered, her tone guarded.
Her question sounded less like "Why are you helping me?" and more like "Give me a reason to trust you."
Judging from her earlier troubled expression, Fish clearly had no idea what to do with the alarm clock.
But in Fish's eyes, "Fluoxetine" offering help out of nowhere wasn't necessarily trustworthy either!
Lin Yu roughly understood Fish's thought process.
While his motives and reasons were solid, as "Fluoxetine," he couldn't very well say it was because of their shared Unique Class status.
But fabricating a convincing reason for Fish wouldn't be difficult.
"Because I believe even if you got a card that could cut ropes, you wouldn't use it on me," Lin Yu said with a smile. "So...I'm quite happy to do you a favor."
Fish narrowed her eyes. "And if I deliberately use it on you?"
Her tone turned unfriendly.
Hearing this, Lin Yu burst out laughing: "That would make things even more interesting - I'd like you even more and look forward even more to you actually doing such a thing!"
"Prove me wrong...that my judgment about you was mistaken!"
His gaze burned with unmistakable intensity as he looked at Fish, his tone fervent.
Seeing Lin Yu like this, Fish scratched her head. "You're really crazy...fine, you win."
"I really wouldn't target you. If I had to choose two people to cut ropes, I already know who I'd pick."
Hearing this, Phantom stroked his chin. "Oh? And who might that be?"
Li Hua shot him a glance and coldly said, "No need to look, it's obviously the two of us."
Phantom studied Li Hua. "Hah? You Order lapdogs and her Marauders are sworn enemies, so you're a given."Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"But us Free Alliance might not be allies with the Marauders, but we're at least on friendly terms...why me?" Phantom asked.
Li Hua coldly replied, "Because you look punchable."
This made Phantom laugh angrily. "What nonsense!"
Phantom turned to Fish. "Hey Fish, this Order bastard's trying to drive a wedge between us!"
Fish coldly looked at Phantom. "Who are you calling 'us'? Soon as I get a card, I'm cutting your ropes and sending you packing."

Lin Yu suspected that even an organization as powerful as the Psychological Society—capable of rivaling Order—couldn't possibly have many members on Fluoxetine's level.
So upon hearing Robin's offhanded threat,
Lin Yu responded with genuine enthusiasm:
"Oh, I look forward to it!"
Ka's voice then intervened:
"Now then, everyone... The 【Main Course】 segment has concluded."
"Next, please enjoy your 【Desserts】."
Ka chuckled.
"Since our guests have varied tastes, after observing everyone through most of this banquet, I've grasped your preferences and personalities."
"Thus, I'll prepare customized desserts for each of you... Each 【Dessert】 will also contain a special banquet card with unique functions hidden within."
"Find the card and finish your dessert completely... Otherwise, penalties may apply!"
"Which guest would like to go first?"
The table fell into silence.
Nobody dared or wanted to be the first guinea pig.
The later segments would undoubtedly increase in difficulty.
This round had already explicitly warned of "penalties"!
Who knew what tricks this 【Dessert】 segment might involve?
Though Ka mentioned...
Each person's dessert would differ, "tailor-made" for them.
Everyone still preferred going later.
Even with individualized desserts...
