They could at least gauge the segment's nature by watching others first!
The potential advantages of being first paled against the risks of the unknown—
Especially for Li Hua's group of five.
With only one or two ropes left, their margin for error was nearly gone.
One misstep could spell absolute doom!
Caution was paramount.
As for Lin Yu and Robin who still had four ropes...
Lin Yu naturally wouldn't volunteer to test the waters.
Finally...
After several seconds of silence, Robin beside Lin Yu sighed and raised her hand.
"Um... I'll go first."
She said timidly.
Ka turned to her with delight.
"Wow—our esteemed lady volunteers to enjoy 【Dessert】 first?"
"Then I shall prepare something special for you..."
Ka retrieved an assortment of baking tools from the pool—
From molds to whisks, everything needed.
All eight tentacles worked busily as Ka enthusiastically began cooking.
Soon...
A plate bearing an exquisite, pure white dessert—likely some white chocolate creation—was presented to Robin.
Beside it sat three small bowls holding differently colored sauces.
Ka explained considerately:
"Your specially prepared dessert is called 【Blank Canvas】."
"I look forward to your 'masterpiece,' my dear Painter."

chapters.title: Chapter 164: The Most Dangerous Phase and Robin's Trial and Error
chapters.content:
Robin stared at the dessert called [Blank Canvas] before her, showing a slightly stunned expression.
"So that's how it is... But how should it be 'consumed' correctly?"
She murmured.
The other players noticed this scene and also showed puzzled expressions.
"What does this mean?"
Robin looked up at Ka the Octopus: "Can I ask others for help or discuss with them?"
"Of course you can!"
Ka the Octopus nodded.
"It's a banquet - having fun together is what matters most!"
The octopus said cheerfully.However, Robin couldn't share this cheerfulness.
She took a deep breath and addressed everyone: "Everyone... The information I currently have is... this dessert might be related to everyone's [Class]."
"Painters can obtain two [Class Items] at [First-Tier], namely [Paints] and [Pencil] - the former is called [Oil Painter], the latter called [Sketch Painter]."
"You should all know I chose [Pencil]."
Lin Yu nodded.
The function of [Paints] is allowing the [Painter] to make corresponding colors appear in reality by adding pigments to the canvas.
This is an excellent method for information transmission, and can also be used in direct combat to suddenly splatter paint on an opponent's face to block their vision.
The function of [Pencil] is allowing the [Painter] to materialize simple geometric shapes they draw and maintain them for one hour, with cooldown determined by the object's size.
Robin had been using this ability constantly - but clearly, this top-tier [Painter] had some method unknown to Lin Yu that made her [Pencil] ability seem to have no cooldown.
Hearing Robin's words, Fish couldn't help but ask:
"We all know this, [Night Watchmen] stuff. So what?"
Robin continued: "You know about [First-Tier] matters, but regarding the four advancement 'paths' after [Second-Tier]...[Blank Canvas] is one of them."
"And it's the path farthest from me - one I would never choose from the beginning."
As Robin spoke, Li Hua showed an understanding expression.
"Oh... So [Blank Canvas] is the [Second-Tier Item] [Painters] would choose after selecting [Paints], right?"
Li Hua said, and Robin confirmed again.
"Correct."
Everyone else also showed understanding.
"I see."
Clearly, Robin's explanation at least let them know what kind of [Dessert] they might be facing next.
Though the solution was still unknown, they now had a general direction.
After all, in this dungeon...
Everyone were players who had undergone their second [Promotion].
Except Lin Yu.
Although he also wore an expression of sudden realization, Lin Yu knew very well inside...
"This is troublesome."
No, rather than troublesome... it's more like completely screwed!
How would he know what the [Second-Tier Item] for [Assassin] was?
Lin Yu had only just learned from Robin's words that...[Second-Tier] advancement had four possible items to choose from!
As for which advancement path [Fluoxetine] himself had chosen, Lin Yu had no idea.
He didn't even have a clue which side this guy had chosen at [First-Tier].
So purely from an information standpoint, he might suffer a huge disadvantage in this [Dessert] phase.
Lin Yu had even prepared himself to 100% accept punishment!
Losing just this phase wouldn't be so bad, given the considerable advantage he'd accumulated earlier.
Ka the Octopus hadn't emphasized how many "ropes" the punishment would cut this round, likely just one.
But...
If he failed to recognize the dessert modeled after the [Item] and reacted suspiciously, his identity might be doubted.
All his efforts maintaining the [Fluoxetine] disguise would be wasted.
Lin Yu absolutely didn't want that to happen.
Moreover...
If Ka the Octopus really provided desserts related to [Assassin], that would be the better scenario.
Lin Yu still had confidence to maneuver and salvage the situation with his acting skills.
If the octopus provided everyone with desserts modeled after their own class's [Second-Tier Items], but gave him something related to [Fraudster] instead of [Assassin]...
That would be truly disastrous, leaving him no way to explain.
Although Ka the Octopus had shown no intention of exposing him, Lin Yu didn't dare be too confident...
Could this NPC backed by "gods" see through his true identity and class?
After all, that damned crow of the "God of Truth and Falsehood and Change" had completely seen through him.
Setting aside the [False Face] used before entering...
During the banquet, he'd also used two [Fraudster]-exclusive items: [Counterfeit] and [Teeth of Prophecy].
In contrast, he hadn't used any [Assassin] items at all.
So...
Lin Yu didn't dare be too optimistic that Ka the Octopus was completely fooled.
"This phase is the most dangerous one for me."
"Think of a way to bluff through..."
Lin Yu's mind raced, pondering completely different problems from everyone else.
While Lin Yu was thinking, Robin was also deep in thought facing the [Blank Canvas] dessert shaped like an item.
According to Ka the Octopus...
This phase's task included two requirements: "find the card" and "consume completely."
For the latter, Robin currently had no clues.
What about the former "find the card" then?
"Where could it be hidden?"
"[Blank Canvas] isn't small - is it hidden inside? Quite possible, since it's chocolate, and when it was being prepared earlier many ingredients were added in a dazzling way that made it hard to see clearly..."
Robin bit her finger in thought.
At this moment, [Magician] Phantom, who had remained silent, spoke up.
"Um... Miss Robin of the [Night Watchmen]."
"Perhaps you could try using your most fundamental [Painter] ability?"
"I mean - use that original class ability to draw the dessert before you!"
Phantom suggested, and Robin looked at him.
Seeing it was Phantom's suggestion, Robin felt somewhat doubtful.
Especially since the suggestion sounded rather nonsensical.
But unexpectedly...
Li Hua, who normally didn't get along with Phantom and likely had real grievances with him in reality, adjusted his glasses and supported Phantom.
"I also think it's worth trying."

chapters.title: Chapter 165: United Effort, Banquet Card
chapters.content:
As a member of Order and a Hai City Game Master, Li Hua, who operated under his real name as a "player," naturally had a much better credibility score than Phantom.
And when both of them proposed the same plan simultaneously, their trustworthiness naturally soared.
So, although Robin still couldn’t quite understand why the two wanted her to use the basic ability of the Painter class, she complied anyway.
After using the Painter’s ability to sketch the dessert in front of her, a line of text appeared on the paper.
[Name: Ka’s Handmade Dessert]
[Function: A delicious chocolate dessert paired with three-colored syrup. Eating it brings a pleasant mood and allows you to paint on top of it. The appearance references the career item called "Blank Canvas."]
[Additional Note: Redraw what you painted the first time you used your ability on it!]
Normally, when the Painter’s ability is activated, it reveals information about the [item] she painted.
However, this painting depicting the Blank Canvas had an extra "Additional Note."
Judging from the content...It was clearly a deliberate hint left by Ka the Octopus specifically for Robin.
Its purpose was to give Robin a clue about the next step to take after using her basic Painter ability.
Robin looked at Phantom in disbelief.
“How did you know?”
Phantom spread his hands: “I guessed.”
Such an honest answer surprised Robin.
“Guessed… you guessed?!”
Robin didn’t say more, but the look she gave Phantom and Li Hua was clearly filled with gloomy resentment.
Li Hua noticed this silent anger and hurriedly added:
“Cough, cough, sometimes you just have to trust your instincts!”
“And when I agreed with Phantom earlier, I also checked the probabilities... it’s very likely to succeed.”
Li Hua said seriously.
Robin’s expression immediately improved a lot.
“So that’s how it is.”
Lin Yu, who had been quietly thinking about his own matters nearby, couldn’t help but smile seeing their interaction.
“So even the Order guys lie sometimes...”
Although Li Hua’s statement was likely a well-intentioned lie to calm Robin’s mood, a lie is still a lie.
Lin Yu was one hundred percent sure that Li Hua was faking it;
he definitely hadn’t used his ability to check the ‘probability.’
However...
Lin Yu agreed with Phantom’s plan.
This dessert phase was related to each person’s advancement item, in other words, their career.
Starting from the career’s ability... although there was definitely some gambling involved, it was somewhat relevant.
Besides, the result turned out well.
And precisely because Phantom guessed correctly, Robin didn’t dwell on it too much.
She looked back at the Blank Canvas.
Seeing Robin hesitate again, Fish couldn’t help but speak.
“Hey, little Painter, you haven’t forgotten what you painted the first time you got your ability, right?”
Robin shook her head.
“No, that painting... I probably will never forget it.”
Then Robin dipped her finger into the three-colored syrup, skillfully blending them in a certain proportion to form a somewhat grayish dark gold color.
She then used the mixed sauce to paint...
A pair of golden scissors.
“This was a tool I encountered in my first dungeon. Almost everyone who joined me in that dungeon died...”
Robin sighed, then pulled out a tissue from her pocket and wiped her finger clean.
“They all died under this pair of scissors.”
After finishing the painting...
The chocolate canvas with the golden scissors seemed to shed a thin film.
That film, stuck to the scissors, floated down and then shrank in the air, quickly turning into a hard-textured card that dropped onto the table with a clack.
Ka the Octopus, seeing this, spoke calmly.
“Oh, congratulations, guest, you have found the little card I hid!”
Saying this, Robin grabbed the card tightly and let out a long breath.
The card was now in her hands!
Next, she just needed to finish eating the chocolate and syrup to succeed!
Robin quickly broke the chocolate into small pieces and dipped them in syrup to eat.
Although the chocolate looked substantial, under the pressure of survival, Robin finished it quite fast.
To prevent “completely enjoying” from not counting, Robin took out a bottle of water and even rinsed the syrup containers clean to finish everything.
After finishing eating, Robin looked up, and Ka the Octopus spoke again.
“Dear guest, you have finished enjoying the [dessert]. How does it taste?”
“Pretty good, very sweet, and rich in chocolate flavor.”
Robin said cautiously.
Hearing the praise, Ka the Octopus happily took back the plate: “Thank you for your recognition!”
This sentence and action clearly showed one thing.
Robin had passed!
She sat in her chair and let out a long sigh.
“Phew... that’s great!”
Robin placed her hand on her chest.
Not only did Robin breathe a sigh of relief, but the others at the table were also happy for her success.
This meant that when it was their turn, they could refer to Robin’s “solution thought process.”
Moreover, it seemed this round was not too difficult!
After recovering, Robin thanked Li Hua and Phantom again: “Thank you both for your help... If it still needs my Painter ability when it’s someone else’s turn... I will still help!”
Although the Painter’s ability had a relatively long cooldown, as Lin Yu had observed before...
Robin seemed to have an ability to refresh or greatly reduce the cooldown of [items] and [skills]!
After Robin finished speaking, Li Hua said:
“We should be the ones thanking you since you were the first to step forward and try. That was already very difficult.”
Master Radish also laughed: “Yeah, when it’s my turn, I’ll rely on your help a lot!”
The others didn’t say much but also didn’t object.
Compared to previous rounds, the atmosphere at this table was relatively harmonious.
After all, by now, everyone seemed to realize that the tone of the dessert phase tended to encourage cooperation.
Taking turns meant the remaining people could help those undergoing the test.
However...
The cheerful atmosphere and optimistic guesses were soon cut short.
Ka the Octopus’s voice twisted the mood at the table again.
“Anyway, before taking the next guest’s order, let me introduce the function of the banquet card that just appeared.”
“The card just now was called [Scissors Card], and its function is...”
“To cut the two ropes on the chairs of any two people at the table!”

chapters.title: Chapter 166: The Second Dessert
chapters.content:
Ka the Octopus's words cut through the players' hopeful fantasy of enjoying a harmonious dessert round like a cruel blade.
Robin tentatively asked, "Um...do I have to use this card?"
"Of course," Ka the Octopus replied mercilessly, shattering her hopes. "If you don't use it by the time everyone finishes their desserts, the card will be 'randomly activated.'"
Ka the Octopus said this with a beaming smile. Robin's expression darkened upon hearing this.
Currently, besides her and Lin Yu, everyone else had at most two ropes remaining.
In other words...
This card would allow Robin to choose two people to immediately sever all their ropes.
And Robin didn't have the courage to choose herself either.
After all...
If she were left with only two ropes while someone else obtained a similar Scissors Card, it would undoubtedly...Mean she was handing her fate over to others.
So Robin clutched the card tightly, lost in thought.
She seemed to be psyching herself up.
Noticing Robin's state, Lin Yu immediately spoke up. "You don't have to use the card right away... The deadline is after the dessert round ends anyway. Let's see what cards others get before deciding."
"There might be more than just this type of card," Lin Yu added in a low voice.
Hearing this, Robin came to her senses. "That makes sense."
She then tightened her grip on the card and fell silent.
But Robin wasn't the only one feeling heavy-hearted.
Ka the Octopus's words had made everyone realize one thing...
This round definitely wasn't based on "cooperation."
The "cards" others obtained could very well become blades pointed at themselves.
Perhaps instead of helping others, interfering when they tried to pass the challenge was the right move!
Moreover...
Having already seen Robin complete this round once, getting a card early might be the best strategy!
Just as the players came to this realization...
Fish raised her hand.
"I'll go second," she declared without hesitation.
Despite having only one rope left - genuinely having just one chance remaining -
Fish still raised her hand.
"Calculating that the intelligence advantage of watching longer isn't worth the risk of waiting to obtain a card, huh?" Li Hua adjusted his glasses and commented. "Very much her style."
Fish ignored Li Hua's remark.
She simply looked straight at Ka the Octopus. "Hurry up and serve me dessert, chef."
As Fish spoke, Ka the Octopus studied her. "Oh, it seems our second guest has arrived... In that case, I'll prepare a dessert guaranteed to satisfy you!"
Then...
The octopus retrieved new ingredients and cookware from the pool, beginning to prepare the dish at dizzying speed.
The clanging sounds of cooking were so intense they sounded more like construction work than dessert preparation!
Soon...
A clock-shaped cake emerged from Ka the Octopus's hands.
He inserted a bell-shaped candy into the clock cake before sliding the dessert toward Fish.
Lin Yu also watched Fish closely.
He knew Fish also possessed a Unique Class.
And that class called "Freelancer" seemed capable of using abilities from other classes.
Lin Yu wanted to see what kind of dessert would be presented to her...
And what situation would unfold.
"Please enjoy your dessert. I've named it [Alarm Clock]."
Fish glared at the cake placed before her, her expression dark. "Tch..."
She clearly had no clue what to do.
Seeing this, Lin Yu spoke up: "Hey Fish, is this a Second-Tier item you didn't choose?"
Fish looked at Lin Yu in surprise. "Fluoxetine, are you trying to mess with me or help me?"
"Help you, of course," Lin Yu replied with a smile.
Others might only use Robin as reference, but for Lin Yu...
Someone else with a Unique Class like "Fish" held far more reference value.
In fact, if he could extract useful information...
It might even help in his next Promotion dungeon!
Sure enough, Fish pressed her lips together before finally responding to Lin Yu. "This isn't a Second-Tier item I didn't choose, but a First-Tier one."
Since no one knew what Promotion items for Unique Classes looked like, Fish's answer surprised everyone.
"This was your First-Tier item? Why are you First-Tier?" Lin Yu asked curiously.
"Who knows? Maybe it's random, maybe because I have a Unique Class," Fish shrugged. "But...why are you helping me?"
"Right now you have the most ropes left on the field, but you still wouldn't want others getting cards, would you?" Fish countered, her tone guarded.
Her question sounded less like "Why are you helping me?" and more like "Give me a reason to trust you."
Judging from her earlier troubled expression, Fish clearly had no idea what to do with the alarm clock.Thɪs updatᴇd by NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
But in Fish's eyes, "Fluoxetine" offering help out of nowhere wasn't necessarily trustworthy either!
Lin Yu roughly understood Fish's thought process.
While his motives and reasons were solid, as "Fluoxetine," he couldn't very well say it was because of their shared Unique Class status.
But fabricating a convincing reason for Fish wouldn't be difficult.
"Because I believe even if you got a card that could cut ropes, you wouldn't use it on me," Lin Yu said with a smile. "So...I'm quite happy to do you a favor."
Fish narrowed her eyes. "And if I deliberately use it on you?"
Her tone turned unfriendly.
Hearing this, Lin Yu burst out laughing: "That would make things even more interesting - I'd like you even more and look forward even more to you actually doing such a thing!"
"Prove me wrong...that my judgment about you was mistaken!"
His gaze burned with unmistakable intensity as he looked at Fish, his tone fervent.
Seeing Lin Yu like this, Fish scratched her head. "You're really crazy...fine, you win."
"I really wouldn't target you. If I had to choose two people to cut ropes, I already know who I'd pick."
Hearing this, Phantom stroked his chin. "Oh? And who might that be?"
Li Hua shot him a glance and coldly said, "No need to look, it's obviously the two of us."
Phantom studied Li Hua. "Hah? You Order lapdogs and her Marauders are sworn enemies, so you're a given."
"But us Free Alliance might not be allies with the Marauders, but we're at least on friendly terms...why me?" Phantom asked.
Li Hua coldly replied, "Because you look punchable."
This made Phantom laugh angrily. "What nonsense!"
Phantom turned to Fish. "Hey Fish, this Order bastard's trying to drive a wedge between us!"
Fish coldly looked at Phantom. "Who are you calling 'us'? Soon as I get a card, I'm cutting your ropes and sending you packing."

chapters.title: Chapter 167: How to Use the 'Freelancer'
chapters.content:
After Fish finished speaking, Phantom obediently closed his mouth. However, his expression carried a hint of resentment as he pulled out a small mirror from his top hat, examining himself from left to right as if asking, "Am I really that annoying?" Clearly, this member of the Free Alliance had little self-awareness about his reputation and personality.
Comparing him with another Free Alliance member Li Nian, Lin Yu couldn't help but form a thought: "Is one of the selection criteria for the Free Alliance being 'unconsciously annoying'?" Should he have Zhu Ming demonstrate some of these personality traits later? But those were considerations for after they got out. Right now, what needed consideration was...
How to help Fish pass this [Dessert] challenge. As fellow Unique Class holders, helping Fish was indirectly helping himself. After some thought, Lin Yu spoke again.
"[Alarm Clock]... Could you tell me about its functions? When you chose it, you must have seen its description. Do you still remember?" Fish crossed her arms: "Of course I remember!"
"The [Alarm Clock] allows me to simultaneously use abilities from three 'Classes' - with time limitations. Depending on the three 'Classes' I choose, it randomly sets an 'alarm time' between one hour and seventy-two hours. Before the alarm sounds, I can freely use all three Class abilities."
"Each time the alarm rings, I randomly lose one of the abilities." Hearing Fish's explanation, Lin Yu pondered. So the 'Freelancer' couldn't inherently use multiple Class abilities simultaneously - it required the [Alarm Clock]'s assistance. But...
This item sounded quite powerful. Why hadn't Fish chosen it? Was the other [Item] more suitable for her? Lin Yu shook his head, deciding not to dwell on it. He followed Phantom's train of thought.
"So among your current Class abilities... is there anything that could interact with this alarm clock?" Fish thought for a moment.
"Well... might as well come clean. The three abilities I drew for this session are 'Soldier', 'Student', and 'Monk'... I haven't decided which to use yet." Hearing this, Lin Yu nodded.
It seemed the 'Freelancer' ability involved drawing three Class abilities per game session for selection? And apparently, one could delay choosing indefinitely. Lin Yu was very familiar with both 'Soldier' and 'Student' - the latter was common, while the former, though fewer in number, formed the backbone of major organizations.'Monk'... Lin Yu searched his memory. Like 'Ninja', it was a relatively rare Class. Its ability was rather special - technically 'Skill Type' but many considered it 'Special Type'.
The 'Monk' ability involved performing a "pious prayer" to randomly receive one of three blessings: "Good Fortune", "Revelation", or "Blessing" - with effects depending on the degree of "piety". It could only be used once per dungeon or return. Rumor had it that in dungeons "closer to the gods", the 'Monk's' ability grew stronger. Clearly...
In dungeons where divine "agents" directly manifested, like now, the 'Monk' ability would be particularly suitable. Lin Yu thought that except for his second dungeon where gods inexplicably appeared personally... this was probably the "closest to gods" a dungeon could get. However...
Lin Yu looked at Fish. "I'd like to recommend choosing 'Monk', but... can you perform a 'pious prayer'?" he asked seriously.
Fish met his gaze, and for the first time, the perpetually cocky blonde-haired girl showed an expression of frustration. "Honestly, I've had 'Monk' before... and only got about 15 seconds of sensory enhancement blessing."
The 'Monk's' "Blessing" granted temporary physical enhancement. Even knowing Fish's temperament, Lin Yu couldn't help but be surprised. "15 seconds?!" According to forum data Lin Yu had seen, even in unfavorable conditions with bad luck, a 'Monk' should receive at least 10 minutes of blessing duration.
Hearing Lin Yu's reaction, Fish turned her head away irritably. "I'm not some god-babbling zealot like you... I'm an atheist materialist, okay? I genuinely can't believe in this stuff!"
Before Lin Yu could respond, Phantom interjected: "Surviving over a year in the Death Game while still claiming to be a materialist makes you some kind of miracle yourself. Why don't you ask that octopus over there what the banquet host's name is?"
Fish glared at him, looking even more annoyed. "Hah? Of course I know these 'gods' exist! But they're nothing like the deities religions describe! I just think they might be... whatever, I'm not discussing this on their turf." She waved her hand dismissively.
As Phantom opened his mouth to continue, Li Hua suddenly spoke: "This is why you're on her kill list. You have a way of making everything sound sarcastic." "Huh? Do I?" Phantom scratched his head. "You do," Even Mosin-Nagant felt compelled to chime in fairly.For more chapters visit NoveI~Fire.net
Lin Yu understood now. Among higher-tier players, 'Magician' Phantom was probably known for traits like "being verbally obnoxious." Clearing his throat, Lin Yu steered the conversation back on track with Fish.
"Anyway... you've explained the reasons yourself, so choosing 'Monk' probably won't work. Therefore, I recommend you choose - 'Student'."
Fish scratched her head. "What? 'Student'? How would I use that?" Lin Yu pointed at Ka the Octopus. "Beg him. Ask this Head Chef how to properly enjoy the [Dessert] or find the cards - or at least get some hints." He said seriously.
Hearing this, Fish looked troubled. "Ah... that is an idea, but... compared to 'pious prayer', 'begging' isn't much easier for me, you know?"

chapters.title: Chapter 168: The Crucial Moment, The Unexpected Card
chapters.content:
"Um... hey... Ka the Octopus... I mean, Brother Ka?"
"Could you give me some hints?"
Although Fish claimed she wasn't good at begging others, she ultimately accepted Lin Yu's suggestion.
After all, "devout prayer" was something Fish objectively couldn't accomplish.
She could "pray," but being "devout"...
Fish lacked that fundamental capacity.
Therefore, compared to the 'Monk' class, she realized the 'Student' class was a better choice.
While the Student's ability to improve negotiation success rates essentially relied on "humbling oneself to make requests," it didn't require "sincerely begging others."
Just going through the motions was enough.
So now, Fish was making an extremely awkward attempt to "plead" with Ka the Octopus, trying to activate her 'Student' ability.Judging from her fidgeting posture...
This girl wasn't lying—she truly sucked at begging.
However, Lin Yu could deduce something from this...
"Since she agreed so readily, her 'Freelancer' class must have other backup plans... At the very least, she should have a way to switch classes."
"Even though [Dessert] is one of the later rounds, choosing the 'Student' class—which might be a 'one-time use' in every dungeon—without selecting anything earlier isn't a very wise move."
Considering Fish had likely undergone two, probably three Promotions as a player...
It wouldn't be surprising if she had such class-switching methods.
That other [First-Tier item] she chose instead of the [Alarm Clock] might be related to this.
As Lin Yu pondered, Fish finally succeeded.
"Brother Ka, just tell me what's going on!"
"Your cooking's great, and you're pretty strong—what's the harm in giving me some hints?"
Although Fish's tone was painfully awkward, making Ka the Octopus visibly uncomfortable...
Precisely because of that...
Her compliments actually made Ka the Octopus somewhat pleased.
And so...
The 'Student' ability successfully activated at this moment.
Fish's negotiation with Ka the Octopus achieved her desired outcome.
"Ahem, alright alright..."
Ka the Octopus tapped his spatula.
"For this [Alarm Clock] dessert of yours, to find the hidden card inside..."
"You need 'the most important moment of your life.'"
Having said this, it closed its mouth and fell silent.
Hearing Ka the Octopus's description, Fish fell into deep thought.
"The most important moment of my life... And then?"
Upon hearing Fish's question, Lin Yu facepalmed and sighed skyward.
"My dear Miss Fish, haven't you noticed that the [Alarm Clock] has clearly movable hands and no cover on its face?"
He could confirm once again.
Fish's combat abilities must be extraordinarily strong.
That terrifying [Piercing Sacred Might] earlier definitely wasn't this brat's only ultimate move.
Without some extreme "violence" as her foundation, she absolutely wouldn't have survived this long, let alone thrived.
After Lin Yu's hint, Fish finally caught on.
"Ohhh, I get it—you mean I need to use the hour and minute hands of this alarm clock to display the exact time of the most important moment in my life, right?"
Lin Yu nodded.
"Not completely stupid."
As he spoke, Fish thought for a moment.
"But what if I don't know the exact time of the most important moment in my life...?"
She asked earnestly, but Lin Yu shook his head.
"No, I think... you definitely would know."
"Or rather, you can think about events where you do know the exact time."ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ net
Fish pursed her lips, then fell silent.
She stared intently at the alarm clock for several seconds—no one knew what Fish was thinking.
Was she recalling which moments met the criteria?
No.
Perhaps others couldn't tell, but Lin Yu could clearly sense...
From the very beginning, Fish already had a crystal-clear answer in mind.
Although this girl hid it well, he could see...
The fleeting emotions in her eyes—a mix of helplessness, anger, and sorrow.
This girl...
Was resisting remembering that moment.
"What a fucking garbage dungeon..."
Fish muttered, then gently reached out and began adjusting the clock hands.
Somehow, despite being an edible "dessert," this [Alarm Clock] had mechanical components identical to a real alarm clock. As Fish turned the minute hand, the hour hand moved accordingly.
Round and round the hands went, until Fish finally set them to...
8:37.
This was a standard 12-hour clock.
So apart from Fish, no one knew whether it was 8:37 AM or PM.
After she finished adjusting the hands...
The bell atop the [Alarm Clock] suddenly started jumping back and forth, emitting a crisp ringing sound.
"Ding-ding-ding!"
The ringing lasted only one urgent burst before falling silent.
Then, a paper "card" popped out from a small slot above the clock!
The card's design was similar to Robin's.
As Fish picked up the card, Phantom sighed.
Meanwhile, Li Hua chuckled lightly.
Phantom looked at the smiling Li Hua in confusion: "What are you laughing about? She got a card—shouldn't you be upset?"
"She's already threatened to kill both of us!"
Li Hua glanced at Phantom: "It's fine. Even if I might die, thinking that you'll die too makes me happy!"
Phantom froze, then said, "You hate me that much?"
Li Hua looked at Phantom with astonishment, as if seeing an idiot: "You actually believed me?"
Lin Yu, who had been watching this whole exchange, couldn't take it anymore and interjected: "Look at the design on that 'card.'"
Phantom turned to see the card in Fish's hand—its pattern wasn't scissors.
But a "knotted rope."
"What kind of card is this? What does it do?"
Fish couldn't help asking.
Hearing her question, Ka the Octopus laughed.
"This is the 'Knot Card'—a very useful card!"
"It can randomly repair and reconnect five broken ropes in the entire room!"
Hearing the card's effect, Phantom was the first to sigh in relief.
"Thank goodness she didn't get the Scissors Card."
Old Man Radish was also pleased, smiling warmly: "Five is more than four, which means we don't need to worry about Miss Robin's card anymore."
"And... with this type of card, maybe nobody has to die in this game!"
Old Man Radish grew optimistic.
Robin nodded repeatedly.
"Yeah, that would be the best outcome!"
Only the card's holder, Fish, wasn't happy.
"Well, it's better than nothing."
She pocketed the card, then angrily grabbed the alarm clock dessert and took a fierce bite—as if venting her frustration.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Li Hua’s Summary
chapters.content:
After Fish finished devouring the dessert on her plate in big mouthfuls, Ka the Octopus also took away the empty plate in front of her, just like he had done earlier with Robin’s empty plate.
This meant...
Fish had cleared this stage as well.
She had successfully obtained the card that could "repair" five broken ropes and passed the dessert segment.
However, before moving on to the next person's dessert time, Fish spoke up.
"Octopus, can I use the card right now?"
Fish said seriously.
"Of course," Ka the Octopus nodded, "Are you sure you want to use it?"
"I'm sure. I don't want someone cutting me off and sending me out later... Even though it's random, since I broke so many ropes, the chance of repairing a few should be pretty high, right?"
Fish said with confidence.After speaking, she took out the card from her bosom and showed it.
"How do I use this?"
"Since you’re sure, it’s already been 'used'!"
Ka the Octopus said with a smile.
As soon as the words fell, the card in Fish’s hand turned into light particles and flew up into the sky, just like the Flavor Papers before!
Once the card completely disappeared, five ropes on the field restored their connections!
One on Fish’s chair.
Two on Radish’s chair.
One on Li Hua’s chair.
One on Mosin-Nagant’s chair.
Instantly, these people became considerably "safer."
The pressure maintaining the "balance" slightly eased.
Li Hua and Mosin-Nagant both returned to three ropes.
Old Radish also surged ahead, also reaching three ropes.
Fish returned to two ropes again.
Only Phantom was left unattended.
He sighed, "I really am just unlucky!"
Fish snorted in dissatisfaction, "Tch, even if I repair one rope, I’d just be equal to you."
Li Hua didn’t miss the chance to mock Phantom.
"This is what happens when you don’t accumulate goodwill regularly. Look at Senior Radish, kind to others, so even luck favors him now."
Phantom ignored Li Hua.
Old Radish felt a bit uneasy.
"That can’t be said so bluntly..."
Still, returning to the safety level of "three ropes" was a reason for Radish to be happy.
So...
Old Radish looked at everyone around the table.
"Since I’m lucky enough to be back at three ropes, how about I take the next turn for the game?"
As he spoke, Li Hua shook his head.
"No, I’ll go."
"After observing the two before me, Robin and Fish, I’ve noticed some pattern... If this pattern is correct, then passing this stage might not be that difficult after all."
Li Hua said solemnly.
"As long as I also fit this ‘pattern,’ you all can follow this plan from now on."
"Although the cards Robin obtained from the game made everyone suspicious, Fish’s card actually proves that... cards might also have content that is ‘positively beneficial’ to us as a whole."
"Considering that failing the segment will be punished, looking at the ‘total number’ of ropes, not completing guarantees a ‘-1,’ while completing can be positive or negative. With only two samples, it’s still limited, but for now, I recommend everyone try their best to complete the tasks."
"This is the better strategy from the perspective of ‘expected benefit.’"
After speaking, Li Hua pushed up his glasses.
Ignoring the reactions of the others listening to his words, Li Hua looked up at Ka the Octopus.
"Alright, esteemed Chef..."
"Now it’s my turn for the dessert segment."
Ka the Octopus nodded respectfully.
"No problem... As you wish!"
With that, the octopus once again began its dazzling operations.
Li Hua stared intently at him;
the resin lenses of his tortoiseshell glasses reflected a bluish-green light.
Soon...
An exquisite dessert was placed in front of Li Hua.
"The dessert prepared for you is called ‘Lead-filled Dice.’"
"Anticipating your keen insight and guaranteed victory in gambling, dear Gambler sir."
Ka the Octopus said with a smile.
Li Hua nodded in thanks and pulled the plate in front of him.
Judging by the difficulty of finishing it, this should be the easiest so far.
Because on the plate were...
Six small, delicate dice.
Standard six-sided dice with red and blue engraved dots.
Li Hua lifted the plate without asking anyone for help.
He shook the plate, and the six dice clattered against the bone dish with a rattling sound.
After a moment, Li Hua released his grip on the plate.
Then, he raised his head and explained to the other players.
"I just activated my two basic abilities and observed the probability of the dice rolling high or low twice."
"The first time, three of the dice followed the normal probability distribution for guessing high or low."
"The second time, the other three dice... did not follow normal probability."
As he spoke, Li Hua pinched one of the dice from the plate.
"Based on the sound just now and the craftsmanship of Ka the Octopus when making it, combined with my ability..."
"The ‘Lead-filled Dice’ specifically refers to this one."
"So far, my process has been the same as the other two’s, using our ‘profession’ base abilities to gain some hints about the game."
After speaking...
Li Hua crushed the ‘Lead-filled Dice’ in his hand.
In an instant, ‘mercury’ burst out and dripped into the plate.
But judging by the sweet aroma, it was likely some kind of syrup rather than mercury.
The syrup finally solidified in the plate, with a small paper bundle floating inside.
Li Hua picked up the paper bundle and unfolded it.
"A hint has appeared."
Li Hua said, then read aloud the text on it.
"Remember the time you lost the most?"
After reading, he paused and squinted.
"I understand now."
Then, Li Hua hesitated not at all and smoothly flicked the dice on the plate.
In the end, the remaining dice on the plate became four fives and one six.
Afterward...
The dice cracked into halves, revealing five torn card pieces inside.
When put together, they formed a complete card.
Li Hua held the card in his hand.
Then, he spoke, "Alright everyone, so far, the processes of the three of us seem exactly the same."
"I need to confirm with Miss Fish—was your ‘most important’ moment happening inside a dungeon, where you were closest to death and many people around you died?"
Fish crossed her arms, looked up to the sky, and snapped, "None of your business, stop babbling."
Li Hua waved his hand.
"Sorry, no offense..."
Lin Yu interrupted Li Hua.
"You should be right. She’s showing a typical ‘defensive posture.’ Although she’s always prickly all over... this time it’s very deliberate."
Li Hua seemed to trust Fluoxetine’s judgment.
"Oh, then the pattern is completely correct."

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Radish's Resolve
chapters.content:
"First, the [Lead-filled Dice] was an item I didn't choose when reaching second tier... This thing indeed randomly selects one item you didn't choose as the dessert's form and prototype, hiding a mechanism that interacts with your original ability while giving you a hint about 'cards'."
"Although it's called [dessert], just like the [aperitif] segment, this challenge is built upon the 'shadows' in your heart."
"If I'm not mistaken, during the [aperitif] segment, everyone probably saw the most sorrowful events from 'reality', just like I did."
"And this [dessert] challenge... forces you to recall your most humiliating experience in a 'dungeon'."
"In any case, while three samples aren't statistically reliable, we can temporarily use this pattern to analyze the difficulties you encounter."
Li Hua spoke methodically. After finishing, he resumed eating the dice on his plate. Having consumed all the dice, he looked up at Ka the Octopus and revealed his card.Official source is NoveI~Fire.net
"Chef, I've obtained the [Scissors Card]... except the scissors on mine are red. What does this mean?"
Hearing Li Hua's words, Ka the Octopus smiled and explained:
"Your card can also cut any two ropes between two people... except the two people are randomly selected."
Li Hua's expression changed slightly upon hearing this."Completely random... That's not good," he murmured.
Beside him, Old Man Radish also showed concern.
"This... what should we do?"
Lin Yu perfectly understood why someone with three ropes and an apparently good relationship with Robin would worry. Because they were good people.
If kindness could be quantified, both Li Hua from [Order] and Old Man Radish from the [Player Mutual Aid Association] would undoubtedly score over 90 on the kindness scale!
[Order] needs no introduction - it's practically the most reliable and upright organization, true to its name in punishing evil and promoting good. Li Hua, who became a city Game Master, embodies proper values through and through.
Although the [Player Mutual Aid Association] leans neutral, it has always been an extremely friendly organization. This cheerful Old Man Radish had already demonstrated through actions that he genuinely wished others well.
While most players in the "Death Game" entered driven by strong survival instincts and developed a layer of madness that made them view others' lives as worthless in this survival game...
Old Man Radish was different from most players. Lin Yu strongly suspected this old man's reason for not wanting to die when entering the "Death Game" was... probably not some selfish motive.
Of course, perhaps this was all an act - Lin Yu wasn't above suspecting the worst of people. But if it were an act, his performance was too convincing. Moreover...
What difference is there between someone who pretends to be good their whole life and someone who truly is good?
Thus, Lin Yu understood Li Hua and Radish's instinctive reactions. They were genuinely weighing the "total number of ropes", trying to minimize "casualties" in this segment. Though the two might still have differences.
Radish probably sincerely wished for everyone present to survive. But... when push came to shove, Li Hua might be willing to sacrifice a few "deserving" individuals. Like key members from the [Free Alliance], [Marauders], and [Psychological Society].
Thinking this, Lin Yu suddenly felt stiff. He was among them too! Although he had four ropes, it wasn't completely safe!
This realization gave Lin Yu a headache. "Although it's indeed a simple round... for me, it seems to be getting increasingly dangerous!"
Even the pattern Li Hua deduced wasn't much help to Lin Yu. After all... he didn't know which dungeon was [Fluoxetine]'s most humiliating experience.
"But looking at it now, it's not completely without gains..."
"If absolutely necessary... I'll gamble with that newly acquired 'buff'..."
Lin Yu pondered internally.
After Li Hua... Old Man Radish volunteered to go next. Clearly, the old man hoped to quickly draw a "Knot Card" to ease the current situation.
Ka the Octopus accordingly served the old man a dessert. "The dessert prepared for you is called [Harvest Season]."
"May your grand wish come true, noble and diligent farmer."
It was a golden wheat ear with a sealed cover. Following Li Hua's deduction, Old Man Radish activated his ability on the wheat ear...
One realistic-looking wheat grain disappeared from the ear - there was actually a real wheat grain mixed into this dessert's imitation wheat. The grain transformed into a fragrant cream bun with words printed on top:
"The most delicious food."
Old Man Radish stared blankly at these six characters, sighed deeply after a long pause. "Li Hua, the pattern you mentioned... holds true for me too."
He slowly stroked the wheat ear, found another real wheat grain hidden in the imitation wheat, and activated his ability again. A brown sugar dumpling appeared in Radish's hand. He put it in his mouth, chewed slowly, then soon spat out a card - the dumpling had hidden this card inside.
Radish smiled bitterly: "I used to love dumplings... After that dungeon where no one but me survived, I never ate them again."
Robin seemed to understand: "Was that when the [Player Mutual Aid Association] suffered heavy losses?"
Hearing this, Radish paused, then shook his head with a smile. "Snowy Owl really treats you as a successor, telling you even this..."
"Yes, that time, three veteran members took five younger ones to play a game together..."
"And then... total wipeout."
Radish said leisurely, placing the card on the table and exhaling heavily.
"Enough, no point elaborating..."
"The card I got seems decent, at least it's not scissors."
He tapped the card. "Octopus host, what does this 'gray rope' mean?"
Ka the Octopus examined the card's content and laughed. "Oh—congratulations, it's an [Iron Rope Card]!"
"After use, one of your ropes and one random rope on the field will be replaced with 'iron ropes' that can withstand being cut once!"
As Ka the Octopus explained, Old Man Radish nodded. He unhurriedly finished the dumpling and bun, then slowly ate the entire wheat ear dessert. After Ka the Octopus took away the plate and Radish confirmed completing this challenge...
"I'll use this [Iron Rope Card] right now!" Radish declared resolutely.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: The Banquet Reaches Its Climax, The Perilous Dessert Round
chapters.content:
After Radish finished speaking, the [Iron Rope Card] immediately took effect.
One of the ropes behind Radish instantly gained a metallic sheen.
As for the other one...
It activated behind "Robin."
Seeing this result, Phantom sighed.
"Truly... money flows to those who already have plenty!"
"Why didn't I get even one?"
Li Hua adjusted his glasses.
"From a probability standpoint, this makes sense."Follow current novels on noᴠelfire.net
"Those with more ropes have a higher chance of being randomly selected... The same applies when choosing which ropes to sever."Li Hua explained seriously.
Phantom shrugged helplessly.
"Fine, fine..."
He looked resignedly at Ka the Octopus.
"Seems fate should remain in one's own hands—I'll have a dessert, please."
"Coming right up!"
Ka the Octopus replied cheerfully.
Having observed several previous rounds and summarized the patterns, Phantom's turn went even more smoothly than Li Hua's.
"The dessert prepared for you is called [Walking Cane]."
"May your magic earn universal admiration while remaining forever unbroken, esteemed Magician."
The dessert served to Phantom was a cane-shaped cake.
Almost immediately, Phantom utilized his basic ability as a 『Magician』.
A Magician's ability allows them to convert an object into a [Temporary Prop] as a [Magic Prop], which can then be stored in their prop space and bound to them for the duration of this dungeon.
The conversion requires physical contact—the more complex or powerful the prop, the longer the contact needed.
But Phantom didn't even need to touch this cake to complete the transformation.
When he retrieved the cake from his [Prop Space], it now had ten numbered candles (0 through 9) stuck into it, along with the words "Happy Birthday."
Phantom sighed at the sight.
"I knew it... This is just cruel!"
With a snap of his fingers, a small flame flickered to life between them.
He then lit the candle marked "5."
The moment it ignited, the number 5 candle burst into dazzling sparkler-like flames, from which a card suddenly popped out.
Phantom turned the card over—it bore the image of a pitch-black pair of scissors.
He frowned. "Hey, Octopus... What's the difference between this black scissors card and the previous two?"
"Don't tell me this one's meant to kill us all."
Ka shook his head with a smile. "Not at all! It simply cuts five random ropes in play... completely at random!"
"Whose ropes get cut... is entirely, entirely uncertain!"
Ka explained cheerfully.
Phantom nodded.
"Ah, got it."
He then began enjoying his cake.
Soon...
Phantom finished his dessert.
He picked up the card and declared:
"I choose to use this random card now."
As he spoke, Phantom revealed the black [Scissors Card].
Li Hua's expression changed slightly as he moved to stop him—
But it was too late.
"Snap! Snap! Snap! Snap!"
Four consecutive snapping sounds rang out as ropes belonging to Li Hua, Robin, and Fish were severed!
Li Hua lost two ropes in one go!
Instantly, the 『Gambler』 who had just returned to the safety line of three ropes was back down to only one!
Fish was equally unlucky, unable to suppress a curse.
"Damn it, Phantom! I just renewed my ropes!"
Robin's ropes were protected by the [Iron Rope Card].
But she still lost one—clearly, without Radish's card, she would have lost two!
The sudden imbalance from her first rope breaking startled the 『Painter』.
However, with three ropes remaining, she quickly steadied herself.
Watching everyone's precarious state, Mosin-Nagant glanced at Lin Yu, who was watching with amused interest.
Seeing the other still silent, Mosin-Nagant gritted his teeth and spoke:
"I'll take a dessert, please!"
At his request, Ka the Octopus enthusiastically began preparing.
"The dessert prepared for you is called [Prey Encyclopedia]."
"May every hunt bring plentiful rewards, esteemed Hunter."
A thick book stood on the plate, its pages open to the table of contents.
Mosin-Nagant pondered for a moment.
"How to apply a 『Hunter』's ability to this..."
He murmured, then...
Mosin-Nagant closed his eyes.
He drew a dart from his pocket and threw it blindly at the book.
"Pretty clever thinking..."
Lin Yu remarked admiringly.
Under the influence of the 『Hunter』 ability, even with closed eyes, Mosin-Nagant could land the dart on the book.
However...
Even with enhanced "accuracy," he couldn't control where exactly it would land.
Mid-flight, the dart's trajectory suddenly twisted unnaturally before embedding itself in a specific page number on the contents.
As if "sucked" toward it.
Opening his eyes, Mosin-Nagant wasn't surprised as he flipped to that page.
The book was exquisitely crafted—though made of sugar, its pages turned effortlessly.
That page depicted four animals:
Elk, python, wild boar, and buffalo.
While others were confused, Mosin-Nagant's expression sharpened.
He drew a dagger from his waist and stabbed it straight into the elk's heart on the page.
The elk actually appeared to grimace in pain as a blood-red liquid oozed from the wound.
The liquid dripped onto the plate, solidifying and coalescing into a card.
Ignoring the card for now, Mosin-Nagant continued cutting the sugar book with his knife.
He chopped it into small pieces, spearing them with his knife to eat.
Only then did he pick up the card from the plate.
"What does this mean?"
The card depicted scissors and a knotted rope.
Ka applauded.
"Congratulations! You've obtained the [Rope Exchange Card]!"
"This card's function is..."
"Randomly cut one rope and reconnect another!"
As Ka explained, Mosin-Nagant didn't seem entirely pleased.
Li Hua, however, sighed in relief.
"At least in terms of total rope count... it's neutral..."
He muttered.
Mosin-Nagant turned to Li Hua.
"『Order』's Game Master... This card seems useless to me. Should I use it now?"
"I get the sense you're planning something—so I'll do you a favor and let you decide when to use it."
After some thought, Li Hua said, "No need to rush..."
But Lin Yu suddenly interjected:
"I think... now would actually be the perfect time to use it."
He cut off Li Hua with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Lucky Sweetness, A Perfect Yet Desperate Situation!
chapters.content:
At this point in the [Dessert] segment, no one believed the "difficulty" lay in completing their respective desserts anymore.
Even without Li Hua's earlier summary...
Everyone could easily deduce through trial and error how to find the cards and avoid their "punishments."
Yet this stage remained challenging.
The true difficulty lay in how to handle these "cards."
Whether intentional or not, Ka the Octopus had misled Li Hua and others with that second "reconnecting" card.
Admittedly...
The cards that severed ropes and those that reconnected/protected ropes were split fifty-fifty.
But the quantities were completely unbalanced!
From Li Hua's perspective of considering "total rope numbers"...Among the six cards revealed so far, those severing ropes far outnumbered the reconnecting ones.
Thus...
Allocating these cards became the real challenge.
Li Hua had to consider this with extreme caution.
Lin Yu naturally noticed this too.
"You want to see what card I draw before deciding, don't you... using yours and Robin's cards as bargaining chips."
He rested his chin on his hand, staring at Li Hua.
"But I refuse."
Without waiting for Li Hua's response, Lin Yu turned to Ka the Octopus.
"Hey octopus, can I delay preparing my [Dessert] until after these three have used all their cards?"
Ka the Octopus blinked, then nodded.
"Of course."
Guests requesting dessert service at any time was "perfectly proper table etiquette."
After receiving confirmation, Lin Yu looked back at Li Hua.
"Hey, 'Gambler'... your scheme failed."
Li Hua's expression flickered briefly before settling into calm.
"Her unwillingness to cooperate was within my expectations..."
"Then... let's begin with Mosin-Nagant."
Mosin-Nagant nodded and used his [Rope Exchange Card]!
Upon activation...
"Bang!"
No ropes severed on the field—instead, another rope reconnected behind Phantom.
"Mine was cut."
Radish turned to observe the ropes behind him.
Three ropes remained behind him, but...
The metallic sheen on one had vanished.
Just as Li Hua prepared to speak and use his own card...
Lin Yu abruptly interrupted again.
"Hey—Robin, you said you owe me, right?"
"Time to repay that debt."
"Use your card... but don't make a selection, okay?"
"I'm not asking you not to use it against me, but... let 'fate' decide, how about that?"
Lin Yu smiled cheerfully at Robin.
"After all, currently nobody has exactly two ropes—only more than two."
"So those with single ropes won't be targeted—while someone like me with four ropes faces the greatest risk."
Robin hesitated, then asked Ka the Octopus: "Is he telling the truth?"
"Indeed—the two [Scissors Cards] in play cannot target those without exactly two ropes remaining."
Ka the Octopus confirmed.
"And if you'd prefer not to choose... I'd be happy to choose for you."
Li Hua's expression darkened, sensing a trap.
But before he could intervene...
"I may dislike you, but... a debt is a debt."
Robin murmured as she raised her card.
"I'll use my card... and I won't make a selection."
"Bang!"
The rope behind her snapped instantly.
Only one rope remained beneath Robin's chair!
Her body lurched violently as she gasped, nearly toppling off.
But Robin reacted swiftly, pulling out a marker to sketch lines mid-air.
These lines instantly replaced the severed rope, stabilizing her chair.
Still shaken, Robin clutched the chairback as she climbed up, glaring at Lin Yu.
"Fluoxetine... now we're even!"
She declared firmly.
Li Hua gritted his teeth: "Idiot, you've been played by this 'Psychological Society' bastard—she tricked you!"
"I just used my last stored ability to see—her rope's 'severance probability' was practically 0%!"
"This bitch used some 'luck-based' [item] to eliminate unfavorable random outcomes."
Li Hua turned coldly to Lin Yu: "Well done, 'Fluoxetine'—are you trying to kill us all?"
"I never imagined you'd possess a luck-enhancing item!"
Lin Yu laughed.
"I don't have one! I'm just... naturally lucky!"
He replied cheerfully.
Meanwhile, Lin Yu reflected internally...
Those earlier uses of [Teeth of Prophecy] hadn't been wasted.
He'd activated [Teeth of Prophecy] earlier.
The timing...
Was when he produced the [Flavor Papers] for the second time.
Back then, Lin Yu actually held only one genuine [Flavor Paper].
The rest were mere scraps.
Using [Teeth of Prophecy], he'd implanted the statement: "Obviously because that [cupcake] didn't cost '58 sheets'" into everyone's minds.
Under its influence, everyone naturally believed Lin Yu's subsequent claim that he still possessed 57 flavor papers.
In reality, only his first [Flavor Paper] was authentic.
This deception served one purpose...
To "freeload" a food item worth 57 flavor papers.
As someone who'd actually interacted with gods, Lin Yu might lag behind other players in some aspects.Follow current novels on novel•fire.net
But—
His understanding of gods matched any veteran present.
Thus Lin Yu knew...
Any item connected to gods would be extraordinary.
Especially in a dungeon hosted by a specific god—its provided items might intertwine intricately with the dungeon's mechanics.
Just as he'd predicted...
The [cupcake] obtained by expending one [Teeth of Prophecy] granted him an ability ensuring invincibility in this [Dessert] segment.
The [cupcake] bestowed [Lucky Sweetness]!
Its effect...
[Until your next meal, receive massively enhanced "luck."]
With increasing "random cards" this round, Lin Yu naturally activated [Lucky Sweetness] without hesitation.
"Go ahead, Li Hua..."
"Use your card."
Lin Yu made an inviting gesture.
The 'Gambler' Li Hua exhaled deeply.
"Everyone, my apologies... for delivering you into this madwoman 'Fluoxetine's' hands."
He then used his [Scissors Card].
Four ropes snapped instantly—two each from behind Phantom and Mosin-Nagant.
When the dust settled...
The battlefield presented a bizarre scene.
Lin Yu's chair retained all four ropes!
While the other six participants each dangled precariously from a single remaining rope!
"See? I really am quite lucky!"
Observing their unsteady postures and tense expressions, Lin Yu remarked lightly.
His voice brimmed with delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 173: The Perfect Solution and Invitation
chapters.content:
Lin Yu's admiration for his own "good luck" came from the heart.
Although his "luck" in this round stemmed from the [Lucky Sweetness] buff effect...
To achieve such an overwhelmingly advantageous position relying solely on [Lucky Sweetness]...
There must have been some fate-level "good fortune" beyond just [Lucky Sweetness].
"Even smoother than anticipated."
Lin Yu exhaled deeply before turning his gaze toward the players literally "hanging by a thread."
Then, Lin Yu looked at Ka the Octopus.
Their eyes met, and then...
Ka the Octopus smiled and spoke: "Guest, you're the only one left..."
"Now, would you like to enjoy your dessert?"Hearing Ka's question, Lin Yu chuckled.
He didn't immediately answer the octopus's inquiry...
Instead, Lin Yu surveyed the other six participants.
"Right now—all of you, or at least three people, owe me your lives."
Then, Lin Yu tapped the table and looked back at Ka.
"Apologies, chef..."
"I'm full."
Lin Yu spoke calmly.
He rejected Ka.
An expression of astonishment appeared on Ka's face.
He stared incredulously at Lin Yu before asking: "You mean you're refusing the dessert?"
"Of course, I'm too full. No point wasting food, right?"
Lin Yu grinned broadly.
"I sneaked a cupcake earlier—already had my dessert!"
His expression suggested genuine satiation as the reason for declining.
Ka regarded Lin Yu with something resembling admiration.
"Acceptable... but refusing means accepting punishment."
Lin Yu rested his chin on one hand.
"Fine by me."
He didn't even ask what the punishment entailed.
Seeing Lin Yu's resolve, Ka retrieved a button from the pool.
"Snap!"
With Ka pressing the button...
One of the ropes in front of Lin Yu's left side snapped.
Just as Li Hua had predicted, the "punishment" only severed one rope.
And for Lin Yu, who currently had four ropes...
This was utterly inconsequential.
He merely felt his chair wobble slightly more.
This was precisely why Lin Yu had fought so hard to maintain "four ropes."
From observing others who'd lost ropes...
Losing one rope with three remaining still provided relative stability.
But losing two...
Would make the chair tilt dangerously in one direction, becoming unusable.
And with only one rope left...
Without reinforcement methods, the chair would swing wildly or even spin.
Unfortunately...
Compared to other players, Lin Yu lacked accumulated [standard items].
Losing two ropes without reinforcement would guarantee greater risk.
Most crucially, Lin Yu needed to maintain his 'Fluoxetine' persona...
Thus, the optimal strategy was keeping at least three ropes.
With four ropes...
Lin Yu could comfortably choose to forfeit outright.
This way.
Whether Ka served some [Assassin]-related item Lin Yu had never heard of...
Or even directly presented something related to [Fraudster]...
Neither scenario would occur!
This was Lin Yu's strategy.
If the [dessert] might expose him...
Then paying a small price to prevent its appearance altogether was ideal.
After Lin Yu made this decision...
Not just Ka, but all other players showed stunned expressions.
Even for the irrational madman Fluoxetine who defied expectations...
This move was abnormally unconventional.
"Why?"
Li Hua looked at Lin Yu and asked solemnly.
Lin Yu had anticipated questions about his "motives."
He'd carefully orchestrated this scenario precisely to explain his "motives."
A Fluoxetine-style justification that would convince everyone.
One that conveniently connected to his entire performance's "ultimate purpose."
"Do I need to explain myself to you, [Gambler]?"
Lin Yu smirked before continuing.
"But... since you asked, I'll humor you."
"Like I said, you all owe me your lives."
He glanced at Ka.
"The final card's effect is 'everyone loses one rope.'"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ novelFirｅ.net
Hearing this, all players displayed shock.
"What?!"
Robin exclaimed.
Mosin-Nagant nearly stood up: "How could you know that?"
"I knew all the card contents in advance," Lin Yu tapped his temple, fabricating confidently, "This is a god-watched dungeon, a divine banquet, and I recognize each participant's potential..."
"So if any of you died during this penultimate [dessert] round... I'd be devastated!"
"Because that would be utterly ridiculous!"
Despite the absurd claims, Lin Yu's delivery was so natural that nobody doubted his knowledge of the final card.
Ka didn't interrupt—because Lin Yu knew the octopus was equally unaware of future "cards"!
Having decided early to "reject" the dessert...
Lin Yu had observed the [dessert] interactions differently.
He'd discovered a crucial fact...
No cards were pre-placed by Ka.
All cards emerged through "interaction" between [dessert] and players!
Therefore...
Ka likely didn't know the desserts beforehand.
Having successfully bluffed Ka and the players...
Everything progressed exactly as Lin Yu's "script" demanded.
Li Hua calculated silently before concluding:
"So... after this round, maximum remaining ropes per person is four!"
"Obviously, did you think the 'gods' designed this game for cozy tea parties?" Lin Yu retorted sharply, "That's why I left you all with just one rope..."
"While I don't want deaths before the finale, I won't let you enter the final round with excessive safety margins."
"With so many elites gathered at this fated banquet by divine invitation..."
"We must maximize drama to match the 'Mad Banquet Beyond Heaven' title!"
"The final showdown between geniuses and gods demands walking the razor's edge between survival and eternal damnation—that's the climax I demand!"
Lin Yu stood up dramatically, pointing skyward.
"Comrades, if you survive this dungeon... come find me!"
"I'll be waiting atop Jiangcheng's twilight rainbows, where thirty silver coins chime through the night!"

chapters.title: Chapter 174: The Final Segment, God of the Banquet
chapters.content:
"What's all this nonsense about rainbow silver coins clattering?" Fish scratched her brightly colored hair. "Fluoxetine, can you speak human language for once?"
Facing Fish's challenge, Lin Yu remained silent, simply returning to his seat.
While Fish had directly voiced her doubts, the others were also deep in thought, pondering Lin Yu's cryptic words.
However...
This clearly wasn't the "best time" to decipher Lin Yu's riddles.
After all, everyone was still in the midst of a "crisis"!
Ka the Octopus's voice rang out.
"Well then, everyone, the [Dessert] segment has also concluded. Let us now proceed to the final segment of tonight's banquet..."
As Ka spoke, the ropes once again exerted an upward pulling force.
Everyone was dragged upwards by the ropes, and soon...They seemed to break through an invisible membrane.
The surroundings transformed once more as a sweet aroma filled everyone's nostrils.
They had abruptly transitioned from the serene, empty skies ten thousand meters above to...
Hovering above an enormous banquet table laden with exquisite dishes.
The table was unimaginably vast, resembling an entire mountain range.
Every soup tureen and plate on this banquet table was several times larger than the dining table around which Lin Yu and the others had been seated.
Looking around, this mountain-like banquet table was placed within a magnificently golden banquet hall.
And most importantly...
The giant in white robes seated at this table.
The giant's head resembled a crystal decanter, with facial features depicted by simple lines drawn upon it.
One of its hands stretched above Lin Yu's group's table—five different threads tied to each finger.
These threads descended downward...
They were the very ropes attached to the table and everyone's chairs!
Ka addressed this giant respectfully.
"My Lord, these are the guests attending tonight's banquet!"
From Ka's words and the surrounding scene...
The identity of this decanter-headed giant was self-evident.
It was the "God of Banquets, Wine, and Revelry"—the host of this feast!
A genuine...
Deity!
The deity looked at the seven individuals seated around the table and spoke.
"Oh—so these are my invited guests!"
"Excellent work, Ka! It seems everyone has been well entertained!"
Its voice was warm and cheerful, like the most welcoming party host imaginable.
The players at the table held their breaths, too nervous to speak.
Although this banquet had differed from ordinary dungeons from the very beginning...
Directly "meeting a deity" was still far beyond everyone's expectations.
Especially since...
This God of Banquets, Wine, and Revelry seemed intent on personally hosting the final segment of the game!
Sure enough, the massive deity spoke.
"Having arrived here, I trust you've all been properly entertained by Ka..."
"All that remains for my honored guests is the [After-Dinner Drinks]!"
"As host of this banquet... I shall personally serve everyone a drink for this final segment!"
As it spoke, all the players were shocked to discover...
They were each inexplicably holding a glass!
Even Lin Yu was startled.
"When did this get here?!"
The glasses seemed to have appeared naturally!
Moreover, everyone's right hands—which had been resting casually on the table or their laps—were now uniformly holding glasses at chest level.
This was the power of a "deity"?
Compared to feats like moving mountains or summoning storms, it was this moment that struck Lin Yu with the greatest awe and impact.
Because...
This deity had manipulated his body without him even noticing!
The other players wore similarly shocked expressions.
The God of Revelry's voice sounded again.
"Of course—as you've likely realized, my banquets aren't merely about enjoying delicacies, but also include many entertaining 'game' segments!"
"So... this [drink] is no exception."
"Ka, please explain the rules to our guests!"
The cheerful deity spoke, and Ka immediately responded.
"As you command, my Lord."
"Honored guests, in this final [After-Dinner Drinks] segment, you will taste specially crafted beverages prepared by our Lord."
"However, each of your drinks is an incomplete semi-finished product with flaws and deficiencies."Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn .net
"You must complete these drinks yourselves."
"Based on how you complete them, our Lord will administer rewards or punishments—the punishment remains severing ropes, with varying quantities."
"As for rewards... you may receive new ropes, again in varying quantities."
After Ka finished explaining, the God of Revelry spoke again.
"Precisely, precisely—everyone, I eagerly anticipate the novel flavors and innovative drinks you'll present me!"
As it spoke...
A splashing sound suddenly came from everyone's glasses.
The liquid levels in each glass rose seemingly from nothing.
Each glass contained liquid of a different color.
Old Man Radish examined the amber liquid in his glass—without even tasting it, a single sniff was enough.
"Hmm, mine is... tea?"
Mosin-Nagant observed the milky-white liquid in his glass.
"This appears to be some dairy product?"
Li Hua frowned. "Mine should be coffee."
Phantom shook his glass of bubbling orange liquid.
"Huh? Why do I get Fanta?"
Robin looked at the red liquid in her hand. "Mine looks like watermelon juice..."
Lin Yu sighed as he examined the clear liquid in his glass.
Though it appeared to be water...
An intensely pungent aroma reminded him exactly what it was.
"How did I end up with hard liquor? What proof is this anyway?"
Moreover, the glass was quite large—holding at least 500 milliliters...
Lin Yu rarely drank, so he doubted his alcohol tolerance was that good.
Frankly, few normal people could consume 500ml of hard liquor without getting drunk.
"Thank goodness this is the final segment, but this is still pretty unlucky."
Lin Yu sighed.
However...
At least he wasn't the most unfortunate one.
Over there, Fish was holding an entire glass of green liquid, her face equally green.
"What's the meaning of this, octopus chef... and you, decanter-headed deity."
"Sure, I currently live in Beijing in real life, but I'm a second-generation immigrant!"
"My ID number doesn't even start with those prestigious three digits—heck, I get called a 'stinking out-of-towner' daily in Beijing... And even if I were local, this is taking stereotypes too far!"
Clutching her glass, Fish spoke through gritted teeth.
"Why do they all get normal stuff like tea and coffee, while I'm stuck with a full glass of fermented bean juice?"

chapters.title: Chapter 175: You Have No Right to Crown Me
chapters.content:
Hearing Fish grit her teeth in frustration, Lin Yu felt somewhat balanced in his heart.
Although the strong liquor was terrible...
Compared to a full cup of fermented bean juice... it seemed almost acceptable?
And when faced with Fish's questioning, the lofty god actually responded.
"The form of the liquid in the cup is merely a vessel..."
"Rest assured, I guarantee you'll be satisfied."
As the God of Banquets, Wine, and Revelry spoke, its drawn facial features revealed a smug expression.
"Even as a semi-finished product... it's enough to immerse you all!"
"So—please take a sip."
The god's voice echoed across the banquet table.Though cheerful in tone, it left no room for refusal.
The players had no choice but to raise their cups and take small sips of the liquid.
Lin Yu was no exception.
He took a shallow taste—the fiery liquor burned every inch from his tongue to his throat.
Yet within this intensity lay a rich, mellow aroma.
"It's good..."
Few first-time drinkers of strong liquor actually enjoy its taste initially.
But even Lin Yu, who knew nothing about alcohol, could detect its "deliciousness" now.
Moreover...
Just like all the previous dishes, there was something beyond just flavor.
An indescribable emotion surged in Lin Yu's heart.
"Honored guests... why do people hold and attend banquets?"
The voice of the God of Banquets, Wine, and Revelry rang in everyone's ears.
"Sometimes, to dull unforgettable sorrow."
"Other times, to celebrate a bountiful hunt."
"Sometimes, to mask irreparable regrets."
"And sometimes, simply... to seek joy."
"Whatever brings you here, I hope in this moment, you can all enjoy this instant."
"So... please savor this drink."
"Its name is [Best Daydream]."
As the god's words faded...
Lin Yu felt the growing intensity of emotions in his heart.
Pure "joy and satisfaction."
And as these feelings deepened, they transformed into "longing."
For the first time, Lin Yu saw the manifestation of his innermost desires.
In a daze, he glimpsed vague visions of the future.
Like a daydream—not entirely real, yet seemingly within reach.
On a red carpet, countless spotlights flashed, focused solely on him.
As if he were the center of the world.
He walked calmly down this glittering path into the venue.
The big screen played a film starring him.
It didn't seem like a mainstream commercial movie, yet his acting transcended the genre's limitations, enthralling audiences worldwide—even the professional critics present.
Countless masterful performances flashed briefly on screen, serving only as his backdrop.
Everyone else was merely supporting cast...
And without doubt, at this ceremony representing the pinnacle of "film and theater," he had achieved the highest honor an actor could attain!
More than that, everyone knew...
His achievement surpassed the combined worth of all previous winners!
The roaring crowd chanted his name—these "viewers" seemed more devout than "believers"!
Lin Yu rose from his seat and walked toward the stage under the spotlights, toward his glory.
There, a heavy trophy awaited him like a throne anticipating its king.
But standing before it, Lin Yu suddenly stopped.
"Hmm... so if the [Main Course] was the past, then the [After-Dinner Drink] is the future?"
He raised his hand.
Though inappropriate, Lin Yu looked down to find a glass of liquor in his hand—definitely not what an award-winning actor should be holding at such a ceremony.
"It really sneaks up on you," Lin Yu muttered.
Now he understood—those who ate the [Main Course] not only gained the advantage of "two extra ropes," but more importantly, experienced this "illusion" before others.
While the [Appetizer] had offered similar visions, those were sorrowful memories—completely different in nature.
Of course, what truly made Lin Yu "snap out" so quickly was...
"Why did you skip the best part?!"
He glared at the screen with dissatisfaction—even resentment.
Whether illusion or future...
Jumping straight to the awards ceremony?!
Why couldn't he experience acting in the film that earned him global acclaim?!
What incredible production team and script must that have been!
And all those top actors working alongside him...
Not only keeping up but outperforming them?!
Just how well had he performed?
Not just performance—what level had his acting skills reached then?
Why couldn't he experience that part?
He wanted to act!
Right now!
How could this god think he cared about receiving awards?This text is hosted at NovєlFіre.net
"Now I see why this drink is flawed—called [Best Daydream], but nowhere near 'best'... it's actually frustrating!"
Even in drama club, he disliked fan meet-and-greets after performances.
Lin Yu enjoyed attention—but only onstage, while acting.
"But... how to improve it?"
Unlike the previous two visions where he was merely an observer or snapped back to reality immediately, here he could move freely within this "daydream."
In fact, after regaining awareness, his surroundings became clearer.
Men and women in formal attire, the extravagantly decorated stage, flashing camera lights.
Lin Yu guessed that his actions within this drink-induced "illusion"...
Might actually complete the beverage's formula.
Yet even with free movement...
Lin Yu couldn't actually perform—he lacked the ability to rewrite the entire scene!
But soon, the answer came to him.
Holding the liquor, he approached the stage as the excited host announced:
"Let's welcome our newest Best Actor, Lin Yu, to receive his award and speak!"
Lin Yu nodded politely with a charming smile, accepted the golden trophy from the presenter, and stepped to the microphone.
"Thud—buzz!"
He struck the mic hard, sending a piercing feedback through the silent hall.
Satisfied by the quiet, Lin Yu leaned into the microphone and declared loudly:
"You bunch of theater-school idiots who've never acted, hypocrites praising political correctness, elitist tastemakers divorced from public aesthetics, opportunists treating drama as political games, mediocre peers bowing to capital and vulgar trends, media sheep chasing trends without original thought, and pitiful audiences brainwashed into fixed tastes—I don't need your pathetic recognition or the sad honors you bestow!"
With that, he smashed the trophy to the ground.
"Crash!"
The award shattered into pieces.
"You... have no right to crown me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Awakening and Negotiation
chapters.content:
What could be more satisfying for Lin Yu than "winning an acting award and going on stage to receive it"?
Of course, refusing the award!
If he couldn't act...
This scenario better matched Lin Yu's idea of a "daydream."
This was what he had always wanted to do.
As the trophy shattered, the "illusion" froze.
After Lin Yu's scathing verbal assault, the shocked expressions of the hosts, guests, and audience members all froze in place.
The only one who could still move was Lin Yu.
And...
The God of Banquets, Wine, and Revelry who appeared beside him."I see now!"
This liquor-bottle-headed figure wore floor-length white robes, holding an engraved golden goblet in his left hand and a kylix pottery cup in his right, swaying as he looked around.
He had now taken on a human-sized form, even slightly shorter than Lin Yu.
The God of Revelry marveled at the scene around Lin Yu.
"Truly impressive... Even better than 'the honor of being adored by thousands' is 'the feeling of trampling on the hollow fame others desperately pursue'..."
"I never even considered this possibility before!"
The deity lavished praise without restraint.
"I'll give you full marks... guest... full marks!"
The God of Revelry said excitedly.
Lin Yu remained relatively calm in the face of this sudden divine appearance.
"I simply followed my heart's desire."
Hearing Lin Yu's words, the painted features on the liquor bottle head transformed into an expression of fervent admiration.
"This is your most precious quality... this level of 'obsession' and 'sincerity,' such wonderful yet unconscious 'arrogance' and 'wit'..."
"And you're even the first to complete it!"
"Ka already told me—neither his prized Mourning Wine from Kirishima Vineyard nor A Victor's Blood Runs Ever Sweet had the slightest effect on you..."
"No wonder you're the seventh 'uninvited guest' at this banquet!"
"I'll be keeping an eye on you... If you became my follower, my agent, you'd surely bring about the most interesting banquets and greatest joys!"
The God of Revelry stepped closer—
"So... guest, might you be interested?"
Before Lin Yu could answer, the god suddenly raised a finger.
"Wait, wait, don't answer yet—let's finish the banquet proceedings first."
With a crisp snap of his fingers, the frozen illusion shattered and Lin Yu returned to his chair.
The god's voice echoed from above:
"Adding 'arrogance' to 'honor'... brilliant concept, perfect harmony!"
"I award you five ropes!"
Five ropes descended before Lin Yu.
The transparent liquor in his glass clinked as several sharply angled ice cubes appeared.
He raised his glass to the deity in salute, then drained it in one gulp.
The cold ice made the strong liquor's taste sharper, reducing the burning sensation while adding layers to its rich aroma.
Beyond just his mouth, a light tipsy feeling emerged.
"Whew—"
Lin Yu exhaled a concentrated breath of alcohol.
Though he couldn't explain why...
This drink's "experience" truly felt best described as "arrogance."
He took the opportunity to observe the other players.
Each held their own glass, eyes vacant as if immersed in pleasant illusions.
Clearly...
As the god had said.
Lin Yu was the first to "complete" and "awaken."
And judging by progress...
He remained far ahead.
