"Though I'm inferior to these veteran players and experts in many ways—they're all geniuses far beyond me—I'm not completely worthless compared to them either."
Lin Yu mused to himself.
As he reflected, the hovering god gave him a peculiar look.
That strange expression seemed to say...
"How did this person think to add 'arrogance' to the drink just now?"
Best Daydream reflected each person's inner desires—to complete this drink required using one's most genuine, intense "emotions."
Yet this guest's current reaction seemed excessively humble?
But the God of Revelry, true to his name, didn't dwell on such questions.
Besides...
Another player had awakened.
Lin Yu looked across the table at Fish.
She exhaled, looking thoroughly satisfied.
"That was awesome!"
The god's voice sounded again from above:
"Adding 'slaughter' to 'victory'... a decent idea."
"I award you two ropes!"
Two ropes descended before Fish.
Just from the god's description, Lin Yu could guess Fish's dream and actions.
This girl must have dreamed of fighting someone and annihilating her opponents.
The color of the soybean milk in her hand had deepened slightly.
Fish chugged the entire cup, then made a face.
"Still packs a punch... but..."
"With this salty flavor balancing it, it's surprisingly decent now."
As she spoke, she noticed the other obviously awake person.
"Oh, Sister Nail? First again?"
The Best Daydream must have truly pleased Fish—her mood seemed excellent.
Earlier she'd been calling Lin Yu "Fluoxetine"...
Now she'd reverted to the original nickname "Sister Nail," reflecting her shifting mood.
"Yes, first again."
Lin Yu smiled.
Fish blinked admiringly. "As expected from the Psychological Society—your mental resistance really is strong."Thɪs Nove1Fire.net
"But speaking of which... five ropes in front of you?"
"Your reward?"
Lin Yu didn't deny it: "Of course."
"That amazing? How'd you do it?"
Fish asked instinctively.
Lin Yu tilted his head slightly with a light smile: "That's a secret, Fish."
Fish didn't press, just shrugged.
"Alright, back to your cryptic nonsense..."
"Just like that earlier riddle—all twisted and impossible to understand!"
But her attention soon shifted elsewhere.
"Hey, the Gambler's out too!"
Beside Lin Yu, Li Hua also awakened.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Meeting with the God of Revelry
chapters.content:
After Li Hua awoke, the voice of the deity sounded again.
"You added 'leisure' to 'calm'... barely passable."
"I grant you one rope as reward."
Then, the others gradually woke up one after another.
The deity's voice continued to sound.
Among them, Phantom, Robin, and Fish each received two ropes like before.
Mosin-Nagant received one rope like Li Hua.
And Elder Radish once again demonstrated his good fortune, receiving a full three ropes.
After everyone finished their drinks...
The God of Revelry spoke again."Alright, honored guests... this banquet has now concluded."
"I will shortly send you all off—and provide corresponding souvenirs."
"The value of these souvenirs depends on how many ropes each of you possesses."
After the God of Revelry finished speaking, most people showed expressions of relief.
"Finally over..."
Elder Radish said with lingering fear.
Robin also nodded: "Indeed..."
Without doubt, even for these experts...
This dungeon had been extremely perilous.
In fact, given their strength and extensive experience, it had likely been a long time since they encountered a dungeon where their "lives hung by a thread."
But this time...
They had truly almost died—just moments ago, they had nearly fallen into an abyss of eternal damnation.
So...
When the deity himself declared the game was ending and drawing to a close.
They even felt an unreal sensation.
"Is it really over?"
This thought inevitably arose in everyone's mind.
However...
No matter what, having this messy and dangerous dungeon end here was still a good thing!
Of course, everyone present clearly understood...
Aside from the dungeon itself involving a deity and being extremely difficult, there was another reason for their disheveled state.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs novel✦fire.net
"Fluoxetine."
Li Hua looked at the young woman sitting beside him, chin resting on one hand, and called her name.
The Gambler's expression was extremely serious.
"After we leave, I will definitely come to Jiangcheng to find you."
"I hope you won't stand me up."
Lin Yu looked at Li Hua's serious expression and smiled radiantly.
"Then I'll be looking forward to it!"
After Lin Yu and Li Hua finished speaking...
"Whoosh—"
Li Hua's chair and his two ropes were suddenly lifted, his entire figure disappearing.
Mosin-Nagant vanished at the same time.
Next, the figures of Phantom, Robin, and Fish also disappeared.
Finally Elder Radish.
Within mere seconds, only Lin Yu remained among the players.
Then the deity's voice sounded again.
"So... have you considered what we discussed earlier?"
A new chair slowly descended, upon which sat a miniature version of the God of Revelry using a knife and fork to cut steak.
He speared a piece of steak into his mouth while looking at Lin Yu.
"I deliberately saved you for last—now no one will disturb our conversation."
Lin Yu looked at the God of Revelry, stroking his chin as he asked.
"I'm considering it, and... I have some questions for you, may I?"
"Of course," the God of Revelry said while spearing half a potato, "though I may not answer questions beyond the banquet's scope—after all, I'm not the God of Wisdom."
"You currently have eight ropes—I'll allow you to ask me two questions."
Lin Yu nodded.
"Two questions... that should suffice."
"My questions are also related to the 'banquet,' even specifically to this very banquet."
"First question—I want to know what that octopus would have served me if I had chosen to eat [dessert] earlier."
The God of Revelry looked toward Ka the Octopus who was washing dishes in the pool.
"Ka, our guest is asking you a question?"
Hearing this, Ka quickly raised his head.
"Oh, well... I was planning to make a dessert called [Narrative Trick], which would look roughly like a quill pen."
Hearing Ka's words, Lin Yu couldn't help but feel fortunate about his wise decision to refuse dessert earlier.
Thank goodness he hadn't accepted.
Otherwise, if this [Narrative Trick] had been served, Lin Yu truly wouldn't have known how to explain himself.
Of course...
Now with no one else around, Lin Yu could ask freely.
After all, this was equivalent to getting a preview of what one of his [Promotion] items might look like—not without its benefits.
It also helped confirm something...
"So the disguise of [False Face] can't fool deities and their agents after all."
Lin Yu sighed.
The God of Revelry interjected: "No, that thing altering your appearance on your face—neither Ka nor I can see through it."
"In fact, even during the 'daydream' earlier, I couldn't discern your true appearance."
"Even now, I can only vaguely perceive your identity—an existence equal to myself has obscured your information... I can only deduce from your banquet performance and dream content that your [Profession] is likely related to 'performance.'"
As the God of Revelry spoke, Lin Yu looked at him in surprise.
This deity didn't seem to be lying.
Rather... deities like the God of Change who take pleasure in deceiving mortals are probably rare exceptions.
Moreover, Lin Yu clearly knew who was likely helping conceal his identity.
The crow mark on his wrist told him everything.
So Lin Yu chose to believe what the God of Revelry said.
"Your guess is correct, both regarding profession and 'deity' matters..."
"So my second question is..."
"You said I was an uninvited guest—what did you mean?"
The God of Revelry set down his knife and fork, wiping his mouth with a napkin.
"Because the other six all received my personal invitations to attend... unlike other games they've participated in. What they saw was probably something like this."
The God of Revelry waved his hand, and a line of squirming blood text appeared:
['A special dungeon awaits your participation. Do you accept the invitation?']
"This dungeon was originally my preliminary test for selecting an agent. Those six were all players I've observed with some potential... Compared to them right now, your 'rank' is slightly lower, so you wouldn't understand."
"This banquet was actually greatly beneficial for their next step—once you've experienced the same number of [Promotions] as them, you'll understand."
"Of course, that's beside the point... back to you."
"Aside from inviting these six I personally selected, I reserved one random spot to be determined by 'fate.'"
"And what surprised me yet didn't surprise me..."
"Was that fate's chosen guest turned out to be the most suitable one."
"Although you've only recently entered this game, I believe..."
"You are the most fitting candidate to be my 'mortal world agent'!"
The God of Revelry spoke with absolute certainty.
Lin Yu looked at him and smiled as he replied:
"I'm honored by your high regard. My questions are finished."
"Then what is your decision?"
The God of Revelry asked eagerly.
Lin Yu's smile widened as he gave his answer.
"My decision is..."

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Sorting the Rewards
chapters.content:
[Congratulations on clearing the game "Banquet in the Skies"!]
[Calculating your rewards for this game session!]
[You have received the basic reward: 7 days of survival time.]
[Based on your performance in this game, you have earned the evaluation "Master of Control," granting an additional reward.]
[Additional reward: Randomly obtain one "non-exclusive item" reward.]
[Obtained non-exclusive item reward: Reusable Flavor Papers.]
[During this game session, you acquired 'Reward Vouchers,' which are now being exchanged for additional rewards...]
[Additional reward: Obtain two "item rewards."]
[Item: Banquet Pendant, now bound.]
[Item: Bliss Immortal Pot, now bound.][During this game session, you gained the favor of a god and received a special item bestowed by the deity.]
[Item: Pocket-Sized Chef Apprentice, now bound.]
Opening his eyes in the Settlement Space, Lin Yu didn't rush to check his rewards. Instead, he looked around. Observing the other Players examining their newly acquired items, Lin Yu could tell from their expressions that the Banquet God had been quite generous. Even Li Hua and Mosin-Nagant, who had only two ropes, seemed satisfied with what they'd obtained.
However, Lin Yu had no intention of reviewing his rewards here in the Settlement Space—nor did he plan to let others see them. He wasn't about to waste these final moments. Clapping his hands, the crisp sound drew everyone's attention.
"Hey, hey, ha~"
All eyes turned to Lin Yu as he smiled and spoke again.
"Everyone, everyone—while the god's invitation has concluded, don't forget about mine! Whether you want to kill me or bring however many people... I'll show up 'alone' for our appointment! You all remember the 'riddle' about the time and place, right? Well then... until we meet again!"
Lin Yu timed his final line perfectly, leaving no room for anyone to react before the Settlement Space's time limit expired. This was an actor's fundamental skill—mastering dialogue timing.
Upon reopening his eyes, the question that had troubled Lin Yu before jumping was suddenly answered. He found himself back on the rooftop's edge where he'd started.
"Oh, so the game really does have a 'Rewind' function," Lin Yu mused, climbing back from the ledge. The time was still just past midnight. Removing his False Face disguise, he casually strolled back down the fire escape, making sure to relock the door behind him.
Only then did Lin Yu begin examining his rewards. The Revelry God, as the deity presiding over banquets, proved exceptionally hospitable and generous—far surpassing a certain crow's stinginess. At the very least, unlike the Deadly Quiz dungeon personally designed by that crow god, this one actually offered extra reward evaluations. Lin Yu was certain his performance had met the Master of Control standard back then too! Not receiving rewards was purely due to that crow skimming off the top.
Though the Teeth of Prophecy and Tongue of Deceit were quite useful... Lin Yu had to work extremely hard to obtain them by unraveling lies and setting traps himself. Unlike this Banquet God, who practically threw items at him, even inventing reasons like "divine favor" to give more.
Thinking this, Lin Yu glanced at the crow mark on his wrist. "You supposedly favor me too—where's the actual support? I'm telling you, it's not too late to compensate me with eight or ten powerful items!" The mark remained unmoved. Shrugging without much disappointment, Lin Yu began cataloging his gains.
[Reusable Flavor Papers: Can be used in every dungeon. Simply hold them while making a request to randomly receive 1-57 falling Flavor Papers worth of food. Higher value foods have lower appearance probabilities.]
Having used Flavor Papers before, Lin Yu knew their value. Though he already had Chate's Supplies, that stuff was barely edible—clearwater crackers were mere sustenance rations. Even a single Flavor Paper guaranteed hot, delicious food. And the upper limit here was 57! Not that Chate's Supplies were useless—they could feed teammates, and had the hidden function of detecting others' fear.
But the Reusable Flavor Papers were the most ordinary reward this time. The real prizes came next.
[Banquet Pendant: Greatly increases the wearer's appetite, with chances to gain random buffs from eating. Can upgrade existing food buffs when consumed.]
[Bliss Immortal Pot: Allows the wearer to temporarily suspend active buffs and convert them into "Immortal Brew" stored in the pot. Drinking the brew reactivates the suspended buffs. Maximum three brews stored simultaneously.]
For Lin Yu, these two items were incredibly useful. Finally, he had means to enhance direct combat ability beyond deception! Gaining buffs from eating, then storing them—combined with Heavenly Artisan's hammers, the ready-to-use Syringe from Counterfeit, the Fear Torch and Guaranteed-Hit Revolver...
"I should have some decent combat power now, right?" Lin Yu pondered. Against First-Tier Players like Heavenly Artisan or Red Fuji, he might win straightforwardly without deception or ambushes.
That said, having just returned from Banquet in the Skies, Lin Yu dared not grow overconfident. Witnessing high-level Players' combat prowess—like Fish's single Piercing Sacred Might attack—left him acutely aware of his own limitations. So despite acquiring this excellent item set, Lin Yu remained grounded.
He dutifully examined the final reward—the one from "divine favor."
"Pocket-Sized Chef Apprentice—what a strange name. What is this thing?" At Lin Yu's thought, the last item appeared.
*Plop!*
A wet sound accompanied the arrival of a palm-sized pink octopus wearing a miniature white chef's uniform, landing in Lin Yu's hand. It waved tiny chopstick-sized spatulas excitedly.
"Gwah gwah! The human world! I've reached the human world! Gwah, are you the future proxy lord my master sent me to serve?"Follow current novels on NoveI-Fire.ɴet

chapters.title: Chapter 179: The Director and Hannah
chapters.content:
[Pocket-Sized Chef Apprentice: You ask what it can do? Why not ask it directly?]
Standing in the hotel stairwell, Lin Yu shifted his gaze from the "Item Description" back to the tiny octopus before him.
"This is... a summon-type item," Lin Yu thought to himself, feeling genuinely surprised.
While he'd known the Banquet God was generous, he hadn't expected this level of generosity.
Summon-type items with autonomous consciousness and life were exceptionally rare throughout the entire Death Game.
Owning one would significantly reduce dungeon difficulty.
After all...
Once bound, these [items] would never betray their bound player.
In other words...
It was like gaining an absolutely loyal teammate.Especially this little octopus before him - not only could it speak human language, but its logic was clear and speech complete, indicating remarkably high intelligence.
Moreover, most living "summon-type items" possessed multiple abilities and effects.
Meaning a single one could replace several other items.
This little octopus came from distinguished origins, personally dispatched by the Banquet God - it definitely had some tricks up its sleeves!
Lin Yu couldn't help but think of "Ka the Octopus" who had hosted the previous dungeon.
Gazing at it, Lin Yu felt his expectations rise.
"Hello, may I ask what your relationship with Ka is? And what abilities do you have?"
Lifting the small octopus level with his palm, Lin Yu asked softly.
The tiny octopus seemed delighted by Lin Yu's question.
"Ribbit! Greetings, future Proxy! Ka is both my teacher and my sixth uncle by blood!"
"I've been learning cooking and combat skills from Uncle Ka, so I'm somewhat proficient in both areas."
"Depending on available ingredients, I can currently prepare three basic dishes."
"[Dish·Grilled Meat]: Slowly restores stamina and energy when consumed."
"[Dish·Salad]: Temporarily enhances mental power and shortens cooldown times for your items and skills."
"[Dish·Stew]: Alleviates or cures injuries and abnormal status effects."
"I can source ingredients myself, but if the future Proxy provides premium ingredients... I might occasionally create advanced delicacies!"
"Each dish takes about 15 minutes... though as I'm still an apprentice, I'll need roughly eight hours of rest after cooking!"
The pink octopus announced proudly.
Lin Yu couldn't help but click his tongue in admiration.
"Incredible..."
The Banquet God had truly gifted him an entire set of synergizing items.
This little pink octopus alone essentially gave Lin Yu three additional consumable opportunities daily.
Paired with the [Banquet Pendant] and [Bliss Immortal Pot], the food effects could be maximized.
And...
"That's just your 'culinary' abilities, right? What about your 'combat' skills?"
Lin Yu asked eagerly.
The little octopus seemed slightly embarrassed by the question.
"Ribbit—Actually, I'm not very skilled in combat... Uncle Ka says my frontal assault capability is too weak, so he mostly taught me stealth techniques."
"'Rather than a warrior who crushes enemies, you're better suited as a top-tier assassin!'—That's Uncle Ka's assessment of me!"
"So I only have two combat-related skills."
"[Concealment Camouflage]... I can alter my body to perfectly match environmental colors, achieving near-invisibility."
As it spoke, the octopus demonstrated.
Its pink skin gradually shifted hues until it nearly blended with Lin Yu's palm.
Even scrutinizing closely, Lin Yu could barely detect any flaws.
Only when the octopus moved could one glimpse faint outlines.
In poorer lighting or at distance, it would be completely undetectable.
After Lin Yu's praise, the octopus bashfully returned to its original form.
"Ribbit hehe, it's nothing special really, just an extension of our [Racial Talent]..."
"My second skill is more impressive—a unique technique I developed myself: [Illusory Ink]!"
Puffing its cheeks, the pink octopus sprayed a stream of rainbow-hued ink.
The ink evaporated midair, forming a larger red octopus.
Lin Yu recognized it as Ka the Octopus from before.
The ink illusion had perfectly replicated Ka's appearance.
More surprisingly...
This "Illusory Ka" could move and speak!
Wielding a spatula, it declared:
"Devote 100% heart to food! Ensure every dish satisfies guests completely!"
The voice matched Ka's perfectly, though the scripted lines sounded slightly unnatural coming from him.
Regardless...
"Truly amazing! This skill will definitely be useful!"
Lin Yu gave a thumbs-up to the pink octopus hiding behind its illusion.
"Ribbit! Thank you, future Proxy!"
The pink octopus cheerfully dispersed the ink illusion.
Lin Yu patted its head.
"No need for formalities. From now on, just call me... hmm, usually 'Director,' though when I change appearances, I might need you to adjust how you address me sometimes."
The octopus nodded somewhat comprehendingly.
"Understood... future Proxy... no, Director!"
It raised a tiny tentacle in salute.
Lin Yu nodded.
"Oh right, you know what to call me... but I don't know your name yet."
"Since Ka has a name, you must have one too?"
The pink octopus nodded vigorously.
"Yes yes, my name is 'Ba'!"
"Director, you can call me 'Ba' or 'Baba'!"
It answered earnestly.
The sincere response nearly broke Lin Yu's composure.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NoveI[F]ire.net
"Well... your name is nice, but it occurs to me... 'Director' is my codename, so I should give you one too!"
"I'll call you... Hannah!"
Rather than taking offense, the pink octopus became ecstatic.
"Wow—A codename! I'm Hannah!"
"So cool... as expected of the Director!"

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Immortal Brew Complete, An Unexpected Encounter
chapters.content:
After completing negotiations with the little octopus "Hannah," Lin Yu took it out of the stairwell and returned to the hotel interior.
Hannah obediently perched on Lin Yu's right shoulder, using [Concealment Camouflage] to blend almost seamlessly with his clothing.
"Croak—the human world is so lively, Director," Hannah marveled from its perch on Lin Yu's shoulder.
Currently in its [Concealment Camouflage] state, Hannah communicated through their soul connection, making its words audible only to Lin Yu.
Lin Yu surveyed the surroundings...
He stood in the executive lounge atop Shengjiang Tower, where the dim glow of the Wakes Lounge sign illuminated a massive liquor cabinet and long wooden bar counter with seven or eight scattered patrons.
The window-side sofa booths weren't full either, hosting only two occupied tables.
"This can hardly be called lively..." Lin Yu responded through their soul connection.
"But there are so many people drinking together without a banquet!" Hannah excitedly looked around. "Absolutely incredible!"
Lin Yu rubbed his chin.Apparently, Hannah came from a place where human gatherings were rare...
Originally, Lin Yu had planned to take the elevator straight back to his hotel room.
But Hannah's interruption changed his mind.
He walked to the lounge bar and pulled out a chair.
"One non-alcoholic lemon special, and a plate of Iberian ham sashimi," Lin Yu told the bartender behind the counter.
The bartender nodded politely. "Certainly, sir. Please wait a moment."
With that, the bartender turned to prepare the order.
"Croak... So this is a human world mixologist!" Hannah whispered excitedly from Lin Yu's shoulder.
This was precisely why Lin Yu had changed plans.
First, he'd intended to test the effects of [Banquet Pendant] and [Bliss Immortal Pot], and this executive lounge provided perfect opportunities for sampling food and drinks.
Second...
Letting Hannah observe how human world cuisine was prepared might yield unexpected benefits.
After all...
Hannah's [Item Description] contained the word "apprentice."
Perhaps it could learn and evolve further!
Unfortunately, though Hannah watched with keen interest this time, no new skills manifested.
Naturally, Lin Yu hadn't expected instant results either.
Soon...
A plate of exquisitely arranged, paper-thin ham slices and a lemon-flavored specialty drink arrived.
Lin Yu rolled a ham slice with his fork, popped it into his mouth, then sipped the beverage.
While delicious...
After attending a banquet hosted by the god presiding over "feasts," everything else paled in comparison.
Just ordinarily tasty.
After leisurely finishing the food...
No buffs appeared.
"Seems the probability of gaining random buffs from ordinary food with [Banquet Pendant] is quite low," Lin Yu muttered, pulling out the white jade pendant shaped like a ram-headed beast from his pocket. He fiddled with it regretfully before wiping his mouth with a tissue.
"Croak, Director! My cooking tastes better than this!" Little octopus Hannah declared confidently.
"Admittedly mediocre, but... let's try more."
Despite the high prices, money meant nothing to current Lin Yu.
Since they were here, they might as well grind for at least one buff before leaving!
So Lin Yu ordered a new grapefruit-flavored drink and honey-roasted cashews.
This time, after slowly consuming everything...
He finally obtained a buff.
[Dance Mastery: Your physical coordination increases by 50%. Temporarily enhances charm while dancing.]
[Remaining Duration: 1 hour 59 minutes 59 seconds]
Lin Yu stroked his chin while examining this buff.
"Well... better than nothing!"
Though he didn't need "charm enhancement while dancing," improved coordination proved useful.
Thus, Lin Yu retrieved the [Bliss Immortal Pot] from his pocket.
The exquisitely crafted copper flask bore beautiful swirling cloud patterns.
Opening the lid, Lin Yu activated the pot's ability.
Instantly...
The nearly two-hour countdown on his [Dance Mastery] froze.
Then, this intangible buff seemed "peeled" from his body by some mysterious force.
Though invisible to others, Lin Yu saw faint white light streaming from himself, coalescing midair into a meandering trickle.
This was...ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ .net
The [Dance Mastery] buff transformed into [Immortal Brew].
The pale white trickle slowly flowed into the [Bliss Immortal Pot], its lid snapping shut automatically after the final drop entered.
Now examining the pot, Lin Yu could see not only its original description but also new text about its contents:
[Dance Immortal Brew: Upon consumption, grants "Dance Mastery" buff lasting 1 hour 59 minutes 55 seconds.]
After storing the pot, Lin Yu prepared to order more food, hoping for additional buffs.
But just as he pressed the table bell to summon the bartender, he noticed a shift change behind the counter.
The ordinary male bartender removed his apron and departed, replaced by...
A petite young woman.
"Ding—"
The clear bell rang as the new bartender looked up toward Lin Yu.
Their eyes met.
Lin Yu's face instantly displayed an "oh crap" expression.
"Damn it..." he muttered involuntarily.
Hannah sounded surprised. "Eh? Director? What's wrong?"
Lin Yu didn't answer, merely sitting up straighter.
Meanwhile, the new female bartender briskly approached, wearing a genuinely delighted—not professional—smile.
"My, what a handsome, dashing, and accomplished guest! What may I get for you today?"
"Shall I recommend our signature drinks? Guaranteed to make you linger with delight!"
Facing this familiar countenance, Lin Yu sighed helplessly and lightly massaged his forehead.
"Spare me, senior..."
Standing behind the counter in bartender attire with a small ponytail...
Was none other than Lin Yu's senior from Jiangcheng Media University, president of the drama club—Shen Bingmiao.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Are You... A Player?
chapters.content:
Late at night, in the luxurious hotel suite.
On the sofa before the floor-to-ceiling window, Shen Bingmiao sat with her legs crossed, swirling a glass of red wine before taking a sip of the liquid inside.
"Ahhh—this iced cola really hits the spot."
Shen Bingmiao sighed contentedly, then turned her gaze to Lin Yu perched on the sofa armrest.
"So... my dear ace..."
"Weren't you practically applying for poverty-stricken student grants last semester? Why are you suddenly booking expensive suites and ordering like crazy from the executive lounge?"
Facing Shen Bingmiao's questioning, Lin Yu broke out in cold sweat.
Having been a 'Fraudster' for so long with formidable acting skills, he could probably deceive even his sister Lin Zhao if she walked in right now.
But Shen Bingmiao was different...
Lin Yu had zero confidence facing her.Because Shen Bingmiao knew Lin Yu's "acting" and "background" too well.
Attempting an improv performance that could fool her would be harder than deceiving a god again.
And most importantly...
Shen Bingmiao's curiosity knew no bounds.
Even if he made up some excuse, she'd probably investigate using her own methods when he couldn't provide answers.
"Can I not answer?"
Lin Yu looked at Shen Bingmiao with sincere eyes.
"Absolutely not. I swapped shifts to be here," Shen Bingmiao rolled her eyes. "As our drama club's star actor and my beloved junior, if you suddenly come into unexplained wealth, it's my duty to get to the bottom of this before you go astray."
She paused momentarily.
"Though judging by your spending habits... you might already be down that crooked path. Now I can only try damage control and guide you back!"
Shen Bingmiao's expression turned dead serious.
Lin Yu raised his hands in surrender: "President, don't make it sound like I'm committing crimes..."
Shen Bingmiao pressed on: "Then immoral activities?"
"This luxury suite... you're not actually selling your looks, are you?"
"Those who trade on beauty lose favor when youth fades, my dear ace."
Lin Yu grew even more exasperated.
"What nonsense is this, senior? Why do you always assume the worst?"
"I just made some small investments recently and want to enjoy life a little!"Google seaʀᴄh NoveI-Fire.ɴet
Seeing an opportunity, Lin Yu quickly offered an explanation Shen Bingmiao couldn't easily verify.
Before she could scrutinize his words, Lin Yu deftly redirected the conversation:
"Speaking of which, senior... why are you here anyway?"
"It's a school day today. What are you doing working at such a high-end place?"
Shen Bingmiao downed the remaining cola in her wine glass.
"Funding our club activities, you idiot!"
"Do you know our annual budget is only five thousand? Yet you keep demanding more realistic props for your plays—props cost money, genius!"
"If I didn't work at upscale places like this, how could I afford your three productions per semester?"
Her angry tirade gradually softened:
"Don't feel too guilty though. I am genuinely interested in mixology..."
Observing Shen Bingmiao's act, Lin Yu rested his chin on one hand and nodded slightly.
"I see... not really."
He sighed.
"President, while you excel as playwright, stage manager, critic, agent, and even troupe owner, your acting skills are strictly supporting-role material from late-night TV dramas."
"Do you really think your clumsy performance and flimsy excuse could hide your nervousness from me?"
Lin Yu fixed his gaze on her. "So what's your real purpose here?"
"Let's compromise," she said with exaggerated flair. "We'll both keep our little secrets."
"Fine by me, but stop sounding like some flirtatious side character hitting on an extra," Lin Yu retorted wearily.
"Your understanding is much appreciated..."
Shen Bingmiao stood, placing the glass aside: "And if you really earned that money legitimately... I'm happy for you."
"Your sister would be proud too."
At the mention of Lin Zhao, Lin Yu froze momentarily before nodding slowly.
"I know, president."
"See you at school tomorrow then."
Shen Bingmiao headed for the door.
Watching her leave, Lin Yu finally relaxed slightly.
He'd managed to bluff his way through!
Personally, Lin Yu didn't want Shen Bingmiao involved in his 'Death Game' affairs.
Given her boundless curiosity and initiative, she'd likely get herself killed.
Especially after learning how the Psychological Society evaluated and eliminated "ordinary people"—Lin Yu deliberately minimized contact to keep Shen Bingmiao off their radar.
After all, Shen Bingmiao perfectly embodied both "genius" and "madness" simultaneously.
Of course...
Lin Yu had wondered if Senior Shen might already be a "player."
But after his first dungeon, he'd tested this theory.
Attempting to discuss the "Death Game" or even thinking about sharing his experiences with her proved impossible—consistent with non-player characteristics.
Thus, Lin Yu concluded his senior hadn't been dragged into that despair-filled 'Death Game.'
Just as Lin Yu reached this conclusion...
The little octopus Hannah, silent on his shoulder until now, finally spoke through their mental link:
"Whew... she's finally gone!"
"Director, that woman terrifies me..."
"It's like she..."
As Lin Yu prepared to reassure Hannah with something like "Senior doesn't bite"...
Shen Bingmiao suddenly stopped at the door.
She spun around abruptly, facing Lin Yu with a radiant smile.
"Ohhh—my dear junior, my beloved Lin Yu..."
"A thought just occurred to me."
She strode back into the room, stopping directly before Lin Yu.
Then...
Shen Bingmiao's red lips parted:
"Could it be... you're a player of the 'Death Game'?"

chapters.title: Chapter 182: The Essence of Promotion
chapters.content:
"Could it be... you're a player of the 'Death Game'?"
Shen Bingmiao's words felt like an ice cube suddenly pressed against the back of Lin Yu's neck, sending an involuntary shiver down his spine.
Is she a player?
No... he had tested this before. He clearly couldn't discuss such matters with Shen Bingmiao previously.
Has senior become a player recently then?
When? Yesterday? The day before? Last week? The week before last?
Did the Psychological Society do this?
No... just minutes ago, he had even considered testing the club president again!
Yet until Shen Bingmiao spoke those words—he couldn't confirm she was a player at all.
Looking at Shen Bingmiao before him, Lin Yu's thoughts tangled chaotically.He instinctively stepped back until his back pressed against the hotel's floor-to-ceiling window, the cool glass helping him regain some clarity.
"Senior... when did you...?"
Lin Yu suppressed his turbulent emotions and asked calmly.
"About two weeks ago. You seemed distracted, so I grew suspicious."
"Then when you asked me to investigate those people, it confirmed my doubts."
Shen Bingmiao stepped back and sighed. "I just couldn't believe it—that you're really a player."
Seeing Shen Bingmiao's regretful expression, Lin Yu froze momentarily before shaking his head.
"No, senior, you misunderstand."
"What I mean is... when did you become a player?"
Shen Bingmiao chuckled softly, her tone suddenly turning gentle. "A-Yu, do you know it's very rude to ask a girl about her age?"
"I'm not asking your age."
Lin Yu responded seriously.
Shen Bingmiao pursed her lips. "The 'Death Game' gives people a second life. Asking when I became a player is like asking my age after rebirth."This content belongs to .net
Lin Yu sighed in exasperation. "What kind of twisted logic is that, President? Fine, don't tell me if you don't want to... But what puzzles me is why I couldn't discuss 'Death Game' matters with you before."
"Until now, I even thought you weren't a player."
Lin Yu remarked thoughtfully.
"Oh, you read that 'forum' guide about identifying players, didn't you?"
Shen Bingmiao realized suddenly.
Lin Yu nodded.
"Exactly, senior."
Shen Bingmiao plopped onto the bed, stretching lazily like a cat.
"Don't believe everything on the forum. The operators deliberately filter content—some things apply to regular players but not to 'high-tier' ones."
"After all, the forum isn't completely neutral—it leans toward 'Order'."
"That quick player identification method you mentioned doesn't work on high-tier players."
Lin Yu pondered Shen Bingmiao's words.
"So high-tier players can 'avoid' such simple player detection tests?"
"Which means... President, you're a high-tier player. In other words, you've at least experienced..."
"Hey, if you keep counting weeks trying to deduce when I joined the game, I'll throw you out this window right now."
Shen Bingmiao threatened bluntly.
Though Lin Yu knew she was joking, seeing her genuine discomfort made him drop the subject.
After all...
The moment one joins the 'Death Game' is when they've "died once."
Some unwillingness to recall those shadows is perfectly understandable.
"Leaving time aside, senior... what tier are you? Which organization did you join?"
Hearing this, Shen Bingmiao didn't evade.
"Third Tier. As for organization... you could say 'Order,' though I'm not an official member—more like outsourced."
She said nonchalantly.
"Third Tier?!"
Lin Yu was shocked.
Though he suspected Shen Bingmiao might be strong, he never imagined she was Third Tier!
He'd assumed she was just an experienced Second Tier at most.
This meant she was on par with those elite players he encountered in the last dungeon!
And...
She was actually affiliated with 'Order'!
Even as an "outsourced" member, that was incredibly impressive.
Being accepted as a non-official member might even carry more weight than being a regular one!
Yet Lin Yu found this reasonable.
Given Shen Bingmiao's talent and drive, of course she wouldn't be ordinary in the 'Death Game.'
"So what method do high-tier players use to avoid detection during conversations?"
Shen Bingmiao hesitated before answering.
"This relates to the nature of 'Promotion'... Honestly, I agree with the forum's approach."
"Letting new players learn too much about 'Promotion' and high-tier players isn't beneficial."
Then she changed tack.
"But since you're my junior whom I know well, I can share a little."
"Your question touches on the essence of 'Promotion.'"
Lin Yu looked puzzled. "Essence?"
"Yes... how many dungeons have you completed? Have you promoted yet?"
Lin Yu hesitated at her question.
He debated whether to lie about his dungeon count or promotion status.
But considering his established identity as "Lin Yu—a new 'Soldier' who's completed four dungeons," he decided to maintain consistency.
"I've done four dungeons. Haven't promoted yet."
Shen Bingmiao nodded. "No wonder you're so weak—a genuine rookie."
"Getting serious now."
She continued: "When you eventually see the First-Tier promotion mission after more dungeons, you'll realize..."
"First-Tier promotion missions are fundamentally different from all previous dungeon clearance tasks."
"Dungeon tasks are usually things like 'survive X time,' 'complete Y requirement,' or 'investigate Z truth.'"
"They rarely require deep 'interaction' with the dungeon world."
"But 'Promotion' missions are different—even First-Tier missions specifically target something critically important within that world."
"In other words, unless deliberately causing trouble, a player could complete dozens of dungeons while barely affecting those worlds."
"But completing just one 'Promotion' mission—"
"Leaves an indelible mark so profound that the world will remember that player forever!"
Pausing briefly, Shen Bingmiao concluded:
"This is the essence of 'Promotion.' Actually, it shares something with your beloved performances—"
"Promotion is the process of making another world remember you permanently."

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Messages from Different Identities, The Ultimate Scheme
chapters.content:
"Alright, junior... Now that we've been open with each other, let's stay in touch online. You can come to me if you encounter any difficulties in the game."
"After all, if I stay any longer in this luxurious suite of yours, my colleagues might start rumors about some rich young master taking a fancy to me... Then I'd have people borrowing money from me left and right, and I really don't want that."
Shen Bingmiao said as she patted her butt and left the room, casually taking along the complimentary skincare products and imported snacks from Lin Yu's hotel room.
With a click of the door closing, Shen Bingmiao was truly gone this time.
Only Lin Yu remained in the room, still processing everything she had just said—
The essence of Promotion is the process of making another world remember you.
This was genuinely information not found in the forums or even in the materials of the organizations he had joined.
Lin Yu had never even considered this possibility before.
"My perspective really was too narrow," he couldn't help but reflect.
His approach to each dungeon defied "common sense," so his methods of clearing them were equally unconventional, which was why he had completely overlooked this point.Knowing this now, Lin Yu felt that while the various "abnormalities" he had experienced weren't entirely clear yet, they did hint at some underlying "connections."
"Player potential, the gaze of the gods... coupled with the true nature of Promotion."
"After a few more dungeons, I might just figure out why the gods have their eyes on me and why I was rated S-class!"
Thinking this, Lin Yu felt considerably lighter.
The lingering tension from dancing on the edge of a blade in the last dungeon, surrounded by experts, gradually faded away.
To Lin Yu, Senior Shen Bingmiao wasn't entirely trustworthy either.
But she was still more reliable than a complete stranger.
Having a relatively familiar 'Third-Tier' expert and member of the 'Order' whom he got along with meant he could indeed turn to her for advice when confused in the future.
With that thought, Lin Yu turned to Hannah.
This little one was also a fairly trustworthy source of consultation.
"By the way, Hannah... What did you think of her earlier?"
Hannah pondered for a moment before shaking her head.
"Nothing, Director. Maybe I was mistaken!"
Lin Yu nodded and pulled out the several phones he carried with him.
Shen Bingmiao hadn't contacted him yet—perhaps she had gone back to start shaking her cocktail shaker and was too busy for now.
Lin Yu looked at the phones belonging to Heavenly Artisan and Old Yao.
The seeds planted in the last dungeon were already beginning to sprout.
On the Marauders' app, a pinned post appeared in the general discussion section.
The poster's ID was 'Fish.'
Her name was highlighted in red, and clicking on it revealed her title: "Deputy Head of Beijing Headquarters."
Without a doubt, this was the blonde girl Lin Yu had encountered in the last dungeon.
The post's title was eye-catching and very much in Fish's style.
"Urgent urgent urgent! Anyone good at riddles, come in!"
Opening the post, the content was exactly what Lin Yu expected.
"Brothers and sisters, help me solve this riddle! The answer should be a specific time and location!"
"'Above the rainbows at dusk in Jiangcheng, on a night when thirty silver coins jingle'—what does this refer to?"
"Big rewards for solving it! Urgent urgent urgent!"
The post was made an hour ago, shortly after the last dungeon ended.
Since Fish was a high-ranking figure within the Marauders, the post had already garnered significant attention.
Seeing this, Lin Yu couldn't help but chuckle.
"Of course she'd ask for outside help... But I didn't expect you to post so quickly, Miss Fish."Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs noⅴelfire.net
He murmured to himself.
Next, he opened Old Yao's phone.
The Jiang'an Hall app also had related news—though not as prominent as Fish's post.
The Tycoon had issued an announcement.
"According to messages from the 'Order' in Haicheng, a group of 'Third-Tier' experts may arrive in Jiangcheng in the near future, likely including members of the 'Marauders,' 'Free Alliance,' and 'Psychological Society.' The 'Order' will also send personnel to assist us. We at 'Jiang'an Hall' should prepare accordingly."
"Exact time and location remain unconfirmed. Await further notice."
Though there was no concrete evidence, Lin Yu was certain this message from "Haicheng" at this timing couldn't possibly be unrelated to the last dungeon.
"It seems the Tycoon, while not an official member of the 'Order,' does hold high priority within it..."
"I wonder if our President, as an 'outsourced' member, fares as well as the Tycoon in the 'Order.'"
Lin Yu pondered before setting the two phones aside.
Good. Everything was progressing as planned.
Though this scheme had been improvised after confirming the identities of the participants from the last dungeon...
It was more than enough to turn the real world upside down.
Zhu Ming's phone remained quiet for now, as its only contact was the Master Thief 'A Nian.'
However, Lin Yu decided to take the initiative.
He sent a message to Li Nian.
"I've completed my Promotion."
Li Nian replied quickly.
"Oh, congrats. Mind sharing which side you picked?"
The two available [First-Tier items] for [Veterinarian] were [Collar] and [Animal Medicine].
[Collar] temporarily converts a non-player creature into one's follower, with a failure chance for overly powerful or intelligent creatures. Followers do not respawn upon death.
[Animal Medicine] fully heals a non-player creature and can optionally send it into a frenzied state, with a 24-hour cooldown.
"I chose [Collar],"
Lin Yu replied.
"How interesting. I like your choice,"
Li Nian messaged back.
Lin Yu could almost feel Li Nian's distant 'belief' resonating with him.
But this wasn't his main objective.
He sent another message.
"By the way, A Nian, my intel network has picked up something."
"Jiangcheng might see major activity in the coming days, with experts from various organizations heading here... Be careful."
Li Nian received the message but, unusually, didn't reply instantly.
Only after a long pause did the response come.
"Noted. Your intel is sharper than I expected."
Lin Yu smiled and set the phone aside.
"Perfect. The acceleration on this end is complete too..."
Finally, he picked up the phone belonging to 'Doctor' May.
When the screen lit up...
Lin Yu raised an eyebrow in mild surprise.
This was the only phone flooded with messages.
99+ explosive notifications, all from a certain famous detective.
"Bro bro, emergency!"
"Call me back ASAP if you see this!"

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Fu Luo's Request
chapters.content:
Lin Yu checked the messages Fu Luo had sent him.
All hundred-plus messages had been sent after midnight. Since Lin Yu always kept his phone on silent mode, he hadn't noticed them.
After reading them, Lin Yu could only sigh.
"Over a hundred messages just saying 'Are you there?' and 'Urgent!' Couldn't you just tell me what's going on first?"
Lin Yu expressed great dissatisfaction with Fu Luo's behavior.
But he still called Fu Luo back.
The call connected after two rings.
"Hello? May? Is that you?"
Fu Luo's voice came through.
"Yes, what is it?"Lin Yu got straight to the point.
"Bro, I'm about to attempt Promotion. Can you help me out?"
"I've already bought the Party Items... We can discuss compensation."Discover more novels at NoveI-Fire.ɴet
Fu Luo spoke sincerely.
Lin Yu was somewhat surprised by Fu Luo's words.
He did some quick mental calculations...
When they first met, Fu Luo had claimed to have completed sixteen dungeons.
That meant this would be Fu Luo's nineteenth dungeon.
That didn't add up...
Although information about "Second-Tier" and the second Promotion Trial was scarce among players, Lin Yu had learned some basics.
The second Promotion Trial usually occurred on even-numbered dungeons.
Because it mirrored the timing of the first-tier dungeons.
For example, if you completed your "First-Tier" Promotion in the seventh dungeon, your "Second-Tier" Promotion would be in the fourteenth dungeon.
Of course, if you failed the first trial,
It would be based on when you eventually passed.
For instance, if the first Promotion Trial appeared in the seventh dungeon but wasn't completed,
Then the second "First-Tier" Promotion Trial would appear in the seventeenth dungeon - if completed then, the "Second-Tier" Promotion Trial would come at 17+7, meaning the twenty-fourth dungeon.
But why was Fu Luo attempting "Second-Tier" in his nineteenth dungeon?
That didn't make sense!
Thinking this, Lin Yu asked directly:
"Why are you attempting Second-Tier in an odd-numbered dungeon?"
Hearing this, Fu Luo gave an embarrassed chuckle on the other end.
"May, buddy... actually this is still First-Tier... my second attempt at First-Tier."
As Fu Luo spoke, Lin Yu was rendered speechless.
He had always assumed this 'Detective' was already First-Tier.
Despite being somewhat cowardly, Fu Luo had quite a reputation, extensive connections, and was always active on the forum posting guides.
Plus, his performance in the Frostpeak Mountains dungeon and during the real-world investigation of Heavenly Artisan had been decent. Lin Yu had thought he was already First-Tier!
"So you failed your first First-Tier Promotion Trial, and now this is your second attempt?"
Lin Yu asked, and Fu Luo answered seriously:
"Exactly, my friend. That's why, to be safe, I'd like you to team up with me."
Lin Yu sighed.
"How can you be this cowardly? With nineteen dungeons under your belt... even if you can't complete the Promotion Trial, surviving shouldn't be a problem, right?"
It seemed there were levels to cowardice. Almond from the Marauders, while also the type to flee rather than fight, had at least passed her First-Tier trial!
At this thought, Lin Yu suddenly realized something.
"Wait... don't tell me you didn't even look at your first trial and just teamed up to skip it?"
In Promotion dungeons, teaming up automatically means the Promotion Trial won't complete.
Faced with Lin Yu's question, Fu Luo's awkward laughter came through the phone.
"Ahahaha..."
"You really did," Lin Yu sighed, feeling disappointed. "Failing the first time is one thing, but after nineteen dungeons... you should at least try, right?"
"If you don't gain experience, even with better items next time, you'll still be clueless facing the Promotion Trial and might waste another chance."
"Besides, what if you succeed this time?"
In response to Lin Yu's reasoning, Fu Luo offered an unexpected perspective:
"Here's the thing, May... what if I never attempt Promotion?"
"Just buy Party Items every ten dungeons to avoid any risk - isn't that more cost-effective?"
Fu Luo said earnestly.
Lin Yu was stunned by Fu Luo's logic.
"You... you're truly one of a kind!"
Having been in the Death Game for a while now, Lin Yu had met all sorts of players.
Beautiful women who seemed fragile but were terrifying, medical students deeply in love yet ultimately killing their boyfriends, otakus who seemed useless yet somehow survived...
He'd even glimpsed the true faces of many high-level players in the last dungeon.
But no player had ever left Lin Yu speechless with just two sentences.
After a long silence, Lin Yu sighed.
"I could help you, but I don't think it's good for you."
"As a friend... I won't do this."
Lin Yu spoke sincerely.
"Though unconfirmed, I hope you'll improve your own strength. Otherwise, one day... you'll face a dungeon that can't be handled with those ordinary items of yours."
"Besides, players need to worry about more than just dungeons... but other players too."
Hearing this, Fu Luo seemed genuinely moved.
"Maybe you're right. It's just that I... I'm really scared."
"Everyone's scared," Lin Yu said firmly. "When I faced my Promotion dungeon, I was terrified too... but we don't have a choice, my friend."
"Death never shows mercy just because you're afraid."
Lin Yu's words seemed to convince Fu Luo.
"I understand, May... this time, I'll really try my best!"
Lin Yu said approvingly: "That's more like it!"
Just as Lin Yu was about to hang up, Fu Luo spoke again.
"Oh right, May, one more small thing!"
"What is it?"
Lin Yu asked curiously.
"Brother Shan just messaged me, asking you to add him as a friend. Order has something they want to discuss with you."
"You remember Brother Shan, right?"
As Fu Luo spoke, Lin Yu recalled after a brief moment.
"Oh, Officer High Mountain... of course I remember!"
Lin Yu took out his wallet and found the "business card" he'd received during his last trip to Zheng City.
"What exactly is it about?"
Examining the card, Lin Yu asked casually.
Fu Luo didn't hold back, sharing everything he knew:
"Seems something's about to happen in Jiangcheng, and Order is mobilizing people."
"I don't know many details yet... but Brother Shan said he might ask me to help solve a puzzle later. If I learn anything, I'll definitely tell you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Infiltrating the Order! Familiar Faces Again!
chapters.content:
Lin Yu successfully added “High Mountain” as a contact by scanning the code, using the identity of the “Doctor” May.
At the same time, Lin Yu felt quite emotional.
“The Order’s response was even faster than I imagined. Not only did the Tycoon over there receive the news, but even the Order in Henan Province has already taken action.”
“As expected, as the most recognized organization among players, the Order really has its strengths.”
After High Mountain added him as a friend, the message he sent straight to the point was not unexpected for Lin Yu.
[High Mountain: Are you Doctor May, brother?]
[High Mountain: I am High Mountain from the Zheng City branch of the Order. Furbollo once told me that you are from Jiangcheng. May I ask if you were the planner behind the ambush on the Marauders’ Henan Province Heavenly Artisan team in Jiangcheng?]
[May Ninth: I participated, but I was not the planner.]
[High Mountain: Good. Your contribution to finding the Heavenly Artisan will be combined in the evaluation. We will complete the review and internal procedures as soon as possible.]
[High Mountain: Also, Furbollo should have informed you that some major events may happen soon in Jiangcheng. So, our Order headquarters is transferring experts from various branches to Jiangcheng and gathering some reliable and capable players to assist.][High Mountain: I should arrive in Jiangcheng in no more than five hours... Are you interested in working with me? You will be compensated accordingly afterward!]
[High Mountain: I will explain the details when we meet! If you feel it’s not suitable after hearing it, you can leave!]
Everything High Mountain said was within Lin Yu’s expectations at this moment.
After learning that Fluoxetine might appear in a certain city, and considering that the Marauders and the Free Alliance were likely to get involved, the Order would definitely take corresponding actions.
Faced with High Mountain’s invitation, Lin Yu thought for a moment and agreed!
[May Ninth: No problem, contact me when you arrive.]
Although Lin Yu’s original plan was to operate under the identity of Old Yao and start activities through Jiang’an Hall,
Plans couldn’t keep up with changes. Being able to connect directly with the Order as May May, Lin Yu judged it was more suitable than Jiang’an Hall.
After all, the identity of May May was more mysterious and more convenient than Old Yao.
His reputation was bigger, and his “battle record” looked better.
“Besides, the Order’s efficiency is really impressive... Judging by High Mountain’s tone, he’ll arrive by tomorrow morning.”
“Being able to directly participate and see the Order’s procedures can’t be missed.”
This operation might even become the opportunity for May May to officially join the Order!
Thinking this, Lin Yu turned off his phone screen.
…
The next day, at six in the morning, Lin Yu woke up punctually from his hotel bed.
After turning on his phone, he checked messages from various sources again.
No exaggeration...
Just by relying on one fake identity after another, Lin Yu felt his information might not be as fast as the big organizations, but definitely more comprehensive.
After one night...
Not only the Order, but also the Marauders, Night Watchmen, Free Alliance, Player Mutual Aid Association...
All organizations with some nationwide influence had already started their activities!
Even on the forum, many discussion posts appeared.
“Did you guys hear? Something big is going to happen in Jiangcheng!”Fresh chapters posted on N()velFire.net
“Wasn’t there a confrontation between the Marauders and Jiang’an Hall just last week?”
“This is much bigger. This time, all the ‘managers’ and ‘captains’ of the organizations showed up in large numbers...”
“What’s going to happen?”
“The Order and all major organizations are recruiting puzzle-solving experts.”
“I heard... it’s related to a mysterious expert from the Psychological Society!”
Just reading the forum discussions made Lin Yu quite satisfied.
Yes, this was exactly right.
The more discussion this matter received, the better!
After all... this was an invitation initiated by Fluoxetine.
Opening the phone belonging to May May, Lin Yu saw a message from High Mountain.
“Jiangcheng Hotel, at the entrance.”
Upon receiving the message, Lin Yu used False Face to adjust his appearance, then checked out and took a taxi directly to the entrance of Jiangcheng Hotel.
Stepping out of the taxi, Lin Yu saw seven or eight people of varying height, build, and appearance standing unusually at the entrance of Jiangcheng Hotel.
Among them was the Police officer High Mountain, whom Lin Yu had met once before.
High Mountain immediately recognized Lin Yu upon seeing him.
“This way!”
High Mountain raised his hand and greeted “Lin Yu.”
Lin Yu quickly walked over.
High Mountain smiled and nodded at Lin Yu.
“Thanks for coming.”
Lin Yu also smiled and nodded, saying, “It’s not unpaid labor. There’s payment, so why not come?”
“But what exactly is going on? The forum’s all in an uproar!”
Saying that, Lin Yu looked around.
“And borrowing captain-level personnel from Zheng City... There should be at least two more captains transferred over from there.”
“Plus the original Order members in Jiangcheng, there are now six captains.”
“What... is this all about?”
High Mountain looked at Lin Yu with surprise, seemingly impressed by Lin Yu’s sharp insight.
“Someone will explain it to you soon.”
“Let’s go inside first.”
Saying that, High Mountain led Lin Yu into Jiangcheng Hotel, entering a large private room.
Lin Yu found a seat to sit down. Seven or eight minutes later, the room was full.
Observing the people again, Lin Yu clearly grasped the situation inside by noting the seating arrangement and their expressions.
“The fifteen core Order members in Jiangcheng are probably divided into three small teams;
the three official captains should all be here.”
“There are three captains borrowed from other places... but these three captains, including High Mountain, seem to have newly recruited peripheral members in their teams.”
“Then there are about fifteen ‘outsiders’ like me who were brought in...”
“And if I’m not mistaken... everyone here has already completed Promotion!”
“Six captains, except for Jiangcheng’s third team, are even all Second-Tier!”
“Being able to gather five Second-Tier and thirty First-Tier players in one night... no wonder the Order is so formidable!”
Lin Yu couldn’t help but feel the strength of the Order again.
But this also indirectly reflected how destructive Fluoxetine was considered by the Order’s top echelon, even though he was an unknown figure.
Although many people were not only here to guard against Fluoxetine, but also cautious of other organizations...
Most definitely, it was still because the cause of this was Fluoxetine!
While Lin Yu was pondering this...
The door of the private room was pushed open.
“The Game Master has arrived!”
A captain from Jiangcheng announced.
With the captain’s voice, a familiar figure entered the banquet hall, causing a stir of surprised exclamations.
“Is it really him?!”
Only Lin Yu showed an expected expression.
The tall, thin man dressed in Tang suit walked in, pushed up his glasses, and spoke in a deep voice.
“Colleagues and invited helpers...”
“Let me introduce myself. I am Li Hua, the Gambler from Haicheng!”

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Deciphering the Riddle
chapters.content:
Li Hua's appearance shocked everyone present except Lin Yu.
"It's the Gambler!"
"The Game Master from Haicheng came personally?!"
"What's really going on here?"
Only Lin Yu remained unsurprised.
After all, Li Hua had been one of the recipients of "Fluoxetine's" invitation - there was no way he wouldn't show up.
Under everyone's suspicious gazes, Li Hua began his explanation.
"Everyone, I'm here because..."
"During the last dungeon, I received an invitation from a member of the Psychological Society - someone as skilled as me, but also an extremely dangerous madman."
"She invited me to meet in Jiangcheng, but didn't specify the exact time or location... instead giving me a riddle.""'I'll be waiting for you above the rainbows during Jiangcheng's twilight, on the night when thirty silver coins jingle' - those were her exact words."
Li Hua spoke unhurriedly, then wrote the phrase on a whiteboard he produced and placed it on the round table.
"Based on analysis by me and several others in our organization, the time should be 'Thursday evening'."
"But we still don't know the location."
"Others who received this same invitation include Fish from the Marauders, Radish from the Player Mutual Aid Association, Robin from the Night Watchmen, the Magician from the Free Alliance... and the bounty hunter Mosin-Nagant."
As Li Hua listed name after name, the regular Order members and most of the temporary recruits were shocked yet again, though they didn't grasp the full gravity of the situation.
But all six squad leaders including High Mountain immediately turned deadly serious.
Originally they had thought this large-scale mobilization was just Order's typical overprepared response...
But now it seemed even this might not be enough.Follow current novels on novel⸺fire.net
The leader of Jiangcheng's First Squad - a nearly fifty-year-old man with thinning hair and thick eyebrows - spoke up.
"Comrade Li Hua, were all these people invited simultaneously with you?"
Li Hua nodded.
"We were all in the same dungeon when she issued the invitations, which means the Psychological Society is planning something major this time."
High Mountain looked horrified upon hearing this.
"So many elite players... Gambler, your last dungeon must have been incredibly dangerous!"
As he spoke, Lin Yu nodded in agreement.
Indeed it had been dangerous - the Gambler had nearly died.
At this point, another squad leader who seemed to be on loan from Haicheng spoke up angrily.
"Captain Li, you kept this information too close to your chest - you should have told us earlier so we could bring more people from Haicheng!"
"If it were just the Psychological Society, fine... but even that bastard Phantom might show up... shouldn't we round them all up?"
This Haicheng squad leader was about Lin Yu's age but seemed much more hotheaded.
His words also suggested he and Li Hua went way back.
Li Hua glared at him.
"Crazy Blade, shut your mouth!"
"Even after becoming squad leader you're still so unreliable - seems you're tired of being captain and want to return to the grunt work!"
Under Li Hua's scolding, Crazy Blade immediately deflated.
He rubbed his buzz cut and hunched his shoulders. "Captain Li, I just think since they're clearly planning something, we came to support Jiangcheng... without proper preparation, even our squad members were hastily assembled..."
As soon as Crazy Blade said this, the dozen or so players around Lin Yu who had been similarly recruited on short notice clearly took offense.
Especially those Crazy Blade himself had brought.
Before any of them could protest, Li Hua quickly smoothed things over with a sigh.
"How many of your squad members are First-Tier? Bring them here to cause trouble or die?"
"You know how dangerous Jiangcheng is right now... the situation here is special - the Chief Squad Leader position has been vacant for two months since the last one died, and Jiangcheng's Game Master rarely intervenes."
"Getting three squad leaders transferred here was already pushing it... if we moved large forces to Jiangcheng, how do you know the Marauders and Psychological Society wouldn't use it as a diversion to attack elsewhere?"
"That's why we have to rely on these justice-minded experts for help!"
With just a few words from Li Hua, Crazy Blade immediately quieted down.
The other players, having been given this face-saving explanation, also cooled their tempers and even felt somewhat flattered.
After all, though they weren't Order members, being invited here today showed they had good relations with Order's squad leaders.
Most did have a sense of justice, and many were actually undergoing Order's recruitment assessments.
Lin Yu couldn't help but admire this.
His previous dungeon encounter with Li Hua had clearly been too limited.
He'd only seen the Gambler's coldly rational, just and responsible side...
Now he saw Li Hua was also a master of social navigation.
Seizing this moment, Lin Yu raised his hand.
"Excuse me, Mr. Li Hua, I have a question."
"How did you confirm the meeting time was Thursday evening?"
Facing Lin Yu's question, Li Hua looked pleased to return to the main topic.
"Simple - because this riddle isn't actually that difficult. She didn't mean to deliberately stump us."
"'Thirty silver coins' very clearly points to a specific religious reference..."
"Judas betraying Jesus," Lin Yu immediately answered.
"Exactly - 'Judas betraying Jesus'," Li Hua nodded. "And since most players are used to counting days by weekdays due to the dungeon cycle..."
"There are many references to Jesus that specify days of the week."
"For example, Good Friday - looking at Easter-related holidays, it falls on a Friday!"
"While we don't know exactly which day Judas betrayed Jesus, there's one famous evening event matching 'thirty silver coins jingling'..."
"'The Last Supper'!"
"This corresponds to Christianity's Maundy Thursday, a major holiday called 'Thursday of Passion'."
As Li Hua calmly explained, everyone present was convinced.
"Makes sense!"
Lin Yu understood well that such riddles couldn't stump Order members.
But the location...
Might require more work.
Li Hua cleared his throat. "So having confirmed the time as 'Thursday evening', we still need to solve the location riddle in our limited remaining time!"
"The answer should be hidden in the first half of that riddle."
"If anyone can solve it or has ideas, please inform me... there will be additional rewards."
Hearing this, Lin Yu rested his chin on his hand.
"Should I try to earn that reward?"
After all, as the one who set the riddle, he definitely knew the answer!

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Operation Begins: The Puzzle Commission
chapters.content:
Lin Yu ultimately chose not to solve the puzzle directly in front of Li Hua.
On one hand, Lin Yu believed the Order had many capable members. Although time wasn't particularly abundant, solving this riddle shouldn't be too difficult for them.
On the other hand...
If the Order truly prioritized stability and urgently needed to decipher the "location," then this puzzle...
Would likely still end up in his hands through other channels.
At this moment, Li Hua had already moved past discussing the "puzzle" and began temporarily assigning tasks to each squad.
"To summarize, we'll temporarily divide into six 'squads' to conduct patrols across Jiangcheng's six districts..."
"During this period, the local Jiangcheng organization 'Jiang'an Hall' will assist us..."
"Once the location is confirmed... your squads' mission will be to control key transportation routes leading to those locations, preventing unrelated personnel and ill-intentioned players from approaching the target areas."
"However, if you encounter players you cannot defeat, you may let them pass—prioritize preserving your own lives above all else. Many 'monsters' may appear in Jiangcheng this time!""Your only task is to intercept those oblivious low-tier or even unranked players."
After speaking, Li Hua distributed a set of Cognitive Disturbance Generators to each squad leader.
Then, he gave everyone a small brooch.
"This is an Artifact: Soul Gold Brooch. It ensures instant communication between us under any circumstances without additional operations—just silently recite its name to activate it. It's slightly more convenient than phones."
"When the time comes, I'll also use these to inform you of specific locations."
"Additionally, it has precise positioning and vital sign monitoring functions... If you're in danger, your squad leader and even I will receive alerts and can rush to assist immediately."
"Now... meeting adjourned. Operation begins!"
Li Hua adjusted his glasses and turned to leave the private room, officially commencing the operation!
The three Order squads from Jiangcheng immediately stood up and followed Li Hua out of the room in an orderly manner, heading to their respective assigned areas.
The remaining three borrowed squad leaders weren't in a hurry to depart—although these three squads had one more member than the Order's direct squads, they were temporarily assembled after all.
Their assigned districts weren't particularly large or important areas.
Moreover, the three squad leaders needed to let their members familiarize themselves with each other.
High Mountain cleared his throat and spoke: "Ahem, everyone, you probably know me well enough—I'll skip the self-introduction as squad leader!"
"Let me introduce you all to each other."
With that, High Mountain introduced the other five members.
Lin Yu listened carefully to the introductions.
Aside from himself, the other four were all First-Tier players who had experienced over twenty dungeons.
Their professions were Security Guard, Policeman, Corporate Drone, and Postman.
Lin Yu hadn't heard of their IDs before, but when they heard Lin Yu's forum name "May May," they all showed signs of recognition.
"Oh, this is that popular Doctor on the forum recently..."
"Brother May is local to Jiangcheng, right? We'll be counting on you!"
They quickly warmed up to each other, creating a harmonious atmosphere within the squad—after all, High Mountain, an Order squad leader, had selected them.
There weren't any signs of mutual dislike.
Moreover, all squad members were young adult males aged between their twenties and thirties.
It seemed High Mountain had intentionally screened the objective conditions when selecting these temporary squad members.
Realizing this, Lin Yu directly pointed it out.
"Brother Shan, why is our entire squad composed of adult men? Was there special consideration?"
The other two temporary squads nearby, including the previous three Order squads, all had mixed genders.
High Mountain awkwardly rubbed his nose.
The somewhat dark-skinned young Policeman in their squad with the forum ID "Reed" laughed instead.
Due to professional connections, he had known High Mountain longer and was more familiar with him.
"Ha, you guys don't know... Brother Mountain came to Jiangcheng using a business trip excuse with his wife. She checks up on him."
"His wife is fierce, and Brother Mountain is henpecked—how would he dare recruit women into the squad!"
The Postman with the forum ID "Henan's Top Deliverer" also teased:
"I've known Brother Shan for two months, but this is the first time I'm hearing about him being afraid of his wife!"
High Mountain coughed lightly.
"Ahem, Top Deliverer, it's not called being afraid of your wife."
"There are no men afraid of their wives—only men who love their wives!"
"Enough about my family matters. Let's move out!"
High Mountain stood up and headed straight outside the restaurant, with the others following behind in good spirits.
After this small interlude, the squad atmosphere became even more harmonious.
Outside, a Jiangcheng Express minivan was parked.
The Postman "Top Deliverer" opened the door and explained:
"Limited conditions—this is all we could rent for now. Make do with it, guys!"
They squeezed into the minivan, with the Postman taking the wheel.
Based on his demeanor and his "Top Deliverer" ID, Lin Yu deduced this Postman might have a similar real-life occupation.Chapters first released on novęlfire.net
Death Game professions didn't completely correspond to reality—for example, many "delivery workers" and "couriers" would be classified as Postmen.
As the vehicle started smoothly, Lin Yu sat alone in the back row, projecting an unapproachable aura while fiddling with his phone.
Of course...
No one noticed the phone Lin Yu was using wasn't the same one from before.
On the phone belonging to his "Zhu Ming" identity, there was a new message from Li Nian:
"Interested in solving puzzles?"
Seeing this, Lin Yu couldn't help but sigh.
"Was my puzzle really that difficult? Even they haven't solved it..."
As for the Marauders, Lin Yu took a quick peek—Fish's post hadn't been taken down yet, meaning they probably hadn't completely solved it either.
Lin Yu had no channels with the Player Mutual Aid Association or the Night Watchmen.
But if these two organizations solved it, they would likely share information with the Order.
As thoughts flowed through his mind, Lin Yu edited a reply to Li Nian:
"What's in it for me?"
"If solved, the Magician will owe you a favor—regardless of whether you ultimately join the organization, you can collect from him."
Lin Yu raised an eyebrow.
"Deal. Send the puzzle."
Then, unsurprisingly, Lin Yu saw the same "puzzle" he had created appear again from Li Nian.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: The Location Solved! Order's Reward!
chapters.content:
Staring at his phone, Lin Yu silently counted five minutes in his mind before replying to Li Nian again.
"Is this riddle about solving the time and location? Can't the entire Free Alliance figure it out?"
"I'm starting to doubt the wisdom of wanting to join you."
His words were undoubtedly aggressive.
But after directly encountering the Magician in the previous dungeon, Lin Yu didn't think showing this side of himself was wrong.
As expected...
Li Nian's next reply showed no anger, instead offering an explanation.
"The Free Alliance isn't an organization where everyone constantly works toward the same goal. This is just a commission from one of our members, the Magician."
"Currently, only me in Jiangcheng, along with Prisoner and Undertaker, have taken on this commission."
"Unfortunately, Prisoner isn't the type good at solving riddles, and Undertaker is clever... but her personality is peculiar and she doesn't handle these matters."Lin Yu carefully pondered these code names.
"Prisoner, Undertaker..."
The Free Alliance only had nine confirmed known members externally, with only four code names publicly known: Master Thief, Magician, Chef, and Mountaineer.
Prisoner and Undertaker were code names Lin Yu was hearing for the first time.
Then, Lin Yu sent another message.
"I see, so it's just you and the Magician who couldn't figure it out?"
"Seems you two are a bit slow in this area."
Li Nian replied with a smiling emoji.
"If you can solve it, just say it! Stop beating around the bush being annoying!"
"Of course I can, just give me some time."
After sending this message, Lin Yu turned off his phone.
He certainly didn't plan to reveal the answer to Li Nian now...
Because the "timing" wasn't right yet.
Lin Yu sat in the back of the van, quietly switching to another phone.
The one belonging to Old Yao.
And just as he predicted...
Inside Jiang'an Hall's internal app, he also saw that same riddle.
[Tycoon: @everyone, friends good at solving riddles, quickly decipher the time and location this phrase points to! This is a commission from Order!]
[Tycoon: Whoever solves the riddle will receive 1000 points rewarded by Order and any one internal item from Order! Those providing ideas will also receive rewards!]
"This organization's decision-makers are more decisive and prudent than I imagined..."
Lin Yu murmured while looking at the messages.
This was the "timing" Lin Yu had been waiting for.
If he solved these riddles personally...
He would definitely claim all the rewards he could get.
If Free Alliance members learned the "location" in advance, they might expose it to Order through their movements!
So...
He planned to send the riddle's answer to every organization he could contact!
Lin Yu privately messaged Tycoon.
"I can solve it."
Three seconds later, Tycoon's reply arrived as expected.
"What's the answer?"
Lin Yu tapped his phone keyboard, casually replying to Tycoon.
Tycoon's "announcement" didn't mention Order having already solved the time.
Lin Yu believed this was intentional.
To further verify the "answer's" accuracy.
So, Lin Yu also re-solved the time issue.
Even more precisely.
"The time is Thursday evening at seven o'clock."
"The reason is 'thirty silver coins jingling' points to 'the Last Supper,' which occurred on a Thursday."
"This uses an allusion from the Bible..."
Tycoon replied with amazement.
"Not bad, Old Yao, you actually figured this out!"
Seeing Tycoon's concise and swift reply, Lin Yu became even more certain...
Order had indeed intentionally withheld the "time."
Those who could solve the time would naturally be more credible regarding the location's answer!
Tycoon quickly followed up.
"The time is confirmed, what about the location?"
"'Thirty silver coins' points to Judas betraying Jesus, the Last Supper..."
"Does this mean 'rainbow' corresponds to another biblical allusion, the 'Rainbow Covenant'?"
Tycoon inquired.
Seeing Tycoon's guess, Lin Yu wasn't surprised.
Tycoon probably wasn't the only one thinking this.
Because compared to "thirty silver coins" which clearly points to one allusion, "rainbow" is indeed a much broader image.
Influenced by the latter half, many would associate it with the "Rainbow Covenant" mentioned in the Bible!
After Noah built the ark to survive the great flood, God made an eternal covenant with Noah, "I set my rainbow in the cloud... I will remember my covenant between me and you"—this covenant was witnessed by the rainbow.
But...
Once interpreting the rainbow this way, it's hard to find a corresponding landmark in reality!
So...
Lin Yu gave a negative answer.
"Not so, boss. The rainbow has no relation to the Bible."
Tycoon quickly replied.
"Oh? Then what do you mean?"
Lin Yu didn't directly state the answer, first explaining his reasoning.
Of course, as the riddler, his logic was crystal clear.
"Although the latter half uses a well-known biblical allusion, the first half doesn't come from the Bible."
"But from another equally famous mythological system's most renowned allusion..."
"If just looking at the rainbow, we can't narrow it down, but there's a modifier before the rainbow."
"'Rainbow at dusk.'"
"Since the latter half already specifies the time, why emphasize dusk here?"
"The answer is obviously because... this 'dusk' and rainbow are inseparable clues about the location."
"It points to... the 'Twilight of the Gods' in Norse mythology."
"And the rainbow mentioned during 'Twilight of the Gods' is the Bifröst connecting Asgard and Midgard!"
Tycoon sent a shocked emoji.
"Bifröst... meaning... a bridge?"
"But Jiangcheng has so many bridges—which one could it be?!"
Seeing Tycoon's question, Lin Yu leisurely provided the final answer.
"In the Twilight of the Gods... the Bifröst is broken."
"Although Jiangcheng has many bridges, only one is broken."
"That bridge wasn't built over water."
"As a local, you should know this well?"
"That place... is also very suitable for players to settle disputes!"

Before Tycoon could reply, Lin Yu casually added.
"Boss, I didn't solve this myself, but you know... I have some connections."
