chapters.title: Chapter 189: Operation Deployment and Lin Yu's Counter-Deduction
chapters.content:
Lin Yu naturally still remembered the general appearance and persona of "Old Yao."
Having someone who looked like they might have dropped out of middle school—probably unable to even pronounce the word "dropped out" correctly—hold forth on the Bible and Norse mythology would certainly be a jarring mismatch in tone.
So Lin Yu had no intention of letting "Old Yao" solve this riddle "on his own."
His approach to solving the puzzle was through "reliable friends."
This was also the persona Lin Yu intended to craft for "Old Yao"—someone with high emotional intelligence and a wide network of friends.
After all, while the Jiang'an Hall wasn't a large organization, with an expert like "Tycoon" among them, their combat strength ranked among the better groups.
After carefully observing the structure of Jiang'an Hall, Lin Yu quickly identified the role that the organization lacked and that the "Old Yao" identity could fill.
Someone capable of calling in "external assistance" and acquainted with all sorts of characters from various walks of life.
This was the idea that could connect all the "fake identities" and the method to make "Old Yao" truly convincing.
"May May" was building reputation through the high-combat-strength lone wolf route, so the "Old Yao" identity needed to adopt a different competitive approach.And the facts proved Lin Yu's idea correct.
"If your friend has no objections, then the reward is yours," came Tycoon's reply, sounding noticeably more cordial than before.
"Old Yao, though you've only been in the organization for two weeks... I really should consider promoting you!"
"You must have passed the First-Tier by now, right?"
Seeing Tycoon's reply, Lin Yu exhaled softly.
"Right, boss, I'll follow your arrangements!"
Good—now even within Jiang'an Hall, this "Thief" identity was gradually gaining footing.
Once this identity became fully established...
Perhaps the Thief's abilities, like the Doctor's, could remain effective long-term.
Of course...
"After building up Old Yao's presence, I can't forget Zhu Ming either..."
Lin Yu muttered to himself before picking up Zhu Ming's phone and resending the earlier message to Li Nian in Zhu Ming's tone.
Li Nian's reply came quickly.
"So it's Norse mythology... very much that woman's style."
Though Lin Yu knew exactly who "that woman" referred to, he still asked,
"Whose style? I'm quite curious who fits this description!"
Li Nian replied again: "You'll find out after officially joining. That's not someone whose name you should know yet—dangerous individual."
Lin Yu didn't press further. After all, he was just reinforcing "Zhu Ming's" presence and establishing her persona.
Then...
Lin Yu took out Heavenly Artisan's confiscated phone and quickly scanned it.
Unexpectedly...
Fish's post had been taken down.
In its place was a new pinned post:
"Riddle solved. Members at Second-Tier or above who wish to go to Jiangcheng can DM me for the address."
"Solved already? That fast!"
Lin Yu was inwardly astonished.
He even suspected whether Order or the Free Alliance had a mole.
But...
Information couldn't spread that quickly. Moreover, the post's timestamp showed it was freshly posted—likely some expert within the Marauders had solved the riddle around the same time.
Scrolling through the Marauders members' replies in the post confirmed Lin Yu's speculation:
"Holy shit, the boss personally stepped in!"
"Sis Fish has serious clout—got the boss to cast the divination himself."
"Brothers, charge!"
"Second-Tier and above can all go? When the boss says so, feels like we gotta go!"
A group of Marauders officers responded enthusiastically, none showing surprise at the riddle being solved.
To them, it seemed perfectly natural for this poster to have solved it.
Lin Yu scrolled back up to check the poster's ID again.
"Diviner."
Just the name suggested this was another big shot who either used their profession directly as their alias or had a closely related codename.
If Lin Yu's guess was correct... the other party might not even need the riddle's content to divine the time and location!
"Truly a dangerous ability," Lin Yu mused.
What struck him even more, though, was the name itself.
For the Marauders to uniformly refer to this person as "boss," their identity was obvious.
Lin Yu also remembered where he'd last seen this alias—
On the forum, ranked second among players, just below "General"!
Also the leader of the Marauders!
Fortunately, it seemed this person wouldn't be coming to Jiangcheng in person.
Not that Lin Yu would worry even if they did—when the sky falls, the tall ones get squashed first.
If Diviner really came, Lin Yu wouldn't be within ten circles of having to face them!
As Lin Yu pondered this...
High Mountain's voice came from the front passenger seat:
"Hey, Single King, make a U-turn."
"Gambler just sent word—location's been solved!"
"We need to leave the city—an abandoned enclosed section of Jiangcheng's southern overpass. We're assigned to the old overpass entrance southwest."
Single King acknowledged: "Got it. Any time pressure?"
"None... the Hai City Game Master's being decent, says the area's desolate so we can eat first, just get there by noon."
"After all, we're probably the first to solve it—no rush to secure position!"

"That was really fast! Could it be our Henan Province's 'Detective'? That guy's unreliable, but he's actually pretty good at solving riddles!"
High Mountain shook his head: "I sent him the riddle first thing. He solved the time part, but for location... he said he's unfamiliar with Jiangcheng's terrain, so even with direction, verification would be troublesome. No movement yet."
Lin Yu was slightly surprised.
"Seems Fu Luo, though not officially in Order, has close ties with them..."
But his thoughts about Fu Luo were fleeting.
From the timing of High Mountain's information report, Lin Yu realized something else:
"His Excellency Tycoon seems deeply connected with Order too—at minimum, he must be on close personal terms with Li Hua."
Within minutes of him solving the riddle, Li Hua had already relayed the information back to the front lines—and not just raw intel, but analyzed, planned "operation instructions" precisely assigned to each team.
This meant Tycoon absolutely had direct communication channels with Li Hua—Jiang'an Hall and Order didn't need organizational-level coordination.
In fact...
Lin Yu had reason to suspect these two might currently be together, looking at the same screen, sharing information in real time!

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Countermeasures and Chance Encounters
chapters.content:
"Hey, if you ask me, this Old Yao is truly a talented individual!"
"What do you think, Brother Li? Did we at Jiang'an Hall strike gold?"
In the backseat of the speeding luxury car, the Tycoon waved his tablet proudly as he spoke.
Li Hua adjusted his glasses.
"Indeed impressive, Brother He. But I'm more interested in the person who solved the puzzle..."
"Of course, now isn't the time to dwell on that—after the puzzle's solution, our top priority is figuring out what 'Fluoxetine' actually intends to do."
Li Hua spoke with seriousness.
The Tycoon waved his hand dismissively: "That crazy woman's thoughts are beyond my comprehension. If anything... trying to speculate about her motives feels utterly pointless..."
"But the Psychological Society isn't the Free Alliance. They don't do things without purpose—even Fluoxetine operates this way."
"These people only seem incomprehensible because their goals and values differ from normal people's. But every move they make is absolutely deliberate."Li Hua analyzed calmly.
"Moreover... I can sense she's definitely plotting something."
"Throughout the entire previous dungeon, beneath her seemingly chaotic and willful actions, there was an extremely strong sense of purpose hidden!"
After hearing Li Hua's words, the Tycoon nodded thoughtfully.
"Alright, Brother Li, I'll admit your reasoning makes sense..."
"But there's no denying it's difficult to deduce her intentions."
Li Hua raised his head with gleaming eyes: "Precisely why I wanted to consult... the opinion of the 'Jiangcheng Game Master'."
This luxury business sedan had soundproofing between the front and rear seats.
With the partition currently lowered, the driver in front and Li Hua with the Tycoon might as well have been in separate spaces.
Only the two of them occupied the rear seats.
Yet Li Hua spoke with complete certainty.
"Then... Honorable Hacker, what is your opinion?"
He seemed to be addressing empty air.
Then something slightly eerie occurred...
In the next moment, a voice actually materialized out of nowhere to respond.
"Fluoxetine's purpose? Hmm... I genuinely have no insights this time!"
A cold, synthesized mechanical voice echoed through the car interior.
Neither the Tycoon nor Li Hua appeared particularly surprised, quickly identifying the sound's source—
The car's rear speaker system.
"You have no leads either?"
Li Hua sounded somewhat astonished.
Though both were Game Masters, his tone carried noticeably more respect.
Yet this "respect" seemed less like obligatory deference to a superior, and more like the courtesy a junior shows an elder.
"I wouldn't say completely without leads, just some baseless conjectures."
"If I had to speculate... perhaps this invitation serves two purposes."
"First, to draw out a specific individual—someone beyond the six invitees in your dungeon."
The mechanical voice continued.
"Someone beyond us? A specific target?"
Li Hua pondered this.
Then, as if struck by inspiration, he murmured incredulously: "I see... that explains why a 'puzzle' was necessary—because to solve it, we'd inevitably share it with others."
"Not only that, but out of caution, we'd also gather members from our own organizations..."
"And among them would be the person Fluoxetine wants to meet!"
The synthesized voice emitted an unnatural, slightly unsettling mechanical laugh: "Hahaha, correct. Like the ABC Murders—the best place to hide a tree is in a forest."
Hearing this, the Tycoon's expression changed slightly.
"Damn, choosing Jiangcheng as the location to draw out a specific person... going through all this trouble."
"Feels like the Psychological Society is coming for me!"
His face showed unprecedented gravity.
"Hmph, seems this rank twenty-seven, Order-affiliated, fourth-tier Unique Class expert has finally drawn their attention!"
The Tycoon's speculation seemed reasonable.
But Li Hua and the mysterious "Jiangcheng Game Master" clearly disagreed.
"One hundred percent not you," stated the mechanical voice.
Li Hua was more direct: "Brother He, you practically live at that old restaurant ruin of yours twenty-four seven. If they wanted you, would they need such elaborate measures?"
"My guess is she's targeting someone far more elusive..."
Li Hua's words carried clear implication.
The Tycoon caught the subtext.
"Well damn, that actually makes sense," he said, leaning toward the car speakers. "Hacker, maybe you should be careful!"
The Jiangcheng Game Master's voice responded:
"Also not me."
"Regardless, this target is extremely difficult to guess."
Li Hua adjusted his glasses again upon hearing this.
"Then let's set that aside... didn't you mention earlier there was a second purpose?"
"Chaos. This aligns with the Psychological Society's consistent methods," the mechanical voice coldly replied. "They want to use this opportunity to create chaos."
"Within their organization, whether radical faction, conservative faction, or moderates, all share one belief—chaos 'accelerates growth'."
"With all major factions now converging on Jiangcheng, centered around that overpass... we're likely to witness the exact kind of 'chaos' the Psychological Society desires!"
"If mishandled, there's over a seventy percent chance its scale will exceed last year's 'Mountain Snow Riot'!"
Both Li Hua and the Tycoon's expressions darkened.
"Is this your speculation?" asked the Tycoon, abandoning his usual casual demeanor to sit upright.

"So... gentlemen."
"Good luck."
The mechanical voice cut off abruptly.
The Tycoon and Li Hua wore grave expressions.
After a long silence, the Tycoon finally cursed:
"Well damn, I'd rather they were coming for me!"
......
Meanwhile, southern Jiangcheng.
At the city outskirts where urban areas transition to suburbs, in an unremarkable noodle shop beneath a residential building.
The Corporate Drone "Big Bird" from Lin Yu's squad had recommended this establishment.
Thus all six team members were currently enjoying authentic Jiangcheng dry-mixed noodles.
"Pretty damn tasty, though I still prefer braised noodles," commented the brawny High Mountain between loud slurps of his extra-large portion.
The group consisted entirely of young adult males who'd woken early and gone hungry until now. Faced with genuinely good noodles, they naturally focused entirely on eating.
Only Lin Yu maintained some decorum fitting his 'May May' persona.
Though another reason was...
While the noodles were good, as a lifelong Jiangcheng native, Lin Yu found them hardly remarkable.
Especially having grown up with his sister running a restaurant—this flavor was practically childhood comfort food.
But just as Lin Yu prepared to politely agree "these noodles are quite good"—
A voice from behind nearly made him jump out of his seat.
"Listen up everyone, my dad told me this place serves the real deal."
"Don't judge by appearances—I wouldn't bring just anyone here!"
A youthful, lively female voice floated in from the entrance.
And this voice...
Undoubtedly belonged to Li Nian.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Small Noodle Shop
chapters.content:
Upon hearing Li Nian's voice, Lin Yu's first reaction was that something was wrong.
But he quickly calmed down again.
Although the face of "May May" did resemble Lin Yu's somewhat, after the slight adjustments made by the False Face, upon closer inspection, people would think "these aren't the same person."
If Li Nian really saw him, she would most likely just think something like "Are they cousins?" or something along those lines.
Plus, with the completely different clothing style and aura, she might only feel that they looked a little similar at first glance.
As long as he didn't expose himself, everything would be fine.
What he mainly needed to worry about now...
was whether Gao Shan, the captain of Order, and the others in his team would recognize these few as members of the Free Alliance.
Without making a sound, Lin Yu used the reflection on the screen of his phone, which was turned off on the table, to glance over. Four people had just entered the door.
The Master Thief Li Nian was walking at the front. The young girl, as usual, wore sunglasses and had a casual demeanor.Behind her followed a fair-skinned man dressed very fashionably, wearing an open-collared shirt paired with a trendy round-neck shirt and a silver necklace. This was none other than the Magician Qian Huan, whom they had met earlier in the dungeon.
As for the other two.
One was a slender young girl wearing a plain black long skirt and black gloves. Her long jet-black hair flowed down to her waist, and her aura was somewhat cold and sinister.
The other was a burly man about 1.9 meters tall, dressed in a black tank top and gray sweatpants, with chest muscles bulging so much that they seemed ready to burst through the tight tank top.
Although Lin Yu did not know who they were...
based on the information from Zhu Ming’s identity earlier, Lin Yu was able to recognize them.
These two should be Prisoner and Undertaker.
The Master Thief was confirmed as Second Tier, the Magician was Third Tier.
These two were also likely above Second Tier.
But their own team setup...
aside from Captain Gao Shan being Second Tier, the rest were all First Tier!
If a direct fight broke out, even if they had a slight numerical advantage, Lin Yu felt...
the Free Alliance side would definitely have an overwhelming advantage.
Although even if both sides really fought, Lin Yu had countless contingency plans to ensure he could survive unscathed.
But it would be best if such a situation never occurred.
Lin Yu could only hope that neither side would recognize each other at all.
However...
the moment the group of four from the Free Alliance entered this noodle shop and Li Nian invited them to sit down, Lin Yu noticed that Gao Shan and Lu Wei both lifted their heads.
This unusual combination, especially with a dangerous-looking burly man among them, naturally triggered the two policemen’s professional instincts to pay extra attention.
Lu Wei’s eating slowed down involuntarily, and Gao Shan even directly put down his chopsticks.
Their gazes also attracted the attention of the other team members, who all turned their heads to look as well.
The five or six people here looking over together also caused the Free Alliance group to notice.
Although Lin Yu was reluctant to see such a scene...
their eyes indeed met.
"This is really bad..."
Lin Yu sighed silently in his heart but still lowered his voice to ask Gao Shan.
"Brother Shan, what's wrong? Do those people look like players?"
"Nothing... I just feel that the burly man in black looks like a martial artist, and he has a killing aura," Gao Shan said in a low voice, "They might not be players, but I have a feeling they are not to be trifled with."
Lu Wei also nodded in agreement: "And this combination is a bit strange..."
As Lin Yu was thinking about how to explain it,
Big Bird, the Corporate Drone on the other side, swallowed the noodles in his mouth and mumbled,
"Eh, it's nothing. I know that girl with the sunglasses over there!"
"She’s also a regular at this shop... and apparently the daughter of a wealthy local family."
"That guy over there is probably her bodyguard!"
Big Bird’s interjection eased much of the remaining suspicion from Lu Wei and Gao Shan.
The Security Guard, code-named 'Jiaozhou Big Steamed Bun,' who hadn’t spoken much, finally said,
"Let’s eat first. We still have a mission."
After hearing this, Gao Shan finally made up his mind.
"Right... better not stir up any trouble."
Even if there really was a fugitive or something, it would be the responsibility of Jiangcheng police.
Moreover, in Gao Shan’s view, players who disobey the Order were far more socially dangerous than ordinary criminals.
Besides, they might not even be criminals!
So it was better to stick to Li Hua’s plan, find the designated spot, and keep watch!
The group lowered their heads to continue eating noodles.
Behind them...
the conversation of Li Nian’s group drifted faintly into Lin Yu’s ears.
"Why were those guys staring at us just now?"
The tall, muscular man in the tank top asked quietly.
Li Nian’s voice responded: "Those guys over there feel like undercover cops on a mission... Brother Zhou, you lean like Fushiguro Megumi from Jujutsu Kaisen, and Xiaoyun looks like a mix of Enma Ai and Yuuko Ichihara. It’s normal for them to take a second look."
The tank top man scratched his head: "Who’s Fushiguro Megumi?"
Qian Huan chuckled: "You wouldn’t understand such a new series... anyway, he’s a very exaggerated muscular guy, kind of like Uraume from Yu Yu Hakusho."
The tank top man said happily: "Oh, Uraume! I know him! Am I really that good?"
Xiaoyun’s voice floated softly: "Almost, but your muscles are a bit more symmetrical."
The four-person conversation further relaxed Gao Shan and the others.
Lu Wei even sighed: "So it’s just a table of two-dimensional fans, then no problem."
Soon, as the four ordered, Lin Yu and his group finished their noodles and headed out.
When Gao Shan, as the captain, and Big Bird, who fancied himself a local boss, argued over the bill, the bun from hospitable Shandong province quietly paid while everyone was distracted.
Gao Shan felt a bit embarrassed.
"Well, as captain, I should at least show some gratitude. Boss, please pack a few bottles of mineral water and Red Bull for us to drink on the way."
"May May, help me carry them. Single King, take them on the bus first."
Though he didn’t know why Gao Shan stayed behind alone, Lin Yu didn’t object.
The two stood inside the shop waiting for the boss to pack the drinks, while the other four walked out.
Gao Shan handed a cigarette to Lin Yu, who waved it off politely.
The old policeman lit his own but didn’t light it, then patted Lin Yu’s shoulder: "This is probably your first time doing a team mission, right? Don’t be too nervous."
Hearing Gao Shan’s words, Lin Yu understood a bit.
It turned out the old cop was worried he wouldn’t adapt well to team cooperation.
He guessed the others had worked with Gao Shan before, so Gao Shan stayed behind with him alone.
Lin Yu smiled: "Brother Shan, you’re joking. I’m not someone who hasn’t seen the world."
"Good then."
Gao Shan nodded.
Soon, the boss finished packing the drinks. After scanning to pay, Gao Shan led Lin Yu outside.
Passing by Li Nian’s table at the door, as expected, Li Nian glanced at Lin Yu.
Although she seemed a bit startled at first, after looking carefully, she regained her composure.
Lin Yu noticed these subtle facial expression changes clearly.
Just as he had expected...
Li Nian did not recognize him, only felt that he looked familiar at first glance.
"This disguise really worked."
Lin Yu breathed a sigh of relief.This update is available on novel✦fire.net
But just as he relaxed slightly,
Gao Shan’s voice rang out again.
"Actually, I still have high hopes for you. If you perform well this time... maybe you can bypass the usual process to join officially, passing the probation before review."
"After all, that comrade Li Hua’s authority is not small."
Hearing Gao Shan’s words, Lin Yu’s scalp tingled instantly.
"This is completely over now."

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Exposure, Negotiation
chapters.content:
There is a famous line from the inspirational movie Forrest Gump, starring the renowned Oscar-winning actor Tom Hanks, which Lin Yu personally loves.
“Life is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re gonna get.”
At this moment, Lin Yu deeply understood this sentence.
Ever since Li Nian led three ‘Free Alliance’ players inside, Lin Yu felt as if he had encountered a chocolate that might have been made by Xie Te.
After both sides had just narrowly avoided trouble and busied themselves separately, Lin Yu realized that this chocolate really was chocolate;
Xie Te was just its appearance.
But now...
The moment the name “Li Hua” slipped out of Gaoshan’s mouth,
it was like biting into that chocolate and Lin Yu was joyfully surprised to discover...
Wow, it turned out to be Xie Te’s filled chocolate.
No one could be blamed. Although it was Gaoshan who said the name Li Hua and Big Bird who chose this restaurant, who would have thought that a whole table of ‘Free Alliance’ players would walk in?It was just all too coincidental.
Of course... Lin Yu still wanted to ask whether that crow was a god who controlled “fate.”
If so, Lin Yu wanted to greet its entire family.
“This damn well could have been settled from the start...”
Lin Yu sighed and reached into his pocket, blindly pressing the buttons on his phone.
Sure enough, all four members of the ‘Free Alliance’ simultaneously looked toward Gaoshan and Lin Yu.
Among them, a muscular man called “Old Zhou” glowed with sharp intent and spoke softly.
“Friend, you just mentioned ‘Li Hua,’ right?”
“I want to ask... is it the Li Hua I’m thinking of?”
Gaoshan stopped in his tracks, about to say something.
Lin Yu suddenly spoke instead.
“You know Secretary Li Hua from the Jiangcheng Procuratorate? Is that true?”
His tone was genuinely surprised, with no hint of deceit on his face.
It seemed he was truly shocked that the two-dimensional person they met at the noodle shop knew such an important figure.
At the same time, he subtly tugged Gaoshan’s shirt.
This unexpected reply made the ‘Free Alliance’ members glance at each other.
Because Lin Yu’s words sounded so convincing, they subconsciously thought, “Better to bluff our way through quickly.”
After all...
“Li Hua,” while a name with special meaning among players,
was indeed a very common name.
“Jiangcheng Procuratorate?”
Qianhuan quickly stepped in to smooth things over. “Ah, then that’s wrong. We’re looking for Li Hua, the deputy general manager of a real estate company in Jiangcheng!”
“He owes us a lot of project payments.”
Qianhuan said with a smile, and Li Nian quickly chimed in to support the story.
“Yeah, this Manager Li is really too much... don’t worry, I have some influence in Jiangcheng, so I’ll definitely help you find this guy!”
These two were quick to make up lies, matching Lin Yu’s speed, though their acting was slightly stiff.
However, with Lin Yu’s hint, the crafty Gaoshan naturally understood his meaning.
As a frontline police officer, he knew all too well that sometimes you can’t just rush in!
If these people were truly players, their ranks might not be low. It was best to call for backup first.
So Gaoshan nodded and put on a look of being fooled.
“Oh, so it’s not Secretary Li Hua... but Li Hua is indeed a common name.”
“If they refuse to pay debts, you can try legal channels. If it’s difficult for you, there are free legal aid services now.”
Gaoshan said casually, patting Lin Yu.
“Hope your trip goes smoothly. Let’s go, Lao Wu.”
He didn’t dare call Lin Yu by May anymore.
But just as Lin Yu and Gaoshan were about to leave in this awkward atmosphere...
the girl in the black dress tilted her head.
“Wait a moment.”
She took a folding umbrella from her delicate handbag and pressed a button to open it.
The pitch-black canopy spread open with a whoosh, blocking their way.
The black-dressed girl looked at the three companions at her table and said lightly,
“Don’t be so easily led by others... Although it’s useless against most advanced players, it doesn’t hurt to test suspicious people by moving a thought first.”
“There’s no need for you two to keep acting... You’re players, right? Players of the ‘Death Game.’”
Xiaoyun’s words caused Gaoshan’s expression to shift slightly.
They were exposed!
The burly man also showed a surprised look.
“Good kid, you almost fooled us!”
“So you’re the players!”
He clenched his fists.
Gaoshan exhaled and spoke succinctly,
“I’ll hold them off. You call for backup.”
He slowly bent down and drew a police baton from his waist.
Lin Yu saw Qianhuan also reveal a battle-ready stance.
And just when it seemed a crisis was imminent...
the noodle shop owner’s voice rang out.
“Guests, your two small portions, one medium portion, and two large portions of mixed noodles are ready!”
The friendly owner appeared carrying a tray.
Gaoshan immediately put away his baton behind his back and stepped aside.
Li Nian also tapped the table.
“Hey, Old Zhou, Huanzi, and Sister Xiaoyun, this noodle shop is one I ‘really like.’”
“So... let’s eat noodles properly first.”
Then Li Nian smiled at the owner.
“Two large portions for that tall guy, one medium for me, and small portions for the other two.”
The owner arranged the noodles according to Li Nian’s instructions.
“Old Zhou” exhaled and sat down, breaking his chopsticks and starting to mix the noodles.
Xiaoyun pursed her lips.
“Since A Nian said so... well, I’ll give you some face.”
With a “snap,” she closed the umbrella.
Lin Yu was still stunned in place when Gaoshan pulled him.
“Hurry up and go!”
Having just heard the name “A Nian,” Gaoshan had already reacted...
these people sitting here were from the ‘Free Alliance’!
Although he didn’t know why they were letting them go, impulsiveness and unpredictability were the trademarks of this organization.
Seizing this opportunity, of course, they had to leave.
But...
at this moment, Lin Yu pulled over a chair and sat down heavily at this table.
“Brother Shan, you should leave first.”
Then he calmly said, “Everyone, one of you can leave, right? Let me stay behind as a hostage.”
The four ‘Free Alliance’ members looked at Lin Yu’s move, somewhat surprised.
Li Nian still smiled and said,
“Oh, quite the talent... Have you joined ‘Order’ yet?”
“Want to consider joining our ‘Free Alliance’?”
The vest-wearing man sighed,
“What a pity!”
Gaoshan didn’t understand how these two reacted...
If he and Lin Yu had taken one step outside just now, that would have been real danger!
Lin Yu exhaled.
Although the other two didn’t understand, Li Nian and Qianhuan had some prior interaction with him.
Those two were clearly “acting” on purpose just now.
Li Nian’s acting... still had flaws, as usual.
But that didn’t matter.The source of thɪs content is NoveIꜰire.net
“So, what do you think of my conditions?”
Qianhuan stroked his chin and said, “Actually, I don’t have much objection... but if you want to negotiate, what capital do you have to come to the negotiation table?”
“Just this guy here could probably crush you two without much trouble.”
Qianhuan pointed at the vest-wearing man.
Lin Yu remained calm and shook the brooch on his collar.
“Our capital is... although we will die, well...”
“You wouldn’t want the ‘Gambler’ and the ‘Tycoon’ to lock onto your whereabouts and appear in front of you next moment, would you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Negotiation Success! Lin Yu’s Brilliant Move!
chapters.content:
Through cross-verifying various insider information from different player circles during this period, Lin Yu easily reached a conclusion.
The strength of the Tycoon was very formidable.
In fact, among all the players he had seen so far...
The title of the 27th-ranked Tycoon nationwide, combined with Li Hua, who was at least on par with several others, was enough to intimidate the four members of the Free Alliance.
Lin Yu sat calmly here, pointing at the brooch as he spoke.
“This is called the Soul Spirit Golden Brooch. I don’t know if you’ve heard of it... but anyway, it can monitor our vital signs in real time.”
“The moment any of us dies, the last place where its signal disappears will be locked onto by the Gambler and the Tycoon.”
“Don’t forget, you still have to stay in Jiangcheng for a whole day... If your whereabouts are exposed now and become the ‘number one target’ for these two, as well as the Jiangcheng Order branch and the local gang Jiang’an Hall, your priority over more than 24 hours will surpass that of the Marauders and the Psychological Society. Can you really accept that?”
“If you release the people over there, maybe he will report to the Order. But on one hand, you have enough time to evacuate, and on the other... you haven’t actively killed any Order members in this operation so far. Li Hua and the Tycoon might try to track your location, but it’s not to the extent where they have to go all out against you, right?”
“Besides, the plan I just proposed—to release him—is the most beneficial for you... You can just release the Order’s team leader here and use my life as a bargaining chip to make him temporarily hold off on reporting to the Order.”Lin Yu explained calmly and clearly.
He was composedly using the Soul Spirit Golden Brooch as the foundation and the Tycoon’s reputation as a deterrent. Combining these two gave him the leverage to negotiate.
On this premise, the plan he proposed...
Was indeed the “best” for the Free Alliance members.
As expected, after hearing Lin Yu’s entire explanation, the four from the Free Alliance were clearly persuaded.For original chapters go to novelFɪre.net
“You’re quite clever and resourceful, and the plan you proposed sounds reasonable,” the muscular man in the vest said, “I vote in favor.”
“Already moved to the voting stage? Then I’ll vote in favor too!”
“After all, what this guy said is absolutely right... He even considered our ‘way out’,” Phantom said with a smile.
The girl in the black dress pursed her lips, “That’s already two votes... but I have no objection. I think having him join might actually be pretty interesting.”
Li Nian grinned, “It should be quite, quite interesting—unanimous approval!”
But the four from the Free Alliance agreed, Captain High Mountain resisted as he spoke.
“May, let me stay behind... After all, you’re just here to help, I’m the Order member.”
“You shouldn’t take such risks!”
He gritted his teeth and spoke, but Lin Yu interrupted him.
“No, you heard it too, Brother Shan... They agreed to the plan, and the majority agreed to bring me along.”
“And if the two of us go back, you as the ‘captain’ can come up with an excuse to fool the others... If you leave, they will definitely notice something.”
High Mountain was about to say something else, but Lin Yu’s words completely cut him off.
“As the captain of the Order, although it’s cruel, Brother Shan, you must be calm—calm to the point of cold-bloodedness,” Lin Yu said, lifting his head while sitting on the chair, “Besides, I might not even die... Don’t let me down.”
High Mountain clenched his teeth and finally spat out one word.
“Damn!”
Xiaoyun’s light and somewhat airy voice reminded him as well.
“If you don’t leave soon, your teammates will come over... It’s better to follow what this junior member said before we change our minds.”
“We will return him to you once we confirm a safe place... maybe.”
High Mountain finally stopped resisting. He swallowed the endless guilt and fury, adjusted his expression, and turned to leave the store.
Lin Yu’s last four words, “Don’t let me down,” struck his heart like a heavy hammer, causing this veteran policeman—who had been accustomed to sacrifice and death due to his profession even before entering the Death Game—to feel profound helplessness.
He hated it so much.
Hated himself for bringing up Li Hua, hated himself for making Lin Yu buy water, hated himself because... he wasn’t strong enough!
Lin Yu could not blame him, but High Mountain could not avoid blaming himself.
“You must definitely come back safely, Brother May.”
High Mountain left without looking back.
Watching his departing figure, Lin Yu turned to the four from the Free Alliance.
Old Zhou had already resumed noisily eating his noodles.
But the other three looked at Lin Yu with interest.
Phantom spoke, “May, right? I’ve heard rumors about you recently. Seems like a very powerful rookie.”
“Seeing you today, you really live up to your reputation.”
He praised with a smile.
Li Nian was more direct, “Although your plan is indeed the ‘optimal solution’ from a macro perspective, you and he won’t die, and we can accept that... But why?”
“Actively surrendering yourself to us, do you consider your own life as a ‘pawn’ too?”
Li Nian’s question was very reasonable.
Because the plan Lin Yu proposed had many advantages, but only one drawback...
He was the one who wouldn’t get out safely!
Normally, it’s hard for anyone to come up with a plan at the first moment that “benefits themselves the least.”
It’s like in Go, sacrificing a stone to break a deadlock.
Many people can think of such solutions in long-circulated life-or-death problems, but if someone made such a move in an actual match...
It could only be called a brilliant move.
Yet Lin Yu remained composed.
He looked at Li Nian, the girl he was most familiar with among the four.
She still hadn’t recognized him because at this moment, his “persona” as a Doctor was the polar opposite of his persona as a Soldier.
As a Soldier, he looked like a clever guy but was actually arrogant, narcissistic, and easily emotional.
But now, as a Doctor...
He was calm to the point of being almost abnormal.
Based on this persona, Lin Yu was able to give an answer that convinced Li Nian and the other three.
“Yes, I do consider myself a pawn... What I’m seeking is the overall optimal solution.”
“Moreover, I’m not the one who benefits the least as you think.”
Lin Yu said this, which further piqued Li Nian’s curiosity.
“What other benefits can you gain?”
Phantom reacted, “From their conversation just now, this guy doesn’t seem to have joined the Order... He’s boosting his reputation!”
Hearing Phantom’s words, Lin Yu smiled and nodded.
“You’re right, Mr. Magician... But for me, there’s an even greater benefit.”
“I get to experience the noble feeling of ‘sacrificing oneself to cover the retreat.’ This will greatly satisfy my psychological craving for ‘fairness and justice’ and my desire to ‘become a hero’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Favors and Connections
chapters.content:
Lin Yu never expected that...
After circling around with the four members of the Free Alliance, he actually ended up back at the hotel on the top floor of Shengjiang Tower.
Although it wasn’t the same room, Li Nian had also booked here.
There was still almost a whole day before Thursday night, and since the four members of the Free Alliance weren’t from the Order, they didn’t need to set up checkpoints near the abandoned overpass in the southern part of the city in advance.
However...
Lin Yu originally thought these people would at least hold some kind of battle meeting or something...
But these people...
were a bit too free-spirited.
Old Zhou, the guy in the tank top, was exercising there. Having just finished a set of Russian push-ups, he was now doing clapping push-ups.
On his back sat Xiaoyun, the girl in the black dress who was watching beauty videos.Meanwhile, Qianhuan and Li Nian were playing blackjack with a deck of cards.
None of these four even cared about Lin Yu in the room, as if he had really opened the door and left...
And no one tried to stop him either.
“Is this what relaxation feels like?”
Lin Yu couldn’t help but sigh aloud.
Hearing Lin Yu’s words, Old Zhou raised his head while doing the clapping push-ups.
“This is exactly how we Free Alliance operate. Interested now?”
“I still quite like you. Want to consider joining us?”
This was the second time Lin Yu had received such a warm invitation from the Free Alliance.
Lin Yu smiled and politely declined.
“No thanks, everyone... Besides, I’ve already said, I have a near-obsessive desire to ‘become a hero.’”
“The organization that can best fulfill my pursuit among players is still the Order.”
Lin Yu emphasized again.
Xiaoyun, who was sitting on Old Zhou’s back, paused the video and blinked. “But to be able to dissect that ‘desire’ so clearly and say it so calmly, maybe the Free Alliance suits you well too.”
“After all... we won’t stop you from pursuing justice.”
Lin Yu still refused politely.
“Better to pass.”
Li Nian seemed to have a bad hand and took this opportunity to toss down her cards and bounced over to Lin Yu.
“You dare refuse us again and again when you’re in our hands? Aren’t you afraid we’ll just kill you outright?”
“Although we don’t want to expose ourselves, we’re not especially scared of those two guys... If we were afraid, none of us would have gotten involved in this mess!”
Li Nian’s tone was teasing but carried a hint of menace.
Lin Yu looked at Li Nian, expression unchanged.
“I can still tell the difference between threats and jokes;
your words don’t scare me.”
“Of course... the most important thing is that joining the Free Alliance would be a ‘good thing’ from your perspective. I refuse your benefits, but of course, I won’t make you angry.”
Qianhuan threw the cards on the floor and spoke lazily, “I disagree with them. I think you really belong in the Order...”
“And precisely because of that, I’m a bit reluctant to let you go.”Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on net
Qianhuan spoke casually, but compared to Li Nian just now, he was now more like a genuine threat.
Hearing Qianhuan’s words, the other three members of the Free Alliance stopped what they were doing and showed interested expressions.
Although all three somewhat admired Lin Yu, and even had some fondness for the “May” persona Lin Yu was playing, the Free Alliance members indeed enjoyed a very high degree of freedom among themselves.
And for trivial matters like this, they wouldn’t interfere with each other’s decisions.
Qianhuan walked straight toward Lin Yu.
“If I said I was willing to risk being hunted by Li Hua and Tycoon to kill you right here... what would you do?”
“Sacrifice yourself like a ‘real hero’?”
As Qianhuan spoke, he flipped a sharp playing card between his fingers and pressed it against Lin Yu’s throat.
The razor-sharp edge of the card emitted a chilling coldness.
Without the cover of the Fluoxetine identity and the game rules inside the dungeon as a buffer,
Lin Yu clearly realized at this moment when facing Qianhuan directly...
Qianhuan was someone he absolutely could not confront head-on at this time.
But life and death were never determined solely by the difference in “power.”
Although Lin Yu, as May May, had given reasons for staying because of a “hero complex,”
Lin Yu himself did not have such a complex!
The real reason he stayed as Lin Yu was most importantly...
With Li Nian and Qianhuan present, Lin Yu had too many ways to guarantee he wouldn’t die.
He only needed to casually throw out some “information.”
Looking into Qianhuan’s eyes, Lin Yu spoke calmly.
“You are the one who cannot kill me because...”
“You owe me a favor.”
Lin Yu said this, and Qianhuan narrowed his eyes.
“I owe you a favor? This is the first time I’ve met you!”
Lin Yu silently pulled out his phone from his pocket and lit up the screen.
Earlier in the restaurant, he had secretly sent a message.
That message was not a call for help but was forging “evidence.”
On the phone belonging to May May, there was a text from Zhu Ming.
“The answer is correct. If needed, tell me. This answer is worth one favor from the Magician.”
Lin Yu looked at Qianhuan and said,
“I don’t know if you’ve heard of Furbollo;
he’s my friend—he’s willing to be friends with me because my puzzle-solving ability is not inferior to his.”
“So... the answer to the ‘time and place’ riddle was solved by me.”
“Zhu Ming asked me to do it.”
Qianhuan looked at Li Nian, who was somewhat surprised and stepped forward to take Lin Yu’s phone, checking the number.
“It really is... Hey, what’s your relationship with Zhu Ming?!”
Lin Yu took the phone back from Li Nian.
“I am under no obligation to tell you that.”
He looked at Qianhuan and smiled, “If I’m not mistaken, the person who needs to rush to the abandoned overpass in the southern part of the city on Thursday night... is also you, Mr. Magician.”
Qianhuan put away the playing cards.
“You got it right... What a surprise, didn’t expect to randomly grab a hostage from the Order and find someone I owe a favor to!”
Qianhuan looked at the other three.
“Hey, can I be the one to make the call and repay the favor... and just let this guy go?”
“No problem,” Li Nian said, resting her chin on her hand, “It’s just changing hotels after all—if we release him, according to what he said, we won’t be the primary target.”
“As long as we don’t go too far, the Order will definitely still be more concerned about the Marauders first.”
Old Zhou and Xiaoyun had no objections either.
However, Lin Yu shook his head.
“No, I’m not planning to leave yet.”

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Free Activity Time, Switching Identities!
chapters.content:
“Are you not planning to leave? Why are you still here?”
Phantom looked at Lin Yu with some curiosity and asked.
“Shouldn’t you be rushing back to the Order’s team? The situation in Jiangcheng is going to be chaotic.”
Although he was a member of the Free Alliance, Phantom was quite clear about grudges and alliances.
Just moments ago, he had entertained the idea of killing Lin Yu, but after learning that Lin Yu had helped him...
That previous statement was almost a well-intentioned reminder.
Lin Yu nodded appreciatively but did not follow Phantom’s advice.
“As a First-Tier doctor, even if I return to the team, I won’t have a decisive impact on the overall situation.”
“On the contrary, if I stay with you, from a ‘big picture’ perspective, it’s actually the optimal choice.”
Lin Yu said calmly.Li Nian reacted immediately.
“Oh my, so you’re planning to use yourself as a human surveillance eye to monitor us with your physical body?”
“Using yourself to restrict our actions... that’s actually a clever idea.”
Old Zhou showed a troubled expression.
“What do we do about this... We can’t possibly carry him around everywhere, right?”
“We definitely can’t kill him!”
Xiaoyun sighed and pointed to her head. “Don’t get stuck on one idea...”
Phantom picked up the conversation. “We don’t have to kill him, but we also don’t have to bring him along.”
“This is where my clever tools come in,” Li Nian stuck out her tongue, licked her lips, and rummaged in her pocket. “This one, this one... hey!”
She pulled out an entire “oil painting.”
It depicted the scene of a certain “room.”
Xiaoyun glanced at it and curiously said, “This is Kui’s piece, right? I heard it was auctioned off at the last anonymous trade meeting of the Hunters’ Association. Turns out you spent a fortune buying it!”
Phantom chuckled lightly. “Xiaoyun, you still don’t really understand A Nian...”
Li Nian laughed heartily.
“What a joke, of course I stole it!”
She tossed the oil painting onto the ground and then winked at Lin Yu.
“Nice to meet you, May May—well, see you next time if fate allows.”
Then, Li Nian snapped her fingers.
“Sister Xiaoyun, please make sure this guy doesn’t come over.”
Xiaoyun nodded.
Suddenly, another pale hand appeared out of thin air in her grasp.
The severed part was stitched, the skin pale with a lifeless bluish-purple hue. Judging by the size and shape of the knuckles and palm, it seemed to belong to an adult male.
Xiaoyun gently waved this short hand.
“No ‘forward movement’ allowed here.”
She whispered, and an invisible barrier stretched between Lin Yu and the four of them.
Lin Yu tried to step forward but seemed to hit an air wall.
“What kind of ability is this?”
Xiaoyun looked at Lin Yu’s awkward state and pursed her lips in response.
“This ability is derived from the Referee’s power changes... but I’m not the Referee, he is.”
She shook the severed hand in her palm.
“To introduce myself, although everyone calls me Xiaoyun, that was a forum ID I used before... My more official codename is Undertaker.”
“Nice to meet you, Doctor May.”
After saying this...
On the other side of the invisible barrier, four Free Alliance members jumped into the oil painting on the ground.
It was as if they had leapt into an “entrance.” The painting’s surface rippled like water waves, then returned to calm.
Afterwards, the oil painting disappeared from its original place.
Lin Yu watched this scene thoughtfully.
“Hm... so this is the Painter’s chosen follow-up ability after selecting [Paint], becoming an ‘Oil Painter’...”ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NoveI-Fire.ɴet
It was completely the opposite of the ‘Sketch Painter’ who chose [Pencil].
Robin’s follow-up ability was still to let things inside the painting come out...
But this ability, after advancement, seemed to let things outside enter into the painting.
As to why Lin Yu was so sure this was related to the Painter’s ability,
It was because the previously mentioned Kui was a well-known figure on the leaderboard.
Ranked eighty-fifth, the Painter was also somewhat famous on the forum.
Of course, none of that really mattered.
What mattered was...
“Phew, they really left!”
Lin Yu sat on the suite’s sofa and exhaled deeply.
Although he knew he probably wouldn’t die, this feeling of dancing on the edge of a knife still made him nervous.
However, the performance was a success.
Now, the “May May” identity must have become much more vivid within the Free Alliance.
Even after Gao Shan returned, he would likely boost Lin Yu’s reputation back in the Order.
This identity’s fame was still rising.
More importantly...
Although this was a last-minute idea after being exposed, Lin Yu’s current situation was truly perfect.
Being “kidnapped” by the Free Alliance should have been disadvantageous.
But now, it had completely turned into an advantage!
In Lin Yu’s plan, he definitely wouldn’t get involved in this incident under the “Lin Yu” identity.
But the three identities of “Old Yao,” “May,” and “Zhu Ming,” along with the Heavenly Artisan whom he had “taken over”... Lin Yu wanted to show himself as much as possible.
Unfortunately, the Order, Marauders, Jiang’an Hall, and Free Alliance all displayed high organizational discipline during this overly serious incident.
So Lin Yu’s initial plan was to prioritize maintaining the somewhat famous “May May” identity to keep building presence.
The others would just send some texts or provide a bit of intelligence.
But now...
After the Free Alliance took him away and then left Lin Yu alone here, it was practically a perfect “alibi” for him!
The most important thing was that after Lin Yu realized this, he deliberately lured the four Free Alliance members to abandon him...
Those four didn’t even realize that Lin Yu also wanted to leave.
Therefore...
At this moment, Lin Yu had regained absolute freedom—the “free activity time.”
“So, whose identity should I use next?”
Lin Yu left the room, walked to the stairwell hidden from surveillance, and pulled out several phones to check back and forth.
Soon after...
Lin Yu had his answer.
“Got it, time to head to the airport for the pickup!”
He wiped his face with his hand, and his facial features quickly shifted into the appearance of an older man.
Lin Yu transformed into Heavenly Artisan’s appearance.
Then, he typed a reply to a message on Heavenly Artisan’s phone.
[A Yu: Anyone in Jiangcheng? A few people gather at the airport. I just landed! Don’t come if you haven’t advanced!]
More than ten people had already replied sporadically to A Yu.
Although the Marauders in Jiangcheng didn’t seem very powerful, there were still people.
Lin Yu also followed with a formation message.
[Heavenly Artisan: Arriving soon!]

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Marauders' Stronghold, Selection
chapters.content:
At Jiangcheng International Airport Terminal 2, domestic flight exit.
As evening approached in Jiangcheng, the weather gradually turned somewhat gloomy.
Because the airport itself was located in the southern suburbs of the city, Lin Yu didn’t take long to get here by taxi.
After getting out of the taxi, Lin Yu quickly found members of the Marauders without much effort.
About ten people were gathered around a tour bus, crowding around a girl with dyed yellow hair.
The girl's style was also very eye-catching—clashing colors, a laser jacket, scattered metal accessories, exaggerated fishnet stockings, and short boots, forming a typical millennial Y2K fashion style.
Plus, the girl was naturally beautiful, causing quite a few travelers to subconsciously assume she was some internet celebrity who had come to Jiangcheng.
Lin Yu recognized her too.
It was Fish from the last dungeon!
Her real-life outfit was even more flamboyant than in the Death Game.Lin Yu felt that Fish’s personality was probably even more flamboyant than he had imagined. He quickly walked forward and showed the app page open on his Heavenly Artisan phone, identifying himself.
“Everyone, I am Heavenly Artisan from Zheng City... Due to some reasons, I happened to be stuck in Jiangcheng, so I’m here to participate in this mission.”
“I am a ‘First-Tier’ ‘Craftsman.’”
As he introduced himself, Fish raised her eyebrows.
“Oh, a ‘Craftsman,’ that’s okay... Come on in.”
Lin Yu obediently stepped into the line.
However...
The Marauders members from various parts of Jiangcheng, plus a few so-called “associates” that Fish probably brought from Beijing, cast some hostile looks toward Lin Yu.
The Marauders, as an organization gathering all kinds of rule-breaking, profit-driven killers, didn’t have a very harmonious internal atmosphere.
Mutual suspicion and wariness among members were very normal.
Those who had interacted within the same city branch might get along a bit better, but people from different branches truly had the feeling of “villagers meeting villagers.”
Especially with Heavenly Artisan’s recent reputation... it was quite notorious.
May May’s identity had recently gained some fame, and most of his reputation came from Heavenly Artisan.
So, conversely, Heavenly Artisan naturally became famous as well.
Especially within the Marauders, Heavenly Artisan had almost turned into a negative example.
Because of this, even though Lin Yu stood quietly among the crowd without provoking anyone, he could still hear some biting criticisms.
“Oh, isn’t that the lost dog?”
“So he didn’t go back to Henan Province...”
“Does the Zheng City branch have no face to return?”
Several people from the Jiangcheng Marauders branch mocked.
And the members from Yanjing standing closer to Fish were extremely disdainful.
“What’s someone like this doing here, Chief...”
“Isn’t this just making things worse?”
“Just get rid of him!”
Fish herself disagreed: “If he’s here, he’s here to help, so say less.”
But she only limited herself to persuasion.
The ridicule toward Lin Yu in the team somewhat subsided, but everyone still showed him little goodwill.
In response...
Lin Yu remained very calm.
He clearly knew these people were targeting Heavenly Artisan, not Lin Yu himself!
Moreover, for an “actor,” if a character is played to the point the audience intensely dislikes them, it’s also a kind of recognition for the actor’s skill.
Currently, Heavenly Artisan’s character image was indeed somewhat “negative.”
After all, he was meant to be a stepping stone for Lin Yu’s other characters.
However, since Lin Yu chose to keep this identity and brought it out now,
he was precisely planning to reverse Heavenly Artisan’s image.
He still had to keep using it going forward.
As a few more people gradually arrived, the Marauders group eventually formed nearly twenty people, slightly smaller in scale than the Order.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ novelꜰire.net
Among them, Fish brought four people from Yanjing.
The rest were Marauders members from Jiangcheng and surrounding cities.
The twenty-plus people boarded the tour bus parked in the airport parking lot, sitting down in small groups.
Then...
The driver from Yanjing started the vehicle, and the bus slowly moved forward.
Recalling what he had seen earlier in Zheng City, Lin Yu couldn’t help but be curious...
Where would the Jiangcheng Marauders branch place Fish?
He soon got the answer.
Because the bus’s destination wasn’t far from the airport.
Soon, the bus stopped at an abandoned dock.
On this dock was a huge, old, rusty, seemingly abandoned cargo ship.
Many containers were stacked on top.
Among the Jiangcheng Marauders members, the highest-ranking one spoke to Fish, explaining.
“This will be our temporary stronghold for this trip, Deputy Chief.”
“Before relocating, this was our branch’s original location.”
“Now, it’s still a branch outpost that hasn’t been abandoned.”
The adult male in a suit, speaking respectfully to Fish who was much younger, maintained a courteous tone.
Fish slightly nodded.
“Not bad, very concealed... and not too far from that overpass.”
“But it looks like it’s going to rain. Is this place waterproof? It won’t leak, right?”
Looking out at the gloomy weather, Fish raised her concern.
“Of course not!”
The Jiangcheng Marauders leader pounded his chest with confidence.
“Don’t be fooled by the shabby appearance, that’s all camouflage... Inside, it’s not just waterproof, the soft furnishings are quite good! Lighting and ceiling height all meet standards!”
His tone was practiced enough to make Lin Yu suspect this guy’s profession was probably some kind of broker.
However, though exaggerated, he wasn’t lying.
Under his lead, the group entered the ship’s interior through a hidden staircase inside a container on the deck...
The interior decoration was indeed quite nice.
Carpet covered the hallways, and ceiling chandeliers gave off gentle warm light.
Rooms were arranged on both sides of the hallway, and the original cargo hold at the far end was converted into a space similar to the underground area in Zheng City.
There was a “training area” and a “recreation area.”
“How is it, Deputy Chief? Not bad, right?”
Fish nodded.
“Not bad, quite standard...”
She walked to the sofa by the arena, sat down, adjusted her posture, and comfortably crossed her legs.
“Since there’s an arena here, that makes things easier.”
“This operation is very important, so... participants will receive very generous rewards.”
“But at the same time...”
“All players below ‘Second Tier’ will undergo a selection and assessment by me!”
“Only those who pass will be eligible to participate in the upcoming operation!”

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Assessment Begins, Lin Yu’s Observation
chapters.content:
Although the Marauders are a large organization, advancing within it is relatively simple.
Whoever is strong can become the leader.
Most player organizations tend to have this kind of inclination to some extent.
But only the Marauders use strength almost exclusively as the criterion to determine internal status.
This is why Fish, such a young girl who clearly has little experience leading an organization, can hold the position of Deputy Chief at the Yanjing Headquarters.
Because she is a Unique Class, and a Third Tier Unique Class at that.
Once the standard and consensus that “strength determines status” spread throughout the Marauders, other matters inside the organization besides status were often ultimately resolved by “fists.”
Whether it was disagreements between members or the distribution of benefits, it could all be settled by “you two fight it out.”
Today was no exception.
Inside the ship’s cabin, Fish half-reclined on the sofa, announcing the upcoming selection rules.“Although I’m glad you all came, this operation involves a lot… The Order has already started moving;
I expect everyone will come to grab a share… In short, the situation is very complicated!”
“I don’t want any dead weight in such a critical operation, so a necessary selection must be conducted.”
“Of course, rest assured, I’m not expecting you to duel one-on-one… that would be too inefficient.”
Fish snapped her fingers.
“Assessments will be handled by my capable subordinate, my most trusted right hand—Sea Cucumber!”
“Come on, Sea Cucumber, show them what’s up!”
A tall, skinny young man with a trendy tin-foil perm hairstyle stood up.
“Damn, let’s go!”
He flipped sideways into the air, letting out a wild yell as he jumped directly onto the half-meter-high stage.
Then, the young man named Sea Cucumber stood firm on the stage and stretched his joints.
He then raised his head and spoke.
“Everyone, my name is Sea Cucumber, from Yanjing Headquarters, Second Tier, profession: Enforcer!”
“Next, I will be responsible for assessing you… Don’t worry, this isn’t about life-or-death fighting with me.”
“You just need to come up, go through three moves under my hand, and land one attack on me.”
“I will hold back—after all, if I injure you, I’ll have to treat you.”
“At the same time, you’re free to use any items, but I’ll only use one or two.”
Sea Cucumber said as he circled the crowd.
“Who’s first?”
Although Sea Cucumber’s aura and status as a Second Tier Enforcer were intimidating, most Marauders weren’t easily scared;
they were often quite fierce.
So many eagerly prepared to step forward.
Sea Cucumber casually picked one.
“You, you’re up!”
A Marauders member from Jiangcheng took the stage.
“My profession is Corporate Drone. Pleased to meet you.”
After a brief greeting, Sea Cucumber nodded.
“Then I’ll start!”
Seeing the opponent get into position, Sea Cucumber immediately surged forward.
Lin Yu watched this scene and raised an eyebrow.
“A martial artist, huh…”
Sea Cucumber’s footwork was very professional, clearly trained in Sanda.
The Corporate Drone took two steps back to create distance, then pulled out a telescopic baton from his pocket.
Seeing the baton, Lin Yu couldn’t quite hold back a twitch at the corner of his mouth.
That was one he had sold before.
For some unknown reason, it had ended up in the hands of a Marauders member.
Whether it was resold to him or he robbed some unlucky buyer, no one knew.
In any case, the Corporate Drone wildly swung the baton up and down, trying to hit Sea Cucumber.
But to Sea Cucumber…
The moves were way too amateurish!
Fish’s trusted right hand easily dodged the chaotic swings, then sidestepped and punched the Corporate Drone in the liver.
“One!”
Sea Cucumber shouted loudly.
Then he pulled back again;
the Corporate Drone’s face twisted fiercely but he managed to stay on his feet.
After stabilizing his stance, the Corporate Drone attacked Sea Cucumber again.
Seeing the opponent move again, Sea Cucumber resumed his footwork.
Again, two dodges, body swaying lightly—this time a side kick sweeping low.
“Bang!”
Sea Cucumber kicked the Corporate Drone’s calf;
the Corporate Drone lost balance and fell to the ground.
Seeing the opponent fall, Sea Cucumber stepped back.
“Two!”
He raised two fingers.
The Corporate Drone shakily got up.
Once he was steady, Sea Cucumber didn’t wait for him to move first and charged forward with a stabbing punch.
“Three!”
“Bang!”
Sea Cucumber struck, causing the Corporate Drone’s nose to bleed.
The Corporate Drone covered his nose, grimacing fiercely.
“Definitely strong!”
He looked at Sea Cucumber with admiration.
This guy was among the stronger Second Tiers.
But Sea Cucumber beckoned with a finger.
“Come on, your turn to hit me—this time I won’t interfere, use your full strength.”
The Corporate Drone nodded and pulled out something like a spray from his pocket, inhaling from it.
After using it, he seemed to forget pain, standing upright with blood-red eyes.
Obviously, he used some kind of buff item!
He shook the baton in his hand and whispered,
“Watch out!”
Then, like an arrow released from a bow, the Corporate Drone charged at Sea Cucumber.
The baton slammed down with a heavy “thud!”
At some point, Sea Cucumber had a shield in his hand that looked like a giant konjac—very elastic.
The baton struck the shield, its force completely absorbed, causing the konjac shield’s surface to wobble nonstop.
Even so, Sea Cucumber was pushed back two steps.
Sea Cucumber’s eyes showed approval.
“That thing just now was not bad. If you can use it again tomorrow, I’ll consider you passed!”
“Of course I can. I wouldn’t waste a one-time or long cooldown item just for a test.”ᴛhis ᴜpdated by N0veI.Fiɾe.net
The Corporate Drone put away the baton, panting heavily.
“Then you passed!”
Sea Cucumber announced confidently.
This made Lin Yu think deeply.
“Hmm, it seems that even if you look a bit clumsy, as long as you seem ‘useful,’ you can pass.”
The Corporate Drone was almost toyed with during the “fight” segment, but that final attack seemed vicious enough to pass.
Perhaps the reason why the opponent was allowed to use items was precisely this.
“In other words, the assessment standard isn’t as strict as imagined.”
Thinking this, Lin Yu temporarily left the stage front and sat down near the bar.
Then, he continued observing the following candidates!
After the Corporate Drone’s performance, everyone had a better understanding of Sea Cucumber’s “assessment process.”
Therefore, those stepping onto the stage became more enthusiastic and eager!

chapters.title: Chapter 198: The Battle for Reputation
chapters.content:
Next, all the First-Tier players inside the arena successively stepped onto the stage to undergo the "assessment."
Some performed better than the Corporate Drones in the first three moves. Although clearly inferior to Sea Cucumber, they could still block one or two attacks.
Those who performed even better managed to land one or two hits on Sea Cucumber.
Some were knocked to the ground after just two moves.
Others were similar to the Corporate Drones—enduring a beating but gritting their teeth and holding on.
During the attack phase, everyone displayed their own tricks.
However, most were stopped by Sea Cucumber’s massive konjac shield.
The Marauders sent a total of twenty-two people this time. Except for Fish, among the other twenty-one, only six had surpassed Second Tier.
The remaining fifteen were First-Tier;
fourteen of them underwent the assessment.
Five were filtered out, judged unqualified by Sea Cucumber, and thus could not participate in this operation.Because their skills were clearly lacking and Fish had given them some compensation money, these five left cleanly and promptly.
After the last one left the stage, Fish looked toward Sea Cucumber resting beside the arena and pondered before speaking.
"Hey, wait... isn’t there one person missing?"
"Looks like someone hasn’t been assessed yet, right?"
Fish’s question immediately drew responses from the crowd.
"That’s right, Sister Fish, there’s someone sitting at the bar!"
"It’s that cowardly Heavenly Artisan... Hey, you’re not afraid to go up now, are you?"
"Just forfeit already!"
A few people who disliked Heavenly Artisan easily mocked him again.
When Lin Yu met them earlier, his reaction was indifferent, which only encouraged them more this time.
Fish turned her head, somewhat surprised, and said,
"Wait, why are you still eating?"
Lin Yu, sitting at the bar, had already unpacked quite a few snacks and instant foods from the nearby cabinet and had been eating there for a while.
He swallowed the bread in his mouth, drank a bottle of water, and then replied to Fish.
"Sorry, I came too quickly and missed dinner. I was starving and worried it would affect my performance, so I had to snack a bit to hold myself over."
Sea Cucumber on stage also noticed Lin Yu and said in surprise,
"Dude, that’s not just a little snack. You’re like a hungry ghost reborn."
Beside Lin Yu, the wrappers of snacks and instant foods were neatly stacked.
The base’s reserve food was almost half eaten by Lin Yu alone.
Lin Yu jumped off the chair and wiped his mouth with a tissue.
"I used to work construction sites, so I’ve always had a big appetite."
"No worries. You’ve eaten enough now. Just the right time to warm up!"
Lin Yu said as he walked onto the arena.
Two hammers slid from his hands.
Although Sea Cucumber hadn’t mocked Lin Yu much before, hearing the ridicule from the Jiangcheng crowd and knowing a bit about Heavenly Artisan, a faint expression of looseness and disdain appeared on his face.
Lin Yu stood opposite Sea Cucumber and bowed politely.
"You go first, Sea Cucumber."
"Me first? Fine!"
Sea Cucumber nodded casually, then suddenly stepped forward, lowered his shoulders and waist, and threw a surprise swinging punch.
"Uncle, eat so much and be careful not to puke it up!"
“One!”
His punch targeted Lin Yu’s face.
Though not especially forceful, Sea Cucumber intended to knock this so-called rubbish down with one punch!
However...
"Bang!"
Sea Cucumber’s pupils shrank in disbelief.
His right wrist, the hand throwing the punch, was firmly grabbed by Lin Yu.
Not blocked, not dodged... grabbed!
What’s more, before Sea Cucumber’s punch landed, Lin Yu had already switched his hammer to the other hand!
Lin Yu looked at Sea Cucumber and said in a low voice,
"Surprised?"
"Aren’t you a Craftsman?"
Sea Cucumber asked in astonishment.
"Yes, but it’s just some tools that enhance physical fitness."
Lin Yu released Sea Cucumber’s hand.
He had been eating voraciously earlier specifically to activate the Banquet Pendant’s buff!
Although the Banquet Pendant’s chance to trigger a buff from ordinary food isn’t very high, Lin Yu kept eating non-stop!
Even with his appetite greatly increased, he almost ate himself full but finally triggered enough buffs for use!
[Esports Expert: Dynamic vision and reaction speed increased by 150%, improving understanding of esports games;
duration 5 minutes], [Tenacity: Enhances damage resistance and willpower;
duration 30 minutes], [Strong Muscles: Improves muscle explosiveness and endurance;
duration 60 minutes]...
These three buffs, combined with Dance Mastery from the Immortal Brew, were enough for Lin Yu to challenge Sea Cucumber, who was not using any items!
"Come on."
Lin Yu beckoned Sea Cucumber over.
Sea Cucumber looked at Lin Yu suspiciously but ultimately chose a safer, more suitable way to counter a skilled opponent’s attacks.
He tested with a fast jab.
Lin Yu stood still, merely tilting his head to dodge.
He didn’t even bother to dodge below the neck.
"That was... Two just now."
Sea Cucumber said, clearly lacking confidence.
"Then hurry up and do Three!"
Lin Yu beckoned again and then pointed to his chest with his thumb.
The initiative on the arena had already shifted.
Sea Cucumber exhaled and said, "If you don’t mind, I’ll put in a bit more force from here on."
"This isn’t about the assessment, just a personal competitive spirit."
Then, this Enforcer took a pair of fingerless gloves from his pocket and put them on.
These were some kind of tools.
"No problem."
Lin Yu nodded.
The disdain in Sea Cucumber’s eyes was completely gone.
"The last punch, I’m going for your lower abdomen."
Dropping the previous flippant English count, Sea Cucumber said seriously.
After that, he roared,
"Come!"
With the fingerless gloves on, Sea Cucumber’s punch speed more than doubled. His punch struck Lin Yu’s lower abdomen like a blur.
This time...
Lin Yu neither dodged nor blocked but took the hit directly.
"Bang!"
He stepped back two steps, expression unchanged, and gave Sea Cucumber a thumbs-up.
"Not bad."
If you didn’t know, you’d think Lin Yu was the examiner.
Sea Cucumber looked at Lin Yu’s calm demeanor and bowed respectfully.
"That punch just now was at least seventy percent power, almost my strongest normal punch."
"Although you haven’t reached Second Tier... you can be considered an expert on my level."
Sea Cucumber waved his hand and said, "At this point, you actually don’t need to attack anymore to pass— but we’ll still go through the motions. I’m quite curious..."
As he spoke, Sea Cucumber saw Lin Yu put away his hammers and pull out a black, dangerous-looking short firearm.
Sea Cucumber’s face changed drastically.
"No, I’m not curious anymore. No need for formalities!"
"You’re fully qualified... You can even command others in this operation."
Lin Yu cheerfully put away the counterfeit short firearm and said,
"Thanks for the compliment!"
Sea Cucumber looked at Lin Yu with a more complex gaze.
"Actually, I am a little curious... but I’m curious about who the hell in the organization spread the rumor that you’re trash? That you got beaten silly by a rookie called May, and when they sent people to Jiangcheng for revenge, they got wiped out instead!"
Lin Yu shook his head and said,
"Those rumors aren’t wrong, but... that May is actually very strong."
"Every one of those guys who ambushed us was strong!"
He walked to the edge of the arena and looked down at the now silent crowd, scanning those who had once looked down on him.
At this moment, after witnessing everything just now, no one dared to show such expressions anymore.
"Of course, even if I told them this, probably no one would believe me."

chapters.title: Chapter 199: A’Yu’s Kindness
chapters.content:
When Lin Yu stood proudly on the stage in his "Heavenly Artisan" persona and received recognition from 'Sea Cucumber' who had just fought over a dozen people without falling behind...
The way everyone in the audience looked at Lin Yu underwent a qualitative change.
Those Marauders members finally remembered...
Before "Heavenly Artisan" suddenly fell from grace some time ago, beaten senseless by some newcomer named 'May' who appeared out of nowhere, he had once been the most promising super rookie in the Henan Province branch.
Just as Lin Yu had said.
In this organization where strength was the only benchmark, when he previously claimed that 'May' was very strong, no one would have believed him.
But now, if Lin Yu were to say the same thing again...
These Marauders members couldn't help but wonder.
"That 'May May'... just what kind of monster is he?"
The level Heavenly Artisan had just displayed was already rare among First-Tiers.And yet he had been rendered completely helpless by a First-Tier 'Doctor'.
Even Fish became interested.
"Ha, if that's the case, if that guy joined Order, he might become someone who gives everyone headaches in the future!"
"Coincidentally, the Jiangcheng Chief position is still vacant. Maybe if we check back in half a year... he might have become Jiangcheng's Chief."
Fish jumped up from the sofa and took a step forward.
Though it was just one step, the next moment...
Fish had already appeared on the arena.
"Although you're indeed very strong too, uncle... but precisely because you're strong, that guy might be a troublesome genius."
"I quite admire you," Fish reached out and straightened Lin Yu's collar, "so... do you want me to help you out?"
Hearing Fish's words, Lin Yu thought to himself that this was bad.
Admittedly, he did intend to restore the Heavenly Artisan identity's reputation within the Marauders, and indeed planned to use demonstrating Heavenly Artisan's strength to further elevate his other identities that had "defeated" Heavenly Artisan.
But who could have expected the effect would be too good.
If Fish were to set her sights on him, at least on his current self... that wouldn't be good!
Fortunately, there was still room for maneuver.
Facing Fish's enthusiastic offer of assistance, Lin Yu shook his head.
"I appreciate your kindness, Deputy Chief... but this is my personal revenge."
"They destroyed my home, burned down my house, and killed the few friends I cherished in this world."
"I will always remember the frozen expressions of pain on their corpses," Lin Yu slightly closed his eyes, "Red Fuji, Little Ice, A-Kang, Ming-Zai... I admit we Players are a pitiful group living precariously from day to day. If they had died in the game or in a dungeon, I might only feel regret..."
"But they died outside, killed by those self-righteous bastards who came for profit and fame."
"I cannot tolerate this... I will absolutely have my revenge!"
Lin Yu opened his eyes, the anger burning like flames in Heavenly Artisan's pupils.
"I will kill them with my own hands. Even if they're geniuses, even if their future potential is limitless, I will definitely find opportunities to kill them—with this game here, it's not impossible for me to become stronger too!"
Fish had already appeared on the arena.
His highly infectious voice echoed through the somewhat spacious interior of the ship cabin, hitting the steel walls and reflecting back, making all those who had just mocked and ridiculed Lin Yu feel deeply shaken.
And greatly moved.
"Well said!"Google seaʀᴄh NoveI-Fire.ɴet
Sea Cucumber couldn't help but exclaim.
Yes, this was exactly what their Marauders were—a group of people with guts, who valued loyalty, and dared to fight!
This description fit them perfectly.
Fish was also quite touched.
She patted Lin Yu's shoulder.
"Good, I won't interfere with your revenge... however, I'll help you in a different way!"
As she spoke, Fish took out an ancient-looking iron token from her bosom.
It had the character "Fish" written on it.
"This is a set of tokens our boss brought out from a dungeon. He engraved characters and gave each of us three deputy chiefs nine tokens. With this token, you hold equal status to the local chief in any branch."
Fish said seriously, stuffing the token into Lin Yu's hand, then added: "For now I'm just lending it to you, but if you perform outstandingly during this operation... it's yours."
Lin Yu accepted the token—it felt heavy in his hand.
[Meteoric Iron Token · Fish: A token representing status. Hard texture. Can store specific forms of energy when injected, releasable when necessary. Release forms include "attack" and "defense".]
[Note: Currently fully charged.]
Lin Yu looked at Fish, who blinked and said with a smile: "You must keep its additional effects secret, okay."
"Understood."
Lin Yu showed a grateful expression and nodded, then asked.
"But... Boss Fish, what exactly is this operation about? I only heard that major organizations are participating, but I have no idea about the specifics!"
He couldn't help but ask.
This question was also on the minds of the other Marauders members present, so when Lin Yu brought it up, everyone looked at Fish.
Even those from the Yanjing branch seemed curious—Lin Yu noticed this and couldn't help but silently admire Fish's prestige again.
So these four guys came to Jiangcheng with Fish without knowing anything!
Hearing Lin Yu's question, Fish rubbed her chin.
"Well... initially it was just that Fluoxetine from the Psychological Society and I happened to meet in the last dungeon. There were seven people in that dungeon, all coincidentally core members of major organizations... so she invited us to meet in Jiangcheng."
"Besides me, the invited members included people from Order, Free Alliance, Night Watchmen..."
"Some of you might not know Fluoxetine, so simply put, although that guy isn't well-known, her position in the Psychological Society is probably similar to mine in the Marauders."
Lin Yu showed a surprised expression: "Such an important figure?! What's her purpose?"
Fish shook her head: "Don't know, but since Fluoxetine invited us and she genuinely helped all of us in the last dungeon, I came to the meeting."
"So, your primary task is to ensure I can reach that overpass tomorrow night on time, and prepare to provide backup from the periphery as much as possible, don't let those killjoys from Order and Night Watchmen ruin my mood... they will definitely try their best to stop us."
"Many hunters from the Hunters' Association will probably also receive the news and wait for opportunities to get a piece of the action."
"Besides, since we're already here, and the Psychological Society has invited so many forces and attracted so many experts, so—"
His highly infectious voice echoed through the somewhat empty space of the ship cabin, hitting the steel ship walls and reflecting back, making all those who had just mocked and ridiculed Lin Yu feel deeply shaken.
"If my meeting goes smoothly, feel free to do as you please and take advantage of this rare opportunity to cause some chaos!"
"Whether it's Order or Night Watchmen or other organizations affiliated with them, or even Psychological Society and Free Alliance members, and those hyenas and vultures attracted by the scent of blood..."
"If you have the opportunity, you can kill whoever you're willing to kill, and anything you plunder belongs entirely to you!"
"I suspect the Psychological Society would also like to see such a chaotic situation."
"With 'Sea Cucumber', 'Glazed', and this 'Heavenly Artisan' as commanders!"
As she spoke, Lin Yu was taken aback.
He showed a surprised expression and spoke somewhat gratefully.
"Thank you for your kindness, but..."
"Allow me to refuse!"

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Going Home
chapters.content:
Lin Yu certainly didn't have the time to lead the Marauders team, as his positioning for "Heavenly Artisan" was never meant to be someone skilled in leadership or ambitious.
"Heavenly Artisan" was a vengeful Lone Wolf. Perhaps in the future, as Lin Yu's strength grew and Heavenly Artisan's power rose accordingly, he would still maintain high status and influence within the Marauders...
But Lin Yu would absolutely never actively seek "power" within the Marauders.
The role of "Heavenly Artisan" was far from Lin Yu's main focus.
Moreover, just for this operation alone, Lin Yu had many other things to handle.
Fortunately, having strength made negotiations easier.
"I'm not really good at cooperating with others... previous events have already proven that."
"Plus, everyone here isn't familiar with me anyway, so I think it's better if I operate alone!"
After these words were spoken, Fish naturally agreed.
Even among the other Marauders members present, Lin Yu's statement actually increased their favorable impression of this "Heavenly Artisan."No one wanted to be "led" by some random unfamiliar player, especially since many of them had openly mocked him before!
So when Lin Yu proposed operating alone...
