These Marauders members all breathed sighs of relief.
Simultaneously, they developed further goodwill toward Lin Yu.
"This guy knows his place!"
And Fish also developed additional favorable feelings toward Lin Yu.
Combined with Lin Yu's previous performance of "feigned grief" and "filled with hatred," Fish seemed to develop some strange assumptions and resonance with the past of the "Heavenly Artisan" that Lin Yu was portraying.
She sighed.
"I completely understand you. Having just experienced something like your trusted companions being completely wiped out... it's natural to feel some resistance toward cooperation."
"But you're lucky—at least you have a clear target for revenge. So go ahead and do it!"
"My promise still stands. Even though you're operating alone this time, as long as you produce results, I'll still preserve your rewards."
Fish spoke seriously, appearing quite confident in Lin Yu.
"Go ahead, I believe in you!"
With Fish's permission and blessings...
In the heavy night darkness, Lin Yu left the cargo ship.
He strolled slowly, transforming back into his original appearance amid the desolate night.
That is, the appearance belonging to Lin Yu.
Then...
He took out May May's phone, edited a brief message, and sent it to "High Mountain."
"Mar base."
Lin Yu intentionally kept the text extremely concise, creating the impression that he had edited the message under extremely inconvenient circumstances.
After this message, Lin Yu sent a location pin.
Then, humming a cheerful little tune, Lin Yu left the abandoned port.
He had no intention of spending the night on the Marauders' ship, even if he hadn't sold these people's coordinates.
Although "Heavenly Artisan" was from Zheng City...
Lin Yu was actually local to Jiangcheng—he had a home in Jiangcheng.
Soon, Lin Yu found a shared bicycle by the roadside, rode it to the main road, hailed a taxi, and returned home.
It was already early morning now.
Looking up at the lit window of his home from downstairs, Lin Yu's expression turned somewhat serious. He immediately took out twenty thousand yuan in cash from his backpack, holding it in his hand for courage before daring to go upstairs.
Standing at the doorway, Lin Yu took a deep breath, shielded himself with the cash, and slowly opened the door.
Sure enough, as soon as the door opened, he heard his sister's angry, dissatisfied voice.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ novel※fire.net
"So you do remember to come home!"
"These past few days have been really too much. Even if you're out making money..."
The voice abruptly stopped.
Lin Zhao behind the door had obviously spotted the twenty thousand yuan in cash and swallowed hard.
"...Even if you're out making money, you still need to take care of your health. What's with working so late?"
Lin Zhao's voice had softened considerably, though it still carried some complaint.
Lin Yu breathed a sigh of relief, entered, shoved the money into her arms, and said cheerfully, "Sis, this was a rare opportunity! This time it wasn't just shooting a commercial—I legitimately guest-starred in a role!"
"Got to seize these good opportunities, right?"
As he spoke, Lin Zhao behind the door put her hands on her hips and pursed her lips.
"Alright, alright—the child has grown up, full of reasoning now!"
"Let's eat!"
As she said this, Lin Zhao pointed to the steaming hot food on the table, all of Lin Yu's favorites.
Lin Yu looked somewhat surprised. "Sis, I don't think I told you in advance I was coming back..."
Lin Zhao snorted lightly. "Just had a feeling you'd be back, that's all."
The two sat at the dining table. Lin Zhao put away the twenty thousand yuan and sat opposite Lin Yu.
Having waited so long, Lin Zhao seemed somewhat hungry too and served herself a bowl of porridge.
The siblings sat facing each other.
Looking at his sister, who clearly looked much better than before, Lin Yu's eyes grew increasingly soft.
Even though "acting" was the strongest obsession that kept him alive and made him join the Death Game, Lin Zhao's existence...
Was also the reason that made Lin Yu sigh, "It's good to be alive."
So, while eating, Lin Yu spoke somewhat vaguely.
"Sis, actually, this twenty thousand is just an advance payment. There should be another seventy or eighty thousand coming later... With this money, you should be able to renovate the shop and hire a couple of people to help."
"Or wait for me to earn a bit more. I've been learning about stock trading and investments recently—might be able to get you a bigger, newer shop."
As Lin Yu spoke, Lin Zhao's first reaction was refusal.
"The shop is doing just fine. Why change it?"
"Renovation... there's no hurry. Anyway, I clean every day. The shop might be small, but it's very clean!"
Lin Yu pressed his lips together. "It's not about cleanliness. Your shop is too old—the wiring and pipes have aged, posing serious safety risks."
"Bah, bah, bah! Who are you cursing, you brat!"
Lin Zhao laughed and scolded while hitting Lin Yu.
"Better save this money. You might need it later yourself."
Seeing Lin Zhao so determined, Lin Yu just shrugged.
"Alright."
But in his heart, he had made up his mind. After all, he now had plenty of money on hand.
Maybe he should keep it from Lin Zhao and secretly arrange for a new shop for her!
As for the source... there would always be a way to explain it.
He absolutely couldn't let Lin Zhao keep squeezing into that dilapidated little street shop in the old district!
Thinking of this, Lin Yu couldn't help but ponder.
"Making money from the Death Game through killing and plundering is easy, but currently none of my identities are really suitable for that kind of work anymore."
"Maybe I should consider creating a new identity specifically for being a 'bounty hunter'..."
"Or maybe use my original 'Lin Yu' identity? After all, this identity's publicly known profession is Soldier, with a relatively decisive personality, and... if I really remain completely inactive and achieve nothing, it might actually make those organizations that have been monitoring this identity suspicious!"
"After all, my potential rating is very high—I should at least show some signs of being extraordinary!"

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Rescue Operation, The Tycoon Makes a Move
chapters.content:
In the middle of the night, as Lin Yu lay on the narrow single bed in his room conceptualizing new "characters" and "scripts," the gloomy clouds that had hung over the city for most of the day finally released a drizzling rain in the deep night.
Raindrops shattered against the window panes, pushed by the night wind, reflecting the dim glow of street lights outside.
On the other end of Jiangcheng, shrouded by this night rain, in a budget hotel located in the southern part of the city, High Mountain of Order stood before a window facing similarly rain-streaked glass, pressing the answer button on his buzzing phone with a heavy heart.
Li Hua's voice came through.
On the other end of Jiangcheng, shrouded by this night rain, in a budget hotel located in the southern part of the city, High Mountain of Order stood before a window facing similarly rain-streaked glass, pressing the answer button on his buzzing phone with a heavy heart.
"I've confirmed it... this is indeed the Marauders' stronghold."
"Knowing this gives us significant strategic advantage."
Hearing this, High Mountain let out a breath but found no joy in it.
"This isn't my accomplishment, it has nothing to do with me..."
"It was the Doctor from my squad, May, who sent back this information."As he spoke, he unconsciously clenched his fist.
On the phone, Li Hua immediately detected something amiss.
"May sent the information... what's going on?"
"As May's squad captain, why do you seem unaware of his whereabouts?"
Li Hua's voice turned serious.
High Mountain's voice carried shame as he hesitated: "I..."
Just that single word's tone was enough for Li Hua to make his judgment.
"High Mountain, don't speak. Let me guess."
"Has May encountered some danger? And this danger prevents you from reporting it to us?"
Li Hua asked calmly. High Mountain gripped the phone tightly, offering no response.
But silence was answer enough for Li Hua.
Li Hua exhaled over the phone.
"I understand..."
"Now, I order you in my capacity as Hai City Game Master of Order and East China Regional Director to report your squad's situation and May's circumstances to me!"
"I will coordinate with Jiangcheng Game Master and Order Honorary Member Tycoon to provide your squad with the highest level of support and assistance—regardless of what consequences your report may bring, I will bear all responsibility!"
"You only need to execute my orders and answer my questions!"
Li Hua spoke with determined tone. High Mountain paused for a moment before immediately responding.
"Understood!"
Li Hua's words acted like a calming pill, instantly reassuring High Mountain.
Although the situation hadn't changed, High Mountain suddenly realized...
They were Order!
The Free Alliance might be terrifying, but...
This was still Order's territory, and they were the strongest organization.
High Mountain quickly composed himself and calmly reported the afternoon's events in detail.
His own mistakes, Lin Yu's decisiveness...
High Mountain held nothing back in his report.
Soon, after listening to High Mountain's report, Li Hua pondered for a few seconds before responding.
"You're saying he was taken by Free Alliance members they encountered by chance?"
"But for some reason... he's now revealed the Marauders' stronghold?"
High Mountain nodded.
"Correct. I suspect Free Alliance and Marauders might have secretly allied, but if that's true, then May could be in real danger!"
"Maybe Free Alliance won't kill him for some strange reason, but if he reaches Marauders' territory or gets handed over to Marauders by Free Alliance... then his chances are slim."
High Mountain couldn't help expressing his concerns.
"I understand," Li Hua said quickly, "Tycoon and I are currently near the Marauders' stronghold—we'll infiltrate to investigate."
"The Soul Gold Brooch isn't sensing anything, but its last appearance seems to have been in this area."
"Notify the other squad captains to be ready for reinforcement at any time."
Li Hua spoke before ending the call.
High Mountain clutched his phone, the self-blame and worry in his heart somewhat alleviated but not completely gone.
Soon, after listening to High Mountain's report, Li Hua pondered for a few seconds before responding.
He looked at that three-word text message, unable to suppress his anxiety.
A young man brave and righteous enough to send intelligence under dangerous circumstances, however hastily...
Even though he wasn't officially an Order member yet, in High Mountain's heart, he already considered him a comrade and colleague.
High Mountain absolutely didn't want anything bad to happen to him!
He looked out the window where continuous fine rain and dark, low clouds enveloped all of Jiangcheng in damp darkness.
The wide river flowing through the city seemed to connect with the sky through this rain, filled with a sense of ominous foreboding.
Though without evidence...
This rainy night seemed intimately connected with bloodshed and death.
Meanwhile, standing before the aged cargo ship, Li Hua held a large transparent umbrella and quietly put away his phone.
Tycoon, standing beside him in a plastic raincoat, grinned.
"Inflitration, Brother Li Hua, that's not really my specialty."
He had been standing next to Li Hua and heard the entire conversation with High Mountain.
Li Hua smiled.
"Just comforting that squad captain from Henan Province," he sighed. "The person is still alive anyway. Hesitant, overly cautious infiltration might actually create danger."
"Gambling with someone else's life doesn't seem like your style," Tycoon stretched lazily. "Though I plan to follow your lead, you'll need to convince me."
Li Hua adjusted his glasses and spoke calmly.
"You know me, Brother He. I never gamble blindly."
"I just calculated the probabilities. The chance that storming this place right now would get May May killed is infinitely close to 0%."
Tycoon laughed.
"So that's how it is! Now I'm reassured!"
Li Hua nodded: "Yes, so next I plan to go all out—please lend me your assistance, Brother He. I know your interventions come at great cost, but... consider me in your debt."This text is hosted at Nov3lFɪre.ɴet
Hearing this, Tycoon smiled: "Is it Gambler Li Hua who owes me, or Order Regional Director Li Hua? Or perhaps Hai City Li Family's Third Young Master Li Hua who owes me?"
Li Hua responded seriously: "All of them."
Tycoon raised his eyebrows in surprise: "Oh? You think that highly of that kid!"
Then he waved his hand.
"I'm joking. Let's not calculate debts between us too carefully, since you called me 'Brother He' after all."
"Besides, Free Alliance and Marauders dare to openly ally in my territory and kidnap Order members..."
Tycoon raised his hand, and the air filled with clinking metallic sounds.
Like coins pouring down, a glint of golden light sparked at his fingertips.
Simultaneously, a hint of ferocity emerged in Tycoon's tone.
"I never planned to let them off anyway!"

chapters.title: Chapter 202: All Sides Take the Stage, the Set Is Built, and the Director’s Confession
chapters.content:
"Boom—"
A tremendous sound rolled and reverberated, like muffled thunder echoing through this rainy night!
Countless sleeping citizens of Jiangcheng were startled awake, looking out their windows but seeing no flashing lightning.
Only a golden light seemed to descend from the sky in the southern area.
Some people grabbed their phones to capture this scene and posted about it.
"Holy crap, is someone undergoing a tribulation crossing in southern Jiangcheng?"
Although many witnessed this strange scene, some mysterious force seemed to prompt people to quickly ignore and forget about it, returning to their dreams.
But the players in Jiangcheng couldn't ignore this.
In a southern city hotel, High Mountain instantly understood why Li Hua hadn't told him what the "need support" signal would be.
Because this was just too obvious!High Mountain quickly stood up, simultaneously grabbing the [Soul Spirit Golden Brooch].
"All squads attention! Comrade 'Gambler' is engaged in combat at 235 Anlin Road, Southern District, former Nangang Pier area! Requires reinforcements!"
"All squads leave only two personnel to guard each station, everyone else mobilize for reinforcement!"
High Mountain calmly made the judgment.
Then...Thɪs updatᴇd by novel[f]ire.net
The [Soul Spirit Golden Brooch] transmitted several brief "received" responses.
Several squads of 『Order』 immediately began advancing toward the direction of the abandoned ships!
And those who moved first weren't just 『Order』!
...
Within the 『Jiang'an Hall』 APP, messages began flooding in.
"Brothers, is that golden light the boss's signature move?"
"It really is—and 『Order』 people took the boss away!"
"Holy shit, the BOSS is fighting someone?!"
"Let's go! Everyone in the organization who's awake, hurry to support!"
"Location should be southern city."
"Those who haven't advanced tiers shouldn't come to die, preferably Second Tier and above!"
One by one, awake 『Jiang'an Hall』 members in Jiangcheng quietly emerged from their homes, rushing toward the southern district.
...
In a barbecue restaurant, Robin sipped Coke in small gulps while wearing a wrinkled mouse-gray crewneck and athletic shorts.
"Thank you for being willing to come to Jiangcheng with me, Snowy Owl."
Sitting across from her named "Snowy Owl" was a girl with white-tipped bangs and a round face.
The other ate crayfish and lamb skewers while scrolling through her phone, waving dismissively.
"Hey, you said you'd cover food and lodging—I should be thanking... Wait? Holy shit, something's happened!"
Snowy Owl put down her chopsticks, showing the 『Night Watchmen』 internal group chat on her phone.
Someone named 『Carrier Pigeon』 had sent a message to the group, specifically tagging Snowy Owl and Robin.
"You two are in Jiangcheng, right? @SnowyOwl@Robin"
"『Order』 and 『Marauders』 have started full-scale warfare in Jiangcheng! At some pier in the southern city, hurry over to check it out and help!"
Robin also looked surprised.
"How did they start fighting tonight? Wasn't the time tomorrow night?"
"Who knows," Snowy Owl stood up, grabbing two napkins to wipe her mouth, "Do 『Order』 and 『Marauders』 need reasons to fight?"
Robin also nodded.
"True enough... Let's go help!"
She hurried toward the front counter, scanned the code to settle the bill, then walked into the rain curtain with Snowy Owl.
...
Under a southern city bridge arch, inside an old-fashioned military tent.
The four members of 『Free Alliance』 crowded in the tent playing cards, 『Magician』 Phantom couldn't help but complain.
"Even though we lost the star-rated hotel, directly downgrading to bridge arch camping is too much!"
"A Nian, isn't the gap between your Plan A and B a bit too large?"
『Master Thief』 Li Nian held her playing cards while looking up at the swaying camping light, appearing quite excited.
"Eh? I think it's quite fun!"
『Prisoner』 Old Zhou also nodded in agreement: "Indeed, compared to staying in a hotel, this has a different charm that reminds me of my past years..."
Sitting at the tent entrance, 『Undertaker』 Xiaoyun calmly watched the slowly rising water level outside, saying lightly: "If the rain maintains current intensity, in about six hours, we'll be soaked in water."
"But fortunately..."
Old Zhou looked at Xiaoyun and said: "Fortunately the rain might stop?"
"No, the rain will intensify," a rare smile appeared on Xiaoyun's face, "In about three hours, you'll be washed away by rapid currents in your sleep, at that time... in the best scenario, I'll get three waterlogged swollen corpses—this is excellent practice opportunity, your abilities are all quite useful too."
As Xiaoyun spoke, brief silence fell in the tent, but everyone seemed somewhat accustomed to it.
Phantom stroked his chin: "Then why did you suddenly change your mind and warn us about this?"
Xiaoyun looked outside the tent again.
"Because we have new excitement to join."
"I smell the scent of blood and fire."
She murmured, and as her light words faded.
Golden light exploded across the sky, followed by rolling thunder-like rumbles.
Old Zhou instantly stood up excitedly: "Damn, whose ability is this? Looks awesome!"
Phantom and Xiaoyun looked at Li Nian.
Li Nian grinned: "Oh, I actually know this one."
"This commotion is probably from our Jiangcheng local powerhouse 『Tycoon』..."
"Should be his 『Capitalist』 professional ability!"
Hearing Li Nian's explanation, the other three were somewhat shocked.
"Truly a veteran 『Fourth Tier』 expert," Old Zhou said eagerly, "We definitely need to check this out!"
"Just wonder who he's fighting..."
Phantom said while stroking his chin.
Xiaoyun said softly: "Whoever he's fighting, we should go see... Nobody doesn't want to go, right?"
"Of course!"
...
And as personnel from all sides converged toward the southern district like rushing rivers.
At home, Lin Yu yawned, looking at his phone where the 『Marauders』 APP was flooded with "FUCKING ENEMY ATTACK" and "PEOPLE EVERYWHERE" messages;
the 『Jiang'an Hall』 APP with "LET'S GO QUICK SUPPORT" and "ORDER BROTHERS ALREADY IN POSITION" messages;
and the 『Hunters' Association』 and 『forum』 with numerous "WHAT'S HAPPENING IN JIANGCHENG" discussion threads, nodding with some satisfaction.
"The effect is even better than imagined."
Just a three-character text message had lightly flapped like a butterfly's wings, stirring the entire Jiangcheng's "players" into motion, gradually turning this city into a chaotic vortex.
And this was exactly what Lin Yu hoped to see.
Before the appointed time arrived, Jiangcheng's waters needed to grow increasingly murky.
He clearly knew he was only 『First-Tier』, just an ordinary player without background or formidable strength.
The situation cleverly created in the last dungeon was far beyond what he could control.
So...
Since he couldn't control it, he might as well make sure nobody could control it!
Only this way could he achieve maximum "benefit."
The more chaotic the situation, the more information these organizations and experts would expose...
This information was exactly what Lin Yu needed most right now.
And what Lin Yu sought by creating chaos wasn't just this...
"Anyway, I'll take a nap first to rest... Wait until big sister is sound asleep too, then I'll sneak over to check the situation."
He turned off his phone screen on the bed, through the faint light coming through the window, pieces of dark phone screens reflected Lin Yu's face from different angles.
From every angle, Lin Yu appeared cold and imposing at this moment, just like the rainy night outside.
"The stage has been set..."
"I hope tomorrow's actors won't disappoint me too much."

chapters.title: Chapter 203: Dock Brawl!
chapters.content:
On the abandoned dock, the originally rust-stained cargo ship was now engulfed in raging flames, mostly submerged in the river water.
Continuous rain fell on the dock's shore, where standing tall was...
A pink pig nearly the size of two buses.
Upon closer inspection, one would realize this chubby little pig wasn't a living creature, but an enormous piggy bank.
Fish and over ten Marauders members climbed ashore dripping wet from the seawater, all somewhat astonished at the sight of this little pig.
"What the hell is this thing?!" Fish couldn't help but curse.
Answering her was a Marauders member from Jiangcheng.
"Big Sis Fish, this is Tycoon's [Matthew Piggy Bank]... The boss of Jiang'an Hall has made his move!"
Fish spat in disgust. "Tycoon? Not surprising - that guy's nothing but Order's loyal dog!"
"Everyone scatter and take cover! I'll handle this!"The members from Jiangcheng and other city branches silently complied, but those from Yanjing grew anxious.
"Sis Fish, you're going to face Tycoon alone?"
"That old bastard is Fourth Tier, right? How can you take such a risk?!"
As they chattered noisily, Fish clapped her hands sharply. "Shut your damn mouths! You know he's Fourth Tier and still want to interfere? Someone ranked in the top thirty nationally is way out of your league!"
"Get the hell back and don't cause trouble! If you really want to help, then hide properly so I don't have to waste energy saving your asses!"
Fish spoke fiercely, and the four from Yanjing immediately fell in line.
"Scatter! Scatter!"
They called out to other Marauders members, and soon these guys dispersed into the darkness like rats, hiding among the various debris piles scattered around the old dock.
Instantly, only Fish remained alone on the dock's shore.
She looked up at the distant pink piggy bank, focusing on the two figures standing on its back.
Two flintlocks appeared in her hands as Fish shouted clearly:
"Hey—Pretty Boy Hua, what's the meaning of ambushing me in the middle of the night?"
"And that nouveau riche uncle over there, what brings you to this party?!"
Fish's voice echoed across the dock.
They called out to other Marauders members, and soon these guys dispersed into the darkness like rats, hiding among the various piles of debris scattered around the old dock.
"Yanjing's Fish, right? First time meeting you, though I've long heard of your reputation," Tycoon's hearty, enthusiastic voice rang out. "How could I not personally welcome someone of your stature coming to Jiangcheng!"
Li Hua also spoke coldly: "Enough nonsense. You planned to ally with Free Alliance ahead of schedule and kidnapped one of Order's external members—you declared war on us first."
While listening to Tycoon, Fish's expression remained relatively calm.
But when she heard Li Hua's words, Fish nearly lost her composure.Official source is n͟o͟v͟e͟l͟f͟i͟r͟e͟.net
"Bull-fucking-shit! Damn you, Li Hua! When did I ever ally with Free Alliance? When did I kidnap your external member?!"
She said furiously.
Li Hua adjusted his glasses. "Heh, denying it doesn't matter... How do you think we found this place? Every participant in this operation has a tracker on them!"
"His last known location was right here—hand him over, and maybe we can still resolve this peacefully."
Fish's frown deepened upon hearing this.
Although she was carefree and didn't pay much attention to details, and as a high-ranking Marauder had done plenty of burning, killing, and looting...
Being falsely accused of something she hadn't done still made Fish feel both irritated and uneasy.
"What kind of nonsense is this? Never heard of it!"
Thoughts raced through her mind as her straightforward thought process considered several possibilities.
Were Li Hua and Tycoon framing her?
That didn't make sense—those Order bastards never needed excuses to attack! Marauders and Order were completely hostile anyway!
Could it be that some Marauders members kidnapped an Order member before coming here? But what about Free Alliance's involvement?
Fish's mind felt completely tangled.
Just as she decided to stop overthinking and fight first...
A heavy "thump" sounded from the container area on the opposite side of the dock.
Four figures appeared atop the containers.
Fish, Tycoon, and Li Hua all looked toward these four uninvited guests, recognizing their identities.
"Free Alliance members—I see Magician," Li Hua said, pushing up his glasses.
Tycoon also narrowed his eyes: "And Jiangcheng's Master Thief, that headache-inducing girl is here too."
The other two were obviously also Free Alliance members.
Li Hua looked back at Fish. "Still claiming you're not working with them?"
Facing Li Hua's accusation while looking at the timely arrival of the four Free Alliance members...
Fish's less-educated mind suddenly had a moment of clarity.
She felt she had figured it out!
"Fuck! Free Alliance set me up! This is what they call forcing someone to join the rebels, right?!"
These four must have kidnapped the Order member to frame her!
Thinking this, Fish glared at the Free Alliance group with intense hatred.
"Go to hell! Trying to force me to ally with you?! Despicable! Shameless!"
Fish turned one of her guns, aiming at the four Free Alliance members.
The four had just arrived and barely found their footing when Fish started cursing at them and pointing guns their way, leaving them completely confused.
Phantom spoke in bewilderment: "What's all this nonsense? Shouldn't we team up against those two Order guys?"
"You're talking like we're the ones who brought Order here!"
Fish gritted her teeth: "Aren't you?"
As she spoke, she fired a shot.
"BANG!"
The shot struck the container at the Free Alliance members' feet, sending bright sparks flying.
"Whoa! Fish, you're playing for real!"
Li Nian jumped in place, startled, quickly hiding behind Old Zhou.
The brawny Old Zhou's thought process actually connected with Fish's.
"I think our timing was just unfortunate, leading to some misunderstanding..."
"How do we clear up this misunderstanding then?" Xiaoyun asked softly, tilting her head at Old Zhou.
The other two were obviously also Free Alliance members, as expected.
As he spoke...
He crouched slightly, then leaped like a cannonball!
"BOOM!"
A tremendous sound echoed like a high-powered internal combustion engine starting, the metal container beneath his feet denting from the force!
With this immense momentum, Old Zhou's figure traced a perfect parabola through the air above the dock, heading straight for Tycoon and Li Hua.
Seeing Old Zhou suddenly attack, Tycoon's expression changed slightly.
He discarded his transparent umbrella and raised both hands, and Old Zhou seemed to crash into some invisible barrier.
"Interesting!"
Old Zhou adjusted his posture, then two tonfa appeared in his hands!
The dual tonfa descended with crackling electric arcs, exploding with blue-white lightning through the rain curtain, outlining the silhouette of what blocked his path!
It was a transparent giant hand!
"That's [Hayek's Invisible Hand]!" Li Nian shouted a warning. "Be careful, Old Zhou! That thing's incredibly tough!"
On the piggy bank, Li Hua also sprang into action, pulling out a deck of playing cards. Just as he prepared to provide support...
"BANG!"
A gunshot rang out, the playing cards in Li Hua's hands scattering as the tremendous impact forced him back three steps, nearly making him fall off the piggy bank.
Just as Old Zhou had predicted—Fish had ultimately chosen to help after all.
She lowered her flintlock with an displeased expression.
"I'll settle accounts with you later, Free Alliance!"
Between the two sides...
Fish indeed still hated Order more!

chapters.title: Chapter 204: A Way to Break Up the Fight, and an Unexpected Arrival
chapters.content:
The moment Fish fired her shot, Xiaoyun and Phantom also dove into the fray!
Aside from Li Nian, who was completely content to watch the spectacle, every “expert” on the field had been pulled into the battle.
The Assistant rabbit slipped into view. Phantom’s magic staff whipped through the air, spawning veils of smoke to block sight, exploding balloons, and razor-sharp throwing knives in quick succession.
Though these distractions didn’t put as much pressure on Li Hua and the Tycoon as Fish’s gunfire and Old Zhou’s close combat did, Phantom’s relentless harassment still drained a great deal of their attention.
As for the ability Xiaoyun displayed, it made both the Tycoon and Li Hua’s skin crawl.
The woman held a huge black umbrella, hummed a melody that was gentle yet tinged with chill, and danced lightly on the rain threads suspended in the air.
From beneath her skirt and her umbrella, there came a steady drip—various severed limbs and organs falling out with a patter.
Stitched hands and feet, writhing entrails, rolling eyeballs, and desiccated skulls...
A physiologically disturbing number of corpse fragments finally stitched together into a monstrous humanoid form as tall as three stories.
The stitched-together abomination casually bashed a nearby shipping container, leaving a huge dent.“Come on, Frankenstein... devour them. Make them part of you!”
Under Xiaoyun’s soft song, the creature joined the battle and launched a fierce assault on the Tycoon and Li Hua.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Li Hua immediately rotated his dice to bias the monster’s hammer strikes, while the piggy bank under the Tycoon’s feet erupted in waves of golden light.
Together, the two of them perfectly blocked the creature’s attacks.
But every time that golden light flickered, the sharp clinking of coins could be heard.
Pain repeatedly contorted the Tycoon’s face—clearly this defensive mode came at a steep cost.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the novel⚑fire.net
More importantly...
Sustaining this depletion like this was unfavorable for him and Li Hua.
Even though the Tycoon was already a Fourth Tier expert, stronger than the others present and with Li Hua—the Hai City Game Master—assisting...
They were, in truth, being besieged.
“I could finish these brats off in one go if I wanted, but doing that in reality would make way too much noise,” the Tycoon said, manipulating Hayek’s Invisible Hand with one hand while wielding the Unicorn’s Broken Horn in the other, trading ranged attacks with Fish and Phantom. “Brother Li, can we expect reinforcements?”
Li Hua observed constantly, twisting dice and spinning disks to alter probabilities as both defense and support for the Tycoon, his expression grave.
“We’ll get backup, but the fastest Order can send will probably be Second-Tier or First-Tier... What about your Jiang’an Hall?”
“What are you talking about, Brother Li? If Jiang’an Hall had anyone at Third Tier, do you think I’d be doing all this myself?” the Tycoon replied with a helpless laugh.
Li Hua exhaled. “Then it looks like we can only count on friends from other groups?”
“Oh? You mean—”
Li Hua didn’t answer the Tycoon directly. Instead he raised his voice.
“Friends from the Night Watchmen, if you’re here, please help!”
“If this keeps going, we won’t be able to contain it!”
When Li Hua finished, both the Tycoon and Fish and the Free Alliance members showed surprised expressions.
Answering Li Hua’s call...
Was a cluster of geometric cubes falling from the rain and a round-faced girl with streaked white hair wielding a long blade.
Bang!
Old Zhou used his crutches to brace against the incoming cubes, then narrowly blocked a blade aimed at his face.
But the stitched monster near him wasn’t so lucky;
it was buried and suppressed under a mound of cubes.
“More experts?” Old Zhou said, surprised, then he forcefully tossed the newcomer away.
The person who had slashed at Old Zhou landed on top of another container. Behind her, Robin—clumsily carrying a drawing board—clambered up.
“Night Watchmen’s Snowy Owl and Robin. Gambler, sir, we weren’t planning to intervene, we literally just arrived!” Snowy Owl shook rain from their blade and said with a smile.
“No matter. We’re grateful for the help!” Li Hua and the Tycoon both nodded in acknowledgment.
The Night Watchmen and Order did not share the same principles. While the Night Watchmen were also relatively righteous and possessed considerable strength, they did not enforce strict rules or try to establish rigid regulations among players the way Order did.
This organization focused on minimizing players’ impact on the real world—erasing traces of player activity, monitoring major organizations and powerful players to ensure none suddenly went berserk, massacred civilians, or caused large-scale real-world destruction. Thus, compared with the Marauders who liked killing players, the Night Watchmen were far more opposed to the Psychological Society, who hunted ordinary people and tried to shove them into the game.
Of course, the Night Watchmen didn’t entirely ignore disputes among players. While it wasn’t strictly their duty, nothing forbade them from stepping in.
Their members generally followed simple chivalrous principles when handling internal conflicts among players—“draw the sword to help when seeing injustice” and “protect the weak and innocent.”
So...
Although Li Hua and the Tycoon couldn’t exactly be called the weak party, when Order was clashing with the Marauders and the Free Alliance, choosing a side wasn’t a hard decision for many Night Watchmen members.
But once these two newcomers appeared, everyone tacitly halted their attacks.
Both sides had reached a delicate balance, facing off on edge.
None of the experts present were confident of a decisive victory.
Or rather, even if one side believed they could win, they couldn’t count on a clean, complete triumph!
Besides, such a chaotic fight could easily drag on...
Members of the Marauders and Free Alliance feared Order reinforcements from other cities arriving!
When it came to foundation and backup, nobody wanted to provoke Order—the massive colossus.
Order’s and the Night Watchmen’s members also didn’t want to see a hasty large-scale battle erupt in the Jiangcheng city area.
Especially since Jiang’an Hall and Order’s ordinary members were arriving on the outskirts as reinforcements—they could easily become pawns in a fatal, all-or-nothing struggle.
At this moment, both sides were developing second thoughts—after all, there was still the elevated road clash in South City tomorrow, and the Psychological Society’s madmen hadn’t shown their faces yet.
But...
Things had already reached this point. Everyone wasn’t so much waiting for the other to strike as they were waiting for a way out.
And at that moment, a clear, cold voice rang out from the direction of the river.
“Oh my, I already arranged a time and place with everyone. Are we really going to decide life and death right here?”
Sitting on the bow of a half-sunken, blazing cargo ship.
Through the curtains of rain, a girl crossed her legs and perched on the upturned prow, her smile mocking and disdainful.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: May You Be Seen by the World
chapters.content:
The rain gradually intensified.
The sudden appearance of 'Fluoxetine' on the pier interrupted this chaotic battle.
As a member of the 'Psychological Society', her initiative to stop the chaos at this moment was somewhat puzzling, even making the two from 'Night Watchmen' and Li Hua from 'Order' secretly wonder.
"Is this person planning something bigger for tomorrow?"
But currently, Fluoxetine's actions aligned with everyone's intentions, so no one raised objections.
In unspoken agreement, even though someone universally disliked stood there making an appearance, everyone seemed to tacitly give her face and actually withdrew.
Sitting on the bow of the boat, 'Fluoxetine' watched the considerably eased atmosphere and smiled faintly.
"Good, everyone knows how to correct mistakes when they're wrong..."
"Anyway—others are fine, but Fish, Li Hua, Phantom, Robin... I spared your lives in the dungeon and invited you here, not for you to recklessly waste your lives here."
"Of course, if you die here, it's only your loss."Before anyone could react, she had already stood up.
"Alright everyone, that's all I have to say... We'll meet tomorrow!"
The figure of the young girl leaped downward, falling toward the river water.
But...
Everyone present could see clearly by the firelight.
That figure completely disappeared before even hitting the water!
Li Hua on the shore pupils constricted.
"She's been hiding this move all along?"
......
Li Hua on the shore had his pupils contract sharply.
Lin Yu picked up the small octopus that had quickly climbed ashore from the water and placed it on his shoulder.
"Well done, Hannah."
"Didn't expect your line delivery to be so excellent."
"Your performance successfully fooled everyone!"
The small pink octopus scratched its head, showing an embarrassed smile.
"That's all thanks to Director's great teaching... The cards were written very detailed!"
As she spoke, Hannah waved the cue cards Lin Yu had written for her.
They contained not only lines and basic emotions but even detailed annotations in brackets like "pause half second here," "light laugh here," "slow speaking speed to half normal pace here"—truly meticulous.
The disappearing "Fluoxetine" figure on the boat earlier was naturally impersonated by Hannah's [Illusory Ink].
After all, it was almost impossible for Lin Yu himself to climb to such a high place without attracting attention midway.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ novel[f]ire.net
But Hannah, who was only palm-sized and excellent at swimming, could easily accomplish it.
After praising Hannah, Lin Yu raised his binoculars and turned his gaze back to the opposite shore.
After the 'Free Alliance' arrived, Lin Yu had also come here.
He had indeed collected considerable information about several experts.
The caliber of players who took action this time was even higher than what he witnessed previously in Zheng City.
With this information, Lin Yu could make better estimates about high-level players' strength.
Meanwhile, among those who took action in this battle...
Fish, Tycoon, Li Hua, Old Zhou, Xiaoyun, Phantom, Robin, and even Snowy Owl who only made one move later...
When necessary, Lin Yu felt he could potentially impersonate them too.
Especially the four he had contact with during the last dungeon—after further grasping their personalities and combat styles, Lin Yu felt even more confident about fooling even those familiar with them!
Of course, Lin Yu also knew this move should be used cautiously.
But regardless, the information gained from this "chaos" was already more than enough for Lin Yu.
Lin Yu was someone who knew how to be content with what he had.
He also didn't want these four forces to reveal all their cards here tonight and fight to the death.
What if the 'Psychological Society' really ended up reaping the benefits tomorrow?
So Lin Yu immediately decided to have Hannah go up and deliver a few lines to dissuade them.
Then report safety to Captain High Mountain using his phone...
"I'm temporarily safe."
Although the situation had developed to this point, the weight of "May" as an external member seemed less significant now.
But this was still enough to become the final straw.
Across the riverbank, Lin Yu watched the scene on the opposite shore.
Everything unfolded exactly as his script had written—High Mountain approached and said something to Li Hua and Tycoon.
Then both sides exchanged a few tough words before withdrawing in different directions.
"Indeed, even when major organizations have extremely opposing stances, they're actually unwilling to start a war so hastily..."
Lin Yu silently noted this point too before leaving the riverbank.
So Lin Yu immediately decided to have Hannah go up and deliver a few lines to persuade them.
Lying in bed, as expected...
Various apps including the forum were exploding.
Tonight's pier chaotic battle, which he started and propelled, was indeed enough to be called an earthquake in the "player community."
There were enough famous experts present.
The originally present 'Marauders' members, plus the arriving 'Order' and 'Jiang'an Hall' reinforcements, were enough to instantly spread these news through various circles.
"Friends, Tycoon and Li Hua did something big in Jiangcheng tonight!"
"Marauders' Fish plus Free Alliance's four against Night Watchmen's two plus Gambler and Tycoon—so intense!"
"More than that, Jiangcheng almost triggered a full-scale war tonight!"
"Compared to that time in Zheng City?"
"That Zheng City incident was far less! I know our Hecheng Game Master—he almost went to reinforce immediately! Fortunately, it didn't actually break out!"
"I heard the trigger was the same person—this time it's still 'May May'!"
"That 'Doctor' again?! Really?!"
"Rumor, but supposedly reliable!"
Message after message scrolled by—exactly the level of discussion Lin Yu wanted to see.
"Tonight's impromptu additional performance had really good effects... This level of heat should make tomorrow even more eye-catching!"
Lin Yu said with satisfaction.
The fame of 'May May' had indirectly increased significantly too.
Of course, this wasn't Lin Yu's main objective.
Beyond "information," what satisfied Lin Yu most about tonight's additional performance was...
"Some woman suddenly appeared at the scene at the end, and then everyone seemed to stop fighting!"
"And apparently she invited all those people, meaning she created that puzzle?"
"Who is that character! I was on site—both 'Snowy Owl' and 'Gambler' looked serious, even 'Fish' seemed very wary of that person!"
This was what Lin Yu most wanted to see.
The usually mysterious "Fluoxetine," who only had reputation in high-level player circles...
Had finally stepped into the view of the general players.
"May you be seen by the world, dear Miss Fluoxetine."
Lin Yu said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Big Shot
chapters.content:
Against the backdrop of increasingly heated discussions on forums and various apps, what formed a stark contrast was...
the eerily silent atmosphere within Jiangcheng's entire "player community."
After accepting "Fluoxetine's" mediation, neither 『Order』 nor 『Marauders』 had taken any further action.
Of course, perhaps there was another important reason...
The certain "mastermind" who had been stirring up trouble behind the scenes had quieted down.
In the Western Theater History classroom, Lin Yu sat in the last row, yawning repeatedly.
He had taken two days off and really needed to show his face at school.
Besides, today was the day for highlighting key points in Theater History—the teacher for this course seemed like a kindly old man, but he showed no mercy when failing students.
The Death Game was certainly important, but Lin Yu didn't want to fail and retake the course either.
So he had Hannah lie on the textbook to help note down the key points the old professor mentioned, while he listened to the casual chatter from the front row and dozed off."This rain just won't stop, could a typhoon have made landfall?"
"Don't be ridiculous, since when does Jiangcheng get typhoons?!"
"Well, actually, there was one ten years ago..."
"That was once in a decade, plus the weather forecast didn't mention anything."
Last night's rain in Jiangcheng had continued until dawn, briefly stopping in the morning before starting again around noon.
Currently, the rain outside was quite heavy, and the sky remained overcast.
Soon, the class bell rang.
Lin Yu packed his notes, preparing to leave the classroom to get some good food and buffs, when he noticed a petite girl peeking through the classroom door.
"Hey, ace!"
Shen Bingmiao waved boldly, moving against the flow of students leaving class toward Lin Yu.
Watching Shen Bingmiao approach, Lin Yu discreetly packed his backpack, stuffing Hannah inside before speaking: "Senior, what's up?"
"Is this about the club or..."
He asked tentatively, Shen Bingmiao pouted: "What could possibly be going on with the club? Finals week is next week."
Lin Yu instantly understood Shen Bingmiao's meaning.
"Urgent? It's meal time now..."
Shen Bingmiao placed two steamed buns on the desk.
"Kinda urgent, but I won't let you go hungry."
She said with a laugh. Lin Yu helplessly grabbed the buns and followed behind Shen Bingmiao.
The two arrived at the club activity building, with Lin Yu holding an umbrella along the way while finishing the buns.
He tentatively asked, Shen Bingmiao pouted: "What could possibly be going on with the club? Finals week is next week."
With his "Lin Yu" identity as the most basic player persona, he was the newest of newbies—a complete rookie.
No promotion, no background, and his only interactions with players were making a splash at the trading meet and briefly contacting Tycoon.
Although marked by the 『Psychological Society』 people, which attracted attention from many organizations, Lin Yu's subsequent "silence" and "low profile," combined with several other highly prominent players recently emerging in Jiangcheng...
Meant that "Lin Yu" himself had actually faded from everyone's sight.
As it should be—no matter how talented, he was ultimately just an uncut jade.
In normal player understanding, Lin Yu should need six or seven dungeons of experience, going through promotion and item accumulation, before gradually growing after joining some organization.
And "contact" works both ways.
Although last night's events in Jiangcheng were significant enough, given "Lin Yu's" identity and awareness as a player, he absolutely shouldn't know anything about the situation.
Moreover, although knowing Shen Bingmiao was a "player" meant Lin Yu could no longer consider her a completely trustworthy contact...
Lin Yu didn't think Shen Bingmiao would suddenly try to harm him either.
Maintaining caution toward others didn't mean being paranoid like someone with persecution complex, seeing danger everywhere.
Shen Bingmiao brought Lin Yu to the drama club activity room, suddenly showing a mysterious expression.
"Hey, A-Yu, my dear junior... next I'm going to introduce you to a VIP!"
"Since you've been on the forum, you must have seen the rankings, right?"
"The person you're about to meet... is actually on the list!"
Hearing Shen Bingmiao's words, Lin Yu felt somewhat surprised.
A ranked VIP?
Lin Yu immediately thought of 『Tycoon』.
That guy was openly ranked 27th nationally, plus he was a local power in Jiangcheng with close ties to 『Order』.
Combined with Shen Bingmiao previously claiming to be 『Order's』 external personnel, being able to invite "Tycoon" made sense.
Of course... Li Hua was also possible.
Although 『Gambler』 Li Hua's name wasn't on the list, Lin Yu was quite sure he had just anonymized himself.
After returning from the last dungeon, Lin Yu had browsed many forum posts, with many generally guessing Li Hua's position should be around rank seventy.
However, whichever of these two it might be, if Shen Bingmiao could invite them...
It would sufficiently prove that his club president was indeed, as he suspected, a highly positioned VIP.
Lin Yu's thoughts raced, but his expression remained unchanged, only showing surprise.
"A ranked VIP? Senior, you're amazing!"
"Of course—anyway, that person is here representing the players' number one organization 『Order』 to ask you some questions!"
Shen Bingmiao stood at the door, explaining to Lin Yu.
"Representing 『Order』 to ask me questions? About what?"
Lin Yu showed appropriate nervousness and curiosity as he asked.
Shen Bingmiao waved her hand: "Relax, relax... if I'm not mistaken, you didn't die naturally, right ace?"
Lin Yu felt briefly surprised by Shen Bingmiao's question method.
But he wasn't shocked, since according to investigations, the 『Psychological Society』 generally didn't hide things—they might even actively tell 『Order』 and other organizations.
So Lin Yu just sighed.
"Yes, senior... honestly, I was killed."
He touched his chest with lingering fear.
"According to investigations, it seems to have been done by an organization called 『Psychological Society』... the one who actually did it was actually at the drama club that day."
Hearing Lin Yu's words, Shen Bingmiao became uncharacteristically serious.
She pressed her lips together and sighed: "Although I already roughly knew, hearing you say it yourself... I'm really sorry, A-Yu."
"That night I was actually on campus too, if only I had noticed..."
Lin Yu interrupted her: "It's not your fault, senior—ultimately, everything should be blamed on the person who killed me."
His voice turned slightly cold, then returned to calm: "So, what does 『Order』 want to ask me about?"
"Probably related to the person who killed you, well, should just be routine questioning."
"『Order』 has been having some troubles recently, they're just desperately trying anything now."
Shen Bingmiao said, opening the activity room door.
Then, Lin Yu saw that sitting inside wasn't the expected 『Tycoon』 or 『Gambler』.
But a young woman with handsome features, short hair, wearing white Tai Chi clothing.
She sat in the club room, slowly drinking tea.
Lin Yu showed perfectly measured nervousness and curiosity as he asked.
The young woman put down her tea cup and stood up, looking at Shen Bingmiao with a slight nod.
"Thank you for bringing him over, A-Miao."
Shen Bingmiao waved her hand: "No problem, with our relationship."
Then, she looked toward Lin Yu.
Their eyes met, and Lin Yu saw her gaze was clear and bright—staring longer felt like looking at the midday sun.
Just standing there, Lin Yu could feel the dampness from the continuous rain in the room fading significantly.
She smiled and nodded toward Lin Yu in greeting.
"How should I address you?"
"Just call me Xiao Lin."
Lin Yu replied, then instinctively asked in return:
"May I ask how to address you?"
And the other's response was completely unexpected for Lin Yu.
"You can call me 'A-Mo,' or use my forum ID..."
"『Grandmaster』."

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Rejection
chapters.content:
In Lin Yu's relatively short life, like many ordinary people, he had encountered many "unexpected" situations.
But because Lin Yu's mental fortitude was quite good, he rarely experienced brain overload due to surprises.
However, the two words spoken by the young woman before him made Lin Yu briefly freeze for one second.
What the hell...
'Grandmaster'?
The third-ranked expert on the leaderboard, the second-in-command of 'Order'?
What was she doing in Jiangcheng?
And...
Why did this person know Senior Shen Bingmiao?
Lin Yu realized he had somewhat underestimated Shen Bingmiao's strength and connections.He had tried to guess as high as possible—wondering if the senior could call in experts like Li Hua or Tycoon.
But he never expected it to be the 'Grandmaster'.
This was like a younger brother getting beaten at school, crying as he went home to ask his professional fighter cousin for help, and the cousin saying "wait here, I'll find someone who can fight."
You thought the cousin might at most bring some professional combat athletes.
Then when you arrived at the fight location, you discovered it was Tyson.
This was truly quite the surprise.
Putting aside everything else...
If this person came for 'Fluoxetine', that woman seemed absolutely doomed.
"Grandmaster, it's truly an honor to meet you."
After greeting her, Lin Yu turned to look at Shen Bingmiao, using his eyes to express his question—"Senior, just who are you and how do you know such an important figure?"
Shen Bingmiao looked quite pleased with herself.
"How about that, am I impressive?"
She said with a cheerful laugh.
"Are you really Third Tier?"
Lin Yu asked suspiciously.
He now suspected Shen Bingmiao had underreported her rank.
Shen Bingmiao chuckled in amusement: "Look how scared you are... I think you've got the cause and effect reversed, my dear junior."
"I didn't get to know this 'Grandmaster' because I'm strong or have high status in 'Order'."
"On the contrary, it's because I know the 'Grandmaster' that I have exceptional status in 'Order'."
Shen Bingmiao cheerfully walked over to the Grandmaster's side and nudged her with an elbow.
"Right, A-Mo?"
The other party nodded with a smile: "That's pretty much how it is. I've known A-Miao since she was little."
Hearing them say this, Lin Yu suddenly understood.
"So that's how it is."
"Alright, let's get to business. Anyway, whatever grievances or injustices you have, speak them all out! This honorable judge will see justice done for you!"
Shen Bingmiao laughed and patted the Grandmaster "A-Mo".
The Grandmaster no longer hesitated and looked at Lin Yu.
"Well, time is precious so I'll ask directly... were you killed by this woman?"
The Grandmaster took out a photo from her pocket and showed it to Lin Yu.
The figure in the photo was a girl wearing loose blue-and-white striped patient clothes standing in a corridor, making a funny face at a camera positioned high above.
Even with disheveled hair, even looking somewhat young...
Lin Yu could instantly confirm this was the person he thought about day and night, who occupied his dreams and thoughts.
"Ah, it's her."
Lin Yu said calmly, his fists unconsciously clenching.
"Could you describe the situation in detail?"
A-Mo asked, and Lin Yu nodded, carefully describing what had happened.
The confession, the gun, the crazy talk, the business card after waking up when the game ended...
Lin Yu laid everything out truthfully and completely.
"So it's indeed 'Fluoxetine'," Grandmaster A-Mo put away the photo and took out her phone as if to record something, "You're the fifth confirmed player who entered the 'Death Game' after being killed by her."
Hearing this number, Lin Yu was somewhat surprised.
"So her name is Fluoxetine."
"And... only five?"
Grandmaster A-Mo nodded: "Yes, only five confirmed so far... She rarely attacks non-players. Sending people into the Death Game isn't usually her job."
Shen Bingmiao added: "Yes, she only goes after very, very important targets with very, very high potential—my dear 'ace', this means the 'Psychological Society' organization actually thinks quite highly of you."
"Why do they value me so much?"
Even though he already knew, Lin Yu still pretended to be puzzled.
"Because of 'potential'. The 'Psychological Society' has been using some kind of mass-producible [item] to evaluate ordinary people's potential," the Grandmaster explained to Lin Yu again, "So based on our intelligence and this, we can infer... if you don't die in dungeons in the 'Death Game', you'll likely grow to extremely great heights in the future."
Lin Yu smiled bitterly: "Really? I don't feel that way... Every dungeon feels extremely dangerous, requiring me to rack my brains just to get through."
This was his genuine, heartfelt words.
Then, as if realizing something, Lin Yu spoke with hope.
"Wait, Grandmaster... you asking me these questions means you're here for that person who killed me, right?"
Lin Yu said excitedly, as if suddenly understanding.
"I checked the forum today—seems like something big is happening in Jiangcheng too. Is it also related to that crazy woman?"
"Can you kill her?"
He spoke excitedly, and the Grandmaster pursed her lips.
"I also hope to catch her, but... I can't easily take action."Chapters first released on noveⅼfire.net
"At my level, there are too many restrictions on taking action in reality."
"But I will still do my best."
The Grandmaster spoke seriously, and seeing Lin Yu appear somewhat disappointed, she slightly lowered her gaze, her eyelashes trembling gently.
"Sorry."
Lin Yu waved his hand and smiled again: "It's fine... I'm already happy that someone is willing to seek justice for me."
"I also hope I can help you. Is there anything else you want to ask?"
The Grandmaster thought for a moment, then spoke.
"If possible, I'd like to invite you to join 'Order'."
Shen Bingmiao also spoke in surprise.
"Huh? Breaking the rules like this, A-Mo? Doesn't he need an assessment?"
"I trust your judgment in friends and the 'Psychological Society's potential assessment," the Grandmaster said calmly, "This way, both his character and strength are guaranteed, aren't they?"
"Moreover, according to Tycoon's report, he awakened as a 'Soldier'!"
The Grandmaster spoke, her gaze burning as she looked at Lin Yu.
"Although you might not understand 'Order' very well yet, I can assure you it's absolutely the best organization."
"We will fully support your revenge against 'Fluoxetine'—as long as you're willing to join, I will give you all the information 'Order' currently has about her."
"So, what's your answer?"
Facing a personal invitation from the nation's third-ranked expert to join the most powerful organization, with words that seemed to suggest giving him "special treatment."
But Lin Yu refused without any hesitation.
"No, I don't want to join any organization."
"I don't like feeling constrained."
Even though the conditions were excellent, Lin Yu remained completely unwavering.
Although he loved improv performances...
He would absolutely never change already established character backgrounds and scripts.
The identity destined to join the 'Order' organization must be the one named 'May May'!

chapters.title: Chapter 208: The Time of the Agreement, On the Overpass
chapters.content:
"Old man, you're pretty good at doing the math."
"You just saved a few thousand on this trip's fare alone."
Mosin-Nagant sat in the driver's seat of a Nissan SUV, watching Radish Grandpa happily fiddling with his tablet in the passenger seat and couldn't help but remark.
Radish Grandpa looked up and smiled.
"Oh, youngster… Aren't you coming too? Consider this a free ride!"
"Besides, I didn't exactly not pay you."
The little old man said cheerfully. Mosin-Nagant sighed.
"Honestly, thirty thousand yuan really is a bargain for me…"
"The jobs are different, comrade Mo," Radish Grandpa said kindly, "I didn't hire you to go kill someone, just to protect me a bit."
"Fair point. Although the more I think about it, this task doesn't seem that much easier than killing someone."Mosin-Nagant smiled wryly, helpless.
He drove slowly along the road in the southern suburbs of Jiangcheng through the curtain of rain. The windshield wipers thrashed wildly, sweeping away the rain that seemed to have been splashed across the windshield.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on novel✶fire.net
The heavy downpour and the dusk-darkening sky made visibility poor. This stretch of road was an abandoned, unfinished overpass, so Mosin-Nagant naturally dared not speed.
Radish had contacted him that morning — after an hour and a half of bargaining, paying thirty thousand yuan, Mosin-Nagant agreed to give the old man a lift and take responsibility for his safety.
"Come to think of it, we're facing Fluoxetine, Fish, and those others… and they might each have brought people," Mosin-Nagant sighed. "This isn't exactly low difficulty. Can I get more pay?"
"Comrade Mo, business needs to be based on integrity. We agreed on thirty thousand as a flat rate," Radish Grandpa leaned back and continued scrolling his tablet. "Of course, if the situation gets truly dangerous, extra pay afterward isn't impossible."
Mosin-Nagant kept driving slowly, a faint worry on his face.
He steered around several knocked-over barricades in the middle of the road and, hugging the edge, drove up a short on-ramp.
"Money aside, I'm actually kind of curious—why did you pick me?"
"Just because I'm coming too? I'm no saint — I'm a bounty hunter with blood on my hands. Aren't you afraid I'll secretly kill you and cash in the bounty?"
"Unbelievable!"
The tablet in Radish Grandpa's hands emitted an English exclamation;
his casual mobile game had been cleared.
Radish set the tablet down and answered Mosin-Nagant's question.
"A lot of how people appear is decided by their environment. When granaries are full, people know etiquette… After joining the Death Game, it's normal to see people act more extremely."
"So even if you're a bounty hunter, I don't automatically deem you 'bad.' Once death has become normalized in this group… the moral consensus and standards among Death Game players is precisely something that requires discussion."
Mosin-Nagant glanced incredulously at the little old farmer. He hadn't expected such thought-provoking words to come from this rustic elderly man.
"Besides," Radish Grandpa noticed Mosin-Nagant's look and a sly smile crept onto his face, "it's precisely because you're a bounty hunter that I'm at ease… I checked the Hunters' Association bounty for me — it's only twelve thousand."
"The reward I'm giving you is thirty thousand."
"Even half of that final payment trumps my listed bounty."
Radish Grandpa said cheerily.
Mosin-Nagant tugged a corner of his mouth. "So that's where the pay comes from, huh?"
He slowly stopped the car at the roadside.
This southern segment of the overpass had barely been built before being abandoned;
after the ramp, the road surface ended abruptly in less than a kilometer.
The pavement showed clear signs of collapse.
"But why not call some members of the Player Mutual Aid Association?"
When the car stopped, Mosin-Nagant asked the last question.
Radish Grandpa didn't answer immediately;
after a long silence he sighed.
"To be honest, I'm not very fond of the Player Mutual Aid Association anymore…"
Hearing that there might be more to the story, Mosin-Nagant didn't press further.
"Alright, we're here anyway… Let's get out."
"Looks like we're the first group to arrive."
Mosin-Nagant opened the door, popped open a folding umbrella, and stepped out.
But the umbrella barely helped.
Swift gusts on the overpass turned the umbrella inside out, and rain whipped onto Mosin-Nagant directly.
The ground was dotted with puddle-filled hollows;
water pooled into them and streamed toward beneath the overpass, the flow soaking through Mosin-Nagant's sneakers like a mountain brook.
"Damn."
He spat in annoyance.
It hadn't been raining in the city he left from.
On the other hand, Radish Grandpa stepped out wearing an old-style bamboo hat and flip-flops.
Surprisingly, the hat acted like an invisible shield, keeping the rain off entirely.
Radish silently walked over to Mosin-Nagant and sheltered part of him from the rain.
Mosin-Nagant nodded in thanks.
"Thanks."
The two moved in tacit agreement, pacing around the overpass to survey the area.
They didn't know why Fluoxetine had called them here. Both of them had life-saving trump cards and escape tools.
But since they arrived early, scouting the terrain was necessary.
Mosin-Nagant even set up a few traps in the corners — several spring traps and trip lines.
Radish Grandpa scattered some mysterious seeds into various nooks.
While the two were busy…
Soon Phantom arrived.
A white dove flew up from the broken edge of the overpass, clutching a hat in its beak.
The pigeon disappeared and Phantom crawled out of the hat.
"Whew—made it."
Whether out of caution toward Fluoxetine or awareness that Order would have planted watchful eyes nearby, the rest of the Free Alliance did not appear.
Phantom adjusted his bowler hat and greeted the two on the overpass cheerfully.
"Good evening! Nice to see you again!"
Mosin-Nagant felt uneasy at Phantom's enthusiasm, but Radish Grandpa smiled and nodded.
"Good to see you too."
Following Phantom up the ramp walked Li Hua and Robin.
But they weren't alone.
Li Hua was with Tycoon, and Robin was with Snowy Owl.
The four's arrival made Mosin-Nagant even more uncomfortable.
"That's a lot of people. Those two shouldn't be on Fluoxetine's invitation list, right?"
Mosin-Nagant muttered.
Li Hua, wearing a transparent raincoat, shook his head. "As a member of Order, why should I care about the rules set by the Psychological Society's lunatic?"
Phantom laughed. "Makes sense."
He then stealthily moved to stand near a crack in the road.
No sooner had Phantom stepped there than there was a "bang" beneath his foot.
A metal grappling hook slammed into the exposed rebar on the broken pavement.
Then…
With the spool whirring and the line tightening with a "sssh" sound, Fish sprang up.
She landed, glared at Li Hua's group, and cursed before pulling a long spear from her embrace.
"Shit, you lot are clustering again?"
But seeing they didn't intend to fight her, Fish didn't take further action.
She looked around for a moment and asked, puzzled,
"Where's Fluoxetine?"

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Fluoxetine Appears
chapters.content:
In the increasingly heavy rain that could now be called a downpour, this elevated bridge that was already isolated from Jiangcheng became shrouded in a curtain of water, making it appear even more like a secluded island cut off from the world.
Six invited individuals and two uninvited guests stood on the shores of this isolated island, mutually suspicious and wary, yet all sharing the same question.
That was the question Fish had just asked...
"Where is Fluoxetine?"
As the inviter calling himself "Fluoxetine," why hadn't he appeared yet?
Tycoon was the first to lose patience.
"Damn it, Brother Li Hua, could that woman have been lying to us?"
"Although I don't know why you trusted that woman so much before... but she's a member of the 'Psychological Society.' Is it possible she's just playing with us?"
Tycoon raised his doubts.
Li Hua shook his head, indicating his disagreement."Members of the 'Psychological Society' might indeed deceive us, but she wouldn't go through all this trouble - sparing our lives in the dungeon, specially coming out to mediate yesterday - just to simply trick us."
"She must have her own purpose."
Snowy Owl nearby also expressed agreement.
"Indeed, after all, the 'Psychological Society' isn't like the 'Free Alliance.' They wouldn't do those thankless, purely mischievous stupid things."
Hearing Snowy Owl's words, Phantom spoke up somewhat displeased: "Hey hey hey—our 'Free Alliance' isn't all like that either! Only 'Master Thief' and that other guy with twisted tastes enjoy doing those kinds of things!"
However, no one paid any attention to Phantom's protest.
Instead, when Tycoon heard Phantom's words, he noticed the presence of this 'Free Alliance' member.
And the high-ranking 'Marauder' Fish beside him.
Tycoon's eyes lit up.
"Hey, but core members of both the 'Marauders' and 'Free Alliance' are here again today, so it's not exactly a 'wasted trip'..."
Upon hearing this, Fish showed a fierce smile.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the nοvelfire.net
"Damn, so you really want to fight to the death with us... but I've prepared myself anyway. You people would still come after me."
"If you want to try, then come on... I was pretty pissed about being interrupted yesterday too!"
She said coldly, raising her gun barrel a few more inches.
Mosin-Nagant immediately pulled out his crossbow and hid behind his car.
Radish Grandpa quickly waved his hands: "Oh dear, fighting is no good, everyone please calm down!"
"The main event hasn't even arrived yet!"
The atmosphere on the elevated bridge grew increasingly tense and heavy.
And just then...
Among the raindrops falling from midair, some flower petals suddenly mixed in.
Pink-white, bright red, cyan-blue...
Various colored petals of different shapes were soaked by the rain, swaying in the wind as they fell toward the ground.
Most of them landed on the ground, continuing to fall below the elevated bridge with the water flow.
A small portion stuck to everyone's bodies, emitting a faint delicate fragrance.
The petals grew increasingly numerous, eventually almost matching the rainfall, occupying half the sky.
This strange phenomenon made everyone look up, trying to find the source of the petals.
Li Hua looked toward Radish.
"Elder Radish, is this your doing?"
Radish was even more confused than Li Hua, shaking his head.
"I don't know... I don't have any flower seeds!"
Everyone was somewhat puzzled, while Phantom frowned as if guessing something.
"Could it be..."
Robin picked up a pure white petal that had landed on her, gently crushing it until the petal turned into points of light.
She froze for a moment, then said quietly: "She's here."
Though her voice wasn't loud, everyone heard it clearly.
And the "she" that Robin referred to...
In this context, naturally couldn't be anyone else.
More and more petals drifted down, slowly transforming into a sky full of floral rain.
And at the moment when this floral rain was at its most magnificent and beautiful...
"Boom—"
A sound resembling the majestic roar of a pipe organ echoed, surrounding the entire elevated bridge.
The moment everyone's attention was captured by this sound...
A figure descending from the sky appeared on the elevated bridge.
The girl wore a beautiful and extravagant brown tiered dress, her hair styled in two buns at the back. She sat on an inverted little parasol, as if riding a paper boat, swaying unsteadily as she landed in the middle of the group.
Then, she jumped off the little parasol, her shiny square-toed leather shoes stepping into the accumulated water, breaking the reflection of the colorful sky.
She raised her little parasol and looked around at the eight people surrounding her, a sweet smile spreading across her face.
When she smiled, the little star sequins pasted near the corners of her eyes shimmered brilliantly.
"My, my... There are more people than I imagined!"
The girl's voice was clear and sweet.
Everyone present could recognize the identity of the newcomer.
"Fluoxetine."
Snowy Owl called out the other's name, excitement in her tone.
Fluoxetine laughed heartily, revealing beautiful but pale white teeth.
"Ahahaha, that's right, that's right, it's me—the genuine Fluoxetine!"
"However, I guess... this 'Snowy Owl' lady probably wasn't invited, was she?"
Hearing this, Snowy Owl sneered: "You indeed didn't invite me, but... I came anyway. Is that not allowed?"
"Of course it's allowed, you can come if you want..."
As Fluoxetine spoke, she snapped her fingers.
A beautiful "bouquet" appeared in her hand, composed of daisies and sunflowers.
Robin's expression changed slightly.
"Hey, Fluoxetine..."
But before she could say anything, the bouquet "exploded and bloomed."
A cold steel object emerged from Fluoxetine's hand.
The Thompson Submachine Gun-M1921, known as the "Chicago Typewriter."
In Chinese, it's called the Thompson submachine gun.
Snowy Owl's expression changed as she prepared to draw her blade, but Fluoxetine's smile widened.
"Guns like this, sometimes they don't necessarily need to be fired!"
As she spoke, the fingers of her free left hand drew a circle in the air. The petals floating in the water on the ground suddenly came to life as if possessed, overwhelming the unprepared Snowy Owl and pushing her off the elevated bridge!
"Bastard!"
Snowy Owl's furious curses echoed through the air.
Fluoxetine turned the submachine gun barrel.
"That's much quieter now—as for the other uninvited uncle, you're a bit more difficult to deal with."
Fluoxetine spoke while pointing the gun barrel toward Tycoon.
"Will you leave on your own... or shall I call someone?"
Tycoon sneered: "Who would you call? If someone from your 'Psychological Society' who can definitely handle me comes here, aren't you afraid of attracting the very top members of 'Order'?"
Fluoxetine shook her head.
"You've misunderstood. When I say call someone, I don't mean calling them here..."
As she spoke, Fluoxetine pulled out her phone with a backhand motion and turned on the screen.
It showed a video call in progress—the content on the screen was the entrance of some "mansion."
"Everyone says you don't have a good relationship with your family, 'Tycoon'... or should I say, Mr. He."
"But—I don't believe it."
Fluoxetine said with a smile.
Tycoon's expression changed slightly as he looked toward Li Hua beside him.
"Brother Li..."
"Go ahead, Brother He."
Li Hua said quietly.
Tycoon nodded, shooting a hateful glance at Fluoxetine.
"'Psychological Society,' you're something else!"
Then, he turned and disappeared into the vast curtain of rain!
...
On the broken section of the elevated bridge on the other side, under the protective disguise of "Hannah," Lin Yu also put down his binoculars and sighed in admiration.
"Tsk, nothing beats the genuine article after all."
"No matter how realistic a counterfeit is, it truly can't compare to the real thing in the slightest."

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Tickets and Ambush
chapters.content:
Fluoxetine appeared on the elevated bridge as promised, exactly as Lin Yu's script had written.
From initially extending the invitation in the form of a "puzzle" within the dungeon, to later returning to reality and fueling the spread of this "puzzle" to reach wider audiences—Lin Yu's entire operation was for one purpose...
To ensure that "Fluoxetine" herself would definitely learn about this invitation.
From the very beginning, Lin Yu never intended to personally attend.
Admittedly, plunging Jiangcheng into chaos, forcing numerous experts to take action, making Fluoxetine's name appear in most players' field of vision...
Admittedly, plunging Jiangcheng into chaos, forcing numerous experts to take action, making Fluoxetine's name appear in most players' field of vision...
But the ultimate purpose behind issuing the invitation in the dungeon wasn't initially about these things.
What Lin Yu wanted was to make Fluoxetine appear again.
Regarding whether Fluoxetine would appear or not, Lin Yu admitted there was an element of gambling involved.
His intuition told him that if Fluoxetine heard this news and learned that "she had invited six experts from other organizations in the previous dungeon," she might choose to attend.Moreover, she would likely claim this invitation that "didn't belong" to her.
But this was ultimately just intuition, without any concrete basis.
Though being wrong wouldn't cause Lin Yu any real loss, having a plan fall through was always somewhat regrettable.
Fortunately...
"You didn't disappoint me, Fluoxetine."
"You're even more insane and interesting than I imagined."
"You're even more insane and interesting than I imagined."
Since Fluoxetine had come, it meant she had accepted the "challenge" Lin Yu presented.
After all, the current Fluoxetine needed to provide a "reason" that even Lin Yu himself hadn't thought of—one compelling enough to make these people come all this way.
Lin Yu really wanted to know...
What reason would Fluoxetine give that wouldn't raise suspicions among everyone present?
Lin Yu soon learned the answer.
After Tycoon and Snowy Owl were "escorted" off the elevated bridge.
Fluoxetine pulled out three golden copperplate papers that looked like tickets from her chest.
"You've all just met 'me' in some god-invited dungeon, right?"
"You all survived in the end, and I quite admire your performance... so then, so then..."
"I have invitation letters for another 'god invitation' here."
Fluoxetine's words caused the remaining six people on the elevated bridge to slightly change expressions.
"Why do you have multiple 'invitation letters' in your hands?"
Li Hua asked solemnly, his gaze sharp.
"Ahaha, probably because some god is paying special attention to me," Fluoxetine said with a blissful smile spreading across her face, "It's such a wonderful feeling! I hope you can all experience it too!"
Phantom also narrowed his eyes.
"Then congratulations, Miss Fluoxetine... but, may I ask, where exactly does this invitation lead to?"
Fluoxetine fanned out the tickets in her hand like a folding fan, revealing them.Latest content published on novel_fіre.net
The golden paper was engraved with images of an amusement park in intaglio.
"They're tickets to the 'Carnival,' leading to 【Heavenly Amusement Park】's carnival—the event time is to be determined, depending on how quickly the tickets get distributed."
"They're tickets to the 'Carnival,' leading to 【Heavenly Amusement Park】's carnival—the event time is to be determined, depending on how quickly the tickets get distributed."
As Fluoxetine spoke, she flicked her wrist, and two tickets dissolved into golden light particles that vanished.
"Although I'm not particularly fond of puzzles myself, since this gathering started with a puzzle, let's end it with a 'puzzle' too."
Fluoxetine said with a smile.
"I'm not very good at word puzzles, so—"
"One ticket will be hidden in the crevice between poetry and dynasty."
"The other ticket will be hidden beneath the iron law of equivalent exchange."
After Fluoxetine finished speaking, everyone slowly digested these words.
Only Fish scratched her hair in frustration.
"Another word puzzle? Are you kidding me!"
"And Sister Nail, what do you mean by showing three but only giving two? Did you keep one for yourself?"
Fluoxetine grinned widely, shaking the last ticket in her hand.
"No, my ticket isn't like this..."
"This last one isn't for any of you six—it's for the person who made this gathering possible!"
As she spoke, Fluoxetine closed her umbrella, letting the rain fall on her.
"Hey—"
Fluoxetine shouted through the rain, but didn't look at anyone present, instead raising her head to look at the sky.
"Whoever you are, however you managed it, I'm grateful you made this fateful meeting happen! These six people standing here... I'm quite satisfied with them too!"
"So, I want to give you a ticket in return—you must be watching, right?"
"Whenever you appear anywhere within my sight... I'll give this ticket to you, understood?"
Fluoxetine's sudden behavior of talking to someone unknown left the six present somewhat bewildered.
"The person who made this gathering possible? Could it be that her invitation received help from someone else?"
Radish murmured questioningly.
Mosin-Nagant stroked his chin and said, "Perhaps the invitation letter she used to enter the last dungeon was also given by someone?"
Robin also fell into thought: "'Appear anywhere within my sight'... what does that mean?"
Fish let out a deep sigh: "Sister Nail's having another episode, you can analyze it if you want... I need to go research where that poetry and dynasty, equivalent exchange stuff is."
"Anyway, Sister Nail and Phantom, let me give you both a piece of advice," Fish said, pulling out her phone to check, "Based on my understanding of 『Order』, if you don't leave soon... 『Order』 will send people to arrest us."
"After all, Sister Nail, since you showed yourself and actively drove away Tycoon and Snowy Owl, that Game Master over there should be able to confirm there's no 'ambush'..."
Phantom also stroked his chin: "Oy, don't say... that bastard would really do something like this!"
"I've got to run, Gambler—"
Hearing this, Li Hua adjusted his glasses.
"Ha, that's somewhat slanderous..."
He said calmly, as the sound of a twenty-sided die rolling echoed.
Above Li Hua's head, a shimmering image of a spinning die appeared.
"The moment she appeared alone, I already confirmed there was no 'ambush'."
"I'll trouble you all—although Tycoon isn't here, do your best to detain these three and the people they brought!"
Li Hua said, tapping on the 【Soul Gold Brooch】.
"Coming—"
