The curtain of rain in the sky seemed to tear open, and then a canvas appeared out of thin air.
From within the canvas, five figures emerged.
Phantom spat in disgust.
"Tch... five Game Masters, they're really going all out. Aren't they afraid of problems arising in their own jurisdictions?"
A look of annoyance mixed with excitement appeared on Fish's face.
"Tch—good thing I prepared an extra contingency."
"Brace yourselves, Phantom, Fluoxetine!"
After speaking, Fish clapped her hands together.
"Clap!"
After the crisp sound, a massive roar erupted.
"Boom!"
The elevated bridge shook violently, with successive explosive flashes lighting up below!

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Chaos on the Overpass! Lin Yu Severely Injured in the Fall
chapters.content:
Successive violent explosions erupted beneath the elevated highway, causing the entire structure to violently shake and tremble several times before beginning to collapse and crumble with a thunderous roar!
Everyone suddenly understood why Fish had arrived late and had climbed up from below earlier.
She hadn't actually been that late—she had just been busy planting explosives on the supporting structures beneath the elevated highway!
Everyone's footing became unsteady, with Radish Grandpa completely losing his balance and tumbling to the ground.
Mosin-Nagant helped him up, sounding the [whistle] to summon several animals that positioned themselves in front of the two. Hawks and hunting dogs used their bodies to block the flying debris.
Radish Grandpa then activated the previously planted "seeds," causing massive plant vines to suddenly emerge, their broad leaves shielding both of them within their protective embrace.
Taking advantage of the chaos created by the explosions, Fish didn't hesitate for even a moment—she leaped forward, firing two consecutive shots from her flintlock aimed directly at the group of Order Game Masters!
These two shots carried tremendous force. Though fired hastily and missing their targets, they struck the ground at the administrators' feet, cracking the road surface and sending rubble flying everywhere, making the already unsteady Game Masters even more precarious!
Of course, Fish's more important goal was...
Using the recoil to propel herself backward."Bet you didn't see this coming! This is my escape route, bitches!"
Fish cheered triumphantly in mid-air.
She truly hadn't planned to fight six Order Game Masters to the death!
But...
Neither Fish nor Phantom, who had quietly retreated into his hat and was being carried away by a pigeon, managed to escape!
They seemed to crash into some kind of invisible barrier, being violently thrown back.
"The match is in progress! Contestants may not cross boundaries!"
A solemn and dignified voice rang out as a bald man in a striped shirt raised a red flag in his hand.
Fluoxetine, who had remained standing steadily throughout the collapse, her hair and skirt billowing dramatically, burst into loud laughter.
"You two, the Tianjin Game Master across from us is quite a famous Referee. Thinking you could leave so easily is rather naive."
The next moment...
Fluoxetine stepped forward, her hands emanating a floral fragrance with petals dancing between her fingers.
A gleaming hand axe appeared in her left hand while an M1911 materialized in her right!
And she instantly teleported right among the five Order members—behind the flag-raising Referee uncle.
"Code name 'Tianjin Tiger,' profession 'Referee,' rank 'Third Tier'... potential B+. Not bad, you two."
"Though, it wouldn't be a pity to kill you either."
Fluoxetine's casual words hung in the air as bloodlust flashed in her eyes.
"Watch out!"
Li Hua roared as he threw two chips, the dice above his head spinning and landing on 11!
"Success!"
With a series of clicking sounds, a pair of brass knuckles appeared on his hands, and he instantly lunged at Fluoxetine.
However, Fluoxetine seemed prepared, the muzzle of her M1911 continuously spitting fire with deafening reports!
Only then did Li Hua realize that gun was meant for him!
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Three shots rang out in rapid succession. At the critical moment, the dice above Li Hua's head spun again, instantly showing numbers 6, 20, and 17!
"Failure!"
"Critical success!"
"Success!"ᴛhis ᴜpdated by Nov3lFɪre.ɴet
The first shot hit Li Hua's shoulder, blood blossoming from the wound as he grunted but stubbornly held his ground.
The second shot completely missed, even ricocheting off a metal guardrail nearby, the bullet strangely changing direction and striking Phantom in the calf.
The third shot barely grazed past Li Hua's ear.
"Li Hua, you bastard! Country bumpkin!"
Phantom's curses echoed through the chaos.
He had just emerged from his hat!
Though these three shots didn't eliminate Li Hua, they were enough to slow his movements.
And that brief moment was all that was needed.
The remaining four Game Masters, disoriented by the collapse, couldn't react as quickly as Li Hua!
Fluoxetine's axe was already swinging toward the back of the Referee who was trying to turn around!
"Thud!"
The hand axe bit into flesh, instantly opening a gruesome wound!
But before Fluoxetine could complete her swing, something resembling a bull from a Picasso painting—or rather, a strange creature composed entirely of lines that vaguely resembled a bull—charged over and sent Fluoxetine flying.
Fluoxetine tossed out two cotton candy-like white clouds mid-air to cushion her fall, finally landing steadily on the clouds before turning to look at the pale-faced Robin.
"Well now, little Robin, my dear treasure... I almost forgot about you!"
"But no matter, anyway the Referee is already... Hmm?"
During her backward movement, Fluoxetine again collided with the invisible barrier, being slightly rebounded.
She looked in surprise at the Referee named "Tianjin Tiger" lying on the ground.
The man was pale, his forehead beaded with sweat, his back drenched in blood.
But with one hand embedded in the concrete road surface to stabilize himself during the collapse, his other hand firmly grasped the small red triangular flag.
"The match isn't over yet."
The Referee spoke weakly but with unwavering determination.
"Quite impressive, Order! This is too interesting!"
Fluoxetine snapped her fingers.
"Though... while it still prevents me from leaving, it shouldn't be too difficult for people outside to come in now, right?"
As she spoke, she holstered her M1911 pistol and scattered a handful of petals from her bosom.
"Swish—"
The petals danced in the air before forming an archway.
On the other side of the archway, a frail-looking girl who appeared to have albinism—wearing bear-themed pajamas at home while holding a bowl of instant noodles and watching cartoons—suddenly turned her head, her gaze meeting Fluoxetine's and the astonished Order Game Masters.
"Fluoxetine, what the hell are you messing around with now?!"
A standard young girl's voice with a strong northeastern accent rang out in angry curses.
Fluoxetine put on a frightened and wronged expression: "Help me, Dolantine! I'm about to be killed! It's so scary!"
"Piss off! Don't disgust me, I'm telling you! Can't you just run away yourself?!"
"If you can't win, can't you at least run? What kind of idiot are you?! What—did Order secretly spit like two hundred sticky bubblegums on the ground to glue your shoes in place, or did you fall for some handsome guy scheme where ten hunks are doing exclusive pole dances that hooked your pure little soul, making you drool all over the place and your legs go weak so you can't move?"
Despite her verbal abuse, the little girl still put down her noodle bowl, paused the cartoon, and stepped through the archway.
Then, she saw the Referee on the ground, Phantom clutching his thigh and howling in pain, and Fish in mid-air with her hover boosters exchanging ranged attacks with two Order Game Masters.
Plus the leaves enveloping Mosin-Nagant and Radish Grandpa, and Robin drawing in the corner.
"Holy fucking hell, this is like a painting of hell! You really outdid yourself, Fluoxetine! There aren't many special specimens among Players, but today you've managed to gather them all! The last time I saw this much random crap was when I was six and my grandma took me to the reptile and insect houses at Fengcheng Zoo!"
As she spoke, she pulled out two futuristic-looking grenades, yanked the pins out with her teeth, and casually dropped them at her feet.
"Watch out for grenades!"
Li Hua shouted a warning, spinning his dice again.
But before the dice could show results, they were interrupted!
"Bzzz—!"
An intense blast of noise and blinding light erupted.
Everyone quickly realized.
"They're flashbangs!"
But soon, they noticed something wrong...
Because these flashbangs kept flashing without end!
The intense light and buzzing continued to envelop the elevated highway, depriving everyone of their vision and hearing!
Even Lin Yu, who had been secretly observing from another section of the abandoned highway that hadn't collapsed and had moved even further away to avoid being caught in the crossfire, suffered from the effects.
He dropped his binoculars, rubbing his right eye vigorously as tears streamed down like broken pearls.
Everything he looked at had afterimages!
"What kind of people are these Psychological Society members?"
"What kind of dirty tricks are these?"

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Concealment and Investigation
chapters.content:
"Whew—made it back alive, that was really not easy."
"Five 'Order' administrators, all from major cities—that was quite thrilling and dangerous."
In a clean, tidy clinic, Fluoxetine sat on the edge of the examination room bed.
Though she said "thrilling and dangerous," she showed no visible injuries anywhere on her body, with only a few mud stains on her leather shoes.
Nearby, Dolantine was having her head bandaged while her right arm was already in a cast, grimacing in pain.
"Fluoxetine, if there's a next time for something like this, I'll take your surname if I so much as glance at you!"
The young doctor in black intern clothing who was applying medicine to the back of Dolantine's head shook his head.
"Teacher Du, don't speak so absolutely just yet..."Newest update provided by novel⁂fire.net
Seeing Dolantine's gaze shift toward him and her mouth already slightly open, the young doctor quickly interrupted the casting.
"But this matter really isn't right of Teacher Fluoxetine," he commented while applying medicine. "She created such a huge mess without reporting to the organization, quietly pulling off such a big stunt in Jiangcheng...""Even making a word puzzle, and even giving away two tickets."
"Teacher Feng almost fainted from anger when he found out!"
Dolantine also turned her criticism toward Fluoxetine: "This bullshit thing you pulled is really somewhat human-like—it takes a mind that hasn't been run over by an eight-wheel, 25-ton semi-truck four times then watered by fifteen large fierce dogs taking turns pissing on it to come up with this B-level nonsense... And I heard on the forum you gave them the word puzzle in a dungeon—when did you participate in such an intense dungeon, may I ask?"
Fluoxetine, sitting on the bedside, stuck out her tongue: "Hehe, it was just a spur-of-the-moment thing... Telling you and those guys in the organization would have ruined the fun."
She said this with a giggle, showing no intention of defending or justifying herself.
"Even hiding it from your partner like me—isn't that going too far?"
The young doctor spoke up again in protest.
"Chlorpromazine, you should just drop it. Hiding things from others might not be good, but hiding from you is absolutely justified—it's been almost a year and you're still 'First-Tier.' I don't know how the hell you got rated A-grade back then. Putting on a 'Ninja' act is quite intimidating, but last time when Fluoxetine was busy and sent you to assess that... that 'Soldier,' you threw a smoke bomb and ran as soon as you heard he was a 'Soldier.' Do you even have any backbone?"
Dolantine spoke with the frustration of seeing someone waste their potential.
"That was only about fifty meters from Tycoon's hideout. Was I afraid of some rookie who just became a player? I was afraid that if we fought, it would attract Tycoon."
The doctor named "Chlorpromazine," or rather the 'Ninja,' protested.
After taking the opportunity to criticize her colleague, Dolantine turned back to Fluoxetine.
"Fluoxetine, what exactly are you planning?"
When asked this, Fluoxetine leaned back slightly on the bedside, looking up at the clinic's ceiling, her calves gently swinging.
"Honestly, I don't know what 'I' am doing either... But I just feel like I've discovered a very, very novel and interesting talent, someone who's absolutely capable of catching the gods' attention but whom no one else has noticed yet."
She smiled with pursed lips, the glitter at the corners of her eyes sparkling.
"What kind of person could it be, someone who dares to even use me? So bold, so clever, so mysterious..."
Fluoxetine extended her tongue to lick her moist lips.
"I really want to meet that person!"
She said cheerfully, while Dolantine and Chlorpromazine sighed in unison.
"It's already June and you're catching some damn spring fever here. I mean, your seasons are seriously mixed up..."
"Now the report will be hard to write!"
...
In Beiqiao District of Jiangcheng City, Lin Yu carried a hiking backpack, wore a windbreaker, and rode his bicycle to the pet hospital whose address he had seen yesterday.
After nearly two days of continuous heavy rain, Jiangcheng had finally welcomed clear weather.
Puddles still dotted the ground, a few clouds still drifted in the sky, and the air was filled with the clear, clean scent after rain.
After parking his bicycle, Lin Yu pushed open the door of Love Baby Pet Hospital.
Since it had just opened for the morning, only one young girl was cleaning at the entrance.
Many cats and dogs were lying in cages.
Hearing someone enter, the young girl looked up.
"Ah, welcome... Are you here to pick up your little treasure?"
Seeing Lin Yu empty-handed, she asked somewhat puzzled.
Lin Yu shook his head.
He glanced around the hospital and quickly spotted the "Employee of the Month" plaque on the wall.
Last month and the month before, the Employee of the Month had been Xia Yue both times.
Lin Yu spoke softly.
"I'm Xia Yue's friend... online friend, I suppose."
Hearing Lin Yu's words, the young girl looked shocked and put down the broom-like tool in her hand.
"You're... here to see Xia Yue?"
"She's already..."
Lin Yu interrupted her.
"I know."
The young girl looked at the somewhat melancholy, handsome youth before her, seemingly infected once again by the sorrow on Lin Yu's face.
"Then please accept my condolences..."
Lin Yu nodded silently and walked to Xia Yue's photo.
Sensing the girl silently watching him from behind, Lin Yu looked up at Xia Yue's photo and spoke.
"Would you mind telling me what kind of person she was?"
For some reason, the young girl found the youth before her particularly trustworthy. After hesitating for a moment, she slowly began to speak.
"Xiao Yue was a very good person—responsible and diligent in her work, very patient with the furry children. Although she only worked part-time on weekends, guests, the store manager, other colleagues, and the little furry children all liked her very much."
"Her family circumstances weren't very good—single parent, I think, with a younger sister too—so she worked really hard. I heard she often received scholarships at school too."
"But she didn't just treat this as a money-making side job. She really had compassion and loved this work... Once a guest brought in a puppy with a serious illness, and the owner said not to treat it... It was Xia Yue who secretly paid for its treatment, and it's still being kept in the shop now... Look, that one right there."
"Yuanbao!"
The girl called softly, and a waddling dachshund emerged from inside the shop, making panting sounds.
Seeing the dachshund, the girl seemed unable to hold back any longer, her eyes slightly reddening.
"I wasn't particularly close with her actually, but she really... no one could dislike her."
"I don't know why something like that had to happen to her. It's just too awful!"
Lin Yu crouched down and patted the dachshund's head.
"Um, about this next question—you don't have to answer if you don't want to. I won't force you to recall these things..."
"I want to know, what exactly happened to Xia Yue?"

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Home Visit
chapters.content:
Because Lin Yu's acting skills were excellent and his appearance was quite good.
So, even though it was her first time meeting Lin Yu, Xia Yue's colleague developed an inexplicable sense of trust in him and almost unconditionally believed everything he said.
She instinctively told Lin Yu everything she knew about the circumstances of Xia Yue's death in complete detail.
"Xia Yue... passed away due to an accident."
"That afternoon, she was alone in the clinic seeing patients when the store owner received a client's call and went out to pick up a pet."
"According to the store owner, when she returned, she found Xia Yue lying in a pool of blood with a terrible wound on her neck."
"She had lost too much blood and fell into a coma... The store owner immediately called for an ambulance and sent her to the hospital."
"The doctors performed emergency treatment for a while, but she never stabilized."
"Finally..."
"In the evening, the hospital declared her dead.""Later the store owner called the police, and many officers came to the clinic. For some reason, the surveillance footage from that afternoon showed as corrupted."
"After investigation, it was concluded that Xia Yue had likely fainted due to low blood sugar and accidentally cut her neck on the edge of an iron shelf."
As Xia Yue's colleague reached this point, her expression once again showed complex emotions of sorrow and fear.
"Sometimes I feel... human life is really fragile."
"She died for such an absurd reason, when she was such a good person with such bright prospects..."
As she spoke, Lin Yu also sighed.
"Yes... but what's gone is gone. Please accept my condolences and take care of yourself."
"Well, thank you for being willing to tell me all this."
Saying this, Lin Yu stood up and left the pet hospital.
His mood was indeed somewhat heavy, and not entirely because of his acting.
This was another instance where Lin Yu directly witnessed the influence of the 'Death Game' in reality.
Although Lin Yu had died around midnight and joined the game, not only those who die at midnight can become players.
Anyone who dies at any time will enter the game at midnight that day—and if they win the game, they will revive after "midnight."
Even if the body no longer exists, the game can reverse cause and effect, essentially rewriting reality to make that person alive again while making everyone around ignore the fact that the player had previously died.
Just like how Lin Yu had clearly jumped off the building but returned to the rooftop.
For someone like "Xia Yue" who only experienced one game, her "death" would still be overlooked by ordinary people who aren't 'players'.
Lin Yu clearly knew that Xia Yue had died at the hands of Fluoxetine.
But...
Xia Yue's colleague actually believed this reason that even she found somewhat "absurd"—that her neck happened to get cut when she fell.
Lin Yu had reason to suspect that if he really died by Fluoxetine's hand, when his body was discovered the next day, the police wouldn't suspect gunshot wounds but would attribute it to some other cause.
From the moment they become 'players', they truly become lingering remnants of life, souls that shouldn't exist in this world.
However, Lin Yu's investigation and digging into Xia Yue's circumstances was still not finished.
He rode his bicycle to a residential community.
Taking a bag of freshly bought fruit and a box of milk from the bicycle basket, Lin Yu smiled and greeted the security guard, entering the not-too-strictly controlled community with the excuse of "visiting relatives."
This was a community with tall buildings and narrow spacing between them. In this era where "skyscrapers" no longer necessarily signify luxury and prosperity, this sufficiently indicated that this community wasn't the high-end expensive type.
In fact, this was indeed an area of "resettlement housing."
Lin Yu arrived in front of one of the buildings, opened the unit door, took the elevator, and went up to the fifth floor.
The layout of six households per floor made the elevator area quite cramped. Lin Yu carried the fruit and milk to the end unit 506 and gently knocked on the door.
"Knock knock!"
"Who is it? Coming!"
A clear response came from inside, then the door of the resettlement housing opened.
A somewhat haggard middle-aged woman wearing a blue floral print shirt looked somewhat surprised as she examined the tall, handsome young man before her, her eyes showing some confusion.
"You are..."
Looking at the woman who bore five or six similarities to Xia Yue but was older, Lin Yu showed a gentle smile on his face.
"Auntie, hello, I'm a friend of Xia Yue's."
When the woman heard Xia Yue's name, a flash of shock appeared in her eyes.
"Xiao Yue's friend? Please come in quickly! How should I address you?"
She quickly opened the door wider and invited Lin Yu to come in and sit.
"Just call me Xiao Lin."
Lin Yu smiled and nodded.
Then, Xia Yue's mother noticed what Lin Yu was carrying in his hands and quickly spoke again.
"Just leave those things by the door, auntie doesn't really need these."
Lin Yu walked through the door, smiling and shaking his head: "No, auntie, Xia Yue told me she has a younger sister at home. These are for the child."
"The fruits are dragon fruit and blueberries, good for brain development."
"The milk is imported too. Children need milk for growth."
"It's just a small gesture... please don't refuse, auntie. I already feel guilty for taking so long to visit."
With a few words, Lin Yu eliminated any possibility of Xia Yue's mother refusing again.
The thin middle-aged woman could only speak somewhat awkwardly: "I'm sorry to have you spend money like this..."
She bent down and took a pair of slippers from the shoe cabinet—women's style.
Xia Yue's mother looked up somewhat embarrassed: "This... maybe you don't need to change, we don't usually have guests."
"These are just what Xiao Yue used to wear..."
Looking at the clean tiled floor, Lin Yu changed into the pink plastic slippers that didn't quite fit and entered the room.
"It's fine, auntie. Slippers don't need to fit perfectly."
He walked into the room and placed the fruit and milk on the shelf by the kitchen door.
Then, Xia Yue's mother pointed to the living room sofa.
"Please sit first. I'll get you a glass of water!"
As she spoke, she hurried toward the kitchen.
Lin Yu nodded and slowly walked to the living room.
In the living room was a small memorial altar with two sets of black-and-white photos, spirit tablets, and an urn.
The one on the left was of an adult man, apparently placed there quite some time ago.
And the one on the right...
Was newly placed—a young girl with a lively, cute smile and gentle features.
This was naturally Xia Yue and her father.
The spirit tablets, memorial photos, and small table for offerings were all wiped clean, with incense sticks burning quietly in the incense burner.
Someone must have been carefully cleaning this area every day.
Lin Yu sat silently on the opposite sofa. Soon...
Xia Yue's mother came out with a cup of tea.
"I don't know if you're used to chrysanthemum tea. If you young people don't like this, I can go downstairs to the supermarket to buy some cola or something."
As Mother Xia spoke, Lin Yu quickly waved his hand.
"No need, auntie. I'm used to drinking tea."
He took the chrysanthemum tea and took a sip.
Xia Yue's mother sat on the sofa opposite Lin Yu, noticed he was sitting across from the memorial altar, and smiled silently.
"The space at home is limited, so we placed her together with her father."
Then, Mother Xia changed the subject: "So... Xiao Lin, your visit this time..."
Lin Yu nodded gently.
"I came to see how you're doing, but I also have a request that might be somewhat excessive..."
"Auntie, I'd like to see Xia Yue's remains or ashes."
"She's probably not here, is she?"

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Infiltration and Schemes
chapters.content:
There was only one urn in Xia Yue's home, and from its wear and placement, Lin Yu could easily deduce...
That "urn" belonged to Xia Yue's father.
In other words, Xia Yue's remains were not in this home.
Hearing Lin Yu's words, Mother Xia seemed somewhat surprised but didn't feel particularly offended.
"Xiao Lin, why do you want to see that?"
Lin Yu pursed his lips: "I have some unfinished words I want to say to her... so I wanted to know where her remains are placed."
"I always feel like she might not hear words spoken to a memorial tablet and photo."
Lin Yu's tone carried some melancholy.
Although this reason didn't sound very reliable, combined with his somewhat sorrowful tone, it actually made Mother Xia not suspect anything.
She looked at Lin Yu and spoke somewhat hesitantly: "Were you and Xiao Yue very close?""We didn't spend much time together, but she was practically one of the people closest to me," Lin Yu said softly. "I often have this unreal feeling—I don't know if you experience this too, Auntie..."
"A perfectly fine person suddenly gone, making me feel like I've suddenly entered a world I've never been to before."
As Lin Yu spoke, he looked down at his own hands, opening and closing them.
"So, Auntie, I want to talk to her, also to confirm for myself... that this has really happened."
Then, Lin Yu raised his head, showing an apologetic smile.
"Sorry, Auntie, I probably shouldn't say these things in front of you."
Mother Xia paused for a moment, then shook her head.
"No, it's fine..."
"Xiao Yue hasn't been cremated yet because she died accidentally, and coincidentally the surveillance was broken."
"Although the comrades from the public security said the preliminary investigation and examination results indeed point to accident, further appraisal results are still pending, taking about over twenty days."
"We weren't in a hurry to cremate anyway, thinking that if Xiao Yue really didn't die accidentally, we couldn't let her suffer injustice... so we decided to temporarily not cremate."
As Mother Xia said these things, although her tone was calm, her expression still seemed somewhat unnatural.
When mentioning words like "remains" and "cremation," it seemed she could still feel the heartache from when she first received the news.
With both husband and child dying accidentally, if not for having another daughter, this mother probably would have already collapsed.
Lin Yu nodded.
"I understand, Auntie. I'm sorry for making you say these things that upset you."
"It's fine, it's fine," Mother Xia shook her head. "You're feeling bad too, Auntie knows, child."
"You're feeling bad too... it's already noon, would you like to stay for lunch? I've already mostly prepared it!"
As Mother Xia spoke, Lin Yu was just about to politely decline.
At that moment, the sound of a door opening came from the entrance.
A young girl wearing middle school uniform pushed the door open and walked in, speaking clearly.
"Mom, I'm back."
After entering, the middle school girl noticed Lin Yu sitting in the living room, showing surprise and wariness.
"Mom, who is he?"
Lin Yu stood up, and Mother Xia introduced: "Xia Yang, this is your sister's friend, Brother Lin."
After Mother Xia's introduction, Lin Yu nodded slightly: "Hello, Xia Yang, I've heard your sister mention you."
The girl named Xia Yang clearly looked uncomfortable.
"Hmm!"
She responded indifferently, then quickly walked straight back to her room.
Mother Xia seemed somewhat embarrassed: "This child is shy around strangers..."
Lin Yu shook his head: "It's fine, I am intruding after all."
"Seeing that you and Xia Yang are both doing well, I feel slightly relieved... Xia Yang might not even want to come out to eat with me here, so I'll take my leave now."
Before Mother Xia could try to persuade him to stay again, Lin Yu added: "I have things to do this afternoon too, I'll come visit you again when I have the chance."
Mother Xia could only nod: "Okay, Xiao Lin... then take care on your way."
Lin Yu left Xia Yue's home and got back on his bicycle.
The noon sun was bright with gentle breezes blowing. As Lin Yu rode on the roads of Jiangcheng's Beiqiao District, his gloomy mood eased somewhat.
After leaving Xia Yue's home, Lin Yu clearly realized.
"You really were a good person..."
He sincerely sighed.
Just from the reactions of colleagues at her workplace and family at home, Lin Yu could clearly see...
Xia Yue was a very good person.
Her death must have been a huge tragedy for those around her, especially her family.
However...
Lin Yu didn't feel the slightest guilt or self-blame because of this.
After all, Xia Yue had also intended to kill him at the time.
Furthermore...
Lin Yu felt that, taking a step back, the one who should bear the most responsibility for Xia Yue's death should be Fluoxetine.
It was Fluoxetine who personally sent Xia Yue into the 'Death Game,' it was Fluoxetine who killed Xia Yue in reality.
Even though Lin Yu killed her twice in the 'Death Game'...
But Lin Yu himself was also sent in by Fluoxetine.
"I'll avenge you, Xia Yue. After all, we share the same enemy."
"So..."
"You don't mind if I borrow your identity, right?"
"I think your family and friends would be happy to see this too."
Lin Yu stopped his bicycle in front of a restaurant.
However, Lin Yu didn't enter the restaurant but turned into the alley beside it.
Then, Lin Yu patted the little octopus dozing on his shoulder.
"Hannah, wake up."
Hannah, who had been wilting from the sun, perked up.
"Quack quack, Director, your orders!"
Lin Yu looked at the "Jiangcheng City Public Security Bureau Beiqiao Branch" across the street and said softly.
"If you use 【Concealment Camouflage】 to keep me and you completely 'invisible' while moving, about how long can you maintain it?"
Lin Yu asked quietly. Hannah thought for a moment before replying softly.
"I probably can't do it for too long because I'm not very strong."
Hearing Hannah's words, Lin Yu stroked his chin.
But...
Hannah's next words made Lin Yu feel helpless.
"Quack... probably only about an hour?"
"If it's just me alone, maybe four hours!"
"That's not short at all, Hannah."
Hannah was utterly shocked by Lin Yu's words.
"Huh?! But Uncle Ka can maintain it for six hours while carrying someone!"
Lin Yu sighed helplessly.
"That's because your Uncle Ka is too strong, not because you're weak."
The little octopus was very happy to hear Lin Yu's words.
"Quack, so I'm actually strong? Director!"
"Hehe... thank you for the praise!"
She said happily.
"Then should I activate the ability now? Director!"
The little octopus asked excitedly.
Lin Yu nodded.
"Of course, because I might need to infiltrate a heavily guarded place now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Corpse, Plan, and Loopholes

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Patching Lin Yu’s Weaknesses
chapters.content:
If he wanted everyone to "immediately" discover the illusion that "Xia Yue wasn't dead," Lin Yu could have made the disappearance of Xia Yue's corpse much more sensational.
An explosion... or intentionally using [False Face] to leave footage of "Xia Yue" stumbling out of the police station on surveillance cameras - these would have been enough to make "Xia Yue's resurrection" solid evidence.
But Lin Yu didn't do that.
Because what he wanted wasn't "Xia Yue's resurrection," but rather to make everyone believe that "Xia Yue wasn't dead"!
Since Order's investigation wasn't thorough enough, there remained some ambiguity about the truth at that time.
Under circumstances where ordinary people were investigating players while enduring the Death Game's interference with normal thinking, it was entirely possible for a "player" to use some props to disguise their own corpse and achieve feigned death.
There had even been precedents for such methods.
But here emerged the first loophole regarding Xia Yue - "time."
Xia Yue was killed by "Fluoxetine" in the afternoon, and her body was discovered before midnight.
The fact that she died in the afternoon hadn't been "erased."If Xia Yue truly was a promising newcomer, then either she passed the first dungeon, directly reversing and eliminating the "death" fact.
Or she didn't pass the first round, and the death fact remained.
According to Fluoxetine and Psychological Society's judgment, Xia Yue wasn't a player during the "afternoon."
"Players" indeed possessed many miraculous means and could use some magical props to deceive the police, making them mistake fake corpses for real ones.
And "players" had sufficient motivation to do so - especially when killed by another player, concealing the fact that they were still alive could save their lives.
But how could someone who wasn't a player accomplish this, and what reason would they have to do so?
Fortunately, Lin Yu had already filled this loophole in advance.
He parked his bicycle at a shopping mall entrance, entered the fire escape through an unnoticed surveillance blind spot, changed into pre-prepared clothes, and quickly activated [False Face] and [Counterfeit].
Afterward, Lin Yu wandered around the mall for a while before pulling out another brand new phone, taking a ride-share to Jiangcheng's downtown commercial district.
Today, besides visiting Xia Yue and disposing of her body, he had another appointment to keep.
He got out of the ride-share car and arrived at an elegant café, walking directly to the counter and taking a seat.
Beside her already sat an excessively young girl wearing a baseball cap and sunglasses, sipping on a fruity coffee drink topped with foamy whipped cream.
"Yo, A Nian, you made quite a stir the other day."
Li Nian, crossing her legs, lowered her sunglasses and glanced at "Zhu Ming" wearing a floral blouse and jeans before speaking.
"Seems your information is indeed very well-informed, but let's not talk about that first..."
"You previously said you killed a player with over 500,000 bounty from Hunters' Association - we've verified it, and it's indeed correct. Marauders' Red Fuji has been confirmed dead, the time and location match what you said, and the photo evidence you submitted is sufficient for confirmation."
"Although there are rumors saying it was done by some hot new newcomer Doctor... but being able to make him voluntarily give you the credit is also proof of your capability and strength."
"Anyway congratulations, you've completed one of the three conditions. Next you just need to complete one more condition and you're OK."
As Li Nian spoke, Lin Yu nodded.
"Good, I understand."
"So which one do you choose - playing one game with us, or joining another organization?" Li Nian flipped out a black card. "If you choose the former... this is a [Team Card]."
"We've already discussed and decided on personnel - it will be me and Mountaineer conducting this dungeon assessment."
Li Nian spoke as if quite certain Lin Yu would choose the "former."
After all, when this "Miss Zhu Ming" first came looking, she had made it very clear.
She had offended both Marauders and Psychological Society, and didn't like Order either.
Although it was still unknown how this individual had offended Psychological Society, but anyway regarding that incident on the river ferry before, she definitely had major beef with Marauders.
Even Red Fuji, who completed the first task, was a core member of Marauders.
Although from recent contact with that guy called May May, she seemed to have some connection with that rising star about to join Order...
But considering Zhu Ming's operations and temperament, Li Nian was quite confident she wouldn't join, and couldn't join Order either.
So...
This individual couldn't possibly join Psychological Society, right?
But unexpectedly, Lin Yu gently picked up the [Team Card], played with it for a moment in his hand, then stuffed it back into Li Nian's jacket pocket.
"I choose option two... when we truly become 'companions' in the future, there will still be time for us to cooperate in dungeons together."
Lin Yu said gently, looking at the stunned Li Nian.
"Sorry, I'm just a bit paranoid."
Li Nian came back to her senses and shook her head: "No problem, this choice is interesting - but, if convenient to disclose, which organization are you planning to join?"
"Psychological Society."
Lin Yu said without hesitation.
"Huh? Those psychos? Don't you have beef with them?"
Li Nian asked reflexively.
Lin Yu smiled and said: "Yes, but recently discovered... seems like it was just some misunderstanding."
He looked at Li Nian and said softly: "Do you think Psychological Society people can make mistakes in their assessments?"
Li Nian paused for a moment, then nodded: "Probably, like those B's apparently only gave Grandmaster a C, and gave me an A too... how could I possibly only be an A? Achieving promotion in just six dungeons should be at least A+!"
Li Nian said while stroking her chin.
Lin Yu smiled faintly: "It's not that they made a mistake about my potential, it's just that Psychological Society pulls promising non-players into the game through assassination methods, right?... This is what created some misunderstanding between me and them."
"What do you mean by that?"
Li Nian's eyebrows furrowed tighter.
Lin Yu didn't directly answer this question, but instead pointed at his own face.
"You know, A Nian, during the first dungeon, I realized the importance of disguising myself, so in every dungeon, I cover my face as much as possible and leave no survivors whenever possible."
"But later, I obtained a prop that can slightly adjust my appearance."
Lin Yu gently peeled off a thin film from his face.
This film had no real existence - it was transformed by [Counterfeit].
While peeling off the film created by [Counterfeit], Lin Yu perfectly timed the activation of [False Face].
"Anyway, since I've already confirmed joining you all, and after several contacts... seems like showing you my real face isn't such a big deal anymore."
Lin Yu's face underwent some subtle changes, his appearance becoming closer to the original prototype of the "Zhu Ming" character.
Looking at the somewhat stunned Li Nian, Lin Yu spoke with a smile.
"Consider this my 'assessment' for you... using my current face and what I just said, try to figure out why I suddenly changed my mind and why I'm confident I can join Psychological Society."
"Let me give you one more hint."
"The code name 'Zhu Ming' comes from 'Huainanzi·Astronomical Training'."
With that, Lin Yu stood up and walked toward the café entrance.
Admittedly, according to Psychological Society's judgment, when Fluoxetine killed Xia Yue, she was just an ordinary person with high potential who hadn't entered the Death Game.
But...
What if Psychological Society was wrong?
At this moment, Lin Yu's profile was reflected in the glass storefront.
Exactly identical to the girl from the corpse and black-and-white memorial photo he had seen just hours before...

chapters.title: Chapter 218: The Tycoon's Dilemma and Reward
chapters.content:
After parting with Li Nian, Lin Yu once again ducked into a corner and changed his appearance.
Only this time he had taken on the face of "Old Yao."
Wearing Old Yao's face, Lin Yu of course intended to go see the Tycoon.
Soon he arrived at the Tycoon's usual grinding spot—the abandoned restaurant.
Being proper about procedure, Lin Yu first took out his phone and sent the Tycoon a message.
"Boss, are you there?"
After spending some time together, the Tycoon had apparently learned a bit about Old Yao's disposition.
He didn't reply on his phone;
"Come up."
The Tycoon waved to Lin Yu.Lin Yu kept a look of delighted flattery on his face, hurried up the stairs, and entered the Tycoon's office.
When he pushed the door open, the Tycoon was sitting on the sofa and smiled at "Old Yao," though the fatigue on his face was apparent.
"What's up?"
Lin Yu rubbed his hands together and put on a sheepish expression.
"These past few days Jiangcheng's been a mess—every kind of troublemaker came to make trouble. Boss, you, as Jiangcheng's stabilizing force, must be exhausted day and night. I just wanted to come check on you..."
Lin Yu paused, then added,
"Your family… should be safe, right?"
The Tycoon looked at "Old Yao" with some surprise;
his brows twitched twice, then he laughed and scolded.
"Damn it, Old Yao, I know you've got good sources… but this is a little too well-informed!"
Lin Yu grinned slyly.
"Our kind of trade, lowly and scrappy, always taught us the value of information… Now that we're in this game, one wrong step and it's eternal damnation. My abilities are limited, so I make lots of friends and build goodwill."
"Of course, clinging to a strong back is most important. Now that I have you as my support, things are a lot easier to handle."
At those words, the Tycoon nodded, not offended at all.
That confidence was Lin Yu's advantage.
Having watched the whole thing from the overpass, he knew exactly how Fluoxetine had used the Tycoon's family as leverage.
Although it seemed like only Fluoxetine knew about it, the Tycoon was normally ostentatious and upright—a brotherly figure in Jiangcheng. It wouldn't be hard for others to find out about his family.
When the Tycoon hurried home from the overpass that day, he couldn't hide from the numerous peripheral members of Order and the Marauders who were staking out near the bridge.
So it wasn't a secret.
Lin Yu also understood the Tycoon—through multiple contacts and identities, Lin Yu's knowledge of the Tycoon far exceeded the Tycoon's knowledge of Old Yao.
He knew that, coming from the relatively harmless persona of Old Yao, using a probing, purpose-driven tone to bring up potentially awkward facts for the Tycoon would not arouse resentment or suspicion.
On the contrary, the Tycoon might actually think Old Yao was being candid in some sense.
So…
The Tycoon leaned back in his chair and directly told Lin Yu the answer.
"The little brat from the Psychological Society set me up—no wonder, they do play with psychology," the Tycoon said, leaning back with a tired tone. "I rushed home only to find a single camera stuck by my front door. Not a soul around!"
He rubbed his face hard, and Lin Yu breathed out in relief as if sharing the moment.
"Well, Boss, that's a good thing… but why do you look so listless?"
"Are you really exhausted?"
The Tycoon gave a bitter laugh and shook his head.
"Bullshit, the main thing is I got into another fight with my old man when I got back. Damn it—I shouldn't have gone back!"
"And my big brother too… never mind, don't bring him up, it's unlucky!"
The Tycoon waved his hand, full of annoyance.
Looking at the Tycoon—over forty and well into middle age—Lin Yu felt like he was seeing a rebellious kid who ran away from home, surfed the internet at a cybercafe, and cursed his father with classmates.
Maybe every family has its own hard chapters, or perhaps a man remains a boy at heart until death.
Either way, Lin Yu didn't plan to pry and just laughed it off.
"As long as your family is safe, that's what matters… It's a pity, though;
without you there, those bastards probably ran far away."
"Too bad the Order friends didn't stop them!"
Lin Yu said regretfully.
Although he had not formally joined Order, he was half in the Free Alliance and a core member of the Marauders.
From the messages on the phones of Li Nian and Heavenly Artisan earlier, he could piece together roughly what had happened after he left that day.
Order, at the cost of two injured Game Masters, had forced Phantom out of his life-saving trump card;
Free Alliance had paid a huge price to rescue him;
members from the Psychological Society who came to support Fluoxetine had also been badly hurt…
As for the Marauders, although Fish fled, she captured many core Marauder members—those not killed in fierce resistance were now held together in one place.
These were details the Tycoon had not yet shared within Jiang'an Hall.
The Tycoon had grown used to Old Yao's well-informed nature, so he went on to share his own views.
"Although many ran off, there were still gains… Order is satisfied with the operation."
"So many troublemakers came, and in the end only a bridge collapsed, with not too many civilians caught up—that's the best of bad outcomes!"
The Tycoon said with feeling.
Then he waved his hand.
"That's enough about that. It doesn't concern Jiang'an Hall much in the long run… I forgot to ask you while I was busy. Old Yao, how's your Promotion going?"
"Which direction did you choose?"
Lin Yu let out a sly chuckle.
"Thanks to you and Senior Phantom Hand, I passed smoothly."
"I'm now First-Tier… and I chose the item Wonder Pouch!"
When Lin Yu said that, a fair amount of belief rose in the Tycoon.
"Not bad… you've reached First-Tier," his voice carried approval. "But why choose the Wonder Pouch? Do you have enough direct combat ability?"
Lin Yu absolutely did.
He chose the Wonder Pouch precisely because he wasn't lacking in offensive options.
But he couldn't show that. He scratched his head and said, "I have no direct combat methods at all, so I plan to avoid fighting whenever possible."
"As the saying goes, capitalize on strengths and avoid weaknesses…"
Lin Yu said it like that, and the Tycoon nodded.
"That's one way… Anyway, Promotion going smoothly is a good thing."
"At worst, I'll help you swap for a more suitable item later—your contribution to that Puzzle was huge. Besides the reward from Order, I should properly reward you!"
"But let's wait until you've fully 'digested' the benefits of Promotion."
Lin Yu was a bit surprised by those words.
The Tycoon's promise of an item reward made him eager and grateful, but he couldn't show it.
"What do you mean by 'digesting' all the benefits of Promotion?"
Isn't the career item the full benefit?
The Tycoon laughed. "You clearly don't know yet!"
"Come on, let this Fourth Tier teach you… and help you avoid detours!"
"Promotion, besides giving you more abilities, has a more important effect…"
"It deepens your connection with the many worlds of the Death Game!"

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Access Rights and Hannah’s Doubts
chapters.content:
Hearing Tycoon's words, Lin Yu felt slightly shocked.
Similar words had been mentioned before by his senior, Shen Bingmiao.
"'Promotion' is the process of making another world firmly remember you."
But obviously...
His senior probably thought he was still far from 'Promotion' back then, so she didn't elaborate further.
From Tycoon's words, Lin Yu could easily deduce...
'Promotion' had other benefits—and these benefits were closely related to making another world "remember you."
Tycoon looked at Lin Yu and spoke with a smile.
"You must have noticed that many dungeon worlds in the 'Death Game' are interconnected... Although not all dungeons form a unified whole, some dungeons are indeed related to each other."
"I can't go into specifics, just like how you as a player can't mention the 'Death Game' to ordinary people... As a high-tier player, there's some information I can't disclose to lower-tier players either."Lin Yu nodded.
"I never knew there was such a thing..."
Tycoon grinned widely: "This is why information about 'Promotion' is so scarce—anyway, during the process of being gradually remembered by another world, besides receiving special 【item】 rewards from the 'Promotion Trial' itself and gaining new abilities..."
"More importantly, you'll obtain more 'privileges'—while being a 'player' certainly comes with many inconveniences, even setting aside your『profession』, you already possess supernatural abilities akin to 'superpowers' that ordinary people don't have."
"These are what 'privileges' give you—like the 'item space' that all players have."
Tycoon said cheerfully while pulling a cigar out of thin air—clearly, this was a [prop cigar].
"The most basic privilege you gain upon entering the Death Game is 'item space,' and when you become a 『First-Tier』player, you can obtain new 『privileges』..."
Lin Yu scratched his head.
He had already completed a dungeon after his 『Promotion』, so why hadn't he heard about these 『privileges』?
Tycoon seemed to notice Lin Yu's confusion and chuckled.
"You'll need to enter a dungeon again and encounter the right opportunity to obtain these 『privileges』."
"Anyway, here's some advice—try to build good relationships with friendlier NPCs and strive to obtain a 'identity' that can be repeatedly used in other worlds."
"When the time comes, you'll probably understand why we use code names with each other and why the 『forum』enjoys such high prestige among players..."
As Tycoon spoke, although Lin Yu felt somewhat confused, he vaguely began to understand.
But since he was currently playing "Old Yao," he could only scratch his head.
"Alright, I'll remember that, boss. I'll work hard."
As Lin Yu spoke, Tycoon nodded.
"Looking forward to your good news, Old Yao—by the way, tell your 『Doctor』friend that 『Order』is quite impressed with him and really wants to know how he's doing now."
"This is some 'inside information' I obtained through my connections."
As Tycoon spoke, Lin Yu's face lit up with joy.
"Wow, May is going to make it big!"
Then, Lin Yu sighed again: "But he's not in great condition right now. You know, it's already a miracle that he survived!"
"This guy is also quite stubborn and obstinate. Before joining 『Order』, he's too embarrassed to trouble them... So currently he's hiding away to recover his strength and waiting for the next dungeon."
As Lin Yu spoke, Tycoon couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"Quite a admirable personality, no wonder 『Order』took a liking to him."
"Feel like your friend has a boundless future ahead once he joins..."
Lin Yu nodded, his face full of yearning.
"Yeah, and then I'll have another powerful backer!"
Then, Lin Yu changed the subject and added another comment.
"But still can't compare to you—at least that guy didn't tell me about the 『privileges』!"
As Lin Yu spoke, Tycoon laughed a couple of times.
"Haha, probably thought it wasn't necessary!"
"Alright... Old Yao, once this turmoil completely settles down in a while, I'll definitely get you some official position in 『Jiang'an Hall』."
Tycoon said with emotion: "Our 『Jiang'an Hall』doesn't lack backbone strength, but compared to truly large organizations, we're still too deficient in high-end power!"
"If only you could jump directly to Third Tier, Old Yao... Ahaha, just kidding!"
Lin Yu joined in the laughter.
"Oh my, I wish I could too!"
"Thanks for your kind words, boss—I'll head back now, I need to prepare for the next dungeon!"
Lin Yu smiled as he bid farewell to Tycoon and left the abandoned restaurant.
"Now the 'Old Yao' identity is gradually getting on track... And I even got an unexpected bonus, obtaining very important information."
"Indeed 『Promotion』isn't that simple... And I'm also getting curious about what exactly the 『forum』is."
It was already afternoon, approaching dinner time.
A whole day of high-intensity infiltration and acting, continuously switching three identities and attending three different gatherings, left Lin Yu feeling utterly exhausted again.
The last time he felt this tired was when he set up the scheme to kill those 『Marauders』.
"Time to go home and rest."
Lin Yu let out a breath.
Although there was still a loophole in the identity regarding 『Zhu Ming』that needed to be addressed, he was simply too tired.
Besides...
"Final exams are next week, need to study over the weekend."
Lin Yu rubbed his temples and said painfully.
Even though matters in the 『Death Game』were important, final exams couldn't be neglected either.
Lin Yu didn't just want to survive—he wanted to live a stable, happy life.
So, real life matters couldn't be delayed either.
After riding his bike back home, his sister Lin Zhao wasn't home—on weekends when her small eatery had good business, Lin Zhao would work late to earn more.
Although recently Lin Yu had been slowly conveying the message to his sister that "I can earn quite a bit of money," it wasn't easy to completely change Lin Zhao's habits overnight.
Simply stir-frying some scallion oil minced meat and egg sauce as toppings, then cooking some hand-pulled noodles for a quick meal, Lin Yu returned to his study to start studying.
Only after finishing eating and returning to his room did Hannah finally speak softly.
"Ribbit, Director-sama, although your cooking skills are good too... why do you never let me help with cooking?"
Lin Yu looked at Hannah, her two tentacles tapping together in front of her like fidgeting fingers, and belatedly patted his head.
"Oh right, I forgot you can cook too!"
"Mainly because my sister usually does the cooking, so I haven't needed your help!"
Hannah scratched her head: "Ribbit? That's Director-sama's older sister?!"
"But she looks even younger than you!"
As Hannah spoke, Lin Yu burst into silent laughter.
"Too bad I can't introduce you to my sister, otherwise if you said that to her face, she'd be absolutely thrilled."

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Another Weakness
chapters.content:
After reviewing his studies throughout the entire weekend at home, Lin Yu felt confident about the exams during finals week.
He had always been quite diligent with his studies, and coupled with his passion for performance, he consistently completed group assignments and attendance requirements thoroughly.
Although he had skipped more classes than usual over the past month due to the Death Game, his regular assessment scores were definitely quite high.
Moreover, since Lin Yu now had substantial financial resources and no longer needed to rely on scholarship money to support his household expenses, his exam goal had shifted to simply passing...
Therefore, Lin Yu felt fairly confident about passing his exams.
After completing his weekend studies, Lin Yu decided to start dealing with Death Game matters again.
He rode his bicycle, preparing to address the final loophole regarding the identities of "Xia Yue" and "Zhu Ming."
Before long, Lin Yu arrived at Jiangcheng No. 6 High School, which he had visited once before.
After all...
If he wanted to merge the identities of "Zhu Ming" and "Xia Yue," the final loophole was Chen Zhuo!Surprisingly, even after a month had passed, the security guard actually recognized Lin Yu.
"Oh hey, young man, here to deliver books to your brother again?"
The gatekeeper said cheerfully, but Lin Yu shook his head.
"Not this time, sir. He forgot his phone, and his family has guests coming over tonight. They booked a restaurant outside, so his parents asked me to come tell him to go straight to the restaurant after school."
Lin Yu replied with a smile, casually fabricating a lie that the gatekeeper wouldn't suspect even if he thought about it ten times over.
Naturally, the guard let Lin Yu in.
With his previous experience, Lin Yu first confirmed that Chen Zhuo's class wasn't having PE on the sports field before heading to the teaching building.
Arriving at the door of Class 5, Grade 11, Lin Yu peeked through the back window and saw they were having an English class.
Chen Zhuo was sound asleep at the very back row.
Lin Yu checked the time - less than ten minutes until class ended - so he simply waited by the classroom's back door.
Soon enough, the bell rang for the end of class.
After the teacher left, Lin Yu directly stopped a student at the doorway.
"Classmate, could you please call Chen Zhuo? Tell him his family needs to see him about something."
The stopped student naturally didn't refuse and immediately ran into the classroom to shake Chen Zhuo awake.
"Brother Zhuo, Brother Zhuo, wake up!"
"Your family came to school looking for you!"
Watching the drowsy Chen Zhuo wake up, Lin Yu contemplated the situation.
Judging by the attitude of the messenger just now, it seemed Chen Zhuo hadn't been bullied by his classmates since last time.
In fact, he seemed to be doing quite well in class?
That made sense - after all, he had experienced three more dungeons since last time... his abilities must have improved further.
Even if he wouldn't use those [items] against ordinary people, the strong mentality forged through life-and-death battles was far beyond what ordinary students could match.
He just didn't know...
Now that Chen Zhuo had a deeper understanding of the "Death Game" and had matured more, would he see through the lies Lin Yu had told before?
After waking up, Chen Zhuo looked around and quickly spotted Lin Yu standing at the doorway.
A flash of pleasant surprise crossed his face as he quickly walked toward Lin Yu.
Sensing the "belief" emanating from the other party, Lin Yu curled his lips.
Well, at least for now...
This chubby kid still regarded him as the "Game Master."
Chen Zhuo quickly approached Lin Yu and spoke with some excitement.
"Game Master, what brings you here?"
"Let's find a quiet place to talk!"
Saying this, Chen Zhuo led Lin Yu quickly toward the storage room at the corridor corner.
Several delinquent-looking students were already smoking there, but when they saw Chen Zhuo bringing someone over, they immediately straightened up.
"Brother Zhuo!"
Chen Zhuo nodded: "Clear out for a bit. I need to talk with my cousin."
As he spoke, he pulled out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket and tossed it over. Several hooligans who didn't look like good students replied with cheeky grins.
"Sure thing, Brother Zhuo! You and our big brother have a good chat!"
With that, the hooligans left the relatively quiet space to Chen Zhuo and Lin Yu.
Watching the scene just now, Lin Yu couldn't help but feel even more impressed.
Not only was Chen Zhuo doing well - he was doing even better than Lin Yu had imagined!
"Learned to smoke?"
Lin Yu asked, looking at Chen Zhuo.
Chen Zhuo shook his head with pretended profundity: "Just learned how to manage people, that's all."
"Having power alone only makes others fear you. Having power and being willing to share benefits with others makes them respect you!"
Chen Zhuo stated with conviction.
Lin Yu chuckled helplessly: "Which anime or novel is that line from?"
Chen Zhuo broke character too, scratching his head and smiling sheepishly: "Made it up myself..."
"I don't smoke, I just found that after they confirmed I could fight well, giving them cigarettes helps maintain a decent relationship."
"They bullied you before - never thought about getting revenge?"
Lin Yu said, looking at Chen Zhuo.
Chen Zhuo grinned: "Thought about it, but... well, I already fought them once. After that, it just seemed pointless."
"I just want nobody to bully me. I don't want to bully others or get revenge by bullying them back."
"Of course... maybe I'm just too kind and weak."
Chen Zhuo said self-mockingly, then looked at Lin Yu.
"By the way, Game Master, you came to find me... did you see the post I made online?"
"Post?"
Lin Yu felt somewhat puzzled internally.
But he didn't show it, just nodded with pretended profundity, neither confirming nor denying.
"Partly because of that... but more importantly because you have great potential, so I've been keeping an eye on you."
As Lin Yu spoke, Chen Zhuo became very excited.
"Really? I didn't know I had potential... but I survived such a dangerous dungeon last time, maybe you're right, Game Master!"
Then, as if realizing something, Chen Zhuo said tentatively: "Eh? Game Master, are you dissatisfied about me trying to hire experts to team up with me online?"
Chen Zhuo said cautiously, and only then did Lin Yu understand.
The post this Otaku was talking about was likely the "paid carry request" post he made on the forum!
Many newcomers would offer forum points, excellent [items], or even cash as payment to seek help from experts to carry them through dungeons and teach them the necessary precautions for that type of dungeon.
And realizing this...
Lin Yu suddenly realized this seemed like a heaven-sent opportunity.
Because of Chen Zhuo's existence, there would always be loopholes in the identities of "Zhu Ming" and "Xia Yue."
It might even expose the fact that he and Xia Yue had been in the same dungeon.
Therefore, Lin Yu had already prepared for the worst-case scenario - either eliminating Chen Zhuo or using "Tongue of Deceit" once to see if he could alter his perception. Even though he would lose a chubby kid who firmly believed he was the "Game Master" and might lose many conveniences.
But for Lin Yu, that was a sacrifice he had to make.
But if Chen Zhuo was looking for experts to carry him through "dungeons"...
Lin Yu's mind became active.
"Seems like there might still be a way out!"

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Xia Yue Revived, Forming a Team
chapters.content:
To be fair, Lin Yu still hoped to find a way to make Chen Zhuo realize that Xia Yue wasn't actually dead without having to kill him.
On one hand, Chen Zhuo's willingness to protect him even at the cost of his own life before Lin Yu used "Rewind" had left some goodwill in Lin Yu's heart.
Though it hadn't been particularly useful, this chubby kid was indeed loyal!
On the other hand...
Mainly because if the "Game Master" identity could become permanently established, Lin Yu felt it would ultimately be a good thing.
Furthermore...
Players like Chen Zhuo who were so straightforward and easily fooled, and who had already established natural trust with him, were quite rare.
Lin Yu still remembered that his first bucket of gold earned through the 『Death Game』 was accomplished with Chen Zhuo's help!
Without Chen Zhuo, those fake items couldn't have become real!
Such a useful tool—if he hadn't died in the dungeon, having Lin Yu personally kill him would indeed feel somewhat reluctant.It was precisely because Chen Zhuo trusted him so much that Lin Yu felt there might be some room for manipulation.
So, Lin Yu cleared his throat lightly as a plan gradually took shape in his mind.
"Ahem, I have no objection to you finding someone, since it's within reasonable game rules."
"Of course, this doesn't mean I'll personally take you under my wing," Lin Yu waved his hand while looking at the shining Chen Zhuo. "If you're willing, I happen to know a player who has completed 『Promotion』 and cleared eight dungeons, and she's recently been short on money taking freelance work..."
Lin Yu paused before continuing to Chen Zhuo: "Moreover, she's an old acquaintance of yours."
Chen Zhuo asked curiously: "Eh?! My old acquaintance!"
Then, Lin Yu nodded.
"Yes, your old acquaintance."
Such a useful tool—if he hadn't died in the dungeon, having Lin Yu personally kill him would indeed feel somewhat heartless.
Lin Yu patted Chen Zhuo's shoulder.
"Then when school lets out at noon, I'll call her over."
"I'll wait for you at the school gate."
Afterward, Lin Yu left very casually, leaving behind an expectant Chen Zhuo.
And later...
Lin Yu also wandered around near Jiangcheng No. 6 High School's entrance, finding a fast-food hamburger joint to sit in for a while.
He casually ordered a set meal from this burger place that clearly targeted student customers—burgers that cost just ten yuan for three.
Although the burgers were pitifully small, given their price, Lin Yu didn't complain about them either, chewing each burger slowly and thoroughly.
Moreover, after Lin Yu swallowed the last bite of burger, he actually gained some unexpected rewards.
【Miserly Wealthy One: For the next 24 hours, any consumable items you use have a 50% chance of not being consumed. Any items and abilities with cooldown times have a 50% chance of not entering cooldown.】
【Remaining Duration: 24 hours】
He actually triggered a BUFF!
Seeing such a good thing, Lin Yu immediately made a decision and pulled out the 【Bliss Immortal Pot】 to activate its ability, turning this into immortal brew!
Although one already stored buff would be wasted, in Lin Yu's view...
The usefulness of this buff effect absolutely wasn't inferior to 【Sweet Luck】!
If it saved one use of 【Teeth of Prophecy】 or 【Tongue of Deceit】, that would be a huge win!
Or significantly shortening the cooldown of 【False Face】 and 【Counterfeit】 would also be good value.
Looking at this buff, Lin Yu felt greatly pleased, and along with it, his fondness for Chen Zhuo increased several notches.
"They say fools have foolish luck—this chubby kid might really be a lucky star, his face just radiates joy."
"Feels like I'm catching some of his luck just being near him."
Lin Yu felt even more strongly that keeping Chen Zhuo alive was indeed better.
After storing the buff in the form of 【Immortal Brew】, Lin Yu began coaching Hannah on new lines.
"Just say these few simple lines later, then exit stage right," Lin Yu communicated with Hannah through soul connection.
After being constantly exposed to it during this period, this little octopus had become much more proficient in using 【Illusory Ink】.
Originally, she couldn't even properly imitate her own sixth uncle with this skill—just creating superficially intimidating illusions.
Afterward, Lin Yu left very casually, leaving behind an expectant Chen Zhuo.
Hearing Lin Yu's instructions, Hannah looked serious.
"Quack quack! Understood, Director, I guarantee mission completion!"
Then Hannah began quietly muttering to herself, memorizing and practicing her lines.
Time quickly passed.
Chen Zhuo, who had been distracted all morning, rushed out of school and soon saw Lin Yu waving at him with a smile under the shade of a tree.
He casually ordered a set meal from this burger place that clearly targeted student customers—burgers that cost just ten yuan for three.
"Where's the expert you mentioned?"
Although the burgers were pitifully small, given their price, Lin Yu didn't disdain them either, chewing each burger slowly and thoroughly.
He had thought all morning but couldn't figure out which acquaintance of his was already an expert who had completed 『Promotion』.
It couldn't be one of his group chat friends, could it?
After all, Chen Zhuo had no real-life friends, only good friends in some anime group chats.
Even though his status at school had improved, Chen Zhuo still felt he couldn't connect with those bad scallions—though some of them watched anime and played mobile games too, Chen Zhuo looked down on them.
These people just treated beautiful anime as social accessories, only chasing popular IPs and overused memes, completely failing to understand the true beauty of anime culture!
But if there was an expert among his group friends...
Chen Zhuo couldn't help but fantasize about clinging to a powerful expert and soaring, then the two of them dominating dangerous dungeons together and building deep friendship...
Right, there were a few in the group who never used voice chat—maybe it was a really cute girl!
Just as Chen Zhuo was lost in his fantasies, Lin Yu before him spoke again, interrupting his daydream.
"Alright, she's here."
Lin Yu said softly. Chen Zhuo turned to look and indeed saw a girl who could be described as "pretty"—even "stunningly beautiful" in her delicate appearance.
Except she clearly wasn't one of his "group friends."
Though they had only met once, Chen Zhuo couldn't help but cry out in shock.
"Ah?! How is it you—you you you, didn't you fail the first dungeon?"
Though he didn't know her name, since it was the first "dungeon," Chen Zhuo remembered almost everyone's appearance clearly.
And regarding Xia Yue, he had additional memories.
"I know you... the Game Master said you were the one who killed the Lone Wolf!"
Or significantly shortening the cooldown of 【False Face】 and 【Counterfeit】 would also be good value.
"What's going on, Game Master? Didn't you say only I cleared it?"
Lin Yu smiled apologetically: "Sorry, this was also a white lie... because at that time this lady was standing right behind you covered in blood, she had 'almost mutually assured destruction with someone else'..."
"I was worried you'd break down in the 【Settlement Space】, so I didn't remind you to look back."
The delicate girl—the image of 『Veterinarian』 Xia Yue—spoke with a smile.
"Yes, little chubby, I was right behind you at that time."
"Nice to see you again."

chapters.title: Chapter 222: The Gradually Perfected Lie, Chen Zhuo's Confidence
chapters.content:
Lin Yu's "explanation" for Chen Zhuo would definitely be hard for ordinary people to believe immediately.
But...
Fortunately, Chen Zhuo's trust index in Lin Yu was exceptionally high.
Even though this reason sounded somewhat ridiculous, Chen Zhuo still nodded in convinced acceptance.
"Wow, Game Master big brother, you're really so kind-hearted, actually caring this much about my mental health."
Lin Yu smiled and said: "Alright, I have other matters to attend to, time is precious... your collaboration from now on will be up to you two to discuss!"
After speaking, Lin Yu turned and left, walking toward the other side of the road.
Chen Zhuo barely had time to say goodbye when he saw a car pass by...
Then, the other's figure suddenly vanished!
Chen Zhuo showed an expression of admiration."What powerful ability... appearing and disappearing mysteriously, truly worthy of being the Game Master!"
And the "Lin Yu" who disappeared...
Naturally wasn't the real Lin Yu, but an illusion created by Hannah.
"What powerful ability... appearing and disappearing mysteriously, truly worthy of being the Game Master!"
Watching Hannah maintain her invisible state as she dangerously yet safely quickly crawled back from between the rolling wheels of the road and jumped back onto his shoulder, Lin Yu quietly sighed in relief.
"Finally made a perfect exit."
But next, he still needed to continue negotiations with Chen Zhuo using the "Xia Yue" identity.
Chen Zhuo looked toward the "Xia Yue" that Lin Yu was impersonating and lightly coughed.
"Ahem, so that means... you actually weren't a 'new player' back then, right?"
Hearing Chen Zhuo get straight to the point with this question, Lin Yu nodded quite pleased.
He had really been afraid Chen Zhuo wouldn't notice this point!
"Correct, though I'm not much more experienced than you—that was only my fifth dungeon. I just entered the game one month earlier than you all."
Chen Zhuo listened, his expression becoming somewhat excited.
"Oh, does this mean it's because my hidden points are very high that such a situation occurred!"
"My first round dungeon already matched me with a player who had cleared four dungeons!"
Through extensive cross-verification among players, everyone generally knew...
Excluding interference from items like [Team Cards], each dungeon in the 『Death Game』 had a certain "range" for difficulty and the other players one might encounter.
Within this range, the difference between the strongest and weakest players in a dungeon usually wouldn't be particularly large.
Although the "first round" was special, normally the entire dungeon would consist of new players...
But if among the newcomers there was someone with excessively high "potential" and extremely strong hidden power, and the same batch of new players couldn't produce monsters of similar caliber, situations might occur where non-new players joined new player dungeons.
This situation was extremely rare, probably about as uncommon as encountering high-level NPCs who could recognize "players as players."
So the more Chen Zhuo thought about it, the more excited he became.
"In that dungeon, you and I were the only survivors—does this mean I was among all the newcomers in that dungeon..."
"Sorry, but you're probably overthinking it," Lin Yu interrupted Chen Zhuo gently in an extremely soft tone, "The ones in that dungeon with the most potential, enough to pull me in for balance, should have been that 『Soldier』 and 『Lone Wolf』..."
Speaking up to this point, Lin Yu showed a very gentle smile and spoke in a joking tone.
"You really should thank me though—if I hadn't dealt with those two, if you had faced them... well, though it's hard to say who would have won or lost."
Xia Yue said thus.
Chen Zhuo didn't stubbornly argue at all, immediately speaking respectfully: "Thank you, sister, for saving my dog's life. I hope you can continue carrying me from now on... may I ask how I should address you?"
"Zhu Ming," Lin Yu skillfully reported his false name, "This is my 'code name'... and yours?"
Chen Zhuo spoke: "Ahem, my forum ID is 『Ai-chan Lifelong Devotee』... you can call me 'Little Zhuo'."
Although he had expected Chen Zhuo's forum ID would be quite abstract, Lin Yu hadn't expected it to actually be this abstract.
So Lin Yu could only maintain Xia Yue's persona as someone completely unfamiliar with otaku culture, showing appropriate confusion.
"Your forum ID has no relation to 'Little Zhuo' at all, right?"
"Yes, Little Zhuo is my childhood nickname in real life," Chen Zhuo answered honestly, "After all, calling five characters according to the ID would be troublesome and somewhat embarrassing... calling me Lifelong or Little Push would also be strange..."
"Then couldn't I just call you Little Ai or Ai-chan?"
Lin Yu blinked, asking curiously and puzzled.
Speaking here, Lin Yu showed a very gentle smile and spoke in a joking tone.
"That absolutely won't do! That would be too blasphemous! You absolutely cannot call me that!"
"Just call me Little Zhuo!"
Seeing Chen Zhuo react so intensely, Lin Yu slightly pursed his lips.
"Alright... in that case, why not just set your forum ID as 'Little Zhuo' from the beginning?"
"That also won't do," Chen Zhuo's voice remained firm, his eyes revealing extremely tenacious willpower, "This is faith."
Lin Yu's face showed an expression of "not understanding but respecting."
"I think I understand... let's put the naming matter aside for now."
"Let's talk about the teaming matter... since that was your first round, the next one you'll participate in is your fifth dungeon, right?"
Lin Yu asked, and Chen Zhuo nodded.
"Yes."
"Since it's not a 『Promotion』 dungeon, why specifically hire experienced players to carry you?" Lin Yu asked puzzled, "Is your dungeon difficulty very high?"
"Whether points or [items], keeping them in your own hands and converting them into your own strength is the optimal solution, right?"
"Not exactly, Senior Zhu Ming," Chen Zhuo shook his head, "As you said, my first dungeon went too smoothly, so during my second dungeon I somewhat looked down on this game—thinking I could become a lone, lofty powerhouse... so I almost lost my life."
"From then on I realized, even though I have potential, I'm actually someone more suited for team play."
"Therefore... for my third and fourth dungeons, I hired some experienced players to help me clear—though not for 『Promotion』, with help it indeed went much more smoothly!"
Chen Zhuo said seriously: "Being able to find others to help oneself is also a manifestation of strength, isn't it?"
Hearing Chen Zhuo's words, Lin Yu considered for a moment before speaking again.
"I don't mind carrying you once, it's just... continuing like this, your points will eventually run out someday."
Chen Zhuo listened, looked at Lin Yu, and suddenly said.
"Have you not looked at the post I published yet?"
"Why not search my forum ID and take a look?"
Chen Zhuo said, his tone filled with confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Zhu Ming, Baby, You’re an Adorably Sweet Little Cake
chapters.content:
Hearing Chen Zhuo's confident tone, Lin Yu also became interested.
He immediately took out the phone that belonged to Zhu Ming and opened the forum app on it.
Although he was a reserve member of the 'Free Alliance', since he wasn't an official member yet, Lin Yu's account as "Zhu Ming" hadn't been removed yet.
He searched for the ID 'Ai-chan Lifelong Devotee' and quickly found the latest post Chen Zhuo had made.
"Honestly inviting two people to team up and help me clear a dungeon. I'll provide [Team Cards], 300 points per person. Interested parties please private message."
Looking at the post Chen Zhuo had sent, Lin Yu stared at him in shock.
"300 points?"
That would be thirty thousand yuan in cash.
Although it wasn't an especially huge amount for Lin Yu now, it still wasn't small.
And Lin Yu knew very well...Obtaining points was much more difficult than getting money.
300 points could buy a very handy weapon, maybe even one with some special effects!
Chen Zhuo could actually casually take out 600 points...
"You've only cleared four dungeons, right? Where did you get so many points?"
Lin Yu asked somewhat puzzled.
Then he added: "You don't have to answer if you don't want to, I respect your secrets... after all, everyone has secrets."
"I was just instinctively curious, sorry."
Hearing Lin Yu say this, Chen Zhuo instead eagerly took the initiative to explain.
"You were introduced by the Game Master big brother, and I did manage to pass safely without doing anything in my first dungeon because of you..."
"So, it's fine to tell you!"
"Besides, I feel like you're a trustworthy good person too. My intuition is very accurate."
Chen Zhuo said with full confidence, then directly explained.
"Though, actually there's not much special to say..."
"The reason I have so many points is actually just because... I guess I got lucky?"
Chen Zhuo scratched his head.
"Although I almost died in my second dungeon, I unexpectedly obtained an item I couldn't use... then I took it to the gathering to sell, and it turned out a very powerful uncle in our Jiangcheng bought it for 1000 points!"
"At the time, I was still a bit traumatized from the second dungeon. Having 1000 points, I naturally wanted to play it safe. Then I checked the market prices and found that ordinary veteran players who haven't advanced yet, with around ten dungeons experience, charging for bringing newcomers through dungeons generally ranges from 30 to 50 points. If it's guaranteed clearance, it's 50 points. So I offered a bit higher... took out 120 points to hire two people."
"Then I bought 10 [Three-Person Team Cards] and some potions from that kind uncle... spent about seven or eight hundred points..."
"The third dungeon went more smoothly, but it was almost too smooth - I used up consumables worth about 100 points."
"But I obtained some more [items]. Those [items] were all ores, medicinal herbs, things I still couldn't utilize. After coming out, I showed them to that kind uncle again, and he was absolutely amazed."
"He directly gave me another 1000 points to acquire them..."
"So, I thought I'd continue hiring people this time. Last week I took out 150 points and hired two veterans who hadn't advanced yet but had around fifteen dungeons experience..."
"After that..."
As Chen Zhuo spoke, Lin Yu could pretty much guess.
"You found more good stuff?"
"Yes, this time I sold it for 2000 points..."
Chen Zhuo said very apologetically, adding: "So I raised the bounty to 300 points."
"It's just that for some reason this time, not many people are applying... I'm about to enter the dungeon soon. I screened them and feel like there aren't many worth considering."
"No wonder you're so generous with money," Lin Yu couldn't help but remark, "As for why there aren't many people, I can understand that."
"300 points is too much - for players who haven't advanced yet, they would speculate whether your dungeon is very dangerous because of these points and wouldn't dare take the risk. Most Death Game players, especially those staying in the 'forum', are relatively rule-following and won't take too many risks."
"As for advanced players, an unknown commission with 300 points... isn't easy to accept either."
