"Because this kind of job is usually directly assigned to those organizations - generally speaking, people who can take out this many points have very wide connections. They can directly find their acquaintances."
"So this is an 'abnormal' commission... naturally making people wait and see."
As Lin Yu spoke, Chen Zhuo also suddenly understood.
"So that's how it is... then I really owe thanks to the Game Master big brother. Otherwise, I might have to do this dungeon alone!"
"And thank you for being willing to take on this commission."
Chen Zhuo said respectfully again.
"No problem, I'm just relatively short on money," Lin Yu waved his hand, then asked again, "By the way... you mentioned earlier that in your first two dungeons, you hired two people and used [Three-Person Team Cards]. What are your plans this time?"
Chen Zhuo looked Lin Yu up and down: "With you here, it's indeed relatively safe. But if possible... would you mind adding one more person?"
"Of course not, having an extra helper would make me feel more at ease too."
Lin Yu shook his head.
Now that Chen Zhuo already believed in "Xia Yue's" identity and the fabricated backstory, Lin Yu would be more than happy to pull in another person, able to use Chen Zhuo's mouth to indirectly spread some "credible" information about Xia Yue's identity.
Hearing Xia Yue's words, Chen Zhuo tentatively spoke again.
"Then... Senior Zhu Ming, Sister Zhu Ming, I have an unreasonable request."
"You said usually veteran players have their own connections... Do you think among your friends there's a suitable candidate? After all, this point bounty shouldn't go to outsiders, right?"
As Chen Zhuo spoke, Lin Yu laughed.
"You want me to make introductions for you?"
Chen Zhuo nodded: "Yes, yes! If you can bring in a reliable expert, I'll also give you an extra referral fee!"
Lin Yu waved his hand.
"Better not - but I do know an expert who seems to have availability."
"However, first, that person isn't very reliable."
"Second, the other party is not just [First-Tier], so the price might be on the expensive side."
"Lastly... that person can't accept points, probably needs cash or [items] for settlement."
Lin Yu said calmly, then took out his phone.
"If you accept, I can call her over to discuss."
Chen Zhuo looked somewhat surprised: "Of course!"
He only noticed one thing Lin Yu had said...
"Not just [First-Tier]!"
There's actually a higher-tier expert?!
Things like unreliable and not accepting points - those can be ignored and overcome!
"Please call her over quickly to discuss."
Lin Yu nodded and immediately dialed the contact in his phone.
The phone rang twice before connecting.
"Hello? Hello? I'm getting food at the school cafeteria, what's up?"
"A Nian, I've got a job here, bringing someone through a dungeon. The other party is offering 300 forum points for [First-Tier] level. I've already taken it. There's one spot left, you coming?"
As Lin Yu spoke, Li Nian on the other end of the phone made an exclamation of surprise.
"Oh wow, there's such a good deal! And you actually thought of me? I'm so touched!"
"Zhu Ming, you're such a good person! I only thought you were a superficially pleasant serial killer before, never expected you to have such a kind and considerate side!"
"Baby Zhu Ming, you're such an especially adorable little cake!"
Listening to Li Nian's gradually deranged words, Lin Yu's tone remained gentle.
"If you can't come, then get lost."
"Coming, coming, coming right away!"

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Negotiation, Price, and Reward
chapters.content:
Inside the fast food restaurant.
Chen Zhuo ate his burger while secretly glancing at the two strikingly different beautiful girls sitting across from him.
Zhu Ming went without saying—she was an incredibly gentle and kind big sister, smiling cheerfully with an elegant presence.
The newly arrived girl wore the handsome red-and-black uniform of a private high school. The refined design and quality fabric gave off a sophistication his own loose, sack-like school uniform couldn't possibly match.
Even with sunglasses hiding her face, he could tell she had delicate features and exquisite facial structure.
But sitting with the two of them didn't make Chen Zhuo feel like he was enjoying some privilege.
Instead, the constant sideways glances from passing classmates just made him increasingly nervous.
Meanwhile, Lin Yu finished explaining Chen Zhuo's commission details to Li Nian through his phone.
"So that's the situation... this kid just cleared four dungeons. His first round happened to be with me. He seems decent enough—just unusually lucky."
"Here's his commission post... whatever price you two work out is between you."After speaking, Lin Yu turned his attention to Chen Zhuo.
Even though Chen Zhuo sat right across from them and had heard every word of their conversation, he still pretended to just notice they'd finished talking as he set down his burger wrapper.
"Oh, ah, you're done talking?"
"About the... price, right?" Chen Zhuo tried his best to sound professional. "Maybe you could introduce yourself? Sister Zhu Ming only mentioned you're Second Tier..."
Lin Yu watched Li Nian with amusement.
He'd deliberately avoided introducing her to Chen Zhuo earlier, curious what false identity she would create for herself.
Li Nian understood Lin Yu's intention perfectly.
Resting her chin in one hand, she leaned forward slightly.
"Well, I offer two payment options. The first: you pay me 500 points in cash, which equals 50,000 yuan. For that, I'll tell you I'm just an ordinary 'Second Tier' Thief who'll use some [common items] and basic skills to try keeping you safe in your next dungeon."
"The second option... you pay me 1000 points—but not directly to me. I'll give you a list of items worth 1000 points that are sold on the 'forum,' items that only accept point payments."
"But in return—no matter how difficult the next dungeon gets, I'll do everything in my power to ensure you come out completely unharmed."
"And... if the opportunity arises, I'll even throw in a special gift."
As Li Nian spoke, Chen Zhuo couldn't help but swallow nervously at her meaningful tone.
"What does that mean?"
"Before you make your choice, that's all the information you get."
Li Nian took a sip of her ice-cold cola, then frowned.
"Why does this cola have no fizz?"
"It cost one-fifty per cup. Don't complain."
Lin Yu commented from beside her.
Hearing Li Nian's words, Chen Zhuo fell into deep internal conflict.
Finally, he reached a decision.
"I choose the second option... and I hope this chance will let me build a connection with you!"
"Maybe we can work together long-term in the future."
Chen Zhuo declared with intense eyes.
Li Nian burst into laughter.
"Personally, I think you made a wise choice. Anyway..."
She lowered her sunglasses slightly, her eyes meeting Chen Zhuo's.
"Let me introduce myself openly. I'm 'A Nian,' though you can also call me..."
"'Master Thief.'"
She offered no further introduction.
That single name alone was enough to make Chen Zhuo gasp in shock.
"You're the 'Master Thief'?"
"The... the one who..."
Li Nian gave a slight nod. "Yes, the newest member of the 'Free Alliance'... though I suspect this title might soon be taken by the 'Sister Zhu Ming' sitting next to me."
Li Nian said lightly: "So, how does it feel? Having one 'Free Alliance' member and one prospective 'Free Alliance' member running a dungeon with you? Exciting enough for you?"
Chen Zhuo was clearly overwhelmed.
"This is too exciting..."
He murmured, forcing a somewhat strained smile.
"Um, is it too late to change my mind?"
"Haha—of course not!"
Li Nian laughed as she pulled out a utility knife from her pocket.
"Usually transactions involving 1000 points require deposits and notaries. The reason I didn't ask for your deposit or find a notary is simply because I..."
"Have complete confidence in my ability to collect this debt myself."
She clicked the utility knife blade out one notch at a time, the sharp edge glinting coldly.
"Alright, take out the [Team Cards]."
As Li Nian spoke, Lin Yu looked at Chen Zhuo.
"Don't be too nervous. While it's true the 'Free Alliance' is a banned organization, they're not exactly chaotic, violent, or malicious. This 'A Nian' especially doesn't kill indiscriminately—she just really enjoys stealing things."
Lin Yu said with a smile.
Li Nian also shrugged. "That's true. If anything... the 'Miss Zhu Ming' who introduced me here is actually more dangerous."
With both of them tag-teaming like this, Chen Zhuo had no choice but to tremblingly pull out the [Three-Person Team Card] from his pocket.
"Then, you two... let's form the team."
There were supposedly two ways to use [Team Cards]. One required face-to-face contact—everyone just needed to hold the card simultaneously to form the team successfully.
The other method apparently allowed remote team formation, though Lin Yu didn't know the specific operating procedure.
In any case, all three reached out to hold the [Three-Person Team Card] together, looking like they were playing with a Ouija board.
Cardholder Chen Zhuo dramatically recited the phrase that actually only needed to be thought silently.
"Use Team Card!"
As Chen Zhuo's words faded, the Team Card instantly vanished.
A line of [blood-written prompt] appeared before Lin Yu's eyes.
[Team formation successful. Current team members: 3]
[Team status will remain until the next dungeon concludes.]
Seeing this [blood-written prompt], Li Nian patted her pants and stood up.
"Alright, that's done!"
"See you Tuesday night, chubby."
Li Nian stood up casually, and Lin Yu followed suit.
Leaving behind the still-shaken Chen Zhuo, the two walked out of the fast food restaurant.
On the way out, Li Nian looked at Lin Yu and grinned.
"Ah, really, thank you... letting me earn 1000 points in one go... plus getting a 'shopping agent'!"
For someone banned from the forum, having someone willing to buy 1000-point [items] from the forum for them was far more valuable than straight cash or points.
Lin Yu remained characteristically humble.
"Don't mention it. You earned this reward yourself... let's make money together."
Li Nian cheerfully elbowed Lin Yu. "What are you talking about? Without your introduction, I wouldn't have had this opportunity."
"And you didn't expose me when I was scaring him earlier!"
"Truly worthy of someone who can deceive the 'Psychological Society'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Li Nian’s Reasoning and the Expected Conclusion
chapters.content:
The moment Li Nian uttered the words "Psychological Society," she could feel Lin Yu's aura instantly turn icy cold.
But soon enough, Lin Yu regained his composure.
"As expected of the Free Alliance. Choosing you was indeed the right decision... Your investigation speed is faster than I imagined, and you've dug deeper than I expected."
Li Nian laughed.
"Hey, this has nothing to do with the Free Alliance—it's purely because I'm just that amazing!"
As she spoke, Li Nian pulled out a register with a flourish.
"Ta-da—Psychological Society Internal Assessment List Summary, combined edition for the first half of this year! I spent an entire weekend stealing this!"
Li Nian said cheerfully, casually flipping through the register as they walked.
"After you gave me that hint about 'Zhu Ming' last time, I went back and searched for quite a while, finally finding your name and information from two months ago—name Xia Yue, location Jiangcheng, rating confidential..."
"Having a confidential rating in Psychological Society internal documents means you're at least A-rank or higher... Impressive stuff, Sister Zhu Ming!"Li Nian said with a playful grin, while Lin Yu's expression remained calm.
"This is actually the first time I've heard that they rated me A or above..."
"However, I'd like to hear how you reached the conclusion that I deceived them."
Lin Yu spoke calmly, and Li Nian laughed.
"Ha... Hearing that I investigated this alone, you want to verify my capabilities, is that it?"
"Hey, don't underestimate me—I've already pieced together the entire story from beginning to end!"
Li Nian declared with full confidence.
"Based on my understanding of the Psychological Society, they dispatch specialists corresponding to the potential level of the ordinary person they kill. Since you were a non-player ordinary person with A-rank or higher potential, that means whoever killed you was... A-rank or S-rank."
"And as far as I know, the only Psychological Society member of that level who recently came to Jiangcheng was 'Fluoxetine'—Jiangcheng is too special. If A-rank or S-rank personnel from the Psychological Society entered, they couldn't possibly leave completely unnoticed after killing someone."
"As I continued my investigation, I discovered... you were actually already 'dead.'"
"One month ago, you 'died' in an 'accident' at your workplace and were pronounced dead after 'failed resuscitation attempts'—I read the report, and it definitely looks like Fluoxetine's work."
"But this creates a 'contradiction'... because your 'death' wasn't erased."
"Moreover, if you were still an ordinary person at that time, you couldn't possibly have experienced eight dungeons and completed your Promotion by now."
Li Nian paused before continuing, "So, although this possibility seemed extremely small, the fact that you yourself are standing here safe and sound, alive and kicking as a First-Tier player, proves one thing."
"That you accomplished what I originally thought was an improbable event."
"You're even more of a genius and more interesting than I imagined... One month ago, you deceived Fluoxetine—an S-rank Execution Department specialist of the Psychological Society—making her believe she had actually killed you."
"Not only that, you deceived the entire Psychological Society—almost immediately after being assessed two months ago, you actually 'died accidentally' and joined the Death Game."
"Even the timing of your 'assessment' might have been after you joined the Death Game—it's just that those Psychological Society guys completely failed to notice!"
"But... for an entire month, you never revealed this, leading the Psychological Society to mistakenly believe you were still an ordinary person, which is why they dispatched Fluoxetine again to try to kill you."
"After being attacked by Fluoxetine, not understanding her motives or why a high-level player had come to kill you, you made a calculated decision to fake your death—this time, you even deceived your family, friends, and the Jiangcheng police!"
"If I hadn't secretly infiltrated the place storing your 'body' yesterday and seen that the cold storage cabinet was empty with your 'corpse' completely missing, I probably would have fallen into the same misconception."
"Of course, this also explains why you suddenly showed up at my place three weeks ago wanting to join the Free Alliance... After a week, you must have figured out that the Psychological Society was behind what happened to you, right?"
"Except at that time, you didn't know they mistakenly thought you were an 'ordinary person' trying to send you into the Death Game. You just thought they were targeting you for some unknown reason, which scared you into quickly seeking to join an organization for companionship and protection, correct?"
At this point, Li Nian looked quite pleased with herself.
"Although you gave me many hints—I ultimately solved this mystery."
"So, how about it? My assessment... I should count as having passed perfectly, right?"
Li Nian said triumphantly, and Lin Yu nodded.
"Your analysis is basically correct, at least the objective facts are right."
"The only flaw is... that day I came to find you, I wasn't panicking and seeking shelter out of fear. I had simply realized that my 'strategy' had been heading in the wrong direction all along."
"Complete low-profile and hiding myself would still drag me into inexplicable dangers... The moment I became a player, some mysterious fate destined that I could no longer continue living a peaceful life."
Lin Yu explained calmly.
Although his surface remained composed, with only slight traces of surprise, appreciation, and pride showing on his face, internally...
Lin Yu was immersed in immense delight at his plan's success.
Yes, this was exactly the script he had written for "Zhu Ming," aka "Xia Yue."
That Li Nian could reason in this direction and reach the conclusion he most wanted...
This was perfect!
Simultaneously, he once again marveled at how Chen Zhuo was truly his lucky star!
From Li Nian's tone, Lin Yu could deduce that not only had she completed this investigation and reasoning herself, but she also apparently hadn't told anyone else about it yet.
So these deductions must have been fully completed just after meeting Chen Zhuo...
Or rather, after meeting Chen Zhuo and using him as a "witness" who had seen "Zhu Ming" in the dungeon to corroborate her reasoning, she became confident in her deductions.
This was the real reason Lin Yu had suddenly called Li Nian over on a whim earlier!
But if Chen Zhuo hadn't coincidentally been recruiting people, Lin Yu wouldn't have had the opportunity to naturally bring Li Nian and Chen Zhuo into contact.
This "lie" becoming truth would probably have taken much longer.
And once there was that first instance of "belief," this "lie" would almost become actual "fact."
Since he wanted to join the Free Alliance, Li Nian would definitely tell the other members of this organization.
And the members of the Free Alliance would become even more powerful evidence that "Xia Yue's" experiences were genuine.
Sure enough, after receiving Lin Yu's affirmative response, Li Nian excitedly exclaimed: "Ahahaha, I really found a treasure... Deciding to let you undergo assessment was definitely the right choice!"
"A genius who could trick both the Psychological Society and Fluoxetine, fabricating his own death for a full month without being discovered—everyone will be thrilled to have you join us."
"And—that 'Comedian' guy is going to absolutely adore you!"
"I'm looking forward to tomorrow night's dungeon... and the day you officially join us."

chapters.title: Chapter 226: The Express Train of Despair!
chapters.content:
Tuesday night.
After reviewing his studies all day in the library, Lin Yu packed up his books and quietly left the school as the closing saxophone music began playing.
After transforming into Xia Yue's appearance in the alley, Lin Yu once again confirmed the blood-text prompt about the dungeon before him.
『Less than 24 hours remain until the latest start time of the next game!』
『Please place yourself inside a moving, enclosed vehicle before midnight tonight to await game entry.』
『Friendly reminder: Detected that you are in a team state. It is recommended that team members enter the game simultaneously for the optimal gaming experience.』
This was Lin Yu's first time using 【Team Cards】 to form a team with others, so seeing this prompt felt somewhat novel.
However, neither Li Nian nor Chen Zhuo were new to teaming up. Both had already decided to gather today as early as yesterday, before the blood-text prompt about the 『dungeon』 had even appeared.
After the blood-text prompt appeared, Chen Zhuo had efficiently arranged the meeting location.
"Both of you, I've made arrangements regarding the game entry location.""Just come to Shengjiang Plaza subway station around 11 PM tonight!"
Probably due to feeling intimidated by the reputations of the two 『Free Alliance』 members, Chen Zhuo appeared particularly enthusiastic and eager to please.
Even though he was the employer, Chen Zhuo seemed terrified that these two might become dissatisfied, hastily completing all preparations.
Of course, another reason was that if Lin Yu and Li Nian had chosen the location, whether Chen Zhuo would dare to go would be another matter entirely.
Anyway...
Lin Yu took the subway to Shengjiang Plaza station as Chen Zhuo had instructed.
Just after exiting the subway station, Lin Yu saw Li Nian wearing sunglasses and Chen Zhuo standing obediently beside her.
Lin Yu walked over with some surprise.
"Oh, was I actually the last to arrive?"
As he approached them, Li Nian spoke with a cheerful laugh.
"I only arrived about ten minutes ago myself."
Then, both of them looked at Chen Zhuo.
"So... where's the transportation? It's not the subway, is it?"
As Lin Yu and Li Nian spoke, Chen Zhuo shook his head.
"Of course not, follow me."
He led them away from the subway station, twisting and turning through the alleys and lanes beside Shengjiang Plaza. After about ten minutes, they arrived at a newly built residential area.
This place wasn't far from No. 6 High School, appearing to be typical school district housing.
Chen Zhuo pulled a car key from his pants pocket, then led them to a...
"An old folks' scooter!"
Li Nian looked at the small three-wheeled vehicle with its red sheet metal shell and couldn't help covering her face.
Lin Yu sighed slightly: "You might as well have had A Nian find something."
Chen Zhuo unlocked the door of the old folks' scooter with the key, smiling awkwardly: "My grandma doesn't have a license, and my parents' car keys were hard to get... just make do with this, you two."
After saying this, Chen Zhuo climbed into the driver's seat.
Li Nian and Lin Yu had no choice but to squeeze into the back seat of the three-wheeled scooter, watching as Chen Zhuo started the vehicle.
"Put-put-put—"
The entire three-wheeler trembled slightly, then Chen Zhuo slowly drove the old folks' scooter out of the residential area.
Sitting in the back seat, Li Nian and Lin Yu were jostled around until their heads wobbled.
Li Nian remarked with feeling: "Actually, it's unexpectedly kind of cool..."
"What, is this your first time riding this kind of vehicle, young lady?"
Lin Yu teased casually.
For the first time, Li Nian showed an embarrassed expression: "It really is my first time..."
Since both Shengjiang Plaza and the area around Jiangcheng No. 6 High School were predominantly residential neighborhoods, there weren't many vehicles or pedestrians on the roads as midnight approached.
Chen Zhuo drove the three-wheeled scooter down the center of the wide road, gradually picking up speed.
The howling wind rushed through the gaps in the scooter's doors, prompting a new question from Li Nian.
"Does this count as an enclosed vehicle? It doesn't feel very sealed!"
Lin Yu was more optimistic: "It has a roof and doors, how could it not count as an enclosed space?"
Chen Zhuo also nodded in agreement with Lin Yu: "I think it counts too!"
As time passed, the three-wheeler raced through the streets, quickly approaching midnight.
Blood-text simultaneously appeared before all three of them.
【Joining game shortly—】
【Game Name: Express Train of Despair】
【Clear Condition: Obtain "Train Ticket"】
【Number of Players in This Game: 6】
"Oh—it's a train!"
Li Nian's cheerful voice rang out, filled with excitement.
Though he didn't know what she was so happy about...
Lin Yu didn't have time to ask right now.
Because Chen Zhuo's startled cry came through: "Why did it suddenly accelerate?!"
The needle on the scooter's dashboard slammed against the maximum limit, frantically hitting the edge!
The engine roared, and all three passengers felt themselves pressed back into their seats by the sudden acceleration.
The scenery outside the windows became blurred and distorted from the high speed, the vehicle shaking with loud "clang-clang" noises.
"It's going to flip, it's going to flip!"
Just as Chen Zhuo couldn't help but scream out...
"Bang!"
A violent sound erupted, and intense white light filled their vision.
"Still with the flashing?"
Lin Yu complained internally.
Then...
The bright light faded, and he felt the seat beneath him had become much softer.
Looking around at their surroundings, they found themselves sitting in a futuristic-looking train.
The train raced along at high speed, passing by a bustling urban nightscape outside the windows. Skyscrapers and illuminated signs streamed past like ribbons of light reflected in the glass.
The carriage interior was spacious, bathed in warm yellowish lighting.
The seats were soft and wide, with only four seats per row.
Lin Yu sat between Chen Zhuo and Li Nian.
The entire carriage was extremely quiet, as if aside from the three of them, there was no one else.
Lin Yu looked at Li Nian and asked:
"From what you said earlier, it sounded like you know about this dungeon?"
Li Nian didn't try to hide it, replying with a light laugh:
"I have indeed heard a little about it... anyway, this dungeon is relatively simple and straightforward."
Chen Zhuo also quickly asked:
"Then, Master Thief, what does 'train ticket' in the clear condition mean?"
"I'm not sure about that. I've only heard other organization members mention it once," Li Nian pulled out her utility knife, "Hey, Zhu Ming, you'd better bring out any useful weapons you have now, because this dungeon is the particularly ferocious kind."
"Ferocious? I don't see how?"
Though confused, Lin Yu still took out his pistol.
Since Li Nian recognized Heavenly Artisan's hammer, Lin Yu could only take out the 【Fear Torch】 as his melee weapon.
Just then, an announcement sounded through the carriage.
"Welcome—welcome six new passengers boarding from D-4, D-5, D-13!"
Lin Yu looked up at the carriage number.
Their carriage number was exactly D-13!
Li Nian whistled.
"Waha—here they come!"
"What's coming?"
Chen Zhuo's face showed a terrified expression.
The carriage was empty.
Li Nian threw her utility knife, and suddenly blood flowers bloomed in the air.
"Correction—they're already here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Restraint Relationship
chapters.content:
"Invisible enemies?"
Lin Yu watched the blood flowers blooming in the air, feeling slightly astonished.
Chen Zhuo's expression turned extremely grim: "Enemies we can't see... doesn't that make us extremely vulnerable?"
Lin Yu remained quite calm.
"It's not that bad—at least A Nian can see them, right?"
As he spoke, Chen Zhuo's expression relaxed somewhat.
At the same time, Lin Yu turned his gaze toward A Nian.
"How are you able to see them? Is there any way to let us see too?"
Li Nian pointed to the sunglasses on her face.
"It's thanks to these... Let me use the party information sharing to show you what this [item] can do, then you'll understand."After using party items, team members not only couldn't harm each other but also gained some relatively convenient functions—this was also related to the grade and type of the [Team Cards].
Although Chen Zhuo's [Team Cards] were the most basic model, they still had the function of sharing each other's [item] information.
An item description appeared on Li Nian's sunglasses.
[Hell Detective's Sunglasses: When worn, allows the user to see spirits, energy entities, and other intangible objects or life forms.]
[Description: As a detective, you need sharp vision;
but if what you're pursuing can't be seen with the naked eye, you also need a very good pair of glasses.]
Seeing this description, Lin Yu breathed a sigh of relief.
After discovering earlier that Li Nian could see some kind of "invisible" things, Lin Yu had actually been somewhat nervous.
He was very worried that Li Nian might have some means of seeing through concealment, which would pose a risk of her spotting the little octopus "Hannah."
Of course, Lin Yu had also been cautious—before meeting Li Nian, he hadn't let Hannah perch on his shoulder but instead hid her in his pocket.
However, Lin Yu felt there would definitely be times when he needed to use Hannah—if Hannah crawled out of his pocket and was seen by Li Nian...
It wouldn't be too hard to explain, since "May" and "Zhu Ming" were indeed acquainted in Li Nian's view, so having the same "pet octopus" around wasn't impossible.
Moreover, Hannah had once claimed that her camouflage skills were excellent, almost impossible to detect—even if Li Nian had means to see through concealment, she might not be able to see through Hannah's [Concealment Camouflage] inherited from "Ka the Octopus."
But regardless...
Lin Yu still hoped that "Hannah's" existence could remain confidential and that there would be no possibility of exposure.
For now, it was much better that Li Nian's glasses only worked on spirits.
"So these things are all spirits?"
As Lin Yu spoke, Li Nian nodded.
"Exactly. Although spirits are usually ghosts, it's not entirely accurate to call these guys ghosts... because they seem more like they were 'manufactured.'"
As she spoke, Li Nian nimbly vaulted over the first two rows of seats, then picked up the utility knife that had fallen earlier.
Then, she lightly stabbed toward the front left.
"Pfft!"
Blood sprayed out once again.
"There's good news—these things are actually pretty weak. They don't move very fast, and as long as you have means to harm spirits or non-physical entities, a single casual strike can take them out."
Li Nian pulled out the utility knife and casually flicked off the blood.
Hearing Li Nian's words, Lin Yu keenly sensed the implication.
"So there's bad news too?"
"The bad news is these things are everywhere!"
Li Nian casually slashed through the air a few times, and blood spurted out everywhere.
Simultaneously, Lin Yu felt a cold, stinging pain on his neck and arms.
It was like being instantly frostbitten.
Soon, even areas covered by clothing began to feel piercingly cold.
Without a doubt, if left unaddressed... these things definitely had the ability to kill them.
Even if not fatal, prolonged exposure could cause frostbite.
Nearby, Chen Zhuo was flailing his arms around and screaming in pain.
"Ouch! Ouch! They're on me, help!"
Lin Yu remained very calm.
"Means to harm non-physical entities?"
Although not entirely sure, he vaguely felt that the torch in his hand might be capable.
Even if not, it couldn't hurt to try.
"Whoosh!"
Pale flames emerged, instantly illuminating the space around Lin Yu and Chen Zhuo.
Dozens of round, spiky creatures resembling pufferfish were clinging all over their bodies.
"So this is actually a torch? And it can make these things visible too!"
Li Nian exclaimed in surprise.
"Of course," Lin Yu said, feeling reassured now that the torch could reveal these invisible spirits. "And these things... should be very afraid of it."
After all...
This thing originally burned "Fear"—it used human emotions and soul-born intangible substances as fuel, and had once ignited a monster condensed from souls—『Chate』!
Lin Yu swung it left and right a couple of times, and the invisible pufferfish-like small monsters clinging to him seemed to sense the threat, clumsily fleeing his body.
But...
They were too slow.
Lin Yu easily caught up with them, sweeping the flames over their bodies.
Then...
"Sizzle!"
These pufferfish instantly ignited—they were engulfed by the pale flames born from "fear," burning even more easily than physical objects.
A pleased expression appeared on Lin Yu's face.
"Seems like it really works."
He waved the torch over to Chen Zhuo, also dispersing and igniting the pufferfish on him.
Lin Yu didn't take further action—he didn't need to.
As Li Nian had said, these things were everywhere.
The ignited pufferfish clumsily collided with each other in the air, quickly setting more of their companions ablaze.
To the "fear flames," these creatures were far too flammable, as if there truly was some kind of restraint relationship between them.
Like a chain reaction, one pale flame after another lit up, and the air was instantly filled with large and small pale fireballs!
"Be careful not to touch them for too long—these things can ignite physical objects too."
Lin Yu reminded them, then calmly returned to his seat.
The still-shaken Chen Zhuo slowly sat down too, then looked at Lin Yu with eyes full of admiration.
"As expected of the Game Mast—"
Lin Yu immediately cut him off, speaking in a low voice: "Ahem, didn't your introducer tell you it's best to keep his identity confidential?"
Chen Zhuo paused for a moment, then understood.
The chubby boy's mind quickly became active. Although usually somewhat slow, Chen Zhuo was after all a high school student—his brain was in its most active period—and he soon grasped the subtleties!
It seemed that although this "A Nian" was introduced by "Zhu Ming," "Zhu Ming" seemed to have a closer relationship with the "Game Master" and didn't want this Master Thief of the 『Free Alliance』 to know about the Game Master's existence.
So Chen Zhuo immediately changed his tune.
"This white flame is truly amazing! You can just casually pull out something so effective against this dungeon... looks like you're very familiar with this dungeon too!"
Hearing Chen Zhuo's flattery, Lin Yu shook his head.
"No, I just got lucky."
"I also want to know what exactly this train's story is!"
After saying this, he turned his gaze back to Li Nian.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: The Fate of the Train of Despair
chapters.content:
After Lin Yu used the [Fear Torch] to ignite all the monsters in this space, Li Nian realized her intervention was no longer necessary.
And...
Since this wave of monsters was eliminated far faster than expected, no other immediate dangers would appear for a while.
Now she couldn't use the excuse of "bad timing" or "urgent situation" to avoid explaining things anymore.
So Li Nian walked over and sat down beside Lin Yu, crossing her hands behind her head.
"I thought you used that torch because you recognized this train's origins."
Hearing Li Nian's words, Lin Yu pondered thoughtfully.
But to maintain Zhu Ming's persona and ensure the figure's origin story held up, Lin Yu offered an explanation.
"This isn't actually my figure;
it's more like a friend gave it to me at a heavily discounted price... Actually, you just met him recently."
"Thanks for giving me face by sparing him—now he owes me a favor."As Lin Yu spoke softly, Li Nian immediately thought of that "May May" she'd met a few days ago.
Then Li Nian looked impressed.
"Oh wow, that guy... He's quite generous, isn't he?"
The girl pulled down her sunglasses to look at Lin Yu, her eyes sparkling with intense gossip curiosity.
"So... what's the relationship between you two?"
Li Nian asked excitedly.
Lin Yu froze for a moment.
He had indeed been working hard to create the impression that the identities of "Zhu Ming," "May," and "Old Yao" were all interconnected, but...
He never expected that in Li Nian's eyes, the connection between Zhu Ming and May seemed suspiciously intimate!
This made even the usually unflappable Lin Yu feel somewhat awkward now.
So I'm having an affair with myself, is that it?
Even if people genuinely misunderstood him having some improper relationship with a girl, Lin Yu would typically just smile faintly and brush it off calmly.
Back in high school, because of his striking looks and outstanding performance in a school play, he'd been pursued by another attractive girl from a well-off family.
Both were exceptionally good-looking—him being the top student, her the young mistress—naturally sparking plenty of discussion at school.
Rumors inevitably spread that the two were already together.
But Lin Yu never felt the need to clarify—what did other people's opinions matter to him?
Besides, the girl didn't seem to care either.
Only today did Lin Yu realize...
His previous calmness was only because those rumors hadn't been too outrageous.
Now facing this kind of "misunderstanding" like "Zhu Ming and May are having an affair," Lin Yu actually felt somewhat uncomfortable.
But currently playing the role of "Zhu Ming," Lin Yu couldn't really explain anything.
He could only say somewhat helplessly.
"That's none of your business, is it?"
Hearing "Zhu Ming's" response only made Li Nian more convinced there was some secret relationship between them.
"How could it be none of my business? If you want to join the 『Free Alliance』, you can't hide things like this from us!"
"This is part of the organization's assessment process... While 『Order』 requires background checks, our 『Free Alliance』 has similar requirements."
Li Nian said with complete seriousness, but Lin Yu immediately called her bluff.
"No, you just made that up right now, didn't you?"
"The 『Free Alliance』 definitely doesn't have such joining rules... Anyone could tell just from your organization's name."
Caught in her lie, Li Nian couldn't help but click her tongue in frustration.
"Tch, what a shame, I was so close to pulling it off."
"I think you were actually quite far from succeeding... I could tell it was made up too."
Chen Zhuo couldn't help speaking up from the side.
"Don't interrupt," Li Nian glared fiercely at her employer, threatening him, "or I'll sneak into your house tonight and replace all your wife figures' heads with Kenshiro! And I'll copy your browsing history and post it in your class group chat!"
Chen Zhuo immediately fell silent.
Watching Li Nian—frustrated at missing out on gossip—taking her anger out on someone weaker, Lin Yu sighed: "We don't have that much time to waste. Let's get back to the main topic."
"A Nian, what's the deal with this train exactly?"
Asked again about the main subject, Li Nian glanced at the nearly consumed monsters in the carriage and quickly began explaining without further digression.
"I've never been on this 'Despair Train' before, but someone in our organization was fortunate enough to enter here once... This is a special express functional train belonging to 'Truth Corporation'."
"Truth Corporation?"
Chen Zhuo's face showed confusion.
"It's a company famous for 'alchemy,' with core technology centered around converting souls and the emotions they generate into physical substances and energy."
Lin Yu explained to Chen Zhuo based on his previous experiences in 【Frostpeak Mountains】.
His manner of answering made it seem like he was quite familiar with the company, just casually sharing information.
But Lin Yu knew perfectly well...
This was pretty much everything he knew about Truth Corporation.
However, just as Lin Yu expected, Li Nian supplemented his explanation.
"Exactly, Truth Corporation is one of the top-tier forces currently known across the Ten Realms, worshiped and protected by the 'God of Wisdom' and 'God of Miracles.' You can find their influence in most dungeon instances within the 'Secret Realms'," Li Nian added, then turned to Chen Zhuo and extended her hand, "Hey, fatty, pay me 200 points—that was all classified information from within the 『Free Alliance』. Since you're not a member, you owe me."
Then she looked at Lin Yu: "I'll consider this an advance for you too. No charge, but you owe me a favor now, Sister Zhu Ming."
Lin Yu said helplessly: "I never said I wanted to hear it... And how do you know I wasn't already aware of this?"
"Anyway, just remember you owe me one," A Nian turned back to Chen Zhuo, beckoning with her finger, "Hurry up, give it to me."
Chen Zhuo looked bewildered: "How am I supposed to give it to you right now..."
"Good point, then I'll just help myself!"
As she spoke, Li Nian turned her hand over, and a hexagonal gray metal block appeared out of nowhere in her palm.
"Oh, Hive Energy Shield—worth about 140 points... Consider us even."
Chen Zhuo's expression changed as he touched his chest: "When did you take that? How could you even take that?"
Seeing Chen Zhuo's panicked look, Li Nian laughed: "Just kidding, here you go."
She tossed the metal block back to Chen Zhuo.
Even though it was his own item, Chen Zhuo still instinctively said "thank you" when he caught it.
This made Li Nian pause for a moment, her expression suddenly becoming somewhat awkward.
"Why thank me? It was yours to begin with."
"So boring!"
After saying this, Li Nian pouted and stood up.
By now, the last invisible pufferfish had been completely burned away.
"Alright, get ready for the 'next wave of assessment'."

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Li Nian's Trump Card and the Robot Assassins
chapters.content:
"Next wave of trials? You mean this carriage will continuously produce various types of monsters?"
Hearing Li Nian's words, Lin Yu became rather excited.
"Not exactly endless—according to Old Zhou, it's probably three to five rounds," Li Nian said cheerfully, "Then you can proceed to other carriages."
"And the 'train ticket' mentioned in our clearance conditions also needs to be obtained from relatively powerful monsters after leaving this carriage."
After listening to Li Nian's description, Chen Zhuo couldn't help but complain: "This Truth Corporation is really insane—why would they design such a train?"
"Is this even transportation anymore?"
Li Nian shook her head: "That I don't know. Who understands what these people intended with their designs."
"Most folks at Truth Corporation are arrogant bastards who view people as expendable materials and fancy themselves as gods walking among mortals."
As she offered this critique, the door at the far end opened once more.
This time, what appeared weren't invisible entities, but a group of robots with fully visible forms.Like the T-1000 from the Terminator movies, their shells were completely silver-white without visible seams, with red lights flashing on their heads.
"Vrrrm—"
Seven human-sized robots charged into the carriage, each holding weapons that looked equally high-tech.
Lin Yu was about to stand up to assist Li Nian, but she spoke up first.
"Hey, this time I'll handle it myself—you just focus on protecting our employer."
"I let you steal the spotlight last round. If I slack off again, this fatty might think I'm not worth the price."
Hearing Li Nian's confident words, Lin Yu didn't intend to spoil her fun.
"If you say so, don't push yourself too hard."
He was perfectly happy to conserve his energy and not intervene.
Li Nian laughed in response: "There's no pushing involved! Just like how last round's creatures happened to be countered by you, I happen to have exactly the right means to deal with this round's opponents!"
With that, Li Nian put away her utility knife and pulled out from her chest...
A pair of gloves with material as light as gauze and color as smooth white as jade.
Lin Yu watched with great interest, curious about the source of Li Nian's confidence.
After all, based on previous performances, this 'Master Thief' didn't seem specialized in frontal combat.
During observations in Jiangcheng, in the chaotic clashes between several organizations, Li Nian didn't seem to have any combat records—she even actively hid herself.
Of course, in that feast of monstrous players where even Third-Tier beings were considered exceptionally powerful, it seemed reasonable for Li Nian, who had just advanced to Second-Tier, to avoid combat.
But from a results perspective, after the Jiangcheng incident concluded, while Lin Yu had gained some understanding of most players involved or dragged into the events, he knew very little about this 'Master Thief' A Nian.
So in this dungeon, with Li Nian as a "invited expert" who took payment to guide people through dungeons...
Lin Yu felt this was an excellent opportunity to assess her combat capabilities and understand her abilities.
The humanoid robot at the forefront had already closed in, using a seat as cover while positioning its gun barrel to aim at Li Nian.
The other robots also took their positions.
"Whoosh!"
The moment their guns were positioned, all seven robots simultaneously pulled their triggers, their high-tech rifles emitting dazzling white beams.
However, these seven interweaving and swift white beams—seemingly unavoidable attacks—did not hit Li Nian. Where she had been standing moments before, her figure had vanished.
Li Nian, now wearing the white gloves, appeared behind the first robot.
"My turn now!"
Li Nian's cheerful voice echoed through the carriage as the first robot instantly lost all mobility.
Like it had been forcibly shut down, its body remained in the gun-holding posture while its head, which had been flashing red light, drooped low with the light instantly extinguishing.
"First one!"
As Li Nian spoke, she leaned backward, dropping behind the seats.
The remaining robots didn't hesitate because of their companion's fall—they instantly adjusted their aim and completed a second volley.
"Crash!"
The seat that had served as cover shattered into pieces, demonstrating what would happen if those beams hit a person.
However, behind the shattered seat, there was no sign of Li Nian—only the first robot remained there.
"Over here!"
Li Nian's voice sounded again as she popped up from beside another robot's seat like a groundhog.
Then, Li Nian's gloves lightly brushed over the robot's surface, and it immediately "shut down and froze" just like the first robot!
"Second one!"
Li Nian pulled her head back.
Another volley fired, but this time...
Still missed!
And this time, she mysteriously appeared on the luggage rack above a robot's head.
Li Nian leaned backward with excellent flexibility, her gloved fingertips lightly touching the robot's head, and then...
The third robot also stopped moving!
Simultaneously, after the luggage rack was shattered by another volley of beams, Li Nian's figure vanished once more.
"Truly perfect countering tactics."
Lin Yu remarked with admiration.
Moreover, Li Nian was indeed proving herself "worth the price."
Such bizarre, elusive movements, such effortless and easy disposal of the robots...
This was practically showing off.
At the very least, Lin Yu asked himself honestly—while Li Nian might indeed be weaker than the monsters who acted in Jiangcheng...
This newcomer who joined the 'Free Alliance' was definitely not ordinary either.
Thinking about it, the name 'Master Thief' was practically infamous throughout the entire player community, because Li Nian delighted in mischief and stealing others' tools without returning them—so most players spoke of her like mentioning an annoying mosquito.
But despite offending so many people—including some more experienced and even quite powerful players—
This "mosquito" still hadn't been swatted, which showed she must have her own exceptional qualities.
Now, even though half the robots were still putting up stubborn resistance on the field, Lin Yu could already conclude.
Li Nian could absolutely handle all of them.
Because what followed would simply be repeated performances of the same scene.
Just as Lin Yu predicted, all seven robots entered the "shutdown" state.
Chen Zhuo sat there dumbfounded—purely in terms of visual spectacle, Li Nian's performance was truly magnificent.
"That was absolutely incredible! Zipping around and taking them out—is this the Flying Thunder God technique?!"
The voice that answered them came from beneath their feet.
"The principle is actually quite similar... but this is my trump card, so I won't reveal it easily."
Li Nian crawled out from under the seats, then tossed a handful of crimson beads onto the table.
"Anyway, robots, puppets... these things are basically free kills for me, no matter how many come!"

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Elite Monsters and Cooperation
chapters.content:
"Are you particularly effective against robots?" Lin Yu asked curiously as he watched Li Nian toss out those beads.
"I'm like this against things without intelligence or life," Li Nian said casually. "Of course, they also need to have a 'core'."
"Truth Corporation's 'Hatred Sentinels' happen to meet this criteria—driven by 'hatred' emotion as their core and fuel. They're indeed quite troublesome for ordinary people."
"But for me, I just need to extract the 'core,' and they naturally lose their mobility."
As she spoke, Li Nian picked up the red bead the size of a glass marble and showed it to Lin Yu and Chen Zhuo.
"This thing here, [Vengeance Crystal]... it's very precious material. Anyway, this is my spoils of war, so it belongs to me now."
Li Nian said with a cheerful laugh.
Lin Yu finally understood. "So you stopped me from acting earlier because you were afraid I'd take your loot?"
Li Nian shook her head. "Wrong, I was afraid you'd break it... Do you even have that capability as a 『First-Tier』?"
Lin Yu stroked his chin. "It seems 『Second-Tier』 privileges probably allow taking certain things out of dungeons..."Li Nian paused, then said, "Were you fishing for information?"
"Yes, otherwise you'd probably charge me 200 points for 『Second-Tier』 privileges intel," Lin Yu said frankly. "I'm really short on money, A Nian, so I save where I can."
Li Nian looked somewhat speechless. "Alright, but the fact that you even know about 'privileges' means you're not far from unlocking 『First-Tier』 privileges, though you probably haven't unlocked them yet."
"Pretty impressive actually. Some people are almost 『Second-Tier』 and still haven't managed to unlock their 『First-Tier』 privileges."
"So, would you like to avoid detours and listen to..."
Lin Yu interrupted Li Nian. "No thanks."
Li Nian looked somewhat disappointed but also somewhat pleased. "Alright then, I hope you work hard and progress quickly."
Chen Zhuo, who had been standing to the side, scratched his head. "Huh? What privileges? What's that?"
Li Nian thought for a moment, then pulled out a small metal top from her pocket and handed it to Chen Zhuo.
"Here you go."
Chen Zhuo took the top, looking completely confused.
"What? Is this the privilege?"
Lin Yu also showed a curious expression, seemingly wanting to know what relationship this "top" had with "privileges."
But Li Nian's next response took him by surprise.
"Nothing special, just giving you a little toy. Go play with it over there."
Chen Zhuo stared blankly at the top in his hand and softly said, "Oh."
Lin Yu felt helpless. "Why are you treating him like a child?"
Li Nian pouted. "Hasn't even achieved promotion, asking about privileges... Okay okay, here comes the next 'thing'."
As she spoke, the carriage door opened once again.
Then...
This time, what appeared was a tall, thin man wearing a gray uniform with a hood, his chest emblazoned with bright red "F-6" lettering, holding a pitch-black short rod.
Seeing the three of them, the man raised the short rod high.
"Come then, new 'exiles,' fall into eternal despair!"
The man shouted these incomprehensible words with an excited, fervent tone.
He pressed some button on the side of the short rod.
The rod emitted crackling blue-white electric arcs.
A tall, thin man holding an electric baton seemed much weaker and less threatening compared to those transparent invisible pufferfish or the gun-wielding robots.
But the moment he appeared, Lin Yu sensed an extremely dangerous aura.
Beside him, Li Nian's expression also became much more serious and solemn.
"An elite monster has appeared. Looks like we encountered three waves..."
As she spoke, she pulled out her utility knife again.
"Hey... fatty, get to the back of the carriage, now, immediately, right away."
Chen Zhuo could tell Li Nian wasn't joking at all, so he immediately jumped up from his seat, scrambled and crawled to the back corner of the carriage, curled up, and activated the [Hive Energy Shield] hanging on his chest that Li Nian had just stolen from him.
A pale yellow transparent hexagon shielded in front of him.
Watching Chen Zhuo's actions, Lin Yu couldn't help but feel some emotion.
Indeed, the Death Game really accelerates people's growth. Even someone as useless as Chen Zhuo, even surviving dungeons by hiring others—after experiencing four dungeons, he's still matured quite a bit.
At the very least...
Chen Zhuo's escape skills are now first-rate.
However, now wasn't the time to focus on Chen Zhuo's growth.
Because there was a very dangerous formidable enemy before them.
Lin Yu slowly exhaled, standing staggered front and back with Li Nian, extracting all three remaining [Immortal Brews] from the [Bliss Immortal Pot], transforming them back into buffs attached to his body.
The three current buffs in the pot were [Dance Mastery] that provided body coordination and agility, [Blacksmithing] that provided blunt weapon damage and strength enhancement, and the freshly obtained [Miserly Wealthy One].
[Dance Mastery] and [Blacksmithing] both had about an hour remaining, while [Miserly Wealthy One] still had almost a full day left.
After activating them, Lin Yu looked at Li Nian.
"This revolver in my hand only has six bullets, each with different random effects..."
As Lin Yu spoke, Li Nian raised an eyebrow.
"The [Mithril Standard Revolver] from the 'Demon Hunters Guild'? No wonder it looked familiar!"
Lin Yu also showed a surprised expression. "You really know your stuff..."
"Of course, the best master thieves are also the best appraisers," Li Nian said proudly. "With this thing, I'll provide cover for you then."
As Li Nian spoke, Lin Yu nodded slightly.
Simultaneously, feeling the "belief" emanating from Li Nian, Lin Yu also sensed the [Counterfeit]-transformed [Mithril Standard Revolver] in his hand become the genuine article!
When he had drawn his gun earlier, he naturally hadn't pulled out the [One-Shot One-Kill Revolver].
Because that thing... Li Nian had seen it before.
And Lin Yu had used it in his "Lin Yu" identity.
It would be hard to explain why it ended up in Zhu Ming's hands.
So the "gun" Lin Yu initially pulled out was transformed by the [Counterfeit].
And choosing the [Mithril Standard Revolver] was also something Lin Yu had prepared in advance.
Since gaining access to internal information from various organizations, Lin Yu had researched extensive materials on various items to better utilize the [Counterfeit].
He selected about ten versatile, widely applicable, reasonably powerful mass-produced [common items], memorizing their appearances and usage methods.
And the [Mithril Standard Revolver] was one of them.
This handgun happened to be the type suitable for various combat situations.
Just as Lin Yu had described earlier...
It wasn't just a six-shot revolver—each bullet had different magical effects!
During the gap in Li Nian and Lin Yu's conversation, the man holding the electric baton seemed to think this was a good opportunity to launch an attack.
He suddenly roared forward, lunging toward Li Nian's direction!

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Teamwork and Good Luck
chapters.content:
At the moment the tall thin man lunged toward Li Nian...
Li Nian's figure vanished once again.
Only this time, Li Nian didn't appear in some strange location, but rather seemed to swap positions with her opponent, reappearing right behind the tall thin man.
Simultaneously, a certain item appeared in Li Nian's hand—it looked like some kind of card.
"Zhu Ming, it's your turn now!"
Li Nian called out clearly before swiftly darting toward the other end of the carriage.
The tall thin man seemed to realize he'd lost something, patting his pockets with a confused expression.
Then he spoke in anger.
"Hey... thief, give that back!"
Hearing his furious roar, Li Nian—while still fleeing—even found time to turn around and make a face."Not giving it back, nah nah nah!"
The cheeky expression on Li Nian's face only further enraged the gray-uniformed man.
"You stop right there!"
The carriage space wasn't large, and the door at the end was closed.
Although this man wasn't as fast as Li Nian, in such a confined space, catching up to her was only a matter of time.
However, that was assuming no interference.
The tall thin man hadn't gotten far when Lin Yu's voice rang out behind him.
"Hey—idiot, stop right there."
"Exposing your back to me like this—you're really looking down on me!"
As he spoke, Lin Yu pulled the trigger.
"Ah!"
Pale white flames erupted from the barrel, and the sound of gunfire resembled not so much an explosion as the sacred chorus of a choir's solemn hymn!
"—This is [Cleansing]."
A sorrowful yet compassionate, solemn and majestic female voice emanated from the gun barrel, like judgment, like proclamation.
Even though the tall thin man had his back to Lin Yu, his body now twisted unnaturally into a C-shape, as if someone had kicked him from the side.
It was as if he could see the bullet coming straight for his back!
This tall thin man actually possessed some ability to dodge bullets!
But...
Even though the bullet grazed past his side, it still didn't miss.
Because the bullet named "Dogma" exploded beside his body, transforming into countless incandescent white threads that surged toward him!
In an instant, these threads wrapped around him and tightened, sending him crashing to the ground!
This was the ability of one of the six random bullets—[Dogma]!
Even without directly hitting the target, merely passing near the target would release energy-constructed threads to bind them.
Of course, this only worked on beings with souls and life.
And obviously... this mysterious tall thin man in gray uniform was a living creature that could trigger the ability.
"Well done, Zhu Ming!"
Still running, Li Nian grabbed a nearby chair to brake sharply before making a 180-degree turn!
Seeing the man restrained and seemingly unable to move, Li Nian naturally wouldn't pass up the chance to kick him while he was down!
After her rapid turn, she pulled out her utility knife from her clothing, ready to deliver a vicious strike to the man.
But before Li Nian could act, the man on the ground actually did a kip-up and stood up.
"You two bastards, why won't you offer up your despair!"
The man growled, the white threads on his body snapping one by one!
Crimson light emanated from his body, making him appear both more dangerous and more deranged.
Li Nian, who stood right before the man, paled dramatically, wanting to dodge but already too late.
"Help—!"
With Li Nian's scream, she was seized firmly by both arms by hands like iron vices.
Seeing this from a distance, Lin Yu raised his gun barrel.
"Hold on... and pray that we don't get [Mercy] or [Blasphemy] next."
What Lin Yu referred to were naturally two of the six bullet types in this [Mithril Standard Pistol].
The effect of [Mercy] was to put all targets in the impact area to sleep.
That one wasn't too bad—it would just make Li Nian fall unconscious too.
But the effect of [Blasphemy]...
Was "annihilation."
It would destroy everything within the impact area.
With five bullets remaining in the gun, the probability of getting either of these bullets was one in five!
Li Nian seemed well aware of what bullets this pistol contained and quickly calculated the probability of each bullet type appearing.
So, hearing Lin Yu's words, Li Nian—already tightly constricted by the tall thin man as if about to be crushed at any moment—quickly spoke up.
"No no no no—don't shoot! I can save myself!"
As he spoke, Lin Yu looked at Li Nian, whose hands were completely immobilized, feeling somewhat curious.
"How are you going to save yourself? Don't push yourself!"
Li Nian didn't answer, as the emergency situation didn't allow her the luxury of responding to Lin Yu's question.
She opened her mouth, her tongue rolling out a gleaming "blade."
Li Nian spat this blade at the tall thin man right in front of her, the cold-gleaming edge aimed directly at the man's hooded face.
The tall thin man tilted his head slightly, once again unnaturally avoiding the blade, which shot backward and embedded itself in a seat within the carriage.
The tall thin man watched the blade warily, but finding nothing unusual, turned his attention back and increased the crushing pressure on Li Nian.
"Pointless struggle!"
He declared coldly.
But the Li Nian in his arms lowered her head, glaring viciously at the tall thin man through the gap between her sunglasses and bangs.
"I was saving this move for later... you really deserve to die."
Li Nian said, then exhaled.
The tall thin man was about to say something else when he suddenly felt weak and limp.
He instinctively released Li Nian, collapsing sideways into a nearby seat before slowly sliding to the ground, saying in terror.
"What did you do?"
Stumbling as she landed, Li Nian barely managed to steady herself, gritting her teeth as she pulled out a roll of bandages from her clothing and symbolically wrapped them around her arms.
The bandages vanished the moment they were applied, but Li Nian's arms—which had looked nearly broken—returned to normal.
She pulled out a hemp rope from her clothing, holding it while looking down at the man, calling to Lin Yu.
"Hey, Zhu Ming—quick, help me tie this guy up!"
"His immobility time is limited."
Hearing this, Lin Yu waved his hand, signaling Li Nian to step back.
"Take your rope and stand further away."
Then he pulled the trigger again, pale gun flames and aria-like gunshots ringing out once more.
"—This is [Mercy]!"
The bullet struck, causing no substantial damage to the man on the ground, only making him fall into a deep sleep.
"Now we have more time... he'll probably sleep for over an hour."
Lin Yu said calmly.
Then he looked at Li Nian.
"How did you take him down with that blade earlier? You didn't even injure him."
Li Nian shook her head.
"The blade was just a decoy to distract him—to make him overlook me throwing a potion bottle and inhaling the 'Paralysis Potion'."
As she spoke, Li Nian kicked a small empty bottle at her feet.
Then Li Nian also asked.
"How were you so sure the next shot would be [Mercy]?"
"I wasn't sure," Lin Yu shook his head, looking at the gun in his hand, "he just got lucky."

chapters.title: Chapter 232: A Useful Pawn and the Creepy Eyeball
chapters.content:
For Lin Yu, it actually didn't matter which of the remaining five bullet types he randomly got.
Aside from [Dogma] and [Mercy], aiming the other four bullet types at vital spots would definitely kill people.
After Lin Yu fired his gun, there would only be two outcomes—an eighty percent chance of instant death, and a twenty percent chance of falling into deep sleep.
That's why Lin Yu said the one-fifth probability of [Mercy] appearing meant the other guy had good luck.
Because [Mercy] was truly "merciful."
"Lucky for him too—this guy should be quite useful later. Keeping him alive has its benefits."
Li Nian picked up the hemp rope and meticulously tied up the man on the ground, speaking to Lin Yu.
Lin Yu raised his eyebrows in surprise.
"What use could he possibly have?"
Li Nian flipped her hand to reveal the card she had stolen from the man earlier, speaking with a cheerful grin."Ta-da!"
She read the text on it aloud.
"Truth Corporation Employee Identification Credentials, Name: Punkdo Von Valetti;
Gender: Male;
Position: Security Department Protection Division Field Team δ Group Leader;
Privileges: C-2... This guy has pretty high clearance. While he's not exactly a big shot within Truth Corporation, he's at least a mid-level manager."
Li Nian said this with a playful smile, while Lin Yu looked surprised.
"This guy is actually an internal Truth Corporation member, and even a minor leader."
Li Nian nodded: "Exactly. Although I have some knowledge about this 'Despair Train,' it's just secondhand rumors and surface-level information. If we can extract useful intel from him later, it might greatly benefit our safe clearance."
"After all, he's not just an internal Truth Corporation member—he also seems to have been on this Despair Train for quite a while. Look how worn his uniform is."
But hearing Li Nian's plan, Lin Yu raised a new question.
"Judging by his condition and statements during our earlier confrontation, I don't think he's in a clear, rational state."
"If he's simply gone mad, that's one thing. But if that's just his normal personality, communication will be even more difficult."
Li Nian rubbed her chin.
"That is indeed a tricky problem, but after he wakes up, let me give it a try. I believe there's still a chance we can get him to cooperate."
"Alright, we've cleared the final checkpoint. We should proceed to the next carriage."
As she spoke, Li Nian waved toward Chen Zhuo at the end of the carriage.
"Hey—fatty, come do some work!"
Chen Zhuo had already been secretly watching that the battle seemed to be over, but out of caution, the chubby guy kept his shield up while huddled in the corner until Li Nian and Lin Yu personally confirmed it was safe.
Only when Li Nian called him did he fully confirm the situation was secure, so he put away his shield and happily scampered over.
"You actually solved it! As expected of two great experts from the 『Free Alliance』—coming from a major organization really makes a difference!"
"Even someone who doesn't look simple at all was easily subdued by you—and captured alive at that!"
Looking at the gray-uniformed man sleeping soundly on the ground, Chen Zhuo quickly offered flattering words.
Lin Yu remained relatively calm, but Li Nian couldn't help putting her hands on her hips and chuckling proudly when praised by Chen Zhuo.
"Quite perceptive there, fatty. But my strength within the 『Free Alliance』 is only mid-to-lower tier at best..."
Lin Yu looked at Li Nian, tilting his head curiously: "Mid-to-lower? Are you sure you're not actually bottom tier?"
While acting as "Zhu Ming," the woman's appearance transformed by [False Face] had soft, gentle features and a warm voice, but it was precisely this kind of face and tone that made her words particularly cutting.
Li Nian was instantly provoked to near madness by Lin Yu's single remark.
"Ahhh—don't expose me like that!"
She cried out dramatically, then glared angrily at Chen Zhuo.
"You're responsible for carrying him!"
Li Nian pointed toward the already open carriage door.
"We need to go to the next carriage."
Beyond the door, the connecting area between carriages was pitch black, completely invisible.
Chen Zhuo looked at the profound darkness and couldn't help feeling afraid.
However, with Lin Yu and Li Nian providing protection, and the strength they'd just demonstrated surpassing all the cheap hires from his previous two employments...
This might not even be their full capability!
So Chen Zhuo quickly overcame his fear.
And what he needed to overcome next...
Was his own laziness.
Looking at the tall, thin man on the ground, Chen Zhuo took the two rope ends Li Nian had deliberately left for him and tried dragging him.
Although the man was tall and thin, the combat-designed uniform and various equipment added up to considerable weight.
Chen Zhuo was an out-of-shape otaku who barely ran during PE classes—just trying to drag the man twice already left him breathing heavily from exhaustion.
"This... do I really have to drag him?"
As the employer, Chen Zhuo prepared to exercise his rights with these two frightening individuals for the first time.
But before Chen Zhuo could protest this arrangement, Li Nian shut him down with one sentence.
"Otherwise? If Zhu Ming and I carry this guy, our combat effectiveness will be reduced. Should you handle any ambushes yourself then?"
As Li Nian spoke, Chen Zhuo immediately fell silent.
Lin Yu, using Zhu Ming's gentle big sister persona, smiled and approached Chen Zhuo. Lifting the sleeping tall man from the ground, he said: "Carry him on your back. I'll help tie him to you... This will be more convenient, and if anything attacks from behind, he might even block it for you."
Lin Yu's tone was gentle.
For an otaku like Chen Zhuo, the current "Zhu Ming" was absolutely impossible to refuse.
He could only nod numbly, watching as Lin Yu tied the rope around him, securing the tall man to his back.
Then Lin Yu patted his shoulder.
"Think of it as exercise. If your physical fitness doesn't improve, things will get harder later."
This scene reminded Chen Zhuo of when he first entered elementary school as a child, and his grandmother helped him carry his backpack.
So Chen Zhuo's gaze became determined.
"Understood! I'll complete the mission!"
Lin Yu nodded with satisfaction.
Then Chen Zhuo walked with firm steps, following the two to the carriage door.
Li Nian took out a portable flashlight and turned it on, illuminating the carriage connection area.
And within the illuminated darkness, both walls were filled with transparent jars packed with eyeballs.
These transparent jars were filled with unknown liquid, with pipes connected to their openings, neatly arranged throughout the carriage connection area.
The eyeballs of various sizes and colors floating in the liquid... actually seemed to possess their own consciousness, rotating and looking around.
And sensing the light from Li Nian's flashlight, these eyeballs all simultaneously turned to look at the three people entering the carriage connection area!

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Higher-Level Access
chapters.content:
Being stared at by those eyeballs of various sizes in jars, Chen Zhuo couldn't help but swallow nervously.
Even though he had already experienced four dungeons and could be considered someone who had seen quite a lot, Chen Zhuo was still quite frightened and felt utterly creeped out.
If the two girls beside him hadn't both appeared extremely calm, Chen Zhuo would probably have screamed out loud already.
A person's courage changes according to the atmosphere around them.
So, although this bizarre scene was extremely terrifying, it still didn't scare Chen Zhuo out of his wits.
He mustered his courage and asked in a trembling voice.
"What are all these things..."
"I don't know either, but let's just research them."
Li Nian had already removed those white jade-like gloves, and she gently tapped on the jar with her finger.
Then, an eyeball miraculously disappeared from the jar and appeared between Li Nian's fingers.This eyeball seemed somewhat panicked after leaving the jar, rotating rapidly.
But being pinched by Li Nian's fingers, it couldn't move much either.
Li Nian watched this "struggling" scene with great interest.
"Looks really fascinating. This thing seems like some kind of 'surveillance device'."
"Truth Corporation really is an extremely sinister company."
As she spoke, Li Nian "stuffed" the eyeball back into the jar.
This operation flowed smoothly without the slightest hesitation.
Chen Zhuo looked at Li Nian with eyes full of admiration, as if he were seeing a brave warrior catching cockroaches barehanded.
Lin Yu remained quite calm.
"Surveillance devices? They're not exactly discreet."
"How did you reach that conclusion?"
Li Nian casually replied: "I guessed... well, that's not the main point. The main point is the door to the next carriage."
She shone her flashlight on the door before the three of them.
The sealed carriage door had excellent airtightness without the slightest gap, looking like it could serve as an outer hatch for a submarine or spacecraft without any issues.
The black one-way glass reflected the three blurry silhouettes like a mirror, making it impossible to see inside the next carriage.
Beside the door was a touch terminal for password input, with what appeared to be a card reading area below the terminal.
However...
The password input keyboard wasn't the traditional nine-key layout, but rather a 4×4 sixteen-key keyboard.
The sixteen keys were printed with different emoticons expressing various emotions like happiness, anger, sorrow, and joy.
Li Nian picked up the identity card they had confiscated from the tall thin man and swiped it.
"Beep—"
The terminal flashed green, seemingly indicating approval.
But the door didn't open.
"Respected C-2 level employee, Punkdo Von Valetti, your access request has been submitted. To enter the forward area, please input the current four-digit dynamic password."
A gentle electronic prompt sounded.
"Oh, looks like we've reached the puzzle-solving part. I thought this dungeon was pure slaughter," Li Nian said with some regret. "Choosing any four from sixteen numbers... if we have to try them one by one, how many attempts would that take..."
"If these symbols can't be selected repeatedly, it's over forty thousand combinations. If repetition is allowed... probably close to seventy thousand possibilities."
Lin Yu quickly did mental calculations and reached a conclusion.
Of course, he had actually calculated the exact possibilities—43,680 combinations without repetition, requiring factorial calculation.
With repetition, it would be 16 to the fourth power—65,536 combinations.
In any case, neither should be something you can randomly guess correctly...
Even with luck-based buffs, it would be difficult to guess correctly directly.
Chen Zhuo looked at the password and thoughtfully said: "I've seen in spy movies that you can use tape to test for fingerprints to determine frequently used buttons..."
"The prompt said this is a dynamic password," Lin Yu reminded him. "Although we don't know how long one cycle is, this method probably won't work."
Li Nian looked around: "Could there be some hint? Let's search his body first to see if he has any receivers or similar devices... if not, we'll wake him up and interrogate him."
Li Nian proposed a relatively practical plan.
But Lin Yu still felt this wouldn't be very efficient.
Meanwhile, Li Nian had already started acting, beginning to search the tall thin man's body.
"Times like these really make me miss those puzzle-solving experts in the organization... Unfortunately, teaming up with them would be completely detrimental to this little fatty who hasn't undergone promotion..."
Li Nian said with emotion.
After all, if a Third Tier player teamed up with Chen Zhuo who hadn't undergone promotion—or even experienced a promotion dungeon—the dungeon difficulty would absolutely be hell-level for Chen Zhuo.
Even a passing dog could probably bite him to death in two mouthfuls.
Chen Zhuo also sighed: "It is a bit unfortunate. I also know a very smart guy who's great at solving puzzles, but he seems to have many restrictions and can't team up with me."
Li Nian nodded: "People skilled at puzzle-solving are truly rare... I previously met a very interesting newcomer who was excellent at solving puzzles. Others were also very interested in him and even sent me to evaluate him. Unfortunately, he didn't seem interested in joining us... and I haven't been able to contact him much recently."
Lin Yu listened from the side, subtly sweating.
He had a feeling...
The two people Chen Zhuo and Li Nian were talking about might actually be the same person.
Originally planning to lie low using the "Zhu Ming" identity, Lin Yu now decided to quickly get this door open.
Of course, it would be best to consider the personas of "Zhu Ming" and "Xia Yue" and choose a method that wasn't too abrupt...
As Lin Yu pondered, inspiration suddenly struck him, and he thought of a certain approach.
Although it might not work...
It was worth a try!
"I actually have a method I want to try. That guy who traded me the [Fear Torch] also gave me an extra gift."
Saying this, Lin Yu took out from his chest...
The identity card belonging to "Vale Valetti."
Lin Yu swiped this identity card again in the card reading area below.
"Beep—"
"Respected B-3 level Independent Researcher, Vale Valetti, welcome to the forward area."
Two green lights lit up, and the password door before them opened directly.
"Indeed, this card's privileges don't require a password."
Lin Yu breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, although Vale Valetti had a naive personality, within Truth Corporation he was absolutely someone with boundless prospects and significant privileges.
The reason this field team leader's C-2 level required a password was because his privileges needed to "request access" to enter.
Vale Valetti with higher privileges likely didn't need to apply!
Of course, the luckiest thing was still...
"Vale Valetti" as an independent researcher who had perished in the snowy mountains years ago—his identity card privileges actually hadn't been deactivated yet.
Did Truth Corporation think he wasn't dead? Or was it normal for an outsourced independent researcher to not return to the company for ten years without any news?
Lin Yu had no way of knowing.
Simultaneously, he noticed another detail—he hadn't realized it when Li Nian picked up the tall thin man's identity card earlier, but after hearing the announcement again, Lin Yu noticed.
Not just him—even Li Nian beside him, and even Chen Zhuo had noticed.
"Hey, these two people share the same surname?"
"Both are Valetti. Could there be some connection between them?"

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Food Trucks, Wine Pairings, and the Awakening of Pang Duo
chapters.content:
After the carriage door opened, Lin Yu's group also entered the next carriage.
Compared to the previous D13 carriage filled with seats that looked like an ordinary passenger car, this one labeled "D-12" appeared somewhat special.
It looked like a dining car—and a rather luxurious one at that.
The entire carriage had only three elegant booth seats, with a solid wood bar counter behind which stood what appeared to be very tasteful wine cabinets and refrigerators.
The whole carriage remained empty, without any staff members.
Lin Yu surveyed the surroundings, finding no immediate dangers for now.
"Is this rest time now? Or does this count as a 'safe zone'?"
He asked cautiously.
Li Nian said casually, "I wouldn't know... my intel isn't that detailed."
As she spoke, she propped herself up on the bar counter with one hand and gracefully flipped over it, landing steadily.Then Li Nian opened the wine cabinet and took out what looked like an extremely expensive bottle of wine.
"Wow, Kirishima Vineyard's year 370 New Calendar wine [Repentance], Truth Corporation is really generous."
She pulled out two glasses from under the bar counter and looked at Lin Yu and Chen Zhuo.
"Zhu Ming and that fat guy over there, either of you want a drink?"
Chen Zhuo, who had just placed the carried Punkdo Von Valetti on a chair and was sitting on the armrest catching his breath, froze at Li Nian's question, then shook his head.
"Huh? Wine... no thanks!"
"I don't drink."
He waved his hand in refusal, then added quietly, "Besides, drinking isn't good, we're not even adults yet."
Li Nian curled her lip: "Philistine."
"We're in a dungeon already, why pretend to be a good student? You think there's going to be a dean on this train to catch you?"
Then Li Nian looked at Lin Yu: "How about you, Zhu Ming? This is rare good stuff!"
Lin Yu also shook his head: "Pass, I know what Kirishima Vineyard's wines are like... Although it seems safe for now, I don't want both of us to end up in a combat-incapable state—even if just for a moment."
Li Nian raised an eyebrow: "You're unexpectedly cautious too."
"And... having only gone through eight dungeons, you already know about Kirishima Vineyard," Li Nian rubbed her chin, "No wonder you have high enough potential for the Psychological Society to send an S-level after you."
Lin Yu smiled modestly: "Just got lucky and happened to see it once."
Li Nian didn't say more, pouring herself a full glass of wine before drinking it.
Then, her eyes briefly lost focus.
After ten-some seconds, a clear tear streamed from the corner of Li Nian's left eye, and then her gaze cleared.
"Whew—though the vintage is so-so, the effect is still decent."
Li Nian gently wiped away her tear, muttering to herself.
Lin Yu looked at Li Nian and asked, "What did you see? It even made you cry."
"Just one tear doesn't count as crying," Li Nian said indifferently, "What I just saw was me getting arrested for stealing too much, writing a confession and penalty acknowledgment in the detention center."
"So it was prison tears."
Lin Yu teased, not believing a single word of Li Nian's explanation.
Clearly, this Master Thief lady was hiding something—but that made sense, she seemed like the type to keep things to herself.
Something like the heartache brought out by the "Kirishima Vineyard" wine would definitely not be shared with Chen Zhuo and "Zhu Ming."
She wasn't close enough with these two to open up like that.
Sure enough, after Lin Yu's teasing, Li Nian smoothly changed the subject.
"Alright, since it's relatively safe now, while we're resting let's not waste time..."
"Let's continue investigating this guy."
