Li Nian said as she walked out from behind the bar, coming before the tall thin man Chen Zhuo had placed on the chair, and grabbed his hood-style mask.
Then, Li Nian removed this mask, revealing a deeply sunken-eyed, high-cheekboned, unshaven face of a disheveled middle-aged man.
His pale golden hair was messy, looking like it hadn't been washed for a long time.
This look resembled a Hollywood blockbuster's former special forces soldier or agent who divorced his wife and took up an alcoholic life, quietly waiting for the day some fool would kidnap his daughter or plot to destroy the world, reactivating him into a hellish war god that even ghosts fear.
"Whoa, a foreigner."
Chen Zhuo exclaimed in surprise.
Hearing Chen Zhuo's remark, Li Nian couldn't help rolling her eyes: "His name is Punkdo Von Valetti, did you expect him to be a fellow townsman from our Jiangcheng?"
Meanwhile, Lin Yu looking at this face did an additional comparison that Chen Zhuo and Li Nian couldn't.
He was comparing this face with the image of Vale Valetti he had seen.
The conclusion was... putting aside body weight and just looking at bone structure, the two did have some similarities.
But these four or five points of similarity weren't enough to prove familial relations.
Besides, the Vale Valetti Lin Yu had seen was already a soul entity, which inevitably caused some distortion.
"Maybe Valetti is a common surname, like Smith..."
But if the two were really relatives... even if this guy was crazy and currently subdued, maybe they could try communicating with him through the "Vale Valetti" identity.
Thinking this, Lin Yu felt conflicted—he was considering whether to try waking this NPC.
But before Lin Yu could mentally reach a conclusion, Li Nian had already taken action.
"Since we're idle anyway, I'll wake him up."
Li Nian said casually, without waiting for Chen Zhuo and Lin Yu to voice any opinions, she took out a spray bottle from her bosom.
From Li Nian's movements, Lin Yu guessed the spray bottle was probably filled with water.
She directly aimed the bottle's showerhead at the sleeping Punkdo Von Valetti and pressed the metal lever on the handle.
"Pshh pshh!"
The showerhead sprayed some liquid, instantly startling awake Punkdo Von Valetti, who had been sleeping soundly and hadn't woken even after being tied up and carried shaking on Chen Zhuo's back all this way.
He opened his eyes wide trying to get up, but quickly found himself tightly bound and began struggling vigorously—like a flapping fish.
"What have you done? Who are you people?! Untie me now!"
Punkdo Von Valetti growled lowly, looking warily at the three people before him.
Hearing Punkdo Von Valetti's words, Lin Yu and Li Nian simultaneously realized something was off;
their eyes met, both somewhat pleasantly surprised.
Li Nian spoke first: "Hey, you're the one who attacked us, and you're questioning us instead?"
Sure enough, after being questioned like this, a confused expression appeared on Punkdo Von Valetti's face.
Just as Lin Yu and Li Nian had anticipated...
Although his tone had been fierce earlier, it wasn't "crazy" like in the previous carriage, but rather somewhat "panicked."
So in other words...
Punkdo Von Valetti was now communicable!
And moreover, the previous attack and fight might not have been his intention!

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Welcome to the Future
chapters.content:
"You mean... I was shouting strange words in the last carriage and attacked you just now?"
Punkdo Von Valetti had completely calmed down.
Looking at Lin Yu, Li Nian, and Chen Zhuo in front of him, Punkdo thought for a moment and drew a conclusion.
"I'll take what you said at face value for now, because it looks like my 'inhibitor' malfunctioned and caused me to lose control."
Punkdo Von Valetti said this, and Lin Yu grew curious.
"Inhibitor?"
"Yes. If you don't believe me, you can open the opening on the back of my uniform."
Saying that, the bound Punkdo struggled and shifted his body forward, then twisted to expose his back to everyone.
Lin Yu and Li Nian exchanged a glance, and Li Nian spoke up: "Honored employer, the two of us are female, and there's a difference between men and women... so this job is yours."
Hearing Li Nian say that, Chen Zhuo agreed without a second thought."Okay!"
But Lin Yu knew full well...
Li Nian was totally bluffing.
She had already groped Punkdo several times earlier;
there was no way she would suddenly act modest now.
There was only one reason Li Nian ordered Chen Zhuo to do it...
Even if Punkdo now seemed not "mad" anymore, he might still not be trustworthy.
Lin Yu thought the same—he was sure Punkdo's earlier daze wasn't an act;
Punkdo truly had no recollection of his previous "madness."
Even so, a sober Punkdo could still harbor ill intent toward them.
Lin Yu approved of Li Nian's arrangement.
Treating the three-person squad as a unit and taking a colder, profit-driven perspective, sending Chen Zhuo to take the risk was the most appropriate choice.
He had the lowest strength;
if something happened to him, Lin Yu and Li Nian could still rescue and support him in time.
But if Lin Yu or Li Nian were harmed, Chen Zhuo wouldn't be much help!
Fortunately, Chen Zhuo wasn't harmed.
He smoothly peeled back a Velcro-sealed patch on the back of Punkdo's gray uniform—under that patch was a rigid piece of fabric.
Behind that fabric, a rounded device the size of a meat bun was affixed to his back, glowing blue.
The device had four metal needles deeply embedded under Punkdo's skin.
And just as Punkdo had said, the device looked broken at first glance.
Although it was still operating, there was a gap on the left side that exposed internal mechanical parts.
"This thing really does look broken."
Chen Zhuo said aloud.
Punkdo sighed. "No wonder..."
He looked at them with an apologetic expression. "I'm sorry, everyone. When my 'inhibitor' fails, I may plunge into madness... that must be why I attacked you."
"I was hit in the back during a mission three days ago and didn't have time to return to the company for repairs."
"In any case, I'm deeply sorry for an employee of Truth Corporation attacking civilians..."
Punkdo apologized very politely.
Li Nian waved magnanimously. "It's fine, you're forgiven—although you almost squeezed my arm to pieces. But as they say, no hard feelings after a fight;
we're brothers now."
Punkdo looked even more embarrassed. "I can't believe this happened. I'll write a report and compensate when I return to the company—subduing me while I'm in a crazed state shows you have considerable skill. If you'd like, I can recommend you to the company."
"However, would you mind untying me when we reach the station? I still have tasks unfinished."
As Punkdo spoke, Li Nian looked at him with a strange expression.
"Are you truly stupid or just pretending... This is your company's Despair Train. Does that thing even have a station to stop at?"
Punkdo was stunned for a moment. "Despair Train? I... why am I even here?"
"Did you think this was an ordinary express train?" Li Nian shot back.
Punkdo's face went pale. "Heavens, what on earth is going on... What did I do when the 'inhibitor' went berserk?!"
"No... even if I did something harmful to the company or Sleepless City, they wouldn't just dump me here—I was only a regular field worker!"
Hearing Punkdo's words, Lin Yu couldn't help but glance again at the identity card he'd taken from him earlier.
"C-2 level field team leader—you are not an ordinary field worker."
Lin Yu said this, and Chen Zhuo's expression changed drastically as well.
"Uncle, you're still lying to us at a time like this?! I actually thought you were sane now!"
He jumped back a step and assumed a defensive stance.
But Lin Yu calmly spoke again.
"No, I don't think he's lying..."
Sure enough, after hearing Lin Yu and Chen Zhuo, a burst of uncontrollable panic and terror flashed across Punkdo's face.
The blue light of the inhibitor on his back sped up noticeably.
"What group leader, uncle, what are you talking about?!"
"What are you holding? Let me see it!"
Lin Yu silently handed Punkdo's identity card back to him.
Punkdo looked at the card's information and photo and leapt up from his seat in fright.
"What... what is going on?!"
He looked toward the train window—the reflection showed the face of a somewhat haggard middle-aged man.
Across his chest the red letters "F-6" blazed.
The inhibitor on Punkdo's back changed from blue to red, and he looked agitated.
"How could I be the leader of the delta group?! How could I become an exiled expendable! This must be an illusion!"
Punkdo looked up at the top of the carriage.
"End the test! Supervisor! Researchers, whoever you are... I request to end this dream!"
He shouted, his voice starting to break.
Chen Zhuo, startled by this man's sudden yelling, was shocked.
"Hey, sir, this isn't a dream..."
But before Chen Zhuo could finish, Punkdo shouted again.
"Shut up! You nightmare... no, you might not even be a nightmare—you could be a spy from the Supreme Evolution Corporation! You're trying to extract secrets from me, right?!"
Punkdo's eyes bulged and he looked crazier than he had in the previous carriage.
However, this kind of frenzy differed from the utterly incomprehensible madness in the earlier carriage.
At least Lin Yu and Li Nian understood that he had become like this because he couldn't accept reality;
the blow was too great.
They also had ways to calm him back down.
The two moved instinctively and in perfect coordination.
In the next moment, Punkdo's movements halted and he slowly sat back down.
That was because a gun barrel was pressed to his brow and a blade rested against his carotid artery.
"Hey, hey, calm down. Like you, we're also 'exiles' on the Despair Train," Li Nian said, her tone light and brisk. "Anyway, you should realize this isn't a hallucination created by Truth Corporation or any other company's spies..."
"For your current understanding, this place should be 'a few years later'... I don't really know the exact time either."
After Li Nian finished, Lin Yu added with wicked relish.
"Welcome to the future, Mr. Punkdo."

chapters.title: Chapter 236: The Truth of the Despair Train, and Inviting Pang Duo
chapters.content:
Under the threat of gun barrels and blades, Pang Kedo finally calmed down.
The damaged inhibitor on his back returned to blue as he slumped into the chair with a dejected expression.
After confirming the man posed no real threat, Lin Yu even proactively untied the ropes binding him.
"So... I've lost several years of memories..."
Pang Kedo clutched his hair in agony, muttering to himself: "First promoted to team leader, then turned into expendable material exiled to this damned train - what exactly happened to me?"
Seeing Pang Kedo's distress, Li Nian offered comfort.
"Hey, don't dwell too much on the past. What matters most is seizing the present... though it seems the present isn't much better either."
Lin Yu pressed curiously: "Since you're an internal Truth Corporation personnel, you should know about this train, right? I still don't understand what's going on with this train."
"What do you mean by 'expendable materials'? What exactly is this train for?"
Hearing Lin Yu's questions, Pang Kedo reluctantly pulled himself together and began explaining."This is just what I've heard... initially, the Despair Train was truly designed and built as a 'public transportation' project."
"Its tracks circle the entire outer ring of Sleepless City, originally with six stations, claiming it could travel from one end of Sleepless City to the other within three minutes."
"It employed the 'Despair Furnace' which had already proven extremely efficient - a single-core furnace capable of simultaneously absorbing emotional energies like sorrow, pain, anger, while having demonstrated its upper limits when used as orbital strike weapons."
"The specially designed train routes could further share the entire Sleepless City's energy pressure."
"However, after actual operation, everyone discovered this furnace's design flaw - it's extremely difficult to stop."
"In other words, once the train starts, there's simply no concept of 'stations.' To make it stop, even after applying brakes and cutting off the furnace's energy supply, it would still run for at least another year."
"So the project failed - but not completely."
"Because the energy supply, originally just its 'byproduct,' was found to far exceed all energy sources Sleepless City was using at the time."
"Initially it was only expected to share energy pressure, but after actual operation... it could almost become the main daily energy supply."
"Thus, the corporate executives decided to convert it into a circular energy supplier - reinforcing the carriage exteriors and tracks with high-resistance materials while removing all stations."
"But for high-frequency energy output, the carriages must have 'passengers' - and lots of passengers containing 'despair-type' emotions."
"So the corporation decided to slightly adjust its original function as transportation... turning it into a 'prison.'"
"Those who made major mistakes within the company, those caught trying to infiltrate the company... in short, among the corporation's 'enemies,' anyone capable of producing such emotions would be thrown into this never-stopping train to squeeze out their despair."
"In my memory, this train has been operating and continuously powering Sleepless City for ten years... though actually, many more years have probably passed by now."
"In summary, this train gathers large numbers of scum, traitors, and dangerous elements, becoming the corporation's testing ground for various new and old weapons."
Here, Pang Kedo covered his face in agony: "Damn it, how did I end up here?! What exactly happened!"
He grew agitated again.
Lin Yu nodded in understanding.
"I see, so though called a 'train'... this is actually a prison built on a train - and the kind that abuses prisoners too."
He completely ignored Pang Kedo's distress, calmly analyzing.
Li Nian also stroked her chin: "So that's how it is."
Both "experts" rather coldly let Pang Kedo have his breakdown.
Only Chen Zhuo couldn't help but step forward to offer comfort.
"It's okay, uncle. Even though you lost your memory and got thrown into this place, it's not like you can't leave here!"
And Chen Zhuo's words reminded Lin Yu.
"True enough," Lin Yu picked up the thread, following up by inquiring about new information, "I heard you just need to get a 'Train Ticket' to leave, right? What exactly is that thing?"
Hearing Lin Yu's words, Pang Kedo looked up, his expression blank again.
"Train Ticket? I don't know... I've never heard of any way to leave this train!"
"Maybe my level wasn't high enough, or maybe the corporation developed something new during my memory loss period... in any case, if I could recover my memories from when I was team leader, I might be able to answer your questions."
Pang Kedo said apologetically.
Lin Yu waved his hand: "No matter. Though unclear on the specifics, at least we know roughly where to find that thing."
Pausing, Lin Yu looked at Li Nian, seemingly seeking her opinion.
Seeing Lin Yu's expression, Li Nian roughly understood what he wanted to do and directly said: "Though this guy isn't very stable... he's after all a skilled local - I second the motion."
She said indifferently.
Chen Zhuo looked confused: "Huh? What do you mean?"
Lin Yu didn't answer Chen Zhuo's question, choosing instead to explain through action.
He directly extended his hand toward Pang Kedo.
"Well, Mr. Pang Kedo, though we knocked you out earlier and you almost killed one of us, that was all while you were in a crazed state."
"Now, would you like to cooperate sincerely with us?"
"We can work together to find a way off this train."
Lin Yu extended an invitation to Pang Kedo.
Faced with the offer, Pang Kedo instead hesitated.
"Sorry, I still haven't quite figured out what's happening, and... I'm not clear about your identities either."
"I need some time alone to process things."
Pang Kedo said, politely declining Lin Yu.
But Lin Yu didn't withdraw his hand, instead offering new information.
"Alright, Mr. Pang Kedo. I originally planned to tell you this after you'd stabilized somewhat, but to gain your trust now, I'm afraid I'll have to shock you a bit more."
As he spoke, Lin Yu used his other hand to retrieve another ID card and black notebook from his chest.
"Do you know Vale Valetti? He and I were comrades who fought side by side."
"This identity card and notebook were given to me by him."
Just as Lin Yu anticipated.
Pang Kedo's pupils constricted sharply upon seeing the card in Lin Yu's hand.
However, the address that next came from Pang Kedo's mouth completely surprised Lin Yu.
"My heavens, how do you have my great-uncle's identity card and notebook?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 237: D-3 Carriage, Meeting an Acquaintance
chapters.content:
With the "Vale Valetti" connection established, Pang Kedo naturally changed his mind and accepted Lin Yu's invitation to join the team, giving this three-person squad an NPC Enforcer.
Lin Yu couldn't help but thank "Vale Valetti" once more in his heart - who would have thought that guy could still send him a teammate even across different dungeons.
And the previous privilege card too, saving him the trouble of puzzle-solving.
However, gratitude aside, Lin Yu still couldn't resist cursing about the "great-uncle" issue.
"Vale Valetti, have you lost track of time in that great snowy mountain?"
"Your damn grandnephew is already going through a midlife crisis!"
Because Lin Yu had the notebook and privilege card, Pang Kedo didn't suspect anything and was tricked into revealing a large amount of personal information about himself and Vale Valetti.
According to Pang Kedo's account...
His grandfather Polly Valetti and Vale Valetti were brothers from Sleepless City.
The older brother Polly had a strong physique, while the younger brother Vale had a quick mind.The older brother Polly Valetti worked as a boxer and enforcer for the underground gangs in Sleepless City, earning money to support his younger brother Vale's education.
Vale was very determined and entered Truth Corporation, which had recently joined the ranks of giant oligarchs in Sleepless City, becoming an Independent Researcher for the company and gaining his mentor's appreciation.
Through his younger brother's connections, the older brother Polly Valetti also entered the company as security personnel.
Because Lin Yu had the notebook and privilege card, Pang Kedo didn't suspect anything and was tricked into revealing a large amount of personal information about himself and Vale Valetti.
Just two years later, Vale went missing during a field assignment.
Polly Valetti was heartbroken and approached Truth Corporation's management, hoping they would conduct a full-scale search and rescue for his brother... at least to see the person alive or confirm the body dead.
But since he was just a lowly security guard, he was completely powerless about it.
He could only strive to climb higher.
Through Polly Valetti's continuous efforts, he eventually reached the peak of what an ordinary person could achieve in Truth Corporation - deputy director of the security department.
The elderly Polly had already given up hope on whether Vale was still alive, but he still wanted to know the "truth."
The deputy director's privileges had reached B-2 level, but he still didn't have the authority to access the files of Independent Researcher Vale's last mission, which was only at "B-3" level.
Therefore, after Polly retired, he still arranged for his son to enter Truth Corporation - on one hand, it was indeed a good job.
On the other hand, Polly hoped his son would continue investigating the truth about Vale.
But Polly's son didn't make any new progress in his investigation of his uncle Vale Valetti. He hadn't even reached his father's position when, while serving as just the section chief of the security department's protection division, he contracted a rare disease and unfortunately died.
This prematurely deceased only son of Polly Valetti was precisely Pang Kedo Von Valetti's father.
He also passed on his father's will to his own son.
So... although Pang Kedo Von Valetti had never even met his great-uncle, he knew everything about him.
Therefore, after extracting all the information, Lin Yu simply did a favor and roughly explained what had approximately happened to Vale Valetti in the form of "I heard from a friend."
"Thank you for sharing. I think my grandfather and father would be comforted to know this... I'll tell them all this when I visit their graves."
Pang Kedo Von Valetti thanked Lin Yu solemnly, then became somewhat pessimistic.
"Though, I hope I can still get out to visit their graves!"
As he said this, Li Nian, carrying her bulging backpack, waved her hand: "Ah, don't be so discouraged! With the few of us, there's definitely no problem."
The three-person team brought Pang Kedo to the other end of the dining car.
After Pang Kedo joined the team, they naturally had no reason to linger in the dining car any longer.
To obtain the "Train Ticket," they had to fight certain things on this train.
Right now, the dining car didn't even have living creatures, let alone moving objects, so obviously there was no possibility of getting tickets here.
They reached the other end of the dining car, but the door here...
had four doors side by side.
The four doors were labeled D-3, D-6, D-9, and "ROLL" respectively.
Chen Zhuo scratched his head.
"What does this mean? Shouldn't train carriages be arranged sequentially? And why are there three doors at once?"
Li Nian looked at Chen Zhuo: "Although you might not have known what 'Truth Corporation' was before... you can probably tell from our conversation that this company can convert human emotions and souls into actual energy or even matter."
"Do you think it's difficult for such a company to install some kind of transportation device on their train?"
As Li Nian spoke, Pang Kedo nodded: "That's right, the company indeed has this technology... Although there are many restrictions regarding distance and placement, within a completely enclosed entire building or vehicle, it's possible to create fixed point-to-point portals using the reality-warping properties of 'confusion'."
As Pang Kedo explained, Chen Zhuo suddenly understood.
"So Truth Corporation is this awesome! I should have bought some of their products!"
"Someone was selling me weapons made by their company at the last gathering, but I didn't take them because the price was too high."
Chen Zhuo said regretfully.
"But never mind that, which door should we choose?"
Lin Yu stroked his chin thoughtfully: "Hmm... Personally, I'd prefer to choose between numbers 3 and 6."
"Eh? Why exclude number nine and that ROLL door?"
Chen Zhuo asked full of curiosity.
"Because these two doors have a high probability of encountering other players. Remember that 'hint' - the carriages with 'new passengers,' besides our D-13, are D-4 and D-5."
Li Nian analyzed.
"Of course, between these two, the one more likely to encounter players should be number 3, because based on our experience with numbers 12 and 13, the dining car should have normal doors leading to larger numbers and spatial doors leading to smaller numbers."
Therefore, after extracting all the information, Lin Yu simply did a favor and roughly explained what had happened to Vale Valetti in the form of "I heard from a friend."
After explaining, Li Nian added her own opinion with a smile.
Pang Kedo stood to the side without speaking, appearing to follow orders.
Only then did Lin Yu realize that everyone seemed to be leaving the decision to him.
But this was reasonable...
After all, the card with the highest privileges that could definitely open doors was in Lin Yu's hand.
"Alright, then let's go with carriage number 3."
Lin Yu took out Vale Valetti's card and swiped it next to the door labeled "D-3."
The door opened again, revealing a deep space with blue light emanating from the floor. Lin Yu led the others inside.
The door behind them closed automatically, and after a slight feeling of dizziness, a door suddenly opened before them.
A strong smell of blood wafted through. The spacious carriage, arranged almost identically to D-12, was littered with corpses everywhere.
On the bar counter, on dining tables, on the floor...
Approximately over ten lives had probably just vanished minutes ago.
And the perpetrator of all this was likely the only one still standing in this carriage right now.
The man who was leisurely cooking pasta using the stove behind the bar counter.
Before Lin Yu and Pang Kedo could assume defensive postures, before Chen Zhuo could hide behind everyone, Li Nian spoke first.
"Holy crap, Brother Wang, it's you!"
The man cooking pasta also looked up, saw Li Nian wearing sunglasses, and looked slightly surprised.
"Oh? A Nian?"
"You're in this dungeon too."

chapters.title: Chapter 238: An Assassin from the Psychology Society, and S-Rank Potential
chapters.content:
"Let me introduce everyone—this is our 'Designer' from the 'Free Alliance.' You can call him Brother Wang."
"Brother Wang, this is 'Zhu Ming' that I mentioned to everyone before... The chubby guy next to her is mine and Zhu Ming's employer. We took a job to carry him through this dungeon."
Li Nian introduced both sides. The man called Brother Wang, whose official code name was 'Designer,' turned the pasta pot to low heat and greeted Lin Yu and Chen Zhuo.
"Hello, Zhu Ming. I've heard A Nian mention you a few times. I look forward to the day you officially join us."
"My real name is Wang Yuyang. You can call me by my name directly."
"Like Li Nian, I'm at the 'Second Tier.'"
Wang Yuyang spoke, clearly another powerhouse who didn't particularly care about hiding his true identity.
Then he looked at Chen Zhuo, thought for a moment, and said: "Hmm, you should lose some weight."
Chen Zhuo was completely thrown off by Wang Yuyang's blunt statement.
The other party wasn't attacking or teasing—it was a sincere suggestion without any malice.So although Chen Zhuo was somewhat bewildered, he still nodded.
"Ah? Oh! Okay!"
Li Nian said with a giggle: "That's just how Brother Wang is—he's quite disciplined."
"Those who enter the 'Death Game' are all people who don't want to die... Since you don't want to die, why not choose a healthy lifestyle?"
Wang Yuyang said this as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
Lin Yu listened to Wang Yuyang's perfectly reasonable statement and sighed inwardly.
"No wonder people who can join the 'Free Alliance' must have something extraordinary about them."
As they talked, Wang Yuyang's pasta finished cooking.
He arranged the pasta on a plate and drizzled it with the sauce he had prepared earlier.
Looking at this exquisite pasta, Li Nian seemed to realize something.
"Oh dear, Brother Wang, you didn't bring someone into this dungeon too, did you?"
As Li Nian spoke, Wang Yuyang smiled.
"Of course. As long as I have Team Cards, I'll definitely bring her along."
Hearing this, Lin Yu became curious.
"Sounds like a fixed teammate..."
Li Nian said: "Exactly. If you see Brother Wang, there's a high probability you'll also see his girlfriend in the same dungeon."
Then Li Nian sighed: "Such sickeningly sweet affection... The main reason I hate encountering couples in dungeons is because Brother Wang is just too awful."
"Someone like me—a gloomy sewer rat whose profession is the shady 'Thief'—will simply die upon seeing others' happiness."
Hearing Li Nian's words, Lin Yu felt that although the girl was half-joking, there might be some genuine feeling mixed in.
He remembered his first encounter with Li Nian in a dungeon—that was in the God of Change's dungeon [Deadly Quiz].
At that time, Li Nian had been very proactive in facilitating the mutual destruction of that young couple in the dungeon.
Although the main reason was their existing conflicts, and the direct cause was that crow causing problems and sowing discord, Li Nian had still somewhat contributed as an accomplice who added fuel to the fire.
However, Wang Yuyang seemed quite accustomed to Li Nian's resentful words.
"Although it's mostly happiness, I do have my worries too... Yuqiang's identity is rather special, as you well know."
Wang Yuyang spoke calmly. Li Nian sighed.
"That's true too..."
Then she suddenly realized something, looked at Lin Yu, and revealed a very sneaky smile.
"Hehe, did you know, dear Miss Zhu Ming..."
"Brother Wang's girlfriend is from the 'Psychological Society.'"
Hearing those four words—'Psychological Society'—Lin Yu immediately froze.
"What?"
He had just been watching Li Nian and Wang Yuyang chat while observing the internal dynamics of the 'Free Alliance.'
But who would have thought... a member of the 'Psychological Society' would suddenly appear?!
The 'Free Alliance' was truly too free—its members actually included someone dating a person from the 'Psychological Society'!
And even if the 'Free Alliance' was relatively loose, was something like this even allowed on the 'Psychological Society' side?
But before Lin Yu could process this, Wang Yuyang spoke with some surprise.
"Oh? Do you also have some history with the 'Psychological Society'?"
"More than just history," Lin Yu said with a fake smile, "It's deeply rooted and endlessly connected."
He spoke softly. Wang Yuyang nodded and spoke again.
"Oh, I see... But Yuqiang is an independent operative in the Execution Department. She doesn't have deep connections with the main Psychological Society and has relatively high autonomy."
Seeming to sense that Lin Yu had grievances with the 'Psychological Society,' Wang Yuyang offered this explanation.
Hearing this introduction, Lin Yu actually found it more familiar.
"Excuse me, what is your girlfriend's profession?"
Before Wang Yuyang could answer, Li Nian burst out laughing.
"Zhu Ming, you've hit the nail on the head... His girlfriend is an 'Assassin'!"
'Psychological Society,' Execution Department, 'Assassin,' female gender...
With all these elements combined, Lin Yu's expression changed slightly, and he was ready to turn and run immediately.
Although he was currently using the combined false identity of "Xia Yue" and "Zhu Ming"...
Meeting that crazy woman in a dungeon with his current identity probably wasn't a good option either.
But before Lin Yu could execute his escape plan, Wang Yuyang's voice sounded.
"Yuqiang—the pasta is ready."
As he spoke, an immediate response came from the middle of the carriage.
"Coming!"
A lively female voice sounded. Then, from behind the dining car booth, a sweet-looking, adorable young girl emerged from a pile of corpses.
She showed several torn pieces of paper in her hand and said somewhat regretfully: "I only found about five fragments of 'Train Tickets'—not even enough to piece together half a ticket."
As she spoke, she briskly crossed half the carriage to stand before Wang Yuyang while checking out the newcomers Lin Yu and his group.
"I overheard your conversation just now... Nice to see you again, A Nian."
"And... Zhu Ming and employer boy, right?"
The girl smiled and nodded politely, her words warm and friendly like a spring breeze.
Looking at her, Lin Yu openly let out a long sigh of relief.
"Although I knew it was impossible... Actually seeing it's not that person is such a relief after all."
The girl looked puzzled: "Huh? Why would you say that?"
Li Nian couldn't help but laugh: "This guy was probably worried just now that it might be 'Fluoxetine' popping out—since Fluoxetine almost killed her before."
Hearing this, the girl looked somewhat embarrassed: "Ah, is that so... Then Senior Fluoxetine was really too much. I'll scold her for you if I get the chance."
"But I'm definitely not Fluoxetine. My code name in the 'Psychological Society' is 'Citalopram,' and my rank in the Execution Department is only B-level..."
"Of course, since you're Yuyang's friend, you can just call me by my name—Pan Yuqiang."
Lin Yu nodded.
Although she wasn't Fluoxetine herself, which relieved him.
But facing a member of the 'Psychological Society,' he didn't dare be careless.
Wang Yuyang spoke again: "You were almost killed by 'Fluoxetine'? For that guy to personally take action, you must have some exceptional qualities."
"A Nian, why didn't you mention this before?"
Li Nian shrugged: "To be honest, I only found out a few days ago and haven't had time to tell you yet."
Pan Yuqiang seemed to remember something: "Hey, wait a moment... I think I saw you in the Execution Department's internal documents."
"You're that S-level potential newcomer who failed to become a 'Player'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 239: A Decisive Lie, and the Mysterious Communicator
chapters.content:
"S rank? Your potential is S rank?"
Wang Yuyang and Li Nian simultaneously turned to look at Lin Yu, their faces showing identical expressions of disbelief.
Though Li Nian had previously stolen the Psychological Society's roster and confirmed that Xia Yue's rating should be above A, she had only thought Xia Yue would be A or A+ level.
Who could have imagined it would be S rank!
Even Lin Yu himself was shocked.
"What in the world? Xia Yue's potential is S rank?"
So the monster he encountered in his first dungeon was actually viewed this highly by the Psychological Society?
Wait, considering his own rating seemed to be no lower, Lin Yu still felt this organization's rating standards had some flaws.
Though countless thoughts raced through his mind, he remained calm on the surface.
"It's actually that high? Though I don't really trust your organization's standards... After all, you just said I 'failed to become a player'—this shows your organization's information is incorrect.""I'm perfectly fine appearing here as a player."
"And this is clearly inside a Death Game dungeon."
Lin Yu spoke calmly.
Pan Yuqiang looked at Lin Yu, falling into thought.
"Oh dear, that's right... Could it be that Fluoxetine's report was wrong?"
"But she clearly confirmed your death—even the information from Order's side says the same."
Lin Yu sighed.
"Well, I can proudly say that I actually managed to deceive two powerful organizations all by myself."
By now, Lin Yu was gradually realizing that although encountering Wang Yuyang and Pan Yuqiang here was unexpected...
These two people's identities—one being a Free Alliance member, the other a Psychological Society member!
While this posed a tremendous challenge to his use of the "Xia Yue" identity for activities, it was also an opportunity.
With appropriate acting, the "setup" he recently created regarding the "Zhu Ming" and "Xia Yue" identities could become even more credible within this dungeon.
It might even completely deceive Fluoxetine herself and the entire Death Game player community.
The key lay with these two people before him.
So, Lin Yu appropriately displayed some anger.
"But honestly, I didn't have to go that far... I won't criticize how your Psychological Society enthusiastically finds promising ordinary people, kills them, and tries to pull them into the Death Game, since that's your operational purpose," his tone remained gentle but now carried some hidden sharpness, "but please, Miss Citalopram, bring back some reform suggestions to your organization... Before executing such operations, could you please confirm whether I've already become a player?"
Lin Yu adopted a somewhat headache-inducing appearance, speaking with a tone half helpless, half resentful: "Can you understand what it felt like being suddenly attacked by a Psychological Society Third Tier expert that day... Though faking death to deceive that Fluoxetine might seem something to be proud of from your perspective, it was just a desperate move I made to survive at the time."
"I consumed at least three precious items, and even made my family and friends believe it... Now I can't return home, my mother and sister think I'm really dead—my sister is about to take her high school entrance exams, this is a huge blow to her, what if she fails?"
"And now I find out... it was all a misunderstanding, damn it, I was unlucky enough to enter this game two months ago, who knew something even worse would happen a month ago—death is something ordinary people experience only once in their lifetime, yet I've already 'died' twice!"
Lin Yu's tone grew increasingly agitated.
He displayed an appropriate level of "loss of control" that matched Xia Yue's personality.
The emotional intensity was enough to make Pan Yuqiang and the others present believe her words and become immersed in her not entirely credible yet quite reasonable logic.
Of course, Lin Yu knew very well.
Whether Wang Yuyang, Pan Yuqiang, or Li Nian—none were ordinary characters.
Even if momentarily affected by emotions...
They would likely realize something was off afterward.
So, to make Xia Yue's identity an "established fact," Lin Yu didn't hesitate to use the Teeth of Prophecy once.
He chose to make all three believe his final statement—"death is something ordinary people experience only once in their lifetime, yet I've already died twice."
For Lin Yu... whether referring to himself or Xia Yue, this happened to be an accurate, undeniable truth.
Of course, for "Xia Yue," she could be considered to have died three times—depending on how you count.
But absolutely no one in the world besides Lin Yu could know what truth this statement actually represented.
Thus, the unconditional belief brought by the Teeth of Prophecy was enough to make the four players present have no remaining doubts about Lin Yu's carefully crafted background for "Xia Yue," completely believing his meticulously woven story.
And among these four players present, there were two Free Alliance members and one Psychological Society member.
They all had sufficient influence to affect how other members of their organizations judged the "Zhu Ming" identity.
As for the remaining Chen Zhuo, though a newcomer, upon careful thought, he had after all experienced the first round with him, making him someone who might actually suspect Xia Yue's identity.
So, even though after this use, the Teeth of Prophecy had only one use remaining, Lin Yu felt...
It was worth it.
For a moment, the remaining four players looked at Lin Yu with his slightly reddened eyes and, under that completely logical "belief," began comforting her.
"It's okay, what matters is you're still alive... This really was poorly handled by the Psychological Society."
Wang Yuyang spoke awkwardly—normally this had nothing to do with him, but this Free Alliance member seemed to have a strange sense of responsibility.
It seemed because his girlfriend Pan Yuqiang was from the Psychological Society, he felt some sense of belonging toward them too.
As for Pan Yuqiang, she was even more apologetic: "I'll definitely report this accurately when I return... Though I'm only B rank, I do have some voice within the organization."
Li Nian scratched her head, changing the subject from this heavy topic: "Hey, Zhu Ming... Never thought you had this side to you."
"But after joining the Free Alliance, if we encounter Fluoxetine again, I can help you take her down, damn it—that woman really isn't much good!"
At that moment, Pang Kedo's voice interrupted the somewhat awkward atmosphere among the players.
"Hey everyone, I found something good."
Earlier when they entered carriage D-3 and saw Li Nian seemingly catching up with acquaintances, Pang Kedo tactfully went to examine the bodies in the carriage.
And now, Pang Kedo seemed to have found some useful items that even Pan Yuqiang had missed.
He waved a black pager-like device in front of everyone.
"This is a communicator exclusively for Truth Corporation supervisors, department heads, and directors—looks like there's someone with very high privileges on this Despair Train."

chapters.title: Chapter 240: The Layout of the Despair Train
chapters.content:
“A dedicated communicator from Truth Corporation?” Lin Yu asked with curiosity.
Pang Kedo nodded. “Exactly. This device is a top-tier confidential communicator... it’s only used to transmit the highest-level orders from the company’s headquarters board to various supervisors. Whoever holds it has at least B-1 level privileges within the company.”
“Ordinary people who get it can’t open it—only authenticated users can normally use it.”
“Not only that... even if you kidnapped a senior executive, you still couldn’t force them to unlock this box, because this thing can even detect whether the user is under threat.”
“That powerful?” Lin Yu found it hard to believe, his skepticism obvious.
But after taking the unassuming black box Pang Kedo had “seized” and reading its item description, Lin Yu saw confirmation of Pang Kedo’s claims.
[Classified Communicator]
[Description: A communicator able to automatically recognize the user’s soul state. Only authenticated users who are fully conscious and emotionally calm can open and use its encrypted communication functions.]
Lin Yu shared the item description with Li Nian and Chen Zhuo, then tossed it to Wang Yuyang.
Li Nian raised an eyebrow. “This is pretty thoroughly designed. It gives the impression that if a senior executive gets kidnapped, they aren’t expected to die.”“Even if they die, the company’s interests are above their lives,” Pan Yuqiang commented. “Very Truth Corporation style. But it’s genuinely disturbing.”
Hearing such a respectful, normal view of human life come from a Psychological Society member made Lin Yu’s expression somewhat odd.
It seemed Miss Pan Yuqiang was an outlier in that twisted organization.
That made Lin Yu even more curious—how did she decide to join the Psychological Society, and how did she awaken as an Assassin?
However, this wasn’t a good moment to pry. Right now Lin Yu’s focus was the current dungeon.
“So among those dead people, was there a Truth Corporation supervisor?” he asked.
Pang Kedo shook his head after thinking. “I don’t think so. The person I found the communicator on earlier looked like just a Sleepless City criminal... tattoos, a vicious face, cheap worn clothing. The emotional residue on the corpse was muddled and mixed—nothing like a company executive.”
Pang Kedo walked to the center of the dining car and lifted the corpse from which he had removed the communicator—indeed, the clothing and demeanor made him look like a brutal gang member who’d lived on the fringes of society for years.
“But he could have been the squad leader or head of this group of thieves. That communicator might have been looted by him or ‘rewarded’ to him by some big shot.”
“After all... if that big shot was also sent onto the Despair Train, just like me—exiled here—then the communicator loses its core purpose and becomes nothing more than a slightly better signal, interference-resistant device.”
Pang Kedo analyzed calmly and logically, though his expression darkened slightly when he mentioned being “exiled.”
Li Nian showed an approving look. “Not bad, Mr. Pang Kedo. Didn’t expect a combatant like you to be so sharp.”
Wang Yuyang chimed in to back up Pang Kedo’s point. “Indeed, that guy did carry some authority in this dining car... If I’d known his connections ran that deep, I wouldn’t have killed him outright.”
His voice carried a hint of regret as he spoke.
Pan Yuqiang smiled and added, “Luckily, while they had only been dead a short time and I was collecting train tickets, I used my Spirit Ring to ask a few questions.”
Wang Yuyang looked at Pan Yuqiang, his face softening into a sweet smile. “I knew you wouldn’t overthink hurting scum like them, so I naturally helped you fill in the blanks.”
“Anyway, I probably wouldn’t have needed to act in the fight,” Pan Yuqiang said, and Wang Yuyang ruffled her hair. “Well done. Truly worthy of being Yuqiang.”
Li Nian couldn’t help but scoff. “Ugh, can you speak seriously for once!”
Pan Yuqiang looked at Li Nian with a neutral expression. “Of course—those thugs did, in fact, have a higher-ranking figure trapped on the train leading them...”
“Not only that, I also have a fair understanding of the general layout of the Despair Train.”
“We came from Carriage 4. In the previous carriage we met two-wheeled robots and defeated them. After that, we encountered three people from Carriage 3 who called themselves the ‘Airport Gang.’”
“Before Yuyang killed them, he got information through interrogation—on the Despair Train, if you harm other beings with souls and emotions, you can be rewarded at the dining car.”
“Delicious food, cigarettes, clean clothes, weapons... even ‘ticket fragments.’”
“And once you collect enough ‘ticket fragments,’ you can assemble a complete ‘train ticket.’”
“The ‘train ticket’ is the proof to leave the Despair Train—although the Despair Train never stops, Truth Corporation has a way to put people on board, so naturally it has a way to let people leave.”
“After hearing this, Yuyang and I went to Carriage 3—that’s the dining car and the Airport Gang’s stronghold, with thirteen members.”
“I had wanted to negotiate with the Airport Gang, but the gang members all seemed to be criminals who’d been placed on the train by Truth Corporation. They were rude to me at first sight.”
Wang Yuyang sighed. “I hate those who can’t control their desires. They live like beasts, squandering the human ‘nature’ they were born with.”
Pan Yuqiang shrugged. “So Yuyang killed them all...”
“Luckily I have a Spirit Ring,” Pan Yuqiang jingled the pretty silver-and-green ring on her right-hand middle finger. “The dead are more honest than the living, so I learned the situation on the Despair Train.”
“Because the train’s rules encourage the trapped people to kill each other, whenever there’s an announcement that new passengers have boarded, nearby ‘veterans’ prepare to hunt them.”
“Veterans usually appear after the train automatically releases two- to four-wheeled ‘weapon tests.’”
“And if those newcomers show sufficient strength, the veterans will try to recruit them into their factions—after all, it’s not only the newly boarded passengers who must face the weapons Truth Corporation drops.”
“Every 24 hours there’s a random weapon drop that targets random carriages and chases passengers for one hour... that can be handled by running, so it’s not a big problem.”
“But roughly every 72 hours, the entire train undergoes a massive three-hour purge—that’s not something you can just hide and run from.”

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Punkdor’s Persistence
chapters.content:
Upon hearing Pan Yuqiang's explanation, Lin Yu instantly understood why there could be "gangs" existing on the Despair Train—a place that encouraged internal conflict and mutual harm among trapped individuals—even developing to a scale of over ten people.
Because there was a greater external threat!
This mechanism made Lin Yu somewhat admire the higher-ups of Truth Corporation.
Whoever designed the internal mechanisms of the Despair Train had created a system that would continuously generate negative emotions from the "passengers" inside.
It was even the optimal solution—on one hand encouraging mutual slaughter, stirring up hatred and anger between them.
On the other hand, using the "great cleansing" every three days to force them to huddle together for warmth, maintaining some organizational structure, keeping daily suspicions and fears alive, and even potentially triggering "betrayal" incidents that could generate massive negative emotions.
It was utterly inhuman, but for harvesting negative emotions on the "Despair Train," it was indeed extremely "efficient."
The passengers on this train lived even more miserably than Death Game players.
Moreover, if Lin Yu wasn't mistaken...
"New people are always dropped in after the 'great cleansing,' right?"Lin Yu said calmly, and Pan Yuqiang nodded.
"Yes, Sleepless City has no shortage of expendable materials called 'people.' Every three days is enough for Truth Corporation to gather a dozen or so new unfortunate souls to throw onto the train."
"This time we only had six people board... which is actually quite special."
As Pan Yuqiang spoke, Li Nian rubbed her chin.
"Hmm, but aside from this recently destroyed, relatively weak 'Airport Gang,' what other forces are on this train?"
"Most forces are quite fragile. Those that survive over a month without being wiped out or disbanded are considered long-standing... Currently besides the recently annihilated Airport Gang, there's the emerging group that has survived five great cleansings—the 'Lion Gang' occupying dining car 6;
and two older groups jointly occupying dining car 9—the 'Blue Blood Team' and the 'Iron Thorn Gang.'"
"I haven't asked about the specifics of these groups... but they all have a major figure called the 'Baron' behind them—that communicator from the Airport Gang likely came from the Baron."
"This is all the information I know."
Pan Yuqiang shared the final details she was aware of.
Chen Zhuo was the first to express his thoughts: "Such a small train with barely a hundred people, all captured to serve as human batteries in this prison... yet it's so factionalized and complicated."
"And the mastermind is called 'Baron,' giving it almost an epic feel."
Hearing Chen Zhuo's sigh, Li Nian wagged her finger: "Where there are people, there are conflicts, fatty. You're still too naive."
"You're in school too—don't tell me your class of twenty-something people doesn't have factionalized cliques?"
Chen Zhuo paused: "Our class does have various cliques, but there are over fifty people in our class..."
Then Li Nian realized: "Oh right, you go to public school."
Lin Yu looked at Li Nian and sighed half-jokingly: "You're no miserable wretch who can't stand others' happiness. I'll fight you, you young lady from a prestigious private school!"
She knocked on her head, stuck out her tongue, and made a Peko-like expression to play it off.
"Anyway, that's the general idea..."
Wang Yuyang, however, was contemplating a different issue.
"Hmm, there are three similar gangs? If we eliminate them all, could we gather enough 'Train Tickets'?"
He casually proposed an extremely radical plan.
Lin Yu, Li Nian, and Chen Zhuo instantly stopped their banter, all looking at Wang Yuyang along with Punkdo.
"I don't think that would work, Yuyang."
Before others could formulate words of persuasion, Pan Yuqiang spoke first.
Wang Yuyang was actually quite receptive, accepting his proposal's rejection by his girlfriend without even asking why.
"Okay."
He nodded in response.
To prevent Wang Yuyang from proposing even less feasible plans, Lin Yu lightly coughed.
"Anyway, most of these gangs occupy dining cars... probably for 'transportation convenience' and easy 'communication'—this suggests there's some surface-level peace between the gangs."
"The gangs occupying other dining cars haven't come to the 'Airport Gang's' territory, so they might not know what happened here yet."
"Perhaps we could impersonate their identity, pose as new 'Airport Gang' members to negotiate with other gang members, and extract information about the 'Baron.'"
"Regarding 'Train Tickets,' the 'Baron' probably knows more about them."
Hearing Chen Zhuo's lament, Li Nian wagged her finger: "Where there are people, there are conflicts, fatty. You're still too naive."
"I second that."
The others had no objections either.
The group prepared to head out to dining car 9 to inquire with the gang stationed there.
However, before departing... Chen Zhuo seemed to realize something and suddenly spoke.
"But speaking of which, the carriage we boarded was number 13... and why was dining car 12 completely empty?"
Chen Zhuo raised the question.
Hearing Chen Zhuo's question, Lin Yu and Li Nian sighed simultaneously.
Lin Yu looked at Li Nian and sighed half-jokingly: "You're no miserable wretch who can't stand others' happiness. I'll fight you, you young lady from the aristocratic high school!"
After all... both Lin Yu and Li Nian had already guessed the possibility that dining car 12 near them was special.
Sure enough, reminded by Chen Zhuo, Pan Yuqiang spoke somewhat strangely.
"Eh? I thought you already understood what was going on."
"According to what those Airport Gang members said, newcomers from carriages 13 and 14 hardly need attention, and dining car 12 should be avoided as much as possible."
"Because dining car 12 is occupied by an incredibly powerful madman—almost equivalent to an entire faction by himself—who indiscriminately hunts everyone. Didn't you deal with him?"
Wang Yuyang realized and looked at Punkdo Von Valetti.
"I thought this guy was a newcomer like you who just boarded and got rescued by you!"
Lin Yu sighed: "Yes, he is that madman, but rest assured, he's not having an episode right now and is quite safe."
Wang Yuyang looked at Li Nian, and the young girl immediately raised her hand.
"Brother Wang, I absolutely had no intention of deliberately hiding this. I just thought... better to avoid trouble than invite it."
"Knowing your temperament, I was afraid you'd insist on taking him down."
Wang Yuyang nodded.
"You thought correctly—having such a time bomb in the team does make me quite uneasy."
"Even though he knows some internal information about Truth Corporation, I still believe... the risks of this move far outweigh the benefits."
Punkdo sensed Wang Yuyang's hostility and became alert.
Before others could formulate words of persuasion, Pan Yuqiang spoke first.
"But... if you insist on not wanting to work with me, I cannot accept that."
Punkdo said, looking at Lin Yu with determined eyes.
"This woman has something I want, and she was the one who actively invited me to join the operation."
"Unless she says otherwise, I will not leave this team."

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Negotiation and Deterrence
chapters.content:
Hearing Pang Kedo's statement, Lin Yu felt a headache coming on.
He knew things would develop like this!
Bringing up Vale Valetti in front of Li Nian and Chen Zhuo was one thing...
But now he had to reveal his connection with Truth Corporation in front of the Psychological Society members.
This wasn't what Lin Yu wanted to see.
But since things had already happened, Lin Yu could only accept it.
He looked at Wang Yuyang with a calm expression.
"I can vouch for him for now—and besides, A Nian and I already subdued him once before."
"If Pang Kedo causes any trouble again, I'll take responsibility for dealing with him."
Lin Yu spoke calmly.Seeing Lin Yu's resolute attitude, Wang Yuyang could only relent.
He just lowered his voice and said something admonishing in a tone Lin Yu could hear: "Don't trust NPCs in dungeons too much. Truth Corporation was never a proper company to begin with."
"This person, being a former Truth Corporation employee who went mad and was dumped here, means he's involved in many things."
"You're still First-Tier, no need to bind yourself too deeply with any specific faction within the dungeon."
Knowing Wang Yuyang meant well, Lin Yu nodded.
"I understand."
After this small interlude, the six of them finally set out, though Wang Yuyang maintained a somewhat guarded posture.
After all, bringing Pang Kedo along certainly carried hidden risks, but it also meant having an additional helper.
Moreover, Pang Kodo's identity on this train still had other useful applications.
They arrived inside carriage 3, then opened the door leading to carriage 9.
After stepping through the door, chaotic noises filled the space, along with a smell similar to something fermented.
This carriage clearly had a futuristic design, yet at this moment Lin Yu felt like he was in an old green-skinned train.
Compared to carriage 3 which only had some boxes piled up and a few mats spread on the floor, carriage 9 showed much more obvious signs of modification.
The carriage was divided into left and right halves by a long curtain, with seats converted into beds using frames, and various worn-out buckets used for water storage and storage.
It looked like these people had been living in this carriage for quite some time.
Seven or eight tramp-like men with messy, unkempt hair occupied one side;
more than ten youngsters who didn't look very old occupied the other side.
Seeing Lin Yu's group emerge from the door of carriage 3, the tallest among the youngsters stood up warily first, raising an iron rod polished at both ends.
"Carriage 3? Airport Gang people?"
"Why are you coming uninvited? This is Blue Blood Team territory!"
In this carriage 9, there was even a barbed wire fence stretched across the corridor between the door and the carriage!
Through the barbed wire fence, Lin Yu stepped forward.
"We're newly joined Airport Gang members, wanted to understand the ecosystem within the Despair Train, so our boss said we could come take a look ourselves."
The tall youngster with the iron rod heard this and looked suspicious: "Since when did the Airport Gang boss become so lax with his subordinates?"
He turned to look at those tramp-like men.
"Hey, Iron Thorn guys, what's going on here?"
The tramps who had been sitting together as if playing cards turned back, saying carelessly: "Oh, their boss was originally from a delinquent background... it's normal for team management to be sometimes loose, sometimes tight."
"That guy never had much brains anyway!"
Through this simple interaction, Lin Yu made a judgment in his heart.
The two organizations entrenched in carriage 9 should have some kind of delicate symbiotic relationship.
The Blue Blood Team was more dominant, holding the leading position.
But these Iron Thorn people had probably been on this Despair Train for a long time, so the Blue Blood Team didn't eliminate them, instead keeping them as their advisors and encyclopedia.
Thinking this, Lin Yu already had a measure of how to proceed with the negotiation.
"Iron Thorn everyone, although I just joined, isn't it inappropriate to slander our boss like this?"
He bypassed the Blue Blood Team youngster and directly addressed the Iron Thorn people in a provocative tone.
Although Zhu Ming's voice was relatively soft, Lin Yu's tone at this moment was extremely fierce.
The tall Blue Blood Team youngster frowned, tapping the iron rod on the floor.
"Hey, newcomer, didn't your boss warn you before coming here not to cause trouble in my territory?"
For a moment, the previously lazily resting Blue Blood Team members gradually stood up, all looking unfavorably at Lin Yu.
Lin Yu stood there with an unchanged expression.
Seeing Lin Yu's calm demeanor, a scruffy uncle from Iron Thorn instead realized something.
"Tang, don't get excited yet, this guy is deliberately provoking you."
He looked at Lin Yu, a glint of sharpness flashing in his eyes beneath dirty eyelids.
"Although this train is full of fools and foolishness... you don't seem to be a fool."
"What exactly is your purpose in coming here."
Being questioned so warily by the other party, Lin Yu didn't seem very surprised.
He gripped the gaps in the barbed wire fence and spoke softly.
"You guessed right, I came here to ask you about someone."
"'Baron'."
As Lin Yu spoke, the Blue Blood Team people became agitated again.
"You want to find Lord Baron?"
"Airport Gang people wanting to find Baron—why come to us instead of your own boss?"
"What exactly do you mean!"
The scruffy uncle from Iron Thorn smiled: "This guy isn't some Airport Gang newcomer, she should indeed have just boarded the train... but this short time onboard was enough."
"What happened to the Airport Gang people?"
Lin Yu wasn't surprised at all that his lie was exposed—on the contrary, if such a crude plan of impersonating the Airport Gang could actually succeed smoothly, that would be strange!
Even if Truth Corporation had released a herd of pigs onto the Despair Train, those who survived wave after wave of cleansing and mutual slaughter should have produced at least some wild boar spirits by now.
But why did he still choose to propose this plan, and why did Li Nian and Wang Yuyang also express agreement?
Because...
The moment this lie was exposed, the truth revealed at that time would instead make "negotiation" proceed more smoothly.
Lin Yu looked at the scruffy tramp and grinned: "You found us out... well, those guys weren't very cooperative, so they were dealt with."
"I hope you can be more cooperative—I have no interest in you, I just want to find 'Baron' now."
Lin Yu spoke calmly, his tone full of threatening implications.
This was even more effective than directly telling them "we wiped out the entire Airport Gang."
"Fuck, you threatening us?"
"You think we're like those Airport Gang trash? Before they were dumped here, they were just scum, garbage, low-level delinquents who only knew petty theft and intimidating civilians, only thrown up here because they offended someone!"
"We're not like those idiots! We come from the Great Wasteland, we've legitimately robbed Truth Corporation convoys!"
Indeed, the Blue Blood Team leader, though looking somewhat displeased, cursed fiercely a few times for show.
But judging from his actions and those of his followers behind him...
They were still intimidated.
They just needed some "reason" to convince them—or rather, a "reason" for them to convince themselves, a "step down" that would allow them to retreat, and they would probably relent.
And this reason wasn't hard to find.
Lin Yu looked behind him where the other five were still hidden in the shadows, only blurry outlines visible from outside.
"Put on your hood and come out for a walk."
He said to Pang Kedo, who nodded.
Then, the famous "madman" of the Truth Train revealed himself.
That iconic uniform and chest spray paint instantly silenced the entire carriage.
Lin Yu smiled and said: "Everyone, I really have legitimate business looking for Baron."
"Could everyone please do me this convenience, how about it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 243: The Baron’s Invitation
chapters.content:
After Pang Kedo appeared, everything Lin Yu said became incredibly persuasive.
From the perspective of the two gang members in Dining Car 9, this newly boarded woman could make this "madman" stand quietly behind her...
Her background was absolutely extraordinary.
Was she another major figure from Truth Corporation's internal power struggles who had been exiled after defeat? Or perhaps a core member from other factions in Sleepless City?
They couldn't even be sure if this woman was truly "exiled" here.
For all they knew, she might have planned her own entry deliberately!
The moment Pang Kedo appeared, all other NPCs in Carriage 9 clearly realized one thing.
The current situation, this woman's schemes—they existed on a completely different plane from people like them who were still figuring out how to survive the next "purge" and muddling through their existence on the train.
The complete annihilation of the Airport Gang didn't frighten them;
groups huddling together for warmth on the train being "overturned" was completely normal.
But...Combined with Pang Kedo's appearance and the woman's utterly genuine delivery, they belatedly felt some fear regarding the Airport Gang's destruction.
Because the Airport Gang... was most likely "crushed to death."
Like a person crushing ants.
This wasn't a situation they could involve themselves in or interfere with.
Therefore, even the outwardly bold and youthful Blue Blood Team couldn't help but quiet down.
The veteran from Iron Thorn spoke again.
"You wish to meet His Excellency the 'Baron,' is that right... Please forgive my impertinence, but I can only help you contact the Baron... I don't have any method to meet him directly either."
Lin Yu narrowed his eyes.
That Iron Thorn and Blue Blood Team were frightened by Pang Kedo's appearance was within Lin Yu's expectations.
Rather, Lin Yu had prepared the groundwork for Pang Kedo's entrance from the very beginning.
So he clearly understood that Iron Thorn and Blue Blood Team should already be terrified out of their wits, viewing him as some kind of superior being they couldn't afford to offend.
But even so...
This Iron Thorn member still needed to "seek instructions from the Baron."
In other words, even though the current Lin Yu appeared "terrifying" and "unapproachable" from their perspective...
"But he's still considered equal to the 'Baron'?"
"This guy is definitely not just an ordinary 'prisoner,' that's for sure."
Lin Yu pondered.
Then...
His current performance might fool these veteran prisoners, but it might not be enough to intimidate the "Baron" hiding in the shadows.
Lin Yu reached a conclusion in his heart.
"Need to raise the stakes."
As for how to raise them...
Lin Yu chose to gamble.
He looked at the old man from Iron Thorn and spoke softly: "Since you have a way to contact him, just tell him directly."
"I don't need you to tell me how to find him... My reason for using you to deliver the message is merely out of 'courtesy' and 'respect' for His Excellency the Baron."
Lin Yu paused slightly, then spoke under the suspicious and uncertain gazes of the numerous NPCs in the carriage: "Because I know where he is—somewhere before Carriage 3, in a place no teleporter can reach directly."
"But it's possible to enter his carriage through random doors—it just requires some slight adjustments in 'probability.'"
"However... I've always had good luck."
Lin Yu calmly stated his analysis about the Baron's hiding place.
Moreover, he didn't present it as reasoning and analysis, but spoke with a certain, confident tone as if he possessed some inside information.
The Blue Blood Team members looked at each other, and one young man couldn't help speaking up.
"Feels like we're hearing something incredible..."
The Iron Thorn member was even more intimidated by Lin Yu, not daring to delay for even a moment as he hurriedly pulled out a communicator from his chest pocket.
"Your Excellency Baron, I've encountered a very formidable woman here..."
The Iron Thorn member faithfully reported everything that happened in Carriage 9 and all the content Lin Yu wanted conveyed to the "Baron" on the other end of the communicator, speaking loud enough for Lin Yu to hear without adding any embellishments.
The communicator flashed with a low-frequency green light. After a long while, a distorted voice filled with static and electrical noise finally came through.
"You can hear me, correct?"
The voice echoed through the quiet carriage.
Though no specific target was indicated, Lin Yu knew...
The Baron was speaking directly to him.
Lin Yu slightly raised his voice: "Yes, I can hear you... Your Excellency Baron."
"Good, I understand your request," the Baron's distorted voice sounded again, "I'm willing to meet with you as well... After all, you managed to restore the out-of-control Delta Team Leader to sanity and carry a B-3 level privilege card. I'm quite curious about who you really are."
The Baron directly gave an affirmative response to Lin Yu's meeting request.
Li Nian, who had witnessed Lin Yu's entire operation from behind, gave a thumbs up.
"Sister Zhu Ming is truly impressive! She actually managed to intimidate what might be the dungeon's BOSS-like existence!"
Wang Yuyang also nodded slightly: "She indeed possesses the qualifications to join us."
As for Chen Zhuo, he felt like he had hit the jackpot.
Was this the kind of expert you could hire for just a few hundred points?
With just a few words, without shedding a single drop of blood, she obtained a meeting opportunity with the BOSS!
This was truly an expert among experts.
However...
Lin Yu's next move once again took everyone by surprise.
"Well, allow me to decline for now."
When these words came out, not to mention the other players and NPCs in the carriage, even the "Baron" in the communicator was clearly caught off guard.
"What?"
"Wasn't it you who requested to meet with me?"
The Baron's voice remained distorted, making it impossible to discern emotional fluctuations.
But even so, everyone could hear the clear confusion and even annoyance in the voice coming through the communicator.
Lin Yu remained composed.
"I didn't expect things to go so smoothly either. My original plan didn't include meeting you immediately."
"Because before our meeting, I originally had other matters to attend to..."
"My apologies for underestimating your decisiveness."
He responded to the Baron with a tone and wording that made it completely impossible to get angry.
The Baron fell silent.
If not for the communicator's light still flashing, the Iron Thorn member holding it would have almost thought the Baron had angrily cut off communication.
After a full minute of lengthy silence, the communicator sounded again.
"Fine, but I want to know what preparations you intend to make."
Lin Yu laughed lightly: "Oh, I don't mind telling you that."
"I need to find that guy who came up in the same batch as me, the one from D-5 carriage."

chapters.title: Chapter 244: The Last Player
chapters.content:
Inside Carriage 3.
Looking at Lin Yu's calm expression, Wang Yuyang lowered his voice again to ask.
"Are you trying to test Baron's control over the Despair Train while buying time and putting on a bluff?"
"Of course."
Hearing Wang Yuyang's question, Lin Yu felt inwardly impressed.
Indeed, this Designer was quite clever—he was the first among the players to grasp his intention.
Noticing Li Nian moving closer to listen in, Lin Yu continued explaining along Wang Yuyang's line of thought.
"Although this might expose our inability to immediately find that last player... there are benefits too."
"Regardless, Designer eliminated the Airport Gang, and I restored Pang Kedo's clarity while revealing his location—we've already demonstrated sufficient capability."
"But to negotiate cooperation, we need him to know not only what we can do, but also what we cannot.""In Baron's eyes, what identity do we hold?"
"He hasn't touched the realm of gods, so he wouldn't consider the possibility of 'players'—the world prevents him from forming such cognition," Lin Yu said softly. "So we're nothing more than just members of some faction within Sleepless City, including Truth Corporation."
"And he's most likely a former Truth Corporation executive—whether abandoned or exiled now, he's trapped on this train like these prisoners."
"We can't gain his trust through 'identity'—so to make him willing to cooperate, we must make this Baron believe that we genuinely need him too."
As Lin Yu spoke, Li Nian suddenly understood.
"And his greatest advantage on this train... is his familiarity with and possible partial control over the train itself!"
"Exactly. Since I used Pang Kedo's privilege card earlier, I've realized something," Lin Yu said calmly. "Those employees exiled here likely still have their privileges active... they remain valid on this train."
"In other words, that Baron would still cling to his superiority of 'being on home ground,' confident in holding higher privileges than us."
"If we also need his privileges, he'll feel more secure coming to the negotiation table."
Wang Yuyang looked at Lin Yu, unable to contain his admiration: "One link connecting another—what meticulous calculation."
Pan Yuqiang was even more astonished: "No wonder he's S-grade."
She added as if reminding her boyfriend: "You didn't even know Baron existed before... meaning these calculations emerged almost instantly just now."
"The plan itself isn't particularly ingenious, but you formulated the strategy while negotiating with Baron... truly astonishing."
Of course, improvisation is my specialty—Lin Yu thought this but couldn't voice such lines that clearly didn't fit Zhu Ming's persona.
He could only smile gently and modestly say: "My profession offers no decisive advantage in direct combat or survival, and I'm not particularly clever myself, so I can only rely on some 'quick wit'... frankly just some petty clever tricks."
"Besides, I initially somewhat intended to actually find that remaining player."
"Why?"
Li Nian instinctively asked.
"Because this dungeon's level specification isn't low. Setting aside backgrounds like Truth Corporation, just looking at the players who entered... we're a Second Tier, First Tier leading a team including Chen Zhuo who's unranked but has many items;
Designer and his friend are two Second Tiers..."
As Lin Yu spoke, Wang Yuyang nodded.
"That remaining solo player is most likely highly skilled too."
"With such experts in this cooperation-oriented dungeon, temporary teaming would be ideal... if cooperation fails, early contact to detect clues would help us stay vigilant, avoiding being caught off-guard when confronting dangerous figures within the dungeon."
Pan Yuqiang also expressed agreement: "Indeed a good idea."
Lin Yu nodded: "Yes, unless that guy is very unlucky or used some special item, his strength should match this dungeon's level."
"Then the question arises," Li Nian voiced her doubt, "where should we look for him?"
Lin Yu continued analyzing.
"He boarded from Carriage 5 but didn't appear in Carriage 3, and he's not in Carriages 9 or 12 either..."
"Although theoretically Carriage 5 can't directly access Carriage 6, since they're adjacent carriages, perhaps we should check Carriage 6?"
This analysis gained approval from the others.
Wang Yuyang and Pan Yuqiang had arrived at Dining Car 3 very early but never saw the player who should have been in their same section.
So Li Nian waved her hand, calling back Chen Zhuo who had been responsible for finding topics to distract Pang Kedo.
The chubby boy cheerfully returned with Pang Kedo.
"Time to depart?"
"Yes, to Dining Car 6."
Li Nian looked Chen Zhuo up and down, noticing he seemed unexpectedly chatty with Pang Kedo.
Chen Zhuo's cheerfulness wasn't surprising, but Pang Kedo—this amnesiac Truth Corporation employee, this middle-aged man with a perpetually bitter expression—now looked quite relaxed, making Li Nian unable to resist asking.
"What were you two talking about?"
Pang Kedo looked at Chen Zhuo, quite moved: "He enlightened me with several profound yet simple allegorical stories and cautionary tales, resolving the confusion in my heart."
This shocked even Lin Yu.
"He enlightened you? Allegorical stories?"
As someone who knew Chen Zhuo fairly well, Lin Yu found this rather unbelievable.
Was this chubby boy hiding his brilliance?
Even Li Nian, Wang Yuyang, and Pan Yuqiang, who didn't know Chen Zhuo well, couldn't help looking at him with expressions of "Did I misjudge him?"
Seeing everyone's puzzled looks, Chen Zhuo couldn't help but chuckle.
"They're called allegories, but I just told this uncle about some anime character experiences that matched his vibe... and casually shared some famous anime lines."
"Like Fate/Zero, Death Note, Devilman, Ghost in the Shell, Berserk, Hellsing, Evangelion, and such..."
Chen Zhuo rattled them off like reciting a menu.
Li Nian couldn't help but facepalm: "Good grief, anime master! It would've been better if you hadn't mentioned these titles—now I'm even more convinced... which of these works are suitable for enlightenment? There aren't even any proper shonen ones among them!"
Chen Zhuo scratched his head: "I don't know either! You told me to chat with him about anything, so I started rambling, and then this uncle suddenly said he found these very interesting and helpful."
"Nobody ever talks about these with me in class, so when he said that, how could I possibly stop myself!"

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Meeting Another Acquaintance!
chapters.content:
Regardless of what Chen Zhuo told the amnesiac Pang Kedo, whether it would shake this conveniently forgetful uncle's worldview, or what chain reactions it might cause in this dungeon world in the future...
At least for now, everything remained normal.
For Lin Yu, the more pressing question worth pondering was...
"He's not in carriage six either?"
Looking at the group of burly, robust men tied up in a line in carriage six, currently being searched by Pang Kedo for any valuable items, Lin Yu expressed his amazement.
The Lion Gang entrenched here lived up to their name—a group of physically imposing men.
Their strength seemed far superior to other gangs, and consequently their tempers appeared more explosive too—upon seeing someone enter carriage six, they immediately cursed with some colorful Tibetan phrases and started fighting.
They didn't even seem particularly afraid of Pang Kedo.
And then...
Perhaps this "Lion Gang" genuinely had some capability, enough that ordinary players might meet their end if they encountered them.But in this current dungeon, there were already three Second-Tier players present.
These NPCs had struggled to survive just a few purges on this Despair Train, while the players' clearance condition was about how to escape this "train."
So throughout the entire process, not even Chen Zhuo who had hired help needed to intervene, let alone Lin Yu, Pan Yuqiang, or even Pang Kedo.
Even Li Nian only stepped in because she felt like taking down a couple of people for fun.
Wang Yuyang basically handled everything by himself.
This was also the first time Lin Yu had seen how Wang Yuyang, the Designer, fought.
Although he resolved the battle so quickly that Lin Yu couldn't see clearly.
But Lin Yu still caught the general method.
Wang Yuyang was "creating objects" out of thin air—he simply reached out his hand, and a process resembling 3D printing would manifest some weapon in the air.
Earlier he had sequentially used three different weapons: a short staff, a flail, and brass knuckles, each used only briefly.
Unlike the Painter, Wang Yuyang's process didn't even require any medium or wind-up time.
This didn't belong to any known Class ability that Lin Yu was aware of.
If it were a [prop], then this thing must be an extremely rare and precious type—likely one with "notes" and "descriptions."
But Lin Yu still leaned toward Wang Yuyang currently using his Class ability.
Earlier when he introduced himself and when Li Nian introduced him, neither had mentioned his Class.
And his code name was Designer—among known ordinary Classes, this Class didn't exist.
And within the Free Alliance, the code names they used seemed mostly related to their own Classes.
So...
"Probably another Unique Class? No wonder the Free Alliance, despite having few members, receives such attention from both Order and the forum."
Lin Yu reached his conclusion.
Of course, regardless of what Wang Yuyang's class was, the most important matter at hand remained the whereabouts of the final player.
"He's not in carriage six, which means he either happened to miss us by going to a different dining car at different times, or he never went to any dining car at all..."
Wang Yuyang mused, and Pan Yuqiang understood what her boyfriend was thinking: "Could he be deliberately avoiding us?"
"Very likely."
Wang Yuyang nodded.
Li Nian rubbed her chin: "A lone wolf type? If nothing works, just let him go solo!"
"Don't you have any tracking methods?"
Lin Yu asked curiously.
Wang Yuyang and Li Nian shook their heads simultaneously.
"I don't have any."
Li Nian scratched her head: "I do have 'people-finding' methods, but in this kind of compartmentalized space with separate carriages, they're not very effective."
"If nothing works, we could contact Baron and ask for his help. Although further showing weakness might be excessive, if we really want to find him, we could try..."
Pan Yuqiang also analyzed.
Chen Zhuo sighed regretfully: "Ah, it's really a case of 'you never appreciate props until you need them.' Someone was selling me a [Life Detection Radar] earlier, but I thought what use could that thing be selling for 300 points each, so I didn't buy it."
Then, an unexpected voice spoke up.
One of the Lion Gang members on the ground spoke up timidly.
"Um... are you looking for someone who just boarded the train?"
"The one who boarded at carriage five?"
