Although limited by cognitive interference, he basically couldn't understand what these experts were saying...
But he didn't find it strange—given his background as a bottom-tier enforcer from Sleepless City, basically half-illiterate, encountering experts saying things he couldn't understand was perfectly normal.
Before Lin Yu could signal, Pang Kedo stopped searching and walked over to the Lion Gang man.
"You have information?"
"Yes, yes," the man nodded like pounding garlic, "We saw the newcomer board earlier. Although carriages 7 and 8 didn't have anyone, according to our previous agreement with the Airport Gang, when both 4 and 5 have people, carriage 5 can belong to us."
"So we were just rubbing our hands together waiting for the newcomer in carriage five to pass the first two 'challenges,' then we'd go ask the Airport Gang for passage."
"Once a newcomer passes the first few rounds, the dining car screen will show which carriage can now enter to fight the newcomer."
The Lion Gang man lifted his chin, indicating the screen.
Pang Kedo gritted his teeth and rubbed his temples: "Now that you mention it, I vaguely remember something like this procedure."
"Yes, but we waited until you arrived, and still didn't get the carriage five notification. Carriages 4 and 13 finished up pretty quickly though."
The Lion Gang man said carefully, clearly having realized these people were the "newcomers" from carriages 4 and 13.
Lin Yu also caught on.
"So, that person might still be in carriage five?"
"Deliberately controlling the timing?" Wang Yuyang also frowned, "What a rather elusive fellow. Yuqiang, what do you think?"
Pan Yuqiang shrugged: "I don't have any ideas either, too little information."
"But it does sound like a very confident expert type... After all, even at our level, the first reaction upon entering a dungeon is 'race against time' and 'gather information.'"
Wang Yuyang nodded: "Then we'll have to meet him personally—let's go, I'm getting interested in this final player too."
He stood up, a forming long sword materializing in his hand.
"No need to kill these people."
Pan Yuqiang gently patted Wang Yuyang's right hand.
Wang Yuyang softly said "Oh," then the mostly-formed long sword in his hand dissipated.
Seeing this scene, Lin Yu couldn't help but complain internally.
Leaving the already dejected Lion Gang in the dining car, they returned to dining car 3.
Passing through dining car 4, Lin Yu's group stood before the door to carriage 5.
Perhaps because the trial inside carriage 5 hadn't ended yet, the connecting door was currently closed.
But this didn't stump Lin Yu.
He took out Pang Kedo's privilege card and swiped it...
"Beep—"
Sure enough, even just C-2 level privileges were sufficient to open the temporarily sealed carriage door due to the ongoing trial.
Just as the door opened and everyone raised their guard, preparing to meet the final expert inside...
Screams of genuine distress came from within.
"Stop hitting! Brother Robot! I'll buy you a battery, okay?"
Hearing this familiar voice, Lin Yu put down his guard with a strange expression.
Looking inside, he indeed saw another acquaintance.
Fu Luo, wearing his straw hat and looking like a foreigner, was jumping around the carriage, being chased in circles by a boxing robot less than half a meter tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: The Feud Between Chen Zhuo and Fu Luo
chapters.content:
Even though Lin Yu might be the only one present who recognized this player Fu Luo, the others also let their guard down after seeing his actual performance.
Or rather...
Anyone who saw Fu Luo being chased around like a dog by a small robot wouldn't consider him much of a threat.
Li Nian sighed: "Well, we all overthought this - turns out this guy really is just terrible."
Chen Zhuo couldn't help but laugh: "He's not even as good as me... With that robot, if I was willing to use some consumables, I could hold my own!"
Wang Yuyang looked at Fu Luo and raised a more practical question.
"Are we still taking him with us?"
Before Lin Yu could speak, Pan Yuqiang spoke up instead.
"Straw hat, light-colored hair, looks foreign, Henan accent," this member of the Psychological Society's Execution Department seemed to remember something as she looked at her boyfriend,
"Yuqiang, save him first."Hearing Pan Yuqiang's words, Wang Yuyang didn't question it and immediately stepped into the carriage.
"Friend, I'll help you!"
He announced loudly, crossing his hands...
This time, what appeared in Wang Yuyang's hands were two thin metal throwing darts.
He flicked his right wrist, and the darts shot out swiftly.
"Clink! Snap!"
The two darts arrived in sequence - the first one lodged in front of the robot's rotating wheels, skillfully throwing it off balance.
The second dart aimed at the robot's chassis - this dart had no sharp point, instead featuring a magnetic suction stone at its tip.
"Click!"
The dart stuck to the bottom of the robot, then erupted with blue-white electric arcs.
"Crackle!"
The already small robot crashed to the ground and instantly stopped moving.
In just an instant, Wang Yuyang had dealt with the robot that had been troubling Fu Luo for so long.
Saved so easily by Wang Yuyang, Fu Luo stopped his frantic escape and slumped into a seat as if relieved.
"Saved!"
Then, he looked toward the direction of his savior.
Lin Yu saw Fu Luo adjust his straw hat, his scrutinizing gaze sweeping over everyone.
Then, this 'Detective' stood up again.
"Thank you, experts, for saving me. My code name is 'Furbollo', profession is 'Detective'... May I ask how I should address you all?"
Hearing Fu Luo's self-introduction, Pan Yuqiang stepped forward: "So it really is that unranked 'Detective'."
Hearing Pan Yuqiang's words, Lin Yu understood.
So she also recognized Fu Luo... though he didn't know how she knew him.
Logically, while Fu Luo was famous, he wasn't known by everyone.
Moreover, judging from Pan Yuqiang's earlier reaction... she should have heard of and knew about Fu Luo, but hadn't actually met him in person.
But after hearing Fu Luo's self-introduction, one person seemed even more excited.
Chen Zhuo looked at the other party and exclaimed in surprise: "Holy shit, you're Fudog!"
Hearing Chen Zhuo's exclamation, Fu Luo flicked his hat brim, put away the straw hat, and replaced it with an ordinary baseball cap.
"You're quite rude, little fatty, calling me by my black name offline, huh?"
Chen Zhuo grew annoyed hearing Fu Luo's heavily Henan-accented, condescending tone: "What's wrong with calling you Fudog? You're always spouting nonsense on the forum... I just can't stand you!"
After saying this, he moved closer to Lin Yu and Li Nian, gaining more confidence.
Seeing Chen Zhuo like this, Fu Luo instead became thoughtful, stroking his chin: "Have you been arguing with me on the forum recently?"
"Of course, you randomly flamed me for an entire night!"
Chen Zhuo said indignantly, while glancing sideways at Lin Yu.
Fu Luo suddenly understood.
"Oh, I know who you are now, that 'Ai-chan', right?" He slapped his thigh and exclaimed with feeling, "Damn, you're really petty. I just said a couple things like Conan is pseudo-reasoning and many cases are kinda dumbed down - was that necessary?"
Chen Zhuo's face flushed red: "How is it unnecessary? Don't make it sound so trivial! I admit myself that most of Conan's reasoning parts are actually average, but your exact words were 'Anyone who can stomach watching eight hundred episodes of this logically flawed, mentally challenged unit drama masquerading as reasoning must be gods among gods. It's understandable if you're in it for the characters, but those who like Haibara Ai must have never seen a woman in their life, you private-study lolicons' - and you said it directly under my post! I was just keeping to my own circle, why did you have to jump in my face!"
Fu Luo also couldn't hold back: "I'm fucking done! You call that keeping to your own circle? Even if the forum has a water section, you can't build a true love appreciation thread for Haibara Ai in the 'Death Game' themed forum, right? Did you really think this was a forum for random posts?"
"Well the Game Master didn't delete it!"
Chen Zhuo became even more emphatic.
As the two went back and forth, their online feud gradually became clear.
Among the remaining people, Pang Kedo, being a non-player, naturally couldn't understand any of it...
And among the four players, three couldn't access the forum.
The only one who could access the forum, Lin Yu, also didn't really browse the water section.
So all four were shocked by the two's behavior.
"Both sides are the dumbest of the dumb."
Li Nian laughed and remarked.
Pan Yuqiang even fell into thought: "Our organization gave 'Furbollo' quite a high potential rating. Even though he never 'advanced', many people have been observing him... Did we get something wrong?"
Watching the two argue, Lin Yu also found it amusing.
But she still looked at Li Nian.
"Don't just watch the show, handle this."
"After all, one side is our employer... and letting this continue isn't productive."
Lin Yu said softly. Li Nian pursed her lips.
"Why don't you go?"
"I'm not good at this - bluffing and intimidation are my strengths, mediation isn't really my thing."
"Especially with players."
Lin Yu said calmly.
Li Nian seemed to remember the results of last time when she had Lin Yu negotiate with Heavenly Artisan, and shuddered.
"True, better let me handle it."
Saying this, Li Nian stepped forward and patted Chen Zhuo.
"Although backing you up in a flame war isn't within our service scope, consider it a freebie. Remember to give us a five-star review."
Li Nian said in a lowered voice, then looked at Fu Luo.
"Hey, Furbollo, you've introduced yourself and know the little fatty's identity."
"But the rest of us haven't introduced ourselves yet... Let me tell you, the short-haired girl in white behind me and I were hired by this little fatty, and the other couple are also my friends."
"My code name is 'Master Thief', the short-haired girl's code name is 'Zhu Ming', the guy in that couple is 'Designer'... It's fine if you've heard of them."
"The three of us are from the 'Free Alliance'."
"By the way, the girl from the couple who spoke to you earlier has the code name 'Citalopram', and she's a cadre of the 'Psychological Society'."
"So, I advise you to be sma..."
Before Li Nian could finish speaking, she saw a figure flash before her eyes.
"Thump!"
Fu Luo dropped to his knees with lightning speed, grabbing Chen Zhuo's hand with a serious expression.
"Bro, Haibara Ai is literally the most perfect woman in the world."
"All my previous slander against Ai-chan came from my jealousy and incompetence. Only someone with messed-up values would think a resilient and intelligent woman like Sherry isn't worth liking. I only disparaged Ai-chan to make myself seem special and unique."
"And Conan is actually a very deep work. Being able to continuously serialize and produce so much content over so many years - having minor flaws in some episodes is just small blemishes that don't detract from the jade's beauty. Gosho Aoyama-sensei is the true god of Japanese reasoning. Seishi Yokomizo and Seichō Matsumoto have been overly deified by everyone - they were just lucky to be born before Aoyama-sensei, mere mortals compared to him."

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Fu Luo’s Insider News and Intimidation
chapters.content:
Under Fu Luo's flexible personality that could bend or stretch as needed, he reconciled with Chen Zhuo on the spot.
"Bro, you never told me you had the connections to get in touch with the big shots from the Free Alliance - we're practically family fighting family here!"
"To be honest, I'm actually half a Conan fan myself, but the TV series has been putting out too much garbage lately, and the movies keep getting worse than the last, so naturally I love it deeply but criticize it harshly."
Although Chen Zhuo had initially been worried about Li Nian and "Zhu Ming's" identities, he now couldn't help but straighten his back proudly.
"After all, this is the forum - mentioning connections to the Free Alliance would just be asking for trouble, right?"
"Besides, I'm a low-key kind of guy. I know someone even more impressive that I haven't even mentioned!"
Chen Zhuo waved his hand, putting on a humble appearance.
Li Nian was quite happy to watch this chubby kid using her reputation to show off.
Lin Yu stepped forward, cleared his throat lightly, then looked at Fu Luo.
"Anyway, we've revealed our backgrounds to you... Furbollo, I've heard of your reputation too.""Even though you just got thoroughly embarrassed by a robot, I know you're just not good at combat."
"This train seems like a Survival and Slaughter type dungeon, but there are actually some mysteries here."
Before Fu Luo could respond, Wang Yuyang added.
"I've heard of you too. You've done a lot of work for Order."
"If hearing which organization we belong to makes you not want to work with us, I personally understand."
Fu Luo coughed lightly: "How could that be, Brother Designer... Did you see how fast I dropped to my knees? Do I look like someone with that much integrity?"
"This isn't a Player Competition dungeon anyway - we can work together to clear it harmoniously, what's wrong with that?"
"It's not like anyone would report me to Order after we get out, right?"
Fu Luo patted his chest as he made this guarantee: "Everyone rest assured, leave the puzzles to me from now on... Coincidentally, this train probably belongs to Truth Corporation, and I just happen to have plenty of experience with this company!"
Lin Yu also nodded.
"Excellent, let's move out then."
As she spoke, Fu Luo looked confused: "Huh? Where to?"
Li Nian laughed as she explained: "While you were battling wits and courage with that useless robot just now, we actually accomplished quite a lot - anyway, we're going to find the person most likely to be close to the Mastermind on this train."
"Someone called 'Baron'."
Fu Luo froze for a moment, then said: "Baron? Could it be Truth Corporation's 'Baron Coleman' who should have been executed after failing to assassinate the CEO?"
This statement shocked everyone around them.
"You actually know about this?!"
Li Nian was astonished.
"Holy shit, so the forum people were right... Fu... Fuzi, you really do have some skills."
Chen Zhuo also expressed amazement.
Pan Yuqiang proudly elbowed Wang Yuyang: "See, I was right to have you save him."
"Of course, you're rarely wrong about these things."
Only Lin Yu wasn't surprised that Fu Luo knew so much about this train.
Back during the Snow Mountain incident, Fu Luo had already revealed that this wasn't his first time dealing with Truth Corporation.
Moreover, if you only looked at dungeon experience without considering tier...
Fu Luo was genuinely more experienced than Li Nian - he might have even been around longer than Wang Yuyang and Pan Yuqiang.
But what surprised Lin Yu was...
Even Pang Kedo showed a shocked expression: "Baron Coleman, I have a newly made friend... no, I should say a friend from when I first joined the company, someone named Jerry Coleman."
Fu Luo had noticed the NPC in their group earlier. After clearly seeing the "F-6" and outfit, he frowned and asked: "What's your background?"
"Met him in carriage 13, he was in a crazed state before, but we knocked some sense into him and he lost his memory - former field agent for Truth Corporation."
Lin Yu briefly introduced Pang Kedo.
Pang Kedo also nodded: "Yes, just call me Pang Kedo."
Fu Luo remained silent for a while, then said: "It wouldn't be Delta Team, would it?"
Pang Kedo looked surprised: "How did you know?"
Lin Yu added: "Although he might not remember, based on his identity card... this guy was the leader of that Delta Team."
Hearing this, Fu Luo's expression grew increasingly grim.
He took off his hat, grabbed his hair, then showed a pained expression.
"Shit... shit! Shit! We're screwed!"
"I should have realized earlier - with three Free Alliance members gathered together, this dungeon definitely won't be simple at all."
"This isn't good, is every Promotion Trial of mine destined to be this fucking ridiculous?!"
Seeing Fu Luo's somewhat broken state, Lin Yu stepped forward and gently patted his shoulder.
"This is your Promotion Trial? Never mind... that's not important right now. Just explain first."
"What's exactly the situation with Pang Kedo and Baron Coleman?"
Fu Luo looked up, his face miserable: "Damn it, I already said it - Baron Coleman's crime was attempting to assassinate Truth Corporation's current CEO."
"And his accomplice was the leader of Security Department's Field Operations Delta Team."
"According to Truth Corporation's archives, these two should have died seven years ago!"
"This involves the power struggles at the very top of Truth Corporation... factional conflicts between the highest privileges."
"And when you reach A-level privileges, you either have combat power comparable to Third Tier, or you can mobilize forces of similar level."
"Like this Delta Team leader you're bringing along - even though his privilege level is C, he underwent the 'Eight Transformations' and is one of the few 'successful works' from Truth Corporation's 'Calamity Series'."
"Someone from this same series once killed a division head of the Marauders!"
Lin Yu remained calm: "So what? He's on our side now, isn't he?"
Pang Kedo nodded: "That's right... although assassinating the CEO sounds rather outrageous, I'm not crazy."
"And I believe Coleman isn't either - moreover, you said we were accomplices, so perhaps he'll give me some face."
Fu Luo shrank back even more: "No no no, this definitely won't go that smoothly..."
As he spoke, he moved away from Pang Kedo, pulling Lin Yu and Li Nian closer, continuing with a bitter expression in a low voice.
"My current Promotion Trial is to 'investigate the truth behind three wrongful cases on the Despair Train'... believe me, anything involving Promotion definitely won't be simple."
Back during the Snow Mountain incident, Fu Luo had already revealed that this wasn't his first time dealing with Truth Corporation.
"If you're really worried, just don't investigate," Lin Yu said calmly. "We're looking for Baron anyway because we want to quickly figure out how to get the Train Tickets."
"This train has a variable called the 'purge' every 72 hours... waiting around idly might be dangerous too."
Although Fu Luo jumped at hearing the term "purge," he still hesitated.
"This..."
"Stop dawdling already," Li Nian scolded, then turned to look at Pan Yuqiang. "Hey, sister, lend me your guy for a bit."
Pan Yuqiang nodded slightly, and Wang Yuyang slowly walked over.
"What do you need me for?"
Li Nian pointed at Wang Yuyang, once again adopting a fierce expression: "The introduction earlier was rather rushed, let me properly introduce this Designer who's dating a Psychological Society executioner."
"He just killed over a dozen people in dining car 3 because he was in a bad mood - the bounty on Hunters' Association for him is enough to buy a house in Haicheng!"
"You dropped to your knees in fear when you heard we were from Free Alliance earlier, why are you hesitating now?"
"Are you saying we're not as intimidating as Truth Corporation when it comes to throwing down?"

chapters.title: Chapter 248: The Baron's Hiding Place
chapters.content:
After Lin Yu grabbed Fu Luo by the collar and dragged him to Carriage 3, the piled-up corpses throughout the carriage once again confirmed that Li Nian's words weren't just empty threats.
Fu Luo couldn't help but feel relieved that he had made the right choice.
After the team regrouped, Lin Yu decided it was time to formally meet this Baron Coleman.
Passing through the door marked with "ROLL" indicating randomness.
Perhaps because this group had decent luck, they reached a completely new carriage on their first attempt.
Unlike any carriage they had seen before, even the artistic style felt somewhat different.
It more closely resembled the connection spaces between carriages—those dark, narrow areas filled with canned eyeballs.
This carriage was equally dim, with only the glowing red D-2 carriage number visible in the darkness.
The only other light sources came from faint white lights at the bases of large stacked containers on both sides.
Except these containers no longer held eyeballs.The front row of containers held various organs.
Some contained hearts, others stomachs and brains, though their sizes and shapes didn't appear human.
Behind several rows of organ containers were sleeping, pale human bodies—men and women, young and old, all with different builds, curled up in some invisible liquid as if nestled in swaddling clothes.
"This Carriage 2 is seriously creepy," Li Nian remarked with feeling.
Chen Zhuo felt even more chilled, shrinking fearfully into the middle of the group.
This time he became the most timid one among them.
Because Fu Luo remained quite calm, as if these things couldn't frighten him.
"So this is indeed the modified core section of the Despair Train," Fu Luo stepped forward and tapped on a container, watching as fluorescent bubbles scattered through the liquid inside. "These 'organ containers' are 'emotional amplification' devices..."
"Combined with those 'eyeball containers' from before serving as 'emotional detection' devices, this train is indeed a very standard energy supply unit design."
Fu Luo's explanation left everyone stunned and bewildered.
Lin Yu instinctively asked: "What about those containers holding people behind them?"
"Excellent question... they're backup material containers," Fu Luo answered with a look of disgust.
Hearing Fu Luo's explanation, even Pang Kedo, former Truth Corporation employee, couldn't help speaking up.
"Might I ask who exactly you are? You wouldn't happen to be some high-ranking corporate official too?"
Even he wasn't entirely clear about these details!
Fu Luo just smiled: "Old friend, you lost your memory first, then got locked up here for so long—of course you wouldn't know who I am... If you were still outside properly serving as field team leader, you should know my identity."
"Oh wow, he's really putting on airs now," Li Nian remarked with feeling.
But she had to admit, Fu Luo truly knew plenty.
Even Pan Yuqiang set aside her previous dismissiveness.
"It seems the organization's assessment of him was indeed accurate."
Lin Yu also looked at Fu Luo: "Since you say this carriage is important, what suggestions do you have?"
He knew Fu Luo's capabilities quite well.
This guy had survived eighteen dungeons without promotion or death, which itself proved that someone who couldn't even beat robots must have exceptional abilities in certain aspects.
Chen Zhuo safely surviving four dungeons was similar—this chubby guy not only had good luck and substantial resources, but also a natural affinity.
Though a standard Otaku, encountering someone like him in a Death Game dungeon... most people probably wouldn't even consider harming him.
The same applied to Fu Luo.
But she had to admit, Fu Luo truly knew plenty.
Especially since they had also faced a mess left by "Truth Corporation" that time.
Indeed, after brief consideration, Fu Luo spoke up.
"If I'm not mistaken, Baron Coleman, you should already be watching us, right?"
"Or rather, you're not in Carriage 1... but right here, correct?"
As he spoke, Fu Luo spread his hands.
This guy had survived eighteen dungeons without promotion or death, which itself proved that someone who couldn't even beat robots must have exceptional abilities in certain aspects.
Chen Zhuo safely surviving four dungeons was similar—this chubby guy not only had good luck and substantial resources, but also a natural affinity.
Wang Yuyang looked at Fu Luo: "Furbollo, what's going on?"
Lin Yu however realized: "He's bluffing the Baron."
Fu Luo calmly withdrew his hands, expression neutral: "Unfortunately, he's not here so my bluff didn't work..."
Having actually witnessed Fu Luo's full deductive capabilities during the mountain dungeon, Lin Yu greatly trusted Fu Luo's judgment in these mystery-filled "dungeons."
Chen Zhuo couldn't help looking at Fu Luo with admiration: "Fuzi, you're really something! I'd be dying of embarrassment!"
Fu Luo smiled slightly: "I am dying of embarrassment—just putting on a brave face right now."
"That damned Baron Coleman made me lose all face!"
Li Nian chuckled helplessly: "Ahaha, you're quite interesting, Furbollo."
"Just your professional skills aren't quite up to par though."
Furbollo's face flushed even redder: "I was just testing randomly—analysis requires trial and error anyway."
But Lin Yu suddenly spoke up.
"No, Furbollo's analysis wasn't wrong."
After saying this, he walked toward one particular container.
This container was mixed among the "material containers," containing a somewhat tall, well-proportioned man floating inside with knees drawn to his chest.
Lin Yu tapped on the container.
"Respected Baron, the playing dead can end now."
The container showed no movement.
"Not admitting it? Fair enough... After all, my 'companion' just tried bluffing, and you probably have some method of reading others' emotions."
"Seems I'll need to provide reasoning convincing enough for you... Though honestly, I was simply playing spot-the-difference," Lin Yu calmly looked at the other containers. "All the remaining containers hold men and women, young and old, but they share one common trait..."
"Emaciated to an unhealthy degree."
"They're probably from Sleepless City's lower levels—whether selling their bodies to Truth Corporation or among the 'disappeared' population..."
"Anyway, your physique is too healthy, sir—with a build like this, you're definitely no 'Expendable Material,' at least not the kind meant to be preserved in these containers."
As he spoke, Lin Yu continued calmly.
"Of course, after noticing this and observing more carefully, your posture also seems designed to block your face and vital areas."
"And your liquid... has different light refraction properties, probably because yours needs to sustain life while the others only need preservation."
The man inside the container opened his eyes and stretched his form.
Unlike the completely naked bodies, he wore extremely tight shorts, and his curled-up face was covered with some high-tech mask.
Through the container's transparent shell, he looked at Lin Yu.
Then, a voice clearer than before but still with some electrical static sounded throughout the carriage.
"Extremely clever."
"Pleased to meet you, respected lady."

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Negotiating a Partnership with the Baron
chapters.content:
There was no doubt that the man in the tank before them was the most prestigious "Baron" aboard this "Despair Train."
When he revealed half of his face, Pang Kedo, who had stepped forward in two or three strides, confirmed that he was indeed "Coleman."
"My heavens, Jerry Coleman, it's really you—you've matured so much compared to my memories."
"You can just say I've aged," Baron Coleman in the tank turned slightly to look at Pang Kedo. "Do you think you're still young? Oh, right—you're lucid now but with incomplete memories, so you probably do think you're young."
The chaotic static noise once again transmitted through the carriage's broadcast system.
Listening to Coleman's words, Lin Yu immediately drew a conclusion.
The relationship between Baron Coleman and Pang Kedo was undoubtedly close.
Although Pang Kedo had lost those memories now and treated Coleman merely like a familiar colleague, the teasing tone in Coleman's words made Lin Yu feel that his attitude toward Pang Kedo was at least fundamentally affectionate.
"Alright, old friend, you haven't remembered anything, so catching up is pointless, and this isn't the right occasion for reminiscing anyway... Let me chat more with this lady instead."
Baron Coleman spoke as he turned his gaze back to Lin Yu."Now then, miss... how should I address you?"
"You can call me Zhu Ming," Lin Yu said calmly.
"Miss Zhu Ming," Baron Coleman said, "I'd like to know why you've come."
"Train Ticket," Lin Yu stated concisely. "I need to know how to obtain a 'Train Ticket'—a fast, effective method that will actually get results."
Baron Coleman chuckled softly upon hearing this: "You really are clever, realizing that the 'Ticket Fragments' everyone on this train is scrambling for are the least efficient method."
"After all, it's about collecting 'despair'-type emotions. If they could obtain it through effort alone, wouldn't that be too unfortunate?" Lin Yu said calmly. "And I'm not that clever either."
"Why do you say that?" Coleman asked, looking at Lin Yu.
Lin Yu gave his reply: "Because I thought the 'Ticket Fragments' method was a complete scam."
Coleman, immersed in fluid within the tank, visibly paused for a moment before laughter echoed through the carriage.
"Ha, ha, ha... What an amusing thought."
"Good thing you're not part of Truth Corporation's upper management."
Then, Coleman looked Lin Yu up and down and spoke again.
"No wonder I can't see through your soul. I thought it might be some divine concealment or something... But now it seems it's simply because you yourself cannot be seen through."
"However, business is business."
"You want answers about the 'Train Ticket'—what can you offer me in exchange?"
Lin Yu looked at Baron Coleman and pointed to Pang Kedo beside him.
"Isn't rescuing your friend from madness enough?"
Baron Coleman's gaze in the tank turned profound: "This wasn't something I commissioned."
Lin Yu hadn't really expected to get the answer for free anyway;
he was just testing the waters.
So when Baron Coleman refused, he remained composed.
"Very well, Your Lordship. Since you think I'm clever... and you've witnessed my companion's strength, why not commission me?"
"I want the Train Ticket to leave this train—you know how to leave but have never done so, which means you cannot leave here."
"But you must still have things you want to accomplish, right? At the very least, that matter which caused you and Pang Kedo to end up here—you never finished it yourself."
When Lin Yu reached this point, Baron Coleman understood his meaning.
"That matter's value far exceeds the method of obtaining a 'Train Ticket'," Baron Coleman replied.
"Then you can add something else to balance it," Lin Yu said easily. "I certainly don't mind making the transaction more fair."
"I think you've misunderstood me, or perhaps you're deliberately making me spell it out," Coleman said. "You should know what I attempted back then... I wanted to kill the current CEO of Truth Corporation, that monster 'Paris'."
"During my ten years trapped on this train, he has become even more terrifying."
"If you can casually make such a promise, I can only suspect... you have no idea how fearsome he truly is."
As Coleman spoke, Lin Yu stared at him.
"Yes, I don't know much about that CEO Paris. Honestly, although I'm aware of some things about Truth Corporation, my knowledge is limited..."
"But, dear Baron, I don't think you know enough about me either."
Saying this, Lin Yu used his left hand to pull out the identity card belonging to "Vale Valetti."
Coleman glanced at it and then sighed: "No wonder, no wonder... No wonder you could temporarily restore Pang Kedo to normal."
"You actually have that person's identity card... Did you inherit his legacy?"
"In a sense, yes," Lin Yu said calmly. "And I cleaned up the mess that even he couldn't handle."
Coleman exhaled: "Alright, I admit you have some skills. But even so, Paris is still..."
"Look more carefully."
Lin Yu brought the card closer, almost pressing it against the tank's exterior, his sleeve sliding down slightly to reveal his currently slender, pale arm.
Coleman glanced at the identity card but noticed nothing unusual.
However, soon enough, this undoubtedly intelligent baron noticed what Lin Yu truly wanted him to see.
The gray mark slowly revealing itself on the other's wrist.
His pupils contracted sharply, and a stream of bubbles emerged beneath his mask.
The next moment, the baron pressed his index finger against his temple, and a muffled sound came from beneath the tank.
Then, the transparent liquid began to drain at an incredible speed!
In mere moments, the fluid in the tank was completely emptied.
After draining, Baron Coleman landed on the floor and steadied himself as the transparent barrier before him slowly lowered.
The drenched baron removed his mask and lowered his voice.
He spoke in his natural voice for the first time—somewhat hoarse from disuse.
"Miss Zhu Ming, I now believe in your capabilities."
He understood Lin Yu's intention—this mark couldn't even be shown to the companion behind him.
Lin Yu also breathed a sigh of relief.
This guy really knew his stuff.
From the beginning, he hadn't thought that using the "Vale Valetti" connection would impress the baron.
Although as "Pang Kedo's" past gradually surfaced, Lin Yu vaguely felt that "Vale Valetti," despite perhaps only having B-level privileges, might hold a surprisingly high position within Truth Corporation for some reason.
But ultimately, it was still B-level!
While 'Chate's' strength was considerable, that was ultimately an accident caused by perfect circumstances.
To persuade the baron who likely had A-level privileges, he needed a more convincing identity.
So, Lin Yu remembered Vale Valetti from the Snow Mountain dungeon who had recognized his identity.
Therefore, Lin Yu speculated...
Perhaps Baron Coleman could do the same.
And as it turned out, his speculation was correct.
Coleman indeed recognized that the mark on his hand was bestowed by a god.
However...
There was also some bad news—Coleman was a bit too knowledgeable.
"While I no longer doubt your capabilities, I now have some doubts about whether you will truly fulfill your agreement?"

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Professional Team
chapters.content:
Although the mark of the "God of Change" made Baron Coleman somewhat more guarded against Lin Yu's character, he ultimately chose to trust him.
The reason was quite simple.
"It's difficult for me to find someone more suitable than you."
After leaving the tank, Baron Coleman touched the back of his neck as if flipping a switch.
A layer of dark-colored tight clothing gradually materialized on his body out of nowhere.
"It's been so long since I've been out... I'm actually a bit unaccustomed to it," Baron Coleman said with emotion.
Watching the Baron move his limbs, seemingly readjusting to controlling his body, Lin Yu asked, "How long were you in that tank?"
"Exactly six years," Coleman said calmly, "About the same time I've been on this train."
"That's really quite long. Was it to better control this train?"
Coleman nodded: "Correct. Although my privileges were retained, this project wasn't something I was 'responsible' for after all... I still needed some methods to bypass the system's security.""What exactly are your privileges? I'm quite sure you can't monitor every part of this train, since I already swiped that card you gave me once before."
As Lin Yu spoke, Coleman sighed helplessly.
"I can only see text-based 'summary reports' from each carriage... and give simple commands to automated sentry-type mechanical units. Otherwise, I wouldn't have needed to give various items to people on the train to influence the situation through them."
"Of course... having been on this train for so long, my 'knowledge' and 'understanding' are sufficient. Although I cannot leave this train, I'm very clear about the methods to do so," Coleman said.
"So your control over this train comes entirely from your personal abilities... I initially thought you actually had the highest authority over this train," Lin Yu said regretfully. "It seems the negotiations between whoever protected you and the person you attempted to assassinate weren't very smooth... or perhaps being able to protect both you and Pang Kedo over there was already quite an achievement."
Baron Coleman slightly widened his eyes, showing surprise: "You actually know these inside details?"
"I don't know, I just deduced it," Lin Yu said nonchalantly. "This might be confidential for your Truth Corporation... but there's nothing new under the sun, dear Baron."
The fact that a high-ranking member of another faction who masterminded the assassination of a certain faction leader didn't actually die, but was imprisoned and exiled to some jail, obviously meant others were maneuvering behind the scenes.
And Fu Luo mentioning "according to the files, Coleman is already dead" further corroborated this.
"It seems you have something in your possession that makes the top few people at Truth Corporation reluctant to kill you," Lin Yu said softly.
Baron Coleman showed an appreciative expression.
"Aside from your faith making me still somewhat doubtful about your credibility, I'm becoming increasingly satisfied with you as a person."
"Then why not be more open? After all, you also think your offer wasn't fair enough!"
Lin Yu looked at Baron Coleman and said with a smile.
Baron Coleman understood Lin Yu's meaning—the other party wanted to know the reason he was kept alive.
That is, the secret he had hidden that attracted even the top figures of Truth Corporation.
"Telling you wouldn't be a problem, it's just... the timing isn't right yet," Baron Coleman said, waving his hand.
"Alright, now that I've left the tank, this isn't a place to linger any longer—everyone, follow me."
His last few words suddenly increased in volume, transforming what was originally a private conversation with Lin Yu and Pang Kedo into an announcement to all the others.
"The deal is reached. I'll now show you the most convenient method to obtain the train tickets," Baron Coleman said, turning and walking toward the other end of the carriage.
Hearing Baron Coleman's words, Chen Zhuo scratched his head.
"Damn, Zhu Ming is so impressive... after all that chatter, he directly pulled this boss-like character into our side."
"And since the Baron says he'll take us to find the tickets, does that mean we'll clear this easily?"
Li Nian looked at Wang Yuyang: "So, Brother Wang, she's got some real skills, right?"
Wang Yuyang then looked at Pan Yuqiang: "What do you think?"
"Just based on the control and strategic ability she's shown over this dungeon so far, I believe she already unquestionably deserves an S-rank rating," Pan Yuqiang said softly.
"I see," Wang Yuyang said, then pondered for a moment. "But my intuition tells me this dungeon probably isn't that simple yet. We should still be cautious."
Fu Luo also agreed: "Correct... when it involves the top levels of Truth Corporation, I'm afraid there will be more turbulence."
Hearing this, Li Nian seemed somewhat displeased. As the person who introduced Zhu Ming to the Free Alliance, she felt somewhat invested in Zhu Ming's success.
"What, you don't trust Zhu Ming's negotiation skills?"
Before Wang Yuyang could explain, Fu Luo quickly shook his head: "No, no, absolutely not that meaning... we believe the Baron should indeed be persuaded, but variables might not necessarily come from the Baron himself."
Li Nian slightly frowned: "That does make some sense..."
While they were talking, the group had already followed the three people at the front to the front of the carriage.
In the darkness, a tightly closed door that hadn't been opened stood on the carriage wall.
It was different from all the doors they had encountered before.
The lock on this door was mechanical in structure.
A metal door handle and keyhole stood erect in the darkness.
"It's actually such a primitive lock."
"Of course, because Carriage No. 1 was originally designed as the 'driver's cabin' and 'internal personnel carriage.' Even after modifications, it remains the central control point for the entire train," Baron Coleman said. "Truth Corporation's tradition is that the more core a location is, the more primitive and simple its security measures are, relying on physical measures and mechanical structures."
"This is also why I haven't gained complete control over this train in six years," he added specifically, apparently still somewhat bothered by Lin Yu's earlier comment.
"So you've never been to Carriage No. 1 either?" Lin Yu asked.
Baron Coleman didn't avoid the question: "Yes, but I can generally understand what's inside from the reports."
He turned to look at the remaining few who had gathered around.
"To enter Carriage No. 1, you need to find the key... This key is stored in the maintenance box outside the carriage. Actually, every carriage connection point has hidden passages leading outside the carriage. Although the Despair Train moves extremely fast and the outside is dangerous, with everyone's skills..."
Li Nian interrupted Baron Coleman's suddenly assigned side quest.
"Enough already, old bastard. Don't constrain us with your conventional thinking."
"Let me show you what I can do—I'm a Master Thief! Using a key to open this kind of door with a keyhole... that's just insulting to my profession!"
Saying this, Li Nian pushed Baron Coleman aside, then extended her fingers toward the keyhole.
And in almost an instant.
"Click."
The door opened.

chapters.title: Chapter 251: Cleared the Stage…?
chapters.content:
Because Li Nian's lock-picking speed was incredibly fast, so fast that she had already finished and the door was open by the time Baron Coleman finished his verbal warning.
"This lock, although mechanical in structure, will trigger an alarm if violently broken or cracked..."
But looking at the open door crack, this Baron was stunned.
"That truly is an ability beyond the scope of common sense."
Not just the Baron, none of the players present understood how this 'Master Thief' had operated.
However, Li Nian was quite generous in displaying it.
Between her two fingers, she pinched several clear yellow metal components.
They were the lock core and the bolt of this mechanical lock.
This young girl didn't use any "lock-picking tools";
she directly stole the bolt and the lock core!
Naturally, this couldn't be considered violent disassembly.Because the component responsible for the "alarm" was also held between her fingers.
"Your method of prying open people's things is getting more and more impressive."
Wang Yuyang sighed with emotion. Li Nian casually stuffed these things into her pocket: "Thanks for the compliment—anyway, let's go."
She pulled open this train car door boldly.
What greeted their eyes next was a carriage that was the complete opposite of Carriage Two, as bright as daylight.
And the source of all light came from the only thing in this entire Carriage One.
Right in the middle of this carriage was a huge tank emitting white light, connected to the ceiling above and the floor below.
Inside, a liquid soaked hundreds, thousands of human heads clustered together, their hollows glowing with light.
These heads were crowded and piled on top of each other, with white light emanating from each of their seven facial orifices.
And they were even alive, each one having different and changing expressions.
Some were frowning with worry, lost in solemn contemplation;
some showed anger, gnashing their teeth;
others were mournful and sorrowful, appearing to wail...
And together, they coalesced to form a new outline resembling a giant human head—this aggregated head, viewed from afar, seemed to have four faces, also changing expressions of sorrow, anger, grief, worry, jealousy, hatred, and despair.
"What the hell is this thing? I'm literally going to puke."
Chen Zhuo's face was extremely unpleasant.
This thing was less terrifying and more something that caused physical discomfort just from looking at it.
Fu Luo also felt his teeth ache slightly: "This is the Truth Corporation's most advanced energy conversion core currently... the 'Despair Furnace'."
"It is also the primary reason for the existence of this Despair Train."
Baron Coleman nodded: "Correct, this is the Despair Furnace—it is a highly efficient energy collection and conversion device, capable of collecting a wide spectrum of emotions, spanning almost all 'negative emotions' except for 'Fear'."
"Not only that, after multiple upgrades, maintenance, and self-learning, it now almost possesses 'intelligence'."
"The 'Despair Train' now operates almost automatically;
all the 'designs,' including the 'purge' and other segments, were developed by it independently."
"Of course, this also includes the 'Train Ticket' that allows people to leave this train."
Baron Coleman said calmly.
"The so-called 'Train Ticket' is actually a reward given by this 'Despair Furnace'—commending you for having provided enough 'energy' on this train."
"So, whether you have been oppressing, intimidating, beating others, causing a great deal of suffering, or your own emotions are particularly intense and pure... there is a probability of receiving the 'Train Ticket Fragments' it distributes."
"And the Train Ticket composed of those 'Train Ticket Fragments' is not actually a ticket for the 'Despair Train,' but rather a ticket for the Truth Corporation's 'Sleepless City VIP Special Car'."
"Therefore, the Train Ticket is essentially no different from the distributed supplies;
it is a type of material reward... it's just the ultimate grand prize."
After Baron Coleman finished explaining, Lin Yu finally snapped back to attention slightly.
He had been observing the heads in the tank earlier, to the point of being somewhat mesmerized.
So many genuine expressions, so many intense emotional outflows, were an absolutely wonderful performance reference library for Lin Yu, and he could even compare them side by side.
So he couldn't help but study for a while.
Realizing that Baron Coleman's main business was finished, Lin Yu switched his brain back from performance mode to the dungeon.
"Oh, I see... but although you explained the 'principle,' you haven't given the most efficient method."
"The most efficient method is, of course, to deceive this stupid furnace," Coleman stepped forward and tapped the tank, "This matter is something Pang Kedo is more skilled at, but just cheating to bypass the detection program... even a clerical worker like me can do it."
As he spoke, he then touched his neck.
Subsequently, while Baron Coleman's expression remained normal, a series of sobs sounded around his body.
Then, the sobs turned into wails.
As if every cell of his was mourning grievously.
All the heads in the tank looked towards Coleman, actually revealing uniformly mournful expressions.
The four giant faces all appeared as if streaming with tears.
They opened their mouths and chanted in unison.
"We thank you for your despair."
Then...
The top of the carriage opened, and a large number of "robots" poured out—though these seemed to have no offensive capability.
They dropped a large quantity of food, daily necessities, weapons, and among them, naturally mixed in, were numerous fragments falling like snowflakes... Train Ticket fragments!
Large swathes of Train Ticket fragments fluttered down. Lin Yu reached out, gathered a few pieces together, and soon those fragments automatically coalesced into a complete golden Train Ticket!
The other players also found a golden "Train Ticket" in their hands.
[Dungeon Item·Train Ticket: One of the clearance credentials for this dungeon. Holding this ticket and leaving by riding the "Sleepless City VIP Special Car" will achieve clearance.]
Wang Yuyang looked at the ticket in his hand, turning it over and over, somewhat unable to believe it.
"To think we actually got it so simply just like that..."
Baron Coleman let out a breath, his face somewhat pale.
It seemed the earlier operation had taken a considerable toll on him.
"Although there are no coercive measures, I hope you will honor the agreement."
"Of course," Lin Yu said calmly, "but let me ask one more thing—how do we use this Train Ticket?"
"Surprisingly, it's this kind of thing you don't know?"
Baron Coleman was somewhat surprised, then explained: "The Sleepless City VIP Special Car is very famous. It was jointly established by three giant corporations and five major families;
it's an absolutely neutral transportation organization, and also the preferred choice for Sleepless City's big shots when traveling secretly under specific circumstances."
"This thing can take you from anywhere to any other place—absolutely guaranteeing privacy and safety. As long as you have a ticket, even the most powerful person in Sleepless City cannot know your itinerary or harm you during the journey."
"Tear this ticket, and the special car will come find you by itself!"

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Their Respective Goals
chapters.content:
Without a doubt, no matter how unbelievable it seemed...
At this moment, through Lin Yu's planning, they had indeed obtained the proof needed to clear the level.
To complete the game, they only needed to tear this train ticket and quietly wait for that miraculous special vehicle to arrive.
Chen Zhuo happily prepared to take action while looking at Lin Yu: "We're actually clearing the level like this? This has been my easiest dungeon run ever!"
"You really get what you pay for."
However, apart from Chen Zhuo, the others held their tickets without speaking.
After a long silence, Fu Luo finally sighed and spoke.
"Can I leave first?"
"You still have your Promotion Trial, why not try to complete it—and besides, leaving now isn't really appropriate," Lin Yu said calmly. "We should help each other in difficult times, Mr. Furbollo."
Only then did Chen Zhuo belatedly realize...Although they had obtained the proof to clear the level, Lin Yu didn't seem to plan on leaving just like that.
Li Nian and Wang Yuyang remained silent.
Although Zhu Ming wasn't an official member of the 'Free Alliance,' Wang Yuyang and Li Nian understood clearly...
After this dungeon, Zhu Ming joining them was pretty much a done deal.
Zhu Ming had already fulfilled one of the joining conditions, and although encountering Wang Yuyang in this dungeon was accidental, it still met the requirement of "completing a dungeon simultaneously with two Free Alliance members."
As for whether they wanted "Zhu Ming" to join... just the 'Psychological Society' potential rating of S-level was enough!
So, in their eyes, Lin Yu was already considered one of their own now.
Naturally, they would support Lin Yu's decision.
Moreover...
Lin Yu's decision was actually what they had been thinking too.
Seeing that the two cowards Chen Zhuo and Fu Luo seemed confused, Pan Yuqiang explained with a smile.
"Let me explain for our new friend here... Compared to rushing to clear every dungeon, when encountering certain relatively 'safe' dungeons, or when you already have an 'escape route,' staying in the dungeon to seek greater benefits is a better long-term choice."
"I believe no one joined the 'Death Game' just to survive week by week, so we need to take a long-term perspective."
"In this current dungeon, we've already obtained a means to 'exit' at any time, two relatively powerful NPCs are on our side—why not try to strive for greater benefits?"
Pan Yuqiang said with a smile.
Of course, she didn't fully explain one point to these two who hadn't undergone 'Promotion'—the point that Lin Yu had only recently discovered.
Increasing one's "influence" within the dungeon worlds of the 'Death Game' seemed to inherently benefit players!
In other words, if you simply understood "benefits" as [items], staying behind might yield gains, but there was also a high chance it could be more trouble than it's worth.
But if you understood that "creating influence" itself had benefits, then this action was guaranteed profit without loss.
This was also the main reason Lin Yu chose to stay—he was too eager to know what "privileges" unlocking at 'First-Tier' actually were.
"In this current dungeon, we've already obtained a means to 'exit' at any time, two relatively powerful NPCs are on our side—why not try to strive for greater benefits?"
"I understand."
But Fu Luo said with a bitter face: "Then why do I have to stay too?"
"If you call the 'special vehicle' alone first, who knows what variables might occur, and besides, aren't you quite clever," Li Nian said impatiently. "Just follow along peacefully—with so many experts carrying you for free, I really don't know what more you could want!"
Due to the lingering deterrence of her previous threat, Fu Luo could only nod in agreement.
Thus, after brief negotiations, all players reached a unanimous strategy.
Seeing that no one left after obtaining their tickets, Baron Coleman was initially somewhat surprised.
But being an intelligent man, he quickly found a reasonable "answer" himself.
"Hah... indeed, you probably went through great efforts to get on this train and sought me out specifically—how could it only be for the method to 'get off'."
Baron Coleman looked at Lin Yu.
"Although not surprising, as expected you were holding back... tell me your true purpose."
Lin Yu chuckled lightly.
This light chuckle was partly performing "having a well-thought-out plan," but also half genuine "joy" from successful deception.
The best way to deal with smart people was to let them deceive themselves.
"Our true purpose? Actually, we're not completely unified—everyone has different goals."
Due to the lingering deterrence of her previous threat, Fu Luo could only nod in agreement.
Saying this, Lin Yu walked to the back of the group and pulled Fu Luo forward.
"His Lordship the Baron is asking about our true purposes... you go first!"
Lin Yu patted Fu Luo's shoulder and lowered his voice.
"Don't lie to this guy."
Fu Luo reacted extremely quickly, soon understanding Lin Yu's purpose.
Staying was to strive for "benefits," but how to "strive" actually required taking things step by step.
But Fu Luo's goal was the clearest and most specific, and he also knew the Truth Corporation best.
So, him speaking first was most appropriate.
"Although not surprising, as expected you were holding back... tell me your true purpose."
Since he couldn't escape anyway, he might as well take a gamble.
Coincidentally—this train did contain the mystery he was most interested in.
This light chuckle was partly performing "having a well-thought-out plan," but also half genuine "joy" from successful deception.
As Fu Luo spoke, Baron Coleman looked at him.
"An interesting reason, but it seems to be true."
"Your employer's identity... never mind, you probably can't say, and I can't be bothered to guess—it's undoubtedly one of the few prominent figures in Sleepless City."
Baron Coleman said this while waving his hand.
Fu Luo responded to the confident Baron Coleman with a smile, silently grumbling in his heart.
"It's really not any of the people you know."
After all, the issuer of this "commission" was the system.
After Fu Luo stated his needs, Li Nian also clarified her thoughts.
She stepped forward.
"I just heard that this 'Despair Train' has many of Truth Corporation's new gadgets—many concept machines and prototypes get transported here."
"As I said earlier, I'm a 'Thief'—and one whom everyone kindly calls a 'Master Thief.'"
"As the saying goes, 'a thief never leaves empty-handed,' Your Lordship the Baron—having come to such a great place, I don't want to leave with nothing!"

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Dismissed!
chapters.content:
"One commissioned by someone, one seeking wealth..."
Baron Coleman nodded slightly after some thought, then looked at the remaining few people.
Pan Yuqiang spoke with a smile: "I'm interested in most things from Truth Corporation, but since we've come to the 'Despair Train' and seen such a magnificent masterpiece."
She looked towards the tank in the very center of carriage number one: "I definitely can't take this thing away, but... whether it's blueprints or components, it wouldn't be bad to figure out a way to take one."
Wang Yuyang gave his girlfriend a surprised look: "Alright, since you want it... I'll try later."
Baron Coleman looked at this couple and laughed heartily: "Ha, interesting, setting your sights on the Despair Furnace!"
"What about you?"
He looked at Chen Zhuo.
"Me? I really just want to get off the train," Chen Zhuo scratched his head and said, "To be honest... I'm really just here to make up the numbers!"
Baron Coleman examined Chen Zhuo carefully: "It's actually genuine feeling. Well, that's easy to handle."Baron Coleman took a card from his pocket and tossed it to Chen Zhuo.
Li Nian caught it from the air before Chen Zhuo could even reach out.
"Coleman Hunt... giving away an identity card just like that? That's a bit too generous, Baron."
Even as she said this, Li Nian showed no greed for the card, instead handing it directly to Chen Zhuo.
Coleman didn't mind Li Nian's action and continued looking at Chen Zhuo.
"Take this card. On the Despair Train, you can go anywhere you want—inanimate objects won't touch you, living people won't dare to touch you."
"Find a dining car, sit down, eat and drink. When your companions are about ready, you can all get off together."
"No need to return it to me before getting off, just take it with you—your companion should have told you that although I'm trapped here, my privileges haven't been revoked."
"Just be careful when using it outside. Even though seven years have passed, it's not impossible that someone might cause trouble for you."
Coleman said calmly.
Chen Zhuo took the card, feeling overwhelmed by the favor.
Even though he'd only been through four dungeons, he knew how valuable this thing was.
This wasn't just a protective charm that would let him move alone on the train without life-threatening dangers.
Chen Zhuo had already seen how Lin Yu used privilege cards to set up his plans step by step.
Although this was his first time hearing about Truth Corporation, with so many experts valuing this organization so highly, it must indeed be important.
Getting A-level privileges from this company...
No wonder Chen Zhuo felt overwhelmed by the favor.
He looked at Baron Coleman with great gratitude.
"Your Lordship, you're truly too generous!"
"I... really don't know how to repay you."
Baron Coleman smiled: "Taking this card out with you is itself repayment to me."
Chen Zhuo nodded, then also gave Lin Yu a grateful look.
He understood perfectly well...
That he could get such a huge bargain was mainly because of that "Zhu Ming," aside from luck and his own honesty!
Baron Coleman was doing it for her sake—he was benefiting from being her companion.
Without this Veterinarian's exquisite setup and planning, he wouldn't even have met Baron Coleman.
"After returning to carriage two, walk to the end. After entering the door, you'll randomly appear in any carriage."
"But be careful—the first wave of random pursuit is about to come. Although you have the privilege card and won't be a target, if you get caught in the crossfire, you'll still die."
The Baron said calmly.
Then he also looked at Li Nian and Pan Yuqiang.
"The things you want, whether it's the company's new gadgets or the blueprints for this 【Despair Furnace】... are not stored in the 'passenger carriage' section."
"When the Despair Train was initially designed as an ordinary passenger train, it had luggage storage compartments—they were just later modified and sealed off."
"The original storage compartments were converted into temporary warehouses, used to store those weapons and sentries for purging and creating despair. Their location is right above our heads."
"Actually, there's space above the ceiling of every carriage, with direct access channels at the connections between carriages... although they're closed off, I imagine with the skills of this 『Master Thief』 lady from earlier, opening them shouldn't be difficult."
After solving Chen Zhuo's problem, Coleman also gave directions to Li Nian and the others.
"Thank you—although Zhu Ming agreed to this herself, if I get the chance later, when I encounter Truth Corporation's CEO, I'll find a way to annoy him too—as for whether I can kill him, I can't guarantee, but I'll do my best."
Li Nian brought her left index and middle fingers together in a sword gesture and lightly waved it at her temple as a salute to Baron Coleman.
Although the gesture was somewhat novel to Baron Coleman, he understood Li Nian's intention and mimicked the salute in return.
"Thank you, madam."
Wang Yuyang also spoke on behalf of his girlfriend: "Your Lordship, I also can't guarantee whether I can deal with Truth Corporation's CEO. Your reward isn't enough for me to risk my life against someone of that level—but I'd like to ask, do you have a grudge against him alone, or are you at odds with his entire faction?"
Baron Coleman understood Wang Yuyang's intention: "Oh, of course the latter... Thank you, sir."
Wang Yuyang nodded: "That's good then. As long as I confirm they're his subordinates and I can handle them, if conditions permit, I'll kill them for you."
Baron Coleman saluted again: "That would be excellent—I wish you and your wife a happy union for a hundred years."
Hearing this, Wang Yuyang actually looked somewhat flustered for once, his voice unusually stammering: "Well... uh, actually she's not quite my wife yet."
Pan Yuqiang elbowed him: "Hmm?"
Wang Yuyang immediately spoke fluently again, with a serious expression: "But thank you for your blessing. I'll have her work hard to become my wife."
Li Nian couldn't watch any longer: "I can't take this anymore—Chen Zhuo, let's go! I'll take you to the dining car!"
"Brother Wang, what the hell are you talking about with them?"
Li Nian grabbed Chen Zhuo, who was holding the card, and headed toward carriage two.
Wang Yuyang and Pan Yuqiang also stopped dealing with Baron Coleman and followed Li Nian away.
"Damn it, if I don't leave, you two won't leave either, right? Stop following me!"
"A Nian, our destination is the same place."
"Then I still don't want to move together with you two, stay away from me!"
The four of them noisily left carriage one.
Fu Luo had pretty much figured things out.
After the Baron personally confirmed from "Zhu Ming" that their team was somewhat hastily assembled, he really wanted to create an opportunity to speak with her alone.
The other two members of the 『Free Alliance』 leaving proactively also had the unspoken implication of making way.
So, Fu Luo quickly stepped forward—he also wanted to quickly find a place to hide and avoid getting involved in trouble.
"Um..."
But as soon as Fu Luo spoke, Lin Yu interrupted him.
"He needs to stay."
Baron Coleman nodded: "He wants to know the 'truth about the wrongful case,' so he really doesn't need to leave."
Even Pang Kedo, who had been silent all along, quietly closed the door to carriage one after Li Nian's group left and wedged the door handle with the stick in his hand.
Fu Luo looked at the three people who were in sync and opened his mouth.
...Did no one consider the opinion of the person involved?

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Baron Coleman's Past
chapters.content:
For Fu Luo, he was gradually getting used to having his opinions ignored.
Looking at Lin Yu, Coleman, and Pang Kedo, Fu Luo sighed.
"Damn it, fine, we'll stay then."
He leaned back against the carriage wall and sighed again. "So... there must be one or two so-called 'unjust cases' that happened to you guys, right?"
Baron Coleman nodded. "Of course, if you're talking about unjust cases, both Pang Kedo and I indeed have grievances that we've carried for many years."
Pang Kedo froze. "Me? I have one too?"
"I've really forgotten too many things."
Pang Kedo rubbed his temples, his expression pained as he spoke.
"Speaking of grievances... could it be that the assassination attempt on that Truth Corporation CEO wasn't actually done by you two?"
Lin Yu asked.Baron Coleman denied Lin Yu's question. "No, that incident was indeed done by us. Rather—the reason I resolved to assassinate the CEO was precisely because of the grievance I carried."
He looked at Fu Luo.
"No one who has been framed doesn't wish for their reputation to be cleared. Since you came here for the grievance I carry, I'll tell you..."
Baron Coleman cleared his throat, then began speaking.
"Eight years ago, just after I was promoted to director of Truth Corporation's R&
D Department's No. 7 Independent Laboratory and obtained A-2 level privileges, I discovered some discrepancies in the laboratory's log archives—there were inconsistencies between the fund accounts and actual project allocations."
"At first, I thought it was just the former director or some researchers in the laboratory embezzling funds, but upon second thought, I realized something was wrong."
"Because if it was embezzlement... everyone entering the laboratory was smart enough not to leave flaws that I could spot at a glance, especially since my transfer to No. 7 Laboratory was a compliant promotion—this meant that before I became director of this laboratory, the former director and others qualified to manipulate project funds had at least half a month to balance the accounts and make everything look perfect."
"So at that time, I considered two possibilities."
"The first was that someone intentionally left this flaw to pull me, the new director, into their group. As long as I didn't report it, they would contact me."
"And since the flaw was so obvious, it meant they had prepared a 'scapegoat,' and likely had backing even within the company's board of directors and highest executive levels—so they weren't afraid of my non-cooperation;
even if I reported it, it wouldn't seriously harm them."
"This was equivalent to a very 'subtle' invitation letter... so I decided to accept this invitation."
Hearing this, Pang Kedo nearby couldn't hold back.
"Jerry Coleman Hunt... how did you become so... so slick just a few years after the memories I have now."
Pang Kedo couldn't help but call out his full name.
Baron Coleman wasn't a nickname but a genuine honorific—although Sleepless City had advanced technology, its system was relatively backward, still having many powerful figures and aristocratic classes.
His mother came from a prominent background, so he inherited the title from her.
His actual surname was "Hunt."
And due to some old family matters, few people who interacted with him called him by his full name.
Pang Kedo calling him this way showed he was truly somewhat shocked and implicitly disapproving.
Baron Coleman responded with a smile, also addressing his old friend by his full name: "Punkdo Von Valetti, if you want to call me cunning and slick, no need to be so indirect."
"Just know that by that period, we were already inseparable friends, our personal relationship almost as close as biological brothers."
"You weren't clean either by that time."
Although he wore a smile and spoke calmly, Lin Yu detected anger in Coleman's words.
"I changed that quickly?"
Pang Kedo said incredulously.
Fu Luo couldn't help interrupting. "No offense, but if you were a good person... you wouldn't have been selected for the 'Eightfold Calamity' modification either."
"What the hell is that?"
Pang Kedo scratched his head confusedly.
"Alright, no interruptions, we'll talk about you later," Baron Coleman abruptly cut off the topic. "Anyway, I waited three days without anyone coming to me, so I realized... this was actually another situation."
"Someone still intentionally left this loophole, but it wasn't an invitation letter—it was a hint."
"It wasn't that someone wanted to pull me into some embezzlement interest group, but that within No. 7 Laboratory, there truly existed some ghost project that even my A-2 level privileges weren't sufficient to know about, directly subordinate to someone at the very top."
"So... I went to investigate."
Baron Coleman said.
"Wow, you actually investigated? That's the standard 'curiosity killed the cat' opening."
Fu Luo exclaimed. "Based on what I know about Truth Corporation's nature, you should have turned a blind eye."
Lin Yu glanced at Fu Luo, really wanting to retort "you're one to talk about curiosity killing the cat."
But "Zhu Ming" and Furbollo weren't familiar after all, so Lin Yu held back the retort.
"Truth Corporation may be like that, but I'm not," Baron Coleman said, looking at Lin Yu. "And what I discovered next can also answer two questions you have, ma'am."
"Why I was spared with my life intact, and... why I joined forces with Pang Kedo and ultimately chose to assassinate President Paris."
"Because I spent nearly three months discovering what exactly this ghost project consuming massive funds was—to be precise, it wasn't just a single ghost project attached to No. 7 Independent Laboratory."
"3, 6, 7, 8, 12... out of Truth Corporation's twelve independent laboratories, I found the same accounting issues in four of them like in No. 7, and even 'ghost employees' appeared in Nos. 3 and 12 laboratories—there were several extra B-level privilege accounts that didn't belong to any researcher I knew."
"And this was only the part I uncovered."
"If you combined these people and funds, they pieced together an entire new... ghost laboratory."
"Some board member or executive decision-maker, highest-level director with extensive connections had secretly established a laboratory that other high-ups might not permit, to research some 'forbidden' subject."
"When my investigation reached this point, I also realized... I seemed to have touched upon something major, but although I was nervous at the time, I didn't feel cornered—after all, I still thought I could join them."
Coleman paused.
"But this naive thought stopped once I learned what they were actually researching."
"The project created by this ghost laboratory originated from a subject and technology that had been ordered stopped fifty years ago..."
Coleman looked directly at Lin Yu. "The entire technology came from one A-level researcher, Professor Dort."
"And Professor Dort had only one prized student in his lifetime, named..."
"Vale Valetti."

chapters.title: Chapter 255: The Value of Fear
chapters.content:
"Vale Valetti, damn it, it's him!"
Before Lin Yu could react, Fu Luo became excited and looked toward Pang Kedo.
"I thought something was off when I heard you were also named Valetti, so it turns out you're..."
"Great-Uncle."
Pang Kedo reminded him.
"Great-Uncle?"
Fu Luo was surprised for a moment, then couldn't help but mutter: "Your grandfather and your dad both had kids pretty early, huh..."
Coleman looked at Fu Luo: "You actually know Vale Valetti too?"
Fu Luo waved his hand: "What do you mean I know him... I'm not bragging, buddy, but the last person in this world to see Vale Valetti was probably me, Furbollo."
"Back then in the vast snowy mountains..."Then, Fu Luo suddenly realized something was wrong.
"Hey, wait a minute, did you just say 'too'?"
"'I also know Vale Valetti'... meaning this sister knows him too?"
Fu Luo looked at Lin Yu with disbelief.
Lin Yu shrugged: "Yeah, and I even have his privilege card and notebook in my possession."
Lin Yu once again displayed the [Ancient Notebook] and Vale Valetti's identity card.
And he certainly knew...
Fu Luo would recognize these two items.
But Lin Yu wasn't afraid of creating any "plot holes" by showing them, because Lin Yu had set up the conditions from the very beginning.
Both Li Nian and Chen Zhuo had heard Lin Yu's explanation... these things were given by a "friend."
Going further back, the connection between "Zhu Ming" and "May" was also reliable.
Sure enough, Fu Luo's eyes widened as he looked at these two items.
"How come you have them?"
Hearing Fu Luo's words, Lin Yu calmly turned his head and stared at Fu Luo.
"What do you mean how come I have them? These are my things to begin with... are you trying to say they're yours instead?"
As Lin Yu spoke, Fu Luo opened his mouth, then said:
"I... but I saw these things in a previous dungeon... I should have been the last person to see them."
Then, Fu Luo caught on.
"You bought them?"
Lin Yu shook his head: "Not bought, just given to me by a friend... or rather, an exchange."
As he said this, Fu Luo looked at Lin Yu in surprise.
"What profession is this friend of yours?"
Lin Yu slightly frowned, appearing as if he had realized something.
"Wait, so that means he must have encountered you in that dungeon... when he went to Zheng City, he also mentioned receiving help from some friends."
"My friend's profession is 'Doctor'."
As Lin Yu spoke, Fu Luo was overjoyed.
"No doubt about it, no doubt about it, sis!"
"'May' right? We have the same friend... wow, he never told me about this!"
"May and I are pure brothers, friendship forged through life and death."
Baron Coleman watched this scene, glanced at Pang Kedo beside him, and couldn't help but sigh emotionally.
"How wonderful."
It seemed that because he had also reunited with an old friend, he didn't interrupt their conversation.
Hearing Fu Luo's words, Lin Yu also put on an expression of pleasant surprise mixed with astonishment.
"So you're the 'extremely intelligent, meticulous detective' that May mentioned."
Hearing Lin Yu's words, Fu Luo seemed somewhat embarrassed.
"Really? Brother May said that about me behind my back? Oh my, look at this... how embarrassing!"
"To be honest, his wisdom is no less than mine."
Lin Yu smiled and shook his head, saying: "Not at all, different specialties... you helped him a lot in that dungeon."
"And after he came out, it was thanks to you that he could investigate matters related to the 'Psychological Society'—to be honest, your investigation of 'Fluoxetine' actually helped me more."
Lin Yu said with a smile.
But Fu Luo was momentarily stunned.
"Fluoxetine? I didn't investigate that... I couldn't possibly dig up information on people from the 'Psychological Society'—they're at the same level as that Miss Citalopram, right?"
As Fu Luo spoke, Lin Yu was also stunned.
He realized that Fu Luo was absolutely not lying.
Then...
What about Furbollo on the forum?
Lin Yu's thoughts raced, feeling a subtle dissonance that sent chills down his spine.
It was as if there were eyes watching him from behind.
But since Lin Yu was still playing the role of "Zhu Ming," he would absolutely not lose his composure during the performance.
So, Lin Yu simply made the reaction most fitting for Zhu Ming's identity.
"Is that so," Lin Yu slightly frowned, "I really don't know what May is up to, I'll go ask him later."
Then, feeling somewhat unsettled, Lin Yu looked toward Baron Coleman and continued questioning.
"Anyway, since we've mentioned Vale Valetti, the so-called 'forbidden' technology must be..."
"Fear, right?"
As she spoke, she pulled out the [Fear Torch] from her chest.
Baron Coleman nodded: "Correct. Ever since Professor Dort passed away from illness and Vale Valetti disappeared, the technology of 'Fear' has been regarded as forbidden."
"Because it was so long ago, I don't know exactly why it was considered forbidden... but Truth Corporation is a company very persistent about technological innovation. Ordinary accidents or technical defects are simply not enough reason to stop the development and research of a new field, new technology, or new energy source."
"So, there must be some extremely huge hidden danger, some irreconcilable contradiction, that made extracting 'Fear' considered the most forbidden of all forbidden things by all researchers and higher-ups."
Hearing this, Fu Luo recalled something and couldn't help but sigh.
"I think I might know what that hidden danger is."
Pang Kedo and Coleman immediately looked at Fu Luo simultaneously, both appearing very concerned.
After all, this was indeed something closely related to both of them.
But before Fu Luo could speak, Lin Yu interrupted him.
"Wait, Furbollo, don't talk about that yet..."
"Let him finish first," Lin Yu pointed at Baron Coleman, "on one hand, to see if what you know is truly valuable compared to what he knows, and on the other hand..."
"If it's really valuable, we can sell it for a good price."
Lin Yu said calmly, and Baron Coleman spoke helplessly.
"Madam, you really are a bit too clever."
"Alright... I'll continue—anyway, after discovering the existence of this ghost laboratory and investigating their research direction, I realized it was truly completely over."
"By then I was already A-2 level, just one step away from the company's top tier... holding onto the idea that I didn't want to ruin my future, I decided to gamble."
"So, I found one of the addresses of that non-existent laboratory, investigated it, and also found one of the responsible persons of this laboratory."
"At that time, the archives showed a certain researcher who had already retired to a leisure position, who had once worked with Professor Dort and was quite prestigious within Truth Corporation."
"And when I personally visited him at his home..."
Baron Coleman let out a breath.
"I discovered he had died in the laboratory in his own home."

chapters.title: Chapter 256: The Correct Way to Unlock the Ancient Notebook
chapters.content:
"So the crime they pinned on you was murder."
Hearing Baron Coleman's words, Fu Luo suddenly understood while feeling a trace of relief.
"When I first heard about it, I thought it might be something like embezzlement!"
Although for Baron Coleman, being framed for murder—with the victim being some respected figure within the company—was definitely more troublesome than something like embezzlement.
But for Fu Luo...
Being wrongly accused of murder was certainly better than embezzlement.
Because the former was easier to investigate and uncover the truth—a dead person would inevitably leave more clues than a pile of chaotic numbers.
Baron Coleman was also clear about this.
"Yes, although I didn't realize it immediately when the body was discovered, soon after... I quickly became the prime suspect in the murder of this researcher, Reed Christopher."
"Back then, this was undoubtedly a bolt from the blue for me, but dragging on until now... I actually have to feel somewhat grateful.""Thanks to the murder charge they pinned on me back then, otherwise after so many years, proving my innocence would be almost impossible."
Fu Luo nodded.
"Exactly, but precisely because it's a murder case, there's still a possibility of overturning the verdict now."
Lin Yu stroked his chin and spoke: "But after all, eight years have passed, now we can only rely on Your Lordship's 'oral account' to reconstruct..."
"No, it's not just my oral account," Baron Coleman said, his eyes shining intensely, "Although I don't know why such a coincidence occurred... but you appearing here with 'Vale Valetti's notebook is greatly helpful for restoring the truth of that year."
Lin Yu took out the [Ancient Notebook], somewhat surprised.
"This notebook? What does it have to do with this case?"
Lin Yu wasn't surprised that this notebook had mysterious uses he didn't know about. After all, when Vale Valetti gave it to him as a reward back then, it inherently indicated that this notebook was definitely not just a very durable notebook.
Moreover, the item's own description almost explicitly hinted at it.
[Ancient Notebook: An indestructible notebook, information recorded on it can be preserved permanently. Seems to have other uses not yet discovered...]
What Lin Yu didn't know was what other miraculous uses this thing actually had.
Coleman looked at the notebook, then turned to Pang Kedo: "Pang Kedo, although you've lost many memories, about this notebook... you shouldn't have forgotten, right?"
"Of course, this was a major project that both my great-uncle and grandfather participated in—excavating and analyzing artifacts from ancient civilization unearthed from 'Ancient Ruin No. 9'."
Pang Kedo continued: "The things unearthed back then benefited the entire Truth Corporation for at least thirty years...
