These two items from Threading the Needle were both very useful.
Rage Spray was perfect for use when deceiving others.
People's judgment severely declines when angry—precisely based on this, Lin Yu had chosen to provoke Yu Longguo in his first dungeon.
As for Corner of the Gloomy...
Although it seemed somewhat overlapping with the little octopus "Hannah's" functions, it had its own unique aspects.
Moreover, this item was of the type that had an additional "Note."
Among Items, the finest and rarest ones aren't necessarily those with additional "Notes" and "Remarks"...
But those with "Notes" and "Remarks" are definitely the rarer, finer Items.
Although the description of Corner of the Gloomy didn't reveal much, Lin Yu was convinced that its actual performance should be stronger than the text description suggested.
Just like Li Nian's sunglasses—seemingly having only the function of seeing through spirits and energy bodies, but seeing Li Nian wear them 24/7, you know this thing has a hidden powerful aspect.
It has no consumption, no cooldown.
As long as it's worn on the face, it makes any spirit unable to hide from Li Nian.
This is extremely useful in dungeons with ghosts and such.
Moreover... spirits and energy bodies aren't just limited to ghosts.
Li Nian must have developed more advanced uses, she just hasn't revealed them.
"I should still test how useful Corner of the Gloomy is when I get the chance..."
Lin Yu pondered, then looked at the items rewarded from Far-Famed Reputation.
But before he could check the Mind-Peeping Eyepiece and Resentful Little Fish Launcher, Lin Yu was interrupted by new "blood text" that popped up before his eyes.
The settlement rewards for this dungeon actually weren't limited to the conventional ones!
"Alright, I'll research the Items after going out..."
Lin Yu was actually quite accustomed to this, because so far, none of the dungeons he had experienced had been completely normal and followed the rules.
Moreover, he had already anticipated this.
In fact, this was something he had been actively striving for throughout this dungeon.
[Detected that your reputation in the dungeon world has reached requirements, interaction count with non-player intelligent life has reached requirements...]
[Detected that you have passed one Promotion Trial, player level is First-Tier player...]
[Now activating new player privilege module for you—"Social."]
Seeing this blood text prompt, Lin Yu let out a breath.
"Good, now the 'privileges' are also obtained."
"But... what the hell is 'Social'?"
Soon, the time in the Settlement Space ended. Lin Yu opened his eyes again, finding himself sitting in the car with Li Nian and Chen Zhuo.
The car was in a state of gradually slowing down—eventually coming to a slow stop by the roadside.
Before he could communicate with Chen Zhuo and Li Nian, Lin Yu immediately realized what the "Social" privilege referred to.
He felt that deep within his soul and consciousness, something new had appeared—as natural as being able to store Items and see Item descriptions, as if innate.
It was an interface resembling a chat software, which could be summoned just by thinking.
This was...
the players' Social panel!

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Socializing and Gift-Giving
chapters.content:
The simplicity of this [Social] panel is exactly the same as the functionality of the [Items] backpack and the game entry prompts.
No matter which god is responsible for this area, they must be a minimalist.
After summoning the [Social] panel, there are only two sections.
One is labeled [Players], which is temporarily empty.
The other is labeled [Non-Players]...
Surprisingly, there's a name sitting inside it.
"Punkdo Von Valetti."
When focusing attention on this name, you can actually choose the outrageous function of [Locate].
And if you focus attention on the [Players] module...
Besides prompting Lin Yu to "add friends," fill out his own "profile," and determine a "code name," there are also two functions: [Trade] and [Chat].If there are special Team Cards, you can even form teams remotely.
After seeing that this [Social] panel exists, Lin Yu instantly understood many things.
He understood why those organizations made apps, but made them so casually, and why you rarely see top players chatting inside them.
Lin Yu also understood why the 'Free Alliance' didn't make an app.
And why "gatherings" exist.
First, you have to accommodate players who haven't unlocked the [Social] function, and "group chat" and "auctions"... this built-in [Social] function doesn't have those.
Second...
Since it's just accommodating them, then making do with whatever works is indeed enough.
However, after unlocking this [Social] function, it actually gave Lin Yu a headache.
"How am I supposed to use this?"
Being able to create alt accounts on the forum was already something to be thankful for, but how is he supposed to create alt accounts now?
If he can't create alt accounts...
Which identity should he use this precious [Social] function for?
Lin Yu became conflicted.
There's no good answer to this problem for now.
So, Lin Yu chose to set it aside.
"Alright, cleared smoothly! Time to go home and play some GAL games!"
Right at that moment, Chen Zhuo's voice sounded, then he looked toward Li Nian and Lin Yu in the back seat.
"Thank you both... I gained a lot of items this time too, later I'll have my items sold through a consignor and pay you your share along with the originally agreed final payment."
Chen Zhuo said seriously, while Li Nian narrowed her eyes.
"Fine, but... don't try to skip out on it, okay?"
"Although you don't know my methods yet, if you try to skip out, I can make sure you find out exactly what they are."
Chen Zhuo immediately said: "How could I, sis? Integrity is what I value most!"
"Before the next dungeon, I'll definitely bring you what you want... If I fail to deliver as promised, you can just... just empty out my entire house!"
Chen Zhuo said earnestly.
Lin Yu gently patted the back of Chen Zhuo's car seat.
"I trust you—well then, pleasure working with you."
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Nian very naturally picked up the conversation and snapped her fingers.
"Let's bounce, Zhu Ming!"
Then, Chen Zhuo only felt the car suddenly become lighter.
The two figures actually disappeared directly without a trace.
Chen Zhuo was filled with deep respect.
"Truly experts! Even their exit is extraordinary!"
...
In the greenbelt outside the old folks' scooter, Lin Yu looked helplessly at Li Nian, who was panting heavily from exhaustion, and gently patted her back to help her catch her breath.
"Couldn't you just exit normally? Did you have to make it so flashy?"
Clearly, Li Nian had used some kind of item just now.
Using that item, she actually dragged Lin Yu directly underground.
Then, Li Nian pulled Lin Yu through the ground for several meters before emerging from the greenbelt.
Only after watching Chen Zhuo drive away in his vehicle did the two stand up.
Having caught her breath, Li Nian put her hands on her hips and declared with conviction: "Hey, this is emotional value, you know... This little fatty spent quite a bit of money, I need to make him feel like his money was well spent."
Then, Li Nian reached into her waistband and pulled out a bottle of foreign liquor that looked quite high-end.
"Of course, Mingming sis... Since you introduced me to such a good job, your referral fee won't be missing either!"
Li Nian's address was somewhat cringey.
Lin Yu was somewhat surprised.
"This is?"
"Kirishima Vineyard's 'Mourning' series, this bottle has the best vintage," Li Nian stuffed it into Lin Yu's arms, "Don't be polite, we're all one of us now anyway."
Ownership of the [Item] transferred to Lin Yu.
Lin Yu shook his head.
"No, I can accept the wine, but... aren't I still in the assessment period?"
"Although it was by chance, Brother Wang and I did go through an entire dungeon with you after all—I'd certainly be happy for you to join us, and I think Brother Wang's opinion should be quite clear too."
Li Nian said with a smile: "From here, you joining the organization is just going through the motions... And since we're called the 'Free Alliance,' we definitely need rules and regulations the least!"
"So, you're already one of our members now."
Lin Yu still shook his head.
"No no, I appreciate your kindness, but I don't plan to join the 'Free Alliance' under these conditions—I still want to choose the other option, join a top organization and then publicly announce my withdrawal."
"So... please help me relay to Brother Wang, ask him to request Pan Yuqiang to keep my matters 'confidential' for a while... I think Pan Yuqiang should be willing."
He said seriously, and Li Nian's smile gradually faded.
"Are you serious about this, Zhu Ming?"
A trace of concern appeared on Li Nian's face at this moment.
She guessed which organization Lin Yu wanted to join—it wasn't hard to guess.
Of course, the 'Psychological Society'!
Otherwise, why would Lin Yu mention Pan Yuqiang, this 'Citalopram'?
Lin Yu nodded calmly.
"You probably understand my past now, so I don't want to run away from it anymore."
Li Nian spoke urgently: "But that was just a misunderstanding, wasn't it? Fluoxetine didn't have any intentions against you."
Lin Yu responded gently.
"Knowing that all of this was just a 'misunderstanding' didn't make me feel any more at ease because of it."
"I clearly understand that Fluoxetine wasn't targeting me... but precisely because of that, I need to target her."
As Lin Yu spoke, his tone and expression were very calm.
But when saying such content, the calmer the expression and tone, the more insane it seems.
Li Nian looked at Lin Yu for a long time, and after realizing his determination couldn't be changed, she let out a breath, her expression suddenly becoming relaxed.
"Alright, if that's the case... then I'll just enjoy and look forward to your amazing adventures!"
She said, then pulled out a "magnifying glass" from her chest again.
"This is for you too."
"What's this again?"
Lin Yu took the magnifying glass, and the [Investigation Magnifying Glass] item name popped up, making him somewhat curious.
"Oh this isn't a gift... more like asking a favor of you."
"You and that 'Detective' Furbollo have a mutual friend, right? Help me give this to him—I couldn't resist on the train earlier and just took it casually."

chapters.title: Chapter 280: The Biggest and Most Ridiculous Unexpected Gain
chapters.content:
After sending Li Nian off, Lin Yu returned home.
In this environment where he wouldn't be disturbed by others, Lin Yu could finally calm down and sort through the gains from this dungeon.
First were the two item descriptions he hadn't had time to examine carefully in the Settlement Space earlier - although Lin Yu earning the "double rewards" through his own efforts was a good thing, it did cause some trouble.
There were too many items, and the time to examine them in the Settlement Space was almost never enough!
In situations like this where he chatted with Fu Luo for a bit, he could only come out and examine some items later.
Lin Yu took out the two remaining items besides the Rage Spray and Corner of the Gloomy.
The Mind-Peeping Eyepiece and the Resentful Little Fish Launcher.
Just from the name alone, he could guess the general function of the former - combined with the abilities displayed by Baron Coleman encountered in the previous dungeon, Lin Yu could almost confirm what this thing did.
Mind-Peeping Eyepiece: When worn, the user can actively view the real-time emotional energy of targets within their field of vision and analyze it. Please try to maintain emotional stability during use, otherwise it may cause deviations in results.
The description was simple, and the function was pretty much what Lin Yu had guessed.Most importantly...
This thing wasn't like Li Nian's sunglasses, which had a very obvious style.
Instead, it was an extremely thin and transparent contact lens.
Lin Yu took it out, placed it on his fingertip, then gently inserted it into his left eye.
He wasn't really nearsighted, but stage makeup for theater performances sometimes involved colored contacts, so this wasn't Lin Yu's first time wearing something like this.
But Lin Yu had to say...
"It feels like I'm wearing nothing at all."
He blinked his left eye, feeling almost no discomfort at all.
Looking in the mirror, he couldn't tell at all that he was wearing a contact lens.
"Truly worthy of a cutting-edge major corporation's core product, the user experience is quite good."
Lin Yu muttered, then looked at the Resentful Little Fish Launcher.
Compared to all the other three items obtained from this dungeon, this one looked somewhat different just in appearance.
The Rage Spray was a very futuristic metal spray can, while the Corner of the Gloomy was something similar to a hand grenade throwing device.
Whichever one, including the previous Fear Torch and Chate's Supplies, all had quite a futuristic and technological feel.
Only this Resentful Little Fish Launcher...
Not only did it have a strange name, but its appearance also resembled a plastic water gun.
The colors were very bright, using highly saturated red, yellow, blue, and green clashing designs, with coloring full of candy-like feel.
It looked exactly like something a party clown would pull out.
Overall, it had the shape of a pistol, but the opening was like a horn.
As for the item description... it was even more baffling.
Resentful Little Fish Launcher: As the name suggests, launches a somewhat unhappy little fish!
"What the hell is this?"
Lin Yu held the gun, feeling that this might not even be a product from Truth Corporation.
He thought for a moment...
Then pulled the trigger aiming at the floor.
"Beep beep—woo!"
The horn-shaped muzzle actually made a sound like a small horn being pressed, startling Lin Yu.
"Splat!"
A soft, floppy bluish-gray fish was sprayed out from the gun muzzle, then directly fell onto the floor about one meter in front of Lin Yu.
He looked at the fish on the floor, and the fish on the floor also looked at Lin Yu, its eyes flickering with a strange light.
"What joy is there in life, what pain is there in death?"
The fish spoke, after uttering these eight words...
It transformed into a string of bubbles and disappeared.
Looking at this bizarre scene, Lin Yu fell into deep thought.
At first glance, this thing seemed useless, and in reality, it was indeed useless.
"Forget it... anyway, the double rewards were basically free, just consider it bad luck."
Lin Yu muttered, putting away this strange horn gun.
Although Lin Yu quickly accepted it, Hannah on his shoulder was somewhat sad.
"Gua ya, Director, that was a very, very good fish... just one look and you could tell it must have excellent flesh texture."
Lin Yu comforted Hannah.
"It's fine, there are plenty of fish with good flesh texture."
After comforting Hannah, Lin Yu focused on his item space.
Soon, he discovered he had overlooked one gain.
That was the most outrageous harvest from this dungeon.
Lin Yu looked at the item named Delta Team Leader in his item space and sighed.
"Damn it, the Collar's duration has already ended, why can this thing still be considered my possession and follow me out?"
Lin Yu never expected that the Fraudster ability combined with the Counterfeit imitating the Veterinarian's Collar would have such chemical reaction!
That Truth Corporation's Delta Team Leader had actually, like Hannah before...
Become his follower-type item!
Lin Yu thought that after returning to reality, with the Collar's duration ended, that Delta Team Leader would be happily released by him!
Now it seemed, that wasn't the case...
At this point, he could only look at Hannah.
"Um, Hannah, anyway, when I don't call you out, are you conscious?"
Lin Yu asked Hannah, trying to understand her state in the item space.
And Hannah's answer made Lin Yu breathe a slight sigh of relief.
"Not really, Director... that state is like being asleep, and sleeping quite comfortably at that."
"It's an unprecedented feeling of relaxation and comfort."
Lin Yu nodded: "Thank you, Hannah."
Then, he thought for a moment...
Decided to still release that guy!
After all, although the Collar had already expired, since that guy was now his possession, he might still be loyal to him!
At the very least... he probably couldn't harm him.
Thinking this, Lin Yu focused his mind.
Then, the fully armed Delta Team Leader appeared in his room.
This Delta Team Leader momentarily appeared confused, then immediately became alert.
"Damn bastard, what have you done to me! Where is this?!"
He growled lowly, about to charge at Lin Yu.
Lin Yu was startled.
"This is too damn unfair, why is there no sense of loyalty to me at all?!"
Just as Lin Yu prepared to put him back, the Delta Team Leader's movements suddenly froze.
Although his expression couldn't be seen, the Delta Team Leader's body language showed he was in extreme pain, his outstretched hand stuck in mid-air.
"You... what have you done? Why can't I imagine harming you!"
"Is it some kind of mental imprint? Or that brainwashing technique from before!"
"Damn it... then why did you preserve my self-awareness, is this your twisted preference?"

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Deal Sealed
chapters.content:
Facing the other party's accusations, Lin Yu sighed.
It seemed the situation was optimistic but not completely optimistic.
Subjective "loyalty" didn't exist.
But there were still objective hard constraints preventing him from harming Lin Yu.
"I don't have any psychopathic preferences, this was an accident for me too, okay?"
The other party calmed down.
Although Lin Yu had already ended his [False Face] disguise, because of the peculiar relationship between the two, this Delta Team leader could still recognize that the man before him was the "girl" who had brainwashed him earlier.
He sneered angrily: "So your psychopathy just involves disguising as a woman? That sounds like something those bastards from Supreme Evolution would do!"
"I'm not from any company in Sleepless City, and of course, not from the Great Wasteland either..."
Lin Yu tried to explain to him, but unexpectedly discovered...He could suddenly talk about things like 『Death Game』 and 『Player』 with this Delta Team leader.
So, looking at the already quite unhappy and pained leader, Lin Yu decided to add more fuel to the fire.
"Listen to my explanation, I don't come from your world, and this isn't your world anymore either..."
Lin Yu spent about twenty-something minutes briefly explaining and used various phones and searched videos as evidence to help this outstanding Truth Corporation employee roughly accept this setting.
The tall armed man sat in the computer chair in front of Lin Yu's desk, holding his head in his hands.
"So, I'm just a game NPC?"
Lin Yu shook his head: "No, although from my perspective you're an NPC... based on my observations, these game dungeons should all be real worlds—it's just that compared to our world, your worlds are somewhat desolate, dangerous, and smaller in scale."
"Whether your world was created by gods or requisitioned, you're all genuinely living people, not just existing for the game."
Lin Yu explained.
The Delta Team leader sighed.
"But... I can't go back, can I?"
Lin Yu used the fresh [Mind-Peeping Eyepiece] to take a look.
The Delta Team leader's emotions were vividly displayed before him—a large mass of blue with some gray around his body.
Lin Yu couldn't understand it.
But fortunately, the [Mind-Peeping Eyepiece] had analytical functions.
"75% despondent, 13% confused, 10% sorrowful, 2% resentful."
Looking at these emotions, Lin Yu patted the other's shoulder.
"Don't be too upset, this unlucky game of mine is played once a week... if I'm lucky and randomly get near Truth Corporation's area, it'll be like you're getting home leave."
"Besides, you probably didn't have many relatives or friends originally anyway, right?"
As Lin Yu spoke, the Delta Team leader raised his head, somewhat annoyed.
But ultimately, because he couldn't harm Lin Yu, he could only angrily punch his own thigh.
"Whether I have relatives and friends or not is none of your business!"
"Of course it is."
Lin Yu was very calm: "What I'm actually more curious about is... what's your relationship with Pang Kedo? Clone? Imitator?"
As he spoke, Lin Yu stepped forward and, while the other couldn't resist, easily removed the helmet from his head.
What was revealed from under that helmet...
was a face almost identical to Pang Kedo's, just slightly younger and not as haggard and gaunt.
Lin Yu had actually learned about the existence of the "third injustice" earlier than Fu Luo.
Because as the holder of the [Ancient Notebook], he clearly knew that what was inside the notebook at that time definitely wasn't generated based on Baron Coleman's memories—this was something Baron Coleman himself admitted.
In other words, that face really did look quite similar to Pang Kedo.
Combined with Pang Kedo's memory loss...
Based on this, Lin Yu could boldly speculate.
CEO Paris most likely controlled someone who looked quite similar to Pang Kedo.
Even Fu Luo noticed that the wound on Reed's back wasn't from Pang Kedo's usual weapon, so how could Baron Coleman not notice?
He suspected that his close friend must have possessed some decisive evidence.
Like... footage or something similar.
An existence that had undergone the same modifications as Pang Kedo and looked almost identical.
And now this new Delta Team leader, Pang Kedo's successor and Paris's confidant, almost perfectly fit the criteria.
Although before removing the face covering, Lin Yu was only guessing.
But now the facts proved...
Lin Yu had guessed correctly.
"You bastard!"
After Lin Yu removed his face covering, the Delta Team leader "Pang Kedo" before him seemed somewhat angry, but aside from glaring furiously, he could do nothing to Lin Yu.
Lin Yu spoke calmly.
"Whether you're willing or not... in the future, the two of us will have to cooperate and coexist for a long time—and frankly speaking, this cooperation isn't equal."
"Because if I die, you will definitely die."
"If you die, I can still live."
"I've already been honest with you just now, and I'm showing my true face now... so, even if you want to keep your origins secret for now, at least tell me your name."
The Delta Team leader let out a long sigh.
Indeed, he was completely dependent on someone else now.
So...
"You're right, I am a new human created by Paris using Supreme Evolution's immature technology, secretly created from Pang Kedo's genes."
"In a sense, I can be considered his more perfect version."
"I don't have a special name, Paris calls me Zero-One... that's my serial number, you can call me that too."
At this moment, Hannah poked her head out.
"Then you can let Director-sama give you a name, he's really good at naming!"
But Lin Yu shook his head.
"No, he should have a name."
The Delta Team leader before him looked slightly surprised, then nodded.
"Well, when I was in the Great Wasteland before, I had a name... called Stiller, which means tranquility in the Great Wasteland language."
"Nice to meet you, Stiller."
Lin Yu smiled and extended his hand to the other.
The one named Stiller, who looked almost identical to Pang Kedo but with a sharper and more flamboyant expression, hesitated for a moment, then slowly extended his hand as well.
"Okay... Director, right?"
Their hands clasped together, then Stiller released his grip.
"I have one last question—what is that talking pink mollusk next to you? A special intelligent lifeform from your world?"
Stiller looked at Hannah and asked suspiciously.
Lin Yu shook his head: "No, this is Hannah, like you, she's from some dungeon... probably not from the same world as you or me."
"Although our world has octopuses too, they don't talk."
Stiller found this even stranger: "Octopus?"
"A type of marine creature, don't you have them where you're from?"
Hearing Lin Yu's words, Stiller showed a puzzled expression on his face.
Finally, he had a sudden realization.
"So your world has oceans—in Sleepless City and the Great Wasteland, those are already almost mythical legends!"

chapters.title: Chapter 282: The Magic of the Forum!
chapters.content:
From Stiller's statement, Lin Yu also unlocked new information related to the Sleepless City dungeon.
That world seemed to have no ocean.
Although he didn't know what use this information from Stiller would have for now, Lin Yu remembered it.
Afterwards, after temporarily establishing a subtle "cooperative" relationship with Stiller...
Lin Yu put him back into his item space.
This guy followed orders but not declarations—even though he seemed submissive now, Lin Yu didn't dare gamble that he wouldn't have second thoughts in the middle of the night.
As a mere mortal with a physical body, he still needed to sleep.
This artificial human had also undergone strange modifications—what if he slipped out to kill and set fires in the middle of the night?
Putting aside everything else...
Even if Lin Zhao in the next room saw him, it wouldn't be easy to handle.How would Lin Yu explain to his sister why there was suddenly a murderous-looking foreigner in the room?
As for whether Stiller himself liked being stored in the item space...
That was a different matter entirely.
After putting Stiller away, Hannah leaned on the table and spoke.
"So he's an artificial human, no wonder his energy and soul felt so strange..."
Lin Yu looked at Hannah, quite surprised. "You can see human souls too?"
"No, but I can sense them," Hannah gestured with her tentacles in front of her. "Anyway, if Uncle Ka saw him, he'd be overjoyed—this is premium ingredients!"
Hannah casually uttered some rather terrifying words.
Lin Yu instantly thought of that deeply memorable dish—"A Victor's Blood Runs Ever Sweet."
He rubbed his temples.
"Although I had some expectations, formally knowing that your diet includes intelligent beings still makes me feel a bit uncomfortable..."
Hannah scratched her head. "Sorry, Director..."
"No, it's not your fault, just a difference in perspective."
Lin Yu sighed.
If possible, he still hoped that eating "humanoid creatures" wouldn't happen again.
What he ate in that dungeon didn't cross the bottom line—at least that monster seemed to have no intelligence and couldn't speak.
"Enough, no more thinking about this nonsense. Next, I need to start checking messages."
Lin Yu muttered and began another important activity he did every time he returned, besides taking stock of gains.
Handling the messages accumulated across various identities.
He first took out "Zhu Ming's" phone.
Since he had been active as Zhu Ming this time, of course he needed to check if there were any messages on Zhu Ming's side.
Four minutes ago, there was a text message from Li Nian.
"Made it home safely!"
Looking at Li Nian's text, before Lin Yu could reply, another new message popped in.
"About what you mentioned, Sister Pan agreed. Don't forget what I arranged for you either."
Seeing this message, Lin Yu nodded slightly.
Although his contact with Pan Yuqiang had been brief, Lin Yu intuitively felt she was trustworthy.
Afterwards, he put down Zhu Ming's phone and picked up Old Yao's.
He checked the Jiang'an Hall APP—no activity there either, only a private message from Tycoon telling him they planned to promote him to team leader the day after tomorrow.
Lin Yu replied in an extremely flattered tone with "I'm deeply honored and will definitely live up to expectations," adding two cupped fist emojis.
After replying, Lin Yu also set aside this phone.
He picked up the one belonging to "May"—preparing to contact Fu Luo.
On one hand, to fulfill Li Nian's request and arrange a time to deliver the items to Fu Luo.
On the other hand...
Lin Yu also remembered there was another new suspicious point about Fu Luo.
Something he couldn't investigate using Zhu Ming's identity, but that really bothered Lin Yu.
"Who exactly is investigating 'Fluoxetine'?"
"Is he unwilling to expose this matter in front of 'Citalopram,' or... was his forum account hacked?"
"It can't be multiple personality disorder, right?"
As Lin Yu pondered, he finally opened the forum intending to send Fu Luo another private message to contact him.
But the moment he opened the forum...
Lin Yu suddenly saw a prompt pop up on his phone.
A prompt from the forum.
"Detected that you have unlocked [Social] privileges. Would you like to link them to your forum account?"
"Please complete the linking confirmation as soon as possible. Otherwise, after 72 hours you will be unable to use the forum's advanced functions normally."
Lin Yu was stunned.
And if it were just a prompt popping up on his phone, that would be one thing.
But besides this prompt appearing on his phone...
Lin Yu also saw blood-red text popping up before his eyes.
A prompt from the Death Game itself—the [Social] privileges were actually being affected by the forum at this moment and automatically activating!
A message popped up.
["Forum Assistant" has been added to your social list.]
Lin Yu watched as a account named "Forum Assistant" appeared in the [Social] friends list. Focusing his attention on it, Lin Yu discovered that the menu that popped up wasn't the normal chat, trade, team-up functions.
The available options were Visit, Search, and Settings!
Through the "Visit" function, he could actually directly access and browse the forum from there.
However, since Lin Yu hadn't bound his account yet, he couldn't post for now.
At this moment, Lin Yu finally understood why Tycoon had said that after unlocking "privileges," he would hold the forum in even greater awe.
This was just too unbelievable!
Lin Yu now somewhat suspected that the forum's creator might be some deity, like some "God of Watering and Trolling" or something!
"This is just too ridiculous!"
After collecting himself, Lin Yu sent a message to Fu Luo.
"Your stuff got stolen, I already retrieved it for you—find some time to arrange a location, I'll deliver it to you."
After sending the message, the distracted Lin Yu had no patience to wait for Fu Luo's reply. He hurriedly picked up his original phone.
After some contemplation and internal struggle, Lin Yu made a decision—while keeping the May phone still on and in his hand, he also opened the forum interface on his original phone!
Then...
"Detected that you have unlocked [Social] privileges. Would you like to link them to your forum account?"
"Please complete the linking confirmation as soon as possible. Otherwise, after 72 hours you will be unable to use the forum's advanced functions normally."
The same prompt popped up again.
Only this time, Lin Yu's [Social] privileges seemed to have glitched out!
His [Social] template first gained an identical "Forum Assistant" account.
But the blood-red prompt had just appeared when it immediately vanished.
Then, a second "Forum Assistant" account kept popping in and out of existence.
Finally...
Under Lin Yu's tense observation, he felt that this [Social] privilege that originally existed in his mind seemed to have malfunctioned, and then...
It split into two.
Looking at the two [Social] panels, one on the left and one on the right, Lin Yu was completely shocked.
The forum was absolutely several times more mysterious and powerful than Tycoon or any other player could imagine.
Because from what just happened, Lin Yu felt he had discovered a fact that probably only he could verify.
The authority of this forum APP that existed in reality seemed to be even higher than the blood-red prompts of the Death Game itself!
